`client/src/binds.rs`:

```rs
//! Key bindings: every action the player can rebind, with CS's defaults, saved in
//! ~/.config/bootleg16/binds.txt by name ("forward=KeyW", "fire=MouseLeft"). Game code asks
//! `Binds` (`held`, `just`) instead of naming keys. Rebinding: `capture` waits for the next key
//! or mouse button (Esc cancels); a key already used moves over and the other action takes the
//! old one, so nothing is ever left unbound or doubled.
//! Keys are kept by position (Bevy's `KeyCode`), so the same keys sit in the same place on any
//! layout; labels show what they print on yours (`Layout`, learned from typing: AZERTY shows Z
//! Q S D for movement).
//! Fixed on purpose: Esc (menus), Enter, the buy menu's number keys, the mouse wheel.
use bevy::prelude::*;
use std::path::PathBuf;

/// A key or a mouse button, saved by name ("KeyK", "MouseBack").
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Bind {
    Key(KeyCode),
    Mouse(MouseButton),
}

/// Keys that can be bound (by their saved names).
pub const KEYS: [KeyCode; 62] = {
    use KeyCode::*;
    [
        KeyA, KeyB, KeyC, KeyD, KeyE, KeyF, KeyG, KeyH, KeyI, KeyJ, KeyK, KeyL, KeyM, KeyN, KeyO, KeyP, KeyQ, KeyR, KeyS, KeyT, KeyU, KeyV, KeyW, KeyX, KeyY, KeyZ, Digit0, Digit1,
        Digit2, Digit3, Digit4, Digit5, Digit6, Digit7, Digit8, Digit9, F1, F2, F3, F4, F5, F6, F7, F8, F9, F10, F11, F12, Space, Tab, CapsLock, ShiftLeft, ShiftRight,
        ControlLeft, ControlRight, AltLeft, AltRight, Backquote, Comma, Period, Slash, Semicolon,
    ]
};
pub const MICE: [MouseButton; 5] = [MouseButton::Left, MouseButton::Right, MouseButton::Middle, MouseButton::Back, MouseButton::Forward];

impl Bind {
    pub fn name(self) -> String {
        match self {
            Bind::Key(k) => format!("{k:?}"),
            Bind::Mouse(m) => format!("Mouse{m:?}"),
        }
    }

    pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Option<Bind> {
        KEYS.iter().find(|k| format!("{k:?}") == s).map(|k| Bind::Key(*k)).or_else(|| MICE.iter().find(|m| format!("Mouse{m:?}") == s).map(|m| Bind::Mouse(*m)))
    }

    /// As shown to the player on this keyboard layout: "K", "5", "Space", "Mouse Back".
    pub fn label(self, layout: Layout) -> String {
        // keys are kept by position; on AZERTY some positions print another letter
        if let (Layout::Azerty, Bind::Key(k)) = (layout, self) {
            let swapped = match k {
                KeyCode::KeyA => Some("Q"),
                KeyCode::KeyQ => Some("A"),
                KeyCode::KeyW => Some("Z"),
                KeyCode::KeyZ => Some("W"),
                KeyCode::Semicolon => Some("M"),
                KeyCode::KeyM => Some(","),
                _ => None,
            };
            if let Some(s) = swapped {
                return s.into();
            }
        }
        let n = self.name();
        let n = n.strip_prefix("Key").or_else(|| n.strip_prefix("Digit")).map(str::to_string).unwrap_or(n);
        match n.as_str() {
            "ControlLeft" => "Ctrl".into(),
            "ControlRight" => "Right Ctrl".into(),
            "ShiftLeft" => "Shift".into(),
            "ShiftRight" => "Right Shift".into(),
            "AltLeft" => "Alt".into(),
            "AltRight" => "Right Alt".into(),
            "MouseLeft" => "Mouse 1".into(),
            "MouseRight" => "Mouse 2".into(),
            "MouseMiddle" => "Mouse 3".into(),
            _ => n.replace("Mouse", "Mouse "),
        }
    }

    pub fn held(self, keys: &ButtonInput<KeyCode>, mouse: &ButtonInput<MouseButton>) -> bool {
        match self {
            Bind::Key(k) => keys.pressed(k),
            Bind::Mouse(m) => mouse.pressed(m),
        }
    }

    pub fn just(self, keys: &ButtonInput<KeyCode>, mouse: &ButtonInput<MouseButton>) -> bool {
        match self {
            Bind::Key(k) => keys.just_pressed(k),
            Bind::Mouse(m) => mouse.just_pressed(m),
        }
    }
}

/// The keyboard's layout, learned from what keys type (see `learn_layout`).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub enum Layout {
    #[default]
    Qwerty,
    Azerty,
}

/// What a key does. The order is the order on the Keys page.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Action {
    Forward,
    Back,
    Left,
    Right,
    Jump,
    Crouch,
    Walk,
    Use,
    Fire,
    AltFire,
    Reload,
    Drop,
    LastWeapon,
    Primary,
    Secondary,
    Knife,
    Grenade,
    Bomb,
    Buy,
    Scores,
    Teams,
    TeamVoice,
    NearVoice,
    VoteYes,
    VoteNo,
    Surrender,
}

use Action::*;

/// Every action with its saved name, its label and CS's default.
pub const ACTIONS: [(Action, &str, &str, Bind); 26] = [
    (Forward, "forward", "Forward", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyW)),
    (Back, "back", "Back", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyS)),
    (Left, "left", "Left", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyA)),
    (Right, "right", "Right", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyD)),
    (Jump, "jump", "Jump", Bind::Key(KeyCode::Space)),
    (Crouch, "crouch", "Crouch", Bind::Key(KeyCode::ControlLeft)),
    (Walk, "walk", "Walk", Bind::Key(KeyCode::ShiftLeft)),
    (Use, "use", "Use", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyE)),
    (Fire, "fire", "Fire", Bind::Mouse(MouseButton::Left)),
    (AltFire, "alt_fire", "Alt fire, scope", Bind::Mouse(MouseButton::Right)),
    (Reload, "reload", "Reload", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyR)),
    (Drop, "drop", "Drop", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyG)),
    (LastWeapon, "last_weapon", "Last weapon", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyQ)),
    (Primary, "primary", "Primary", Bind::Key(KeyCode::Digit1)),
    (Secondary, "secondary", "Pistol", Bind::Key(KeyCode::Digit2)),
    (Knife, "knife", "Knife", Bind::Key(KeyCode::Digit3)),
    (Grenade, "grenade", "Grenades", Bind::Key(KeyCode::Digit4)),
    (Bomb, "bomb", "Bomb", Bind::Key(KeyCode::Digit5)),
    (Buy, "buy", "Buy menu", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyB)),
    (Scores, "scores", "Scoreboard", Bind::Key(KeyCode::Tab)),
    (Teams, "teams", "Choose team", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyM)),
    // V rather than CS's K: next to the movement keys
    (TeamVoice, "team_voice", "Team voice", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyV)),
    (NearVoice, "near_voice", "Proximity voice", Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyX)),
    (VoteYes, "vote_yes", "Vote yes", Bind::Key(KeyCode::F1)),
    (VoteNo, "vote_no", "Vote no", Bind::Key(KeyCode::F2)),
    (Surrender, "surrender", "Call surrender", Bind::Key(KeyCode::F3)),
];

/// The Keys page's three columns: (title, first, last) into `ACTIONS`.
pub const GROUPS: [(&str, usize, usize); 3] = [("Move", 0, 8), ("Weapons", 8, 18), ("Game · voice", 18, 26)];

/// The bindings, and the action waiting for a key on the Keys page.
#[derive(Resource, Clone)]
pub struct Binds {
    keys: [Bind; ACTIONS.len()],
    pub capture: Option<Action>,
    pub layout: Layout,
}

fn index(a: Action) -> usize {
    ACTIONS.iter().position(|e| e.0 == a).expect("every action is listed")
}

impl Default for Binds {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Binds { keys: ACTIONS.map(|e| e.3), capture: None, layout: Layout::Qwerty }
    }
}

fn path() -> PathBuf {
    crate::gamefiles::config_dir()
}

impl Binds {
    pub fn get(&self, a: Action) -> Bind {
        self.keys[index(a)]
    }

    pub fn held(&self, a: Action, keys: &ButtonInput<KeyCode>, mouse: &ButtonInput<MouseButton>) -> bool {
        self.get(a).held(keys, mouse)
    }

    pub fn just(&self, a: Action, keys: &ButtonInput<KeyCode>, mouse: &ButtonInput<MouseButton>) -> bool {
        self.get(a).just(keys, mouse)
    }

    /// Bind `a` to `b`; an action that had `b` takes `a`'s old key.
    pub fn set(&mut self, a: Action, b: Bind) {
        let i = index(a);
        let old = self.keys[i];
        if let Some(j) = self.keys.iter().position(|k| *k == b) {
            self.keys[j] = old;
        }
        self.keys[i] = b;
    }

    /// From the text of binds.txt (unknown names and keys are skipped).
    fn parse(text: &str) -> Binds {
        let mut b = Binds::default();
        for line in text.lines() {
            let Some((name, v)) = line.split_once('=') else { continue };
            if name.trim() == "layout" {
                b.layout = if v.trim() == "azerty" { Layout::Azerty } else { Layout::Qwerty };
                continue;
            }
            let (Some(e), Some(key)) = (ACTIONS.iter().find(|e| e.1 == name.trim()), Bind::parse(v.trim())) else { continue };
            b.set(e.0, key);
        }
        b
    }

    fn text(&self) -> String {
        let layout = if self.layout == Layout::Azerty { "azerty" } else { "qwerty" };
        format!("layout={layout}\n") + &ACTIONS.iter().zip(self.keys).map(|(e, k)| format!("{}={}\n", e.1, k.name())).collect::<String>()
    }

    pub fn load() -> Binds {
        let dir = path();
        if let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("binds.txt")) {
            return Binds::parse(&text);
        }
        // before binds.txt, the voice keys were in voice.txt (keys changed from the old
        // defaults K and X carry over)
        let mut b = Binds::default();
        for line in std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("voice.txt")).unwrap_or_default().lines() {
            match line.split_once('=') {
                Some(("team_key", v)) if v.trim() != "KeyK" => _ = Bind::parse(v.trim()).map(|k| b.set(TeamVoice, k)),
                Some(("near_key", v)) if v.trim() != "KeyX" => _ = Bind::parse(v.trim()).map(|k| b.set(NearVoice, k)),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        b
    }

    pub fn save(&self) {
        let dir = path();
        let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
        let _ = std::fs::write(dir.join("binds.txt"), self.text());
    }
}

/// Waiting for a key: the next key or mouse button takes it (Esc cancels).
fn capture(mut b: ResMut<Binds>, keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>, mouse: Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>, mut dirty: ResMut<crate::menu::MenuDirty>, mut armed: Local<bool>) {
    let Some(a) = b.capture else {
        *armed = false;
        return;
    };
    // the click that asked for a key isn't the key
    if !*armed {
        *armed = true;
        return;
    }
    if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Escape) {
        b.capture = None;
        dirty.0 = true;
        return;
    }
    let pressed = keys.get_just_pressed().find_map(|k| KEYS.contains(k).then_some(Bind::Key(*k))).or_else(|| mouse.get_just_pressed().find_map(|m| MICE.contains(m).then_some(Bind::Mouse(*m))));
    let Some(k) = pressed else { return };
    b.set(a, k);
    b.capture = None;
    b.save();
    dirty.0 = true;
}

/// The layout from what keys type: the key at QWERTY's Q typing "a" (or W typing "z") is
/// AZERTY. Learned from any key press, saved with the bindings, labels follow.
fn learn_layout(mut events: MessageReader<bevy::input::keyboard::KeyboardInput>, mut b: ResMut<Binds>, mut dirty: ResMut<crate::menu::MenuDirty>) {
    use bevy::input::keyboard::Key;
    for ev in events.read() {
        let Key::Character(c) = &ev.logical_key else { continue };
        let c = c.to_lowercase();
        let layout = match (ev.key_code, c.as_str()) {
            (KeyCode::KeyQ, "a") | (KeyCode::KeyW, "z") => Layout::Azerty,
            (KeyCode::KeyQ, "q") | (KeyCode::KeyW, "w") => Layout::Qwerty,
            _ => continue,
        };
        if b.layout != layout {
            b.layout = layout;
            b.save();
            dirty.0 = true;
        }
    }
}

pub struct BindsPlugin;

impl Plugin for BindsPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.insert_resource(Binds::load()).add_systems(Update, (capture.run_if(in_state(crate::menu::AppState::Menu)), learn_layout));
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn a_taken_key_swaps_instead_of_doubling() {
        let mut b = Binds::default();
        b.set(Jump, Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyW));
        assert_eq!(b.get(Jump), Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyW));
        assert_eq!(b.get(Forward), Bind::Key(KeyCode::Space));
        let mut all: Vec<String> = b.keys.iter().map(|k| k.name()).collect();
        all.sort();
        all.dedup();
        assert_eq!(all.len(), ACTIONS.len());
    }

    #[test]
    fn saved_and_loaded_by_name() {
        let mut b = Binds::default();
        b.set(Fire, Bind::Mouse(MouseButton::Back));
        b.set(TeamVoice, Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyC));
        let back = Binds::parse(&b.text());
        assert_eq!(back.get(Fire), Bind::Mouse(MouseButton::Back));
        assert_eq!(back.get(TeamVoice), Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyC));
        assert_eq!(Binds::default().get(TeamVoice), Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyV));
        assert_eq!(Binds::parse("nonsense\nforward=NoSuchKey\n").get(Forward), Bind::Key(KeyCode::KeyW));
    }

    #[test]
    fn azerty_labels_follow_the_layout() {
        let b = Binds::default();
        assert_eq!(b.get(Forward).label(Layout::Qwerty), "W");
        assert_eq!(b.get(Forward).label(Layout::Azerty), "Z");
        assert_eq!(b.get(Left).label(Layout::Azerty), "Q");
        assert_eq!(b.get(LastWeapon).label(Layout::Azerty), "A");
        assert_eq!(b.get(Jump).label(Layout::Azerty), "Space");
        let mut az = Binds::default();
        az.layout = Layout::Azerty;
        assert_eq!(Binds::parse(&az.text()).layout, Layout::Azerty);
    }

    #[test]
    fn groups_cover_every_action_once() {
        assert_eq!(GROUPS[0].1, 0);
        assert!(GROUPS.windows(2).all(|w| w[0].2 == w[1].1));
        assert_eq!(GROUPS[2].2, ACTIONS.len());
    }
}
```

`client/src/bomb.rs`:

```rs
//! The bomb in the world: the backpack when it's dropped, the planted C4 with its blinking
//! light and beeps that speed up as it runs down.
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::models::{self, Parts};
use crate::{map, sound};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use net::protocol::BombNet;

pub struct BombPlugin;

impl Plugin for BombPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(Update, (show_bomb, beeps).in_set(Frame::World));
    }
}

#[derive(Component)]
struct BombView;

#[derive(Component)]
struct BombLight;

/// What is drawn now: dropped or planted, and where.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Shown {
    Dropped([f32; 3]),
    Planted([f32; 3]),
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn show_bomb(
    mut commands: Commands,
    w: Res<Walker>,
    mut cache: ResMut<models::ModelCache>,
    mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>,
    mut materials: ResMut<Assets<StandardMaterial>>,
    mut studio: ResMut<Assets<crate::studio::StudioMaterial>>,
    mut meshes: ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>,
    mut parts: Local<Option<(Parts, Parts, Handle<Mesh>, Handle<StandardMaterial>)>>,
    mut shown: Local<Option<Shown>>,
    views: Query<Entity, With<BombView>>,
) {
    let want = match w.client.bomb {
        BombNet::Dropped(at) => Some(Shown::Dropped(at)),
        BombNet::Planted { at, .. } => Some(Shown::Planted(at)),
        _ => None,
    };
    if *shown == want {
        return;
    }
    *shown = want;
    for e in &views {
        commands.entity(e).despawn();
    }
    let Some(want) = want else { return };
    let (backpack, c4, light, red) = parts.get_or_insert_with(|| {
        let mut load = |file: &str| match cache.get(file, &mut images, &mut studio) {
            Some(m) => models::static_parts(&m, &m.model.pose(0, 0, 0.0), &mut meshes),
            None => Vec::new(),
        };
        let (b, c) = (load("w_backpack.mdl"), load("w_c4.mdl"));
        (b, c, meshes.add(Sphere::new(1.2)), materials.add(StandardMaterial { base_color: Color::srgb(1.0, 0.1, 0.05), unlit: true, ..default() }))
    });
    let (at, list) = match want {
        Shown::Dropped(at) => (at, &*backpack),
        Shown::Planted(at) => (at, &*c4),
    };
    let parent = commands.spawn((BombView, Transform::from_translation(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(at))), Visibility::default(), DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame))).id();
    models::spawn_lit(&mut commands, parent, list, &mut studio);
    if matches!(want, Shown::Planted(_)) {
        let l = commands.spawn((BombLight, Mesh3d(light.clone()), MeshMaterial3d(red.clone()), Transform::from_xyz(0.0, 5.0, 0.0), Visibility::Hidden)).id();
        commands.entity(parent).add_child(l);
    }
}

/// Beep (and blink) faster as the timer runs down; CS goes through five beep sounds.
fn beeps(time: Res<Time>, mut w: ResMut<Walker>, mut next: Local<f32>, mut total: Local<f32>, mut lights: Query<&mut Visibility, With<BombLight>>) {
    let BombNet::Planted { at, left, .. } = w.client.bomb else {
        *total = 0.0;
        return;
    };
    if *total < left {
        *total = left; // first sight of it: about the full timer
        *next = 0.0;
    }
    let frac = (left / total.max(0.01)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    let blink = now < *next - (0.1 + 1.4 * frac) * 0.5; // lit for the first half of each gap
    for mut v in &mut lights {
        v.set_if_neq(if blink { Visibility::Inherited } else { Visibility::Hidden });
    }
    if now >= *next {
        *next = now + 0.1 + 1.4 * frac;
        const BEEPS: [&str; 5] = ["weapons/c4_beep1.wav", "weapons/c4_beep2.wav", "weapons/c4_beep3.wav", "weapons/c4_beep4.wav", "weapons/c4_beep5.wav"];
        let file = BEEPS[(((1.0 - frac) * 5.0) as usize).min(4)];
        w.cues.push(sound::Cue::At { file, at, far: false });
    }
}

```

`client/src/buy.rs`:

```rs
//! The buy menu (B), direction E: a full-screen armory with the categories on the left
//! and a card per item (picture, name, price). CS 1.6 keys still work (number picks,
//! 0 closes) and everything is clickable. No ammo to buy: guns come full and reserves
//! are topped up every round.
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::hud::{weapon_icon, Icons};
use crate::ui::{chip, clickable_keep_border, kit_text, nav, primary_button, primary_off, vh, Anim, Kit, NavItem, UiAction, UiActions, AMBER, BAD, BG1, CT_COLOR, LINE, OK, TX1, TX2, TX3, T_COLOR};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::window::{CursorGrabMode, CursorOptions};
use net::protocol::{BuyItem, Team};
use net::server::buy::price;

/// Teammates with less than this show red in the buy menu: they can't buy a rifle (an AK-47).
const RIFLE: i32 = 2700;
/// Two clicks on a card within this many seconds buy it.
const DOUBLE_CLICK: f32 = 0.4;

pub struct BuyPlugin;

impl Plugin for BuyPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.init_resource::<BuyMenu>()
            .add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::InGame), spawn)
            .add_systems(Update, buy_menu.in_set(Frame::Ui));
    }
}

/// Closed (None), open on the categories (Some(None)) or on one category.
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct BuyMenu(Option<Option<usize>>, usize);

impl BuyMenu {
    pub fn is_open(&self) -> bool {
        self.0.is_some()
    }
}

/// One buy menu category: its name and items.
#[derive(Clone)]
struct Entry(&'static str, Vec<(&'static str, BuyItem)>);

/// Terrorists and counter-terrorists see different guns.
fn layout(ct: bool) -> Vec<Entry> {
    use sim::weapons::Id::*;
    use BuyItem::*;
    let side = |t: (&'static str, sim::weapons::Id), c: (&'static str, sim::weapons::Id)| if ct { (c.0, Weapon(c.1)) } else { (t.0, Weapon(t.1)) };
    let mut equipment = vec![("Kevlar", Kevlar), ("Kevlar + Helmet", KevlarHelmet), ("Flashbang", Weapon(Flashbang)), ("HE Grenade", Weapon(HeGrenade)), ("Smoke Grenade", Weapon(Smoke))];
    if ct {
        equipment.push(("Defuse Kit", DefuseKit));
    }
    vec![
        Entry("Pistols", vec![("Glock-18", Weapon(Glock)), ("USP", Weapon(Usp)), ("P228", Weapon(P228)), ("Desert Eagle", Weapon(Deagle))]),
        Entry("SMGs", vec![side(("MAC-10", Mac10), ("TMP", Tmp)), ("MP5", Weapon(Mp5)), ("UMP45", Weapon(Ump45)), ("P90", Weapon(P90))]),
        Entry(
            "Rifles",
            if ct {
                vec![("FAMAS", Weapon(Famas)), ("M4A1", Weapon(M4a1)), ("Scout", Weapon(Scout)), ("AWP", Weapon(Awp))]
            } else {
                vec![("Galil", Weapon(Galil)), ("AK-47", Weapon(Ak47)), ("Scout", Weapon(Scout)), ("AWP", Weapon(Awp))]
            },
        ),
        Entry("Equipment", equipment),
    ]
}



#[derive(Component)]
struct BuyRoot;

fn spawn(mut menu: ResMut<BuyMenu>) {
    menu.0 = None;
    menu.1 = 0;
}

/// B opens / closes; with the menu open the mouse is free to click, and number keys work as in CS.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn buy_menu(
    mut commands: Commands,
    (kit, icons): (Res<Kit>, Res<Icons>),
    keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>,
    mut actions: ResMut<UiActions>,
    mut w: ResMut<Walker>,
    mut menu: ResMut<BuyMenu>,
    mut shown: Local<Option<(Option<Option<usize>>, usize, Team, i32, Vec<(String, i32, bool)>)>>,
    mut cursor: Single<&mut CursorOptions>,
    roots: Query<Entity, With<BuyRoot>>,
    mut hints: MessageWriter<crate::hud::Hint>,
    (binds, mouse): (Res<crate::binds::Binds>, Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>),
    (time, mut last_click): (Res<Time>, Local<Option<(usize, f32)>>),
) {
    let auto = std::env::var_os("BOOTLEG16_SCREENSHOT").is_some();
    if auto && std::env::var_os("BOOTLEG16_MENU").is_none() {
        return;
    }
    let team = w.client.team();
    let ct = team == Team::Ct;
    let layout = layout(ct);
    let was_open = menu.0.is_some();
    // Number keys become the same actions as clicks.
    let digits = [KeyCode::Digit0, KeyCode::Digit1, KeyCode::Digit2, KeyCode::Digit3, KeyCode::Digit4, KeyCode::Digit5, KeyCode::Digit6, KeyCode::Digit7, KeyCode::Digit8, KeyCode::Digit9];
    let can_buy = w.client.me_info.can_buy;
    // Enter buys the selected card.
    if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Enter) {
        if let Some(Some(cat)) = menu.0 {
            if let Some(Entry(_, items)) = layout.get(cat) {
                if let Some((_, item)) = items.get(menu.1) {
                    actions.0.push(UiAction::Buy(*item));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let b_pressed = binds.just(crate::binds::Action::Buy, &keys, &mouse);
    if b_pressed && can_buy {
        menu.0 = if menu.0.is_some() { None } else { Some(None) };
    } else if b_pressed && w.client.vitals.alive() && team != Team::Spectator {
        // say why instead of ignoring the key
        let side = if ct { sim::zones::Side::Ct } else { sim::zones::Side::T };
        let why = if w.client.world.zones.in_buy_zone(side, w.client.me().origin) { "Buy time is over" } else { "Not in a buy zone" };
        hints.write(crate::hud::Hint(why.into()));
    } else if let (Some(state), Some(n)) = (menu.0, digits.iter().position(|k| keys.just_pressed(*k))) {
        let i = n.wrapping_sub(1);
        actions.0.push(match (n, state) {
            (0, _) => UiAction::CloseBuy,
            (_, None) => UiAction::BuyCategory(i),
            (_, Some(cat)) => match layout.get(cat) {
                Some(Entry(_, items)) if i < items.len() => UiAction::Buy(items[i].1),
                _ => UiAction::BuyCategory(cat),
            },
        });
    }
    let mut buy_now = false;
    actions.0.retain(|a| match a {
        UiAction::CloseBuy => {
            menu.0 = None;
            false
        }
        UiAction::UndoBuys => {
            w.client.undo_buys();
            false
        }
        UiAction::BuyCategory(i) => {
            if *i < layout.len() {
                menu.0 = Some(Some(*i));
                menu.1 = 0;
            }
            false
        }
        UiAction::SelectBuy(i) => {
            menu.1 = *i;
            // a second click on the same card soon after buys it
            let now = time.elapsed_secs();
            if last_click.is_some_and(|(j, at)| j == *i && now - at < DOUBLE_CLICK) {
                *last_click = None;
                buy_now = true;
            } else {
                *last_click = Some((*i, now));
            }
            false
        }
        UiAction::Buy(item) => {
            w.client.buy(*item);
            menu.0 = None;
            false
        }
        _ => true,
    });
    // Buy time over, left the buy zone, died: the menu goes away.
    if buy_now {
        if let Some(Some(cat)) = menu.0 {
            if let Some((_, item)) = layout.get(cat).and_then(|Entry(_, items)| items.get(menu.1)) {
                w.client.buy(*item);
                menu.0 = None;
            }
        }
    }
    if !can_buy && !auto {
        menu.0 = None;
    }
    if auto && menu.0.is_none() {
        // Screenshot check: `BOOTLEG16_MENU=<page>` (0 pistols .. 3 equipment; default rifles).
        menu.0 = Some(Some(std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_MENU").ok().and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(2)));
    }
    // Free the mouse while buying; take it back when done.
    if menu.0.is_some() && !was_open {
        cursor.grab_mode = CursorGrabMode::None;
        cursor.visible = true;
    } else if menu.0.is_none() && was_open && !auto {
        cursor.grab_mode = CursorGrabMode::Locked;
        cursor.visible = false;
    }

    let money = w.client.me_info.money;
    // teammates' money (CS2): who can buy, who needs a drop. The server only sends your team's.
    let mates: Vec<(String, i32, bool)> = w.client.scores.iter().filter(|s| Some(s.id) != w.client.id()).filter_map(|s| s.money.map(|m| (s.name.clone(), m, s.alive))).collect();
    if *shown == Some((menu.0, menu.1, team, money, mates.clone())) {
        return;
    }
    // What changed decides what moves: opening tunes everything in; a new category tunes the
    // cards in (staggered) and the details; a new card just the details; closing tunes out.
    let prev = shown.replace((menu.0, menu.1, team, money, mates.clone()));
    let was = prev.as_ref().and_then(|p| p.0);
    let opening = was.is_none();
    let new_cat = opening || was != Some(menu.0.unwrap_or(None)) || prev.as_ref().map(|p| p.2) != Some(team);
    let new_item = new_cat || prev.as_ref().map(|p| p.1) != Some(menu.1);
    for e in &roots {
        if menu.0.is_none() {
            commands.entity(e).remove::<(BuyRoot, crate::ui::Blurs)>().insert(Anim::tune_out());
        } else {
            commands.entity(e).despawn();
        }
    }
    let Some(state) = menu.0 else { return };
    let tune = |on: bool, i: usize| on.then(|| Anim::stagger(i));
    let free = w.client.practice || w.client.round.phase == net::rounds::Phase::Warmup;
    let cost = |item: BuyItem| match price(item) {
        _ if free => "FREE".to_string(),
        Some(p) => format!("${p}"),
        None => String::new(),
    };
    // Prices you can't pay show red, the card dims.
    let afford = |item: BuyItem| free || price(item).is_none_or(|p| p <= money);
    let team_color = if ct { CT_COLOR } else { T_COLOR };
    let cat = state.unwrap_or(0);
    let Some(Entry(_, items)) = layout.get(cat).cloned() else { return };
    let sel = menu.1.min(items.len().saturating_sub(1));
    let abs = |node: Node| Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, ..node };
    // Layout at 1080p (from the mockup): 96 side margins; header at 120 under the HUD's
    // top band; categories 96..456, cards 496..1316 (2 columns), details 1356..1824.
    let top = 240.0;
    commands
        .spawn((
            BuyRoot,
            DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame),
            Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), height: percent(100), ..default() },
            crate::ui::Blurs(0.9),
            GlobalZIndex(7),
        ))
        .with_children(|root| {
            let mut head = root.spawn((abs(Node { left: vh(96.0), right: vh(96.0), top: vh(120.0), height: vh(96.0), align_items: AlignItems::FlexEnd, padding: UiRect::bottom(vh(24.0)), border: UiRect::bottom(px(1)), ..default() }), BorderColor::all(LINE)));
            if let Some(a) = tune(opening, 0) {
                head.insert(a);
            }
            head.with_children(|h| {
                    h.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, row_gap: vh(8.0), ..default() }).with_children(|t| {
                        t.spawn(kit_text(if ct { "BUY · BUREAU" } else { "BUY · STRAYS" }, 13.0, team_color, &kit.text));
                        t.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Baseline, column_gap: vh(16.0), ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
                            r.spawn(kit_text("ARMORY", 52.0, TX1, &kit.display));
                            r.spawn(kit_text("武器庫", 13.0, TX3, &kit.jp));
                        });
                    });
                    if !free && !mates.is_empty() {
                        h.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect::left(Val::Auto), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::FlexEnd, row_gap: vh(8.0), ..default() }).with_children(|t| {
                            t.spawn(kit_text("TEAM", 13.0, TX2, &kit.text));
                            t.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(24.0), ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
                                for (name, m, alive) in &mates {
                                    let dim = if *alive { 1.0 } else { 0.45 };
                                    r.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Baseline, column_gap: vh(8.0), ..default() }).with_children(|b| {
                                        b.spawn(kit_text(name.clone(), 16.0, TX2.with_alpha(dim), &kit.text));
                                        b.spawn(kit_text(format!("${m}"), 20.0, if *m < RIFLE { BAD } else { TX1 }.with_alpha(dim), &kit.num));
                                    });
                                }
                            });
                        });
                    }
                    let lead = if !free && !mates.is_empty() { vh(48.0) } else { Val::Auto };
                    h.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect::left(lead), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::FlexEnd, row_gap: vh(8.0), ..default() }).with_children(|f| {
                        f.spawn(kit_text("FUNDS", 13.0, TX2, &kit.text));
                        f.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Baseline, column_gap: vh(4.0), ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
                            if free {
                                r.spawn(kit_text("FREE", 44.0, OK, &kit.num));
                            } else {
                                r.spawn(kit_text("$", 44.0, OK, &kit.num));
                                r.spawn(kit_text(money.to_string(), 44.0, TX1, &kit.num));
                            }
                        });
                    });
                });
            // Categories.
            let mut cats = root.spawn(abs(Node { left: vh(96.0), top: vh(top), width: vh(360.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() }));
            if let Some(a) = tune(opening, 1) {
                cats.insert(a);
            }
            cats.with_children(|col| {
                let nums: Vec<String> = (1..=layout.len()).map(|i| format!("{i:02}")).collect();
                nav(col, &kit, "buy.cat", layout.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, e)| NavItem { num: &nums[i], label: e.0, jp: "", action: UiAction::BuyCategory(i), selected: i == cat }).collect(), true);
                col.spawn((kit_text("1-9 · BUY    ENTER · BUY SELECTED    0 · CLOSE", 13.0, TX3, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(24.0)), padding: UiRect::left(vh(16.0)), ..default() }));
                // sell back this round's buys (the server refunds only what's unused)
                if !free {
                    col.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect { top: vh(24.0), left: vh(16.0), ..default() }, ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
                        chip(r, &kit, "Undo buys", UiAction::UndoBuys, false);
                    });
                }
            });
            // Cards, two columns.
            root.spawn(abs(Node { left: vh(496.0), width: vh(820.0), top: vh(top), flex_wrap: FlexWrap::Wrap, column_gap: vh(16.0), row_gap: vh(16.0), align_content: AlignContent::FlexStart, ..default() })).with_children(|grid| {
                for (i, (name, item)) in items.iter().enumerate() {
                    let ok = afford(*item);
                    let selected = i == sel;
                    let base = if selected { BG1.mix(&AMBER, 0.08) } else { BG1 };
                    let mut card = grid.spawn(crate::ui::card(Node { width: vh(402.0), height: vh(200.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, padding: UiRect::axes(vh(24.0), vh(20.0)), ..default() }, selected));
                    if let Some(a) = tune(new_cat, i + 2) {
                        card.insert(a);
                    }
                    card.with_children(|c| {
                        c.spawn(Node { justify_content: JustifyContent::SpaceBetween, ..default() }).with_children(|top| {
                            top.spawn((kit_text(format!("{}", i + 1), 13.0, if selected { AMBER } else { TX2 }, &kit.text), Pickable::IGNORE));
                            top.spawn((kit_text(cost(*item), 20.0, if ok { TX1 } else { BAD }, &kit.num), Pickable::IGNORE));
                        });
                        c.spawn((Node { flex_grow: 1.0, justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE)).with_children(|pic| {
                            item_art(pic, &icons, *item, 76.0, if ok { TX1 } else { TX3 });
                        });
                        c.spawn((kit_text(name.to_uppercase(), 26.0, if ok { TX1 } else { TX3 }, &kit.text), Pickable::IGNORE));
                    });
                    clickable_keep_border(&mut card, UiAction::SelectBuy(i), base);
                }
            });
            // Details of the selected card.
            let (name, item) = items[sel];
            root.spawn((abs(Node { left: vh(1356.0), right: vh(96.0), top: vh(top), bottom: vh(96.0), ..default() }), BackgroundColor(BG1)))
                .with_children(|panel| {
                    let mut d = panel.spawn(Node { flex_grow: 1.0, flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, padding: UiRect::all(vh(32.0)), ..default() });
                    if let Some(a) = tune(new_item, if opening { 3 } else { 0 }) {
                        d.insert(a);
                    }
                    d.with_children(|d| {
                    d.spawn(kit_text(format!("{} · SELECTED", layout[cat].0.to_uppercase()), 13.0, AMBER, &kit.text));
                    // the name fills the panel width at most
                    let size = (404.0 / (name.len() as f32 * 0.43)).min(96.0);
                    d.spawn((kit_text(name.to_uppercase(), size, TX1, &kit.display), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(8.0)), ..default() }));
                    d.spawn(Node { height: vh(150.0), margin: UiRect::vertical(vh(16.0)), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }).with_children(|pic| {
                        item_art(pic, &icons, item, 120.0, TX1);
                    });
                    for (label, value, frac) in stats(item) {
                        d.spawn((Node { height: vh(44.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, column_gap: vh(16.0), border: UiRect::top(px(1)), ..default() }, BorderColor::all(LINE))).with_children(|r| {
                            r.spawn((kit_text(label, 13.0, TX2, &kit.text), Node { width: vh(110.0), ..default() }));
                            r.spawn((Node { flex_grow: 1.0, height: vh(4.0), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(LINE))).with_children(|b| {
                                b.spawn((Node { width: percent(frac.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 100.0), height: percent(100), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(TX1)));
                            });
                            r.spawn((kit_text(value, 16.0, TX1, &kit.num), Node { width: vh(92.0), justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexEnd, ..default() }));
                        });
                    }
                    d.spawn(Node { flex_grow: 1.0, ..default() });
                    if afford(item) {
                        primary_button(d, &kit, &format!("Buy · {}", cost(item)), "Enter", UiAction::Buy(item));
                    } else {
                        primary_off(d, &kit, &format!("Buy · {}", cost(item)), &format!("Need ${}", price(item).unwrap_or(0) - money));
                    }
                    });
                });
        });
}

/// The picture for an item: gun art, or the HUD icon for armor and the kit.
fn item_art(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, icons: &Icons, item: BuyItem, height: f32, color: Color) {
    let name = match item {
        BuyItem::Weapon(id) => Some(weapon_icon(id)),
        BuyItem::Kevlar => Some("suit_full"),
        BuyItem::KevlarHelmet => Some("suithelmet_full"),
        BuyItem::DefuseKit => Some("defuser"),
    };
    let h = if matches!(item, BuyItem::Weapon(_)) { height } else { height * 0.8 };
    if let Some(n) = name {
        p.spawn((icons.node_in(n, h, 3.8, color), Pickable::IGNORE));
    }
}

/// Real numbers from the weapon data: label, value, bar fill (0..1).
fn stats(item: BuyItem) -> Vec<(&'static str, String, f32)> {
    use sim::weapons::data::Kind;
    let BuyItem::Weapon(id) = item else {
        return match item {
            BuyItem::Kevlar => vec![("ARMOR", "100".into(), 1.0)],
            BuyItem::KevlarHelmet => vec![("ARMOR", "100".into(), 1.0), ("HELMET", "YES".into(), 1.0)],
            _ => vec![("DEFUSE", "5 S".into(), 0.5)],
        };
    };
    let def = sim::weapons::def(id);
    let Kind::Gun(g) = def.kind else { return vec![] };
    let m = &g.modes[0];
    let rpm = (60.0 / m.cycle).round();
    vec![
        ("DAMAGE", m.damage.to_string(), m.damage as f32 / 120.0),
        ("FIRE RATE", format!("{rpm}"), rpm / 1000.0),
        ("MAGAZINE", format!("{}/{}", g.clip, g.reserve), g.clip as f32 / 100.0),
        ("SPEED", format!("{:.0}", g.speed), g.speed / 260.0),
        ("PENETRATE", g.penetration.to_string(), g.penetration as f32 / 3.0),
    ]
}
```

`client/src/characters.rs`:

```rs
//! Characters page (menu): the character you wear on each side, picked from CS 1.6's classes
//! with their own portraits (`gfx/vgui`). Everyone sees your pick (`Score::looks`). Stands in
//! until our own characters replace them.
use crate::menu::Settings;
use crate::ui::{card, clickable_keep_border, kit_text, page_title, vh, Kit, UiAction, BG1, CT_COLOR, T_COLOR, TX1, TX2, TX3};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::render::render_resource::TextureFormat;

/// The classes per side, in `Score::looks` order (players.rs loads the same models).
pub const T_CLASSES: [(&str, &str); 4] = [("terror", "Phoenix Connexion"), ("leet", "Elite Crew"), ("arctic", "Arctic Avengers"), ("guerilla", "Guerilla Warfare")];
pub const CT_CLASSES: [(&str, &str); 4] = [("urban", "Seal Team 6"), ("gsg9", "GSG-9"), ("sas", "SAS"), ("gign", "GIGN")];

/// The portraits, loaded once.
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct Portraits(pub [[Option<Handle<Image>>; 4]; 2]);

pub struct CharactersPlugin;

impl Plugin for CharactersPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.init_resource::<Portraits>().add_systems(Startup, load);
    }
}

fn load(mut portraits: ResMut<Portraits>, mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>) {
    for (side, list) in [T_CLASSES, CT_CLASSES].iter().enumerate() {
        for (i, (file, _)) in list.iter().enumerate() {
            portraits.0[side][i] = crate::gamefiles::paths(&format!("gfx/vgui/{file}.tga")).iter().find_map(|p| std::fs::read(p).ok()).and_then(|d| goldsrc::tga::decode(&d)).map(|t| images.add(crate::level::rgba_image(t.width, t.height, t.rgba, false, TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb)));
        }
    }
}

/// The page: a row of four portraits per side; the one you wear is framed.
pub fn page(page: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, settings: &Settings, portraits: &Portraits) {
    page_title(page, kit, "Who you are on each side · everyone in your match sees it", "Characters", "キャラ");
    for (side, (name, color, list)) in [("Terrorists", T_COLOR, T_CLASSES), ("Counter-Terrorists", CT_COLOR, CT_CLASSES)].into_iter().enumerate() {
        page.spawn((kit_text(name.to_uppercase(), 13.0, color, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect { top: vh(32.0), bottom: vh(12.0), ..default() }, ..default() }));
        page.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(16.0), ..default() }).with_children(|row| {
            for (i, (_, label)) in list.iter().enumerate() {
                let picked = settings.looks.is_some_and(|l| l[side] == i as u8);
                let mut c = row.spawn(card(Node { width: vh(220.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, padding: UiRect::all(vh(12.0)), row_gap: vh(10.0), ..default() }, picked));
                clickable_keep_border(&mut c, UiAction::SetLook(side as u8, i as u8), BG1);
                c.with_children(|c| {
                    // CS's class art is 256x196.
                    let (w, h) = (196.0, 196.0 * 196.0 / 256.0);
                    match &portraits.0[side][i] {
                        Some(img) => _ = c.spawn((ImageNode::new(img.clone()), Node { width: vh(w), height: vh(h), ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE)),
                        None => _ = c.spawn((Node { width: vh(w), height: vh(h), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(Color::BLACK), Pickable::IGNORE)),
                    }
                    c.spawn((kit_text(label.to_uppercase(), 15.0, if picked { TX1 } else { TX2 }, &kit.text), Pickable::IGNORE));
                });
            }
        });
    }
    if settings.looks.is_none() {
        page.spawn((kit_text("NOT PICKED YET: YOU GET ONE AT RANDOM EACH MATCH", 13.0, TX3, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(24.0)), ..default() }));
    }
}
```

`client/src/effects.rs`:

```rs
//! Server events turned into things you see and hear: tracers, the kill feed, grenades in
//! flight, explosions, the flashbang white-out and guns on the ground.
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::level::rgba_image;
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::impacts::Hit;
use crate::killfeed::{Kill, KillFeed};
use crate::round_hud::RoundNews;
use crate::models::Parts;
use crate::players::PlayerAnim;
use crate::{map, models, sound};
use bevy::{
    prelude::*,
    render::render_resource::TextureFormat,
};
use net::protocol::{GameEvent, Team};

pub struct EffectsPlugin;

impl Plugin for EffectsPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.init_resource::<Flash>()
            .add_message::<GameNews>()
            .add_systems(Startup, load)
            .add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::InGame), spawn_overlay)
            .add_systems(Update, events.in_set(Frame::Events))
            .add_systems(Update, (grenade_effects, ground_guns).in_set(Frame::World));
    }
}

#[derive(Resource)]
struct Effects {
    /// HE, flash, smoke world models.
    grenades: Vec<Parts>,
}

/// Flashbang: seconds of full white left, seconds of fade left (and total), strength.
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
struct Flash {
    hold: f32,
    fade: f32,
    total_fade: f32,
    alpha: f32,
}

fn load(mut commands: Commands, mut meshes: ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>, mut materials: ResMut<Assets<crate::studio::StudioMaterial>>, mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>) {
    let grenades = ["w_hegrenade", "w_flashbang", "w_smokegrenade"]
        .iter()
        .map(|name| {
            crate::gamefiles::paths(&format!("models/{name}.mdl"))
                .iter()
                .find_map(|p| goldsrc::mdl::Model::load(p).ok())
                .map(|m| model_parts(&m, 0, &mut meshes, &mut materials, &mut images))
                .unwrap_or_default()
        })
        .collect();
    commands.insert_resource(Effects {
        grenades,
    });
}

/// Full-screen white for flashbangs (invisible until flashed).
fn spawn_overlay(mut commands: Commands, mut flash: ResMut<Flash>) {
    *flash = Flash::default();
    commands.spawn((
        FlashOverlay,
        Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), height: percent(100), ..default() },
        BackgroundColor(Color::srgba(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0)),
        GlobalZIndex(10),
        // over the menus too: clicks must go through it (it blocked the buy menu)
        Pickable::IGNORE,
        DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame),
    ));
}

/// Meshes and materials for one posed studio model.
fn model_parts(model: &goldsrc::mdl::Model, seq: usize, meshes: &mut Assets<Mesh>, materials: &mut Assets<crate::studio::StudioMaterial>, images: &mut Assets<Image>) -> Parts {
    let textures: Vec<Handle<crate::studio::StudioMaterial>> = model
        .textures()
        .into_iter()
        .map(|t| {
            let mut rgba = t.rgba;
            crate::level::tex_gamma(&mut rgba);
            materials.add(crate::studio::material(images.add(rgba_image(t.width, t.height, rgba, false, TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb))))
        })
        .collect();
    model
        .posed_mesh(&model.pose(seq, 0, 0.5))
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|p| !p.indices.is_empty())
        .map(|p| (meshes.add(models::part_mesh(&p, map::to_y_up, false)), textures.get(p.texture).cloned().unwrap_or_default()))
        .collect()
}

/// Spawn a model's parts under one parent at `at` (GoldSrc coordinates).
fn spawn_parts(commands: &mut Commands, marker: impl Bundle, at: [f32; 3], parts: &Parts, materials: &mut Assets<crate::studio::StudioMaterial>) {
    let parent = commands.spawn((marker, Transform::from_translation(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(at))), Visibility::default(), DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame))).id();
    models::spawn_lit(commands, parent, parts, materials);
}

#[derive(Component)]
struct GrenadeView;

#[derive(Component)]
struct GroundGunView;

/// Guns lying on the ground (CS `w_` models), redrawn from the latest snapshot.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn ground_guns(
    mut commands: Commands,
    w: Res<Walker>,
    mut cache: ResMut<models::ModelCache>,
    mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>,
    mut materials: ResMut<Assets<crate::studio::StudioMaterial>>,
    mut meshes: ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>,
    mut parts: Local<std::collections::HashMap<sim::weapons::Id, Parts>>,
    mut shown: Local<Vec<(sim::weapons::Id, [f32; 3])>>,
    views: Query<Entity, With<GroundGunView>>,
) {
    if *shown == w.client.ground {
        return;
    }
    *shown = w.client.ground.clone();
    for e in &views {
        commands.entity(e).despawn();
    }
    for &(id, at) in &w.client.ground {
        let p = parts.entry(id).or_insert_with(|| match cache.get(&models::weapon_model("w", id), &mut images, &mut materials) {
            Some(m) => models::static_parts(&m, &m.model.pose(0, 0, 0.0), &mut meshes),
            None => Vec::new(),
        });
        spawn_parts(&mut commands, GroundGunView, at, p, &mut materials);
    }
}



#[derive(Component)]
struct FlashOverlay;

/// Grenades in flight and the flashbang white-out (explosions: `explosions.rs`, smoke: `smoke.rs`).
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn grenade_effects(
    mut commands: Commands,
    time: Res<Time>,
    mut w: ResMut<Walker>,
    mut flash: ResMut<Flash>,
    fx: Res<Effects>,
    mut studio: ResMut<Assets<crate::studio::StudioMaterial>>,
    views: Query<Entity, With<GrenadeView>>,
    mut overlay: Single<&mut BackgroundColor, With<FlashOverlay>>,
) {
    let dt = time.delta_secs();
    // Grenades in flight: few enough to redraw from scratch every frame they exist.
    for e in &views {
        commands.entity(e).despawn();
    }
    for (kind, at) in w.client.grenades.clone() {
        let i = match kind {
            sim::grenades::Kind::He => 0,
            sim::grenades::Kind::Flash => 1,
            sim::grenades::Kind::Smoke => 2,
        };
        spawn_parts(&mut commands, GrenadeView, at, &fx.grenades[i], &mut studio);
    }
    // Explosions and flashes from server events (sorted out in `events`).
    let me = w.client.id();
    for e in std::mem::take(&mut w.pending_fx) {
        match e {
            GameEvent::Flash { blinded, .. } => {
                if let Some((_, b)) = blinded.iter().find(|(id, _)| Some(*id) == me) {
                    // The server already combined it with any flash still on (`grenades::combine`).
                    flash.hold = b.hold;
                    flash.fade = b.fade;
                    flash.alpha = b.alpha as f32 / 255.0;
                    flash.total_fade = flash.fade;
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    // Flashbang white-out: full for `hold` seconds, then fades out over `fade`.
    let a = if flash.hold > 0.0 {
        flash.hold -= dt;
        flash.alpha
    } else if flash.fade > 0.0 {
        flash.fade -= dt;
        flash.alpha * (flash.fade / flash.total_fade.max(0.01)).max(0.0)
    } else {
        flash.alpha = 0.0;
        0.0
    };
    overlay.set_if_neq(BackgroundColor(Color::srgba(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, a)));
}

/// Server events: tracers, sounds, the kill feed, bullet holes and blood (`impacts`), player
/// animations (`players`); explosions and flashes go on to `grenade_effects`.
/// Every game event, for systems that only need to watch (the AI assistant).
#[derive(Message)]
pub struct GameNews(pub GameEvent);

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn events(mut w: ResMut<Walker>, mut feed: ResMut<KillFeed>, mut tracers: ResMut<crate::tracers::Tracers>, mut hits: MessageWriter<Hit>, mut anims: MessageWriter<PlayerAnim>, mut round: MessageWriter<RoundNews>, mut news: MessageWriter<GameNews>, shot_assets: Option<Res<crate::game::ShotAssets>>) {
    let me = w.client.id();
    let predicting = shot_assets.is_some();
    // Where a player is now (for sounds and the direction blood flies).
    let eye_of = |w: &Walker, id: u8| -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
        if Some(id) == me {
            return Some(w.client.me().eye());
        }
        w.client.others().iter().find(|o| o.id == id).map(|o| [o.origin[0], o.origin[1], o.origin[2] + 17.0])
    };
    for e in w.client.take_events() {
        news.write(GameNews(e.clone()));
        match e {
            GameEvent::Shot { shooter, weapon, silenced, from, to, holes } => {
                // Our own holes were drawn when we fired (game.rs), if we could trace them.
                let predicted = Some(shooter) == me && predicting;
                for (at, normal) in holes.into_iter().filter(|_| !predicted) {
                    hits.write(Hit::Wall { at, normal });
                    w.cues.push(sound::Cue::Impact { at, normal });
                }
                if Some(shooter) != me {
                    tracers.shot(from, to);
                    w.cues.push(sound::Cue::Shot { weapon, silenced, at: Some(from) });
                    anims.write(PlayerAnim::Shot(shooter, silenced));
                }
            }
            GameEvent::Footstep { player, at, step } if Some(player) != me => {
                w.cues.push(sound::Cue::Footstep { feet: [at[0], at[1], at[2] - 36.0], who: Some(player), step });
            }
            GameEvent::Damage { attacker, victim, sound, group, at, .. } => {
                let victim_at = eye_of(&w, victim);
                w.cues.push(sound::Cue::Hit { sound, at: if Some(victim) == me { None } else { victim_at } });
                anims.write(PlayerAnim::Hurt(victim, group));
                // Knife hits have no exact point: their middle.
                let at = at.or_else(|| (sound != net::protocol::HitSound::Explosion).then_some(victim_at).flatten());
                if let (Some(at), Some(from)) = (at, eye_of(&w, attacker)) {
                    let d = [at[0] - from[0], at[1] - from[1], at[2] - from[2]];
                    let l = (d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1] + d[2] * d[2]).sqrt().max(1e-3);
                    hits.write(Hit::Player { at, dir: d.map(|v| v / l), head: group == sim::hitbox::HitGroup::Head });
                }
            }
            GameEvent::GrenadeBounce { kind, at } => w.cues.push(sound::Cue::Bounce { kind, at }),
            GameEvent::Kill { killer, victim, weapon, headshot } => {
                let at = if Some(victim) == me { None } else { w.client.others().iter().find(|o| o.id == victim).map(|o| o.origin) };
                w.cues.push(sound::Cue::Death { at });
                anims.write(PlayerAnim::Died(victim));
                // Name and team as the feed shows them ("the bomb" for the world).
                let who = |id: u8| -> (String, Team) {
                    if id == net::protocol::WORLD {
                        return ("the bomb".to_string(), Team::Spectator);
                    }
                    w.client.scores.iter().find(|s| s.id == id).map(|s| (s.name.clone(), s.team)).unwrap_or_else(|| (format!("player {id}"), Team::Spectator))
                };
                let mine = me.is_some_and(|m| m == killer || m == victim);
                let by = (weapon.is_some() && killer != victim).then(|| who(killer));
                feed.push(Kill { killer: by, victim: who(victim), weapon, headshot, mine });
            }
            GameEvent::Explosion { at } => {
                w.cues.push(sound::Cue::Explosion { at });
                hits.write(Hit::Scorch { at });
                w.pending_fx.push(e);
            }
            GameEvent::Flash { at, .. } => {
                w.cues.push(sound::Cue::Flash { at });
                w.pending_fx.push(e);
            }
            GameEvent::BombPlanted { at, .. } => {
                w.cues.push(sound::Cue::At { file: "weapons/c4_plant.wav", at, far: false });
                round.write(RoundNews(e));
            }
            GameEvent::Defusing { .. } => {
                if let net::protocol::BombNet::Planted { at, .. } = w.client.bomb {
                    w.cues.push(sound::Cue::At { file: "weapons/c4_disarm.wav", at, far: false });
                }
            }
            GameEvent::BombDefused { .. } => {
                if let net::protocol::BombNet::Planted { at, .. } = w.client.bomb {
                    w.cues.push(sound::Cue::At { file: "weapons/c4_disarmed.wav", at, far: false });
                }
                round.write(RoundNews(e));
            }
            GameEvent::BombExploded { at } => {
                w.cues.push(sound::Cue::At { file: "weapons/c4_explode1.wav", at, far: true });
                w.pending_fx.push(e.clone());
                round.write(RoundNews(e));
            }
            // The gibs come from gibs.rs.
            GameEvent::Broke { material, at, .. } => w.cues.push(sound::Cue::Break { material, at }),
            GameEvent::RoundStart { .. } | GameEvent::RoundEnd { .. } | GameEvent::SidesSwapped | GameEvent::MatchOver { .. } | GameEvent::Surrendered { .. } | GameEvent::VotedOut { .. } | GameEvent::KillLimit { .. } => {
                round.write(RoundNews(e));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}
```

`client/src/explosions.rs`:

```rs
//! Explosions as CS 1.6 draws them, with its own sprites:
//! - HE (`CGrenade::Explode3`): `fexplo` (scale 2.5) 20 units up and `eexplo` (3.0) up to
//!   64 units off, both played once at 30 fps, additive (`TE_EXPLOSION`); 0-3 spark showers;
//!   debris clatter; 0.55 s later a puff of `steam1` smoke (3.5-4.5, 5 fps) rising.
//! - C4 (`CGrenade::Explode2`): four huge sprites (scale 13.5) up to 512 units around, three
//!   at 150 brightness, `zerogxplode` at 17 (`TE_SPRITE`).
//!
//! The flash lights the walls too: a short orange point light (the engine's dynamic light).
use crate::effects::GameNews;
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::impacts::Hit;
use crate::level::rgba_image;
use crate::map;
use crate::menu::AppState;
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::render::render_resource::TextureFormat;
use net::protocol::GameEvent;

pub struct ExplosionsPlugin;

impl Plugin for ExplosionsPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(Startup, load).add_systems(Update, (start, play).chain().in_set(Frame::World).run_if(resource_exists::<Sprites>));
    }
}

/// One sprite's frames (images) and its width/height in texels.
struct Frames {
    images: Vec<Handle<Image>>,
    size: Vec2,
    /// Each frame's centre relative to the sprite's origin (texels, x right, y up).
    centres: Vec<Vec2>,
}

#[derive(Resource)]
struct Sprites {
    fexplo: Frames,
    eexplo: Frames,
    zerogxplode: Frames,
    steam: Frames,
    quad: Handle<Mesh>,
}

/// `additive`: GoldSrc adds these on screen (display values), so their texels are used as they
/// are (no sRGB decode): a dim fire frame still brightens a bright wall the way it does in CS.
fn frames(name: &str, additive: bool, images: &mut Assets<Image>) -> Frames {
    let s = crate::gamefiles::paths(&format!("sprites/{name}")).iter().find_map(|p| goldsrc::spr::Sprite::load(p).ok());
    let format = if additive { TextureFormat::Rgba8Unorm } else { TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb };
    match s {
        Some(s) => Frames {
            centres: s.origins.iter().map(|(x, y)| Vec2::new(*x as f32 + s.width as f32 / 2.0, *y as f32 - s.height as f32 / 2.0)).collect(),
            images: s.frames.into_iter().map(|f| images.add(rgba_image(s.width, s.height, f, false, format))).collect(),
            size: Vec2::new(s.width as f32, s.height as f32),
        },
        None => Frames { images: Vec::new(), size: Vec2::ONE, centres: Vec::new() },
    }
}

fn load(mut commands: Commands, mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>, mut meshes: ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>) {
    commands.insert_resource(Sprites {
        fexplo: frames("fexplo.spr", true, &mut images),
        eexplo: frames("eexplo.spr", true, &mut images),
        zerogxplode: frames("zerogxplode.spr", true, &mut images),
        steam: frames("steam1.spr", false, &mut images),
        quad: meshes.add(Rectangle::new(1.0, 1.0)),
    });
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum Which {
    Fexplo,
    Eexplo,
    Zero,
    Steam,
}

/// A sprite animation playing once, facing the camera.
#[derive(Component)]
struct Anim {
    which: Which,
    at: Vec3,
    scale: f32,
    fps: f32,
    age: f32,
    /// Seconds before it shows (the smoke comes after the blast).
    delay: f32,
    /// Units a second it drifts up (smoke).
    rise: f32,
    material: Handle<StandardMaterial>,
}

/// A brief light from the blast.
#[derive(Component)]
struct Burst(f32);

fn start(mut commands: Commands, mut news: MessageReader<GameNews>, sprites: Res<Sprites>, mut materials: ResMut<Assets<StandardMaterial>>, mut hits: MessageWriter<Hit>, mut w: ResMut<Walker>, mut rng: Local<u64>) {
    if *rng == 0 {
        *rng = 0x2F6B_9D3C_11A7_E4F5;
    }
    let mut rand = || {
        *rng ^= *rng << 13;
        *rng ^= *rng >> 7;
        *rng ^= *rng << 17;
        (*rng % 100_000) as f32 / 100_000.0
    };
    for GameNews(e) in news.read() {
        let mut spawn = |which: Which, at: [f32; 3], scale: f32, fps: f32, bright: f32, delay: f32, rise: f32| {
            let additive = !matches!(which, Which::Steam);
            let first = match which {
                Which::Fexplo => &sprites.fexplo,
                Which::Eexplo => &sprites.eexplo,
                Which::Zero => &sprites.zerogxplode,
                Which::Steam => &sprites.steam,
            }
            .images
            .first()
            .cloned();
            let material = materials.add(StandardMaterial {
                base_color_texture: first,
                base_color: if additive { Color::linear_rgb(bright, bright, bright) } else { Color::WHITE },
                unlit: true,
                alpha_mode: if additive { AlphaMode::Add } else { AlphaMode::Blend },
                ..default()
            });
            commands.spawn((
                Anim { which, at: Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(at)), scale, fps, age: 0.0, delay, rise, material: material.clone() },
                Mesh3d(sprites.quad.clone()),
                MeshMaterial3d(material),
                Transform::default(),
                Visibility::Hidden,
                DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame),
            ));
        };
        match e {
            GameEvent::Explosion { at } => {
                spawn(Which::Fexplo, [at[0], at[1], at[2] + 20.0], 2.5, 30.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
                spawn(Which::Eexplo, [at[0] + (rand() - 0.5) * 128.0, at[1] + (rand() - 0.5) * 128.0, at[2] + 30.0 + rand() * 5.0], 3.0, 30.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
                spawn(Which::Steam, [at[0], at[1], at[2] - 5.0], 3.5 + rand(), 5.0, 1.0, 0.55, 30.0);
                for _ in 0..(rand() * 4.0) as usize {
                    hits.write(Hit::Sparks { at: *at });
                }
                let file = ["weapons/debris1.wav", "weapons/debris2.wav", "weapons/debris3.wav"][((rand() * 3.0) as usize).min(2)];
                w.cues.push(crate::sound::Cue::Quiet { file, at: *at, volume: 0.55 });
                commands.spawn((Burst(0.0), PointLight { color: Color::srgb(1.0, 0.75, 0.4), intensity: 1.5e5, range: 400.0, ..default() }, Transform::from_translation(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(*at))), DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame)));
            }
            GameEvent::BombExploded { at } => {
                let around = |r: &mut dyn FnMut() -> f32| [at[0] + (r() - 0.5) * 1024.0, at[1] + (r() - 0.5) * 1024.0, at[2] + (r() - 0.5) * 20.0];
                spawn(Which::Fexplo, [at[0], at[1], at[2] - 10.0], 13.5, 10.0, 150.0 / 255.0, 0.0, 0.0);
                spawn(Which::Eexplo, around(&mut rand), 13.5, 10.0, 150.0 / 255.0, 0.0, 0.0);
                spawn(Which::Fexplo, around(&mut rand), 13.5, 10.0, 150.0 / 255.0, 0.0, 0.0);
                spawn(Which::Zero, around(&mut rand), 13.5, 10.0, 17.0 / 255.0, 0.0, 0.0);
                commands.spawn((Burst(0.0), PointLight { color: Color::srgb(1.0, 0.75, 0.4), intensity: 2.0e6, range: 1500.0, ..default() }, Transform::from_translation(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(*at))), DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame)));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn play(
    mut commands: Commands,
    time: Res<Time>,
    sprites: Res<Sprites>,
    cam: Single<&GlobalTransform, With<crate::game::FlyCam>>,
    mut anims: Query<(Entity, &mut Anim, &mut Transform, &mut Visibility), Without<Burst>>,
    mut bursts: Query<(Entity, &mut Burst, &mut PointLight)>,
    mut materials: ResMut<Assets<StandardMaterial>>,
) {
    let dt = time.delta_secs();
    let eye = cam.translation();
    for (e, mut a, mut tf, mut vis) in &mut anims {
        a.age += dt;
        if a.age < a.delay {
            continue;
        }
        let set = match a.which {
            Which::Fexplo => &sprites.fexplo,
            Which::Eexplo => &sprites.eexplo,
            Which::Zero => &sprites.zerogxplode,
            Which::Steam => &sprites.steam,
        };
        let frame = ((a.age - a.delay) * a.fps) as usize;
        let Some(image) = set.images.get(frame) else {
            commands.entity(e).despawn();
            continue;
        };
        if let Some(mut m) = materials.get_mut(&a.material) {
            if m.base_color_texture.as_ref() != Some(image) {
                m.base_color_texture = Some(image.clone());
            }
        }
        let rise = a.rise * dt;
        a.at.y += rise;
        *tf = Transform::from_translation(a.at).looking_at(eye, Vec3::Y).with_scale((set.size * a.scale).extend(1.0));
        tf.rotate_local_y(std::f32::consts::PI); // the quad faces +Z
        // The frame sits where its origin puts it (camera-facing right and up).
        let c = set.centres.get(frame).copied().unwrap_or(Vec2::ZERO) * a.scale;
        let (right, up) = (tf.rotation * Vec3::X, tf.rotation * Vec3::Y);
        tf.translation += right * c.x + up * c.y;
        vis.set_if_neq(Visibility::Inherited);
    }
    // The engine's explosion light: bright, gone in a third of a second.
    for (e, mut b, mut light) in &mut bursts {
        b.0 += dt;
        if b.0 > 0.35 {
            commands.entity(e).despawn();
        } else {
            light.intensity *= (1.0 - dt / 0.35).max(0.0);
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Matchmaking on screen (design/mockups/ui: Match found, Accepted, Reconnect, Play):
//! - `overlay`: a match found, over any menu page: ten slots filling as players accept (yours
//!   solid amber), the time to accept running down, ACCEPT breathing and Decline; once you've
//!   accepted, how many are still to accept. It tunes in once with a chirp.
//! - `notes`: top right under your name: your running match (Reconnect), then a party invite.
//! - `cooldown`: Find match while you may not queue: why, and for how long.
use crate::play::{Lobby, LobbyAction};
use crate::steam::Steam;
use crate::ui::{chip, kit_text, lift, meter, primary_button, soft, t, vh, Anim, Kit, Type, UiAction, UiMemory, UiSound, AMBER, AMBER_WASH_2, BACKDROP, BAR, BG1, BG2, LINE_2, TX1, TX2, TX3};
use bevy::prelude::*;

pub(crate) fn plugin(app: &mut App) {
    app.add_systems(Update, (chirp, breathe));
}

/// Seconds a match waits for everyone (the lobby's ready check).
const READY_SECONDS: f32 = 20.0;

fn mmss(secs: f32) -> String {
    let s = secs.max(0.0).ceil() as u32;
    format!("{}:{:02}", s / 60, s % 60)
}

/// The match found screen's root (flat over the 3D menu; the menu takes no clicks under it).
#[derive(Component)]
pub struct FoundOverlay;

/// The accept button: its glow breathes.
#[derive(Component)]
struct Breathe;

fn breathe(time: Res<Time>, mut q: Query<&mut BoxShadow, With<Breathe>>) {
    let s = (time.elapsed_secs() * std::f32::consts::TAU / 1.4).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5;
    for mut b in &mut q {
        b.0 = vec![ShadowStyle { color: AMBER.with_alpha(0.12 + 0.18 * s), x_offset: px(0), y_offset: px(0), spread_radius: px(0), blur_radius: vh(8.0 + 10.0 * s) }];
    }
}

/// A match found: three rising notes, once.
fn chirp(lobby: Res<Lobby>, mut was: Local<bool>, mut sounds: MessageWriter<UiSound>) {
    let ready = lobby.shown.as_ref().is_some_and(|s| s.ready.is_some());
    if ready && !*was {
        sounds.write(UiSound::Found);
    }
    *was = ready;
}

/// The match found screen, over everything on the menu.
/// Its own root over everything (`MenuRoot`: the next rebuild replaces it).
pub fn overlay(commands: &mut Commands, kit: &Kit, lobby: &Lobby, memory: &mut UiMemory) {
    // screenshot runs: BOOTLEG16_FOUND shows a match found (3 of 10 in)
    let fake = std::env::var_os("BOOTLEG16_FOUND").is_some().then_some(net::lobby::ReadyNet { accepted: 3, total: 10, left: 14.0, you: false });
    let ready = lobby.shown.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.ready).or(fake);
    // tune in when it appears; later redraws (the count, the time) stay put
    let appeared = memory.previous("found.open") != Some("1");
    memory.changed("found.open", if ready.is_some() { "1" } else { "0" });
    let Some(r) = ready else { return };
    commands
        .spawn((crate::menu::MenuRoot, FoundOverlay, DespawnOnExit(crate::menu::AppState::Menu), Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), height: percent(100), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }, BackgroundColor(BACKDROP), GlobalZIndex(30)))
        .with_children(|full| {
            let mut panel = full.spawn((soft(Node { width: vh(640.0), padding: UiRect::axes(vh(48.0), vh(40.0)), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, border: UiRect::all(px(1)), ..default() }), BackgroundColor(BG1.with_alpha(0.96)), BorderColor::all(LINE_2), lift()));
            if appeared {
                panel.insert(Anim::tune_in(0.0));
            }
            panel.with_children(|p| {
                p.spawn(t(kit, Type::Label, "Casual 5v5 · a match is ready", TX2));
                p.spawn((kit_text("MATCH FOUND", 96.0, TX1, &kit.display), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(12.0)), ..default() }));
                // one slot per player: yours solid, the others amber as they accept
                p.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(8.0), margin: UiRect::top(vh(28.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|row| {
                    let others = r.accepted.saturating_sub(r.you as u8);
                    for i in 0..r.total.max(1) {
                        let (bg, border, w) = if i == 0 && r.you {
                            (AMBER, AMBER, 2.0)
                        } else if i >= r.you as u8 && i < r.you as u8 + others {
                            (AMBER_WASH_2, AMBER, 2.0)
                        } else {
                            (Color::NONE, LINE_2, 1.0)
                        };
                        let mut slot = row.spawn((Node { width: vh(40.0), height: vh(40.0), border: UiRect::all(px(w)), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(vh(4.0)), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(bg), BorderColor::all(border)));
                        if memory.changed(&format!("found.slot{i}"), &format!("{w}")) {
                            slot.insert(Anim::burst());
                        }
                    }
                });
                let m = meter(p, 544.0, AMBER, r.left / READY_SECONDS);
                p.commands().entity(m).entry::<Node>().and_modify(|mut n| n.margin = UiRect::top(vh(24.0)));
                p.spawn((t(kit, Type::Label, &format!("{} to accept", mmss(r.left)), TX2), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(8.0)), ..default() }));
                p.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, row_gap: vh(12.0), margin: UiRect::top(vh(28.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|b| {
                    if r.you {
                        let waiting = r.total.saturating_sub(r.accepted);
                        b.spawn((soft(Node { height: vh(64.0), min_width: vh(520.0), padding: UiRect::horizontal(vh(24.0)), align_items: AlignItems::Center, justify_content: JustifyContent::SpaceBetween, border: UiRect { left: vh(6.0), right: px(1), top: px(1), bottom: px(1) }, ..default() }), BorderColor::all(AMBER))).with_children(|o| {
                            o.spawn(kit_text("ACCEPTED", 18.0, TX1, &kit.text));
                            o.spawn(t(kit, Type::Label, &format!("Waiting for {waiting}"), TX2));
                        });
                    } else {
                        let accept = primary_button(b, kit, "Accept", "Enter", UiAction::Lobby(LobbyAction::AcceptMatch));
                        b.commands().entity(accept).insert((Breathe, BoxShadow::default())).entry::<Node>().and_modify(|mut n| n.min_width = vh(520.0));
                        chip(b, kit, "Decline", UiAction::Lobby(LobbyAction::DeclineMatch), false);
                    }
                });
            });
        });
}

/// Top right under your name, stacked: your running match, then an invite.
pub fn notes(root: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, lobby: &Lobby, steam: Option<&Steam>, top: f32) {
    root.spawn((Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, right: vh(96.0), top: vh(top), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, row_gap: vh(16.0), ..default() }, GlobalZIndex(10))).with_children(|col| {
```

`client/src/framerate.rs`:

```rs
//! Frame rate: VSync on or off and an fps cap (CS's `fps_max`), from the settings.
use crate::menu::Settings;
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::window::PresentMode;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

pub struct FrameratePlugin;

impl Plugin for FrameratePlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(Update, apply_vsync).add_systems(Last, cap);
    }
}

fn apply_vsync(settings: Res<Settings>, mut windows: Query<&mut Window>) {
    // Not AutoNoVsync: on KDE Wayland it ended up capped at 60; Mailbox runs free without tearing.
    let mode = if settings.vsync { PresentMode::AutoVsync } else { PresentMode::Mailbox };
    for mut w in &mut windows {
        if w.present_mode != mode {
            w.present_mode = mode;
        }
    }
}

/// Wait out the rest of the frame when we're faster than the cap.
fn cap(settings: Res<Settings>, mut last: Local<Option<Instant>>) {
    if settings.fps_max > 0 {
        let frame = Duration::from_secs_f64(1.0 / settings.fps_max as f64);
        if let Some(t) = *last {
            let left = frame.saturating_sub(t.elapsed());
            // ponytail: plain sleep overshoots ~0.1 ms on Linux; spin the last bit if the cap feels uneven.
            if !left.is_zero() {
                std::thread::sleep(left);
            }
        }
    }
    *last = Some(Instant::now());
}
```
