```rs
//! Kill feed, top right (direction E): killer, weapon icon, headshot, victim; newest at
//! the bottom. Kills you made or took are tinted amber with the amber bar on the outer edge.
//! Rows tune in and out (the shared `ui::feed_row`, like the voice rows).
use crate::game::Frame;
use crate::hud::{weapon_icon, Icons};
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::ui::{feed_row, kit_text, vh, Anim, Kit, Outer, CT_COLOR, TX1, T_COLOR};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use net::protocol::Team;

pub struct KillFeedPlugin;

impl Plugin for KillFeedPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.init_resource::<KillFeed>().add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::InGame), spawn).add_systems(Update, (age, show).chain().in_set(Frame::Ui));
    }
}

/// How long a line stays, and how many are shown.
const LIFETIME: f32 = 6.0;
const MAX_LINES: usize = 5;

/// One kill. `killer` is None for falls and the bomb.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Kill {
    pub killer: Option<(String, Team)>,
    pub victim: (String, Team),
    pub weapon: Option<sim::weapons::Id>,
    pub headshot: bool,
    /// You killed or died.
    pub mine: bool,
}

#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct KillFeed {
    lines: Vec<(u32, Kill, f32)>,
    next: u32,
}

impl KillFeed {
    pub fn push(&mut self, kill: Kill) {
        self.lines.push((self.next, kill, LIFETIME));
        self.next += 1;
        let n = self.lines.len();
        if n > MAX_LINES {
            self.lines.drain(..n - MAX_LINES);
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Component)]
struct FeedRoot;

fn spawn(mut commands: Commands) {
    commands.spawn((
        FeedRoot,
        crate::ui::HudLayer,
        DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame),
        Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, right: vh(crate::hud::SAFE), top: vh(crate::hud::FEED_TOP), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::FlexEnd, row_gap: vh(4.0), ..default() },
    ));
}

fn age(time: Res<Time>, mut feed: ResMut<KillFeed>) {
    let dt = time.delta_secs();
    for line in &mut feed.lines {
        line.2 -= dt;
    }
    feed.lines.retain(|l| l.2 > 0.0);
}

fn team_color(team: Team) -> Color {
    match team {
        Team::Ct => CT_COLOR,
        Team::T => T_COLOR,
        Team::Spectator => TX1,
    }
}

/// One row on screen: which kill.
#[derive(Component)]
struct Line(u32);

/// New kills tune in at the bottom; expired ones tune out.
fn show(mut commands: Commands, feed: Res<KillFeed>, kit: Res<Kit>, icons: Res<Icons>, root: Single<Entity, With<FeedRoot>>, lines: Query<(Entity, &Line)>) {
    let live: Vec<u32> = feed.lines.iter().map(|l| l.0).collect();
    for (e, Line(id)) in &lines {
        if !live.contains(id) {
            commands.entity(e).remove::<Line>().insert(Anim::tune_out());
        }
    }
    let shown: Vec<u32> = lines.iter().map(|(_, l)| l.0).collect();
    commands.entity(*root).with_children(|col| {
        for (id, k, _) in feed.lines.iter().filter(|l| !shown.contains(&l.0)) {
            col.spawn((Line(*id), Anim::tune_in(0.0), feed_row(40.0, k.mine, Outer::Right))).with_children(|row| {
                if let Some((name, team)) = &k.killer {
                    row.spawn(kit_text(name.clone(), 16.0, team_color(*team), &kit.num));
                }
                let icon = k.weapon.map(weapon_icon).unwrap_or("d_skull");
                row.spawn(icons.node(icon, 28.0, TX1));
                if k.headshot {
                    row.spawn(icons.node("d_headshot", 28.0, TX1));
                }
                row.spawn(kit_text(k.victim.0.clone(), 16.0, team_color(k.victim.1), &kit.num));
            });
        }
    });
}
```

`client/src/level.rs`:

```rs
//! Drawing the map: textured, lightmapped world geometry and the doors that move with the sim.
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::menu::{AppState, GameConfig};
use crate::map;
use bevy::{
    asset::RenderAssetUsages,
    image::{ImageAddressMode, ImageSampler, ImageSamplerDescriptor},
    math::Rect,
    mesh::{Indices, PrimitiveTopology},
    pbr::Lightmap,
    prelude::*,
    render::render_resource::{Extent3d, TextureDimension, TextureFormat},
};

/// GoldSrc's video defaults: `gamma` 2.5 (also `lightgamma`), `texgamma` 2.0, `brightness` 1.
const GAMMA: f32 = 2.5;
const TEX_GAMMA: f32 = 2.0;
const BRIGHTNESS: f32 = 1.0;

/// GoldSrc's `texgammatable`: every texture brightened a little (x^(texgamma / gamma)).
pub fn tex_gamma(rgba: &mut [u8]) {
    let table: Vec<u8> = (0..256).map(|i| (255.0 * (i as f32 / 255.0).powf(TEX_GAMMA / GAMMA)).round() as u8).collect();
    for px in rgba.chunks_mut(4) {
        for c in &mut px[..3] {
            *c = table[*c as usize];
        }
    }
}

/// GoldSrc's `lightgammatable`: light below `g3` is lifted (more with `brightness`), then
/// everything is raised to 1 / gamma. The result multiplies the texture in display space.
fn light_gamma(rgba: &mut [u8]) {
    let g3 = if BRIGHTNESS <= 0.0 { 0.125 } else if BRIGHTNESS > 1.0 { 0.05 } else { 0.125 - BRIGHTNESS * BRIGHTNESS * 0.075 };
    let table: Vec<u8> = (0..256)
        .map(|i| {
            let mut f = i as f32 / 255.0;
            if BRIGHTNESS > 0.0 {
                f = if f > g3 { 0.125 + (f - g3) / (1.0 - g3) * 0.875 } else { f / g3 * 0.125 };
            }
            (255.0 * f.powf(1.0 / GAMMA)).round() as u8
        })
        .collect();
    for px in rgba.chunks_mut(4) {
        for c in &mut px[..3] {
            *c = table[*c as usize];
        }
    }
}

pub struct LevelPlugin;

impl Plugin for LevelPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::InGame), spawn_level).add_systems(Update, (move_doors, hide_broken).in_set(Frame::World));
    }
}

pub fn rgba_image(w: u32, h: u32, rgba: Vec<u8>, repeat: bool, format: TextureFormat) -> Image {
    let mut img = Image::new(
        Extent3d { width: w, height: h, depth_or_array_layers: 1 },
        TextureDimension::D2,
        rgba,
        format,
        RenderAssetUsages::RENDER_WORLD,
    );
    if repeat {
        img.sampler = ImageSampler::Descriptor(ImageSamplerDescriptor {
            address_mode_u: ImageAddressMode::Repeat,
            address_mode_v: ImageAddressMode::Repeat,
            ..ImageSamplerDescriptor::linear()
        });
    } else {
        img.sampler = ImageSampler::linear();
    }
    img
}

fn spawn_level(
    mut commands: Commands,
    config: Res<GameConfig>,
    mut map_data: ResMut<crate::loading::MapData>,
    mut meshes: ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>,
    mut materials: ResMut<Assets<StandardMaterial>>,
    mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>,
) {
    let Some(geo) = map_data.geometry.take() else { return };
    info!("{}: {} batches, lightmap {:?}", config.map, geo.batches.len(), geo.lightmap_size);
    commands.insert_resource(Spawns(geo.spawns.clone()));

    let (lw, lh) = geo.lightmap_size;
    // Through GoldSrc's light curve, stored as display values (sRGB): Bevy decodes both it and
    // the texture, multiplies, and encodes again, which is GoldSrc's multiply in display space.
    let mut lm = geo.lightmap_rgba;
    light_gamma(&mut lm);
    let lightmap = images.add(rgba_image(lw as u32, lh as u32, lm, false, TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb));
    let mut tex_handles = vec![None; geo.textures.len()];

    let mut spawn_batch = |b: map::Batch, render: Option<map::Render>, commands: &mut Commands| -> Entity {
        let t = &geo.textures[b.texture];
        let image = tex_handles[b.texture]
            .get_or_insert_with(|| {
                let mut rgba = t.rgba.clone();
                tex_gamma(&mut rgba);
                images.add(rgba_image(t.width, t.height, rgba, true, TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb))
            })
            .clone();
        let material = materials.add(StandardMaterial {
            base_color_texture: Some(image),
            perceptual_roughness: 1.0,
            reflectance: 0.0,
            lightmap_exposure: 1.0,
            // See-through brushes: `texture` mode fades by renderamt, `additive` glows (nuke's glass).
            base_color: Color::WHITE.with_alpha(render.filter(|r| matches!(r.mode, 1 | 2 | 3 | 5)).map(|r| r.amt).unwrap_or(1.0)),
            alpha_mode: match render.map(|r| r.mode) {
                Some(5) | Some(3) => AlphaMode::Add,
                Some(1) | Some(2) => AlphaMode::Blend,
                _ if t.name.starts_with('{') => AlphaMode::Mask(0.5),
                _ => AlphaMode::Opaque,
            },
            ..default()
        });
        // Keep the mesh on the CPU side too: Bevy needs it to compute the bounding box for
        // culling (GPU-only meshes get a box at the origin and vanish when it's off-screen).
        let mesh = Mesh::new(PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList, RenderAssetUsages::default())
            .with_inserted_attribute(Mesh::ATTRIBUTE_POSITION, b.positions)
            .with_inserted_attribute(Mesh::ATTRIBUTE_UV_0, b.uv)
            .with_inserted_attribute(Mesh::ATTRIBUTE_UV_1, b.lightmap_uv)
            .with_inserted_indices(Indices::U32(b.indices))
            .with_computed_normals(); // face vertices are never shared, so these are flat
        commands
            .spawn((
                Mesh3d(meshes.add(mesh)),
                MeshMaterial3d(material),
                Lightmap { image: lightmap.clone(), uv_rect: Rect::new(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0), ..default() },
                DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame),
            ))
            .id()
    };
    for b in geo.batches {
        spawn_batch(b, None, &mut commands);
    }
    // Breakables and see-through brushes: one parent each (breakables vanish when broken).
    for (model, render, batches) in geo.pieces {
        let parent = commands.spawn((BrushPiece(model), Transform::default(), Visibility::default(), DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame))).id();
        for b in batches {
            let child = spawn_batch(b, Some(render), &mut commands);
            commands.entity(parent).add_child(child);
        }
    }
    // Doors: one parent per door, moved every frame to where the sim says it is.
    for (model, batches) in geo.movers {
        let parent = commands.spawn((DoorMesh(model), Transform::default(), Visibility::default(), DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame))).id();
        for b in batches {
            let child = spawn_batch(b, None, &mut commands);
            commands.entity(parent).add_child(child);
        }
    }
}

/// A breakable or see-through brush entity's render parent; the value is its brush model.
#[derive(Component)]
struct BrushPiece(usize);

/// Broken pieces disappear (and come back when the server restores them).
fn hide_broken(w: Res<Walker>, mut pieces: Query<(&BrushPiece, &mut Visibility)>) {
    for (BrushPiece(m), mut v) in &mut pieces {
        v.set_if_neq(if w.client.broken.contains(&(*m as u16)) { Visibility::Hidden } else { Visibility::Inherited });
    }
}

/// Spawn points (Bevy coordinates) and the way they face (GoldSrc yaw, degrees).
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct Spawns(pub Vec<([f32; 3], f32)>);

/// A door's render entity; the value is its brush model index.
#[derive(Component)]
struct DoorMesh(usize);

/// GoldSrc (Z up) to Bevy (Y up) for direction vectors.
fn y_up(v: [f32; 3]) -> Vec3 {
    Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(v))
}

/// Where to draw a door: the same transform the sim uses for its collision.
fn door_transform(d: &sim::doors::Door) -> Transform {
    let (off, ang) = d.transform();
    let (f, r, u) = sim::doors::angle_vectors(ang);
    // Model space -> world: columns are where the model's x, z, -y axes end up.
    Transform {
        rotation: Quat::from_mat3(&Mat3::from_cols(y_up(f), y_up(u), y_up(r))),
        translation: y_up([d.pivot[0] + off[0], d.pivot[1] + off[1], d.pivot[2] + off[2]]),
        ..default()
    }
}

fn move_doors(w: Res<Walker>, mut doors: Query<(&DoorMesh, &mut Transform)>) {
    for (DoorMesh(model), mut tf) in &mut doors {
        if let Some(d) = w.client.world.doors.doors.iter().find(|d| d.model == *model) {
            *tf = door_transform(d);
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// A door drawn with `door_transform` must sit exactly where its collision is.
    #[test]
    fn rendered_door_matches_collision_on_inferno() {
        let path = crate::game_dir().join("maps/de_inferno.bsp");
        let Ok(bsp) = goldsrc::bsp::Bsp::load(&path) else { return };
        let mut doors = sim::doors::Doors::from_bsp(&bsp);
        let actor = sim::doors::Actor { mins: [0.0; 3], maxs: [0.0; 3], eye: [0.0; 3], forward: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], using: false };
        // Fire it open by touching it, then let it swing partway.
        let (lo, hi) = doors.doors[0].bounds();
        let toucher = sim::doors::Actor { mins: lo, maxs: hi, ..actor };
        doors.update(1.0 / 128.0, &[toucher], |_, _| false);
        for _ in 0..40 {
            doors.update(1.0 / 128.0, &[], |_, _| false);
        }
        let d = &doors.doors[0];
        assert!(d.transform().1[1].abs() > 1.0, "door did not move");
        let (off, ang) = d.transform();
        let (f, r, u) = sim::doors::angle_vectors(ang);
        let tf = door_transform(d);
        for corner in [d.mins, d.maxs, [d.mins[0], d.maxs[1], d.mins[2]]] {
            let sim_world = sim::doors::local_to_world(corner, f, r, u);
            let sim_world = [sim_world[0] + d.pivot[0] + off[0], sim_world[1] + d.pivot[1] + off[1], sim_world[2] + d.pivot[2] + off[2]];
            let drawn = tf.transform_point(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(corner)));
            assert!(drawn.distance(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(sim_world))) < 0.01, "{drawn} vs {sim_world:?}");
        }
    }
}
```

`client/src/loading.rs`:

```rs
//! What the loading screen shows (`Loading`, while `AppState::Connecting`), the map loaded
//! for the match (`MapData`), and `Job`: slow work on its own thread so the screen keeps
//! moving. The flow itself is `menu::connect`; the screen is `status_screens`.
use bevy::prelude::*;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};
use std::sync::{mpsc, Arc, Mutex};

/// The steps of getting into a match, in order.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
pub enum Step {
    StartingServer,
    Contacting,
    LoadingMap,
    Joining,
}

impl Step {
    pub const ALL: [Step; 4] = [Step::StartingServer, Step::Contacting, Step::LoadingMap, Step::Joining];

    pub fn label(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Step::StartingServer => "Starting server",
            Step::Contacting => "Contacting server",
            Step::LoadingMap => "Loading map",
            Step::Joining => "Joining",
        }
    }
}

/// Getting into a match, as the loading screen shows it.
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct Loading {
    /// The map (practice) or the address (joining).
    pub target: String,
    /// The map, once known (practice: from the start; joining: once the server says).
    pub map: Option<String>,
    /// A solo practice on the built-in server (else joining a server).
    pub practice: bool,
    pub step: Step,
    /// 0..1, real: each step and the map's parts (file, collision, geometry) move it.
    pub progress: f32,
    /// Seconds since loading started.
    pub elapsed: f32,
}

/// The map as loaded for this match, shared by everything that reads it on entering the game
/// (the file is parsed once). `world` and `geometry` are taken by the game and the level.
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct MapData {
    pub bsp: goldsrc::bsp::Bsp,
    pub world: Option<sim::collision::World>,
    pub geometry: Option<crate::map::MapGeometry>,
}

/// Work on its own thread; `poll` hands back the result once (Err: the thread died).
pub struct Job<T>(Mutex<mpsc::Receiver<T>>);

impl<T: Send + 'static> Job<T> {
    pub fn spawn(f: impl FnOnce() -> T + Send + 'static) -> Job<T> {
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel();
        std::thread::spawn(move || _ = tx.send(f()));
        Job(Mutex::new(rx))
    }

    pub fn poll(&self) -> Result<Option<T>, ()> {
        match self.0.lock().map_err(|_| ())?.try_recv() {
            Ok(v) => Ok(Some(v)),
            Err(mpsc::TryRecvError::Empty) => Ok(None),
            Err(mpsc::TryRecvError::Disconnected) => Err(()),
        }
    }
}

/// Progress a job reports (0..1) while it runs.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub struct Progress(Arc<AtomicU32>);

impl Progress {
    pub fn set(&self, v: f32) {
        self.0.store(v.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    pub fn get(&self) -> f32 {
        f32::from_bits(self.0.load(Ordering::Relaxed))
    }
}

/// Load the map for a match: the file (checked against the server's), collision, then the
/// geometry and textures. Err: what to tell the player.
pub fn load_map(name: String, server_hash: u64, progress: Progress) -> Result<MapData, crate::notice::Notice> {
    use crate::notice::Notice;
    let root = crate::game_dir();
    let bsp = goldsrc::bsp::Bsp::load(&root.join("maps").join(format!("{name}.bsp"))).map_err(|e| Notice::error("Map missing", format!("You don't have {name} ({e}).")))?;
    // Same map name isn't enough: a changed file would mean different walls on our side.
    if bsp.hash != server_hash {
        return Err(Notice::error("Map mismatch", format!("Your {name} is different from the server's (another version, or modified). Verify your game files.")));
    }
    progress.set(0.3);
    let world = sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    progress.set(0.5);
    let roots = crate::gamefiles::roots();
    let geometry = crate::map::load(&bsp, &roots.iter().map(|r| r.as_path()).collect::<Vec<_>>());
    progress.set(1.0);
    Ok(MapData { bsp, world: Some(world), geometry: Some(geometry) })
}

/// The game opens behind the loading screen, which stays until the first frames are drawn
/// with every shader ready (Bevy compiles pipelines in the background: without this the map
/// shows up a moment after the HUD, sky first).
pub struct LoadingPlugin;

impl Plugin for LoadingPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        let waiting = Waiting::default();
        app.insert_resource(waiting.clone()).add_systems(Update, reveal.run_if(in_state(crate::menu::AppState::InGame)).run_if(resource_exists::<Loading>));
        if let Some(render) = app.get_sub_app_mut(bevy::render::RenderApp) {
            render.insert_resource(waiting).add_systems(bevy::render::Render, count_waiting);
        }
    }
}

/// Pipelines still compiling (from the render world).
#[derive(Resource, Clone, Default)]
struct Waiting(Arc<AtomicU32>);

fn count_waiting(cache: Res<bevy::render::render_resource::PipelineCache>, waiting: Res<Waiting>) {
    waiting.0.store(cache.waiting_pipelines().count() as u32, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

/// In the game, still covered: lift the cover once nothing has been compiling for a few frames
/// (15 s at most: never stuck behind it).
fn reveal(mut commands: Commands, mut loading: ResMut<Loading>, waiting: Res<Waiting>, time: Res<Time>, mut frames: Local<u32>, mut quiet: Local<u32>, mut covered: Local<f32>) {
    loading.elapsed += time.delta_secs();
    *covered += time.delta_secs();
    *frames += 1;
    *quiet = if waiting.0.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == 0 { *quiet + 1 } else { 0 };
    loading.progress = 0.95 + 0.05 * (*quiet as f32 / 5.0).min(1.0);
    if (*frames >= 5 && *quiet >= 5) || *covered > 15.0 {
        commands.remove_resource::<Loading>();
        (*frames, *quiet, *covered) = (0, 0, 0.0);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! The game client. Opens on the main menu; practice starts a server inside the game,
//! "Join server" connects to one. Each part of the game is its own plugin module.
//!
//! Usage: `client [map] [--connect host:port] [--name name] [--give ak47,awp] [--practice N]`
//! (any argument skips the menu). The game directory comes from `BOOTLEG16_DIR`
//! (default: `data/` beside the executable, else `gamedata/` in the repo).
//! `BOOTLEG16_FAKE_PING=ms` and `BOOTLEG16_FAKE_LOSS=0.05` simulate a bad connection.
//! `BOOTLEG16_SCREENSHOT=path.png` saves one frame (after `BOOTLEG16_SCREENSHOT_AT` seconds,
//! default 2) and exits; such runs ignore mouse and keyboard (used for automated checks).
//! `BOOTLEG16_TEAM=t|ct|spec` picks the team in such runs (default auto).
//! `BOOTLEG16_MENU_PAGE=practice|join|settings|crosshair|assistant|voice|characters|maps` opens that menu page
//! (crosshair and assistant: Settings sections) in such runs.
//! `BOOTLEG16_OVERLAY=pause|teams` shows that in-game overlay; `BOOTLEG16_MENU=1` the buy menu.
//! `BOOTLEG16_SCORES=1` holds the scoreboard open. `BOOTLEG16_FIRE=1` holds fire (bullet holes).
//! `BOOTLEG16_CAM=x,y,z` parks the camera there (with `BOOTLEG16_LOOK`, to check map details).
//! `BOOTLEG16_ASSISTANT=0..3` picks the AI assistant for the run (not saved).
//! `BOOTLEG16_VOICE=1` shows you and a teammate on the voice list.
//! `BOOTLEG16_FOUND=1` shows a match found and the Reconnect card on the menu.
//! `BOOTLEG16_SPECTATE=1` watches another player instead of playing (as when dead);
//! `BOOTLEG16_SPECTATE=front` watches them from the front.
mod binds;
mod tracers;
mod gamefiles;

mod effects;

use bevy::{
    light::GlobalAmbientLight,
    prelude::*,
    render::view::window::screenshot::{save_to_disk, Screenshot},
};
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn game_dir() -> PathBuf {
    net::gamefiles::data_dir()
}

fn main() {
    // NVIDIA's Vulkan on Wayland (driver 615, KDE) kills the game with "explicit sync is used,
    // but no buffer is attached" when the window goes fullscreen or is resized; its own switch
    // turns explicit sync off for the game. Set before anything opens Vulkan; a value the
    // player set wins.
    #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
    if std::env::var_os("__NV_DISABLE_EXPLICIT_SYNC").is_none() {
        std::env::set_var("__NV_DISABLE_EXPLICIT_SYNC", "1");
    }
    App::new()
        .add_plugins(
            DefaultPlugins
                .set(WindowPlugin { primary_window: Some(Window { title: "bootleg16".into(), name: Some("bootleg16".into()), decorations: !menu::Settings::load().borderless, ..default() }), ..default() })
                // Shrink audio space so rodio's 1/d^2 loudness never kicks in: it only pans,
                // and `sound` applies GoldSrc's own distance falloff.
                .set(bevy::audio::AudioPlugin { default_spatial_scale: bevy::audio::SpatialScale::new(1.0 / 4096.0), ..default() })
                // BOOTLEG16_THREADS=n: how many threads Bevy's task pools use (default: one per core).
                .set(bevy::app::TaskPoolPlugin {
                    task_pool_options: std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_THREADS").ok().and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).map_or_else(Default::default, bevy::app::TaskPoolOptions::with_num_threads),
                }),
        )
        // GoldSrc lighting is fully baked into lightmaps; no extra ambient.
        .insert_resource(GlobalAmbientLight { brightness: 0.0, ..default() })
        .insert_resource(ClearColor(Color::srgb(0.45, 0.6, 0.8)))
        // The simulation steps at the server's tick rate: this is only the default until its
        // Welcome says (`menu::connect`).
        .insert_resource(Time::<Fixed>::from_hz(net::tick::DEFAULT_TICK_RATE as f64))
        .insert_resource(models::ModelCache::new())
        .insert_resource(sound::Sounds::new())
        .init_state::<menu::AppState>()
        .add_plugins((
            menu::MenuPlugin,
            framerate::FrameratePlugin,
            game::GamePlugin,
            level::LevelPlugin,
            players::PlayersPlugin,
            effects::EffectsPlugin,
            impacts::ImpactsPlugin,
            viewmodel::ViewModelPlugin,
            sound::SoundPlugin,
            buy::BuyPlugin,
            hud::HudPlugin,
            killfeed::KillFeedPlugin,
            round_hud::RoundHudPlugin,
            // (Bevy takes at most 15 plugins per tuple.)
            (bomb::BombPlugin, characters::CharactersPlugin, map_pool::MapPoolPlugin, explosions::ExplosionsPlugin, gibs::GibsPlugin, glows::GlowsPlugin, studio::StudioPlugin, map_sounds::MapSoundsPlugin, status_screens::StatusScreensPlugin, loading::LoadingPlugin),
            (teammates::TeammatesPlugin, voice::VoicePlugin, smoke::SmokePlugin, sky::SkyPlugin, muzzle::MuzzlePlugin, assistant::AssistantPlugin, scoreboard::ScoreboardPlugin, radar::RadarPlugin, ui::UiPlugin, spectate::SpectatePlugin, vote::VotePlugin, binds::BindsPlugin),
        ))
        .add_plugins((tracers::TracerPlugin, window::WindowPlugin))
        .add_systems(Update, screenshot)
        .run();
}

/// With BOOTLEG16_SCREENSHOT set: save a frame to that path after ~2 s (or
/// BOOTLEG16_SCREENSHOT_AT seconds), then quit.
fn screenshot(mut commands: Commands, time: Res<Time>, mut taken: Local<Option<f32>>, mut exit: MessageWriter<AppExit>) {
    let Some(path) = std::env::var_os("BOOTLEG16_SCREENSHOT") else { return };
    let at: f32 = std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_SCREENSHOT_AT").ok().and_then(|f| f.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(2.0);
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    match *taken {
        None if now >= at => {
            commands.spawn(Screenshot::primary_window()).observe(save_to_disk(PathBuf::from(path)));
            *taken = Some(now);
        }
        Some(t) if now >= t + 1.0 => {
            exit.write(AppExit::Success);
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}
```

`client/src/map.rs`:

```rs
//! Turns a GoldSrc BSP into renderer-neutral draw batches: one batch per texture,
//! with texture UVs, lightmap-atlas UVs and Y-up positions.
use goldsrc::{bsp::Bsp, texture::Texture, wad::Wad};
use std::path::Path;

pub const ATLAS_W: usize = 2048;
const PAD: usize = 1;

/// Brush entities that are never drawn (volumes, not geometry).
const INVISIBLE_CLASSES: &[&str] = &[
    "func_buyzone",
    "func_bomb_target",
    "func_hostage_rescue",
    "func_vip_safetyzone",
    "func_escapezone",
    "func_ladder",
];

/// Textures that are tool brushes, not visible surfaces.
fn is_tool_texture(name: &str) -> bool {
    let n = name.to_ascii_lowercase();
    matches!(n.as_str(), "sky" | "clip" | "origin" | "aaatrigger" | "null" | "bevel" | "hint" | "skip")
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Batch {
    pub texture: usize,
    pub positions: Vec<[f32; 3]>,
    pub uv: Vec<[f32; 2]>,
    pub lightmap_uv: Vec<[f32; 2]>,
    pub indices: Vec<u32>,
}

/// GoldSrc `rendermode` / `renderamt` of a brush entity.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Render {
    /// 0 normal, 1 color, 2 texture (see-through by `amt`), 3 glow, 4 solid (masked), 5 additive.
    pub mode: u8,
    /// 0..1 opacity for modes 1, 2 and 5.
    pub amt: f32,
}

pub struct MapGeometry {
    /// The world and everything that never moves.
    pub batches: Vec<Batch>,
    /// Doors: (brush model index, batches in the model's own space). The sim says where they are.
    pub movers: Vec<(usize, Vec<Batch>)>,
    /// Brush entities drawn on their own: breakables (hidden once broken) and see-through ones.
    pub pieces: Vec<(usize, Render, Vec<Batch>)>,
    /// Decoded textures, indexed by `Batch::texture`. Missing ones are a checkerboard.
    pub textures: Vec<Texture>,
    pub lightmap_size: (usize, usize),
    pub lightmap_rgba: Vec<u8>,
    /// Spawn points in Y-up space: (origin, yaw in degrees).
    pub spawns: Vec<([f32; 3], f32)>,
}

/// GoldSrc is Z-up (x forward, y left); Bevy is Y-up. A proper rotation, so
/// handedness is kept: (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y).
pub fn to_y_up(v: [f32; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
    [v[0], v[2], -v[1]]
}

fn dot(a: [f32; 3], b: &[f32; 4]) -> f32 {
    a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2] + b[3]
}

/// Shelf packer for lightmap rectangles.
struct Atlas {
    rgba: Vec<u8>,
    x: usize,
    y: usize,
    shelf_h: usize,
}

impl Atlas {
    fn height(&self) -> usize {
        self.rgba.len() / (ATLAS_W * 4)
    }

    /// Place a w*h RGB block (with a 1px border copied from its edges); returns its top-left.
    fn insert(&mut self, w: usize, h: usize, rgb: &[u8]) -> (usize, usize) {
        let (pw, ph) = (w + 2 * PAD, h + 2 * PAD);
        if self.x + pw > ATLAS_W {
            self.x = 0;
            self.y += self.shelf_h;
            self.shelf_h = 0;
        }
        let need = (self.y + ph) * ATLAS_W * 4;
        if self.rgba.len() < need {
            self.rgba.resize(need, 255);
        }
        for py in 0..ph {
            for px in 0..pw {
                let sx = px.saturating_sub(PAD).min(w - 1);
                let sy = py.saturating_sub(PAD).min(h - 1);
                let s = (sy * w + sx) * 3;
                let d = ((self.y + py) * ATLAS_W + self.x + px) * 4;
                self.rgba[d..d + 4].copy_from_slice(&[rgb[s], rgb[s + 1], rgb[s + 2], 255]);
            }
        }
        let at = (self.x + PAD, self.y + PAD);
        self.x += pw;
        self.shelf_h = self.shelf_h.max(ph);
        at
    }
}

fn checkerboard(name: &str) -> Texture {
    let rgba = (0..64)
        .flat_map(|i| if (i % 8 < 4) ^ (i / 8 < 4) { [255, 0, 255, 255] } else { [0, 0, 0, 255] })
        .collect();
    Texture { name: name.to_string(), width: 8, height: 8, rgba }
}

/// A loaded map's geometry and its WADs. `search` lists the directories to look in for the
/// WAD files the map names.
pub fn load(bsp: &Bsp, search: &[&Path]) -> MapGeometry {
    let wads: Vec<Wad> = bsp
        .wad_names()
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|n| search.iter().find_map(|d| Wad::load(d.join(n.to_lowercase())).ok()))
        .collect();
    let textures: Vec<Texture> = bsp
        .textures
        .iter()
        .map(|t| {
            // Our texture files first: a map's own copy (many carry one) is only the fallback.
            wads.iter()
                .find_map(|w| w.texture(&t.name))
                .or_else(|| t.pixels.clone())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| checkerboard(&t.name))
        })
        .collect();

    // Which brush models to draw: the world, plus visible brush entities.
    // (model, offset, group): group 0 is static; each door gets its own group.
    let mut models: Vec<(usize, [f32; 3], usize)> = vec![(0, [0.0; 3], 0)];
    let mut mover_models = Vec::new();
    let mut piece_models: Vec<(usize, Render)> = Vec::new();
    let mut spawns = Vec::new();
    for e in bsp.entity_list() {
        let class = e.get("classname").map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
        let origin = e
            .get("origin")
            .map(|o| {
                let v: Vec<f32> = o.split_whitespace().filter_map(|x| x.parse().ok()).collect();
                [v.first().copied().unwrap_or(0.0), v.get(1).copied().unwrap_or(0.0), v.get(2).copied().unwrap_or(0.0)]
            })
            .unwrap_or([0.0; 3]);
        if matches!(class, "info_player_start" | "info_player_deathmatch") {
            let yaw = e.get("angles").and_then(|a| a.split_whitespace().nth(1)?.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0.0);
            spawns.push((to_y_up(origin), yaw));
        }
        if class.starts_with("trigger_") || INVISIBLE_CLASSES.contains(&class) {
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(i) = e.get("model").and_then(|m| m.strip_prefix('*')?.parse::<usize>().ok()) {
            if i < bsp.models.len() {
                let render = Render {
                    mode: e.get("rendermode").and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0),
                    amt: e.get("renderamt").and_then(|v| v.parse::<f32>().ok()).unwrap_or(255.0) / 255.0,
                };
                if matches!(class, "func_door" | "func_door_rotating" | "func_button" | "func_rot_button") {
                    mover_models.push(i);
                    models.push((i, [0.0; 3], mover_models.len()));
                } else if class == "func_breakable" || matches!(render.mode, 1 | 2 | 3 | 5) {
                    // Groups after the doors' (renumbered below, once all doors are known).
                    piece_models.push((i, render));
                    models.push((i, origin, usize::MAX - (piece_models.len() - 1)));
                } else {
                    models.push((i, origin, 0));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let mut atlas = Atlas { rgba: Vec::new(), x: 0, y: 0, shelf_h: 0 };
    // Fully-lit 2x2 block for faces without lightmap data.
    let fullbright = atlas.insert(2, 2, &[255; 12]);
    let new_group = || -> Vec<Batch> { (0..textures.len()).map(|t| Batch { texture: t, ..Default::default() }).collect() };
    // Pieces' groups come after the doors'.
    let doors = mover_models.len();
    for m in &mut models {
        if m.2 > usize::MAX / 2 {
            m.2 = doors + 1 + (usize::MAX - m.2);
        }
    }
    let mut groups: Vec<Vec<Batch>> = (0..=doors + piece_models.len()).map(|_| new_group()).collect();
    let mut lm_rects = Vec::new(); // (group, batch, first vertex, atlas pos, smin, tmin)

    for (model, offset, group) in models {
        let m = bsp.models[model];
        for face in &bsp.faces[m.first_face as usize..(m.first_face + m.num_faces) as usize] {
            let ti = bsp.texinfo[face.texinfo as usize];
            let tex = &textures[ti.miptex as usize];
            if is_tool_texture(&tex.name) {
                continue;
            }
            let verts: Vec<[f32; 3]> = bsp
                .face_vertices(face)
                .into_iter()
                .map(|v| [v[0] + offset[0], v[1] + offset[1], v[2] + offset[2]])
                .collect();
            // Lightmap extents in 16-unit luxels, computed from the un-offset vertices.
            let st: Vec<(f32, f32)> = bsp.face_vertices(face).iter().map(|&v| (dot(v, &ti.s), dot(v, &ti.t))).collect();
            let (mut smin, mut smax, mut tmin, mut tmax) = (f32::MAX, f32::MIN, f32::MAX, f32::MIN);
            for &(s, t) in &st {
                smin = smin.min(s);
                smax = smax.max(s);
                tmin = tmin.min(t);
                tmax = tmax.max(t);
            }
            let (bs, bt) = ((smin / 16.0).floor(), (tmin / 16.0).floor());
            let lw = ((smax / 16.0).ceil() - bs) as usize + 1;
            let lh = ((tmax / 16.0).ceil() - bt) as usize + 1;
            let lit = face.light_offset >= 0 && face.styles[0] != 255;
            let data = lit
                .then(|| bsp.lighting.get(face.light_offset as usize..face.light_offset as usize + lw * lh * 3))
                .flatten();

            let b = &mut groups[group][ti.miptex as usize];
            let first = b.positions.len() as u32;
            for (i, v) in verts.iter().enumerate() {
                b.positions.push(to_y_up(*v));
                b.uv.push([st[i].0 / tex.width as f32, st[i].1 / tex.height as f32]);
            }
            // GoldSrc winds front faces clockwise; Bevy wants counter-clockwise.
            for i in 1..verts.len() as u32 - 1 {
                b.indices.extend([first, first + i + 1, first + i]);
            }
            match data {
                Some(rgb) => {
                    let at = atlas.insert(lw, lh, rgb);
                    b.lightmap_uv.extend(std::iter::repeat_n([0.0; 2], verts.len())); // filled in below
                    lm_rects.push((group, ti.miptex as usize, first, st, at, bs, bt));
                }
                None => {
                    let c = [(fullbright.0 as f32 + 1.0), (fullbright.1 as f32 + 1.0)];
                    b.lightmap_uv.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(c, verts.len()));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Atlas height is only known now, so lightmap UVs are filled in last.
    let ah = atlas.height().next_power_of_two();
    atlas.rgba.resize(ah * ATLAS_W * 4, 255);
    for b in groups.iter_mut().flatten() {
        for uv in &mut b.lightmap_uv {
            *uv = [uv[0] / ATLAS_W as f32, uv[1] / ah as f32];
        }
    }
    for (g, bi, first, st, (ax, ay), bs, bt) in lm_rects {
        let b = &mut groups[g][bi];
        let at = first as usize;
        for (i, (s, t)) in st.into_iter().enumerate() {
            let u = (ax as f32 + s / 16.0 - bs + 0.5) / ATLAS_W as f32;
            let v = (ay as f32 + t / 16.0 - bt + 0.5) / ah as f32;
            b.lightmap_uv[at + i] = [u, v];
        }
    }
    for g in &mut groups {
        g.retain(|b| !b.indices.is_empty());
    }
    let mut groups = groups.into_iter();
    let batches = groups.next().unwrap_or_default();
    let movers = mover_models.into_iter().zip(groups.by_ref().take(doors)).collect();
    let pieces = piece_models.into_iter().zip(groups).map(|((m, r), g)| (m, r, g)).collect();

    MapGeometry { batches, movers, pieces, textures, lightmap_size: (ATLAS_W, ah), lightmap_rgba: atlas.rgba, spawns }
}
```

```rs
//! The map of a custom game, on the Play page: one row under the mode. The leader picks a map
//! from the pool, or Random, and starts. No veto.
use crate::play::LobbyAction;
use crate::ui::{chip, kit_text, vh, Kit, UiAction, AMBER, TX2, TX3};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use net::lobby::LobbyState;
use net::server::Group;

/// The map row: the leader picks a pool map (or Random) and starts; the others see the pick.
pub fn row(col: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, s: &LobbyState) {
    let a = |x: LobbyAction| UiAction::Lobby(x);
    col.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect { top: vh(32.0), bottom: vh(16.0), ..default() }, ..default() }).with_children(|h| {
        h.spawn(kit_text("MAP", 13.0, TX2, &kit.text));
    });
    col.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(8.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
        if s.leader == s.you {
            chip(r, kit, "Random", a(LobbyAction::SetMap(None)), s.map.is_none());
            for m in net::config::MAP_POOL {
                chip(r, kit, m, a(LobbyAction::SetMap(Some(m.to_string()))), s.map.as_deref() == Some(*m));
            }
        } else {
            r.spawn(kit_text(s.map.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "Random".into()).to_uppercase(), 16.0, AMBER, &kit.text));
            r.spawn(kit_text("THE LEADER PICKS THE MAP", 13.0, TX3, &kit.text));
        }
    });
}

/// Screenshot runs: BOOTLEG16_FAKE_LOBBY=custom shows a custom game you lead.

    std::env::var_os("BOOTLEG16_FAKE_LOBBY")?;
    let member = |id: u32, name: &str, group: Group| net::lobby::Member { id, name: name.into(), group, steam: 0 };
    Some(LobbyState {
        you: 1,
        code: "KX7-42Q".into(),
        leader: 1,
        mode: net::lobby::Mode::Custom,
        members: vec![member(1, "anas", Group::A), member(2, "kova", Group::A), member(3, "vera", Group::B), member(4, "rook", Group::B)],
        searching: None,
        ready: None,
        cooldown: None,
        found: None,
        rejoin: None,
        notice: String::new(),
        invites: Vec::new(),
        map: None,
        regions: Vec::new(),
    })
}
```

`client/src/map_pool.rs`:

```rs
//! Maps page (menu): the official map pool, each with its CS 1.6 radar image, the map's own
//! briefing (`maps/<map>.txt`) and whether you have it (matches only use maps everyone has).
//! Stands in until our own maps and art replace them.
use crate::ui::{card, kit_text, page_title, vh, Kit, AMBER, BAD, OK, TX1, TX2, TX3};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::render::render_resource::TextureFormat;

/// One pool map: radar image, briefing title and lines, and whether it's installed.
pub struct PoolMap {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub radar: Option<Handle<Image>>,
    pub title: String,
    pub brief: Vec<String>,
    pub installed: bool,
}

#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct Pool(pub Vec<PoolMap>);

pub struct MapPoolPlugin;

impl Plugin for MapPoolPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.init_resource::<Pool>().add_systems(Startup, load);
    }
}

fn load(mut pool: ResMut<Pool>, mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>) {
    let dir = crate::game_dir();
    pool.0 = net::config::MAP_POOL
        .iter()
        .map(|&name| {
            let radar = std::fs::read(dir.join("overviews").join(format!("{name}.bmp")))
                .ok()
                .and_then(|d| crate::radar::load_bmp(&d))
                .map(|(w, h, rgba)| images.add(crate::level::rgba_image(w, h, rgba, false, TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb)));
            // The briefing: a title line, then paragraphs (we keep the side objectives).
            let text = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("maps").join(format!("{name}.txt"))).unwrap_or_default();
            let mut lines = text.lines().map(str::trim).filter(|l| !l.is_empty());
            let title = lines.next().unwrap_or(name).to_string();
            let brief = text.split("\n\n").skip(1).map(|p| p.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ")).filter(|p| p.starts_with("Counter-Terrorists") || p.starts_with("Terrorists")).collect();
            PoolMap { name, radar, title, brief, installed: dir.join("maps").join(format!("{name}.bsp")).exists() }
        })
        .collect();
}

/// The page: a card per map, radar image on the left, briefing on the right.
pub fn page(page: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, pool: &Pool) {
    page_title(page, kit, "The official pool · casual matches and custom games play these", "Maps", "マップ");
    page.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, row_gap: vh(12.0), margin: UiRect::top(vh(24.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|list| {
        for m in &pool.0 {
            list.spawn(card(Node { column_gap: vh(20.0), padding: UiRect::all(vh(12.0)), ..default() }, false)).with_children(|c| {
                // CS radar images are 4:3.
                let (w, h) = (152.0, 114.0);
                match &m.radar {
                    Some(img) => _ = c.spawn((ImageNode::new(img.clone()), Node { width: vh(w), height: vh(h), flex_shrink: 0.0, ..default() })),
                    None => _ = c.spawn((Node { width: vh(w), height: vh(h), flex_shrink: 0.0, ..default() }, BackgroundColor(Color::BLACK))),
                }
                c.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, row_gap: vh(6.0), flex_grow: 1.0, ..default() }).with_children(|t| {
                    t.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(12.0), align_items: AlignItems::Baseline, ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
                        r.spawn(kit_text(m.name.to_uppercase(), 22.0, TX1, &kit.text));
                        r.spawn(kit_text(m.title.to_uppercase(), 13.0, AMBER, &kit.text));
                    });
                    for p in &m.brief {
                        t.spawn(kit_text(p.clone(), 14.0, TX2, &kit.text));
                    }
                    let (status, color) = if m.installed { ("INSTALLED", OK) } else { ("MISSING: YOU CAN'T BE MATCHED ON IT", BAD) };
                    t.spawn((kit_text(status, 12.0, color, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(4.0)), ..default() }));
                });
            });
        }
        list.spawn(kit_text("MATCHES ONLY USE MAPS EVERY PLAYER HAS", 12.0, TX3, &kit.text));
    });
}
```

`client/src/map_sounds.rs`:

```rs
//! Sounds the map makes, as GoldSrc plays them: `ambient_generic` (looping ambience, and
//! one-shots fired by name: train's jet fly-by, birds, dogs), doors moving and stopping
//! (`movesnd`/`stopsnd`), buttons, and `env_spark` (crackles and sparks every so often).
use crate::effects::GameNews;
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::impacts::Hit;
use crate::map;
use crate::menu::{AppState, Settings};
use crate::sound::{Sounds, ATTN_NORM};
use bevy::audio::{PlaybackSettings, Volume};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use net::protocol::GameEvent;
use sim::doors::DoorState;

pub struct MapSoundsPlugin;

impl Plugin for MapSoundsPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::InGame), load).add_systems(Update, (ambience, doors, sparks).in_set(Frame::Sound).run_if(resource_exists::<MapSounds>));
    }
}

// GoldSrc attenuations (silent at 1000 / attn units; 0 = heard everywhere at full volume).
const ATTN_NONE: f32 = 0.0;
const ATTN_IDLE: f32 = 2.0;
const ATTN_STATIC: f32 = 1.25;

// `ambient_generic` spawnflags.
const EVERYWHERE: u32 = 1;
const SMALL_RADIUS: u32 = 2;
const MEDIUM_RADIUS: u32 = 4;
const LARGE_RADIUS: u32 = 8;
const START_SILENT: u32 = 16;
const NOT_LOOPING: u32 = 32;

/// One `ambient_generic`.
struct Ambient {
    at: [f32; 3],
    file: String,
    /// `health` / 10.
    volume: f32,
    attn: f32,
    looping: bool,
    name: Option<String>,
    /// A looping sound that's on (its player entity once spawned).
    on: bool,
    playing: Option<Entity>,
}

/// One `env_spark`: when it next sparks (None until the map's first frame).
struct Spark {
    at: [f32; 3],
    max_delay: f32,
    next: Option<f32>,
}

#[derive(Resource)]
struct MapSounds {
    ambients: Vec<Ambient>,
    sparks: Vec<Spark>,
    /// Each door's state last frame, and its move sound while it plays.
    doors: Vec<(DoorState, Option<Entity>)>,
    rng: u64,
}

impl MapSounds {
    fn rand(&mut self) -> f32 {
        self.rng ^= self.rng << 13;
        self.rng ^= self.rng >> 7;
        self.rng ^= self.rng << 17;
        (self.rng % 10_000) as f32 / 10_000.0
    }
}

/// A looping (or moving) sound in the world: where it is, how loud, how fast it fades.
#[derive(Component)]
struct Placed {
    at: [f32; 3],
    volume: f32,
    attn: f32,
}

fn load(mut commands: Commands, map: Res<crate::loading::MapData>) {
    let bsp = &map.bsp;
    let num = |e: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>, k: &str| e.get(k).and_then(|v| v.parse::<f32>().ok());
    let origin = |e: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>| {
        let v: Vec<f32> = e.get("origin").map(|o| o.split_whitespace().filter_map(|x| x.parse().ok()).collect()).unwrap_or_default();
        [v.first().copied().unwrap_or(0.0), v.get(1).copied().unwrap_or(0.0), v.get(2).copied().unwrap_or(0.0)]
    };
    let mut ambients = Vec::new();
    let mut sparks = Vec::new();
    for e in bsp.entity_list() {
        match e.get("classname").map(String::as_str) {
            Some("ambient_generic") => {
                let Some(file) = e.get("message").filter(|m| m.ends_with(".wav")) else { continue };
                let flags = num(&e, "spawnflags").unwrap_or(0.0) as u32;
                let attn = if flags & EVERYWHERE != 0 {
                    ATTN_NONE
                } else if flags & SMALL_RADIUS != 0 {
                    ATTN_IDLE
                } else if flags & MEDIUM_RADIUS != 0 {
                    ATTN_STATIC
                } else if flags & LARGE_RADIUS != 0 {
                    ATTN_NORM
                } else {
                    ATTN_STATIC
                };
                let looping = flags & NOT_LOOPING == 0;
                ambients.push(Ambient {
                    at: origin(&e),
                    file: file.clone(),
                    volume: (num(&e, "health").unwrap_or(10.0) / 10.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                    attn,
                    looping,
                    name: e.get("targetname").cloned(),
                    on: looping && flags & START_SILENT == 0,
                    playing: None,
                });
            }
            // Sparks every 0.1 s plus up to `MaxDelay` (1.5 when unset), from 0.1-1.6 s in.
            Some("env_spark") => sparks.push(Spark { at: origin(&e), max_delay: num(&e, "MaxDelay").filter(|d| *d > 0.0).unwrap_or(1.5), next: None }),
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    commands.insert_resource(MapSounds { ambients, sparks, doors: Vec::new(), rng: 0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15 });
}

/// Distance falloff, GoldSrc's: full at the source, silent at 1000 / attn.
fn gain(at: [f32; 3], ear: [f32; 3], attn: f32) -> f32 {
    let d = ((at[0] - ear[0]).powi(2) + (at[1] - ear[1]).powi(2) + (at[2] - ear[2]).powi(2)).sqrt();
    (1.0 - d * attn / 1000.0).max(0.0)
}

fn spawn_loop(commands: &mut Commands, sounds: &mut Sounds, assets: &mut Assets<AudioSource>, file: &str, at: [f32; 3], volume: f32, attn: f32) -> Option<Entity> {
    let handle = sounds.get(file, assets)?;
    let spatial = attn > 0.0;
    let play = PlaybackSettings::LOOP.with_volume(Volume::Linear(0.0)).with_spatial(spatial);
    Some(commands.spawn((AudioPlayer(handle), play, Placed { at, volume, attn }, Transform::from_translation(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(at))), DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame))).id())
}

/// Looping ambience on and off, one-shots when their name fires; every placed sound's volume
/// follows the distance to you.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn ambience(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut ms: ResMut<MapSounds>,
    mut sounds: ResMut<Sounds>,
    mut assets: ResMut<Assets<AudioSource>>,
    mut news: MessageReader<GameNews>,
    w: Res<Walker>,
    settings: Res<Settings>,
    mut placed: Query<(&Placed, &mut Transform, Option<&mut AudioSink>, Option<&mut SpatialAudioSink>)>,
) {
    let ear = w.client.me().eye();
    for GameNews(e) in news.read() {
        let GameEvent::Fired { name } = e else { continue };
        for a in ms.ambients.iter_mut().filter(|a| a.name.as_deref() == Some(name.as_str())) {
            if a.looping {
                a.on = !a.on; // a named looping sound toggles
            } else {
                let g = if a.attn > 0.0 { gain(a.at, ear, a.attn) } else { 1.0 };
                let v = settings.volume * a.volume * g;
                if let (true, Some(h)) = (v > 0.01, sounds.get(&a.file, &mut assets)) {
                    let play = PlaybackSettings::DESPAWN.with_volume(Volume::Linear(v)).with_spatial(a.attn > 0.0);
                    commands.spawn((AudioPlayer(h), play, Transform::from_translation(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(a.at)))));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for a in ms.ambients.iter_mut() {
        match (a.on, a.playing) {
            (true, None) => a.playing = spawn_loop(&mut commands, &mut sounds, &mut assets, &a.file, a.at, a.volume, a.attn),
            (false, Some(e)) => {
                commands.entity(e).try_despawn();
                a.playing = None;
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    for (p, mut tf, sink, spatial) in &mut placed {
        tf.translation = Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(p.at));
        let v = Volume::Linear(settings.volume * p.volume * if p.attn > 0.0 { gain(p.at, ear, p.attn) } else { 1.0 });
        if let Some(mut s) = sink {
            s.set_volume(v);
        }
        if let Some(mut s) = spatial {
            s.set_volume(v);
        }
    }
}

/// Doors: the move sound loops while it moves, the stop sound plays when it gets there
/// (`CHAN_STATIC`, volume 1, `ATTN_NORM`). A button clicks when pressed.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn doors(mut commands: Commands, mut ms: ResMut<MapSounds>, mut sounds: ResMut<Sounds>, mut assets: ResMut<Assets<AudioSource>>, w: Res<Walker>, settings: Res<Settings>, mut placed: Query<&mut Placed>) {
    let ear = w.client.me().eye();
    let all = &w.client.world.doors.doors;
    if ms.doors.len() != all.len() {
        ms.doors = all.iter().map(|d| (d.state, None)).collect();
    }
    for (d, (last, playing)) in all.iter().zip(ms.doors.iter_mut()) {
        let (lo, hi) = d.bounds();
        let at = [(lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2.0, (lo[1] + hi[1]) / 2.0, (lo[2] + hi[2]) / 2.0];
        let moving = |s: DoorState| matches!(s, DoorState::Opening | DoorState::Closing);
        if moving(d.state) && !moving(*last) {
            if d.is_button() {
                if d.state == DoorState::Opening && d.move_sound > 0 {
                    one_shot(&mut commands, &mut sounds, &mut assets, &format!("buttons/button{}.wav", d.move_sound), at, ear, settings.volume);
                }
            } else if d.move_sound > 0 {
                *playing = spawn_loop(&mut commands, &mut sounds, &mut assets, &format!("doors/doormove{}.wav", d.move_sound), at, 1.0, ATTN_NORM);
            }
        }
        if !moving(d.state) && moving(*last) {
            if let Some(e) = playing.take() {
                commands.entity(e).try_despawn();
            }
            if d.stop_sound > 0 {
                one_shot(&mut commands, &mut sounds, &mut assets, &format!("doors/doorstop{}.wav", d.stop_sound), at, ear, settings.volume);
            }
        }
        if let Some(mut p) = playing.and_then(|e| placed.get_mut(e).ok()) {
            p.at = at; // the sound moves with the door
        }
        *last = d.state;
    }
}

fn one_shot(commands: &mut Commands, sounds: &mut Sounds, assets: &mut Assets<AudioSource>, file: &str, at: [f32; 3], ear: [f32; 3], volume: f32) {
    let v = volume * gain(at, ear, ATTN_NORM);
    if let (true, Some(h)) = (v > 0.01, sounds.get(file, assets)) {
        commands.spawn((AudioPlayer(h), PlaybackSettings::DESPAWN.with_volume(Volume::Linear(v)).with_spatial(true), Transform::from_translation(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(at)))));
    }
}

/// `env_spark` (`DoSpark`): sparks and a crackle at 0.25-0.75 x 0.4 volume, then again in
/// 0.1 s plus up to `MaxDelay`.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn sparks(mut commands: Commands, mut ms: ResMut<MapSounds>, mut sounds: ResMut<Sounds>, mut assets: ResMut<Assets<AudioSource>>, w: Res<Walker>, settings: Res<Settings>, time: Res<Time>, mut hits: MessageWriter<Hit>) {
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    let ear = w.client.me().eye();
    for i in 0..ms.sparks.len() {
        let r = ms.rand();
        let next = *ms.sparks[i].next.get_or_insert(now + 0.1 + r * 1.5); // first: 0.1-1.6 s in
        if now < next {
            continue;
        }
        let (r1, r2, r3) = (ms.rand(), ms.rand(), ms.rand());
        let s = &mut ms.sparks[i];
        s.next = Some(now + 0.1 + r1 * s.max_delay);
        hits.write(Hit::Sparks { at: s.at });
        let file = format!("buttons/spark{}.wav", 1 + (r2 * 6.0).min(5.0) as u32);
        one_shot(&mut commands, &mut sounds, &mut assets, &file, s.at, ear, settings.volume * (0.25 + r3 * 0.5) * 0.4);
    }
}
```

`client/src/match_flow.rs`:

```rs
//! A reserved match on screen: "waiting for players", the knife round, the winners' stay or
//! switch vote (F1 / F2, CS's vote keys), the match paused when a side is empty, the
//! surrender vote once a teammate abandoned (F3 calls it, F1 / F2 answer), and back to the
//! menu when the match is over.
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::ui::{hud_panel, kit_text, vh, Kit, AMBER, TX1};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use net::protocol::{Stage, Team};

pub struct MatchFlowPlugin;

impl Plugin for MatchFlowPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::InGame), spawn).add_systems(Update, (banner, vote, ended).in_set(Frame::Ui));
    }
}

#[derive(Component)]
struct Banner;

fn spawn(mut commands: Commands, kit: Res<Kit>) {
    commands
        .spawn((DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame), Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), top: vh(190.0), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, ..default() }))
        .with_children(|row| {
            row.spawn((Banner, Visibility::Hidden, hud_panel(Node { padding: UiRect::axes(vh(24.0), vh(12.0)), border: UiRect::top(vh(crate::ui::BAR)), ..default() }), BorderColor::all(AMBER)))
                .with_children(|p| {
                    p.spawn(kit_text("", 20.0, TX1, &kit.text));
                });
        });
}

fn side(t: Team) -> &'static str {
    if t == Team::Ct { "Bureau" } else { "Strays" }
}

fn banner(w: Res<Walker>, binds: Res<crate::binds::Binds>, mut banner: Query<(&mut Visibility, &Children), With<Banner>>, mut texts: Query<&mut Text>) {
    use crate::binds::Action;
    // the keys as bound, in the player's layout
    let key = |a: Action| binds.get(a).label(binds.layout);
    let Ok((mut vis, kids)) = banner.single_mut() else { return };
    let round = &w.client.round;
    let me = w.client.team();
    let mine = (me == Team::Ct) as usize;
    let msg = match round.stage {
        Stage::Match if round.paused => Some("Match paused: a team has nobody connected. It resumes when someone returns.".to_string()),
        Stage::Match => match round.vote {
            Some(v) if v.team == me && v.kick == w.client.id() => Some(format!("Your team is voting to kick you ({:.0}s)", v.left)),
            // your team's other votes have their own panel (`vote`)
            Some(v) if v.team == me => None,
            None if me != Team::Spectator && round.abandoned[mine] => Some(format!("A teammate abandoned the match · {} calls a surrender vote", key(Action::Surrender))),
            _ => None,
        },
        Stage::Waiting => Some("Waiting for everyone to connect...".to_string()),
        Stage::Knife => Some("KNIFE ROUND · the winners pick their side".to_string()),
        Stage::SideVote { winners, left } if w.client.team() == winners => Some(format!("You won the knife round: {} stay · {} switch sides ({left:.0}s)", key(Action::VoteYes), key(Action::VoteNo))),
        Stage::SideVote { winners, left } => Some(format!("{} are picking sides ({left:.0}s)", side(winners))),
    };
    *vis = if msg.is_some() { Visibility::Inherited } else { Visibility::Hidden };
    if let Some(mut t) = kids.first().and_then(|k| texts.get_mut(*k).ok()) {
        let s = msg.unwrap_or_default();
        if t.0 != s {
            t.0 = s;
        }
    }
}

fn vote(mut w: ResMut<Walker>, keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>, mouse: Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>, binds: Res<crate::binds::Binds>) {
    use crate::binds::Action;
    let (yes, no) = (binds.just(Action::VoteYes, &keys, &mouse), binds.just(Action::VoteNo, &keys, &mouse));
    if matches!(w.client.round.stage, Stage::SideVote { .. }) {
        if yes {
            w.client.side_vote(false);
        } else if no {
            w.client.side_vote(true);
        }
    } else if w.client.round.vote.is_some_and(|v| v.team == w.client.team()) {
        if yes || no {
            w.client.surrender_vote(yes);
        }
    } else if binds.just(Action::Surrender, &keys, &mouse) {
        w.client.call_surrender();
    }
}

fn ended(mut commands: Commands, w: Res<Walker>, mut next: ResMut<NextState<AppState>>) {
    if w.client.match_ended {
        commands.insert_resource(crate::notice::Notice::info("Match over", "Good games!"));
        next.set(AppState::Menu);
    }
}
```

`client/src/menu/connect.rs`:

```rs
//! Joining a match: what the next match is, then the steps (`loading::Step`), each slow one
//! on its own thread so the loading screen keeps moving: start the built-in server (or find
//! the address), say hello until welcomed (10 s), load the map, enter. Any failure goes back
//! to the menu with a `Notice`; Esc cancels. Also leaving again.
use super::{AppState, Settings};
use crate::game::Walker;
use crate::game_dir;
use crate::loading::{load_map, Job, Loading, MapData, Progress, Step};
use crate::notice::Notice;
use crate::ui::{UiAction, UiActions};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::Arc;

/// What the next match is.
#[derive(Resource, Clone)]
pub struct GameConfig {
    /// Map to run (built-in server). For a remote server the server says which map.
    pub map: String,
    pub server: ServerChoice,
    pub give: Vec<sim::weapons::Id>,
    /// Our seat in a reserved match (from the lobby); 0 = none.
    pub ticket: u64,
    /// The seat's encryption key (from the lobby).
    pub key: Option<[u8; 32]>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub enum ServerChoice {
    /// A server inside the game.
    Local(net::server::Rules),
    Remote(String),
}

/// The server running inside the game, stopped when the match ends.
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct LocalServer(pub Arc<AtomicBool>);

/// A connection waiting for the server's welcome.
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct PendingClient(pub Option<net::Client>);

/// The step in progress: the server's address being found (or the server started), or the
/// map being loaded.
#[derive(Resource)]
pub(super) enum Work {
    Server(Job<Result<SocketAddr, Notice>>),
    Hello { waited: f32 },
    Map(Job<Result<MapData, Notice>>, Progress),
    /// Map loaded: waiting for the first snapshot, so the game opens where we are.
    Joining { waited: f32 },
}

/// Start: the built-in server, or look the address up.
pub(super) fn start_connecting(mut commands: Commands, config: Res<GameConfig>) {
    commands.remove_resource::<PendingClient>();
    commands.remove_resource::<Notice>();
    commands.spawn((Camera2d, DespawnOnExit(AppState::Connecting)));
    let practice = matches!(config.server, ServerChoice::Local(_));
    commands.insert_resource(Loading {
        target: match &config.server {
            ServerChoice::Remote(a) => a.clone(),
            ServerChoice::Local(_) => config.map.clone(),
        },
        map: practice.then(|| config.map.clone()),
        practice,
        step: if practice { Step::StartingServer } else { Step::Contacting },
        progress: 0.0,
        elapsed: 0.0,
    });
    let job = match config.server.clone() {
        ServerChoice::Remote(a) => Job::spawn(move || {
            std::net::ToSocketAddrs::to_socket_addrs(&a).ok().and_then(|mut it| it.next()).ok_or_else(|| Notice::error("Can't find the server", format!("No server at '{a}'. Check the address.")).with_retry())
        }),
        ServerChoice::Local(rules) => {
            // The stop flag exists before the thread: cancelling stops a server still starting.
            let stop = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
            commands.insert_resource(LocalServer(stop.clone()));
            let (map, give) = (config.map.clone(), config.give.clone());
            Job::spawn(move || {
                let root = game_dir();
                let bsp = goldsrc::bsp::Bsp::load(&root.join("maps").join(format!("{map}.bsp"))).map_err(|e| Notice::error("Map missing", format!("Can't load {map} ({e}).")))?;
                let assets = net::server::Assets::load(&root).map_err(|e| Notice::error("Game files missing", format!("{e}. Verify your game files.")))?;
                let mut server = net::Server::new(([127, 0, 0, 1], 0).into(), &map, &bsp, assets).map_err(|e| Notice::error("Couldn't start the game", format!("The built-in server didn't start ({e}).")).with_retry())?;
                server.set_give(give);
                server.set_rules(rules);
                let addr = server.local_addr();
                std::thread::spawn(move || server.run_until(&stop));
                Ok(addr)
            })
        }
    };
    commands.insert_resource(Work::Server(job));
}

/// Back to the menu with a notice.
fn fail(commands: &mut Commands, next: &mut NextState<AppState>, notice: Notice) {
    commands.insert_resource(notice);
    next.set(AppState::Menu);
}

/// Move the steps along (the connection itself ticks at the tick rate, `tick_connection`).
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(super) fn advance(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut work: ResMut<Work>,
    mut loading: ResMut<Loading>,
    mut pending: Option<ResMut<PendingClient>>,
    config: Res<GameConfig>,
    settings: Res<Settings>,
    steam: Option<Res<crate::steam::Steam>>,
    mut next: ResMut<NextState<AppState>>,
    time: Res<Time>,
    mut fixed: ResMut<Time<Fixed>>,
) {
    loading.elapsed += time.delta_secs();
    match &mut *work {
        Work::Server(job) => {
            let addr = match job.poll() {
                Ok(None) => return,
                Ok(Some(Ok(addr))) => addr,
                Ok(Some(Err(n))) => return fail(&mut commands, &mut next, n),
                Err(()) => return fail(&mut commands, &mut next, Notice::error("Couldn't start the game", "Something went wrong getting ready.").with_retry()),
            };
            // With Steam you play under your Steam name.
            let name = steam.as_ref().map(|s| s.name.clone()).unwrap_or_else(|| settings.name.clone());
            let mut client = match net::Client::connect(addr, &name, sim::collision::World::flat_floor(-100_000.0)) {
                Ok(c) => c,
                Err(e) => return fail(&mut commands, &mut next, Notice::error("Network error", format!("Can't open a connection ({e}).")).with_retry()),
            };
            let ping = std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_FAKE_PING").ok().and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
            let loss = std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_FAKE_LOSS").ok().and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0.0);
            client.simulate_network(ping, loss);
            client.ticket = config.ticket;
            client.key = config.key;
            commands.insert_resource(PendingClient(Some(client)));
            loading.step = Step::Contacting;
            loading.progress = 0.15;
            *work = Work::Hello { waited: 0.0 };
        }
        Work::Hello { waited } => {
            let Some(client) = pending.as_mut().and_then(|p| p.0.as_mut()) else { return };
            *waited += time.delta_secs();
            match client.status {
                net::client::Status::Connected { .. } => {
                    // Predict at the server's step size, or it corrects us all the time.
                    fixed.set_timestep_hz(client.rate().hz() as f64);
                    let map = client.map.clone().unwrap_or_default();
                    let hash = client.map_hash;
                    loading.map = Some(map.clone());
                    loading.step = Step::LoadingMap;
                    loading.progress = 0.25;
                    let progress = Progress::default();
                    let p = progress.clone();
                    *work = Work::Map(Job::spawn(move || load_map(map, hash, p)), progress);
                }
                net::client::Status::Rejected => {
                    let why = client.reject_reason.clone().unwrap_or_default();
                    fail(&mut commands, &mut next, Notice::error("Server refused you", why).with_retry());
                }
                net::client::Status::Connecting if *waited > 10.0 => {
                    let body = match &config.server {
                        ServerChoice::Remote(a) => format!("{a} didn't answer in 10 seconds."),
                        ServerChoice::Local(_) => "The built-in server didn't answer.".to_string(),
                    };
                    fail(&mut commands, &mut next, Notice::error("Can't reach the server", body).with_retry());
                }
                net::client::Status::Connecting => loading.progress = 0.15 + 0.1 * (*waited / 10.0),
            }
        }
        Work::Map(job, progress) => {
            loading.progress = 0.25 + 0.65 * progress.get();
            let mut map = match job.poll() {
                Ok(None) => return,
                Ok(Some(Ok(m))) => m,
                Ok(Some(Err(n))) => return fail(&mut commands, &mut next, n),
                Err(()) => return fail(&mut commands, &mut next, Notice::error("Map didn't load", "The map file couldn't be read.")),
            };
            let Some(client) = pending.as_mut().and_then(|p| p.0.as_mut()) else { return };
            if let Some(world) = map.world.take() {
                client.world = world;
            }
            if let Some(m) = client.map.clone() {
                commands.insert_resource(GameConfig { map: m, ..config.clone() });
            }
            commands.insert_resource(map);
            loading.step = Step::Joining;
            loading.progress = 0.95;
            *work = Work::Joining { waited: 0.0 };
        }
        Work::Joining { waited } => {
            let Some(client) = pending.as_ref().and_then(|p| p.0.as_ref()) else { return };
            *waited += time.delta_secs();
            if client.has_snapshot() {
                loading.progress = 1.0;
                next.set(AppState::InGame);
            } else if *waited > 10.0 {
                fail(&mut commands, &mut next, Notice::error("Can't reach the server", "The server stopped answering while you joined.").with_retry());
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Keep the connection alive while loading (the server drops a silent player after 5 s).
pub(super) fn tick_connection(mut pending: Option<ResMut<PendingClient>>) {
    if let Some(client) = pending.as_mut().and_then(|p| p.0.as_mut()) {
        client.tick(sim::pmove::Input::default());
    }
}

/// Esc or the screen's Cancel: back to the menu (the match is left).
pub(super) fn cancel(keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>, mut actions: ResMut<UiActions>, mut next: ResMut<NextState<AppState>>) {
    let clicked = actions.0.iter().any(|a| *a == UiAction::CancelLoading);
    actions.0.retain(|a| *a != UiAction::CancelLoading);
    if clicked || keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Escape) {
        next.set(AppState::Menu);
    }
}

/// Leaving the loading screen: drop the steps; a cancelled join says goodbye.
pub(super) fn stop_loading(mut commands: Commands, mut pending: Option<ResMut<PendingClient>>, server: Option<Res<LocalServer>>, state: Res<State<AppState>>) {
    commands.remove_resource::<Work>();
    // (the state is already the new one here; into the game the screen stays up a moment,
    // `loading::reveal`)
    if *state.get() == AppState::InGame {
        return;
    }
    commands.remove_resource::<Loading>();
    if let Some(c) = pending.as_mut().and_then(|p| p.0.as_mut()) {
        c.disconnect();
    }
    commands.remove_resource::<PendingClient>();
    if let Some(s) = server {
        s.0.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    commands.remove_resource::<LocalServer>();
}

/// Leaving a match: say goodbye, stop the built-in server, back to the menu.
pub(super) fn leave_game(mut commands: Commands, walker: Option<ResMut<Walker>>, server: Option<Res<LocalServer>>) {
    if let Some(mut w) = walker {
        w.client.disconnect();
    }
    if let Some(s) = server {
        s.0.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    commands.remove_resource::<Walker>();
    commands.remove_resource::<LocalServer>();
    commands.remove_resource::<MapData>();
    commands.remove_resource::<Loading>(); // left while still covered
}
```
