```rs
//! Main menu, practice setup, joining a server, settings, the connecting screen,
//! the in-game Esc menu and team selection. `settings`: the player settings and their file;
//! `connect`: starting and joining a match.
mod connect;
mod settings;

pub use connect::*;
pub use settings::Settings;
use crate::ui::{Kit, UiAction, UiActions};
use crate::game::Walker;
use crate::game_dir;
use bevy::input::keyboard::{Key, KeyboardInput};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::window::{CursorGrabMode, CursorOptions};

#[derive(States, Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub enum AppState {
    #[default]
    Menu,
    Connecting,
    InGame,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub enum Page {
    #[default]
    Main,
    Practice,
    Join,
    Settings,
    Voice,
    Characters,
    Maps,
}

/// Set to redraw the menu from outside (e.g. after a voice key was bound).
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct MenuDirty(pub bool);

/// Menu-only state: current page, chosen map, typed party code or address.
#[derive(Resource)]
pub(crate) struct MenuState {
    pub(crate) page: Page,
    pub(crate) maps: Vec<String>,
    pub(crate) map: String,
    pub(crate) dummies: i32,
    /// Practice page: deathmatch online (else solo, offline).
    pub(crate) deathmatch: bool,
    /// Settings page section (`UiAction::SettingsTab`).
    pub(crate) settings_tab: u8,
    pub(crate) address: String,
    pub(crate) rebuild: bool,
}

#[derive(Component)]
pub(crate) struct MenuRoot;

pub struct MenuPlugin;

impl Plugin for MenuPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        crate::found::plugin(app);
        app.add_plugins(crate::play::PlayPlugin)
            .init_resource::<UiActions>()
            .init_resource::<Kit>()
            .init_resource::<MenuDirty>()
            .insert_resource(Settings::load())
            .add_systems(Startup, from_command_line)
            .add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::Menu), enter_menu)
            .add_systems(Update, escape.run_if(in_state(AppState::Menu)).run_if(resource_exists::<MenuState>))
            .add_systems(
                Update,
                ((crate::notice::keys, crate::notice::actions).chain().run_if(resource_exists::<crate::notice::Notice>), menu_actions, crate::menu_pages::rebuild_menu, type_text).chain().run_if(in_state(AppState::Menu)),
            )
            .add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::Connecting), connect::start_connecting)
            .add_systems(Update, (connect::cancel, connect::advance).chain().run_if(in_state(AppState::Connecting)).run_if(resource_exists::<connect::Work>))
            .add_systems(FixedUpdate, connect::tick_connection.run_if(in_state(AppState::Connecting)))
            .add_systems(OnExit(AppState::Connecting), connect::stop_loading)
            .add_systems(Update, (crate::overlay::pause_menu, crate::overlay::in_game_actions).chain().run_if(in_state(AppState::InGame)).run_if(resource_exists::<Walker>))
            .add_systems(OnExit(AppState::InGame), connect::leave_game);
    }
}

/// `client [map] [--connect host:port] [--name name] [--give ak47,awp] [--practice N]`:
/// any argument skips the menu.
fn from_command_line(mut commands: Commands, mut settings: ResMut<Settings>, mut next: ResMut<NextState<AppState>>) {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
    if args.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let flag = |f: &str| args.iter().position(|a| a == f).and_then(|i| args.get(i + 1)).cloned();
    if let Some(name) = flag("--name") {
        settings.name = name; // this run only, not saved
    }
    let map = args.first().filter(|a| !a.starts_with("--")).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| "de_dust2".into());
    let server = match (flag("--connect"), flag("--practice")) {
        (Some(addr), _) => ServerChoice::Remote(addr),
        (None, Some(n)) => ServerChoice::Local(net::server::Rules::practice(n.parse().unwrap_or(5))),
        // A match on a local server (for testing the rules; nobody else is there).
        (None, None) => ServerChoice::Local(net::server::Rules::default()),
    };
    let give = flag("--give").map(|l| l.split(',').filter_map(sim::weapons::data::by_name).collect()).unwrap_or_default();
    commands.insert_resource(GameConfig { map, server, give, ticket: 0, key: None });
    next.set(AppState::Connecting);
}

/// The map pool, in order: stand-ins for our four maps (docs/MAPS.md: port is Train,
/// data_center Dust2, bank Mirage, high_rise Inferno), the ones that are installed.
const POOL: [&str; 4] = ["de_dust2", "de_inferno", "de_mirage", "de_train"];

fn maps_installed() -> Vec<String> {
    let dir = game_dir().join("maps");
    POOL.iter().filter(|m| dir.join(format!("{m}.bsp")).exists()).map(|m| m.to_string()).collect()
}

fn enter_menu(mut commands: Commands, mut cursor: Single<&mut CursorOptions>) {
    cursor.grab_mode = CursorGrabMode::None;
    cursor.visible = true;
    let maps = maps_installed();
    // Screenshot runs can open a page directly (BOOTLEG16_MENU_PAGE=practice|join|settings|
    // crosshair|assistant|keys|voice; crosshair, assistant and keys are Settings sections).
    let wanted = std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_MENU_PAGE");
    let settings_tab = match wanted.as_deref() {
        Ok("crosshair") => 1,
        Ok("assistant") => 2,
        Ok("keys") => 3,
        _ => 0,
    };
    let page = match wanted.as_deref() {
        Ok("practice") => Page::Practice,
        Ok("join") => Page::Join,
        Ok("settings" | "crosshair" | "assistant" | "keys") => Page::Settings,
        Ok("voice") => Page::Voice,
        Ok("characters") => Page::Characters,
        Ok("maps") => Page::Maps,
        _ => Page::Main,
    };
    commands.insert_resource(MenuState {
        page,
        map: maps.first().cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| "de_dust2".into()),
        maps,
        dummies: 5,
        deathmatch: false,
        settings_tab,
        address: String::new(),
        rebuild: true,
    });
    // The page colour is the clear colour, so menu parts can tune in and out over it.
    commands.spawn((Camera2d, Camera { clear_color: ClearColorConfig::Custom(crate::ui::BG0), ..default() }, Msaa::Off, IsDefaultUiCamera, DespawnOnExit(AppState::Menu)));
}

/// Esc closes a page back to the main menu (not while a key is being bound; the Play screen
/// has its own, `play::back`).
fn escape(keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>, binds: Res<crate::binds::Binds>, mut st: ResMut<MenuState>) {
    if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Escape) && binds.capture.is_none() && !matches!(st.page, Page::Main | Page::Join) {
        st.page = Page::Main;
        st.rebuild = true;
    }
}

/// Typing into the party code / address field (Play page) or the name (Settings page).
/// With Steam your name is your Steam name, so the Settings field is only typed into without it.
fn type_text(mut keys: MessageReader<KeyboardInput>, mut st: ResMut<MenuState>, mut settings: ResMut<Settings>, steam: Option<Res<crate::steam::Steam>>) {
    for k in keys.read().filter(|k| k.state.is_pressed()) {
        let field = match st.page {
            Page::Join => &mut st.address,
            Page::Settings if steam.is_none() && st.settings_tab == 0 => &mut settings.name,
            _ => continue,
        };
        match &k.logical_key {
            Key::Backspace => {
                field.pop();
            }
            Key::Character(c) if field.len() < 40 && c.chars().all(|ch| !ch.is_control()) => field.push_str(c),
            _ => continue,
        }
        if st.page == Page::Settings {
            settings.save();
        }
        st.rebuild = true;
    }
}

fn menu_actions(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut actions: ResMut<UiActions>,
    mut st: ResMut<MenuState>,
    mut settings: ResMut<Settings>,
    mut next: ResMut<NextState<AppState>>,
    mut exit: MessageWriter<AppExit>,
    keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>,
    (mut voice, devices): (ResMut<crate::voice::VoiceSettings>, Res<crate::voice::Devices>),
    (mut lobby, steam): (ResMut<crate::play::Lobby>, Option<Res<crate::steam::Steam>>),
    (mut binds, notice): (ResMut<crate::binds::Binds>, Option<Res<crate::notice::Notice>>),
) {
    let ready = lobby.shown.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.ready);
    if notice.is_some() {
        // Enter belongs to the notice over the menu
    } else if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Enter) && ready.is_some_and(|r| !r.you) {
        // a match found takes Enter first (the accept button says so)
        actions.0.push(UiAction::Lobby(crate::play::LobbyAction::AcceptMatch));
    } else if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Enter) && st.page == Page::Join {
        // Nothing typed: the big button (find match / start). An address (has a dot or colon)
        // connects directly; anything else is a party code.
        actions.0.push(match st.address.trim() {
            "" => UiAction::Lobby(crate::play::LobbyAction::Play),
            a if a.contains(['.', ':']) => UiAction::Connect,
            _ => UiAction::Lobby(crate::play::LobbyAction::JoinParty),
        });
    } else if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Enter) && st.page == Page::Practice {
        // the page's main button, as its key hint says
        if !st.deathmatch {
            actions.0.push(UiAction::StartPractice);
        } else if lobby.shown.is_some() {
            actions.0.push(UiAction::Lobby(crate::play::LobbyAction::Deathmatch));
        }
    }
    for a in std::mem::take(&mut actions.0) {
        st.rebuild = true;
        match a {
            UiAction::Page(p) => {
                st.page = p;
            }
            UiAction::PickMap(m) => st.map = m,
            // Characters page: wear this one on that side (the other side keeps its pick).
            UiAction::SetLook(side, i) => {
                let mut looks = settings.looks.unwrap_or([0, 0]);
                looks[side.min(1) as usize] = i.min(net::protocol::CLASSES - 1);
                settings.looks = Some(looks);
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::PracticeMode(dm) => st.deathmatch = dm,
            UiAction::Dummies(d) => st.dummies = (st.dummies + d).clamp(0, 20),
            UiAction::StartPractice => {
                commands.insert_resource(GameConfig {
                    map: st.map.clone(),
                    server: ServerChoice::Local(net::server::Rules::practice(st.dummies as u8)),
                    give: Vec::new(),
                    ticket: 0,
                    key: None,
                });
                next.set(AppState::Connecting);
            }
            UiAction::Lobby(a) => crate::play::apply(&mut lobby, &mut st, steam.as_deref(), a),
            UiAction::Connect => {
                commands.insert_resource(GameConfig { map: String::new(), server: ServerChoice::Remote(st.address.trim().to_string()), give: Vec::new(), ticket: 0, key: None });
                next.set(AppState::Connecting);
            }
            UiAction::Sensitivity(d) => {
                settings.sensitivity = (settings.sensitivity + d).clamp(0.1, 20.0);
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::Volume(d) => {
                settings.volume = (settings.volume + d).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::FpsMax(step) => {
                // Steps like CS players use; 0 (unlimited) last.
                const CAPS: [u32; 8] = [60, 100, 144, 200, 240, 300, 500, 0];
                let i = CAPS.iter().position(|c| *c == settings.fps_max).unwrap_or(5) as i32;
                settings.fps_max = CAPS[(i + step).clamp(0, CAPS.len() as i32 - 1) as usize];
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::Voice(a) => crate::voice::apply(&mut voice, &devices, a),
            UiAction::SetTeamIds(v) => {
                settings.team_ids = v.min(2);
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::SetVsync(v) => {
                settings.vsync = v;
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::SetBorderless(v) => {
                settings.borderless = v;
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::SetResolution(i) => {
                settings.resolution = i.min(crate::window::RESOLUTIONS.len() as u8 - 1);
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::SetAssistant(i) => {
                settings.assistant = i.min(crate::assistant::OFF);
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::Chattiness(c) => {
                settings.chattiness = c.min(2);
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::SetRelay(v) => {
                settings.relay = v;
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::SetAssistantInRound(v) => {
                settings.assistant_in_round = v;
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::SettingsTab(t) => st.settings_tab = t.min(3),
            UiAction::Rebind(a) => binds.capture = if binds.capture == Some(a) { None } else { Some(a) },
            UiAction::ResetBinds => {
                *binds = crate::binds::Binds::default();
                binds.save();
            }
            UiAction::CrosshairColor(c) => {
                settings.crosshair_color = c.min(crate::hud::CROSSHAIR_COLORS.len() as u8 - 1);
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::CrosshairSize(v) => {
                settings.crosshair_size = v.min(2);
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::CrosshairDynamic(v) => {
                settings.crosshair_dynamic = v;
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::HudCurve(d) => {
                settings.hud_curve = (settings.hud_curve as i16 + d as i16 * 20).clamp(0, 100) as u8;
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::CrosshairDot(v) => {
                settings.crosshair_dot = v;
                settings.save();
            }
            UiAction::Quit => {
                exit.write(AppExit::Success);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

pub use crate::overlay::{overlay_open, Overlay};
```

`client/src/menu/settings.rs`:

```rs
//! Player settings: what they are and their file (~/.config/bootleg16/settings.txt).
use bevy::prelude::*;
use std::path::PathBuf;

/// Player settings, saved in ~/.config/bootleg16/settings.txt.
#[derive(Resource, Clone)]
pub struct Settings {
    pub name: String,
    /// Mouse sensitivity, as in CS (× 0.022° per mouse count).
    pub sensitivity: f32,
    pub volume: f32,
    /// Frame rate cap (0 = none), like CS's fps_max.
    pub fps_max: u32,
    pub vsync: bool,
    /// A borderless window the size of the screen (not the compositor's fullscreen mode).
    pub borderless: bool,
    /// The window's size when it is not borderless: an index into `window::RESOLUTIONS`.
    pub resolution: u8,
    /// CS2 "Show Team ID Through Walls": 0 off, 1 pips, 2 pips and names.
    pub team_ids: u8,
    /// AI assistant: index into `assistant::ASSISTANTS`, or `assistant::OFF`.
    pub assistant: u8,
    /// How often it talks: 0 quiet, 1 normal, 2 chatty.
    pub chattiness: u8,
    /// Relay live team info (kills, fights, bomb) like a teammate typing.
    pub relay: bool,
    /// Talk during live rounds at all (competitive servers can force this off).
    pub assistant_in_round: bool,
    /// Crosshair: colour (index into `hud::CROSSHAIR_COLORS`), size 0 small .. 2 large, whether
    /// the gap follows the weapon's spread (CS's dynamic crosshair), and a centre dot.
    pub crosshair_color: u8,
    pub crosshair_size: u8,
    pub crosshair_dynamic: bool,
    pub crosshair_dot: bool,
    /// How much the HUD bends like a visor (0 flat .. 100), `hud::visor`.
    pub hud_curve: u8,
    /// Your character as a terrorist and as a counter-terrorist (Characters page); None until
    /// you pick (the server varies them).
    pub looks: Option<[u8; 2]>,
}

impl Default for Settings {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Settings { name: "player".into(), sensitivity: 5.0, volume: 0.8, fps_max: 300, vsync: false, borderless: false, resolution: crate::window::DEFAULT_RESOLUTION, team_ids: 2, assistant: 0, chattiness: 1, relay: true, assistant_in_round: true, crosshair_color: 0, crosshair_size: 1, crosshair_dynamic: true, crosshair_dot: false, hud_curve: 60, looks: None }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn settings_path() -> PathBuf {
    crate::gamefiles::config_dir().join("settings.txt")
}

impl Settings {
    pub fn load() -> Settings {
        let mut s = Settings::default();
        if let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(settings_path()) {
            for line in text.lines() {
                match line.split_once('=') {
                    Some(("name", v)) => s.name = v.trim().to_string(),
                    Some(("sensitivity", v)) => s.sensitivity = v.trim().parse().unwrap_or(s.sensitivity),
                    Some(("volume", v)) => s.volume = v.trim().parse().unwrap_or(s.volume),
                    Some(("fps_max", v)) => s.fps_max = v.trim().parse().unwrap_or(s.fps_max),
                    Some(("vsync", v)) => s.vsync = v.trim() == "true",
                    Some(("borderless", v)) => s.borderless = v.trim() == "true",
                    Some(("resolution", v)) => s.resolution = v.trim().parse::<u8>().unwrap_or(s.resolution).min(crate::window::RESOLUTIONS.len() as u8 - 1),
                    Some(("team_ids", v)) => s.team_ids = v.trim().parse::<u8>().unwrap_or(s.team_ids).min(2),
                    Some(("assistant", v)) => s.assistant = v.trim().parse::<u8>().unwrap_or(s.assistant).min(crate::assistant::OFF),
                    Some(("chattiness", v)) => s.chattiness = v.trim().parse::<u8>().unwrap_or(s.chattiness).min(2),
                    Some(("relay", v)) => s.relay = v.trim() == "true",
                    Some(("assistant_in_round", v)) => s.assistant_in_round = v.trim() == "true",
                    Some(("crosshair_color", v)) => s.crosshair_color = v.trim().parse::<u8>().unwrap_or(0).min(crate::hud::CROSSHAIR_COLORS.len() as u8 - 1),
                    Some(("crosshair_size", v)) => s.crosshair_size = v.trim().parse::<u8>().unwrap_or(1).min(2),
                    Some(("crosshair_dynamic", v)) => s.crosshair_dynamic = v.trim() == "true",
                    Some(("crosshair_dot", v)) => s.crosshair_dot = v.trim() == "true",
                    Some(("looks", v)) => {
                        let n: Vec<u8> = v.split(',').filter_map(|x| x.trim().parse().ok()).collect();
                        if let [t, ct] = n[..] {
                            s.looks = Some([t.min(net::protocol::CLASSES - 1), ct.min(net::protocol::CLASSES - 1)]);
                        }
                    }
                    Some(("hud_curve", v)) => s.hud_curve = v.trim().parse::<u8>().unwrap_or(60).min(100),
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
        }
        s
    }

    pub(crate) fn save(&self) {
        let p = settings_path();
        let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(p.parent().unwrap());
        let _ = std::fs::write(
            p,
            format!(
                "name={}\nsensitivity={}\nvolume={}\nfps_max={}\nvsync={}\nborderless={}\nresolution={}\nteam_ids={}\nassistant={}\nchattiness={}\nrelay={}\nassistant_in_round={}\ncrosshair_color={}\ncrosshair_size={}\ncrosshair_dynamic={}\ncrosshair_dot={}\nhud_curve={}\n{}",
                self.name, self.sensitivity, self.volume, self.fps_max, self.vsync, self.borderless, self.resolution, self.team_ids, self.assistant, self.chattiness, self.relay, self.assistant_in_round, self.crosshair_color, self.crosshair_size, self.crosshair_dynamic, self.crosshair_dot, self.hud_curve,
                self.looks.map(|[t, ct]| format!("looks={t},{ct}\n")).unwrap_or_default()
            ),
        );
    }
}
```

`client/src/menu_pages.rs`:

```rs
//! Drawing the main menu and its pages (Interference, design/mockups/ui): the numbered list on
//! the left, the wordmark bottom left, you top right, the open page on the right.
//! The frame stays while pages swap inside it: on a page change the old page tunes out and the
//! new one tunes in, its rows staggered. Any other change rebuilds in place, where selections
//! slide and values roll (`UiMemory`). Play is a full screen of its own.
use crate::assistant::{ASSISTANTS, OFF};
use crate::menu::{AppState, MenuDirty, MenuRoot, MenuState, Page, Settings};
use crate::ui::{chips, kit_text, nav, page_title, primary_button, setting_row, stepper, vh, Anim, Choice, Kit, NavItem, UiAction, UiMemory, AMBER, AMBER_INK, T_OUT, TX1, TX2, TX3};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::text::LineHeight;

/// The open page (or the whole Play screen), swapped with a transition.
#[derive(Component)]
pub(crate) struct MenuPage;

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn rebuild_menu(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut st: ResMut<MenuState>,
    settings: Res<Settings>,
    voice: Res<crate::voice::VoiceSettings>,
    kit: Res<Kit>,
    lobby: Res<crate::play::Lobby>,
    steam: Option<Res<crate::steam::Steam>>,
    mut dirty: ResMut<MenuDirty>,
    mut memory: ResMut<UiMemory>,
    faces: Res<crate::assistant::view::Faces>,
    binds: Res<crate::binds::Binds>,
    portraits: Res<crate::characters::Portraits>,
    pool: Res<crate::map_pool::Pool>,
    frames: Query<Entity, With<MenuRoot>>,
    pages: Query<Entity, With<MenuPage>>,
) {
    if !st.rebuild && !dirty.0 {
        return;
    }
    st.rebuild = false;
    dirty.0 = false;
    let st = &*st;
    let first = frames.is_empty() && pages.is_empty();
    let play = st.page == Page::Join;
    let page_changed = memory.changed("menu.page", &format!("{:?}", st.page));
    let kind_changed = memory.changed("menu.kind", if play { "play" } else { "menu" });
    // Leaving parts tune out (and are despawned when done); the rest is rebuilt in place.
    for e in &frames {
        if kind_changed {
            commands.entity(e).remove::<MenuRoot>().insert(Anim::tune_out());
        } else {
            commands.entity(e).despawn();
        }
    }
    for e in &pages {
        if page_changed {
            commands.entity(e).remove::<MenuPage>().insert(Anim::tune_out());
        } else {
            commands.entity(e).despawn();
        }
    }
    let tune_frame = first || kind_changed;
    let tune_page = first || page_changed;
    let delay = if page_changed { T_OUT } else { 0.0 };
    let tune = |i: usize| Anim::tune_in(delay + i as f32 * crate::ui::STAGGER);
    let abs = |node: Node| Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, ..node };
    let full = Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), height: percent(100), ..default() };
    let steam = steam.as_deref();

    if play {
        let mut page = commands.spawn((MenuPage, DespawnOnExit(AppState::Menu), full));
        if tune_page {
            page.insert(tune(0));
        }
        page.with_children(|root| {
            crate::play::screen(root, &kit, st, &lobby, &settings, steam);
            crate::found::notes(root, &kit, &lobby, steam, 72.0 + 68.0 + 16.0);
        });
        crate::found::overlay(&mut commands, &kit, &lobby, &mut memory);
        return;
    }

    // The frame: the right side (your name, invites, the far 16) and the left side (list,
    // wordmark).
    commands.spawn((MenuRoot, DespawnOnExit(AppState::Menu), full.clone())).with_children(|root| {
        // the far 16: the wordmark's number, huge and faint behind everything on the right
        root.spawn((abs(Node { right: vh(-60.0), top: vh(-140.0), ..default() }), kit_text("16", 1150.0, TX1.with_alpha(0.007), &kit.display), LineHeight::RelativeToFont(0.8), Pickable::IGNORE));
        // Top right: who you are; under it your running match and invites.
        crate::play::identity(root, &kit, &settings, steam, 80.0);
        crate::found::notes(root, &kit, &lobby, steam, 80.0 + 68.0 + 16.0);
    });
    commands.spawn((MenuRoot, DespawnOnExit(AppState::Menu), full.clone())).with_children(|root| {
        // 160 from the top: seven items and an error line still clear the wordmark
        let mut list = root.spawn(abs(Node { left: vh(80.0), top: vh(160.0), width: vh(560.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() }));
        if tune_frame {
            list.insert(Anim::stagger(0));
        }
        list.with_children(|col| {
            let item = |num, label, jp, action, selected| NavItem { num, label, jp, action, selected };
            nav(col, &kit, "menu.nav", vec![
                item("01", "Play", "プレイ", UiAction::Page(Page::Join), false),
                item("02", "Practice", "練習", UiAction::Page(Page::Practice), st.page == Page::Practice),
                item("03", "Characters", "キャラ", UiAction::Page(Page::Characters), st.page == Page::Characters),
                item("04", "Maps", "マップ", UiAction::Page(Page::Maps), st.page == Page::Maps),
                item("05", "Settings", "設定", UiAction::Page(Page::Settings), st.page == Page::Settings),
                item("06", "Voice", "音声", UiAction::Page(Page::Voice), st.page == Page::Voice),
                item("07", "Quit", "終了", UiAction::Quit, false),
            ], false);
        });
        // Bottom left: the wordmark. The amber 16 block spans BOOTLEG's cap height exactly
        // (cap top to baseline), the 16 inside it with equal space on all sides.
        let mut jp = root.spawn((abs(Node { left: vh(92.0), bottom: vh(262.0), ..default() }), kit_text("ブートレグ・シックスティーン", 16.0, TX2, &kit.jp)));
        if tune_frame {
            jp.insert(Anim::stagger(3));
        }
        const CAP: f32 = 123.0;
        const BASE: f32 = 1.5;
        const NUDGE: f32 = 7.5;
        let mut mark = root.spawn(abs(Node { left: vh(88.0), bottom: vh(96.0), align_items: AlignItems::FlexEnd, column_gap: vh(8.0), ..default() }));
        if tune_frame {
            mark.insert(Anim::stagger(4));
        }
        mark.with_children(|w| {
            w.spawn((kit_text("BOOTLEG", 150.0, TX1, &kit.display), LineHeight::RelativeToFont(0.8)));
            w.spawn((Node { height: vh(CAP), margin: UiRect::bottom(vh(BASE)), padding: UiRect::horizontal(vh(12.0)), align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }, BackgroundColor(AMBER))).with_children(|b| {
                b.spawn((kit_text("16", 112.0, AMBER_INK, &kit.display), LineHeight::RelativeToFont(1.0), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(NUDGE)), ..default() }));
            });
        });
    });
    // over all, flat: a match found
    crate::found::overlay(&mut commands, &kit, &lobby, &mut memory);

    // The page.
    let mut page = commands.spawn((MenuPage, DespawnOnExit(AppState::Menu), abs(Node { left: vh(720.0), right: vh(96.0), top: vh(200.0), bottom: vh(96.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() })));
    if tune_page {
        page.insert(tune(2));
    }
    page.with_children(|page| match st.page {
        Page::Main | Page::Join => {}
        Page::Practice => practice(page, &kit, &mut memory, st, &lobby),
        Page::Settings => settings_page(page, &kit, &faces, &mut memory, &settings, steam, &binds, st.settings_tab, tune_page.then_some(delay)),
        Page::Voice => crate::voice::page(page, &kit, &mut memory, &voice, tune_page.then_some(delay)),
        Page::Characters => crate::characters::page(page, &kit, &settings, &portraits),
        Page::Maps => crate::map_pool::page(page, &kit, &pool),
    });
}

fn practice(page: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, memory: &mut UiMemory, st: &MenuState, lobby: &crate::play::Lobby) {
    page_title(page, kit, if st.deathmatch { "Up to 20 players · drop in any time · instant respawn" } else { "Offline · no rounds · infinite ammo · instant respawn" }, "Practice", "練習");
    label(page, kit, "Mode");
    chips(page, kit, "practice.mode", vec![Choice::new("Solo · offline", UiAction::PracticeMode(false), !st.deathmatch), Choice::new("Deathmatch · online", UiAction::PracticeMode(true), st.deathmatch)]);
    if st.deathmatch {
        // an official server: teams are picked for you, buying is free anywhere, no rounds;
        // at 100 kills the leader is announced and everyone starts over
        for (i, line) in ["Teams are picked for you, respawn at a random spawn", "Buy anything, anywhere, any time", "First to 100 kills wins, then scores start over"].into_iter().enumerate() {
            page.spawn((kit_text(line, 18.0, TX2, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(if i == 0 { 40.0 } else { 12.0 })), ..default() }));
        }
        page.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(40.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|b| {
            if lobby.shown.is_some() {
                primary_button(b, kit, "Join deathmatch", "Enter", UiAction::Lobby(crate::play::LobbyAction::Deathmatch));
            } else {
                crate::ui::primary_off(b, kit, "Join deathmatch", "The lobby is offline");
            }
        });
        if !lobby.notice.is_empty() {
            page.spawn((kit_text(lobby.notice.clone(), 15.0, AMBER, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(16.0)), ..default() }));
        }
        return;
    }
    label(page, kit, "Map");
    chips(page, kit, "practice.map", st.maps.iter().map(|m| Choice::new(m, UiAction::PickMap(m.clone()), *m == st.map)).collect());
    label(page, kit, "Dummies");
    stepper(page, kit, memory, "practice.dummies", &st.dummies.to_string(), UiAction::Dummies(-1), UiAction::Dummies(1));
    page.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(40.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|b| {
        primary_button(b, kit, &format!("Start · {}", st.map), "Enter", UiAction::StartPractice);
    });
}

/// Setting rows, staggered in when the page tunes in (`tune` is the page's delay).
pub(crate) fn rows(page: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, tune: Option<f32>, build: impl FnOnce(&mut ChildSpawnerCommands) -> Vec<Entity>) {
    page.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, margin: UiRect::top(vh(24.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|rows| {
        let ids = build(rows);
        if let Some(d) = tune {
            for (i, id) in ids.into_iter().enumerate() {
                rows.commands().entity(id).insert(Anim::tune_in(d + (i + 1) as f32 * crate::ui::STAGGER));
            }
        }
    });
}

/// The chip that shows an action's key and rebinds it when clicked (Keys, Voice).
pub(crate) fn key_chip(r: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, binds: &crate::binds::Binds, a: crate::binds::Action) {
    let waiting = binds.capture == Some(a);
    let label = if waiting { "Press a key".to_string() } else { binds.get(a).label(binds.layout) };
    crate::ui::key_chip(r, kit, &label, UiAction::Rebind(a), waiting);
}

/// Every binding in three columns (move, weapons, game and voice): click a key, press the new
/// one (Esc cancels); a key already used swaps over.
fn keys_section(page: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, binds: &crate::binds::Binds, tune: Option<f32>) {
    let mut cols = page.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(24.0)), column_gap: vh(48.0), ..default() });
    if let Some(d) = tune {
        cols.insert(Anim::tune_in(d + crate::ui::STAGGER));
    }
    cols.with_children(|cols| {
        for (title, from, to) in crate::binds::GROUPS {
            cols.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, flex_grow: 1.0, flex_basis: px(0), ..default() }).with_children(|col| {
                col.spawn((kit_text(title.to_uppercase(), 13.0, TX2, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::bottom(vh(8.0)), ..default() }));
                for (a, _, label, _) in &crate::binds::ACTIONS[from..to] {
                    col.spawn((Node { height: vh(52.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, justify_content: JustifyContent::SpaceBetween, border: UiRect::top(px(1)), ..default() }, BorderColor::all(crate::ui::LINE))).with_children(|r| {
                        r.spawn(kit_text(label.to_uppercase(), 16.0, TX1, &kit.text));
                        key_chip(r, kit, binds, *a);
                    });
                }
            });
        }
    });
    page.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(24.0)), column_gap: vh(16.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
        crate::ui::chip(r, kit, "Reset to defaults", UiAction::ResetBinds, false);
        r.spawn(kit_text(if binds.capture.is_some() { "PRESS A KEY OR MOUSE BUTTON · ESC CANCELS" } else { "CLICK A KEY TO CHANGE IT" }, 13.0, TX3, &kit.text));
    });
}

/// Settings, in four sections picked by chips under the title; a new section's rows tune in.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn settings_page(page: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, faces: &crate::assistant::view::Faces, memory: &mut UiMemory, s: &Settings, steam: Option<&crate::steam::Steam>, binds: &crate::binds::Binds, tab: u8, tune: Option<f32>) {
    page_title(page, kit, "Saved as you change them", "Settings", "設定");
    // straight on the page (a wrapper would shrink the group and wrap it)
    page.spawn(Node { height: vh(24.0), ..default() });
    chips(page, kit, "set.tab", ["General", "Crosshair", "AI assistant", "Keys"].into_iter().enumerate().map(|(i, l)| Choice::new(l, UiAction::SettingsTab(i as u8), tab == i as u8)).collect());
    let tune = if memory.changed("set.tab.shown", &tab.to_string()) { Some(0.0) } else { tune };
    let on_off = |key: &str, on: bool, a: fn(bool) -> UiAction| (key.to_string(), on, a);
    let toggle = |rows: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, name: &str, (key, on, a): (String, bool, fn(bool) -> UiAction)| setting_row(rows, kit, name, |r| chips(r, kit, &key, vec![Choice::new("On", a(true), on), Choice::new("Off", a(false), !on)]));
    match tab {
        3 => keys_section(page, kit, binds, tune),
        1 => {
            rows(page, tune, |rows| {
                vec![
                    setting_row(rows, kit, "Colour", |r| {
                        chips(r, kit, "set.xcolor", crate::hud::CROSSHAIR_COLORS.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, (l, _))| Choice::new(l, UiAction::CrosshairColor(i as u8), s.crosshair_color == i as u8)).collect());
                    }),
                    setting_row(rows, kit, "Size", |r| {
                        chips(r, kit, "set.xsize", ["Small", "Medium", "Large"].into_iter().enumerate().map(|(i, l)| Choice::new(l, UiAction::CrosshairSize(i as u8), s.crosshair_size == i as u8)).collect());
                    }),
                    toggle(rows, "Opens with spread", on_off("set.xdyn", s.crosshair_dynamic, UiAction::CrosshairDynamic)),
                    toggle(rows, "Centre dot", on_off("set.xdot", s.crosshair_dot, UiAction::CrosshairDot)),
                    // the HUD bends like a visor (hud::visor); 0 is flat
                    setting_row(rows, kit, "HUD curve", |r| stepper(r, kit, memory, "set.curve", &if s.hud_curve == 0 { "Flat".to_string() } else { format!("{}%", s.hud_curve) }, UiAction::HudCurve(-1), UiAction::HudCurve(1))),
                ]
            });
            // what it looks like, on a wall
            page.spawn((Node { width: vh(320.0), height: vh(180.0), margin: UiRect::top(vh(32.0)), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(vh(crate::ui::RADIUS)), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }, BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.62, 0.50, 0.36)))).with_children(|b| {
                b.spawn(Node { width: px(0), height: px(0), ..default() }).with_children(|c| crate::hud::draw_crosshair(c, s, crate::hud::STATIC_GAP));
            });
        }
        2 => rows(page, tune, |rows| {
            let mut ids = vec![setting_row(rows, kit, "AI assistant", |r| {
                let mut options: Vec<Choice> = ASSISTANTS
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, a)| {
                        let color = a.color;
                        let face = i;
                        Choice { label: a.name, action: UiAction::SetAssistant(i as u8), selected: s.assistant == i as u8, lead: Some(Box::new(move |c: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands| crate::assistant::view::chip_portrait(c, faces, face, color))) }
                    })
                    .collect();
                options.push(Choice::new("Off", UiAction::SetAssistant(OFF), s.assistant == OFF));
                chips(r, kit, "set.ai", options);
            })];
            ids.push(setting_row(rows, kit, "Messages", |r| {
                chips(r, kit, "set.chat", ["Quiet", "Normal", "Chatty"].into_iter().enumerate().map(|(i, l)| Choice::new(l, UiAction::Chattiness(i as u8), s.chattiness == i as u8)).collect());
            }));
            ids.push(toggle(rows, "Relay team info", on_off("set.relay", s.relay, UiAction::SetRelay)));
            ids.push(toggle(rows, "During rounds", on_off("set.inround", s.assistant_in_round, UiAction::SetAssistantInRound)));
            ids
        }),
        _ => rows(page, tune, |rows| {
            // your Steam name; typed only when playing without Steam
            let mut ids = vec![setting_row(rows, kit, "Name", |r| match steam {
                Some(st) => {
                    r.spawn(kit_text(st.name.clone(), 20.0, TX1, &kit.text));
                    r.spawn(kit_text("FROM STEAM", 13.0, TX3, &kit.text));
                }
                None => {
                    r.spawn(kit_text(format!("{}_", s.name), 20.0, TX1, &kit.num));
                    r.spawn(kit_text("TYPE TO CHANGE", 13.0, TX3, &kit.text));
                }
            })];
            ids.push(setting_row(rows, kit, "Sensitivity", |r| stepper(r, kit, memory, "set.sens", &format!("{:.2}", s.sensitivity), UiAction::Sensitivity(-0.1), UiAction::Sensitivity(0.1))));
            ids.push(setting_row(rows, kit, "Volume", |r| stepper(r, kit, memory, "set.vol", &format!("{:.0}%", s.volume * 100.0), UiAction::Volume(-0.05), UiAction::Volume(0.05))));
            let cap = if s.fps_max == 0 { "Off".to_string() } else { s.fps_max.to_string() };
            ids.push(setting_row(rows, kit, "Frame rate cap", |r| stepper(r, kit, memory, "set.fps", &cap, UiAction::FpsMax(-1), UiAction::FpsMax(1))));
            ids.push(toggle(rows, "VSync", on_off("set.vsync", s.vsync, UiAction::SetVsync)));
            ids.push(setting_row(rows, kit, "Display", |r| {
                chips(r, kit, "set.display", ["Windowed", "Borderless"].into_iter().enumerate().map(|(i, l)| Choice::new(l, UiAction::SetBorderless(i == 1), s.borderless == (i == 1))).collect());
            }));
            // (a borderless window is the size of the screen: no size to choose)
            if !s.borderless {
                let labels: Vec<(u8, String)> = crate::window::sizes_for_screen().into_iter().map(|i| (i, format!("{} x {}", crate::window::RESOLUTIONS[i as usize].0, crate::window::RESOLUTIONS[i as usize].1))).collect();
                ids.push(setting_row(rows, kit, "Window size", |r| {
                    chips(r, kit, "set.res", labels.iter().map(|(i, l)| Choice::new(l, UiAction::SetResolution(*i), s.resolution == *i)).collect());
                }));
            }
            ids.push(setting_row(rows, kit, "Team IDs through walls", |r| {
                chips(r, kit, "set.ids", ["Off", "Pips", "Pips + names"].into_iter().enumerate().map(|(i, l)| Choice::new(l, UiAction::SetTeamIds(i as u8), s.team_ids == i as u8)).collect());
            }));
            ids
        }),
    }
}

/// A small caps label above a control.
fn label(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, s: &str) {
    p.spawn((kit_text(s.to_uppercase(), 13.0, TX2, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect { top: vh(32.0), bottom: vh(12.0), ..default() }, ..default() }));
}
```

`client/src/models.rs`:

```rs
//! Loading CS studio models (weapons, grenades) from the install and turning
//! posed models into Bevy meshes.
use crate::level::rgba_image;
use crate::map;
use crate::studio::{LitPart, StudioMaterial};
use bevy::{
    asset::RenderAssetUsages,
    camera::visibility::NoFrustumCulling,
    mesh::{skinning::{SkinnedMesh, SkinnedMeshInverseBindposes}, Indices, PrimitiveTopology, VertexAttributeValues},
    prelude::*,
    render::render_resource::TextureFormat,
};
use goldsrc::mdl::{BoneTransform, MeshPart, Model};
use sim::weapons::Id;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Model file for a weapon: `v_` (first person), `p_` (in a player's hand) or `w_` (on the ground).
pub fn weapon_model(prefix: &str, id: Id) -> String {
    let name = match sim::weapons::def(id).name {
        "mp5navy" => "mp5",
        n => n,
    };
    format!("{prefix}_{name}.mdl")
}

/// Meshes with their materials, ready to spawn (`spawn_lit` gives each instance its own).
pub type Parts = Vec<(Handle<Mesh>, Handle<StudioMaterial>)>;

/// A copy of a model material for one instance (its light changes as it moves).
pub fn own(materials: &mut Assets<StudioMaterial>, shared: &Handle<StudioMaterial>) -> Handle<StudioMaterial> {
    let m = materials.get(shared).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| crate::studio::material(Handle::default()));
    materials.add(m)
}

/// Spawn lit model parts under `parent`.
pub fn spawn_lit(commands: &mut Commands, parent: Entity, parts: &Parts, materials: &mut Assets<StudioMaterial>) {
    for (mesh, mat) in parts {
        let child = commands.spawn((Mesh3d(mesh.clone()), MeshMaterial3d(own(materials, mat)), LitPart)).id();
        commands.entity(parent).add_child(child);
    }
}

/// A model and the materials for its textures.
pub struct Loaded {
    pub model: Model,
    pub materials: Vec<Handle<StudioMaterial>>,
    /// GPU-skinned meshes, built on first use (see `Loaded::skin`); [normal, mirrored].
    skin: [std::sync::OnceLock<Skin>; 2],
}

/// A model's meshes in bind pose (each vertex in its bone's space) for GPU skinning:
/// animating it only moves bone entities, the meshes are never re-uploaded.
pub struct Skin {
    pub parts: Parts,
    pub bindposes: Handle<SkinnedMeshInverseBindposes>,
}

/// A skinned model spawned under a parent: its bone entities and its mesh entities
/// (plus the mirroring entity the bones hang off, if mirrored).
pub struct SpawnedSkin {
    pub joints: Vec<Entity>,
    pub parts: Vec<Entity>,
    pub mirror: Option<Entity>,
}

impl SpawnedSkin {
    pub fn despawn(&self, commands: &mut Commands) {
        for e in self.joints.iter().chain(&self.parts).chain(&self.mirror) {
            commands.entity(*e).try_despawn();
        }
    }
}

impl Loaded {
    /// `mirrored`: triangles wound the other way, for bones placed through a reflection.
    pub fn skin(&self, mirrored: bool, meshes: &mut Assets<Mesh>, bindposes: &mut Assets<SkinnedMeshInverseBindposes>) -> &Skin {
        self.skin[mirrored as usize].get_or_init(|| {
            let parts = self
                .model
                .bind_mesh()
                .iter()
                .filter(|p| !p.indices.is_empty())
                .map(|p| {
                    let joints: Vec<[u16; 4]> = p.bones.iter().map(|b| [*b, 0, 0, 0]).collect();
                    let weights = vec![[1.0f32, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]; p.bones.len()];
                    let mesh = part_mesh(p, map::to_y_up, mirrored)
                        .with_inserted_attribute(Mesh::ATTRIBUTE_JOINT_INDEX, VertexAttributeValues::Uint16x4(joints))
                        .with_inserted_attribute(Mesh::ATTRIBUTE_JOINT_WEIGHT, weights);
                    (meshes.add(mesh), self.materials.get(p.texture).cloned().unwrap_or_default())
                })
                .collect();
            // Vertices are already in bone space, so binding is the identity.
            let bindposes = bindposes.add(SkinnedMeshInverseBindposes::from(vec![Mat4::IDENTITY; self.model.bones.len().max(1)]));
            Skin { parts, bindposes }
        })
    }

    /// Spawn bones and skinned meshes as children of `parent` (posed with `set_pose`).
    /// `mirror`: the bones go through this reflection first (the first-person view model).
    pub fn spawn_skinned(&self, commands: &mut Commands, parent: Entity, mirror: Option<Transform>, meshes: &mut Assets<Mesh>, bindposes: &mut Assets<SkinnedMeshInverseBindposes>, materials: &mut Assets<StudioMaterial>) -> SpawnedSkin {
        // A reflection (negative scale) turns the triangles inside out: flip them back.
        let skin = self.skin(mirror.is_some_and(|t| t.scale.x * t.scale.y * t.scale.z < 0.0), meshes, bindposes);
        let mirror = mirror.map(|t| commands.spawn((t, ChildOf(parent))).id());
        let joints: Vec<Entity> = (0..self.model.bones.len().max(1)).map(|_| commands.spawn((Transform::default(), ChildOf(mirror.unwrap_or(parent)))).id()).collect();
        let mut parts = Vec::new();
        for (mesh, material) in &skin.parts {
            // Bounds come from the bind pose, which is nowhere near the posed body: don't cull.
            parts.push(commands.spawn((Mesh3d(mesh.clone()), MeshMaterial3d(own(materials, material)), LitPart, SkinnedMesh { inverse_bindposes: skin.bindposes.clone(), joints: joints.clone() }, NoFrustumCulling)).id());
        }
        commands.entity(parent).add_children(&parts);
        SpawnedSkin { joints, parts, mirror }
    }
}

/// Move a skinned model's bones to `pose` (GoldSrc model space).
pub fn set_pose(joints: &[Entity], pose: &[BoneTransform], transforms: &mut Query<&mut Transform, With<ChildOf>>) {
    for (e, b) in joints.iter().zip(pose) {
        if let Ok(mut t) = transforms.get_mut(*e) {
            *t = bone_transform(b);
        }
    }
}

/// A GoldSrc bone transform in Bevy's Y-up space: C·M·C⁻¹ with C = (x, y, z) → (x, z, −y).
fn bone_transform(b: &BoneTransform) -> Transform {
    let r = &b.rot;
    // Rows of C·R·Cᵀ, written out.
    let m = Mat3::from_cols(
        Vec3::new(r[0][0], r[2][0], -r[1][0]),
        Vec3::new(r[0][2], r[2][2], -r[1][2]),
        Vec3::new(-r[0][1], -r[2][1], r[1][1]),
    );
    Transform { translation: Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(b.pos)), rotation: Quat::from_mat3(&m), scale: Vec3::ONE }
}

/// Models loaded on first use and kept (missing files are remembered as missing).
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct ModelCache {
    /// The game data folder's models.
    dirs: Vec<PathBuf>,
    models: HashMap<String, Option<Arc<Loaded>>>,
}

impl ModelCache {
    pub fn new() -> ModelCache {
        ModelCache { dirs: crate::gamefiles::paths("models"), models: HashMap::new() }
    }

    pub fn get(&mut self, file: &str, images: &mut Assets<Image>, materials: &mut Assets<StudioMaterial>) -> Option<Arc<Loaded>> {
        if let Some(m) = self.models.get(file) {
            return m.clone();
        }
        let loaded = self.dirs.iter().find_map(|d| Model::load(d.join(net::gamefiles::clean(file))).ok()).map(|model| {
            let mats = model
                .textures()
                .into_iter()
                .map(|t| {
                    let mut rgba = t.rgba;
                    crate::level::tex_gamma(&mut rgba);
                    let image = images.add(rgba_image(t.width, t.height, rgba, true, TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb));
                    materials.add(crate::studio::material(image))
                })
                .collect();
            Arc::new(Loaded { model, materials: mats, skin: Default::default() })
        });
        if loaded.is_none() {
            warn!("missing model {file}");
        }
        self.models.insert(file.to_string(), loaded.clone());
        loaded
    }
}

/// Bevy mesh for one posed part, with `place` mapping GoldSrc model space to the target
/// space. `mirrored`: `place` flips handedness, so triangles are wound the other way.
/// Normals go through `place` too (as directions), for `studio` lighting.
pub fn part_mesh(p: &MeshPart, place: impl Fn([f32; 3]) -> [f32; 3], mirrored: bool) -> Mesh {
    let positions: Vec<[f32; 3]> = p.positions.iter().map(|v| place(*v)).collect();
    let o = place([0.0; 3]);
    let normals: Vec<[f32; 3]> = p.normals.iter().map(|n| { let d = place(*n); [d[0] - o[0], d[1] - o[1], d[2] - o[2]] }).collect();
    let mut indices = p.indices.clone();
    if mirrored {
        for t in indices.chunks_exact_mut(3) {
            t.swap(1, 2);
        }
    }
    Mesh::new(PrimitiveTopology::TriangleList, RenderAssetUsages::default())
        .with_inserted_attribute(Mesh::ATTRIBUTE_POSITION, positions)
        .with_inserted_attribute(Mesh::ATTRIBUTE_UV_0, p.uvs.clone())
        .with_inserted_attribute(Mesh::ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, normals)
        .with_inserted_indices(Indices::U32(indices))
}

/// A model posed once, as world-ready (Y-up) meshes with their materials.
pub fn static_parts(l: &Loaded, pose: &[BoneTransform], meshes: &mut Assets<Mesh>) -> Parts {
    l.model
        .posed_mesh(pose)
        .iter()
        .filter(|p| !p.indices.is_empty())
        .map(|p| (meshes.add(part_mesh(p, map::to_y_up, false)), l.materials.get(p.texture).cloned().unwrap_or_default()))
        .collect()
}
```

```rs
//! Muzzle flashes: a short, bright, additive star at the gun's muzzle (the model's first
//! attachment), for your own gun (`viewmodel.rs`) and other players' (`players.rs`).
use crate::level::rgba_image;
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::render::render_resource::TextureFormat;

pub struct MuzzlePlugin;

impl Plugin for MuzzlePlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(PreStartup, load);
    }
}

/// How long a flash shows (CS's are one or two frames).
pub const FLASH_SECONDS: f32 = 0.045;

#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct FlashLook {
    pub quad: Handle<Mesh>,
    pub material: Handle<StandardMaterial>,
}

/// A hot centre with a few soft spikes: yellow-white fading to orange.
fn flash_image(n: u32) -> Image {
    let mut px = Vec::with_capacity((n * n * 4) as usize);
    let c = n as f32 / 2.0;
    for y in 0..n {
        for x in 0..n {
            let (dx, dy) = (x as f32 + 0.5 - c, y as f32 + 0.5 - c);
            let r = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt() / c;
            let ang = dy.atan2(dx);
            let spikes = 0.55 + 0.45 * (ang * 3.0).cos().abs().powf(6.0);
            let a = ((spikes - r) / spikes).clamp(0.0, 1.0).powf(1.5);
            let hot = (1.0 - r * 1.6).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            let col = [255.0, 200.0 + 55.0 * hot, 90.0 + 150.0 * hot];
            px.extend_from_slice(&[col[0] as u8, col[1] as u8, col[2] as u8, (a * 255.0) as u8]);
        }
    }
    rgba_image(n, n, px, false, TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb)
}

fn load(mut commands: Commands, mut meshes: ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>, mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>, mut materials: ResMut<Assets<StandardMaterial>>) {
    let material = materials.add(StandardMaterial { base_color_texture: Some(images.add(flash_image(64))), unlit: true, alpha_mode: AlphaMode::Add, ..default() });
    commands.insert_resource(FlashLook { quad: meshes.add(Rectangle::new(1.0, 1.0)), material });
}

/// A hidden flash quad (shown and placed by its owner when firing).
pub fn spawn(commands: &mut Commands, look: &FlashLook) -> Entity {
    commands.spawn((Mesh3d(look.quad.clone()), MeshMaterial3d(look.material.clone()), Transform::default(), Visibility::Hidden)).id()
}

/// Whether this weapon flashes (not knives, grenades, the bomb or silenced guns).
pub fn flashes(weapon: sim::weapons::Id, silenced: bool) -> bool {
    sim::weapons::is_gun(weapon) && !silenced
}
```

`client/src/notice.rs`:

```rs
//! Why we're back at the menu: one notice (title, body, maybe Retry), shown over the menu
//! until closed. Every way out of a match that the player should hear about ends here.
//! Enter retries (or closes), Esc closes. Drawn by `status_screens`.
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::ui::{UiAction, UiActions};
use bevy::prelude::*;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum NoticeKind {
    Error,
    Info,
}

#[derive(Resource, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Notice {
    pub title: String,
    pub body: String,
    pub kind: NoticeKind,
    /// Retry joins the same match again (`GameConfig` is kept).
    pub retry: bool,
}

impl Notice {
    pub fn error(title: &str, body: impl Into<String>) -> Notice {
        Notice { title: title.into(), body: body.into(), kind: NoticeKind::Error, retry: false }
    }

    pub fn info(title: &str, body: impl Into<String>) -> Notice {
        Notice { title: title.into(), body: body.into(), kind: NoticeKind::Info, retry: false }
    }

    pub fn with_retry(mut self) -> Notice {
        self.retry = true;
        self
    }
}

/// Enter and Esc (the menu runs these before its own actions).
pub(crate) fn keys(keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>, notice: Res<Notice>, mut actions: ResMut<UiActions>) {
    if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Enter) {
        actions.0.push(if notice.retry { UiAction::NoticeRetry } else { UiAction::NoticeClose });
    } else if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Escape) {
        actions.0.push(UiAction::NoticeClose);
    }
}

/// Take the notice's own actions out of the queue (the menu handles the rest).
pub(crate) fn actions(mut commands: Commands, mut actions: ResMut<UiActions>, notice: Res<Notice>, mut next: ResMut<NextState<AppState>>) {
    let mut close = false;
    actions.0.retain(|a| match a {
        UiAction::NoticeRetry if notice.retry => {
            next.set(AppState::Connecting);
            close = true;
            false
        }
        UiAction::NoticeRetry | UiAction::NoticeClose => {
            close = true;
            false
        }
        _ => true,
    });
    if close {
        commands.remove_resource::<Notice>();
    }
}
```

`client/src/overlay.rs`:

```rs
//! In-game overlays: the Esc menu and team selection, drawn over the game. They tune in over
//! the blurred game and tune out when closed.
use crate::game::Walker;
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::ui::{card, chip, clickable_keep_border, kit_text, nav, page_title, vh, Anim, Blurs, Kit, NavItem, UiAction, UiActions, BAR, CT_COLOR, TX1, TX2, TX3, T_COLOR};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::window::{CursorGrabMode, CursorOptions};
use net::protocol::Team;

/// In-game overlays (Esc menu, team select) as one optional panel.
#[derive(Resource, Default, PartialEq, Clone, Copy)]
pub enum Overlay {
    #[default]
    None,
    Pause,
    Teams,
}

#[derive(Component)]
pub(crate) struct OverlayRoot;

/// Esc toggles the pause menu; the Teams key (M) opens team selection (also shown when you join).
pub(crate) fn pause_menu(
    mut commands: Commands,
    kit: Res<Kit>,
    keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>,
    (mouse, binds): (Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>, Res<crate::binds::Binds>),
    mut overlay: ResMut<Overlay>,
    mut shown: Local<Option<Overlay>>,
    w: Res<Walker>,
    mut asked: Local<bool>,
    mut cursor: Single<&mut CursorOptions>,
    roots: Query<Entity, With<OverlayRoot>>,
) {
    let auto = std::env::var_os("BOOTLEG16_SCREENSHOT").is_some();
    if !auto {
        if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Escape) {
            *overlay = if *overlay == Overlay::None { Overlay::Pause } else { Overlay::None };
        }
        if binds.just(crate::binds::Action::Teams, &keys, &mouse) {
            *overlay = if *overlay == Overlay::Teams { Overlay::None } else { Overlay::Teams };
        }
        // First time in: pick a side, like CS.
        if !*asked && w.client.id().is_some() && !w.client.scores.is_empty() && w.client.team() == Team::Spectator {
            *asked = true;
            *overlay = Overlay::Teams;
        }
    } else if !*asked && w.client.id().is_some() {
        // Screenshot runs pick automatically (BOOTLEG16_TEAM=t|ct|spec, default auto).
        *asked = true;
        commands.queue(|world: &mut World| {
            let team = match std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_TEAM").as_deref() {
                Ok("t") => Some(Team::T),
                Ok("ct") => Some(Team::Ct),
                Ok("spec") => Some(Team::Spectator),
                _ => None,
            };
            if let Some(mut w) = world.get_resource_mut::<Walker>() {
                w.client.join_team(team);
            }
        });
    }
    // Screenshot runs can show an overlay (BOOTLEG16_OVERLAY=pause|teams).
    if auto {
        match std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_OVERLAY").as_deref() {
            Ok("pause") => *overlay = Overlay::Pause,
            Ok("teams") => *overlay = Overlay::Teams,
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    if *shown == Some(*overlay) {
        return;
    }
    *shown = Some(*overlay);
    // the open overlay tunes out; the blur and scrim fade with it
    for e in &roots {
        commands.entity(e).remove::<(OverlayRoot, Blurs)>().insert(Anim::tune_out());
    }
    if *overlay != Overlay::None {
        cursor.grab_mode = CursorGrabMode::None;
        cursor.visible = true;
    }
    let me_team = w.client.team();
    let practice = w.client.practice;
    match *overlay {
        Overlay::None => {}
        Overlay::Pause => {
            // a teammate left: you may call a surrender vote
            let abandoned = w.client.round.abandoned[(me_team == Team::Ct) as usize] && me_team != Team::Spectator;
            commands.spawn((OverlayRoot, DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame), full_dim())).with_children(|root| {
                root.spawn((Node { width: vh(560.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() }, Anim::stagger(0))).with_children(|col| {
                    col.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect::bottom(vh(24.0)), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() }).with_children(|t| {
                        page_title(t, &kit, if practice { "Practice" } else { "Match" }, "Paused", "一時停止");
                    });
                    let item = |num, label, jp, action, selected| NavItem { num, label, jp, action, selected };
                    let mut items = vec![item("01", "Resume", "再開", UiAction::Resume, true), item("02", "Choose team", "チーム", UiAction::ShowTeams, false)];
                    if abandoned {
                        items.push(item("03", "Call a surrender vote", "降伏", UiAction::Surrender, false));
                    }
                    items.push(item(if abandoned { "04" } else { "03" }, "Leave match", "退出", UiAction::Leave, false));
                    nav(col, &kit, "pause.nav", items, false);
                    col.spawn((kit_text("ESC · BACK TO THE GAME", 13.0, TX3, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(24.0)), padding: UiRect::left(vh(16.0)), ..default() }));
                });
            });
        }
        Overlay::Teams => {
            commands.spawn((OverlayRoot, DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame), full_dim())).with_children(|root| {
                root.spawn((Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() }, Anim::stagger(0))).with_children(|col| {
                    col.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, margin: UiRect::bottom(vh(32.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|t| {
                        page_title(t, &kit, "Pick a side", "Choose your team", "チーム選択");
                    });
                    col.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(16.0), ..default() }).with_children(|row| {
                        team_card(row, &kit, 1, "1", "Strays", "ストレイズ", "Attack · plant the bomb", T_COLOR, UiAction::ChooseTeam(Some(Team::T)), me_team == Team::T);
                        team_card(row, &kit, 2, "2", "Bureau", "ビューロー", "Defend · defuse the bomb", CT_COLOR, UiAction::ChooseTeam(Some(Team::Ct)), me_team == Team::Ct);
                    });
                    col.spawn((Node { column_gap: vh(8.0), margin: UiRect::top(vh(16.0)), ..default() }, Anim::stagger(3))).with_children(|row| {
                        chip(row, &kit, "5 · Auto-select", UiAction::ChooseTeam(None), false);
                        chip(row, &kit, "6 · Spectate", UiAction::ChooseTeam(Some(Team::Spectator)), me_team == Team::Spectator);
                    });
                });
            });
        }
    }
}

fn full_dim() -> impl Bundle {
    (
        Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), height: percent(100), align_items: AlignItems::Center, justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, ..default() },
        Blurs(0.93),
        GlobalZIndex(20),
    )
}

/// One side: key, big name, Japanese name, what you do; the side's colour as a bar on top.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn team_card(row: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, i: usize, key: &str, name: &str, jp: &str, role: &str, color: Color, action: UiAction, current: bool) {
    let node = Node { width: vh(420.0), height: vh(280.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, padding: UiRect::all(vh(28.0)), ..default() };
    let mut e = row.spawn((card(node, current), Anim::stagger(i)));
    let base = if current { crate::ui::BG1.mix(&crate::ui::AMBER, 0.08) } else { crate::ui::BG1 };
    e.with_children(|c| {
        c.spawn((Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, left: px(0), right: px(0), top: px(0), height: vh(BAR), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(color), Pickable::IGNORE));
        c.spawn((kit_text(key, 13.0, TX2, &kit.text), Pickable::IGNORE));
        c.spawn((Node { flex_grow: 1.0, ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE));
        c.spawn((kit_text(name.to_uppercase(), 52.0, color, &kit.display), Pickable::IGNORE));
        c.spawn((kit_text(jp, 13.0, TX3, &kit.jp), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(6.0)), ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE));
        c.spawn((kit_text(role.to_uppercase(), 13.0, if current { TX1 } else { TX2 }, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(16.0)), ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE));
    });
    clickable_keep_border(&mut e, action, base);
}

pub fn in_game_actions(mut actions: ResMut<UiActions>, mut overlay: ResMut<Overlay>, mut w: ResMut<Walker>, mut next: ResMut<NextState<AppState>>, keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>) {
    // CS team menu keys.
    if *overlay == Overlay::Teams {
        for (k, team) in [(KeyCode::Digit1, Some(Team::T)), (KeyCode::Digit2, Some(Team::Ct)), (KeyCode::Digit5, None), (KeyCode::Digit6, Some(Team::Spectator))] {
            if keys.just_pressed(k) {
                actions.0.push(UiAction::ChooseTeam(team));
            }
        }
    }
    let mut keep = Vec::new();
    for a in std::mem::take(&mut actions.0) {
        match a {
            UiAction::Resume => *overlay = Overlay::None,
            UiAction::ShowTeams => *overlay = Overlay::Teams,
            UiAction::Leave => next.set(AppState::Menu),
            UiAction::Surrender => {
                w.client.call_surrender();
                *overlay = Overlay::None;
            }
            UiAction::ChooseTeam(team) => {
                w.client.join_team(team);
                *overlay = Overlay::None;
            }
            other => keep.push(other), // buy menu actions are handled by the HUD
        }
    }
    actions.0 = keep;
}

pub fn overlay_open(overlay: Option<Res<Overlay>>) -> bool {
    overlay.is_some_and(|o| *o != Overlay::None)
}
```

```rs
//! presence, and going into a match when one is found. Talks to the lobby all the time, so

/// The official lobby, built into release builds (`BOOTLEG16_LOBBY=host:port cargo build`,
/// see README "Shipping the game"), so players just open the game. Setting `BOOTLEG16_LOBBY`
/// when starting the game overrides it (testing another lobby).
fn lobby_address() -> String {
    let built_in = option_env!("BOOTLEG16_LOBBY").map(String::from).unwrap_or_else(|| format!("127.0.0.1:{}", net::lobby::LOBBY_PORT));
    std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_LOBBY").unwrap_or(built_in)
}

/// The official lobby's public key (`BOOTLEG16_LOBBY_KEY=<hex>` when building, printed by
/// `./host.sh`), or at run time for testing another lobby. None: learned from the lobby.
fn lobby_key() -> Option<[u8; 32]> {
    std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_LOBBY_KEY").ok().or(option_env!("BOOTLEG16_LOBBY_KEY").map(String::from)).and_then(|k| net::crypto::from_hex(&k))
}

#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct Lobby {
    client: Option<LobbyClient>,
    pub(crate) address: String,
    /// What the page was last drawn with (redraw when it changes).
    pub(crate) shown: Option<LobbyState>,
    pub(crate) notice: String,
    /// Friends we invited (Steam id -> seconds ago), shown as "Invited" for a while.
    pub(crate) invited: HashMap<u64, f32>,
    /// Invites we waved away (by party code).

    /// A party to join once signed in (from `+party CODE` on the command line: Steam's "Join
    /// game" or an accepted invite when the game wasn't running).
    join_on_start: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum LobbyAction {
    /// Join the party whose code is typed in the field.
    JoinParty,
    LeaveParty,
    SetMode(Mode),
    Move(u32, Group),
    Play,
    Cancel,
    /// Invite a Steam friend; `in_game`: they're in the game (lobby invite), else Steam's.
    Invite(u64, bool),

    Ignore(String),

    SetMap(Option<String>),
    /// Drop into a deathmatch server (the lobby picks one with room; it comes back as `found`).

}

fn start(mut commands: Commands, settings: Res<Settings>, steam: Option<Res<Steam>>) {
    let address = lobby_address();
    // Signed in to Steam: your Steam name, and a Steam login for the lobby.
    let name = steam.as_ref().map(|s| s.name.clone()).unwrap_or_else(|| settings.name.clone());
    // One address, or the main and standby lobbies ("a:27010,b:27010"): whichever answers.
    let lobbies = net::config::addresses(&address, true);
    let client = LobbyClient::with_lobbies(lobbies, &name).ok().map(|mut c| {
        c.steam = steam.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.login());
        // The lobby's public key, built into release builds: only the real lobby can answer.
        c.lobby_key = lobby_key();
        c.builtin_key = c.lobby_key.is_some();
        // The pool maps this game has (a match only gets a map everyone has).
        c.maps = net::config::pool_maps_in(&crate::game_dir());
        c
    });
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    commands.insert_resource(Lobby { client, address, shown: None, notice: String::new(), invited: HashMap::new(), ignored: Vec::new(), join_on_start: crate::steam::party_code(&args) });
}

pub fn apply(lobby: &mut Lobby, st: &mut MenuState, steam: Option<&Steam>, a: LobbyAction) {
    let code = lobby.shown.as_ref().map(|s| s.code.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
    let Some(c) = &mut lobby.client else { return };
    let cmd = match a {
        LobbyAction::JoinParty => Command::JoinParty { code: std::mem::take(&mut st.address) },
        LobbyAction::LeaveParty => Command::LeaveParty,
        LobbyAction::SetMode(m) => Command::SetMode(m),
        LobbyAction::Move(member, group) => Command::Move { member, group },
        LobbyAction::Play => Command::Play,
        LobbyAction::Cancel => Command::Cancel,
        LobbyAction::AcceptMatch => Command::Accept,
        LobbyAction::Deathmatch => Command::Deathmatch,
        LobbyAction::SetMap(m) => Command::SetMap(m),
        LobbyAction::DeclineMatch => Command::Decline,
        LobbyAction::Reconnect => {
            // Same as a match found: `poll` connects with the seat.
            c.found = lobby.shown.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.rejoin);
            return;
        }
        LobbyAction::Accept(code) => Command::JoinParty { code },
        LobbyAction::Ignore(code) => {
            lobby.ignored.push(code);
            return;
        }
        LobbyAction::Invite(friend, in_game) => {
            lobby.invited.insert(friend, 0.0);
            if in_game {
                Command::Invite { steam: friend }
            } else {
                // Not in the game: Steam shows them the invite and starts the game for them.
                if let Some(s) = steam {
                    s.invite(friend, &code);
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    };
    c.send(cmd);
}

/// Keep the lobby session alive, redraw on news, and go play when a match is found.
fn poll(mut commands: Commands, mut lobby: ResMut<Lobby>, mut dirty: ResMut<MenuDirty>, state: Res<State<AppState>>, mut next: ResMut<NextState<AppState>>, time: Res<Time>) {
    let lobby = &mut *lobby;
    let Some(c) = &mut lobby.client else { return };
    c.tick();
    if c.state != lobby.shown {
        lobby.shown = c.state.clone();
        dirty.0 = true;
    }
    if !c.notice.is_empty() {
        lobby.notice = std::mem::take(&mut c.notice);
        dirty.0 = true;
    }
    if c.online() {
        if let Some(code) = lobby.join_on_start.take() {
            c.send(Command::JoinParty { code });
        }
    }
    let before = lobby.invited.len();
    lobby.invited.retain(|_, t| {
        *t += time.delta_secs();
        *t < net::lobby::INVITE_SECONDS
    });
    dirty.0 |= lobby.invited.len() != before;
    if *state.get() == AppState::Menu {
        if let Some((addr, ticket, key)) = c.found.take() {
            commands.insert_resource(GameConfig { map: String::new(), server: ServerChoice::Remote(addr.to_string()), give: Vec::new(), ticket, key: Some(key) });
            next.set(AppState::Connecting);
        }
    }
}

/// Steam friends see what we're doing and can join our party; their "Join game" lands here.
fn steam_glue(steam: Option<ResMut<Steam>>, mut lobby: ResMut<Lobby>, state: Res<State<AppState>>) {
    let Some(mut steam) = steam else { return };
    for code in steam.take_joins() {
        if let Some(c) = &mut lobby.client {
            c.send(Command::JoinParty { code });
        }
    }
    let Some(s) = &lobby.shown else { return };
    let status = match (*state.get(), s.searching) {
        (AppState::InGame | AppState::Connecting, _) => "In a match".to_string(),
        (_, Some(_)) => "Looking for a match".to_string(),
        _ if s.members.len() > 1 => format!("In a party ({} of {})", s.members.len(), if s.mode == Mode::Custom { net::lobby::MAX_CUSTOM } else { net::lobby::MAX_PARTY }),
        _ => "In menus".to_string(),
    };
    steam.set_presence(&s.code, &status);
}

/// Esc on the Play page goes back to the main menu.
fn back(keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>, st: Option<ResMut<MenuState>>) {
    if let Some(mut st) = st {
        if st.page == Page::Join && keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Escape) {
            st.page = Page::Main;
            st.rebuild = true;
        }
    }
}
```
