`client/src/play_page.rs`:

```rs
//! Drawing the Play screen (design/mockups/ui, Play): your party's slots, mode and the main
//! button on the left, Steam friends on the right, the identity card top right, and the invite
//! toast (over any menu page). Specs are at 1080p.
use crate::menu::{MenuState, Page, Settings};
use crate::play::{Lobby, LobbyAction};
use crate::steam::{Presence, Steam};
use crate::ui::{card, chip, chip_w, chips, kit_text, page_title, primary_button, vh, Choice, Kit, UiAction, AMBER, BAR, BG1, BG2, BG3, CT_COLOR, LINE, LINE_2, OK, TX1, TX2, TX3, T_COLOR};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use net::lobby::{Member, Mode, MAX_CUSTOM, MAX_PARTY};
use net::server::Group;

fn abs(node: Node) -> Node {
    Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, ..node }
}

fn label(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, s: impl Into<String>, color: Color) {
    p.spawn((kit_text(s.into().to_uppercase(), 13.0, color, &kit.text), Pickable::IGNORE));
}

/// A square avatar: the Steam picture, or a letter tile without one. `dot`: presence colour.
fn avatar(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, size: f32, picture: Option<&Handle<Image>>, name: &str, dot: Option<Color>) {
    let mut e = p.spawn((Node { width: vh(size), height: vh(size), flex_shrink: 0.0, justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }, BackgroundColor(BG3), Pickable::IGNORE));
    e.with_children(|a| {
        match picture {
            Some(img) => _ = a.spawn((ImageNode::new(img.clone()), Node { width: percent(100), height: percent(100), ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE)),
            None => {
                let initial: String = name.chars().next().map(|c| c.to_uppercase().collect()).unwrap_or_default();
                a.spawn((kit_text(initial, size * 0.4, TX1, &kit.num), Pickable::IGNORE));
            }
        }
        if let Some(c) = dot {
            a.spawn((abs(Node { right: vh(-3.0), bottom: vh(-3.0), width: vh(10.0), height: vh(10.0), ..default() }), BackgroundColor(c), Pickable::IGNORE));
        }
    });
}

fn picture<'a>(steam: Option<&'a Steam>, id: u64) -> Option<&'a Handle<Image>> {
    steam.and_then(|s| s.avatars.get(&id))
}

/// Top right: who you are (Steam avatar and name, or a letter tile without Steam).
pub fn identity(root: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, settings: &Settings, steam: Option<&Steam>, top: f32) {
    let (name, sub) = match steam {
        Some(s) => (s.name.clone(), "Online · via Steam"),
        None => (settings.name.clone(), "Playing without Steam"),
    };
    root.spawn((abs(Node { right: vh(96.0), top: vh(top), height: vh(68.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, column_gap: vh(16.0), padding: UiRect { left: vh(12.0), right: vh(24.0), ..default() }, ..default() }), BackgroundColor(BG1))).with_children(|c| {
        avatar(c, kit, 44.0, steam.and_then(|s| picture(Some(s), s.me)), &name, steam.map(|_| OK));
        c.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, row_gap: vh(4.0), ..default() }).with_children(|t| {
            t.spawn(kit_text(name, 18.0, TX1, &kit.text));
            label(t, kit, sub, TX2);
        });
    });
}

/// An invite to someone's party (in the notes under your name, `found::notes`): Accept /
/// Ignore and the time left.
pub fn toast(root: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, lobby: &Lobby, steam: Option<&Steam>) {
    let Some(inv) = lobby.shown.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.invites.iter().rev().find(|i| !lobby.ignored.contains(&i.code) && i.code != s.code)) else { return };
    root.spawn((
        // on the right edge: the amber bar on the outer (right) side
        crate::ui::soft(Node { width: vh(480.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, row_gap: vh(16.0), padding: UiRect::axes(vh(20.0), vh(16.0)), border: UiRect::right(vh(BAR)), ..default() }),
        BackgroundColor(BG2),
        BorderColor::all(AMBER),
        crate::ui::lift(),
    ))
    .with_children(|t| {
        t.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(16.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
            avatar(r, kit, 44.0, picture(steam, inv.steam), &inv.from, None);
            r.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, row_gap: vh(6.0), ..default() }).with_children(|c| {
                label(c, kit, "Party invite", AMBER);
                c.spawn(kit_text(format!("{} invited you to their party", inv.from), 18.0, TX1, &kit.text));
            });
        });
        t.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(8.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, padding: UiRect::left(vh(60.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
            chip(r, kit, "Accept", UiAction::Lobby(LobbyAction::Accept(inv.code.clone())), true);
            chip(r, kit, "Ignore", UiAction::Lobby(LobbyAction::Ignore(inv.code.clone())), false);
            r.spawn((Node { flex_grow: 1.0, justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexEnd, ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE)).with_children(|c| {
                let s = inv.left.max(0.0) as u32;
                label(c, kit, format!("{}:{:02}", s / 60, s % 60), TX3);
            });
        });
    });
}

/// A framed choice; without an action, a framed label in `fg` (the mode, for members).
fn small_button(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, text: &str, fg: Color, action: Option<UiAction>) {
    match action {
        Some(a) => chip(p, kit, text, a, false),
        None => {
            p.spawn((Node { height: vh(44.0), padding: UiRect::horizontal(vh(18.0)), align_items: AlignItems::Center, border: UiRect::all(px(1)), ..default() }, BorderColor::all(LINE_2))).with_children(|b| label(b, kit, text, fg));
        }
    }
}

/// The whole Play screen.
pub fn screen(root: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, st: &MenuState, lobby: &Lobby, settings: &Settings, steam: Option<&Steam>) {
    let a = |x: LobbyAction| UiAction::Lobby(x);
    let mode = lobby.shown.as_ref().or(crate::map_pick::fake().as_ref()).map(|s| s.mode).unwrap_or(Mode::Casual);
    root.spawn(abs(Node { left: vh(96.0), top: vh(72.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() })).with_children(|t| {
        page_title(t, kit, if mode == Mode::Custom { "Play · Custom game" } else { "Play · Casual 5v5" }, "Party", "パーティー");
    });
    identity(root, kit, settings, steam, 72.0);
    root.spawn((abs(Node { left: vh(96.0), right: vh(96.0), top: vh(160.0), height: px(1), ..default() }), BackgroundColor(LINE)));
    // back to the main menu (Esc does the same)
    root.spawn(abs(Node { left: vh(96.0), bottom: vh(48.0), ..default() })).with_children(|b| chip(b, kit, "Back · Esc", UiAction::Page(Page::Main), false));
    friends(root, kit, lobby, steam);

    // Left column: party, mode, the big button, joining by code.
    root.spawn(abs(Node { left: vh(96.0), top: vh(200.0), width: vh(1200.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() })).with_children(|col| {
        let fake = crate::map_pick::fake();
        let Some(s) = lobby.shown.as_ref().or(fake.as_ref()) else {
            label(col, kit, format!("Connecting to the lobby at {}...", lobby.address), TX2);
            field(col, kit, st, "Or connect to a server address (testing)");
            return;
        };
        let leader = s.leader == s.you;
        let max = if s.mode == Mode::Custom { MAX_CUSTOM } else { MAX_PARTY };
        col.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect::bottom(vh(16.0)), column_gap: vh(16.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
            label(r, kit, format!("Your party · {} of {max} · code {}", s.members.len(), s.code), TX2);
            if s.members.len() > 1 {
                small_button(r, kit, "Leave party", TX2, Some(a(LobbyAction::LeaveParty)));
            }
        });
        match s.mode {
            Mode::Casual => slots(col, kit, s, &s.members.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>(), MAX_PARTY, 280.0, None, steam),
            Mode::Custom => {
                for (group, title, color) in [(Group::A, "Team A · starts Strays", T_COLOR), (Group::B, "Team B · starts Bureau", CT_COLOR)] {
                    col.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect::vertical(vh(8.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|r| label(r, kit, title, color));
                    let members: Vec<&Member> = s.members.iter().filter(|m| m.group == group).collect();
                    slots(col, kit, s, &members, 5, 156.0, Some(group), steam);
                }
            }
        }
        label_block(col, kit, "Mode", 40.0);
        col.spawn(Node { ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
            if leader {
                chips(r, kit, "play.mode", vec![Choice::new("Casual queue", a(LobbyAction::SetMode(Mode::Casual)), s.mode == Mode::Casual), Choice::new("Custom game · 10 players", a(LobbyAction::SetMode(Mode::Custom)), s.mode == Mode::Custom)]);
            } else {
                small_button(r, kit, if s.mode == Mode::Custom { "Custom game · 10 players" } else { "Casual queue" }, AMBER, None);
            }
        });
        if s.mode == Mode::Custom {
            crate::map_pick::row(col, kit, s);
        }
        col.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(24.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, margin: UiRect::top(vh(40.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|r| match s.searching {
            Some(t) => {
                let t = t as u32;
                r.spawn(kit_text(format!("SEARCHING {}:{:02}", t / 60, t % 60), 30.0, OK, &kit.display));
                if leader {
                    small_button(r, kit, "Cancel", TX1, Some(a(LobbyAction::Cancel)));
                }
            }
            None => {
                let (text, hint) = if s.mode == Mode::Custom { ("Start game", "Knife round first: the winners pick their side") } else { ("Find match", "10 players make a match, your party stays together") };
                if let Some(left) = s.cooldown {
                    crate::found::cooldown(r, kit, text, left);
                } else if leader {
                    primary_button(r, kit, text, "Enter", a(LobbyAction::Play));
                    label(r, kit, hint, TX3);
                } else {
                    label(r, kit, "Only the party leader can start the queue", TX3);
                }
            }
        });
        if !lobby.notice.is_empty() {
            col.spawn((kit_text(lobby.notice.clone(), 15.0, AMBER, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(16.0)), ..default() }));
        }
        // (a custom game is full height: joining by code is on the casual screen)
        if s.mode != Mode::Custom {
            field(col, kit, st, "Join with a party code, Enter");
        }
    });
}

fn label_block(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, s: &str, top: f32) {
    p.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect { top: vh(top), bottom: vh(16.0), ..default() }, ..default() }).with_children(|b| label(b, kit, s, TX2));
}

/// A row of party slots: members first, then empty "invite" slots up to `count`.
fn slots(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, s: &net::lobby::LobbyState, members: &[&Member], count: usize, height: f32, group: Option<Group>, steam: Option<&Steam>) {
    let leader = s.leader == s.you;
    // custom games (two rows of five) use compact slots: picture and name side by side
    let compact = height <= 200.0;
    let side = if compact { 40.0 } else { 96.0 };
    p.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(16.0), ..default() }).with_children(|row| {
        for i in 0..count {
            let base = Node { flex_grow: 1.0, flex_basis: px(0), height: vh(height), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, row_gap: vh(if compact { 10.0 } else { 16.0 }), padding: UiRect::all(vh(if compact { 16.0 } else { 24.0 })), border: UiRect::all(px(1)), ..default() };
            let Some(m) = members.get(i) else {
                // ponytail: the mockup's dashed outline; Bevy UI has no dashed borders, so solid LINE.
                row.spawn((base, BorderColor::all(LINE))).with_children(|c| {
                    c.spawn((Node { width: vh(side), height: vh(side), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, align_items: AlignItems::Center, border: UiRect::all(px(1)), ..default() }, BorderColor::all(LINE))).with_children(|b| {
                        b.spawn(kit_text("+", 28.0, TX3, &kit.num));
                    });
                    label(c, kit, "Invite a friend", TX3);
                });
                continue;
            };
            let is_leader = m.id == s.leader;
            row.spawn(card(base, is_leader)).with_children(|c| {
                if compact {
                    c.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Center, column_gap: vh(12.0), ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
                        avatar(r, kit, side, picture(steam, m.steam), &m.name, None);
                        r.spawn(kit_text(m.name.clone(), 20.0, TX1, &kit.text));
                    });
                } else {
                    avatar(c, kit, side, picture(steam, m.steam), &m.name, None);
                    c.spawn(kit_text(m.name.clone(), 28.0, TX1, &kit.text));
                }
                let you = if m.id == s.you { " · you" } else { "" };
                if is_leader {
                    label(c, kit, format!("Leader{you}"), AMBER);
                } else {
                    label(c, kit, format!("In party{you}"), TX2);
                }
                // Custom games: the leader moves people between the teams.
                if let (Some(g), true) = (group, leader) {
                    let (text, to) = if g == Group::A { ("To team B", Group::B) } else { ("To team A", Group::A) };
                    small_button(c, kit, text, TX2, Some(UiAction::Lobby(LobbyAction::Move(m.id, to))));
                }
            });
        }
    });
}

/// The text field: a party code (or, for testing, a server address).
fn field(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, st: &MenuState, title: &str) {
    label_block(p, kit, title, 40.0);
    p.spawn((Node { width: vh(520.0), height: vh(56.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, padding: UiRect::horizontal(vh(18.0)), border: UiRect::left(vh(BAR)), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(BG1), BorderColor::all(LINE_2)))
        .with_children(|f| {
            f.spawn(kit_text(format!("{}_", st.address), 22.0, TX1, &kit.num));
        });
}

/// Right column: Steam friends, in game / online / offline, with invite buttons.
fn friends(root: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, lobby: &Lobby, steam: Option<&Steam>) {
    root.spawn((abs(Node { left: vh(1344.0), right: vh(96.0), top: vh(200.0), bottom: vh(120.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, overflow: Overflow::clip(), ..default() }), BackgroundColor(BG1))).with_children(|panel| {
        let list = steam.map(|s| s.friends.as_slice()).unwrap_or_default();
        let count = |p: Presence| list.iter().filter(|f| f.presence == p).count();
        panel.spawn((Node { align_items: AlignItems::Baseline, padding: UiRect { left: vh(24.0), right: vh(24.0), top: vh(20.0), bottom: vh(16.0) }, border: UiRect::bottom(px(1)), ..default() }, BorderColor::all(LINE))).with_children(|h| {
            h.spawn(kit_text("FRIENDS", 28.0, TX1, &kit.display));
            h.spawn(Node { flex_grow: 1.0, justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexEnd, ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
                if steam.is_some() {
                    label(r, kit, format!("{} in game · {} online", count(Presence::InGame), count(Presence::Online)), TX2);
                }
            });
        });
        let Some(steam) = steam else {
            panel.spawn(Node { padding: UiRect::all(vh(24.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|t| {
                t.spawn(kit_text("Start Steam to see your friends and invite them. Party codes work without it.", 15.0, TX2, &kit.text));
            });
            return;
        };
        let in_party: Vec<u64> = lobby.shown.as_ref().map(|s| s.members.iter().map(|m| m.steam).collect()).unwrap_or_default();
        let code = lobby.shown.as_ref().map(|s| s.code.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
        panel.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, padding: UiRect::vertical(vh(8.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|rows| {
            for (presence, title, dot) in [(Presence::InGame, "In game", AMBER), (Presence::Online, "Online", OK), (Presence::Offline, "Offline", TX3)] {
                let group: Vec<_> = steam.friends.iter().filter(|f| f.presence == presence).collect();
                if group.is_empty() {
                    continue;
                }
                rows.spawn(Node { padding: UiRect { left: vh(24.0), right: vh(24.0), top: vh(16.0), bottom: vh(8.0) }, ..default() }).with_children(|h| label(h, kit, format!("{title} · {}", group.len()), TX3));
                // ponytail: no scrolling yet; offline friends are capped so the panel fits.
                let shown = if presence == Presence::Offline { 6 } else { 40 };
                for f in group.into_iter().take(shown) {
                    let offline = presence == Presence::Offline;
                    let (name_c, status_c) = if offline { (TX3, TX3) } else { (TX1, TX2) };
                    rows.spawn(Node { height: vh(64.0), flex_shrink: 0.0, align_items: AlignItems::Center, column_gap: vh(16.0), padding: UiRect::horizontal(vh(24.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
                        avatar(r, kit, 44.0, picture(Some(steam), f.id), &f.name, Some(if f.away { TX2 } else { dot }));
                        r.spawn(Node { flex_grow: 1.0, flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, row_gap: vh(4.0), overflow: Overflow::clip(), ..default() }).with_children(|t| {
                            t.spawn(kit_text(f.name.clone(), 18.0, name_c, &kit.text));
                            let status = if in_party.contains(&f.id) { "In your party".to_string() } else { f.status.clone() };
                            t.spawn(kit_text(status, 13.0, status_c, &kit.text));
                        });
                        if !offline {
                            r.spawn(Node { width: vh(112.0), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, ..default() }).with_children(|b| {
                                if in_party.contains(&f.id) {
                                    label(b, kit, "In party", TX3);
                                } else if lobby.invited.contains_key(&f.id) {
                                    label(b, kit, "Invited", TX3);
                                } else if !code.is_empty() {
                                    chip_w(b, kit, "Invite", UiAction::Lobby(LobbyAction::Invite(f.id, presence == Presence::InGame)), 112.0);
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        });
    });
}
```

`client/src/players.rs`:

```rs
//! Other players: their CS model for their team, animated like GoldSrc does it (legs
//! from a gait sequence, upper body aiming up/down with the weapon's pose), shooting and
//! flinching when hit, and a corpse playing a death animation when they die.
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::{map, models};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::mesh::skinning::SkinnedMeshInverseBindposes;
use net::protocol::Team;
use sim::hitbox::HitGroup;
use sim::weapons::Id;
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::Arc;

pub struct PlayersPlugin;

impl Plugin for PlayersPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_message::<PlayerAnim>()
            .add_systems(Startup, load_looks)
            .add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::InGame), |mut l: ResMut<OtherPlayers>| {
                l.dying.clear();
                l.last_hit.clear();
            })
            .add_systems(Update, (clear_corpses, anim_events, draw_others, animate).chain().in_set(Frame::World));
    }
}

/// A new round: the bodies are gone (CS clears them at round start).
fn clear_corpses(mut commands: Commands, mut news: MessageReader<crate::effects::GameNews>, corpses: Query<Entity, With<Corpse>>) {
    if news.read().any(|n| matches!(n.0, net::protocol::GameEvent::RoundStart { .. })) {
        for e in &corpses {
            commands.entity(e).despawn();
        }
    }
}

/// Something that changes how a player is animated (sent by `effects::events`).
#[derive(Message)]
pub enum PlayerAnim {
    /// They fired (silenced: no muzzle flash).
    Shot(u8, bool),
    Hurt(u8, HitGroup),
    Died(u8),
}

/// Corpses kept at once (CS clears them each round).
const MAX_CORPSES: usize = 16;

#[derive(Resource)]
struct OtherPlayers {
    /// T looks, then CT looks.
    looks: Vec<Arc<models::Loaded>>,
    t_count: usize,
    /// Died, but the snapshot we draw from may still show them alive: don't redraw them yet.
    dying: HashSet<u8>,
    /// Where each player was last hit (picks the death animation).
    last_hit: HashMap<u8, HitGroup>,
}

fn load_looks(mut commands: Commands, mut cache: ResMut<models::ModelCache>, mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>, mut materials: ResMut<Assets<crate::studio::StudioMaterial>>) {
    // The CS 1.6 classes (characters.rs), in `Score::looks` order.
    let mut load = |classes: &[(&str, &str)]| -> Vec<_> { classes.iter().filter_map(|(n, _)| cache.get(&format!("player/{n}/{n}.mdl"), &mut images, &mut materials)).collect() };
    let mut looks = load(&crate::characters::T_CLASSES);
    let t_count = looks.len();
    looks.extend(load(&crate::characters::CT_CLASSES));
    commands.insert_resource(OtherPlayers { looks, t_count, dying: HashSet::new(), last_hit: HashMap::new() });
}

impl OtherPlayers {
    /// Which look a player gets: the character they picked for their side (`Score::looks`).
    fn look_for(&self, looks: [u8; 2], team: Team) -> Option<usize> {
        let (start, n, pick) = match team {
            Team::Ct => (self.t_count, self.looks.len() - self.t_count, looks[1]),
            _ => (0, self.t_count, looks[0]),
        };
        (n > 0).then(|| start + pick as usize % n)
    }
}

/// A live player's model. Children are the body parts, then the weapon parts.
#[derive(Component)]
struct OtherPlayer {
    id: u8,
    look: usize,
    weapon: Id,
    body: Vec<Entity>,
    /// The p_ model in their hand and its bones (it borrows the body's pose by bone name).
    gun: Option<(Arc<models::Loaded>, models::SpawnedSkin)>,
    /// Legs, upper body and spine, as CS animates them (shared with the server's hitboxes).
    anim: sim::anim::Anim,
    crouched: bool,
    /// Muzzle flash quad (a child) and until when it shows.
    flash: Entity,
    flash_until: f32,
}

/// A dead player playing their death animation (then lying still).
#[derive(Component)]
struct Corpse {
    look: usize,
    body: Vec<Entity>,
    seq: usize,
    started: f32,
    done: bool,
}

fn seq(model: &goldsrc::mdl::Model, name: &str) -> Option<usize> {
    model.sequence(name)
}

fn anim_events(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut msgs: MessageReader<PlayerAnim>,
    mut look: ResMut<OtherPlayers>,
    time: Res<Time>,
    mut live: Query<(Entity, &mut OtherPlayer)>,
    corpses: Query<(Entity, &Corpse)>,
) {
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    for m in msgs.read() {
        match *m {
            PlayerAnim::Shot(id, _) | PlayerAnim::Hurt(id, _) => {
                if let PlayerAnim::Hurt(_, g) = *m {
                    look.last_hit.insert(id, g);
                }
                let Some((_, mut p)) = live.iter_mut().find(|(_, p)| p.id == id) else { continue };
                if let PlayerAnim::Shot(_, silenced) = *m {
                    if crate::muzzle::flashes(p.weapon, silenced) {
                        p.flash_until = now + crate::muzzle::FLASH_SECONDS;
                    }
                }
                match *m {
                    PlayerAnim::Hurt(_, g) => p.anim.hurt(g, now),
                    _ => p.anim.shot(now),
                }
            }
            PlayerAnim::Died(id) => {
                look.dying.insert(id);
                let Some((e, p)) = live.iter().find(|(_, p)| p.id == id) else { continue };
                // The corpse keeps the body; the gun drops (the server puts it on the ground).
                if let Some((_, g)) = &p.gun {
                    g.despawn(&mut commands);
                }
                commands.entity(p.flash).despawn();
                let model = &look.looks[p.look].model;
                let name = match look.last_hit.get(&id) {
                    _ if p.crouched => "crouch_die",
                    Some(HitGroup::Head) => "head",
                    Some(HitGroup::Stomach) => "gutshot",
                    Some(HitGroup::LeftArm) => "left",
                    Some(HitGroup::RightArm) => "right",
                    _ => ["death1", "death2", "death3", "back", "forward"][(id as usize + now as usize) % 5],
                };
                let s = seq(model, name).unwrap_or(0);
                commands.entity(e).remove::<OtherPlayer>().insert(Corpse { look: p.look, body: p.body.clone(), seq: s, started: now, done: false });
                // Old corpses go first.
                let mut old: Vec<_> = corpses.iter().map(|(e, c)| (c.started, e)).collect();
                if old.len() >= MAX_CORPSES {
                    old.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.total_cmp(&b.0));
                    for (_, e) in &old[..old.len() + 1 - MAX_CORPSES] {
                        commands.entity(*e).despawn();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn place(o: &net::client::Remote) -> Transform {
    Transform::from_translation(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(o.origin))).with_rotation(Quat::from_rotation_y(o.yaw.to_radians()))
}

/// Spawn models for players that appeared (or changed team or weapon), remove ones that left.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn draw_others(
    mut commands: Commands,
    w: Res<Walker>,
    mut look: ResMut<OtherPlayers>,
    mut cache: ResMut<models::ModelCache>,
    mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>,
    mut materials: ResMut<Assets<crate::studio::StudioMaterial>>,
    mut meshes: ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>,
    mut bindposes: ResMut<Assets<SkinnedMeshInverseBindposes>>,
    flash_look: Res<crate::muzzle::FlashLook>,
    drawn: Query<(Entity, &OtherPlayer)>,
) {
    let all = w.client.others();
    // Dead in the snapshot now: they can be drawn again once they respawn.
    look.dying.retain(|id| all.iter().any(|o| o.id == *id && o.alive));
    // Their characters from the scoreboard (until it arrives, varied by id like the server does).
    let looks_of = |id: u8| w.client.scores.iter().find(|s| s.id == id).map(|s| s.looks).unwrap_or([id % net::protocol::CLASSES; 2]);
    let others: Vec<_> = all.into_iter().filter(|o| o.alive && !look.dying.contains(&o.id)).filter_map(|o| Some((look.look_for(looks_of(o.id), o.team)?, o))).collect();
    for (e, p) in &drawn {
        if !others.iter().any(|(li, o)| o.id == p.id && *li == p.look && o.weapon == p.weapon) {
            commands.entity(e).despawn();
        }
    }
    for (li, o) in &others {
        if drawn.iter().any(|(_, d)| d.id == o.id && d.look == *li && d.weapon == o.weapon) {
            continue;
        }
        let body = look.looks[*li].clone();
        let parent = commands.spawn((place(o), Visibility::default(), DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame))).id();
        let joints = body.spawn_skinned(&mut commands, parent, None, &mut meshes, &mut bindposes, &mut materials).joints;
        let gun = cache.get(&models::weapon_model("p", o.weapon), &mut images, &mut materials).map(|wm| {
            let s = wm.spawn_skinned(&mut commands, parent, None, &mut meshes, &mut bindposes, &mut materials);
            (wm, s)
        });
        let flash = crate::muzzle::spawn(&mut commands, &flash_look);
        commands.entity(parent).add_child(flash);
        commands.entity(parent).insert(OtherPlayer { id: o.id, look: *li, weapon: o.weapon, body: joints, gun, anim: sim::anim::Anim::new(o.yaw), crouched: o.crouched, flash, flash_until: 0.0 });
    }
}

/// Pose every player's (and corpse's) bones for this frame; the GPU does the rest.
fn animate(
    w: Res<Walker>,
    look: Res<OtherPlayers>,
    time: Res<Time>,
    mut live: Query<(Entity, &mut OtherPlayer, &mut Transform), (Without<Corpse>, Without<ChildOf>)>,
    mut corpses: Query<&mut Corpse>,
    mut bones: Query<&mut Transform, With<ChildOf>>,
    mut vis: Query<&mut Visibility>,
    cam: Single<&GlobalTransform, With<crate::game::FlyCam>>,
    watch: Res<crate::spectate::Watch>,
) {
    // Watching someone through their eyes: their own body isn't drawn.
    let in_eye = crate::spectate::in_eye(&w, &watch).map(|o| o.id);
    let cam_rot = cam.compute_transform().rotation;
    let (now, dt) = (time.elapsed_secs(), time.delta_secs().max(1e-4));
    let others = w.client.others();
    for (e, mut p, mut tf) in &mut live {
        let Some(o) = others.iter().find(|o| o.id == p.id) else { continue };
        if let Ok(mut v) = vis.get_mut(e) {
            v.set_if_neq(if in_eye == Some(p.id) { Visibility::Hidden } else { Visibility::Inherited });
        }
        let model = &look.looks[p.look].model;
        p.crouched = o.crouched;
        let d = sim::anim::Drive { origin: o.origin, yaw: o.yaw, pitch: o.pitch, crouched: o.crouched, airborne: o.airborne, reloading: o.reloading, weapon: p.weapon };
        p.anim.step(model, &d, now, dt);
        let posed = p.anim.pose(model, &d, now);
        *tf = Transform::from_translation(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(o.origin))).with_rotation(Quat::from_rotation_y(posed.yaw.to_radians()));
        let pose = posed.bones;
        models::set_pose(&p.body, &pose, &mut bones);
        let lit = now < p.flash_until;
        if let Some((wm, g)) = &p.gun {
            let gun_pose = wm.model.borrow_pose(model, &pose);
            models::set_pose(&g.joints, &gun_pose, &mut bones);
            // Muzzle flash at the p_ model's muzzle, facing the camera.
            if let (true, Some(at)) = (lit, wm.model.attachment(0, &gun_pose)) {
                if let Ok(mut t) = bones.get_mut(p.flash) {
                    t.translation = Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(at));
                    t.rotation = tf.rotation.inverse() * cam_rot * Quat::from_rotation_z((now * 7919.0).fract() * std::f32::consts::TAU);
                    t.scale = Vec3::splat(14.0);
                }
            }
        }
        if let Ok(mut v) = vis.get_mut(p.flash) {
            v.set_if_neq(if lit { Visibility::Inherited } else { Visibility::Hidden });
        }
    }
    for mut c in &mut corpses {
        if c.done {
            continue;
        }
        let model = &look.looks[c.look].model;
        let sq = &model.sequences[c.seq];
        let frame = (now - c.started) * sq.fps;
        c.done = frame >= sq.frames as f32 - 1.0;
        models::set_pose(&c.body, &model.pose_at(c.seq, frame, 0.5), &mut bones);
    }
}
```

`client/src/radar.rs`:

```rs
//! The radar (top left, direction E): the map's own overview image (`overviews/<map>.bmp`
//! and its `.txt`), centred on you and cropped to a window. On it: your arrow, your
//! teammates (circles), enemies the server shows you (squares; it only sends the ones you
//! can see), and the bomb when it's dropped, planted, or carried by a teammate.
use crate::game::{FlyCam, Frame, Walker};
use crate::hud::SAFE;
use crate::menu::{AppState, GameConfig};
use crate::ui::{vh, AMBER, BG0, CT_COLOR, LINE, T_COLOR};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::render::render_resource::TextureFormat;
use net::protocol::{BombNet, Team};

pub struct RadarPlugin;

impl Plugin for RadarPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::InGame), spawn).add_systems(Update, update.in_set(Frame::Ui).run_if(resource_exists::<Walker>));
    }
}

/// Radar size at 1080p, and how many game units it shows across.
pub const SIZE: f32 = 256.0;
const SPAN: f32 = 2400.0;
const DOTS: usize = 10;

/// How the overview image maps to the world (GoldSrc overview `.txt`).
#[derive(Resource, Clone, Copy)]
struct Overview {
    zoom: f32,
    origin: [f32; 2],
    rotated: bool,
    size: Vec2,
}

impl Overview {
    /// Image pixels per world unit (the 1024 px image covers 8192 / zoom units).
    fn per_unit(&self) -> f32 {
        self.zoom * 1024.0 / 8192.0
    }

    /// World (x, y) to image pixels, centred on origin. ROTATED 1: image right is world +x,
    /// image up is world +y. ROTATED 0: turned a quarter, image right is world -y, image up
    /// is world +x. (Fitted: each map's floor plan from its BSP against its overview image,
    /// scale and axes.)
    fn to_px(&self, x: f32, y: f32) -> Vec2 {
        let k = self.per_unit();
        let (dx, dy) = (x - self.origin[0], y - self.origin[1]);
        let (u, v) = if self.rotated { (dx, -dy) } else { (-dy, -dx) };
        Vec2::new(self.size.x / 2.0 + u * k, self.size.y / 2.0 + v * k)
    }
}

#[derive(Component)]
struct RadarRoot;
#[derive(Component)]
struct Map;
#[derive(Component)]
struct Me;
#[derive(Component)]
struct Dot(usize);
#[derive(Component)]
struct Bomb;

/// 8-bit paletted BMP (what the overviews are) to RGBA, the green background clear.
pub(crate) fn load_bmp(data: &[u8]) -> Option<(u32, u32, Vec<u8>)> {
    let u32_at = |o: usize| Some(u32::from_le_bytes(data.get(o..o + 4)?.try_into().ok()?));
    let i32_at = |o: usize| Some(i32::from_le_bytes(data.get(o..o + 4)?.try_into().ok()?));
    if data.get(..2)? != b"BM" || u16::from_le_bytes(data.get(28..30)?.try_into().ok()?) != 8 {
        return None;
    }
    let pixels = u32_at(10)? as usize;
    let (w, h) = (i32_at(18)?.unsigned_abs(), i32_at(22)?);
    let palette = 14 + u32_at(14)? as usize;
    let stride = (w as usize + 3) & !3;
    let mut rgba = vec![0u8; (w * h.unsigned_abs() * 4) as usize];
    for y in 0..h.unsigned_abs() as usize {
        // Rows are stored bottom-up unless the height is negative.
        let src = if h > 0 { h as usize - 1 - y } else { y };
        for x in 0..w as usize {
            let i = *data.get(pixels + src * stride + x)? as usize;
            let c = data.get(palette + i * 4..palette + i * 4 + 3)?;
            let (b, g, r) = (c[0], c[1], c[2]);
            let clear = g > 200 && r < 60 && b < 60;
            rgba[(y * w as usize + x) * 4..][..4].copy_from_slice(&[r, g, b, if clear { 0 } else { 255 }]);
        }
    }
    Some((w, h.unsigned_abs(), rgba))
}

fn parse_txt(text: &str) -> Option<(f32, [f32; 2], bool)> {
    let mut zoom = None;
    let mut origin = None;
    let mut rotated = false;
    for l in text.lines() {
        let p: Vec<&str> = l.split_whitespace().collect();
        match p.first().map(|s| s.to_ascii_uppercase()).as_deref() {
            Some("ZOOM") => zoom = p.get(1)?.parse().ok(),
            Some("ORIGIN") => origin = Some([p.get(1)?.parse().ok()?, p.get(2)?.parse().ok()?]),
            Some("ROTATED") => rotated = p.get(1) == Some(&"1"),
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    Some((zoom?, origin?, rotated))
}

fn spawn(mut commands: Commands, config: Res<GameConfig>, w: Option<Res<Walker>>, mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>) {
    let map = w.as_ref().and_then(|w| w.client.map.clone()).unwrap_or_else(|| config.map.clone());
    let dir = crate::game_dir().join("overviews");
    let img = std::fs::read(dir.join(format!("{map}.bmp"))).ok().and_then(|d| load_bmp(&d));
    let txt = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join(format!("{map}.txt"))).ok().and_then(|t| parse_txt(&t));
    let (Some((iw, ih, rgba)), Some((zoom, origin, rotated))) = (img, txt) else { return };
    let ov = Overview { zoom, origin, rotated, size: Vec2::new(iw as f32, ih as f32) };
    commands.insert_resource(ov);
    let image = images.add(crate::level::rgba_image(iw, ih, rgba, false, TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb));
    let wedge = images_wedge(&mut images);
    commands
        .spawn((
            RadarRoot,
            crate::ui::HudLayer,
            DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame),
            Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, left: vh(SAFE), top: vh(SAFE), width: vh(SIZE), height: vh(SIZE), overflow: Overflow::clip(), border: UiRect::all(px(1)), ..default() },
            BackgroundColor(BG0.with_alpha(0.78)),
            BorderColor::all(LINE),
        ))
        .with_children(|r| {
            r.spawn((Map, ImageNode { image, color: Color::srgba(0.75, 0.78, 0.82, 0.85), ..default() }, Node { width: percent(100), height: percent(100), ..default() }));
            for i in 0..DOTS {
                r.spawn((Dot(i), Visibility::Hidden, Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: vh(10.0), height: vh(10.0), border: UiRect::all(vh(2.0)), border_radius: BorderRadius::MAX, ..default() }, BorderColor::all(BG0), BackgroundColor(CT_COLOR)));
            }
            r.spawn((Bomb, Visibility::Hidden, Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: vh(12.0), height: vh(12.0), margin: UiRect { left: vh(-6.0), top: vh(-6.0), ..default() }, border: UiRect::all(vh(2.0)), ..default() }, UiTransform { rotation: Rot2::degrees(45.0), ..default() }, BorderColor::all(BG0), BackgroundColor(AMBER)));
            // You: an amber wedge in the centre, pointing where you look.
            r.spawn((Me, UiTransform::default(), Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, left: percent(50), top: percent(50), margin: UiRect { left: vh(-7.0), top: vh(-9.0), ..default() }, width: vh(14.0), height: vh(18.0), ..default() }))
                .with_children(|m| {
                    m.spawn((ImageNode { image: wedge.clone(), color: AMBER, ..default() }, Node { width: percent(100), height: percent(100), ..default() }));
                });
        });
}

/// A 28x36 arrow pointing up.
fn images_wedge(images: &mut Assets<Image>) -> Handle<Image> {
    let (w, h) = (28u32, 36u32);
    let mut rgba = vec![255u8; (w * h * 4) as usize];
    for y in 0..h {
        for x in 0..w {
            let fy = y as f32 + 0.5;
            let half = w as f32 / 2.0 * (fy / h as f32);
            let inside = (x as f32 + 0.5 - w as f32 / 2.0).abs() <= half && !(fy > h as f32 * 0.72 && (x as f32 + 0.5 - w as f32 / 2.0).abs() < (fy - h as f32 * 0.72) * 1.2);
            rgba[((y * w + x) * 4 + 3) as usize] = if inside { 255 } else { 0 };
        }
    }
    images.add(crate::level::rgba_image(w, h, rgba, false, TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb))
}

#[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]
fn update(
    w: Res<Walker>,
    ov: Option<Res<Overview>>,
    cam: Query<&GlobalTransform, With<FlyCam>>,
    mut map: Query<&mut ImageNode, With<Map>>,
    mut me: Query<&mut UiTransform, With<Me>>,
    mut dots: Query<(&Dot, &mut Node, &mut Visibility, &mut BackgroundColor, &mut BorderColor), Without<Bomb>>,
    mut bomb: Query<(&mut Node, &mut Visibility), With<Bomb>>,
) {
    let Some(ov) = ov else { return };
    let c = &w.client;
    let o = c.me().origin;
    let centre = ov.to_px(o[0], o[1]);
    let half = SPAN * ov.per_unit() / 2.0;
    // Crop the overview to the window around you (the image fills the radar).
    for mut img in &mut map {
        let rect = Some(Rect::new(centre.x - half, centre.y - half, centre.x + half, centre.y + half));
        if img.rect != rect {
            img.rect = rect;
        }
    }
    if let Ok(t) = cam.single() {
        // Bevy forward (Y-up) back to GoldSrc: x stays, y = -z. Screen angle follows the image axes.
        let f = t.forward();
        let a = ov.to_px(o[0] + f.x, o[1] - f.z) - centre;
        for mut tr in &mut me {
            tr.rotation = Rot2::radians(a.x.atan2(-a.y));
        }
    }
    let my_team = c.team();
    let carrier = match c.bomb {
        BombNet::Carried(id) => Some(id),
        _ => None,
    };
    // Position on the radar (0..1), with off-window players held on its edge.
    let place = |x: f32, y: f32, edge: bool| {
        let d = (ov.to_px(x, y) - centre) / (2.0 * half);
        let d = if edge { d.clamp(Vec2::splat(-0.48), Vec2::splat(0.48)) } else { d };
        Vec2::new(0.5 + d.x, 0.5 + d.y)
    };
    let others: Vec<_> = c.others().into_iter().filter(|r| r.alive && r.team != Team::Spectator).collect();
    for (Dot(i), mut node, mut vis, mut bg, mut border) in &mut dots {
        let Some(r) = others.get(*i) else {
            vis.set_if_neq(Visibility::Hidden);
            continue;
        };
        let mate = r.team == my_team;
        let p = place(r.origin[0], r.origin[1], mate);
        // Enemies leave the radar when they leave its window.
        if !mate && !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&p.x) || !mate && !(0.0..=1.0).contains(&p.y) {
            vis.set_if_neq(Visibility::Hidden);
            continue;
        }
        node.left = percent(p.x * 100.0);
        node.top = percent(p.y * 100.0);
        node.margin = UiRect { left: vh(-5.0), top: vh(-5.0), ..default() };
        node.border_radius = if mate { BorderRadius::MAX } else { BorderRadius::ZERO };
        bg.set_if_neq(BackgroundColor(if r.team == Team::T { T_COLOR } else { CT_COLOR }));
        // The teammate with the bomb gets an amber ring.
        border.set_if_neq(BorderColor::all(if carrier == Some(r.id) { AMBER } else { BG0 }));
        vis.set_if_neq(Visibility::Inherited);
    }
    let at = match c.bomb {
        BombNet::Dropped(p) | BombNet::Planted { at: p, .. } => Some(p),
        _ => None,
    };
    for (mut node, mut vis) in &mut bomb {
        let Some(p) = at else {
            vis.set_if_neq(Visibility::Hidden);
            continue;
        };
        let q = place(p[0], p[1], true);
        node.left = percent(q.x * 100.0);
        node.top = percent(q.y * 100.0);
        vis.set_if_neq(Visibility::Inherited);
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn the_axes_follow_the_overview_files() {
        // de_dust2 (ROTATED 0): the T spawn is south-west in the world, so low and to the right.
        let ov = Overview { zoom: 1.5, origin: [-223.0, 1097.0], rotated: false, size: Vec2::new(1024.0, 768.0) };
        let t = ov.to_px(-832.0, -704.0);
        assert!(t.x > 700.0 && t.y > 400.0, "{t:?}");
        // north (+y) is to the left, east (+x) is up
        assert!(ov.to_px(-223.0, 1297.0).x < ov.to_px(-223.0, 1097.0).x);
        assert!(ov.to_px(-23.0, 1097.0).y < ov.to_px(-223.0, 1097.0).y);
        // de_inferno (ROTATED 1): +x is right, +y is up
        let ov = Overview { zoom: 1.49, origin: [490.0, 1280.0], rotated: true, size: Vec2::new(1024.0, 768.0) };
        assert!(ov.to_px(690.0, 1280.0).x > ov.to_px(490.0, 1280.0).x);
        assert!(ov.to_px(490.0, 1480.0).y < ov.to_px(490.0, 1280.0).y);
        // 1024 px cover 8192 / zoom units
        assert!((ov.to_px(490.0 + 8192.0 / 1.49, 1280.0).x - ov.to_px(490.0, 1280.0).x - 1024.0).abs() < 0.5);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! ticks top centre; `money`: money, what it just changed by and the status icons (buy zone,

/// A round event for the announcements (sent by `effects::events`).

/// Player-facing side names (the code still says Ct/T): Bureau defends, Strays attack.

    if t == Team::Ct { "Bureau" } else { "Strays" }
}

        Team::T => T_COLOR,

fn spawn(mut commands: Commands, kit: Res<Kit>) {

        .spawn((DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame), HudLayer, abs(Node { width: percent(100), top: vh(SAFE), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, row_gap: vh(12.0), ..default() })))
        .with_children(|col| {
            col.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(4.0), ..default() }).with_children(|row| {

                    row.spawn(hud_panel(Node { width: vh(88.0), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() })).with_children(|p| {
                        p.spawn(edge(EdgeColor::Fixed(color), 1.0));
                        let mut t = p.spawn(kit_text("0", 32.0, color, &kit.num));
                        if mark {
                            t.insert(ScoreCt);

                            t.insert(ScoreT);
                        }
                    });

                score(row, CT_COLOR, true);
                row.spawn(hud_panel(Node { width: vh(148.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, padding: UiRect::vertical(vh(10.0)), row_gap: vh(6.0), ..default() })).with_children(|c| {
                    c.spawn((ClockEdge, edge(EdgeColor::Team, EDGE_REST)));
                    c.spawn((Clock, kit_text("", 32.0, TX1, &kit.num)));
                    c.spawn((RoundNo, kit_text("", 13.0, TX2, &kit.text)));
                });
                score(row, T_COLOR, false);
            });
            col.spawn(Node { width: vh(332.0), justify_content: JustifyContent::SpaceBetween, ..default() }).with_children(|row| {
                for team in [Team::Ct, Team::T] {

/// Change a text only when it really changes.
fn set(t: &mut Mut<Text>, s: String) {
    if t.0 != s {
        t.0 = s;
    }
}

fn mmss(secs: f32) -> String {
    let s = secs.max(0.0).ceil() as u32;
    format!("{}:{:02}", s / 60, s % 60)
}

/// The last seconds swell and tick; the last five tick out loud.
const URGENT: f32 = 10.0;
const URGENT_SOUND: f32 = 5.0;

#[allow(clippy::type_complexity, clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn top_bar(
    w: Res<Walker>,
    mut st: Single<&mut Text, (With<ScoreT>, Without<ScoreCt>, Without<Clock>, Without<RoundNo>)>,
    mut sc: Single<&mut Text, (With<ScoreCt>, Without<Clock>, Without<RoundNo>)>,
    clock: Single<(Entity, &mut Text, &mut TextColor), (With<Clock>, Without<RoundNo>)>,
    mut round: Single<&mut Text, With<RoundNo>>,
    mut edge: Single<&mut Edge, With<ClockEdge>>,
    mut last_second: Local<u32>,
    mut sounds: MessageWriter<UiSound>,
    mut commands: Commands,
) {
    let r = w.client.round;
    let practice = w.client.practice;
    // Rounds won: [terrorists, counter-terrorists].
    set(&mut st, if practice { "-".into() } else { r.score[0].to_string() });
    set(&mut sc, if practice { "-".into() } else { r.score[1].to_string() });
    let planted = matches!(w.client.bomb, BombNet::Planted { .. });
    let urgent = !practice && r.phase == Phase::Live && !planted && r.left <= URGENT;
    let (t, color) = match r.phase {
        _ if practice => ("--:--".to_string(), TX2),
        Phase::Warmup => ("--:--".to_string(), TX2),
        Phase::Live if planted => ("BOMB".to_string(), BAD),
        Phase::Live if urgent => (mmss(r.left), BAD),
        Phase::Freeze | Phase::Live => (mmss(r.left), TX1),
        Phase::Over | Phase::GameOver => (mmss(r.left), TX2),
    };
    let (clock_e, mut text, mut tc) = clock.into_inner();
    set(&mut text, t);
    if tc.0 != color {
        tc.0 = color;
    }
    edge.alert = urgent || (r.phase == Phase::Live && planted);
    edge.rest = if edge.alert { 1.0 } else { crate::ui::EDGE_REST };
    // each second in the last ten: the clock swells and splits, and the last five tick
    let second = r.left.max(0.0).ceil() as u32;
    if urgent && second != *last_second && second > 0 {
        commands.entity(clock_e).insert(Anim::tick());
        if r.left <= URGENT_SOUND {
            sounds.write(UiSound::Tick);
        }
    }
    *last_second = second;
    let label = match r.phase {
        _ if practice => "PRACTICE".into(),
        Phase::Warmup => "WARMUP".into(),
        Phase::Freeze => format!("ROUND {} · BUY", r.round),
        Phase::Live => format!("ROUND {}", r.round),
        Phase::Over => "ROUND OVER".into(),
        Phase::GameOver => "MATCH OVER".into(),
    };
    set(&mut round, label);
}

/// One tick per player under each score, lit while they're alive.
fn ticks(w: Res<Walker>, mut ticks: Query<(&Tick, &mut BackgroundColor)>) {
    for (Tick(team, i), mut bg) in &mut ticks {
        let c = match w.client.scores.iter().filter(|s| s.team == *team).nth(*i) {
            Some(p) if p.alive => side_color(*team),
            Some(_) => LINE_2,
            None => Color::NONE,
        };
        bg.set_if_neq(BackgroundColor(c));
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Money, top left under the radar: it counts to its new value, the change floats up beside
//! it and fades; the status icons on the right (defuse kit, buy zone, bomb) open and close in
//! place with a soft blip. The bomb icon turns red in a bomb site.
use super::{abs, set};
use crate::game::Walker;
use crate::hud::{Icons, SAFE};
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::ui::{edge, hud_panel, kit_text, vh, Anim, Count, Edge, EdgeColor, HudLayer, Kit, Opens, UiSound, BAD, CT_COLOR, EDGE_REST, OK, TX1, TX2};

#[derive(Component)]
pub(super) struct MoneyPanel;
#[derive(Component)]
pub(super) struct MoneyEdge;
#[derive(Component)]
pub(super) struct Money;
#[derive(Component)]
pub(super) struct Delta;
/// A status icon: which one.
#[derive(Component, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum Status {
    Kit,
    Buy,
    Bomb,
}

/// An icon's slot: 24 wide plus the 8 gap before it.
const SLOT: f32 = 32.0;
/// The change floats for this long.
const T_DELTA: f32 = 1.3;

pub(super) fn spawn(mut commands: Commands, kit: Res<Kit>, icons: Res<Icons>) {
    commands
        .spawn((MoneyPanel, HudLayer, DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame), hud_panel(abs(Node { left: vh(SAFE), top: vh(SAFE + crate::radar::SIZE + 8.0), width: vh(256.0), height: vh(48.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, padding: UiRect::horizontal(vh(16.0)), column_gap: vh(8.0), ..default() }))))
        .with_children(|p| {
            p.spawn((MoneyEdge, edge(EdgeColor::Team, EDGE_REST)));
            p.spawn(kit_text("$", 26.0, OK, &kit.num));
            p.spawn((Money, Count::new(0.0, 0.14), kit_text("0", 26.0, TX1, &kit.num)));
            p.spawn((Delta, kit_text("", 16.0, OK, &kit.num), UiTransform::default()));
            p.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect::left(Val::Auto), align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }).with_children(|row| {
                for (s, icon, color) in [(Status::Kit, "defuser", CT_COLOR), (Status::Bomb, "c4", TX1), (Status::Buy, "buyzone", OK)] {
                    row.spawn((s, Opens::new(false, SLOT), Node { width: px(0), height: vh(24.0), justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexEnd, overflow: Overflow::clip(), ..default() })).with_children(|slot| {
                        slot.spawn(icons.node(icon, 24.0, color)).entry::<Node>().and_modify(|mut n| n.flex_shrink = 0.0);
                    });
                }
            });
        });
}

#[allow(clippy::type_complexity, clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(super) fn money(
    w: Res<Walker>,
    time: Res<Time>,
    mut last: Local<Option<(i32, f32, i32)>>,
    mut panel: Single<&mut Visibility, With<MoneyPanel>>,
    mut count: Single<&mut Count, With<Money>>,
    delta: Single<(&mut Text, &mut TextColor, &mut UiTransform), With<Delta>>,
    mut edge: Single<&mut Edge, With<MoneyEdge>>,
    mut slots: Query<(Entity, &Status, &mut Opens, &Children)>,
    mut images: Query<&mut ImageNode>,
    mut sounds: MessageWriter<UiSound>,
    mut commands: Commands,
) {
    let alive = w.client.vitals.alive() && w.client.id().is_some();
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    let money = w.client.me_info.money;
    panel.set_if_neq(if w.client.practice { Visibility::Hidden } else { Visibility::Inherited });
    count.target = money as f32;
    match *last {
        Some((before, _, _)) if before != money => {
            *last = Some((money, now, money - before));
            edge.flare();
        }
        None => *last = Some((money, -10.0, 0)),
        _ => {}
    }
    // the change: in from below, held, then up and out
    let (_, at, d) = last.unwrap_or((0, -10.0, 0));
    let (text, color, tr) = delta.into_inner();
    let t = (now - at) / T_DELTA;
    if (0.0..1.0).contains(&t) && d != 0 {
        let mut text = text;
        set(&mut text, if d > 0 { format!("+{d}") } else { format!("−{}", -d) });
        let (y, a) = if t < 0.15 { (8.0 * (1.0 - t / 0.15), t / 0.15) } else if t < 0.7 { (0.0, 1.0) } else { (-10.0 * (t - 0.7) / 0.3, 1.0 - (t - 0.7) / 0.3) };
        color.into_inner().0 = if d > 0 { OK } else { TX2 }.with_alpha(a);
        tr.into_inner().translation = Val2::new(px(0), vh(y));
    } else {
        let mut text = text;
        set(&mut text, String::new());
    }
    // what you need to act on: kit, bomb (red in a site), buy zone
    let l = &w.client.state.loadout;
    let in_site = w.client.world.zones.in_bomb_site(w.client.me().origin);
    for (e, s, mut o, kids) in &mut slots {
        let want = alive
            && match s {
                Status::Kit => w.client.me_info.defuse_kit,
                Status::Bomb => l.c4,
                Status::Buy => w.client.me_info.can_buy,
            };
        if o.open != want {
            o.open = want;
            if want {
                commands.entity(e).insert(Anim::burst());
            }
            sounds.write(if want { UiSound::On } else { UiSound::Off });
        }
        if *s == Status::Bomb {
            for k in kids {
                if let Ok(mut img) = images.get_mut(*k) {
                    let c = if in_site { BAD } else { TX1 };
                    if img.color != c {
                        img.color = c;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`client/src/round_hud/news.rs`:

```rs
//! Round announcements in the upper middle (design/mockups/ui `announce`): the headline, a
//! short rule in the side's colour, and a readable line under it. Each one tunes in and,
//! after a few seconds, tunes out. Low middle: plant and defuse progress.
use super::{abs, set, shadow, side_color, side_name, RoundNews};
use crate::game::Walker;
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::ui::{kit_text, meter, vh, Anim, Kit, Meter, BAD, TX1};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use net::protocol::{BombNet, GameEvent, Team};
use net::rounds::EndReason;

/// How long an announcement stays.
const HOLD: f32 = 4.0;

#[derive(Component)]
pub(super) struct NewsRoot;
/// The announcement on screen, and when it came.
#[derive(Component)]
pub(super) struct Shown(f32);
#[derive(Component)]
pub(super) struct Bar;
#[derive(Component)]
pub(super) struct BarMeter;
#[derive(Component)]
pub(super) struct BarLabel;

pub(super) fn spawn(mut commands: Commands, kit: Res<Kit>) {
    commands.spawn((NewsRoot, crate::hud::Visor, DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame), abs(Node { width: percent(100), top: percent(26), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() })));
    // Plant / defuse progress, low middle.
    commands
        .spawn((Bar, crate::hud::Visor, DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame), Visibility::Hidden, abs(Node { width: percent(100), bottom: percent(24), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() })))
        .with_children(|col| {
            col.spawn((BarLabel, kit_text("", 16.0, TX1, &kit.text), shadow()));
            let m = meter(col, 320.0, TX1, 0.0);
            col.commands().entity(m).insert(BarMeter);
        });
}

/// What to announce for an event: headline, the line under it, the colour.
fn words(e: &GameEvent, w: &Walker) -> Option<(String, String, Color)> {
    let name = |id: u8| w.client.scores.iter().find(|s| s.id == id).map(|s| (s.name.clone(), s.team));
    Some(match e {
        GameEvent::RoundEnd { winner, reason } => {
            let why = match reason {
                EndReason::Eliminated => "Enemy eliminated",
                EndReason::BombExploded => "Target bombed",
                EndReason::BombDefused => "The bomb has been defused",
                EndReason::TimeUp => "Target saved",
            };
            (format!("{} win", side_name(*winner)), why.into(), side_color(*winner))
        }
        GameEvent::MatchOver { winner } => {
            let r = w.client.round.score;
            match winner {
                Some(t) => (format!("{} win the match", side_name(*t)), format!("{} to {}", r[0].max(r[1]), r[0].min(r[1])), side_color(*t)),
                None => ("Draw".into(), format!("{} to {}", r[0], r[1]), TX1),
            }
        }
        GameEvent::SidesSwapped => ("Switching sides".into(), "Halftime".into(), TX1),
        GameEvent::RoundStart { round: 1 } => ("Match started".into(), "Good luck, have fun".into(), TX1),
        GameEvent::BombPlanted { .. } => ("The bomb has been planted".into(), "Forty seconds".into(), BAD),
        GameEvent::Surrendered { team } => {
            let other = if *team == Team::Ct { Team::T } else { Team::Ct };
            (format!("{} surrendered", side_name(*team)), format!("{} win the match", side_name(other)), side_color(*team))
        }
        GameEvent::KillLimit { player } => {
            let (who, team) = name(*player)?;
            (format!("{who} reached 100 kills"), "Scores start over".into(), side_color(team))
        }
        GameEvent::VotedOut { player } => {
            let (who, team) = name(*player)?;
            let left = w.client.scores.iter().filter(|s| s.team == team && s.id != *player).count();
            (format!("{who} was voted out"), format!("{} plays on with {left}", side_name(team)), side_color(team))
        }
        _ => return None,
    })
}

/// A new announcement replaces the one up; one held long enough tunes out.
pub(super) fn news(mut commands: Commands, mut msgs: MessageReader<RoundNews>, time: Res<Time>, w: Res<Walker>, kit: Res<Kit>, root: Single<Entity, With<NewsRoot>>, shown: Query<(Entity, &Shown)>) {
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    let mut fresh = None;
    for RoundNews(e) in msgs.read() {
        if let Some(words) = words(e, &w) {
            fresh = Some(words);
        }
    }
    let leave = |commands: &mut Commands, e: Entity| {
        commands.entity(e).remove::<Shown>().insert(Anim::tune_out());
    };
    if let Some((head, sub, color)) = fresh {
        for (e, _) in &shown {
            leave(&mut commands, e);
        }
        commands.entity(*root).with_children(|col| {
            col.spawn((Shown(now), Anim::tune_in(0.0), Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, row_gap: vh(10.0), ..default() })).with_children(|a| {
                a.spawn((kit_text(head.to_uppercase(), 52.0, TX1, &kit.display), shadow()));
                a.spawn((Node { width: vh(72.0), height: vh(3.0), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(px(2)), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(color), BoxShadow(vec![ShadowStyle { color: color.with_alpha(0.6), x_offset: px(0), y_offset: px(0), spread_radius: px(0), blur_radius: vh(10.0) }])));
                if !sub.is_empty() {
                    a.spawn((kit_text(sub, 20.0, TX1, &kit.text), shadow()));
                }
            });
        });
        return;
    }
    for (e, s) in &shown {
        if now - s.0 > HOLD {
            leave(&mut commands, e);
        }
    }
}

/// Planting (your own) or defusing (anyone you see) progress.
#[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]
pub(super) fn progress(w: Res<Walker>, mut bar: Single<&mut Visibility, With<Bar>>, mut m: Single<&mut Meter, With<BarMeter>>, mut label: Single<&mut Text, With<BarLabel>>, mut defuse_total: Local<f32>) {
    let me = w.client.id();
    let l = &w.client.state.loadout;
    let mut shown: Option<(String, f32)> = None;
    if let Some(start) = l.planting {
        // Own command clock (input number x tick), as the weapon code counts it.
        let elapsed = w.client.cmd_time() - start;
        shown = Some(("Planting the bomb".into(), (elapsed / sim::weapons::C4_PLANT_TIME) as f32));
    }
    if let BombNet::Planted { defuse: Some((id, left)), .. } = w.client.bomb {
        if *defuse_total < left {
            *defuse_total = left; // the first we hear of it is close to the full time
        }
        let who = if Some(id) == me { "Defusing the bomb".to_string() } else { "Bomb being defused".to_string() };
        shown = Some((who, 1.0 - left / defuse_total.max(0.01)));
    } else {
        *defuse_total = 0.0;
    }
    bar.set_if_neq(if shown.is_some() { Visibility::Inherited } else { Visibility::Hidden });
    if let Some((s, f)) = shown {
        set(&mut label, s);
        m.value = f.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    }
}
```

`client/src/scoreboard.rs`:

```rs
//! The scoreboard (hold Tab): match line, the round-history strip (who won each round and how),
//! then one block per side with its colour bar, name and rounds won, and a row per player.
//! Your row has the amber bar; dead players are dimmed. It tunes in when Tab goes down and out

pub struct ScoreboardPlugin;

    }

#[derive(Component)]
struct ScoresRoot;

/// While Tab is held: whether the mouse is free (right-click), and whose report menu is open.
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct ScoreMouse {
    pub on: bool,
    open: Option<u8>,
}

/// The round you last called a kick vote in (one per round).
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
struct Kicked(Option<u32>);

/// Who you reported this match.
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
struct Reported(HashSet<u8>);

fn mouse(keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>, buttons: Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>, binds: Res<crate::binds::Binds>, mut m: ResMut<ScoreMouse>, mut cursor: Single<&mut CursorOptions>) {
    if binds.held(crate::binds::Action::Scores, &keys, &buttons) {
        if buttons.just_pressed(MouseButton::Right) {
            m.on = !m.on;
            cursor.grab_mode = if m.on { CursorGrabMode::None } else { CursorGrabMode::Locked };
            cursor.visible = m.on;
        }
    } else if m.on || m.open.is_some() {
        *m = ScoreMouse::default();
        cursor.grab_mode = CursorGrabMode::Locked;
        cursor.visible = false;
    }
}

fn report_actions(mut actions: ResMut<UiActions>, mut m: ResMut<ScoreMouse>, mut reported: ResMut<Reported>, mut kicked: ResMut<Kicked>, mut w: ResMut<Walker>, mut voice: ResMut<crate::voice::VoiceSettings>) {
    actions.0.retain(|a| match a {
        UiAction::Mute(name) => {
            let g = voice.player_gain(name);
            voice.set_player_gain(name, if g == 0.0 { 1.0 } else { 0.0 });
            false
        }
        UiAction::PlayerVolume(name, d) => {
            let g = voice.player_gain(name);
            voice.set_player_gain(name, g + d);
            false
        }
        UiAction::Kick(id) => {
            w.client.call_kick(*id);
            kicked.0 = Some(w.client.round.round);
            m.open = None;
            false
        }
        UiAction::ReportMenu(id) => {
            m.open = if m.open == Some(*id) { None } else { Some(*id) };
            false
        }
        UiAction::Report(id, reason) => {
            w.client.report(*id, *reason);
            reported.0.insert(*id);
            m.open = None;
            false
        }
        _ => true,
    });
}

/// Slots in the strip: a full regulation match (first to 13).
const SLOTS: usize = 24;

/// The stat columns after the name (which grows): label and width at 1080p. Money is only
/// known for your own team (blank for the other).
const COLS: [(&str, f32); 8] = [("K", 56.0), ("D", 56.0), ("A", 56.0), ("ADR", 72.0), ("HS%", 72.0), ("MVP", 64.0), ("$", 96.0), ("PING", 72.0)];

type Shown = (Vec<Score>, [u32; 2], usize, bool, Option<u8>, usize);

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn scoreboard(mut commands: Commands, (keys, buttons, binds): (Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>, Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>, Res<crate::binds::Binds>), w: Res<Walker>, kit: Res<Kit>, icons: Res<Icons>, m: Res<ScoreMouse>, (reported, kicked, voice): (Res<Reported>, Res<Kicked>, Res<crate::voice::VoiceSettings>), roots: Query<Entity, With<ScoresRoot>>, mut shown: Local<Option<Shown>>) {
    let auto_show = std::env::var_os("BOOTLEG16_SCORES").is_some();
    let want = (binds.held(crate::binds::Action::Scores, &keys, &buttons) || auto_show).then(|| (w.client.scores.clone(), w.client.round.score, w.client.round_history.len(), m.on, m.open, reported.0.len()));
    // a voice volume changed: redraw too
    if *shown == want && !voice.is_changed() {
        return;
    }
    let opening = shown.is_none();
    *shown = want.clone();
    for e in &roots {
        if want.is_none() {
            commands.entity(e).remove::<(ScoresRoot, Blurs)>().insert(Anim::tune_out());
        } else {
            commands.entity(e).despawn();
        }
    }
    let Some((scores, won, ..)) = want else { return };
    let me = w.client.id();
    let r = &w.client.round;
    let line = if w.client.practice { "PRACTICE".to_string() } else { format!("ROUND {}", r.round.max(1)) };
    // kicking: teammates, reserved matches, one call per round, not while a vote runs
    let can_kick = m.on && w.client.ticket != 0 && kicked.0 != Some(r.round) && r.vote.is_none();
    let ctx = Ctx { me, my_team: w.client.team(), carrier: match w.client.bomb { net::protocol::BombNet::Carried(id) => Some(id), _ => None }, my_kit: w.client.me_info.defuse_kit, can_report: m.on && !w.client.practice, can_report_or_mouse: m.on, can_kick, open: m.open, reported: &reported.0, voice: &voice };
    let tune = |i: usize| opening.then(|| Anim::stagger(i));
    commands
        .spawn((
            ScoresRoot,
            DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame),
            Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), height: percent(100), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, padding: UiRect::top(vh(160.0)), ..default() },
            Blurs(0.85),
            GlobalZIndex(7),
        ))
        .with_children(|root| {
            root.spawn(Node { width: vh(1200.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() }).with_children(|col| {
                let mut head = col.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() });
                if let Some(a) = tune(0) {
                    head.insert(a);
                }
                head.with_children(|h| {
                    h.spawn((kit_text(format!("SCOREBOARD · {line}"), 13.0, TX2, &kit.text), Node { flex_grow: 1.0, ..default() }));
                    if !w.client.practice {
                        h.spawn(kit_text(if m.on { "CLICK A PLAYER: VOICE, REPORT · RIGHT-CLICK TO LOCK THE MOUSE" } else { "RIGHT-CLICK TO USE THE MOUSE" }, 13.0, TX3, &kit.text));
                    }
                });
                if !w.client.practice {
                    let mut s = col.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() });
                    if let Some(a) = tune(1) {
                        s.insert(a);
                    }
                    s.with_children(|s| strip(s, &icons, &w.client.round_history));
                }
                // Rounds won: [terrorists, counter-terrorists].
                for (i, (team, name, jp, color, rounds)) in [(Team::Ct, "Bureau", "ビューロー", CT_COLOR, won[1]), (Team::T, "Strays", "ストレイズ", T_COLOR, won[0])].into_iter().enumerate() {
                    let players: Vec<&Score> = scores.iter().filter(|s| s.team == team).collect();
                    let mut b = col.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() });
                    if let Some(a) = tune(2 + i) {
                        b.insert(a);
                    }
                    b.with_children(|b| team_block(b, &kit, name, jp, color, rounds, &players, &ctx));
                }
                let specs: Vec<&str> = scores.iter().filter(|s| s.team == Team::Spectator).map(|s| s.name.as_str()).collect();
                if !specs.is_empty() {
                    col.spawn((kit_text(format!("SPECTATORS · {}", specs.join(", ")), 13.0, TX3, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(24.0)), ..default() }));
                }
            });
        });
}

/// What a row needs to know beyond its player.
struct Ctx<'a> {
    me: Option<u8>,
    my_team: Team,
    carrier: Option<u8>,
    my_kit: bool,
    can_report: bool,
    /// The mouse is free (the row menu can open).
    can_report_or_mouse: bool,
    can_kick: bool,
    open: Option<u8>,
    reported: &'a HashSet<u8>,
    voice: &'a crate::voice::VoiceSettings,
}

/// One team: header bar (side colour, name, rounds won), column labels, then the players.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn team_block(col: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, name: &str, jp: &str, color: Color, rounds: u32, players: &[&Score], ctx: &Ctx) {
    col.spawn((Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(32.0)), align_items: AlignItems::Stretch, border: UiRect::left(vh(BAR)), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(BG1), BorderColor::all(color))).with_children(|h| {
        h.spawn(Node { flex_grow: 1.0, align_items: AlignItems::Baseline, column_gap: vh(16.0), padding: UiRect::axes(vh(24.0), vh(14.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|t| {
            t.spawn(kit_text(name.to_uppercase(), 40.0, TX1, &kit.display));
            t.spawn(kit_text(jp, 13.0, TX3, &kit.jp));
            t.spawn(kit_text(match players.len() { 1 => "1 PLAYER".to_string(), n => format!("{n} PLAYERS") }, 13.0, TX2, &kit.text));
        });
        h.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Center, padding: UiRect::horizontal(vh(24.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|n| {
            n.spawn(kit_text(format!("{rounds:02}"), 32.0, color, &kit.num));
        });
    });
    header(col, kit);
    if players.is_empty() {
        col.spawn((Node { height: vh(48.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, padding: UiRect::left(vh(120.0)), border: UiRect::top(px(1)), ..default() }, BorderColor::all(LINE))).with_children(|r| {
            r.spawn(kit_text("No one on this side yet", 16.0, TX3, &kit.text));
        });
    }
    for s in players {
        player_row(col, kit, s, ctx);
    }
}

fn header(col: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit) {
    col.spawn(Node { height: vh(36.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, padding: UiRect::horizontal(vh(24.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
        r.spawn(Node { width: vh(96.0), ..default() });
        r.spawn((kit_text("PLAYER", 13.0, TX2, &kit.text), Node { flex_grow: 1.0, ..default() }));
        for (c, w) in COLS {
            r.spawn((kit_text(c, 13.0, TX2, &kit.text), Node { width: vh(w), justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexEnd, ..default() }));
        }
    });
}

/// One player: status tag, name, kills, deaths. Yours has the amber bar. With the mouse free,
/// other players' rows open the report menu under them.
fn player_row(col: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, s: &Score, ctx: &Ctx) {
    let mine = Some(s.id) == ctx.me;
    let c = if !s.alive { TX3 } else { TX1 };
    // Status: dead, carrying the bomb (only your own team is told), your kit, a bot.
    let (tag, tag_color) = if !s.alive {
        ("DEAD", TX3)
    } else if ctx.carrier == Some(s.id) {
        ("C4", T_COLOR)
    } else if mine && ctx.my_kit {
        ("KIT", CT_COLOR)
    } else if s.bot {
        ("BOT", TX3)
    } else {
        ("", TX3)
    };
    let reported = ctx.reported.contains(&s.id);
    let gain = ctx.voice.player_gain(&s.name);
    let base = if mine { BG1.mix(&AMBER, 0.08) } else { Color::NONE };
    // your bar sits inside the padding, so every row's content lines up
    let node = Node { height: vh(48.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, padding: UiRect { left: vh(if mine { 24.0 - BAR } else { 24.0 }), right: vh(24.0), ..default() }, border: UiRect { left: vh(if mine { BAR } else { 0.0 }), top: px(1), ..default() }, ..default() };
    let mut e = col.spawn((node, BorderColor { left: AMBER, top: LINE, ..BorderColor::all(Color::NONE) }, BackgroundColor(base)));
    e.with_children(|r| {
        r.spawn((Node { width: vh(96.0), ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE)).with_children(|t| {
            if !tag.is_empty() {
                crate::ui::status_label(t, kit, tag, tag_color);
            }
        });
        r.spawn((kit_text(&s.name, 19.0, c, &kit.text), Node { flex_grow: 1.0, ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE));
        if gain == 0.0 {
            r.spawn((kit_text("MUTED", 13.0, TX3, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::right(vh(16.0)), ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE));
        }
        if reported {
            r.spawn((kit_text("REPORTED", 13.0, TX3, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::right(vh(16.0)), ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE));
        }
        let pct = |n: u32, of: i32| if of > 0 { format!("{}", n * 100 / of as u32) } else { "0".into() };
        let values = [
            s.kills.to_string(),
            s.deaths.to_string(),
            s.assists.to_string(),
            (s.damage / s.rounds.max(1)).to_string(),
            pct(s.headshots, s.kills),
            s.mvps.to_string(),
            s.money.map(|m| format!("${m}")).unwrap_or_default(),
            if s.bot { String::new() } else { s.ping.to_string() },
        ];
        for (v, (_, w)) in values.into_iter().zip(COLS) {
            r.spawn((kit_text(v, 18.0, c, &kit.num), Node { width: vh(w), justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexEnd, ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE));
        }
    });
    let report = ctx.can_report && !mine && !s.bot && !reported;
    let kick = ctx.can_kick && !mine && !s.bot && s.team == ctx.my_team;
    // their voice: mute or set how loud (people only)
    let voice = ctx.can_report_or_mouse && !mine && !s.bot;
    if report || kick || voice {
        clickable(&mut e, UiAction::ReportMenu(s.id), base, false);
    }
    if ctx.open == Some(s.id) {
        col.spawn((Node { height: vh(56.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, column_gap: vh(8.0), padding: UiRect::left(vh(120.0)), ..default() }, Anim::tune_in(0.0))).with_children(|m| {
            if voice {
                m.spawn((kit_text("VOICE", 13.0, TX2, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::right(vh(8.0)), ..default() }));
                chip(m, kit, if gain == 0.0 { "Unmute" } else { "Mute" }, UiAction::Mute(s.name.clone()), gain == 0.0);
                chip(m, kit, "−", UiAction::PlayerVolume(s.name.clone(), -0.25), false);
                m.spawn((kit_text(format!("{:.0}%", gain * 100.0), 16.0, TX1, &kit.num), Node { width: vh(56.0), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, ..default() }));
                chip(m, kit, "+", UiAction::PlayerVolume(s.name.clone(), 0.25), false);
                m.spawn((Node { width: px(1), height: vh(28.0), margin: UiRect::horizontal(vh(8.0)), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(LINE)));
            }
            if report {
                m.spawn((kit_text(format!("REPORT {} FOR", s.name.to_uppercase()), 13.0, TX2, &kit.text), Node { margin: UiRect::right(vh(8.0)), ..default() }));
                for (label, reason) in [("Cheating", ReportReason::Cheating), ("Griefing", ReportReason::Griefing), ("Abuse", ReportReason::Abuse)] {
                    chip(m, kit, label, UiAction::Report(s.id, reason), false);
                }
            }
            if kick {
                // apart from the reports: it's a team vote, not a review
                m.spawn((Node { width: px(1), height: vh(28.0), margin: UiRect::horizontal(vh(8.0)), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(LINE)));
                chip(m, kit, "Vote to kick", UiAction::Kick(s.id), false);
            }
            chip(m, kit, "Cancel", UiAction::ReportMenu(s.id), false);
        });
    }
}

/// One slot per round: tinted by the winner with an icon for how it ended; the round
/// being played has an amber outline; future rounds are empty frames.
fn strip(col: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, icons: &Icons, rounds: &[(Team, EndReason)]) {
    col.spawn(Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(16.0)), column_gap: vh(4.0), ..default() }).with_children(|row| {
        for i in 0..SLOTS {
            let slot = Node { flex_grow: 1.0, flex_basis: px(0), height: vh(40.0), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() };
            match rounds.get(i) {
                Some(&(winner, reason)) => {
                    let c = if winner == Team::Ct { CT_COLOR } else { T_COLOR };
                    let icon = match reason {
                        EndReason::Eliminated => "d_skull",
                        EndReason::BombExploded => "c4",
                        EndReason::BombDefused => "defuser",
                        EndReason::TimeUp => "stopwatch",
                    };
                    row.spawn((Node { border: UiRect::bottom(vh(BAR)), ..slot }, BackgroundColor(BG1), BorderColor::all(c))).with_children(|s| {
                        s.spawn(icons.node(icon, 24.0, c));
                    });
                }
                None if i == rounds.len() => {
                    row.spawn((Node { border: UiRect::all(vh(2.0)), ..slot }, BorderColor::all(AMBER)));
                }
                None => {
                    row.spawn((Node { border: UiRect::all(px(1)), ..slot }, BorderColor::all(LINE)));
                }
            }
        }
    });
}
```
