`client/src/sky.rs`:

```rs
//! The map's skybox (worldspawn `skyname`, six TGAs in gfx/env) instead of a flat colour.
use crate::game::FlyCam;
use crate::menu::AppState;
use bevy::light::Skybox;
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::render::render_resource::{Extent3d, TextureDimension, TextureFormat, TextureViewDescriptor, TextureViewDimension};

pub struct SkyPlugin;

impl Plugin for SkyPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(Update, add_sky.run_if(in_state(AppState::InGame)));
    }
}

/// GoldSrc's six faces, in the engine's order (gl_warp.c): rt +X, lf -X, bk +Y, ft -Y, up +Z, dn -Z.
const FACES: [&str; 6] = ["rt", "lf", "bk", "ft", "up", "dn"];

/// Read one face, case-insensitively (maps say "Des", files are "Desbk.tga"), from the game data folder.
fn face(sky: &str, suffix: &str) -> Option<goldsrc::tga::Tga> {
    let want = format!("{sky}{suffix}.tga").to_ascii_lowercase();
    for dir in crate::gamefiles::paths("gfx/env") {
        let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else { continue };
        for e in entries.flatten() {
            if e.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_ascii_lowercase() == want {
                return goldsrc::tga::decode(&std::fs::read(e.path()).ok()?);
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

/// Where a GoldSrc direction lands on the six faces: (face, s, t) with s, t in -1..1, using
/// the engine's face axes (Quake's `st_to_vec`): sides have t up, s to the right as seen from inside.
fn goldsrc_face(g: [f32; 3]) -> (usize, f32, f32) {
    let [x, y, z] = g;
    let (ax, ay, az) = (x.abs(), y.abs(), z.abs());
    if ax >= ay && ax >= az {
        if x > 0.0 { (0, -y / ax, z / ax) } else { (1, y / ax, z / ax) }
    } else if ay >= az {
        if y > 0.0 { (2, x / ay, z / ay) } else { (3, -x / ay, z / ay) }
    } else if z > 0.0 {
        (4, -y / az, -x / az)
    } else {
        (5, -y / az, x / az)
    }
}

/// The six faces resampled into one cubemap. For every cubemap texel: its direction (WebGPU
/// cube layout, our Y-up space), back to GoldSrc space, and the GoldSrc face pixel there.
fn cubemap(sky: &str) -> Option<Image> {
    let faces: Vec<goldsrc::tga::Tga> = FACES.iter().map(|s| face(sky, s)).collect::<Option<_>>()?;
    let n = faces[0].width as usize;
    if faces.iter().any(|f| f.width as usize != n || f.height as usize != n) {
        return None;
    }
    let mut data = Vec::with_capacity(n * n * 4 * 6);
    for cube in 0..6 {
        for j in 0..n {
            for i in 0..n {
                let u = 2.0 * (i as f32 + 0.5) / n as f32 - 1.0;
                let v = 2.0 * (j as f32 + 0.5) / n as f32 - 1.0;
                let d = match cube {
                    0 => [1.0, -v, -u],
                    1 => [-1.0, -v, u],
                    2 => [u, 1.0, v],
                    3 => [u, -1.0, -v],
                    4 => [u, -v, 1.0],
                    _ => [-u, -v, -1.0],
                };
                // Y-up (x, y, z) is GoldSrc (x, -z, y).
                let (f, s, t) = goldsrc_face([d[0], -d[2], d[1]]);
                let px = (((s + 1.0) * 0.5) * (n - 1) as f32).round() as usize;
                let py = (((1.0 - t) * 0.5) * (n - 1) as f32).round() as usize;
                let k = (py.min(n - 1) * n + px.min(n - 1)) * 4;
                data.extend_from_slice(&faces[f].rgba[k..k + 4]);
            }
        }
    }
    let n = n as u32;
    let mut img = Image::new(Extent3d { width: n, height: n, depth_or_array_layers: 6 }, TextureDimension::D2, data, TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb, default());
    img.texture_view_descriptor = Some(TextureViewDescriptor { dimension: Some(TextureViewDimension::Cube), ..default() });
    Some(img)
}

/// Once the camera exists: give it the map's sky.
fn add_sky(mut commands: Commands, cams: Query<Entity, Added<FlyCam>>, map: Res<crate::loading::MapData>, mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>) {
    for cam in &cams {
        let sky = Some(&map.bsp)
            .and_then(|b| b.entity_list().into_iter().find(|e| e.get("classname").map(String::as_str) == Some("worldspawn"))?.get("skyname").cloned())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "desert".into());
        match cubemap(&sky) {
            Some(img) => {
                // Brightness 1: with our exposure the texture shows as it is, like the walls.
                commands.entity(cam).insert(Skybox { image: Some(images.add(img)), brightness: 1.0, ..default() });
            }
            None => warn!("sky {sky}: faces missing"),
        }
    }
}
```

`client/src/smoke.rs`:

```rs
//! Smoke clouds drawn like CS: a cluster of soft grey sprite puffs that billow out over the
//! first second and a half, drift a little, and thin out over the last three seconds.
//! (The server also treats them as blocking sight: server/visibility.rs.)
use crate::game::{FlyCam, Frame, Walker};
use crate::level::rgba_image;
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::{map, sound};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::render::render_resource::TextureFormat;

pub struct SmokePlugin;

impl Plugin for SmokePlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(Startup, load).add_systems(Update, (clouds, puffs).chain().in_set(Frame::World));
    }
}

/// Puffs per cloud, and how far they reach from its middle (GoldSrc units).
const PUFFS: usize = 30;
const SPREAD: f32 = 120.0;
const PUFF_SIZE: f32 = 110.0;
/// Seconds to billow out, and to fade at the end.
const BLOOM: f32 = 1.5;
const FADE: f32 = 3.0;

#[derive(Resource)]
struct Looks {
    quad: Handle<Mesh>,
    puff: Handle<Image>,
}

/// A soft round puff: grey, alpha falling off smoothly to the edge, a little lumpy.
fn puff_image(n: u32) -> Image {
    let mut px = Vec::with_capacity((n * n * 4) as usize);
    let c = n as f32 / 2.0;
    for y in 0..n {
        for x in 0..n {
            let (dx, dy) = (x as f32 + 0.5 - c, y as f32 + 0.5 - c);
            let ang = dy.atan2(dx);
            let lump = 1.0 + 0.08 * (ang * 5.0).sin() + 0.05 * (ang * 9.0 + 2.0).cos();
            let r = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt() / c / lump;
            let a = (1.0 - r).clamp(0.0, 1.0).powf(1.6);
            let g = (200.0 + 25.0 * (1.0 - r)) as u8;
            px.extend_from_slice(&[g, g, g, (a * 255.0) as u8]);
        }
    }
    rgba_image(n, n, px, false, TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb)
}

fn load(mut commands: Commands, mut meshes: ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>, mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>) {
    commands.insert_resource(Looks { quad: meshes.add(Rectangle::new(1.0, 1.0)), puff: images.add(puff_image(64)) });
}

/// One cloud, keyed by where it popped.
#[derive(Component)]
struct Cloud([i32; 3]);

/// One puff: where it settles relative to the cloud, its size, drift and spin.
#[derive(Component)]
struct Puff {
    home: Vec3,
    size: f32,
    drift: Vec3,
    spin: f32,
    material: Handle<StandardMaterial>,
}

/// Spawn clouds that appeared, remove ones that are gone.
fn clouds(mut commands: Commands, mut w: ResMut<Walker>, looks: Res<Looks>, mut materials: ResMut<Assets<StandardMaterial>>, existing: Query<(Entity, &Cloud)>) {
    let key = |at: [f32; 3]| at.map(|v| v.round() as i32);
    let live: Vec<_> = w.client.smokes.iter().map(|s| (key(s.at), *s)).collect();
    for (e, c) in &existing {
        if !live.iter().any(|(k, _)| *k == c.0) {
            commands.entity(e).despawn();
        }
    }
    for (k, smoke) in live {
        if existing.iter().any(|(_, c)| c.0 == k) {
            continue;
        }
        if smoke.left > sim::grenades::SMOKE_SECONDS as f32 - 1.0 {
            w.cues.push(sound::Cue::Smoke { at: smoke.at }); // just popped (not one we joined late)
        }
        let centre = Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(smoke.at));
        let parent = commands.spawn((Cloud(k), Transform::from_translation(centre), Visibility::default(), DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame))).id();
        // Deterministic scatter (golden-angle spiral, layered upwards) so every client sees the same cloud.
        for i in 0..PUFFS {
            let f = i as f32;
            let a = f * 2.399_963;
            let r = SPREAD * (0.25 + 0.75 * ((f + 0.5) / PUFFS as f32).sqrt());
            let home = Vec3::new(a.cos() * r, 25.0 + (i % 5) as f32 * 28.0 + (f * 0.37).sin() * 10.0, a.sin() * r * 0.9);
            let material = materials.add(StandardMaterial { base_color_texture: Some(looks.puff.clone()), unlit: true, alpha_mode: AlphaMode::Blend, ..default() });
            let puff = Puff {
                home,
                size: PUFF_SIZE * (0.8 + 0.4 * ((f * 1.7).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5)),
                drift: Vec3::new((f * 0.9).sin(), 0.3, (f * 1.3).cos()) * 6.0,
                spin: ((f * 2.3).sin()) * 0.15,
                material: material.clone(),
            };
            let child = commands.spawn((puff, Mesh3d(looks.quad.clone()), MeshMaterial3d(material), Transform::from_scale(Vec3::ZERO))).id();
            commands.entity(parent).add_child(child);
        }
    }
}

/// Grow, drift and fade each puff, always facing the camera.
fn puffs(
    w: Res<Walker>,
    time: Res<Time>,
    cam: Single<&GlobalTransform, With<FlyCam>>,
    clouds: Query<(&Cloud, &Children)>,
    mut puffs: Query<(&Puff, &mut Transform)>,
    mut materials: ResMut<Assets<StandardMaterial>>,
) {
    let t = time.elapsed_secs();
    let cam_rot = cam.compute_transform().rotation;
    for (cloud, children) in &clouds {
        let Some(s) = w.client.smokes.iter().find(|s| s.at.map(|v| v.round() as i32) == cloud.0) else { continue };
        let age = sim::grenades::SMOKE_SECONDS as f32 - s.left;
        let grow = (age / BLOOM).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let grow = 1.0 - (1.0 - grow).powi(3); // fast out, settles gently
        let alpha = 0.9 * (s.left / FADE).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        for c in children {
            let Ok((p, mut tf)) = puffs.get_mut(*c) else { continue };
            tf.translation = p.home * grow + p.drift * (age * 0.3).min(4.0);
            tf.rotation = cam_rot * Quat::from_rotation_z(p.spin * t);
            tf.scale = Vec3::splat(p.size * (0.3 + 0.7 * grow));
            if let Some(mut m) = materials.get_mut(&p.material) {
                if (m.base_color.alpha() - alpha).abs() > 0.01 {
                    m.base_color.set_alpha(alpha);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`client/src/sound.rs`:

```rs
//! Sound from the install's WAV files: GoldSrc-style distance falloff, panned by
//! direction, random pitch like CS's gunshots.
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::map;
use crate::menu::Settings;
use bevy::audio::{PlaybackSettings, Volume};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use goldsrc::materials::Materials;
use sim::grenades::Kind;
use sim::weapons::Id;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;

/// GoldSrc attenuations: how fast a sound fades with distance (silent at 1000/attn units).
pub const ATTN_NORM: f32 = 0.8;
const ATTN_FAR: f32 = 0.3;

/// Something that should make a sound this frame.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub enum Cue {
    /// `at` None = our own (heard in the head, not positioned).
    Shot { weapon: Id, silenced: bool, at: Option<[f32; 3]> },
    /// `who` None = our own (heard in the head).
    Footstep { feet: [f32; 3], who: Option<u8>, step: sim::pmove::Step },
    Hit { sound: net::protocol::HitSound, at: Option<[f32; 3]> },
    Death { at: Option<[f32; 3]> },
    Explosion { at: [f32; 3] },
    Flash { at: [f32; 3] },
    Smoke { at: [f32; 3] },
    Bounce { kind: Kind, at: [f32; 3] },
    /// A breakable broke (`CBreakable::Die`: one of two sounds, pitch 95-124 (97-103 = 100),
    /// volume 0.85-1).
    Break { material: sim::breakables::Material, at: [f32; 3] },
    /// A bullet hit the map here: its material's sound, and half the time a ricochet.
    Impact { at: [f32; 3], normal: [f32; 3] },
    DryFire { pistol: bool },
    Swing,
    Zoom,
    /// A sound file named by a view model animation event (reloads, draws, pins).
    File(String),
    /// A sound file played somewhere at this volume (ATTN_NORM).
    Quiet { file: &'static str, at: [f32; 3], volume: f32 },
    /// A sound file played somewhere in the world; `far`: carries across the map (the bomb).
    At { file: &'static str, at: [f32; 3], far: bool },
}

#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct Sounds {
    /// Where sounds are looked for (the game data folder).
    dirs: Vec<PathBuf>,
    cache: HashMap<String, Option<Handle<AudioSource>>>,
    materials: Materials,
    /// Cheap per-sound randomness (pitch, variant picks); doesn't need to be deterministic.
    rng: u64,
    /// Whose next footstep is the left foot (None: ours).
    left_foot: HashMap<Option<u8>, bool>,
}

impl Sounds {
    pub fn new() -> Sounds {
        let materials = crate::gamefiles::paths("sound/materials.txt").iter().find_map(|p| std::fs::read_to_string(p).ok()).ok_or(()).map(|t| Materials::parse(&t)).unwrap_or_default();
        Sounds { dirs: crate::gamefiles::paths("sound"), cache: HashMap::new(), materials, rng: 0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D, left_foot: HashMap::new() }
    }

    fn rand(&mut self) -> f32 {
        self.rng ^= self.rng << 13;
        self.rng ^= self.rng >> 7;
        self.rng ^= self.rng << 17;
        (self.rng % 10_000) as f32 / 10_000.0
    }

    fn pick(&mut self, options: &[&str]) -> String {
        options[((self.rand() * options.len() as f32) as usize).min(options.len() - 1)].to_string()
    }

    pub fn get(&mut self, file: &str, assets: &mut Assets<AudioSource>) -> Option<Handle<AudioSource>> {
        if let Some(h) = self.cache.get(file) {
            return h.clone();
        }
        let h = self.dirs.iter().find_map(|d| std::fs::read(d.join(net::gamefiles::clean(file))).ok()).map(|bytes| assets.add(AudioSource { bytes: bytes.into() }));
        if h.is_none() {
            warn!("missing sound {file}");
        }
        self.cache.insert(file.to_string(), h.clone());
        h
    }
}

/// The firing sound for a weapon (CS picks between variants where there are two; volume 1,
/// attenuation `fire_attenuation`, pitch 94..109%: `EV_Fire*` in client.so).
fn fire_sound(id: Id, silenced: bool) -> &'static [&'static str] {
    use Id::*;
    match id {
        Ak47 => &["weapons/ak47-1.wav", "weapons/ak47-2.wav"],
        Awp => &["weapons/awp1.wav"],
        Deagle => &["weapons/deagle-1.wav", "weapons/deagle-2.wav"],
        Famas => &["weapons/famas-1.wav", "weapons/famas-2.wav"],
        Galil => &["weapons/galil-1.wav", "weapons/galil-2.wav"],
        Glock => &["weapons/glock18-1.wav", "weapons/glock18-2.wav"],
        M4a1 if silenced => &["weapons/m4a1-1.wav"],
        M4a1 => &["weapons/m4a1_unsil-1.wav", "weapons/m4a1_unsil-2.wav"],
        Mac10 => &["weapons/mac10-1.wav"],
        Mp5 => &["weapons/mp5-1.wav", "weapons/mp5-2.wav"], // EV_FireMP5N
        P228 => &["weapons/p228-1.wav"],
        P90 => &["weapons/p90-1.wav"],
        Scout => &["weapons/scout_fire-1.wav"],
        Tmp => &["weapons/tmp-1.wav", "weapons/tmp-2.wav"],
        Ump45 => &["weapons/ump45-1.wav"],
        Usp if silenced => &["weapons/usp1.wav", "weapons/usp2.wav"],
        Usp => &["weapons/usp_unsil-1.wav"],
        _ => &[],
    }
}

/// Footstep sound set (`PM_PlayStepSound`): files 1 and 3 are the right foot, 2 and 4 the left.
fn step_set(kind: sim::pmove::StepKind, material: char) -> &'static str {
    use sim::pmove::StepKind::*;
    match (kind, material) {
        (Ladder, _) => "ladder",
        (Wade, _) => "wade",
        (Slosh, _) | (Surface, 'S') => "slosh",
        (Surface, 'M') => "metal",
        (Surface, 'D') => "dirt",
        (Surface, 'V') => "duct",
        (Surface, 'G') => "grate",
        (Surface, 'T') => "tile",
        (Surface, 'N') => "snow",
        _ => "step",
    }
}

struct Play {
    file: String,
    /// None = in your head (own weapon, own footsteps).
    at: Option<[f32; 3]>,
    volume: f32,
    attn: f32,
    pitch: f32,
}

/// Play this frame's cues.
fn play_cues(mut commands: Commands, mut w: ResMut<Walker>, settings: Res<Settings>, mut sounds: ResMut<Sounds>, mut assets: ResMut<Assets<AudioSource>>) {
    let cues = std::mem::take(&mut w.cues);
    if cues.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let ear = w.client.me().eye();
    for cue in cues {
        let mut plays: Vec<Play> = Vec::new();
        // Gunshot pitch varies a little, like CS (94 + 0..15 %).
        let gun_pitch = 0.94 + (sounds.rand() * 16.0).floor() / 100.0;
        match cue {
            Cue::Shot { weapon, silenced, at } => {
                let options = fire_sound(weapon, silenced);
                if !options.is_empty() {
                    let file = sounds.pick(options);
                    plays.push(Play { file, at, volume: 1.0, attn: sim::weapons::data::fire_attenuation(weapon, silenced), pitch: gun_pitch });
                }
            }
            Cue::Footstep { feet, who, step } => {
                // The surface under the feet decides the sound and its volume.
                let below = [feet[0], feet[1], feet[2] - 64.0];
                let material = w.client.world.texture_at(feet, below).map(|t| sounds.materials.kind(t)).unwrap_or('C');
                let left = sounds.left_foot.entry(who).or_insert(false);
                *left = !*left;
                let left = *left as u32;
                let n = (sounds.rand() < 0.5) as u32 * 2 + 1 + left;
                let file = format!("player/pl_{}{n}.wav", step_set(step.kind, material));
                plays.push(Play { file, at: if who.is_none() { None } else { Some(feet) }, volume: step.loudness(material), attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: 1.0 });
            }
            Cue::Hit { sound, at } => {
                use net::protocol::HitSound::*;
                let options: &[&str] = match sound {
                    Flesh => &["player/bhit_flesh-1.wav", "player/bhit_flesh-2.wav", "player/bhit_flesh-3.wav"],
                    Kevlar => &["player/bhit_kevlar-1.wav"],
                    Helmet => &["player/bhit_helmet-1.wav"],
                    Headshot => &["player/headshot1.wav", "player/headshot2.wav", "player/headshot3.wav"],
                    KnifeSlash => &["weapons/knife_hit1.wav", "weapons/knife_hit2.wav", "weapons/knife_hit3.wav", "weapons/knife_hit4.wav"],
                    KnifeStab => &["weapons/knife_stab.wav"],
                    Explosion => &["player/pl_pain2.wav", "player/pl_pain4.wav", "player/pl_pain5.wav", "player/pl_pain6.wav", "player/pl_pain7.wav"],
                };
                let file = sounds.pick(options);
                plays.push(Play { file, at, volume: 1.0, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: 1.0 });
            }
            Cue::Death { at } => {
                let file = sounds.pick(&["player/die1.wav", "player/die2.wav", "player/die3.wav", "player/death6.wav"]);
                plays.push(Play { file, at, volume: 1.0, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: 1.0 });
            }
            Cue::Explosion { at } => {
                let file = sounds.pick(&["weapons/hegrenade-1.wav", "weapons/hegrenade-2.wav"]);
                plays.push(Play { file, at: Some(at), volume: 1.0, attn: ATTN_FAR, pitch: 1.0 });
            }
            Cue::Flash { at } => {
                let file = sounds.pick(&["weapons/flashbang-1.wav", "weapons/flashbang-2.wav"]);
                plays.push(Play { file, at: Some(at), volume: 0.9, attn: ATTN_FAR, pitch: 1.0 });
            }
            Cue::Smoke { at } => plays.push(Play { file: "weapons/sg_explode.wav".into(), at: Some(at), volume: 1.0, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: 1.0 }),
            Cue::Bounce { kind, at } => {
                let file = if kind == Kind::He { "weapons/he_bounce-1.wav".into() } else { sounds.pick(&["weapons/grenade_hit1.wav", "weapons/grenade_hit2.wav", "weapons/grenade_hit3.wav"]) };
                plays.push(Play { file, at: Some(at), volume: 0.5, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: 1.0 });
            }
            Cue::Break { material, at } => {
                use sim::breakables::Material::*;
                let options: &[&str] = match material {
                    Glass | UnbreakableGlass => &["debris/bustglass1.wav", "debris/bustglass2.wav"],
                    Wood => &["debris/bustcrate1.wav", "debris/bustcrate2.wav"],
                    Metal | Computer => &["debris/bustmetal1.wav", "debris/bustmetal2.wav"],
                    Flesh => &["debris/bustflesh1.wav", "debris/bustflesh2.wav"],
                    Concrete | Rocks => &["debris/bustconcrete1.wav", "debris/bustconcrete2.wav"],
                    CeilingTile => &["debris/bustceiling.wav"],
                };
                let file = sounds.pick(options);
                let pitch = 95 + (sounds.rand() * 30.0) as u32;
                let pitch = if pitch > 97 && pitch < 103 { 100 } else { pitch };
                let volume = 0.85 + sounds.rand() * 0.15;
                plays.push(Play { file, at: Some(at), volume, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: pitch as f32 / 100.0 });
            }
            Cue::Impact { at, normal } => {
                // `EV_HLDM_PlayTextureSound`: the surface's sound (pitch 96-111%), ATTN_NORM.
                let (a, b) = (std::array::from_fn(|i| at[i] + normal[i] * 2.0), std::array::from_fn(|i| at[i] - normal[i] * 2.0));
                let world = &w.client.world;
                let material = world.texture_of(world.trace_line(a, b).model, a, b).map(|t| sounds.materials.kind(t)).unwrap_or('C');
                let (volume, options): (f32, &[&str]) = match material {
                    'M' => (0.9, &["player/pl_metal1.wav", "player/pl_metal2.wav"]),
                    'D' => (0.9, &["player/pl_dirt1.wav", "player/pl_dirt2.wav", "player/pl_dirt3.wav"]),
                    'V' => (0.5, &["player/pl_duct1.wav"]),
                    'G' => (0.9, &["player/pl_grate1.wav", "player/pl_grate4.wav"]),
                    'T' => (0.8, &["player/pl_tile1.wav", "player/pl_tile2.wav", "player/pl_tile3.wav", "player/pl_tile4.wav"]),
                    'S' => (0.9, &["player/pl_slosh1.wav", "player/pl_slosh2.wav", "player/pl_slosh3.wav", "player/pl_slosh4.wav"]),
                    'W' => (0.9, &["debris/wood1.wav", "debris/wood2.wav", "debris/wood3.wav"]),
                    'Y' | 'P' => (0.8, &["debris/glass1.wav", "debris/glass2.wav", "debris/glass3.wav"]),
                    'N' => (0.7, &["player/pl_snow1.wav", "player/pl_snow2.wav", "player/pl_snow3.wav", "player/pl_snow4.wav"]),
                    _ => (0.9, &["player/pl_step1.wav", "player/pl_step2.wav"]),
                };
                let pitch = 0.96 + (sounds.rand() * 16.0).floor() / 100.0;
                let file = sounds.pick(options);
                plays.push(Play { file, at: Some(at), volume, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch });
                // `EV_HLDM_GunshotDecalTrace`: half the impacts ricochet, metal and vents ring.
                if sounds.rand() < 0.5 {
                    let file = if matches!(material, 'M' | 'V') {
                        sounds.pick(&["weapons/ric_metal-1.wav", "weapons/ric_metal-2.wav"])
                    } else {
                        sounds.pick(&["weapons/ric1.wav", "weapons/ric2.wav", "weapons/ric3.wav", "weapons/ric4.wav", "weapons/ric5.wav", "weapons/ric_conc-1.wav"])
                    };
                    plays.push(Play { file, at: Some(at), volume: 1.0, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: 1.0 });
                }
            }
            Cue::DryFire { pistol } => {
                plays.push(Play { file: if pistol { "weapons/dryfire_pistol.wav" } else { "weapons/dryfire_rifle.wav" }.into(), at: None, volume: 0.8, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: 1.0 })
            }
            Cue::Swing => {
                // The swing itself is a whoosh, slash or stab (CS plays the same miss sounds for
                // both); what it hit sounds on its own, from the server (`Cue::Hit`).
                let file = sounds.pick(&["weapons/knife_slash1.wav", "weapons/knife_slash2.wav"]);
                plays.push(Play { file, at: None, volume: 1.0, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: 1.0 });
            }
            Cue::Zoom => plays.push(Play { file: "weapons/zoom.wav".into(), at: None, volume: 1.0, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: 1.0 }),
            Cue::File(file) => plays.push(Play { file, at: None, volume: 1.0, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: 1.0 }),
            Cue::Quiet { file, at, volume } => plays.push(Play { file: file.into(), at: Some(at), volume, attn: ATTN_NORM, pitch: 1.0 }),
            Cue::At { file, at, far } => plays.push(Play { file: file.into(), at: Some(at), volume: 1.0, attn: if far { ATTN_FAR } else { ATTN_NORM }, pitch: 1.0 }),
        }
        for p in plays {
            let Some(handle) = sounds.get(&p.file, &mut assets) else { continue };
            let mut play = PlaybackSettings::DESPAWN.with_speed(p.pitch);
            match p.at {
                Some(at) => {
                    // GoldSrc falloff: full at the source, silent at 1000 / attn units.
                    let d = ((at[0] - ear[0]).powi(2) + (at[1] - ear[1]).powi(2) + (at[2] - ear[2]).powi(2)).sqrt();
                    let gain = settings.volume * p.volume * (1.0 - d * p.attn / 1000.0);
                    if gain <= 0.01 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    play = play.with_volume(Volume::Linear(gain)).with_spatial(true);
                    commands.spawn((AudioPlayer(handle), play, Transform::from_translation(Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(at)))));
                }
                None => {
                    play = play.with_volume(Volume::Linear(settings.volume * p.volume));
                    commands.spawn((AudioPlayer(handle), play));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

pub struct SoundPlugin;

impl Plugin for SoundPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(Update, play_cues.in_set(Frame::Sound));
    }
}
```

`client/src/spectate.rs`:

```rs
//! Spectating while dead, as in competitive CS: you watch living teammates through their own
//! eyes (left and right click cycle through them). When your whole team is out, the camera
//! watches where the last of you went down, from behind, until the next round (black if
//! nobody's known). The server sends a dead player only what living teammates can see, so a
//! team that's out sees no enemies at all. Players on the spectator team may watch anyone.
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::ui::{hud_panel, kit_text, vh, Anim, HudLayer, Kit, BG0, CT_COLOR, LINE_3, SAFE, TX1, TX2, TX3, T_COLOR};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::window::{CursorGrabMode, CursorOptions};
use net::protocol::Team;

pub struct SpectatePlugin;

impl Plugin for SpectatePlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.init_resource::<Watch>()
            .add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::InGame), spawn_plate)
            .add_systems(Update, (note_downs, cycle, team_out, plate).chain().in_set(Frame::Ui).run_if(resource_exists::<Walker>));
    }
}

/// Which living teammate you watch (an index into them, wrapped), and whether the team is out.
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct Watch {
    index: usize,
    pub out: bool,
    /// Where the last of your team went down this round, and which way they faced.
    pub last_down: Option<([f32; 3], f32)>,
}

/// Remember where teammates die (the camera goes there once the whole team is out).
fn note_downs(mut news: MessageReader<crate::effects::GameNews>, w: Res<Walker>, mut watch: ResMut<Watch>, cam: Single<&crate::game::FlyCam>) {
    let mine = w.client.team();
    for crate::effects::GameNews(e) in news.read() {
        match e {
            net::protocol::GameEvent::RoundStart { .. } => watch.last_down = None,
            net::protocol::GameEvent::Kill { victim, .. } => {
                let at = if Some(*victim) == w.client.id() {
                    Some((w.client.me().origin, cam.yaw.to_degrees() + 90.0))
                } else {
                    w.client.others().into_iter().find(|o| o.id == *victim && o.team == mine).map(|o| (o.origin, o.yaw))
                };
                if at.is_some() {
                    watch.last_down = at;
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

/// The teammate you see through the eyes of (None: not spectating, or nobody left).
/// `BOOTLEG16_SPECTATE=front` (model checks) watches from in front instead.
pub fn in_eye(w: &Walker, watch: &Watch) -> Option<net::client::Remote> {
    if !spectating(w) || std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_SPECTATE").is_ok_and(|v| v == "front") {
        return None;
    }
    target(w, watch)
}

/// Whether you are watching someone instead of playing.
pub fn spectating(w: &Walker) -> bool {
    !w.client.vitals.alive() || std::env::var_os("BOOTLEG16_SPECTATE").is_some()
}

/// The player to watch: a living teammate (any living player for the spectator team).
pub fn target(w: &Walker, watch: &Watch) -> Option<net::client::Remote> {
    let mine = w.client.team();
    let mut alive: Vec<_> = w.client.others().into_iter().filter(|o| o.alive && (mine == Team::Spectator || o.team == mine)).collect();
    alive.sort_by_key(|o| o.id);
    let n = alive.len();
    (n > 0).then(|| alive.swap_remove(watch.index % n))
}

/// Left and right click: next and previous teammate (only while the mouse is captured).
fn cycle(mouse: Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>, cursor: Single<&CursorOptions>, w: Res<Walker>, mut watch: ResMut<Watch>) {
    if !spectating(&w) || cursor.grab_mode == CursorGrabMode::None {
        return;
    }
    if mouse.just_pressed(MouseButton::Left) {
        watch.index = watch.index.wrapping_add(1);
    }
    if mouse.just_pressed(MouseButton::Right) {
        watch.index = watch.index.wrapping_add(usize::MAX);
    }
}

/// match is going, and the keys to switch.

    Kills,

    Adr,

fn spawn_plate(mut commands: Commands, kit: Res<Kit>) {
    let stat = |r: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, which: PlateText, unit: &str| {
        r.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Baseline, column_gap: vh(4.0), ..default() }).with_children(|s| {
            s.spawn((which, kit_text("0", 20.0, TX1, &kit.num)));
            s.spawn(kit_text(unit, 13.0, TX2, &kit.text));
        });
    };
    let key = |r: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, cap: &str, what: &str| {
        r.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Center, column_gap: vh(8.0), ..default() }).with_children(|k| {
            k.spawn((Node { padding: UiRect::axes(vh(6.0), vh(1.0)), border: UiRect::all(px(1)), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(px(2)), ..default() }, BorderColor::all(LINE_3)))
                .with_children(|c| {
                    c.spawn(kit_text(cap, 11.0, TX1, &kit.num));
                });
            k.spawn(kit_text(what, 13.0, TX2, &kit.text));
        });
    };
    commands
        .spawn((Plate, HudLayer, Visibility::Hidden, DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame), Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), bottom: vh(SAFE), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, ..default() }))
        .with_children(|row| {
            row.spawn(hud_panel(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, row_gap: vh(8.0), padding: UiRect::axes(vh(32.0), vh(14.0)), ..default() })).with_children(|p| {
                p.spawn(kit_text("WATCHING", 13.0, TX2, &kit.text));
                p.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Baseline, column_gap: vh(20.0), ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
                    r.spawn((PlateText::Name, kit_text("", 26.0, TX1, &kit.text)));
                    stat(r, PlateText::Kills, "K");
                    stat(r, PlateText::Deaths, "D");
                    stat(r, PlateText::Adr, "ADR");
                });
                p.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(28.0), ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
                    key(r, "MOUSE 1", "NEXT");
                    key(r, "MOUSE 2", "PREVIOUS");
                });
            });
        });
}

fn plate(w: Res<Walker>, watch: Res<Watch>, covered: Res<crate::ui::Covered>, mut root: Single<&mut Visibility, With<Plate>>, mut texts: Query<(&PlateText, &mut Text, &mut TextColor)>) {
    let who = spectating(&w).then(|| target(&w, &watch)).flatten().and_then(|t| w.client.scores.iter().find(|s| s.id == t.id));
    root.set_if_neq(if who.is_some() && !covered.0 { Visibility::Inherited } else { Visibility::Hidden });
    let Some(s) = who else { return };
    for (which, mut t, mut c) in &mut texts {
        let v = match which {
            PlateText::Name => {
                c.set_if_neq(TextColor(if s.team == Team::T { T_COLOR } else { CT_COLOR }));
                s.name.clone()
            }
            PlateText::Kills => s.kills.to_string(),
            PlateText::Deaths => s.deaths.to_string(),
            PlateText::Adr => (s.damage / s.rounds.max(1)).to_string(),
        };
        if t.0 != v {
            t.0 = v;
        }
    }
}

/// No living teammate while you are dead: black over the world, under the HUD.
fn team_out(mut commands: Commands, w: Res<Walker>, kit: Res<Kit>, mut watch: ResMut<Watch>, screens: Query<Entity, With<OutScreen>>) {
    let out = spectating(&w) && w.client.team() != Team::Spectator && w.client.id().is_some() && target(&w, &watch).is_none();
    let black = out && watch.last_down.is_none();
    let was = screens.iter().next().is_some();
    watch.out = out;
    if black == was {
        return;
    }
    for e in &screens {
        commands.entity(e).remove::<OutScreen>().insert(Anim::tune_out());
    }
    if !black {
        return;
    }
    commands
        .spawn((
            OutScreen,
            DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame),
            Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), height: percent(100), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, row_gap: vh(8.0), ..default() },
            BackgroundColor(BG0),
            GlobalZIndex(-1),
            Anim::tune_in(0.0),
        ))
        .with_children(|c| {
            c.spawn(kit_text("YOUR TEAM IS OUT", 28.0, TX2, &kit.text));
            c.spawn(kit_text("NEXT ROUND SOON", 13.0, TX3, &kit.text));
        });
}
```

```rs
//! Loading, notices and reconnecting (design/mockups/ui: Loading, Notice, Reconnecting).
//! The logic lives in `loading`, `notice` and `game`; these views only read their resources:
//! each view is up while its resource exists and follows it every frame.
//! - Loading (Connecting, and into the game until the first frame is drawn): the map big, the steps in a row (done, now, next), real
//!   progress, Cancel · Esc.
//! - Notice (menu): over everything, blurred behind: what happened, why, Retry and Back.
//! - Reconnecting (in a match): under the score while the server is quiet, draining to the
//!   moment we give up.
use crate::game::Reconnecting;
use crate::loading::{Loading, Step};
use crate::menu::AppState;
use crate::notice::{Notice, NoticeKind};
use crate::ui::{chip, edge, hud_panel, kit_text, lift, meter, primary_button, soft, t, vh, Anim, EdgeColor, HudLayer, Kit, Meter, Type, UiAction, UiSound, AMBER, BACKDROP, BAD, BG0, BG1, LINE_2, TX1, TX2, TX3};
use bevy::prelude::*;

pub struct StatusScreensPlugin;

impl Plugin for StatusScreensPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(Update, (loading, notice.run_if(in_state(AppState::Menu)), reconnecting.run_if(in_state(AppState::InGame))));
    }
}

#[derive(Component)]
struct LoadingRoot;
#[derive(Component)]
struct LoadingBar;
#[derive(Component)]
enum LoadingText {
    What,
    Map,
    Percent,
}
/// One step: its index, and the diamond in front of it.
#[derive(Component)]
struct StepRow(usize, Entity);

fn loading(mut commands: Commands, kit: Res<Kit>, state: Option<Res<Loading>>, root: Query<Entity, With<LoadingRoot>>, mut texts: Query<(&LoadingText, &mut Text)>, mut rows: Query<(&StepRow, &mut Node, &Children)>, mut colors: Query<&mut TextColor>, mut fills: Query<&mut BackgroundColor>, mut bar: Query<&mut Meter, With<LoadingBar>>, time: Res<Time>) {
    let Some(l) = state else {
        // the game is drawn under it by now: tune out over it
        for e in &root {
            commands.entity(e).remove::<LoadingRoot>().insert(Anim::tune_out());
        }
        return;
    };
    // practice starts its own server; joining skips that step
    let steps: Vec<Step> = Step::ALL.into_iter().filter(|s| l.practice || *s != Step::StartingServer).collect();
    if root.is_empty() {
        commands
            .spawn((LoadingRoot, Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), height: percent(100), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(BG0), GlobalZIndex(40)))
            .with_children(|full| {
                full.spawn((Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, left: px(0), right: px(0), top: vh(380.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() }, Anim::tune_in(0.0))).with_children(|c| {
                    c.spawn((LoadingText::What, t(&kit, Type::Label, "", TX2)));
                    c.spawn((LoadingText::Map, kit_text("", 120.0, TX1, &kit.display), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(12.0)), ..default() }));
                    c.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(32.0), margin: UiRect::top(vh(40.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
                        for (i, s) in steps.iter().enumerate() {
                            let dot = r.commands().spawn((Node { width: vh(8.0), height: vh(8.0), border: UiRect::all(px(1)), ..default() }, BorderColor::all(TX3), BackgroundColor(Color::NONE), UiTransform::from_rotation(Rot2::degrees(45.0)))).id();
                            r.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Center, column_gap: vh(10.0), ..default() }).add_child(dot).with_children(|row| {
                                row.spawn(t(&kit, Type::Label, s.label(), TX3));
                            }).insert(StepRow(i, dot));
                        }
                    });
                    let m = meter(c, 640.0, AMBER, 0.0);
                    c.commands().entity(m).insert(LoadingBar).entry::<Node>().and_modify(|mut n| n.margin = UiRect::top(vh(32.0)));
                    c.spawn((LoadingText::Percent, kit_text("0%", 16.0, TX2, &kit.num), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(10.0)), ..default() }));
                });
                full.spawn(Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, left: vh(96.0), bottom: vh(48.0), ..default() }).with_children(|b| {
                    chip(b, &kit, "Cancel · Esc", UiAction::CancelLoading, false);
                });
            });
        return;
    }
    let what = if l.practice { "Practice · solo".to_string() } else { format!("Match · {}", l.target) };
    for (which, mut text) in &mut texts {
        let s = match which {
            LoadingText::What => what.to_uppercase(),
            LoadingText::Map => l.map.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| if l.practice { l.target.clone() } else { "...".into() }).to_uppercase(),
            LoadingText::Percent => format!("{:.0}%", l.progress.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 100.0),
        };
        if text.0 != s {
            text.0 = s;
        }
    }
    for mut m in &mut bar {
        m.value = l.progress.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    }
    // done steps grey, the current one amber and pulsing, the rest quiet
    let now = steps.iter().position(|s| *s == l.step).unwrap_or(0);
    let pulse = 0.65 + 0.35 * (time.elapsed_secs() * std::f32::consts::TAU / 1.2).cos();
    for (row, _, kids) in &mut rows {
        let c = match row.0.cmp(&now) {
            std::cmp::Ordering::Less => TX2,
            std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => AMBER,
            std::cmp::Ordering::Greater => TX3,
        };
        for k in kids {
            if let Ok(mut tc) = colors.get_mut(*k) {
                tc.set_if_neq(TextColor(c));
            }
        }
        if let Ok(mut bg) = fills.get_mut(row.1) {
            let fill = match row.0.cmp(&now) {
                std::cmp::Ordering::Less => TX2,
                std::cmp::Ordering::Equal => AMBER.with_alpha(pulse),
                std::cmp::Ordering::Greater => Color::NONE,
            };
            bg.set_if_neq(BackgroundColor(fill));
        }
    }
}

/// The notice over the menu: rebuilt when it changes, tuned out when it's closed.
fn notice(mut commands: Commands, kit: Res<Kit>, state: Option<Res<Notice>>, root: Query<Entity, With<NoticeRoot>>, mut sounds: MessageWriter<UiSound>) {
    let changed = state.as_ref().is_some_and(|n| n.is_changed());
    if state.is_none() || changed {
        for e in &root {
            commands.entity(e).despawn();
        }
    }
    let Some(n) = state else { return };
    if !changed && !root.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    sounds.write(UiSound::On);
    let error = matches!(n.kind, NoticeKind::Error);
    commands
        .spawn((
            NoticeRoot,
            // like match found: flat over the 3D menu, which takes no clicks under it
            crate::found::FoundOverlay,
            DespawnOnExit(AppState::Menu),
            Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), height: percent(100), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() },
            BackgroundColor(BACKDROP),
            GlobalZIndex(30),
        ))
        .with_children(|full| {
            full.spawn((soft(Node { width: vh(720.0), padding: UiRect::axes(vh(48.0), vh(40.0)), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, border: UiRect::all(px(1)), ..default() }), BackgroundColor(BG1.with_alpha(0.96)), BorderColor::all(LINE_2), lift(), Anim::tune_in(0.0))).with_children(|p| {
                p.spawn(t(&kit, Type::Label, if error { "Error" } else { "Notice" }, if error { BAD } else { TX2 }));
                p.spawn((kit_text(n.title.to_uppercase(), 72.0, TX1, &kit.display), Node { margin: UiRect::top(vh(12.0)), ..default() }));
                p.spawn((kit_text(n.body.clone(), 18.0, TX2, &kit.text), TextLayout::justify(Justify::Center), Node { max_width: vh(560.0), margin: UiRect::top(vh(16.0)), ..default() }));
                p.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, row_gap: vh(12.0), margin: UiRect::top(vh(36.0)), ..default() }).with_children(|b| {
                    if n.retry {
                        let r = primary_button(b, &kit, "Retry", "Enter", UiAction::NoticeRetry);
                        b.commands().entity(r).entry::<Node>().and_modify(|mut n| n.min_width = vh(420.0));
                        chip(b, &kit, "Back · Esc", UiAction::NoticeClose, false);
                    } else {
                        let r = primary_button(b, &kit, "Back", "Enter", UiAction::NoticeClose);
                        b.commands().entity(r).entry::<Node>().and_modify(|mut n| n.min_width = vh(420.0));
                    }
                });
            });
        });
}

#[derive(Component)]
struct ReconnectRoot;

/// Under the score while the server is quiet: how long, and how long until we give up.
fn reconnecting(mut commands: Commands, kit: Res<Kit>, state: Option<Res<Reconnecting>>, root: Query<Entity, With<ReconnectRoot>>, mut secs: Query<&mut Text, With<ReconnectSecs>>, mut bar: Query<&mut Meter, With<ReconnectBar>>) {
    let Some(r) = state else {
        for e in &root {
            commands.entity(e).remove::<ReconnectRoot>().insert(Anim::tune_out());
        }
        return;
    };
    let left = 1.0 - (r.since / r.give_up.max(1.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    if root.is_empty() {
        commands
            .spawn((ReconnectRoot, HudLayer, DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame), Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), top: vh(190.0), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, ..default() }, Anim::tune_in(0.0)))
            .with_children(|row| {
                row.spawn(hud_panel(Node { width: vh(420.0), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, row_gap: vh(8.0), padding: UiRect { left: vh(24.0), right: vh(24.0), top: vh(16.0), bottom: vh(14.0) }, ..default() })).with_children(|p| {
                    p.spawn(edge(EdgeColor::Fixed(BAD), 1.0));
                    p.spawn(t(&kit, Type::Label, "Connection interrupted", BAD));
                    p.spawn((ReconnectSecs, kit_text("", 20.0, TX1, &kit.text)));
                    let m = meter(p, 372.0, BAD, left);
                    p.commands().entity(m).insert(ReconnectBar).entry::<Node>().and_modify(|mut n| n.margin = UiRect::top(vh(2.0)));
                    p.spawn(t(&kit, Type::Label, "Esc · leave match", TX3));
                });
            });
        return;
    }
    let s = format!("Reconnecting  {:.0} s", r.since.floor());
    for mut t in &mut secs {
        if t.0 != s {
            t.0 = s.clone();
        }
    }
    for mut m in &mut bar {
        m.value = left;
    }
}
```

`client/src/steam.rs`:

```rs
//! Steam (built with the `steam` feature, on by default): your Steam name and id, your
//! friends with their avatars, invites, and rich presence so friends see your party and can
//! join it from Steam. App 480 (Valve's Spacewar test app) until we have our own App ID.
//! Without Steam running (or without the feature) the game plays anonymously; nothing here
//! is required.
use bevy::prelude::*;
use std::collections::HashMap;

pub struct SteamPlugin;

/// Our Steam app. ponytail: 480 is Valve's shared test app; swap for ours when we have it.
#[cfg(feature = "steam")]
const APP_ID: u32 = 480;

impl Plugin for SteamPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        #[cfg(feature = "steam")]
        match steamworks::Client::init_app(APP_ID) {
            Ok(client) => {
                let (tx, rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
                let join = client.register_callback(move |r: steamworks::GameRichPresenceJoinRequested| _ = tx.send(r.connect));
                let user = client.user();
                let me = user.steam_id().raw();
                let name = client.friends().name();
                info!("Steam: signed in as {name} ({me})");
                app.insert_resource(Steam { me, name, friends: Vec::new(), avatars: HashMap::new(), presence: String::new(), sdk: Some(Sdk { client, joins: std::sync::Mutex::new(rx), _join: join }), refresh: 0.0 })
                    .add_systems(Update, update);
            }
            Err(e) => warn!("Steam isn't running or refused us ({e}): playing without Steam"),
        }
    }
}

/// Present only when signed in to Steam.
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct Steam {
    pub me: u64,
    pub name: String,
    /// Friends, in game first, then online, then offline.
    pub friends: Vec<Friend>,
    /// Steam id -> 64x64 avatar (missing until Steam has sent it).
    pub avatars: HashMap<u64, Handle<Image>>,
    /// The rich presence we last set (the party code and what we're doing).
    presence: String,
    #[cfg(feature = "steam")]
    sdk: Option<Sdk>,
    #[cfg(not(feature = "steam"))]
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    sdk: Option<()>,
    refresh: f32,
}

/// Fields drop in order: the callback must go before the client (dropping the client shuts
/// Steam down; unregistering a callback after that trips Steam's asserts and a crash dump).
#[cfg(feature = "steam")]
struct Sdk {
    _join: steamworks::CallbackHandle,
    /// "Join game" / accepted Steam invites: their connect strings ("+party CODE").
    joins: std::sync::Mutex<std::sync::mpsc::Receiver<String>>,
    client: steamworks::Client,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Friend {
    pub id: u64,
    pub name: String,
    pub presence: Presence,
    /// Online but away / snoozing (a dimmer dot).
    pub away: bool,
    /// What they're doing: our rich presence status when in game, else Online/Away/Offline.
    pub status: String,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
pub enum Presence {
    InGame,
    Online,
    Offline,
}

/// What a Steam "Join game" or invite carries: our party code.
pub fn connect_string(code: &str) -> String {
    format!("+party {code}")
}

/// The party code in a connect string or the game's command line (`+party CODE`).
pub fn party_code<S: AsRef<str>>(args: &[S]) -> Option<String> {
    let i = args.iter().position(|a| a.as_ref() == "+party")?;
    args.get(i + 1).map(|c| c.as_ref().to_string())
}

impl Steam {
    /// A fresh Steam login for the lobby (a ticket is used once).
    pub fn login(&self) -> Option<Box<dyn FnMut() -> Option<net::lobby::SteamLogin> + Send + Sync>> {
        #[cfg(feature = "steam")]
        if let Some(sdk) = &self.sdk {
            let client = sdk.client.clone();
            let steam_id = self.me;
            return Some(Box::new(move || {
                // ponytail: tickets are never cancelled; Steam drops them when the game exits.
                let (_ticket, ticket) = client.user().authentication_session_ticket(steamworks::networking_types::NetworkingIdentity::new());
                Some(net::lobby::SteamLogin { steam_id, ticket })
            }));
        }
        None
    }

    /// Invite a friend who isn't in the game: Steam shows them the invite and starts the game.
    pub fn invite(&self, friend: u64, code: &str) {
        #[cfg(feature = "steam")]
        if let Some(sdk) = &self.sdk {
            sdk.client.friends().get_friend(steamworks::SteamId::from_raw(friend)).invite_user_to_game(&connect_string(code));
        }
        let _ = (friend, code);
    }

    /// Tell friends what we're doing (and let them join our party from Steam).
    pub fn set_presence(&mut self, code: &str, status: &str) {
        let key = format!("{code}|{status}");
        if self.presence == key {
            return;
        }
        self.presence = key;
        #[cfg(feature = "steam")]
        if let Some(sdk) = &self.sdk {
            let f = sdk.client.friends();
            f.set_rich_presence("status", Some(status));
            f.set_rich_presence("connect", Some(&connect_string(code)));
        }
    }

    /// Party codes from Steam "Join game" / accepted invites since last asked.
    pub fn take_joins(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        #[cfg(feature = "steam")]
        if let Some(sdk) = &self.sdk {
            let rx = sdk.joins.lock().unwrap();
            return rx.try_iter().filter_map(|c| party_code(&c.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>())).collect();
        }
        Vec::new()
    }
}

/// Run Steam's callbacks; every couple of seconds refresh friends and fetch missing avatars.
#[cfg(feature = "steam")]
fn update(mut steam: ResMut<Steam>, mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>, time: Res<Time>, mut dirty: ResMut<crate::menu::MenuDirty>) {
    let steam = &mut *steam;
    let Some(sdk) = &steam.sdk else { return };
    sdk.client.run_callbacks();
    steam.refresh -= time.delta_secs();
    if steam.refresh > 0.0 {
        return;
    }
    steam.refresh = 2.0;
    let friends = sdk.client.friends();
    let ours = steamworks::AppId(APP_ID);
    let mut list: Vec<Friend> = friends
        .get_friends(steamworks::FriendFlags::IMMEDIATE)
        .into_iter()
        .map(|f| {
            let in_game = f.game_played().is_some_and(|g| g.game.app_id() == ours);
            let state = f.state();
            let (presence, status) = if in_game {
                (Presence::InGame, f.rich_presence("status").unwrap_or_else(|| "In game".into()))
            } else {
                match state {
                    steamworks::FriendState::Offline | steamworks::FriendState::Invisible => (Presence::Offline, "Offline".into()),
                    steamworks::FriendState::Away | steamworks::FriendState::Snooze => (Presence::Online, "Away".into()),
                    _ => (Presence::Online, "Online".into()),
                }
            };
            let away = matches!(state, steamworks::FriendState::Away | steamworks::FriendState::Snooze) && presence == Presence::Online;
            Friend { id: f.id().raw(), name: f.nick_name().unwrap_or_else(|| f.name()), presence, away, status }
        })
        .collect();
    list.sort_by(|a, b| (a.presence, a.name.to_lowercase()).cmp(&(b.presence, b.name.to_lowercase())));
    // Avatars: ours and every friend's (offline too); Steam sends them over time, so ask
    // again until they come.
    for id in std::iter::once(steam.me).chain(list.iter().map(|f| f.id)) {
        if steam.avatars.contains_key(&id) {
            continue;
        }
        let f = friends.get_friend(steamworks::SteamId::from_raw(id));
        match f.medium_avatar() {
            Some(rgba) => {
                let img = crate::level::rgba_image(64, 64, rgba, false, bevy::render::render_resource::TextureFormat::Rgba8UnormSrgb);
                steam.avatars.insert(id, images.add(img));
                dirty.0 = true;
            }
            None => _ = friends.request_user_information(f.id(), false),
        }
    }
    if list != steam.friends {
        steam.friends = list;
        dirty.0 = true;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn party_code_from_connect_string_and_command_line() {
        assert_eq!(super::party_code(&["+party", "KX7-42Q"]).as_deref(), Some("KX7-42Q"));
        assert_eq!(super::party_code(&["client", "+party", "ABC-DEF"]).as_deref(), Some("ABC-DEF"));
        assert_eq!(super::party_code(&["client"]), None);
        assert_eq!(super::party_code(&super::connect_string("ABC-DEF").split(' ').collect::<Vec<_>>()).as_deref(), Some("ABC-DEF"));
    }
}
```

`client/src/studio.rs`:

```rs
//! Lighting studio models (players, guns, grenades, the weapon in your hands) the way GoldSrc
//! does: the light under the model (`R_LightPoint`: the lightmap texel a line straight down
//! from its origin meets) gives an ambient and a shade level (Quake's split: ambient up to
//! 128, both together up to 192); the shade falls off away from the sun when the model can
//! see the sky (`light_environment`), else away from straight down. studio.wesl does the
//! per-pixel part; this keeps each model's light up to date as it moves.
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::map;
use crate::menu::AppState;
use bevy::asset::embedded_asset;
use bevy::pbr::{ExtendedMaterial, MaterialExtension};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::render::render_resource::{AsBindGroup, ShaderType};
use bevy::shader::ShaderRef;
use std::collections::HashMap;

pub type StudioMaterial = ExtendedMaterial<StandardMaterial, StudioLight>;

#[derive(Asset, AsBindGroup, Reflect, Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct StudioLight {
    #[uniform(100)]
    pub light: StudioUniform,
}

#[derive(ShaderType, Reflect, Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct StudioUniform {
    /// Which way the light travels (world, Y-up).
    pub dir: Vec4,
    /// Light colour, brightest channel 1.
    pub color: Vec4,
    /// x ambient, y shade (GoldSrc 0..255 units).
    pub levels: Vec4,
}

impl Default for StudioUniform {
    /// Mid-grey from straight above, until the model's first frame.
    fn default() -> Self {
        StudioUniform { dir: Vec4::new(0.0, -1.0, 0.0, 0.0), color: Vec4::ONE, levels: Vec4::new(96.0, 64.0, 0.0, 0.0) }
    }
}

impl MaterialExtension for StudioLight {
    fn fragment_shader() -> ShaderRef {
        "embedded://client/studio.wesl".into()
    }
}

/// A model's texture as a studio material (masked, lit by `StudioLight`).
pub fn material(image: Handle<Image>) -> StudioMaterial {
    ExtendedMaterial {
        base: StandardMaterial { base_color_texture: Some(image), unlit: true, alpha_mode: AlphaMode::Mask(0.5), ..default() },
        extension: StudioLight::default(),
    }
}

/// A mesh part lit by where its parent stands (each instance has its own material).
#[derive(Component)]
pub struct LitPart;

/// Put on a model's parent when its light should come from where you stand (the view model).
#[derive(Component)]
pub struct LitByMe;

pub struct StudioPlugin;

impl Plugin for StudioPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        embedded_asset!(app, "studio.wesl");
        app.add_plugins(MaterialPlugin::<StudioMaterial>::default())
            .add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::InGame), load)
            .add_systems(Update, light_models.in_set(Frame::World).run_if(resource_exists::<Probe>));
    }
}

/// One lit world face's lightmap: where its luxels start in the lighting lump and how its
/// texture axes map onto them (16 units a luxel).
struct FaceLight {
    offset: usize,
    s: [f32; 4],
    t: [f32; 4],
    s0: f32,
    t0: f32,
    w: usize,
    h: usize,
}

/// What `R_LightPoint` needs: every world face's lightmap, and the sun.
#[derive(Resource)]
struct Probe {
    faces: Vec<Option<FaceLight>>,
    lighting: Vec<u8>,
    /// The sun's light travels this way (GoldSrc axes), if the map has one.
    sun: Option<[f32; 3]>,
}

fn load(mut commands: Commands, map: Res<crate::loading::MapData>) {
    let bsp = &map.bsp;
    let dot = |v: [f32; 3], a: &[f32; 4]| v[0] * a[0] + v[1] * a[1] + v[2] * a[2] + a[3];
    let faces = bsp
        .faces
        .iter()
        .map(|f| {
            if f.light_offset < 0 || f.styles[0] == 255 {
                return None;
            }
            let ti = bsp.texinfo[f.texinfo as usize];
            let (mut smin, mut smax, mut tmin, mut tmax) = (f32::MAX, f32::MIN, f32::MAX, f32::MIN);
            for v in bsp.face_vertices(f) {
                let (s, t) = (dot(v, &ti.s), dot(v, &ti.t));
                (smin, smax, tmin, tmax) = (smin.min(s), smax.max(s), tmin.min(t), tmax.max(t));
            }
            let (s0, t0) = ((smin / 16.0).floor(), (tmin / 16.0).floor());
            let w = ((smax / 16.0).ceil() - s0) as usize + 1;
            let h = ((tmax / 16.0).ceil() - t0) as usize + 1;
            Some(FaceLight { offset: f.light_offset as usize, s: ti.s, t: ti.t, s0, t0, w, h })
        })
        .collect();
    // light_environment: `angles` yaw, `pitch` (-90 = straight down).
    let sun = bsp.entity_list().iter().find(|e| e.get("classname").map(String::as_str) == Some("light_environment")).map(|e| {
        let yaw = e.get("angles").and_then(|a| a.split_whitespace().nth(1)?.parse::<f32>().ok()).unwrap_or(0.0).to_radians();
        let pitch = e.get("pitch").and_then(|p| p.parse::<f32>().ok()).unwrap_or(-90.0).to_radians();
        [pitch.cos() * yaw.cos(), pitch.cos() * yaw.sin(), pitch.sin()]
    });
    commands.insert_resource(Probe { faces, lighting: bsp.lighting.clone(), sun });
}

impl Probe {
    /// The light colour (0..255) at the floor below `origin`, bilinear across luxels.
    fn light_point(&self, world: &sim::collision::World, origin: [f32; 3]) -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
        let end = [origin[0], origin[1], origin[2] - 2048.0];
        let face = world.face_at(origin, end)?;
        let f = self.faces.get(face)?.as_ref()?;
        let hit = world.trace_line(origin, end).end;
        let dot = |a: &[f32; 4]| hit[0] * a[0] + hit[1] * a[1] + hit[2] * a[2] + a[3];
        let (s, t) = ((dot(&f.s) / 16.0 - f.s0).clamp(0.0, (f.w - 1) as f32), (dot(&f.t) / 16.0 - f.t0).clamp(0.0, (f.h - 1) as f32));
        let (x0, y0) = (s.floor() as usize, t.floor() as usize);
        let (x1, y1) = ((x0 + 1).min(f.w - 1), (y0 + 1).min(f.h - 1));
        let (fx, fy) = (s - x0 as f32, t - y0 as f32);
        let px = |x: usize, y: usize, c: usize| self.lighting.get(f.offset + (y * f.w + x) * 3 + c).copied().unwrap_or(0) as f32;
        Some(std::array::from_fn(|c| {
            let top = px(x0, y0, c) * (1.0 - fx) + px(x1, y0, c) * fx;
            let bottom = px(x0, y1, c) * (1.0 - fx) + px(x1, y1, c) * fx;
            top * (1.0 - fy) + bottom * fy
        }))
    }

    /// A model's light at `origin` (GoldSrc coordinates).
    fn light(&self, world: &sim::collision::World, origin: [f32; 3]) -> StudioUniform {
        let c = self.light_point(world, origin).unwrap_or([128.0; 3]);
        let total = c[0].max(c[1]).max(c[2]);
        let ambient = total.min(128.0);
        let shade = total.min(192.0 - ambient);
        let color = if total > 0.0 { Vec4::new(c[0] / total, c[1] / total, c[2] / total, 1.0) } else { Vec4::ONE };
        // Out under the sky: shaded away from the sun; indoors: from straight above.
        let dir = match self.sun {
            Some(sun) if world.trace_line(origin, std::array::from_fn(|i| origin[i] - sun[i] * 8192.0)).hit_sky => sun,
            _ => [0.0, 0.0, -1.0],
        };
        StudioUniform { dir: Vec3::from(map::to_y_up(dir)).extend(0.0), color, levels: Vec4::new(ambient, shade, 0.0, 0.0) }
    }
}

/// The least ambient light (GoldSrc 0..128) on the weapon you hold.
const VIEW_MIN_AMBIENT: f32 = 72.0;

/// Every lit model part gets the light where its parent stands (a few traces per model).
fn light_models(
    probe: Res<Probe>,
    w: Res<Walker>,
    parts: Query<(&MeshMaterial3d<StudioMaterial>, &ChildOf), With<LitPart>>,
    parents: Query<(&GlobalTransform, Has<LitByMe>)>,
    mut materials: ResMut<Assets<StudioMaterial>>,
) {
    let mut cache: HashMap<Entity, StudioUniform> = HashMap::new();
    for (mat, parent) in &parts {
        let p = parent.parent();
        let light = *cache.entry(p).or_insert_with(|| {
            let mine = matches!(parents.get(p), Ok((_, true)) | Err(_));
            let origin = if mine {
                w.client.me().origin
            } else {
                let v = parents.get(p).map(|(tf, _)| tf.translation()).unwrap_or_default();
                [v.x, -v.z, v.y] // back from Y-up to GoldSrc axes
            };
            let mut light = probe.light(&w.client.world, origin);
            // The weapon in your hands never goes black in a dark corner (its textures are dark already).
            if mine {
                light.levels.x = light.levels.x.max(VIEW_MIN_AMBIENT);
            }
            light
        });
        if let Some(mut m) = materials.get_mut(&mat.0) {
            m.extension.light = light;
        }
    }
}
```

`client/src/studio.wesl`:

```wesl
// Studio model lighting as GoldSrc does it (studio.rs): an ambient level plus a shade level
// that falls off with GoldSrc's hemispherical lambert (`lambert` 1.5) away from the light,
// through the same light gamma as the lightmaps, times the light's colour.
import bevy_pbr::render::{
    pbr_fragment::pbr_input_from_standard_material,
    pbr_functions::alpha_discard,
};

@if(PREPASS_PIPELINE)
import bevy_pbr::{
    prepass::io::{VertexOutput, FragmentOutput},
    deferred::functions::deferred_output,
};
@else
import bevy_pbr::render::{
    forward_io::{VertexOutput, FragmentOutput},
    pbr_functions::main_pass_post_lighting_processing,
};

struct Studio {
    // Which way the light travels (world, Y-up).
    dir: vec4<f32>,
    // Light colour, brightest channel 1.
    color: vec4<f32>,
    // x: ambient level, y: shade level (GoldSrc 0..255 units).
    levels: vec4<f32>,
}

@group(constants::MATERIAL_BIND_GROUP) @binding(100)
var<uniform> studio: Studio;

// GoldSrc's lightgammatable (brightness 1, gamma 2.5): the same curve as level.rs.
fn light_gamma(illum: f32) -> f32 {
    var f = illum / 255.0;
    let g3 = 0.05;
    if f > g3 {
        f = 0.125 + (f - g3) / (1.0 - g3) * 0.875;
    } else {
        f = f / g3 * 0.125;
    }
    return pow(f, 1.0 / 2.5);
}

@fragment
fn fragment(in: VertexOutput, @builtin(front_facing) is_front: bool) -> FragmentOutput {
    var pbr_input = pbr_input_from_standard_material(in, is_front);
    pbr_input.material.base_color = alpha_discard(pbr_input.material.flags, pbr_input.material.alpha_cutoff, pbr_input.material.base_color);
    var out: FragmentOutput;
@if(PREPASS_PIPELINE) {
    out = deferred_output(in, pbr_input);
} @else {
    // R_StudioLighting: full where the surface faces the light, down by the shade level
    // facing away (the 1.5 wrap keeps the back from going black).
    let n = normalize(in.world_normal);
    var lightcos = min(dot(n, studio.dir.xyz), 1.0);
    var illum = studio.levels.x + studio.levels.y;
    lightcos = (lightcos + 0.5) / 1.5;
    if lightcos > 0.0 {
        illum -= studio.levels.y * lightcos;
    }
    illum = clamp(illum, 0.0, 255.0);
    // Display-space light, back to linear for the multiply (the output encodes it again).
    let lv = light_gamma(illum) * studio.color.rgb;
    let lin = pow(lv, vec3<f32>(2.2));
    out.color = vec4<f32>(pbr_input.material.base_color.rgb * lin, pbr_input.material.base_color.a);
    out.color = main_pass_post_lighting_processing(pbr_input, out.color);
}
    return out;
}

```

`client/src/teammates.rs`:

```rs
//! CS2's "Show Team ID Through Walls": a team-coloured pip, and optionally the name, over
//! each teammate's head, seen through walls, so you know where your team is without a radar.
//! Settings: off / pips / names and health (`Settings::team_ids`). Markers fade with distance.
//! With names on, a mic shows above the name while that teammate talks
//! (design/mockups/ui `mateTag`).
//!
//! Safe against "make everyone a teammate" memory hacks: the server decides who your team is
//! and never sends enemies you can't see (server/visibility.rs), so there's nothing hidden to mark.
use crate::game::{FlyCam, Frame, Walker};
use crate::map;
use crate::menu::{AppState, Settings};
use crate::ui::{kit_text, BAD, CT_COLOR, T_COLOR};
use crate::voice::{MicIcon, Talking};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use net::protocol::Team;

pub struct TeammatesPlugin;

impl Plugin for TeammatesPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.add_systems(Update, team_ids.in_set(Frame::Ui));
    }
}

/// One teammate's overhead marker, and its parts.
#[derive(Component)]
struct TeamId {
    id: u8,
    mic: Entity,
    name: Entity,
    track: Entity,
    fill: Entity,
    pip: Entity,
}

/// Distance (game units) where markers start to fade, where they reach their faintest, and how
/// faint that is.
const NEAR: f32 = 600.0;
const FAR: f32 = 2600.0;
const FAINTEST: f32 = 0.4;
/// The marker's width; it's centred over the head.
const WIDTH: f32 = 200.0;
/// The top of a standing player model's head over their origin (the hull's middle; the model
/// stands a little under the 72-unit hull).
const HEAD: f32 = 26.0;

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn team_ids(
    mut commands: Commands,
    w: Res<Walker>,
    settings: Res<Settings>,
    cam: Single<(&Camera, &GlobalTransform), With<FlyCam>>,
    mut ids: Query<(Entity, &TeamId, &mut Visibility)>,
    mut nodes: Query<&mut Node>,
    mut colors: Query<&mut BackgroundColor>,
    mut texts: Query<&mut TextColor>,
    mut images: Query<&mut ImageNode>,
    (kit, talking, mic, time): (Res<crate::ui::Kit>, Option<Res<Talking>>, Option<Res<MicIcon>>, Res<Time>),
) {
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    let mine = w.client.team();
    let color = if mine == Team::Ct { CT_COLOR } else { T_COLOR };
    let on = settings.team_ids > 0 && mine != Team::Spectator;
    let names_on = settings.team_ids >= 2;
    // screenshot runs: BOOTLEG16_VOICE has every teammate talking
    let fake = std::env::var_os("BOOTLEG16_VOICE").is_some();
    let mates: Vec<_> = if on { w.client.others().into_iter().filter(|o| o.alive && o.team == mine).collect() } else { Vec::new() };
    let show = |b: bool| if b { Display::Flex } else { Display::None };
    for (e, t, mut v) in &mut ids {
        let Some(o) = mates.iter().find(|o| o.id == t.id) else {
            commands.entity(e).despawn();
            continue;
        };
        let head = Vec3::from(map::to_y_up([o.origin[0], o.origin[1], o.origin[2] + HEAD]));
        // near teammates read clearly, far ones step back so they don't crowd the screen
        let fade = (1.0 - (cam.1.translation().distance(head) - NEAR) / (FAR - NEAR)).clamp(FAINTEST, 1.0);
        let c = color.with_alpha(fade);
        let talks = fake || talking.as_ref().is_some_and(|tk| tk.level(t.id, now).is_some());
        match cam.0.world_to_viewport(cam.1, head) {
            Ok(p) => {
                if let Ok(mut n) = nodes.get_mut(e) {
                    // hangs from the head and grows upward: the pip's tip just over it
                    let h = cam.0.logical_viewport_size().map_or(0.0, |s| s.y);
                    let (left, bottom) = (px(p.x - WIDTH / 2.0), px(h - p.y + 4.0));
                    if n.left != left || n.bottom != bottom {
                        n.left = left;
                        n.bottom = bottom;
                    }
                }
                v.set_if_neq(Visibility::Inherited);
            }
            Err(_) => {
                v.set_if_neq(Visibility::Hidden); // behind you
                continue;
            }
        }
        // health (the server sends it for teammates): red when low
        let hp = o.mate.map(|m| (m.health as f32 / 100.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0));
        for (part, d) in [(t.name, names_on), (t.mic, names_on && talks), (t.track, names_on && hp.is_some())] {
            if let Ok(mut n) = nodes.get_mut(part) {
                if n.display != show(d) {
                    n.display = show(d);
                }
            }
        }
        if let Ok(mut tc) = texts.get_mut(t.name) {
            tc.set_if_neq(TextColor(c));
        }
        if let Ok(mut img) = images.get_mut(t.mic) {
            if img.color != c {
                img.color = c;
            }
        }
        if let Some(hp) = hp {
            if let Ok(mut n) = nodes.get_mut(t.fill) {
                if n.width != percent(hp * 100.0) {
                    n.width = percent(hp * 100.0);
                }
            }
            if let Ok(mut bg) = colors.get_mut(t.fill) {
                bg.set_if_neq(BackgroundColor(if hp <= 0.25 { BAD.with_alpha(fade) } else { c }));
            }
        }
        if let Ok(mut bg) = colors.get_mut(t.pip) {
            bg.set_if_neq(BackgroundColor(c));
        }
    }
    let Some(mic) = mic else { return };
    for o in &mates {
        if ids.iter().any(|(_, t, _)| t.id == o.id) {
            continue;
        }
        let name = w.client.scores.iter().find(|s| s.id == o.id).map(|s| s.name.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
        // dark shadows so every part reads on any wall
        let shadow = TextShadow { offset: Vec2::splat(1.0), color: Color::srgba(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.9) };
        let dark = Color::srgba(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.6);
        let mic_e = commands.spawn((ImageNode { image: mic.0.clone(), color, ..default() }, Node { display: Display::None, width: px(18), height: px(18), margin: UiRect::bottom(px(4)), ..default() })).id();
        let name_e = commands.spawn((kit_text(name, 18.0, color, &kit.text), shadow)).id();
        let fill = commands.spawn((Node { width: percent(100), height: percent(100), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(color))).id();
        let track = commands
            .spawn((Node { display: Display::None, width: px(64), height: px(5), margin: UiRect::top(px(4)), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(px(2)), overflow: Overflow::clip(), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(dark)))
            .add_child(fill)
            .id();
        // the pip: a small diamond pointing down at them
        let pip = commands
            .spawn((
                Node { width: px(10), height: px(10), margin: UiRect::top(px(5)), border: UiRect::all(px(2)), ..default() },
                BackgroundColor(color),
                BorderColor::all(Color::srgba(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.9)),
                UiTransform::from_rotation(Rot2::degrees(45.0)),
            ))
            .id();
        commands
            .spawn((
                TeamId { id: o.id, mic: mic_e, name: name_e, track, fill, pip },
                Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: px(WIDTH), flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, align_items: AlignItems::Center, ..default() },
                Visibility::Hidden,
                DespawnOnExit(AppState::InGame),
            ))
            .add_children(&[mic_e, name_e, track, pip]);
    }
}
```

`client/src/tracers.rs`:

```rs
//! Bullet tracers, as CS 1.6 draws them (`EV_HLDM_CheckTracer` in client.so, read from the
//! disassembly): the tracer starts at the shooter's eye + 2 units forward + 16 to the right +
//! (0, 0, -4), not at the gun model, and flies straight to where the bullet ended; the engine's
//! tracer is a short bright dash at 6000 units a second. Your shots (predicted in `game`) and
//! everyone else's (from the server in `effects`) both call `Tracers::shot`.
use crate::map::to_y_up;
use bevy::camera::visibility::RenderLayers;
use bevy::gizmos::config::{GizmoConfig, GizmoConfigGroup, GizmoLineConfig};
use bevy::prelude::*;

/// Dash speed (the engine's `tracerspeed`), dash length, and the longest shot that gets a tracer
/// (units; one that ends farther, or in the sky, has none: it would stop in mid air).
const SPEED: f32 = 6000.0;
const DASH: f32 = 60.0;
const REACH: f32 = 4096.0;
/// The first stretch of a path is not drawn, and a shot that ends inside it has no tracer: a
/// line that close to the camera is stretched across the screen by perspective, and how far
/// the wall is is what makes it depend on where you stand.
const NEAR: f32 = 64.0;

/// The layer tracers are drawn on, which only the world camera shows: a 2D camera (the HUD's
/// visor) on the default layer would draw them flat, one pixel per unit, as sideways dashes.
pub const LAYER: usize = 2;

#[derive(Default, Reflect, GizmoConfigGroup)]
struct TracerGizmos;

struct Tracer {
    from: Vec3,
    to: Vec3,
    age: f32,
}

#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct Tracers(Vec<Tracer>);

/// Where a player's tracer starts (GoldSrc coordinates), CS's offsets from the eye along the
/// shot: 2 forward, 16 right, 4 down.
pub fn start(eye: [f32; 3], end: [f32; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
    let d = [end[0] - eye[0], end[1] - eye[1], end[2] - eye[2]];
    let len = (d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1] + d[2] * d[2]).sqrt().max(1e-3);
    let f = [d[0] / len, d[1] / len, d[2] / len];
    // right = forward x up (GoldSrc: z is up), flat
    let flat = (f[0] * f[0] + f[1] * f[1]).sqrt().max(1e-3);
    let right = [f[1] / flat, -f[0] / flat, 0.0];
    [eye[0] + 2.0 * f[0] + 16.0 * right[0], eye[1] + 2.0 * f[1] + 16.0 * right[1], eye[2] + 2.0 * f[2] - 4.0]
}

impl Tracers {
    /// A shot by someone whose eye is at `eye` (GoldSrc coordinates), ending at `end`.
    pub fn shot(&mut self, eye: [f32; 3], end: [f32; 3]) {
        let (a, b) = (Vec3::from(to_y_up(start(eye, end))), Vec3::from(to_y_up(end)));
        let len = a.distance(b);
        // Too close: stretched across the screen. Too far: it would stop in mid air, not on a surface.
        if len < NEAR * 2.0 || len > REACH {
            return;
        }
        let dir = (b - a) / len;
        let to = b;
        self.0.push(Tracer { from: a + dir * NEAR, to, age: 0.0 });
    }
}

/// The dash at `age` on a path of `len`: (tail, head) distances from the start; None once it
/// has arrived.
fn dash(age: f32, len: f32) -> Option<(f32, f32)> {
    let head = (age * SPEED).min(len);
    let tail = (head - DASH).max(0.0);
    (age * SPEED - DASH < len).then_some((tail, head))
}

/// Whether a dash is drawn: not while it is still coming out of the start (a short dash right
/// next to the camera is stretched by perspective into a long false line, and a dash with no
/// length at all has no direction); once whole, and while it arrives at the end.
fn shown(tail: f32, head: f32, len: f32) -> bool {
    head - tail >= DASH - 0.5 || (head >= len - 0.01 && head - tail >= 2.0)
}

fn draw(mut tracers: ResMut<Tracers>, time: Res<Time>, mut gizmos: Gizmos<TracerGizmos>, mut hold: Local<Option<bool>>) {
    // Screenshot runs hold the latest tracer part-way (they live a fraction of a second).
    let hold = *hold.get_or_insert_with(|| std::env::var_os("BOOTLEG16_SCREENSHOT").is_some());
    if hold && tracers.0.len() > 1 {
        let last = tracers.0.pop().unwrap();
        tracers.0 = vec![last];
    }
    let dt = if hold { 0.0 } else { time.delta_secs() };
    for t in &mut tracers.0 {
        let len = t.from.distance(t.to).max(1.0);
        let age = if hold { (len * 0.5 / SPEED).min(0.05) } else { t.age };
        if let Some((tail, head)) = dash(age, len).filter(|&(tail, head)| shown(tail, head, len)) {
            let (a, b) = (t.from.lerp(t.to, tail / len), t.from.lerp(t.to, head / len));
            // the engine's tracer colour: warm yellow
            gizmos.line(a, b, Color::srgba(1.0, 0.85, 0.4, 0.9));
        }
        t.age += dt;
    }
    tracers.0.retain(|t| hold || dash(t.age, t.from.distance(t.to).max(1.0)).is_some());
}

pub struct TracerPlugin;

impl Plugin for TracerPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.init_resource::<Tracers>()
            .init_gizmo_group::<TracerGizmos>()
            .insert_gizmo_config(TracerGizmos, GizmoConfig { line: GizmoLineConfig { width: 2.5, ..default() }, render_layers: RenderLayers::layer(LAYER), ..default() })
            .add_systems(Update, draw);
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn the_start_is_cs_offsets_from_the_eye_along_the_shot() {
        // Shooting along +x from the origin: 2 ahead, 16 to the right (-y in GoldSrc), 4 down.
        let s = start([0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [1000.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
        assert!((s[0] - 2.0).abs() < 1e-4 && (s[1] + 16.0).abs() < 1e-4 && (s[2] + 4.0).abs() < 1e-4, "{s:?}");
        // Along +y the right-hand side is +x.
        let s = start([0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1000.0, 0.0]);
        assert!((s[0] - 16.0).abs() < 1e-4 && (s[1] - 2.0).abs() < 1e-4, "{s:?}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn nothing_is_drawn_close_to_the_camera() {
        let mut t = Tracers::default();
        t.shot([0.0; 3], [100.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
        assert!(t.0.is_empty(), "a wall right in front has no tracer");
        t.shot([0.0; 3], [1000.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
        assert!(t.0[0].from.distance(Vec3::from(to_y_up(start([0.0; 3], [1000.0, 0.0, 0.0])))) > NEAR - 0.5);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_dash_is_not_drawn_while_it_is_coming_out_of_the_start() {
        for age in [0.0, 0.0005, 0.002, 0.005, 0.0099] {
            let (tail, head) = dash(age, 1000.0).unwrap();
            assert!(!shown(tail, head, 1000.0), "partial dash drawn at {age}: {tail}..{head}");
        }
        let (tail, head) = dash(0.02, 1000.0).unwrap();
        assert!(shown(tail, head, 1000.0), "the whole dash is drawn");
        // arriving at the end it shrinks, and is still drawn until it is almost gone
        let (tail, head) = dash(1000.0 / SPEED + 0.004, 1000.0).unwrap();
        assert!(shown(tail, head, 1000.0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_dash_flies_from_the_start_to_the_end_and_is_gone() {
        assert!(dash(0.0, 1000.0).is_some());
        let (tail, head) = dash(0.05, 1000.0).unwrap();
        assert!((head - 300.0).abs() < 0.5 && (head - tail - DASH).abs() < 0.5);
        assert!(dash(1000.0 / SPEED + 0.02, 1000.0).is_none());
    }
}
```
