```rs
//! The font kit and shared images (embedded, so no asset paths), and the text helpers.
use super::tokens::Type;
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::text::FontSize;

#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct Kit {
    /// Big Shoulders Display ExtraBold: large words.
    pub display: Handle<Font>,
    /// Chakra Petch SemiBold: labels and running text.
    pub text: Handle<Font>,
    /// JetBrains Mono Bold: every number (tabular, so widths never jump).
    pub num: Handle<Font>,
    /// Noto Sans CJK JP Bold, subset to kana and the menu kanji: the Japanese subtitles.
    pub jp: Handle<Font>,
}

impl FromWorld for Kit {
    fn from_world(world: &mut World) -> Self {
        let mut fonts = world.resource_mut::<Assets<Font>>();
        let display = fonts.add(Font::from_bytes(include_bytes!("../../assets/fonts/BigShouldersDisplay-ExtraBold.ttf").to_vec()));
        let text = fonts.add(Font::from_bytes(include_bytes!("../../assets/fonts/ChakraPetch-SemiBold.ttf").to_vec()));
        let num = fonts.add(Font::from_bytes(include_bytes!("../../assets/fonts/JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf").to_vec()));
        let jp = fonts.add(Font::from_bytes(include_bytes!("../../assets/fonts/NotoSansJP-Bold-subset.otf").to_vec()));
        // Text without a font set (anything not built from the kit) still gets Chakra Petch.
        let _ = fonts.insert(AssetId::default(), Font::from_bytes(include_bytes!("../../assets/fonts/ChakraPetch-SemiBold.ttf").to_vec()));
        Kit { display, text, num, jp }
    }
}

impl Kit {
    fn font(&self, t: Type) -> &Handle<Font> {
        match t {
            Type::Display | Type::H2 => &self.display,
            Type::Jp => &self.jp,
            Type::NumL | Type::NumM | Type::NumS => &self.num,
            Type::H3 | Type::Body | Type::Label => &self.text,
        }
    }
}

/// A length designed at 1080p that scales with the window height.
pub fn vh(px_at_1080: f32) -> Val {
    Val::Vh(px_at_1080 / 10.8)
}

/// Text on the type scale. Labels and titles are uppercased here, so callers write
/// sentences normally.
pub fn t(kit: &Kit, ty: Type, s: impl Into<String>, color: Color) -> impl Bundle {
    let s: String = s.into();
    let s = if matches!(ty, Type::Label | Type::H2 | Type::Display) { s.to_uppercase() } else { s };
    kit_text(s, ty.size(), color, kit.font(ty))
}

/// Text in a kit font at any 1080p size (prefer `t` and the type scale).
pub fn kit_text(s: impl Into<String>, px_at_1080: f32, color: Color, font: &Handle<Font>) -> impl Bundle {
    (Text::new(s), TextFont { font: font.clone().into(), font_size: FontSize::Vh(px_at_1080 / 10.8), ..default() }, TextColor(color))
}

/// Text over the 3D world (team names, voice tags): default font, 1080p size, dark shadow
/// so it reads on any wall.
pub fn text(s: impl Into<String>, px_at_1080: f32, color: Color) -> impl Bundle {
    (Text::new(s), TextFont { font_size: FontSize::Vh(px_at_1080 / 10.8), ..default() }, TextColor(color), TextShadow { offset: Vec2::splat(1.5), color: Color::srgba(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.8) })
}
```

```rs
//! Tuning in and out, bursts, slams and rolls: short keyframed animations on a node and its
//! whole subtree (alpha, offset, and the channel split on its text).
use crate::ui::kit::vh;
use crate::ui::tokens::*;
use super::Fade;
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::window::PrimaryWindow;
use std::collections::HashMap;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Debug)]
enum Kind {
    TuneIn,
    TuneOut,
    Burst,
    /// A harder, longer burst (Grumpk's entrance).
    Slam,
    Roll { up: bool },
    /// A second ticking by: a small swell and split that settles.
    Tick,
}

/// A short animation on a node and everything inside it.
#[derive(Component)]
#[require(UiTransform)]
pub struct Anim {
    kind: Kind,
    delay: f32,
    start: Option<f32>,
}

impl Anim {
    pub fn tune_in(delay: f32) -> Anim {
        Anim { kind: Kind::TuneIn, delay, start: None }
    }
    /// The i-th part of a group tuning in, a beat after the one before.
    pub fn stagger(i: usize) -> Anim {
        Anim::tune_in(i as f32 * STAGGER)
    }
    /// Leave: tune out, then the node is despawned.
    pub fn tune_out() -> Anim {
        Anim { kind: Kind::TuneOut, delay: 0.0, start: None }
    }
    pub fn burst() -> Anim {
        Anim { kind: Kind::Burst, delay: 0.0, start: None }
    }
    pub fn slam() -> Anim {
        Anim { kind: Kind::Slam, delay: 0.0, start: None }
    }
    pub fn roll(up: bool) -> Anim {
        Anim { kind: Kind::Roll { up }, delay: 0.0, start: None }
    }
    pub fn tick() -> Anim {
        Anim { kind: Kind::Tick, delay: 0.0, start: None }
    }
}

// ---- the animation curves ---------------------------------------------------------------
fn keys(t: f32, k: &[(f32, f32)]) -> f32 {
    for w in k.windows(2) {
        let ((t0, v0), (t1, v1)) = (w[0], w[1]);
        if t <= t1 {
            return v0 + (v1 - v0) * ((t - t0) / (t1 - t0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        }
    }
    k.last().unwrap().1
}

/// (x offset, y offset, alpha, split) at progress t (0..1), all offsets at 1080p.
fn curve(kind: Kind, t: f32) -> (f32, f32, f32, f32) {
    match kind {
        Kind::TuneIn => {
            let e = 1.0 - (1.0 - t).powf(3.5);
            (keys(e, &[(0.0, -10.0), (0.35, 3.0), (0.65, -1.0), (1.0, 0.0)]), 0.0, keys(e, &[(0.0, 0.0), (0.35, 1.0)]), keys(e, &[(0.0, SPLIT_IN), (0.35, 3.0), (0.65, 1.0), (1.0, 0.0)]))
        }
        Kind::TuneOut => {
            let e = t * t;
            (keys(e, &[(0.0, 0.0), (0.4, 2.0), (1.0, 10.0)]), 0.0, 1.0 - e, keys(e, &[(0.0, 0.0), (0.4, 3.0), (1.0, 6.0)]))
        }
        Kind::Burst => {
            let e = 1.0 - (1.0 - t).powf(2.5);
            (keys(e, &[(0.0, 2.0), (0.25, -2.0), (0.5, 1.0), (1.0, 0.0)]), 0.0, 1.0, keys(e, &[(0.0, 5.0), (0.25, 3.0), (0.5, 2.0), (1.0, 0.0)]))
        }
        Kind::Slam => {
            let e = 1.0 - (1.0 - t).powf(2.5);
            (keys(e, &[(0.0, -14.0), (0.15, 8.0), (0.3, -5.0), (0.5, 3.0), (1.0, 0.0)]), 0.0, 1.0, keys(e, &[(0.0, 12.0), (0.15, 8.0), (0.3, 6.0), (0.5, 3.0), (1.0, 0.0)]))
        }
        Kind::Roll { up } => {
            let e = 1.0 - (1.0 - t).powi(3);
            (0.0, (if up { 14.0 } else { -14.0 }) * (1.0 - e), e, 4.0 * (1.0 - e))
        }
        Kind::Tick => (0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 4.0 * (1.0 - t).powi(3)),
    }
}

fn duration(kind: Kind) -> f32 {
    match kind {
        Kind::TuneIn => T_TUNE,
        Kind::TuneOut => T_OUT,
        Kind::Burst => T_BURST,
        Kind::Slam => 0.52,
        Kind::Roll { .. } => T_ROLL,
        Kind::Tick => 0.42,
    }
}

/// The colours a part had before an animation touched it, restored when it ends.
#[derive(Component)]
pub(super) struct Base {
    text: Option<Color>,
    bg: Option<Color>,
    border: Option<BorderColor>,
    img: Option<Color>,
    had_shadow: bool,
}

type Parts<'a> = (Option<&'a mut TextColor>, Option<&'a mut BackgroundColor>, Option<&'a mut BorderColor>, Option<&'a mut ImageNode>, Option<&'a mut TextShadow>, Option<&'a Base>, Has<Fade>);

pub(super) fn anim(
    time: Res<Time>,
    mut commands: Commands,
    window: Query<&Window, With<PrimaryWindow>>,
    mut roots: Query<(Entity, &mut Anim, &mut UiTransform)>,
    children: Query<&Children>,
    mut parts: Query<Parts>,
) {
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    let px = window.single().map(|w| w.height() / 1080.0).unwrap_or(1.0);
    // Animations nest (a page tunes in while each of its rows does): they share one Base per
    // node, so only the last one still covering a node restores it and lets the Base go.
    let subtree = |root: Entity| {
        let mut all = Vec::new();
        let mut stack = vec![root];
        while let Some(e) = stack.pop() {
            if let Ok(kids) = children.get(e) {
                stack.extend(kids.iter());
            }
            all.push(e);
        }
        all
    };
    // Bases made this frame (the insert lands at the end of the frame): a second animation
    // reaching the same node this frame must use the colours from before the first one
    let mut fresh: HashMap<Entity, Base> = HashMap::new();
    let mut cover: HashMap<Entity, u32> = HashMap::new();
    for (root, ..) in &roots {
        for e in subtree(root) {
            *cover.entry(e).or_default() += 1;
        }
    }
    for (root, mut a, mut tr) in &mut roots {
        let delay = a.delay;
        let start = *a.start.get_or_insert(now + delay);
        let t = ((now - start) / duration(a.kind)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let done = t >= 1.0 && now >= start;
        let (x, y, alpha, split) = if now < start { curve(a.kind, 0.0) } else { curve(a.kind, t) };
        tr.translation = if done { Val2::ZERO } else { Val2::new(vh(x), vh(y)) };
        if a.kind == Kind::Tick {
            tr.scale = Vec2::splat(if done { 1.0 } else { 1.0 + 0.14 * (1.0 - t).powi(3) });
        }
        let touches_alpha = !matches!(a.kind, Kind::Burst | Kind::Slam | Kind::Tick);
        // walk the subtree
        let mut stack = vec![root];
        while let Some(e) = stack.pop() {
            if let Ok(kids) = children.get(e) {
                stack.extend(kids.iter());
            }
            let Ok((text, bg, border, img, shadow, base, faded)) = parts.get_mut(e) else { continue };
            let b = match (base, fresh.get(&e)) {
                (Some(b), _) | (None, Some(b)) => Base { text: b.text, bg: b.bg, border: b.border, img: b.img, had_shadow: b.had_shadow },
                (None, None) => {
                    let b = Base { text: text.as_ref().map(|c| c.0), bg: bg.as_ref().map(|c| c.0), border: border.as_deref().copied(), img: img.as_ref().map(|i| i.color), had_shadow: shadow.is_some() };
                    commands.entity(e).insert(Base { ..b });
                    fresh.insert(e, Base { ..b });
                    b
                }
            };
            if done && cover.get(&e).copied().unwrap_or(1) > 1 {
                // another animation still runs here: it restores the node when it ends
                continue;
            }
            if done {
                if let (Some(mut c), Some(v)) = (text, b.text) {
                    c.0 = v;
                }
                if touches_alpha {
                    if let (Some(mut c), Some(v), false) = (bg, b.bg, faded) {
                        c.0 = v;
                    }
                    if let (Some(mut c), Some(v)) = (border, b.border) {
                        *c = v;
                    }
                    if let (Some(mut c), Some(v)) = (img, b.img) {
                        c.color = v;
                    }
                }
                if !b.had_shadow {
                    commands.entity(e).remove::<TextShadow>();
                }
                commands.entity(e).remove::<Base>();
                continue;
            }
            let k = (split / SPLIT_IN).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            if let (Some(mut c), Some(v)) = (text, b.text) {
                let tinted = v.mix(&CH_A, k * 0.6);
                c.0 = if touches_alpha { tinted.with_alpha(v.alpha() * alpha) } else { tinted };
                if !b.had_shadow {
                    let s = TextShadow { offset: Vec2::new(split * px, 0.0), color: CH_B.with_alpha(0.9 * alpha * k.min(1.0).max(if split > 0.3 { 0.4 } else { 0.0 })) };
                    match shadow {
                        Some(mut sh) => *sh = s,
                        None => {
                            commands.entity(e).insert(s);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if touches_alpha {
                if let (Some(mut c), Some(v), false) = (bg, b.bg, faded) {
                    c.0 = v.with_alpha(v.alpha() * alpha);
                }
                if let (Some(mut c), Some(v)) = (border, b.border) {
                    *c = BorderColor { top: v.top.with_alpha(v.top.alpha() * alpha), right: v.right.with_alpha(v.right.alpha() * alpha), bottom: v.bottom.with_alpha(v.bottom.alpha() * alpha), left: v.left.with_alpha(v.left.alpha() * alpha) };
                }
                if let (Some(mut c), Some(v)) = (img, b.img) {
                    c.color = v.with_alpha(v.alpha() * alpha);
                }
            }
        }
        if done {
            for e in subtree(root) {
                if let Some(n) = cover.get_mut(&e) {
                    *n -= 1;
                }
            }
            if a.kind == Kind::TuneOut {
                commands.entity(root).despawn();
            } else {
                commands.entity(root).remove::<Anim>();
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`client/src/ui/motion/blur.rs`:

```rs
//! Menus over the game: the game blurs (the 3D camera's depth of field), the shared scrim
//! dims it, a scanline sweeps once, and the HUD hides; closing reverses it.
use super::ease;
use crate::ui::tokens::*;
use bevy::post_process::dof::{DepthOfField, DepthOfFieldMode};
use bevy::prelude::*;

/// Put on the root of a menu or popup drawn over the game, with how dark the scrim gets.
#[derive(Component)]
pub struct Blurs(pub f32);

impl Default for Blurs {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Blurs(BACKDROP.alpha())
    }
}

/// True while a menu covers the game (the HUD hides under it).
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct Covered(pub bool);

/// HUD roots hidden while a menu covers the game (`Covered`). Parts that manage their own
/// visibility read `Covered` instead.
#[derive(Component)]
pub struct HudLayer;

// ---- menus over the game ------------------------------------------------------------------
/// The one full-screen dim behind every menu over the game (under them, over the HUD).
#[derive(Component)]
struct Scrim;
/// The scanline that sweeps down once when a menu opens.
#[derive(Component)]
struct Sweep;

fn spawn_scrim(mut commands: Commands) {
    let full = Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), height: percent(100), ..default() };
    commands.spawn((Scrim, full, BackgroundColor(Color::NONE), GlobalZIndex(Z_SCRIM), Pickable::IGNORE));
    commands.spawn((
        Sweep,
        Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, width: percent(100), height: px(2), top: percent(0), ..default() },
        BackgroundColor(Color::NONE),
        GlobalZIndex(Z_SCRIM),
        Pickable::IGNORE,
    ));
}

/// How covered the game is (0..1), the scrim's darkness, and when the last sweep started.
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
struct BlurLevel(f32, f32, Option<f32>, bool);

/// The 3D camera's depth of field doubles as a full-screen blur: everything is out of focus
/// and the strength is the largest blur size, eased with the level.
#[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]
fn blur(
    time: Res<Time>,
    mut level: ResMut<BlurLevel>,
    wanted: Query<&Blurs>,
    mut scrim: Query<&mut BackgroundColor, (With<Scrim>, Without<Sweep>)>,
    mut sweep: Query<(&mut Node, &mut BackgroundColor), With<Sweep>>,
    mut hud: Query<&mut Visibility, With<HudLayer>>,
    mut covered_flag: ResMut<Covered>,
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut cams: Query<(Entity, Option<&mut DepthOfField>), With<Camera3d>>,
) {
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    let covered = !wanted.is_empty();
    if covered && !level.3 {
        level.2 = Some(now);
    }
    level.3 = covered;
    if let Some(dim) = wanted.iter().map(|b| b.0).reduce(f32::max) {
        level.1 = dim;
    }
    let target = if covered { 1.0 } else { 0.0 };
    let k = ease(time.delta_secs(), T_BLUR / 3.0);
    level.0 += (target - level.0) * k;
    if (level.0 - target).abs() < 0.01 {
        level.0 = target;
    }
    for mut bg in &mut scrim {
        bg.0 = BACKDROP.with_alpha(level.1 * level.0);
    }
    // the sweep: 420 ms down the screen, fading
    for (mut node, mut bg) in &mut sweep {
        let t = level.2.map(|s| ((now - s) / 0.42).clamp(0.0, 1.0)).unwrap_or(1.0);
        let e = 1.0 - (1.0 - t).powi(3);
        node.top = percent(100.0 * e);
        bg.0 = TX1.with_alpha(0.35 * (1.0 - t));
    }
    let hide = level.0 > 0.5;
    covered_flag.0 = hide;
    for mut v in &mut hud {
        let want = if hide { Visibility::Hidden } else { Visibility::Inherited };
        if *v != want {
            *v = want;
        }
    }
    for (cam, dof) in &mut cams {
        match (dof, level.0 > 0.0) {
            (Some(mut d), true) => d.max_circle_of_confusion_diameter = 24.0 * level.0,
            (None, true) => {
                commands.entity(cam).insert(DepthOfField { mode: DepthOfFieldMode::Gaussian, focal_distance: 0.5, aperture_f_stops: 0.02, max_circle_of_confusion_diameter: 24.0 * level.0, ..default() });
            }
            (Some(_), false) => {
                commands.entity(cam).remove::<DepthOfField>();
            }
            (None, false) => {}
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn plugin(app: &mut App) {
    app.init_resource::<BlurLevel>().init_resource::<Covered>().add_systems(Startup, spawn_scrim).add_systems(Update, blur);
}
```

`client/src/ui/motion/live.rs`:

```rs
//! Live values on the HUD (design/mockups/ui: hud.js, components.css "the HUD, alive"):
//! - `Edge`: the light on a HUD panel's top edge, in your side's colour (or a fixed one).
//!   Quiet at rest; `flare()` lights it full and it settles; `alert` turns it red; `beat`
//!   makes it pulse like a heartbeat.
//! - `Meter`: a bar whose fill drops at once while a light trail shows what was lost and
//!   drains after it (going up, the trail jumps with it).
//! - `Count`: a number that counts to its new value instead of jumping.
//! - `Tint`: HUD glass takes a faint tint of your side; your own rows a faint amber.
//! `Side` says which side you're on; the game sets it, everything here follows.
use super::ease;
use crate::ui::kit::vh;
use crate::ui::tokens::*;
use bevy::prelude::*;

/// Your side's colour (Bureau cyan, Strays pink), or None when you're on neither.
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct Side(pub Option<Color>);

/// The glass tint a HUD surface takes.
#[derive(Component, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum Tint {
    /// A faint tint of your side.
    Team,
    /// Yours (your kill, your voice): a faint amber.
    You,
}

fn tint(side: Res<Side>, mut q: Query<(&Tint, &mut BackgroundColor)>) {
    for (t, mut bg) in &mut q {
        let want = match (t, side.0) {
            (Tint::You, _) => HUD_BG.mix(&AMBER, 0.10),
            (Tint::Team, Some(c)) => HUD_BG.mix(&c, 0.07),
            (Tint::Team, None) => HUD_BG,
        };
        if bg.0 != want {
            bg.0 = want;
        }
    }
}

// ---- the edge light -------------------------------------------------------------------------
/// What colour an edge light is.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum EdgeColor {
    Team,
    Fixed(Color),
}

/// How bright an edge rests (0..1).
pub const EDGE_REST: f32 = 0.35;
/// How long a flare takes to settle.
const T_FLARE: f32 = 0.6;

#[derive(Component)]
pub struct Edge {
    pub color: EdgeColor,
    pub rest: f32,
    /// Red: something needs you (a hit, low health, the last seconds).
    pub alert: bool,
    /// Pulse like a heartbeat (low health).
    pub beat: bool,
    level: f32,
    drawn: Option<(Color, u8)>,
}

impl Edge {
    pub fn flare(&mut self) {
        self.level = 1.0;
    }
}

/// The edge light, as a child of the panel it lights.
pub fn edge(color: EdgeColor, rest: f32) -> impl Bundle {
    (
        Edge { color, rest, alert: false, beat: false, level: rest, drawn: None },
        Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, left: vh(12.0), right: vh(12.0), top: px(0), height: vh(2.0), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(px(1)), ..default() },
        BackgroundGradient::default(),
        ZIndex(1),
        Pickable::IGNORE,
    )
}

/// The light fading out at both ends, at `alpha`.
fn edge_gradient(c: Color, alpha: f32) -> BackgroundGradient {
    let on = c.with_alpha(alpha);
    let off = c.with_alpha(0.0);
    BackgroundGradient::from(LinearGradient::to_right(vec![ColorStop::percent(off, 0.0), ColorStop::percent(on, 25.0), ColorStop::percent(on, 75.0), ColorStop::percent(off, 100.0)]))
}

/// A heartbeat: two quick pulses, then rest (1.1 s).
fn heartbeat(t: f32) -> f32 {
    let p = (t / 1.1).fract();
    let keys = [(0.0, 0.0), (0.08, 1.0), (0.18, 0.15), (0.28, 0.85), (0.6, 0.0), (1.0, 0.0)];
    for w in keys.windows(2) {
        let ((t0, v0), (t1, v1)) = (w[0], w[1]);
        if p <= t1 {
            return v0 + (v1 - v0) * (p - t0) / (t1 - t0);
        }
    }
    0.0
}

fn edges(time: Res<Time>, side: Res<Side>, mut q: Query<(&mut Edge, &mut BackgroundGradient)>) {
    let k = ease(time.delta_secs(), T_FLARE / 3.0);
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    for (mut e, mut g) in &mut q {
        let rest = e.rest;
        e.level += (rest - e.level) * k;
        let level = if e.beat { e.level.max(rest + (1.0 - rest) * heartbeat(now)) } else { e.level };
        let c = if e.alert {
            BAD
        } else {
            match e.color {
                EdgeColor::Fixed(c) => c,
                EdgeColor::Team => side.0.unwrap_or(LINE_3),
            }
        };
        // only rebuild the gradient when it visibly changed
        let key = (c, (level * 64.0) as u8);
        if e.drawn != Some(key) {
            e.drawn = Some(key);
            *g = edge_gradient(c, level);
        }
    }
}

// ---- meters ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/// How long the trail waits before it drains, and how fast it drains.
const TRAIL_HOLD: f32 = 0.28;
const T_TRAIL: f32 = 0.42;

#[derive(Component)]
pub struct Meter {
    /// 0..1
    pub value: f32,
    pub color: Color,
    shown: f32,
    trail: f32,
    drain_at: f32,
    fill: Entity,
    trail_node: Entity,
}

/// A meter `width` wide (1080p px) in `color`, with its trail; returns the meter.
pub fn meter(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, width: f32, color: Color, value: f32) -> Entity {
    let bar = |w: f32| Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, left: px(0), top: px(0), bottom: px(0), width: percent(w * 100.0), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(px(2)), ..default() };
    let mut track = p.spawn((Node { width: vh(width), height: vh(4.0), margin: UiRect::top(vh(10.0)), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(px(2)), overflow: Overflow::clip(), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(LINE_2)));
    let (mut fill, mut trail) = (Entity::PLACEHOLDER, Entity::PLACEHOLDER);
    track.with_children(|t| {
        trail = t.spawn((bar(value), BackgroundColor(TX1.with_alpha(0.5)))).id();
        fill = t.spawn((bar(value), BackgroundColor(color))).id();
    });
    track.insert(Meter { value, color, shown: value, trail: value, drain_at: 0.0, fill, trail_node: trail });
    track.id()
}

fn meters(time: Res<Time>, mut q: Query<&mut Meter>, mut nodes: Query<(&mut Node, &mut BackgroundColor)>) {
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    let dt = time.delta_secs();
    for mut m in &mut q {
        let v = m.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        m.shown += (v - m.shown) * ease(dt, 0.04);
        if v >= m.trail {
            m.trail = v;
            m.drain_at = now + TRAIL_HOLD;
        } else if now >= m.drain_at {
            m.trail += (v - m.trail) * ease(dt, T_TRAIL / 3.0);
        }
        let (shown, trail, color) = (m.shown, m.trail, m.color);
        if let Ok((mut n, mut bg)) = nodes.get_mut(m.fill) {
            n.width = percent(shown * 100.0);
            bg.set_if_neq(BackgroundColor(color));
        }
        if let Ok((mut n, _)) = nodes.get_mut(m.trail_node) {
            n.width = percent(trail * 100.0);
        }
    }
}

// ---- numbers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/// A whole number that counts to `target` (about `tau` seconds per third of the way).
#[derive(Component)]
pub struct Count {
    pub target: f32,
    pub tau: f32,
    shown: f32,
}

impl Count {
    pub fn new(value: f32, tau: f32) -> Count {
        Count { target: value, tau, shown: value }
    }
}

fn counts(time: Res<Time>, mut q: Query<(&mut Count, &mut Text)>) {
    let dt = time.delta_secs();
    for (mut c, mut t) in &mut q {
        let target = c.target;
        c.shown += (target - c.shown) * ease(dt, c.tau);
        if (target - c.shown).abs() < 0.5 {
            c.shown = target;
        }
        let s = format!("{:.0}", c.shown);
        if t.0 != s {
            t.0 = s;
        }
    }
}

// ---- opening in place ---------------------------------------------------------------------
/// A part that opens and closes in place (status icons): its width eases between 0 and
/// `size` (1080p px) and it clips what's inside, so its neighbours slide over smoothly.
#[derive(Component)]
pub struct Opens {
    pub open: bool,
    pub size: f32,
    shown: f32,
}

impl Opens {
    pub fn new(open: bool, size: f32) -> Opens {
        Opens { open, size, shown: if open { 1.0 } else { 0.0 } }
    }
}

fn opens(time: Res<Time>, mut q: Query<(&mut Opens, &mut Node)>) {
    let k = ease(time.delta_secs(), T_SLIDE / 3.0);
    for (mut o, mut n) in &mut q {
        let target = if o.open { 1.0 } else { 0.0 };
        o.shown += (target - o.shown) * k;
        if (target - o.shown).abs() < 0.01 {
            o.shown = target;
        }
        let w = vh(o.size * o.shown);
        if n.width != w {
            n.width = w;
        }
    }
}

pub(super) fn plugin(app: &mut App) {
    app.init_resource::<Side>().add_systems(Update, (tint, edges, meters, counts, opens));
}
```

`client/src/ui/motion/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Motion (design/mockups/ui/motion.css). Calm at rest; every change tunes in. Everything is
//! eased per frame from the real clock, so it runs the same at any frame rate.
//! - `Anim::tune_in` / `tune_out`: a part enters split into its two channels and settles clean
//!   (320 ms), or leaves the same way faster (180 ms, then it is despawned). The whole subtree
//!   fades and its text splits: a pink copy beside it, the text itself tinted cyan.
//! - `Anim::burst`: a hover or a choice: a 240 ms jitter and split that settles fully clean.
//! - `Anim::roll`: a stepped value rolls in from the side it moved toward.
//! - `Slide`: one selection per list or chip group, sliding (280 ms) to the chosen item.
//! - `Fade` / `FadeBorder`: a background or frame eases to its target colour (hovers).
//! - `Pulse`: live markers breathe.
//! - `Blurs`: a menu over the game. The game blurs, the shared scrim dims it, a scanline
//!   sweeps once, and the HUD (`HudLayer`) hides; closing reverses it.
mod anim;
mod blur;
mod live;

pub use anim::Anim;
pub use blur::{Blurs, Covered, HudLayer};
pub use live::*;

use super::tokens::*;
use bevy::prelude::*;
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// The background colour a node eases toward.
#[derive(Component)]
pub struct Fade(pub Color);

/// The frame colour a node eases toward.
#[derive(Component)]
pub struct FadeBorder(pub Color);

/// Breathe: the background's alpha swings between `low` and full.
#[derive(Component)]
pub struct Pulse {
    pub base: Color,
    pub low: f32,
}

impl Pulse {
    pub fn new(base: Color) -> Pulse {
        Pulse { base, low: 0.35 }
    }
}

/// A sliding selection: this node moves to cover `target` (a sibling inside the same parent).
/// Its last place is remembered under `key`, so a rebuilt list slides on from where it was.
#[derive(Component)]
pub struct Slide {
    pub key: String,
    pub target: Entity,
}

/// What the UI remembers across rebuilds: where each selection was, each shown value.
#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct UiMemory {
    rects: HashMap<String, (Vec2, Vec2)>,
    values: HashMap<String, String>,
}

impl UiMemory {
    /// Remember `value` under `key`; true if it differs from last time (and there was one).
    pub fn changed(&mut self, key: &str, value: &str) -> bool {
        match self.values.insert(key.to_string(), value.to_string()) {
            Some(old) => old != value,
            None => false,
        }
    }
    /// The previous value under `key`, if any.
    pub fn previous(&self, key: &str) -> Option<&str> {
        self.values.get(key).map(|s| s.as_str())
    }
}

/// Ease factor for a time constant: about 95% of the way in 3 τ, at any frame rate.
pub fn ease(dt: f32, tau: f32) -> f32 {
    1.0 - (-dt / tau).exp()
}

pub(crate) fn lerp_color(a: Color, b: Color, k: f32) -> Color {
    let (a, b) = (a.to_srgba(), b.to_srgba());
    let m = |x: f32, y: f32| if (y - x).abs() < 0.002 { y } else { x + (y - x) * k };
    Color::srgba(m(a.red, b.red), m(a.green, b.green), m(a.blue, b.blue), m(a.alpha, b.alpha))
}

fn fade(time: Res<Time>, mut q: Query<(Option<&Fade>, Option<&FadeBorder>, Option<&mut BackgroundColor>, Option<&mut BorderColor>), Or<(With<Fade>, With<FadeBorder>)>>) {
    let k = ease(time.delta_secs(), T_HOVER / 3.0);
    for (f, fb, bg, border) in &mut q {
        if let (Some(f), Some(mut bg)) = (f, bg) {
            if bg.0 != f.0 {
                bg.0 = lerp_color(bg.0, f.0, k);
            }
        }
        if let (Some(fb), Some(mut b)) = (fb, border) {
            if b.top != fb.0 {
                *b = BorderColor::all(lerp_color(b.top, fb.0, k));
            }
        }
    }
}

fn slide(time: Res<Time>, mut memory: ResMut<UiMemory>, mut inds: Query<(&Slide, &mut Node, &ChildOf)>, nodes: Query<(&ComputedNode, &UiGlobalTransform)>) {
    let k = ease(time.delta_secs(), T_SLIDE / 3.0);
    for (s, mut node, parent) in &mut inds {
        let (Ok((tn, tt)), Ok((pn, pt))) = (nodes.get(s.target), nodes.get(parent.parent())) else { continue };
        if tn.size.x <= 0.0 {
            continue;
        }
        let inv = tn.inverse_scale_factor;
        let corner = |n: &ComputedNode, t: &UiGlobalTransform| t.affine().translation - n.size / 2.0;
        let pos = (corner(tn, tt) - corner(pn, pt)) * inv;
        let size = tn.size * inv;
        let cur = memory.rects.entry(s.key.clone()).or_insert((pos, size));
        cur.0 += (pos - cur.0) * k;
        cur.1 += (size - cur.1) * k;
        let (p, z) = *cur;
        node.left = px(p.x);
        node.top = px(p.y);
        node.width = px(z.x);
        node.height = px(z.y);
    }
}

fn pulse(time: Res<Time>, mut q: Query<(&Pulse, &mut BackgroundColor)>) {
    let s = (time.elapsed_secs() * std::f32::consts::TAU / 1.6).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5;
    for (p, mut bg) in &mut q {
        bg.0 = p.base.with_alpha(p.base.alpha() * (p.low + (1.0 - p.low) * s));
    }
}

pub(super) fn plugin(app: &mut App) {
    app.init_resource::<UiMemory>().add_systems(Update, (fade, anim::anim, slide, pulse));
    blur::plugin(app);
    live::plugin(app);
}
```

`client/src/ui/panels.rs`:

```rs
//! Surfaces: softened corners, lit from above, sitting at a height (`elevation`). The anchor rule: a part on a screen edge mirrors to it,
//! so its content and its amber bar (you, or the main action) sit on the outer side; each
//! screen applies it with `UiRect::left` / `right(vh(BAR))`.
use super::kit::vh;
use super::motion::Tint;
use super::tokens::{AMBER, BAR, BG1, GAP, HUD_BG, LINE, RADIUS, RADIUS_S};
use bevy::prelude::*;

/// Softened corners on any node.
pub fn soft(node: Node) -> Node {
    Node { border_radius: BorderRadius::all(vh(RADIUS)), ..node }
}

/// How high a surface sits (light from above): 1 panels and rows, 2 raised (toasts, chosen
/// cards), 3 overlays. Each height is the slab's own edge (solid, a few px under it, so it reads
/// on any background) and its soft shadow, farther the higher it sits (tokens.css --e1..3).
pub fn elevation(h: u8) -> BoxShadow {
    let (edge, near, far, far_a) = match h {
        // (Bevy's shadow blur spreads wider than the browser's: about half the mockup's numbers)
        0 | 1 => (3.0, 6.0, 14.0, 0.26),
        2 => (4.0, 8.0, 24.0, 0.34),
        _ => (6.0, 12.0, 40.0, 0.46),
    };
    let s = |y: f32, blur: f32, a: f32| ShadowStyle { color: Color::srgba(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, a), x_offset: px(0), y_offset: vh(y), spread_radius: px(0), blur_radius: vh(blur) };
    BoxShadow(vec![
        ShadowStyle { color: Color::srgba(0.012, 0.016, 0.024, 0.55), x_offset: px(0), y_offset: vh(edge), spread_radius: px(0), blur_radius: px(0) },
        s(edge * 2.0, near, 0.25),
        s(edge * 4.0, far, far_a),
    ])
}

/// A panel's height off what's behind it (`elevation(1)`).
pub fn lift() -> BoxShadow {
    elevation(1)
}

/// The light from above on a surface: a touch lighter at the top, a touch darker at the
/// bottom, drawn over its fill (tokens.css --lit).
pub fn lit() -> BackgroundGradient {
    BackgroundGradient::from(LinearGradient::to_bottom(vec![
        ColorStop::percent(Color::srgba(0.918, 0.949, 0.973, 0.05), 0.0),
        ColorStop::percent(Color::srgba(0.918, 0.949, 0.973, 0.0), 45.0),
        ColorStop::percent(Color::srgba(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.14), 100.0),
    ]))
}

/// A panel drawn over the game: dark glass, softened, lit, lifted, tinted by your side.
pub fn hud_panel(node: Node) -> impl Bundle {
    (soft(node), BackgroundColor(HUD_BG), lit(), lift(), Tint::Team)
}

/// Which side of the screen a part hugs (where its amber bar goes).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum Outer {
    Left,
    Right,
}

/// A feed row (kill feed, voices): HUD glass with the small corners. Yours is tinted amber
/// and wears the amber bar on its outer side, inside the same padding, so its content lines
/// up with the other rows'.
pub fn feed_row(height: f32, you: bool, outer: Outer) -> impl Bundle {
    let bar = if you { vh(BAR) } else { px(0) };
    let pad = |on: bool| vh(if on && you { GAP - BAR } else { GAP });
    let (border, padding) = match outer {
        Outer::Left => (UiRect::left(bar), UiRect { left: pad(true), right: pad(false), ..default() }),
        Outer::Right => (UiRect::right(bar), UiRect { left: pad(false), right: pad(true), ..default() }),
    };
    (
        Node { height: vh(height), align_items: AlignItems::Center, column_gap: vh(12.0), padding, border, border_radius: BorderRadius::all(vh(RADIUS_S)), ..default() },
        BackgroundColor(HUD_BG),
        BorderColor::all(AMBER),
        lit(),
        lift(),
        if you { Tint::You } else { Tint::Team },
    )
}

/// A card: a choice with content (buy items, party slots, sides). Selected cards wear the
/// amber frame on an amber wash; the others a quiet frame.
pub fn card(node: Node, selected: bool) -> impl Bundle {
    let border = UiRect::all(vh(if selected { 2.0 } else { 1.0 }));
    (soft(Node { border, ..node }), BackgroundColor(if selected { BG1.mix(&AMBER, 0.08) } else { BG1 }), BorderColor::all(if selected { AMBER } else { LINE }), lit(), elevation(if selected { 2 } else { 1 }))
}
```

`client/src/ui/sound.rs`:

```rs
//! UI sounds, made here instead of loaded (design/mockups/ui ai.js `tone`): short soft
//! triangle blips, quiet so footsteps stay clear. Send a `UiSound`; it plays at the game's
//! volume.
use crate::menu::Settings;
use bevy::audio::{PlaybackSettings, Volume};
use bevy::prelude::*;
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// A UI sound to play.
#[derive(Message, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum UiSound {
    /// The assistant's channel opening (rises), the Twins handing over (one blip), closing
    /// (falls); each assistant has its own pitch (Hz).
    Open(f32),
    Hand(f32),
    Close(f32),
    /// The round timer's last seconds.
    Tick,
    /// A match found: three rising notes.
    Found,
    /// A status icon appearing (buy zone, kit) or going.
    On,
    Off,
}

impl UiSound {
    /// (tones in Hz one after another, loudness)
    fn tones(self) -> (Vec<f32>, f32) {
        match self {
            UiSound::Open(f) => (vec![f, f * 1.5], 0.35),
            UiSound::Hand(f) => (vec![f * 1.5], 0.35),
            UiSound::Close(f) => (vec![f * 1.25, f * 0.84], 0.3),
            UiSound::Tick => (vec![1320.0], 0.2),
            UiSound::Found => (vec![660.0, 880.0, 1320.0], 0.5),
            UiSound::On => (vec![880.0], 0.18),
            UiSound::Off => (vec![660.0], 0.18),
        }
    }
}

const RATE: u32 = 22050;
/// Each blip: 8 ms attack, then a fast fall over 90 ms; the next starts 60 ms later.
const GAP: f32 = 0.06;
const LEN: f32 = 0.09;

/// Blips as a 16-bit mono WAV file.
fn wav(tones: &[f32]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let total = GAP * (tones.len() - 1) as f32 + LEN + 0.02;
    let n = (total * RATE as f32) as usize;
    let mut pcm = vec![0f32; n];
    for (k, f) in tones.iter().enumerate() {
        let start = (k as f32 * GAP * RATE as f32) as usize;
        for i in 0..((LEN * RATE as f32) as usize) {
            let t = i as f32 / RATE as f32;
            let env = if t < 0.008 { t / 0.008 } else { (-(t - 0.008) / 0.018).exp() };
            // triangle wave
            let ph = (t * f).fract();
            let tri = 4.0 * (ph - 0.5).abs() - 1.0;
            if let Some(s) = pcm.get_mut(start + i) {
                *s += tri * env;
            }
        }
    }
    let data: Vec<u8> = pcm.iter().flat_map(|s| (((s * 0.5).clamp(-1.0, 1.0) * i16::MAX as f32) as i16).to_le_bytes()).collect();
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(44 + data.len());
    let u32le = |v: u32| v.to_le_bytes();
    out.extend_from_slice(b"RIFF");
    out.extend_from_slice(&u32le(36 + data.len() as u32));
    out.extend_from_slice(b"WAVEfmt ");
    out.extend_from_slice(&u32le(16));
    out.extend_from_slice(&1u16.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&1u16.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&u32le(RATE));
    out.extend_from_slice(&u32le(RATE * 2));
    out.extend_from_slice(&2u16.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&16u16.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(b"data");
    out.extend_from_slice(&u32le(data.len() as u32));
    out.extend_from_slice(&data);
    out
}

#[derive(Resource, Default)]
struct Made(HashMap<Vec<u32>, Handle<AudioSource>>);

fn play(mut commands: Commands, mut msgs: MessageReader<UiSound>, mut made: ResMut<Made>, mut assets: ResMut<Assets<AudioSource>>, settings: Option<Res<Settings>>) {
    let volume = settings.map(|s| s.volume).unwrap_or(1.0);
    for s in msgs.read() {
        let (tones, loud) = s.tones();
        let key: Vec<u32> = tones.iter().map(|f| f.round() as u32).collect();
        let handle = made.0.entry(key).or_insert_with(|| assets.add(AudioSource { bytes: wav(&tones).into() })).clone();
        commands.spawn((AudioPlayer(handle), PlaybackSettings::DESPAWN.with_volume(Volume::Linear(volume * loud))));
    }
}

pub(super) fn plugin(app: &mut App) {
    app.add_message::<UiSound>().init_resource::<Made>().add_systems(Update, play);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn blips_are_a_valid_wav() {
        let w = wav(&[660.0, 990.0]);
        assert_eq!(&w[0..4], b"RIFF");
        assert_eq!(&w[8..12], b"WAVE");
        let data = u32::from_le_bytes(w[40..44].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
        assert_eq!(w.len(), 44 + data);
        // 2 blips: 60 ms + 90 ms + 20 ms of tail
        assert_eq!(data / 2, ((GAP + LEN + 0.02) * RATE as f32) as usize);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Design tokens: Interference (docs/UI.md, design/mockups/ui/tokens.css name for name). The UI

/// One step of the type scale: which font, what size.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Type {
    /// Wordmark, hero names (Big Shoulders 150).
    Display,
    /// Page titles (Big Shoulders 52).
    H2,
    /// Section and card titles (Chakra Petch 28).
    H3,
    /// Running text (Chakra Petch 18).
    Body,
    /// Small caps labels (Chakra Petch 13, uppercase).
    Label,
    /// Japanese subtitle (Noto Sans JP 13).
    Jp,
    /// Numbers, large / medium / small (JetBrains Mono 56 / 32 / 18).
    NumL,
    NumM,
    NumS,
}

impl Type {
    pub fn size(self) -> f32 {
        match self {
            Type::Display => 150.0,
            Type::H2 => 52.0,
            Type::H3 => 28.0,
            Type::Body => 18.0,
            Type::Label | Type::Jp => 13.0,
            Type::NumL => 56.0,
            Type::NumM => 32.0,
            Type::NumS => 18.0,
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Widgets (design/mockups/ui/components.css). Buttons are framed, never filled solid. Every
//! pressable thing bursts when hovered and when pressed, and reports its click as a `UiAction`.
//! Lists and chip groups have one sliding selection.
use super::kit::{kit_text, t, vh, Kit};
use super::motion::{Anim, Fade, FadeBorder, Slide, UiMemory};
use super::tokens::*;
use super::{UiAction, UiActions};
use bevy::prelude::*;

/// Hover: ease to the hover wash and frame and burst once; leave: ease back.
pub fn hoverable(e: &mut EntityCommands, bg: (Color, Color), border: (Color, Color)) {
    e.insert((Fade(bg.0), FadeBorder(border.0)))
        .observe(move |ev: On<PointerOver>, mut q: Query<(&mut Fade, &mut FadeBorder)>, mut commands: Commands| {
            if let Ok((mut f, mut b)) = q.get_mut(ev.entity) {
                f.0 = bg.1;
                b.0 = border.1;
                commands.entity(ev.entity).insert(Anim::burst());
            }
        })
        .observe(move |ev: On<PointerOut>, mut q: Query<(&mut Fade, &mut FadeBorder)>| {
            if let Ok((mut f, mut b)) = q.get_mut(ev.entity) {
                f.0 = bg.0;
                b.0 = border.0;
            }
        });
}

/// Click → `UiAction`, with a burst.
pub fn pressable(e: &mut EntityCommands, action: UiAction) {
    e.observe(move |ev: On<PointerClick>, mut actions: ResMut<UiActions>, mut commands: Commands| {
        actions.0.push(action.clone());
        commands.entity(ev.entity).insert(Anim::burst());
    });
}

/// Hover and click for a card or row whose look is its own: only the hover wash changes.
pub fn clickable(e: &mut EntityCommands, action: UiAction, base: Color, _selected: bool) {
    let hover = if base == Color::NONE { HOVER } else { base.mix(&TX1, 0.04) };
    e.insert((Fade(base), BackgroundColor(base)))
        .observe(move |ev: On<PointerOver>, mut q: Query<&mut Fade>, mut commands: Commands| {
            if let Ok(mut f) = q.get_mut(ev.entity) {
                f.0 = hover;
                commands.entity(ev.entity).insert(Anim::burst());
            }
        })
        .observe(move |ev: On<PointerOut>, mut q: Query<&mut Fade>| {
            if let Ok(mut f) = q.get_mut(ev.entity) {
                f.0 = base;
            }
        });
    pressable(e, action);
}

/// Hover and click for a card that keeps its own frame colour.
pub fn clickable_keep_border(e: &mut EntityCommands, action: UiAction, base: Color) {
    clickable(e, action, base, false);
}

/// A hairline between list rows.
pub fn hairline(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands) {
    p.spawn((Node { height: px(1), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(LINE)));
}

/// One row of a numbered list.
pub struct NavItem<'a> {
    pub num: &'a str,
    pub label: &'a str,
    pub jp: &'a str,
    pub action: UiAction,
    pub selected: bool,
}

/// A numbered list (main menu, buy categories, Esc menu) with one sliding selection: an amber
/// wash with the amber bar. `key` names it so a rebuilt list slides on from where it was.
pub fn nav(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, key: &str, items: Vec<NavItem>, compact: bool) {
    p.spawn(Node { flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column, ..default() }).with_children(|col| {
        let ind = col.spawn((Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, border: UiRect::left(vh(BAR)), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(vh(RADIUS_S)), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(AMBER_WASH), BorderColor::all(AMBER), Pickable::IGNORE)).id();
        let mut chosen = None;
        for it in items {
            hairline(col);
            let color = if it.selected { AMBER } else { TX1 };
            let node = Node { height: vh(if compact { 64.0 } else { 76.0 }), align_items: AlignItems::Center, column_gap: vh(PAD), padding: UiRect::left(vh(20.0)), border: UiRect::left(vh(BAR)), ..default() };
            let mut e = col.spawn((node, BackgroundColor(Color::NONE), BorderColor::all(Color::NONE)));
            e.with_children(|r| {
                r.spawn((t(kit, Type::Label, it.num, if it.selected { AMBER } else { TX2 }), Node { width: vh(PAD), ..default() }, Pickable::IGNORE));
                r.spawn((kit_text(it.label.to_uppercase(), if compact { 36.0 } else { 52.0 }, color, &kit.display), Pickable::IGNORE));
                if !it.jp.is_empty() {
                    r.spawn((t(kit, Type::Jp, it.jp, TX3), Pickable::IGNORE));
                }
            });
            if it.selected {
                chosen = Some(e.id());
            } else {
                hoverable(&mut e, (Color::NONE, HOVER), (Color::NONE, LINE_3));
            }
            pressable(&mut e, it.action);
        }
        hairline(col);
        match chosen {
            Some(target) => {
                col.commands().entity(ind).insert(Slide { key: key.to_string(), target });
            }
            None => {
                col.commands().entity(ind).insert(Visibility::Hidden);
            }
        }
    });
}

/// One option: framed; hover brightens the frame. `framed`: a lone chip draws its own amber
/// selection; in a group the sliding selection draws it.
fn chip_node(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, label: &str, action: UiAction, selected: bool, framed: bool, lead: impl FnOnce(&mut ChildSpawnerCommands)) -> Entity {
    let frame = if selected && framed { AMBER } else if selected { Color::NONE } else { LINE_2 };
    let bg = if selected && framed { AMBER_WASH } else { Color::NONE };
    let node = Node { height: vh(44.0), padding: UiRect::horizontal(vh(18.0)), column_gap: vh(10.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, border: UiRect::all(px(1)), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(vh(RADIUS_S)), ..default() };
    let mut e = p.spawn((node, BackgroundColor(bg), BorderColor::all(frame)));
    e.with_children(|c| {
        lead(c);
        c.spawn((kit_text(label.to_uppercase(), 13.0, if selected { AMBER } else { TX2 }, &kit.text), Pickable::IGNORE));
    });
    if !selected {
        hoverable(&mut e, (Color::NONE, HOVER), (LINE_2, LINE_3));
    }
    pressable(&mut e, action);
    e.id()
}

/// A single framed choice (toast buttons, Invite). Selected: amber frame and text.
pub fn chip(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, label: &str, action: UiAction, selected: bool) {
    chip_node(p, kit, label, action, selected, true, |_| {});
}

/// A lone chip with a fixed width (a column of actions that must line up).
pub fn chip_w(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, label: &str, action: UiAction, width: f32) {
    let id = chip_node(p, kit, label, action, false, true, |_| {});
    p.commands().entity(id).entry::<Node>().and_modify(move |mut n| n.width = vh(width));
}

/// A key binding: a fixed-width chip with the key; amber while it waits for a new one.
pub fn key_chip(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, label: &str, action: UiAction, waiting: bool) {
    let id = chip_node(p, kit, label, action, waiting, true, |_| {});
    p.commands().entity(id).entry::<Node>().and_modify(|mut n| n.width = vh(136.0));
}

/// A choice in a group; `lead` draws something before the label (an assistant portrait).
pub struct Choice<'a> {
    pub label: &'a str,
    pub action: UiAction,
    pub selected: bool,
    pub lead: Option<Box<dyn FnOnce(&mut ChildSpawnerCommands) + 'a>>,
}

impl<'a> Choice<'a> {
    pub fn new(label: &'a str, action: UiAction, selected: bool) -> Choice<'a> {
        Choice { label, action, selected, lead: None }
    }
}

/// A row of choices with one sliding selection (amber frame on an amber wash).
pub fn chips(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, key: &str, options: Vec<Choice>) {
    // one line, always: groups are sized to fit their row
    p.spawn(Node { column_gap: vh(GAP_S), align_items: AlignItems::Center, flex_shrink: 0.0, ..default() }).with_children(|g| {
        let ind = g.spawn((Node { position_type: PositionType::Absolute, border: UiRect::all(px(1)), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(vh(RADIUS_S)), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(AMBER_WASH), BorderColor::all(AMBER), Pickable::IGNORE)).id();
        let mut chosen = None;
        for o in options {
            let lead = o.lead;
            let id = chip_node(g, kit, o.label, o.action, o.selected, false, |c| {
                if let Some(f) = lead {
                    f(c);
                }
            });
            if o.selected {
                chosen = Some(id);
            }
        }
        match chosen {
            Some(target) => {
                g.commands().entity(ind).insert(Slide { key: key.to_string(), target });
            }
            None => {
                g.commands().entity(ind).insert(Visibility::Hidden);
            }
        }
    });
}

/// "−  value  +". When the value changed since last shown, it rolls in from the side it moved
/// toward.
pub fn stepper(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, memory: &mut UiMemory, key: &str, value: &str, minus: UiAction, plus: UiAction) {
    let num = |s: &str| s.trim_end_matches(['%', ' ']).parse::<f32>().ok();
    let up = memory.previous(key).and_then(num).zip(num(value)).map(|(a, b)| b > a);
    let changed = memory.changed(key, value);
    p.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Center, column_gap: vh(GAP_S), ..default() }).with_children(|r| {
        chip_node(r, kit, "−", minus, false, true, |_| {});
        let bx = Node { min_width: vh(96.0), height: vh(44.0), border_radius: BorderRadius::all(vh(RADIUS_S)), justify_content: JustifyContent::Center, align_items: AlignItems::Center, border: UiRect::bottom(px(1)), overflow: Overflow::clip(), ..default() };
        r.spawn((bx, BorderColor::all(LINE_2))).with_children(|v| {
            let mut e = v.spawn(kit_text(value, 20.0, TX1, &kit.num));
            if changed {
                e.insert(Anim::roll(up.unwrap_or(true)));
            }
        });
        chip_node(r, kit, "+", plus, false, true, |_| {});
    });
}

/// One settings row: name on the left, controls on the right, hairline above.
pub fn setting_row(p: &mut ChildSpawnerCommands, kit: &Kit, name: &str, controls: impl FnOnce(&mut ChildSpawnerCommands)) -> Entity {
    p.spawn((Node { min_height: vh(60.0), align_items: AlignItems::Center, padding: UiRect::vertical(vh(GAP_S)), border: UiRect::top(px(1)), ..default() }, BorderColor::all(LINE))).with_children(|r| {
        r.spawn((kit_text(name.to_uppercase(), 22.0, TX1, &kit.text), Node { width: vh(360.0), flex_shrink: 0.0, ..default() }));
        r.spawn(Node { align_items: AlignItems::Center, column_gap: vh(GAP_S), ..default() }).with_children(controls);
    })
    .id()
}
```

`client/src/viewmodel.rs`:

```rs
//! The weapon in your hands (CS `v_` models): drawn by its own camera so it never
//! sinks into walls, animated from what you do (draw, shoot, reload, ...).
use crate::models::{set_pose, weapon_model, Loaded, ModelCache, SpawnedSkin};
use crate::game::{Frame, Walker};
use crate::menu::AppState;
use bevy::camera::visibility::RenderLayers;
use bevy::mesh::skinning::SkinnedMeshInverseBindposes;
use bevy::prelude::*;
use sim::weapons::{Fired, Id};
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Render layer for the view model and its camera.
const LAYER: usize = 1;

/// Things that happened to our weapon this frame (from our own predicted inputs).
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Cues {
    pub shots: usize,
    /// The last shot was silenced (no muzzle flash).
    pub silenced: bool,
    pub swing: Option<bool>, // stab?
    pub throw: bool,
}

impl Cues {
    pub fn add(&mut self, f: &Fired) {
        self.shots += f.shots.len();
        if let Some(s) = f.shots.last() {
            self.silenced = s.silenced;
        }
        if let Some(s) = f.swing {
            self.swing = Some(s.stab);
        }
        self.throw |= f.throw.is_some();
    }
}

#[derive(Resource, Default)]
pub struct ViewModel {
    /// Which model is shown, and its silencer/burst mode.
    shown: Option<(Id, u8)>,
    model: Option<Arc<Loaded>>,
    /// The model's bones and parts (GPU-skinned; only the bones move).
    skin: Option<SpawnedSkin>,
    seq: usize,
    started: f32,
    looping: bool,
    was_reloading: bool,
    was_pinned: bool,
    was_planting: bool,
    slash: u8,
    pub cues: Cues,
    /// Muzzle flash quad (child of the view model camera), until when it shows, and which muzzle.
    flash: Option<Entity>,
    flash_until: f32,
    /// Animation frame reached last update (for firing animation sound events once).
    last_frame: f32,
    last_fov: u8,
    /// Updates left before a just-spawned model is shown: its bones exist from the next frame,
    /// and until a pose lands it would show in its rest pose (huge arms round the camera).
    reveal: u8,
    /// Where this weapon sits (see `placement_transform`).
    placement: Transform,
}

#[derive(Component)]
pub struct ViewModelCamera;

/// Second camera, child of the main one, that only sees the view model and draws it
/// on top of the world. Fixed 90 degree field of view, like CS.
pub fn attach(commands: &mut Commands, cam: Entity) {
    let vm = commands
        .spawn((
            ViewModelCamera,
            Camera3d::default(),
            Msaa::Off,
            bevy::light::cluster::ClusterConfig::Single,
            Camera { order: 1, clear_color: ClearColorConfig::None, ..default() },
            Projection::Perspective(PerspectiveProjection { fov: 2.0 * (45f32.to_radians().tan() * 0.75).atan(), near: 1.0, far: 200.0, ..default() }),
            bevy::core_pipeline::tonemapping::Tonemapping::None,
            bevy::core_pipeline::tonemapping::DebandDither::Disabled,
            RenderLayers::layer(LAYER),
            Transform::default(),
            // The weapon in your hands is lit by where you stand.
            crate::studio::LitByMe,
        ))
        .id();
    commands.entity(cam).add_child(vm);
}

/// From the model's Y-up space (`map::to_y_up`) to camera space, mirrored left-right:
/// GoldSrc (x forward, y left, z up) ends up as (y, z, -x). CS's v_ models are stored
/// left-handed and CS 1.6 shows them right-handed by default (`cl_righthand 1`).
fn to_camera() -> Transform {
    // (a, b, c) -> (-c, b, -a): a reflection, written as a mirror in x then a rotation.
    let rotation = Quat::from_mat3(&Mat3::from_cols(Vec3::new(0.0, 0.0, 1.0), Vec3::Y, Vec3::new(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0)));
    Transform { rotation, scale: Vec3::new(-1.0, 1.0, 1.0), ..default() }
}

/// Where a weapon sits in your hands: from `assets/viewmodels.txt`.
struct Placement {
    /// Right, up, forward (the file's numbers).
    offset: Vec3,
    mirror: bool,
}

fn placements() -> &'static std::collections::HashMap<String, Placement> {
    static PLACEMENTS: std::sync::OnceLock<std::collections::HashMap<String, Placement>> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    PLACEMENTS.get_or_init(|| {
        include_str!("../assets/viewmodels.txt")
            .lines()
            .filter_map(|line| {
                let w: Vec<&str> = line.split('#').next()?.split_whitespace().collect();
                let n = |i: usize| w.get(i)?.parse::<f32>().ok();
                Some((w.first()?.to_string(), Placement { offset: Vec3::new(n(1)?, n(2)?, n(3)?), mirror: w.get(4)? != &"no" }))
            })
            .collect()
    })
}

/// The transform from a model's Y-up space to camera space for this weapon.
fn placement_transform(id: Id) -> Transform {
    let p = placements().get(sim::weapons::def(id).name);
    let (offset, mirror) = p.map_or((Vec3::ZERO, true), |p| (p.offset, p.mirror));
    let mut t = if mirror { to_camera() } else { Transform::from_rotation(Quat::from_rotation_y(std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2)) };
    // Camera space: x right, y up, looking down -z.
    t.translation = Vec3::new(offset.x, offset.y, -offset.z);
    t
}

/// Where the muzzle is (GoldSrc model space): the attachment point furthest forward (models
/// from different makers order their attachments differently; the other is the ejection port).
fn muzzle_at(model: &goldsrc::mdl::Model, pose: &[goldsrc::mdl::BoneTransform]) -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
    (0..model.attachments.len()).filter_map(|i| model.attachment(i, pose)).max_by(|a, b| a[0].total_cmp(&b[0]))
}

fn find(model: &goldsrc::mdl::Model, names: &[&str]) -> Option<usize> {
    names.iter().find_map(|n| model.sequence(n))
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn update(
    mut commands: Commands,
    time: Res<Time>,
    mut w: ResMut<Walker>,
    mut vm: ResMut<ViewModel>,
    mut cache: ResMut<ModelCache>,
    mut images: ResMut<Assets<Image>>,
    mut materials: ResMut<Assets<crate::studio::StudioMaterial>>,
    mut meshes: ResMut<Assets<Mesh>>,
    mut bindposes: ResMut<Assets<SkinnedMeshInverseBindposes>>,
    mut vis: Query<&mut Visibility>,
    mut bones: Query<&mut Transform, With<ChildOf>>,
    camera: Single<Entity, With<ViewModelCamera>>,
    flash_look: Res<crate::muzzle::FlashLook>,
    watch: Res<crate::spectate::Watch>,
) {
    let now = time.elapsed_secs();
    let l = &w.client.state.loadout;
    // Watching a teammate through their eyes: their gun (idle) in their hands.
    let watched = crate::spectate::in_eye(&w, &watch);
    let id = watched.map(|o| o.weapon).unwrap_or(l.active_id());
    let gun = l.active_gun().filter(|_| watched.is_none());
    let mode = gun.map(|g| g.mode).unwrap_or(0);
    let alive = (w.client.vitals.alive() && w.client.id().is_some() && !crate::spectate::spectating(&w)) || watched.is_some();
    // Silenced-capable guns have *_unsil animations for the plain mode.
    let unsil = matches!(id, Id::Usp | Id::M4a1) && mode == 0;
    let names = |base: &str| -> Vec<String> { if unsil { vec![format!("{base}_unsil"), base.to_string()] } else { vec![base.to_string()] } };

    // A different weapon (or silencer switch): load it and play draw / attach.
    if vm.shown.map(|s| s.0) != Some(id) {
        if let Some(old) = vm.skin.take() {
            old.despawn(&mut commands);
        }
        vm.model = cache.get(&weapon_model("v", id), &mut images, &mut materials);
        if let Some(m) = vm.model.clone() {
            // The parts hang off the view model camera, which only sees their layer.
            vm.placement = placement_transform(id);
            let skin = m.spawn_skinned(&mut commands, *camera, Some(vm.placement), &mut meshes, &mut bindposes, &mut materials);
            for e in &skin.parts {
                commands.entity(*e).insert((RenderLayers::layer(LAYER), Visibility::Hidden));
            }
            vm.skin = Some(skin);
            vm.reveal = 3;
            // The old weapon's animation number means nothing to this model (fewer animations).
            vm.seq = 0;
            vm.started = now;
            vm.looping = true;
            vm.last_frame = -1.0;
            // The Glock picks one of two draws at random (cs.so CGLOCK18::Deploy).
            let draw_name = if id == Id::Glock && (now * 1000.0) as u32 % 2 == 1 { "draw2" } else { "draw" };
            let draw: Vec<String> = names(draw_name).into_iter().chain(["deploy".to_string(), "draw".to_string()]).collect();
            let draw: Vec<&str> = draw.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
            play(&mut vm, find(&m.model, &draw), now, false);
        }
        vm.shown = Some((id, mode));
        vm.cues = Cues::default();
    } else if vm.shown.map(|s| s.1) != Some(mode) {
        if let Some(m) = vm.model.clone() {
            let name = if matches!(id, Id::Usp | Id::M4a1) { if mode == 1 { "add_silencer" } else { "detach_silencer" } } else { "" };
            play(&mut vm, m.model.sequence(name), now, false);
        }
        vm.shown = Some((id, mode));
    }
    let Some(m) = vm.model.clone() else { return };

    // What happened this frame decides the animation.
    let cues = std::mem::take(&mut vm.cues);
    let reloading = gun.is_some_and(|g| g.reloading || g.loading_shells());
    if cues.shots > 0 {
        if crate::muzzle::flashes(id, cues.silenced) {
            vm.flash_until = now + crate::muzzle::FLASH_SECONDS;
        }
        let empty = gun.is_some_and(|g| g.clip == 0);
        let seq = if id == Id::Glock {
            // CS 1.6 (client.so EV_FireGlock18): every bullet, burst or not, plays `shoot3`;
            // the last round `shoot_empty`. (`shoot`/`shoot2` are the shield versions.)
            find(&m.model, if empty { &["shoot_empty", "shootlast"] } else { &["shoot3", "shoot1", "shoot"] })
        } else {
            let k = (now * 1000.0) as usize % 3;
            let shoot = names(["shoot1", "shoot2", "shoot3"][k]);
            let last = names("shootlast");
            let mut want: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
            if empty {
                want.extend(last.iter().map(String::as_str));
                want.push("shoot_empty");
            }
            want.extend(shoot.iter().map(String::as_str));
            want.extend(["shoot", "shoot1"]);
            find(&m.model, &want)
        };
        play(&mut vm, seq, now, false);
    } else if let Some(stab) = cues.swing {
        vm.slash ^= 1;
        let seq = if stab { find(&m.model, &["stab"]) } else { find(&m.model, if vm.slash == 0 { &["midslash1", "slash1"] } else { &["midslash2", "slash2"] }) };
        play(&mut vm, seq, now, false);
    } else if cues.throw {
        play(&mut vm, m.model.sequence("throw"), now, false);
    } else if l.planting.is_some() && !vm.was_planting {
        play(&mut vm, m.model.sequence("pressbutton"), now, false);
    } else if l.planting.is_none() && vm.was_planting && l.c4 {
        // Let go before it was planted: back to holding it.
        play(&mut vm, m.model.sequence("idle1"), now, true);
    } else if l.pin_pulled() && !vm.was_pinned {
        play(&mut vm, m.model.sequence("pullpin"), now, false);
    } else if reloading && !vm.was_reloading {
        // The Glock picks one of two reloads at random (cs.so CGLOCK18::Reload).
        let r = names(if id == Id::Glock && (now * 1000.0) as u32 % 2 == 1 { "reload2" } else { "reload" });
        let mut want: Vec<&str> = r.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
        want.insert(0, "start_reload");
        play(&mut vm, find(&m.model, &want), now, false);
    } else if gun.is_some_and(|g| g.loading_shells()) && vm.looping {
        play(&mut vm, m.model.sequence("insert"), now, false);
    }
    vm.was_reloading = reloading;
    vm.was_pinned = l.pin_pulled();
    vm.was_planting = l.planting.is_some();

    // A one-shot animation that has finished goes back to idle (looping).
    let s = &m.model.sequences[vm.seq.min(m.model.sequences.len() - 1)];
    let mut frame = (now - vm.started) * s.fps;
    // Holding a pulled grenade (or a plant in progress): stay on the last frame, cocked,
    // instead of dropping back to idle before the throw.
    let holding = l.pin_pulled() || l.planting.is_some();
    if !vm.looping && holding && frame >= (s.frames - 1) as f32 {
        frame = (s.frames - 1) as f32;
    } else if !vm.looping && frame >= (s.frames - 1) as f32 {
        let idle = names("idle");
        let mut want: Vec<&str> = idle.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
        want.extend(["idle1", "idle"]);
        if gun.is_some_and(|g| g.loading_shells()) {
            want.insert(0, "insert");
        }
        let seq = find(&m.model, &want).unwrap_or(0);
        play(&mut vm, Some(seq), now, true);
        frame = 0.0;
    }
    let s = &m.model.sequences[vm.seq.min(m.model.sequences.len() - 1)];
    if vm.looping {
        frame %= (s.frames.max(2) - 1) as f32;
    }

    // Sounds the model's animation asks for (reload clicks, bolt pulls, pin pulls).
    let mut sounds = Vec::new();
    let s = &m.model.sequences[vm.seq.min(m.model.sequences.len() - 1)];
    let wrapped = frame < vm.last_frame;
    for (f, event, file) in &s.events {
        let f = *f as f32;
        let crossed = if wrapped { f > vm.last_frame || f <= frame } else { f > vm.last_frame && f <= frame };
        if *event == 5004 && crossed && alive {
            sounds.push(crate::sound::Cue::File(file.clone()));
        }
    }
    vm.last_frame = frame;
    // Scoping in and out clicks.
    let fov = gun.map(|g| g.fov()).unwrap_or(90);
    if fov != vm.last_fov && vm.shown.is_some_and(|s| s.0 == id) && vm.last_fov != 0 {
        sounds.push(crate::sound::Cue::Zoom);
    }
    vm.last_fov = fov;

    // Pose the bones (the GPU moves the vertices).
    let pose = m.model.pose_at(vm.seq, frame, 0.0);
    let mut reveal = vm.reveal;
    if let Some(skin) = &vm.skin {
        set_pose(&skin.joints, &pose, &mut bones);
        if reveal > 0 {
            reveal -= 1;
            if reveal == 0 {
                for e in &skin.parts {
                    commands.entity(*e).insert(Visibility::Inherited);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    vm.reveal = reveal;
    // Muzzle flash at the muzzle, facing us, a random turn each shot.
    let flash = *vm.flash.get_or_insert_with(|| {
        let e = crate::muzzle::spawn(&mut commands, &flash_look);
        commands.entity(e).insert(RenderLayers::layer(LAYER));
        commands.entity(*camera).add_child(e);
        e
    });
    let lit = now < vm.flash_until && alive;
    if let (true, Some(at)) = (lit, muzzle_at(&m.model, &pose)) {
        if let Ok(mut t) = bones.get_mut(flash) {
            t.translation = vm.placement.transform_point(Vec3::from(crate::map::to_y_up(at)));
            t.rotation = Quat::from_rotation_z((now * 9973.0).fract() * std::f32::consts::TAU);
            t.scale = Vec3::splat(9.0);
        }
    }
    if let Ok(mut v) = vis.get_mut(flash) {
        v.set_if_neq(if lit { Visibility::Inherited } else { Visibility::Hidden });
    }
    // Hidden while dead (unless watching a teammate through their eyes) or through a sniper scope.
    let scoped = gun.is_some_and(|g| g.fov() < 90) && matches!(id, Id::Awp | Id::Scout);
    let show = alive && !scoped && !w.noclip;
    for e in vm.skin.iter().flat_map(|s| &s.parts) {
        if let Ok(mut v) = vis.get_mut(*e) {
            v.set_if_neq(if show { Visibility::Inherited } else { Visibility::Hidden });
        }
    }
    w.cues.extend(sounds);
}

fn play(vm: &mut ViewModel, seq: Option<usize>, now: f32, looping: bool) {
    if let Some(seq) = seq {
        vm.seq = seq;
        vm.started = now;
        vm.looping = looping;
        vm.last_frame = -1.0;
    }
}

pub struct ViewModelPlugin;

impl Plugin for ViewModelPlugin {
    fn build(&self, app: &mut App) {
        app.init_resource::<ViewModel>()
            // A fresh match starts with no weapon shown (the old entities went with the camera).
            .add_systems(OnEnter(AppState::InGame), |mut commands: Commands| commands.insert_resource(ViewModel::default()))
            .add_systems(Update, update.in_set(Frame::World));
    }
}
```

`client/src/voice/audio.rs`:

```rs
//! Sound card side of voice: the microphone (captured, mixed to mono, resampled to 48 kHz) and
//! a little mixer that plays everyone talking, each with its own volume and left/right pan.
//! Both run on cpal's audio threads; the game talks to them through shared buffers.
use cpal::traits::{DeviceTrait, HostTrait, StreamTrait};
use net::protocol::VOICE_RATE;
use std::collections::{HashMap, VecDeque};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

/// Names of the microphones on this machine ("" first = the system default).
pub fn input_devices() -> Vec<String> {
    let mut v = vec![String::new()];
    if let Ok(devs) = cpal::default_host().input_devices() {
        v.extend(devs.filter_map(|d| d.description().ok().map(|d| d.name().to_string())));
    }
    v.dedup();
    v
}

/// Linear resampling of a mono stream, keeping its position between calls.
#[derive(Default)]
struct Resampler {
    pos: f64,
    last: f32,
}

impl Resampler {
    fn run(&mut self, input: &[f32], from: u32, to: u32, out: &mut Vec<f32>) {
        if from == to {
            out.extend_from_slice(input);
            return;
        }
        let step = from as f64 / to as f64;
        while self.pos < input.len() as f64 {
            let i = self.pos.floor() as usize;
            let t = (self.pos - i as f64) as f32;
            let a = if i == 0 { self.last } else { input[i - 1] };
            out.push(a + (input[i] - a) * t);
            self.pos += step;
        }
        self.pos -= input.len() as f64;
        self.last = input.last().copied().unwrap_or(self.last);
    }
}

/// An open microphone. Paused while nobody holds push-to-talk.
pub struct Mic {
    stream: cpal::Stream,
    /// 48 kHz mono samples not yet sent.
    buf: Arc<Mutex<VecDeque<f32>>>,
    running: bool,
}

impl Mic {
    /// Open `name` ("" or missing = the default microphone).
    pub fn open(name: &str) -> Option<Mic> {
        let host = cpal::default_host();
        let dev = host
            .input_devices()
            .ok()
            .and_then(|mut d| d.find(|d| !name.is_empty() && d.description().is_ok_and(|x| x.name() == name)))
            .or_else(|| host.default_input_device())?;
        let cfg = dev.default_input_config().ok()?;
        let (rate, channels) = (cfg.sample_rate(), cfg.channels() as usize);
        let buf: Arc<Mutex<VecDeque<f32>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(VecDeque::new()));
        let b = buf.clone();
        let mut rs = Resampler::default();
        let mut mono = Vec::new();
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        let mut push = move |data: &mut dyn Iterator<Item = f32>| {
            mono.clear();
            let all: Vec<f32> = data.collect();
            mono.extend(all.chunks(channels.max(1)).map(|f| f.iter().sum::<f32>() / f.len() as f32));
            out.clear();
            rs.run(&mono, rate, VOICE_RATE, &mut out);
            if let Ok(mut q) = b.lock() {
                q.extend(out.iter());
                let max = VOICE_RATE as usize; // never more than a second behind
                while q.len() > max {
                    q.pop_front();
                }
            }
        };
        let said = std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false);
        let err = move |e| {
            if !said.swap(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {
                eprintln!("microphone: {e}");
            }
        };
        let stream = match cfg.sample_format() {
            cpal::SampleFormat::F32 => dev.build_input_stream(&cfg.into(), move |d: &[f32], _: &_| push(&mut d.iter().copied()), err, None),
            cpal::SampleFormat::I16 => dev.build_input_stream(&cfg.into(), move |d: &[i16], _: &_| push(&mut d.iter().map(|s| *s as f32 / 32768.0)), err, None),
            _ => return None,
        }
        .ok()?;
        let _ = stream.pause();
        Some(Mic { stream, buf, running: false })
    }

    /// Start or stop capturing (stopping also drops what's left, so a new press starts fresh).
    pub fn set_running(&mut self, on: bool) {
        if on == self.running {
            return;
        }
        self.running = on;
        if on {
            let _ = self.stream.play();
        } else {
            let _ = self.stream.pause();
            if let Ok(mut q) = self.buf.lock() {
                q.clear();
            }
        }
    }

    /// Whole 20 ms frames captured so far.
    pub fn frames(&self, frame: usize) -> Vec<Vec<f32>> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        if let Ok(mut q) = self.buf.lock() {
            while q.len() >= frame {
                out.push(q.drain(..frame).collect());
            }
        }
        out
    }
}

/// One person talking: their decoded samples waiting to play, and how loud in each ear.
#[derive(Default)]
struct Voice {
    queue: VecDeque<f32>,
    left: f32,
    right: f32,
    /// Waiting for a little audio before starting, so network jitter doesn't stutter.
    primed: bool,
}

/// Start playing a voice once this much is buffered (60 ms), and never let it lag more than 400 ms.
const PRIME: usize = VOICE_RATE as usize * 6 / 100;
const MAX_LAG: usize = VOICE_RATE as usize * 4 / 10;

#[derive(Default)]
struct Mixer {
    voices: HashMap<u8, Voice>,
}

/// The output stream that plays everyone's voice.
pub struct Speakers {
    _stream: cpal::Stream,
    mixer: Arc<Mutex<Mixer>>,
    /// The sound card side reported an error (the stream is dead: `Audio` opens a new one).
    failed: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool>,
}

impl Speakers {
    pub fn open() -> Option<Speakers> {
        let dev = cpal::default_host().default_output_device()?;
        let cfg = dev.default_output_config().ok()?;
        let (rate, channels) = (cfg.sample_rate(), cfg.channels() as usize);
        let mixer: Arc<Mutex<Mixer>> = Arc::default();
        // Device rate differs from 48 kHz: step through each voice at 48k/rate per output frame.
        let step = VOICE_RATE as f64 / rate as f64;
        // An error usually means the stream is gone (device switched, sound server restarted):
        // say so once, and let `Audio` open a fresh one instead of logging every callback.
        let failed = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false));
        let f2 = failed.clone();
        let err = move |e| {
            if !f2.swap(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {
                eprintln!("voice output: {e} (reopening)");
            }
        };
        let mx2 = mixer.clone();
        let mut acc = 0.0f64;
        let mut render = move |len: usize, write: &mut dyn FnMut(usize, f32)| {
            let Ok(mut mx) = mx2.lock() else { return };
            for f in 0..len / channels.max(1) {
                let (mut l, mut r) = (0.0f32, 0.0f32);
                for v in mx.voices.values_mut() {
                    if !v.primed {
                        v.primed = v.queue.len() >= PRIME;
                    }
                    if v.primed {
                        let s = v.queue.front().copied().unwrap_or(0.0);
                        l += s * v.left;
                        r += s * v.right;
                    }
                }
                acc += step;
                while acc >= 1.0 {
                    acc -= 1.0;
                    for v in mx.voices.values_mut().filter(|v| v.primed) {
                        if v.queue.pop_front().is_none() {
                            v.primed = false; // ran dry: wait for more before starting again
                        }
                    }
                }
                let (l, r) = (l.clamp(-1.0, 1.0), r.clamp(-1.0, 1.0));
                for c in 0..channels {
                    write(f * channels + c, if channels == 1 { (l + r) * 0.5 } else if c % 2 == 0 { l } else { r });
                }
            }
        };
        let stream = match cfg.sample_format() {
            cpal::SampleFormat::F32 => dev.build_output_stream(&cfg.into(), move |d: &mut [f32], _: &_| { let n = d.len(); render(n, &mut |i, s| d[i] = s) }, err, None),
            cpal::SampleFormat::I16 => dev.build_output_stream(&cfg.into(), move |d: &mut [i16], _: &_| { let n = d.len(); render(n, &mut |i, s| d[i] = (s * 32767.0) as i16) }, err, None),
            _ => return None,
        }
        .ok()?;
        stream.play().ok()?;
        Some(Speakers { _stream: stream, mixer, failed })
    }

    pub fn failed(&self) -> bool {
        self.failed.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed)
    }

    /// Queue decoded 48 kHz samples from `who`, at this volume in each ear.
    pub fn push(&self, who: u8, samples: &[f32], left: f32, right: f32) {
        if let Ok(mut mx) = self.mixer.lock() {
            let v = mx.voices.entry(who).or_default();
            v.queue.extend(samples.iter());
            while v.queue.len() > MAX_LAG {
                v.queue.pop_front();
            }
            (v.left, v.right) = (left, right);
        }
    }
}
```
