`net/examples/bots.rs`:

```rs
//! Test bots against a real deployment: `bots <lobby host:port> [count] [--local]
//! [--difficulty easy|normal|hard|expert] [--deathmatch]`. Each bot signs in to the lobby, queues for
//! casual, plays the match it gets in real time and queues again. Needs a test lobby
//! (`./host.sh --test`): official lobbies only let in Steam players. `--local`: reach the game
//! servers through 127.0.0.1 (on the hosting machine).
//!
//! Orders (see net/src/bot/control.rs): type them into its terminal, or from anywhere on the
//! same machine: `bots --order "t plant b; ct hold"` (sent to UDP 127.0.0.1:27099).
use net::bot::{control, Bot, BotMap, Mode, Order, Profile};
use net::lobby::{Command, LobbyClient};
use std::net::UdpSocket;
use std::sync::mpsc::channel;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

const CONTROL_PORT: u16 = 27099;

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    if let Some(i) = args.iter().position(|a| a == "--order") {
        let order = args.get(i + 1).expect("--order \"<who> <order>\"");
        UdpSocket::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap().send_to(order.as_bytes(), ("127.0.0.1", CONTROL_PORT)).unwrap();
        return;
    }
    let lobby = std::net::ToSocketAddrs::to_socket_addrs(args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("127.0.0.1:27010")).expect("lobby address").next().unwrap();
    let count: usize = args.get(2).and_then(|n| n.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(10);
    let local = args.iter().any(|a| a == "--local");
    // Deathmatch: take seats on the deathmatch server instead of queueing for matches.
    let deathmatch = args.iter().any(|a| a == "--deathmatch");
    let difficulty = args.iter().position(|a| a == "--difficulty").and_then(|i| args.get(i + 1)).and_then(|d| Profile::parse(d)).unwrap_or(net::bot::Difficulty::Normal);
    let dir = net::gamefiles::data_dir().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
    // Each map's navigation, worked out the first time a match is on it.
    let mut maps: std::collections::HashMap<String, std::sync::Arc<BotMap>> = std::collections::HashMap::new();
    let mut load = |name: &str| -> Option<std::sync::Arc<BotMap>> {
        if !maps.contains_key(name) {
            let bsp = goldsrc::bsp::Bsp::load(format!("{dir}/maps/{name}.bsp")).ok()?;
            maps.insert(name.to_string(), BotMap::new(bsp, name));
        }
        maps.get(name).cloned()
    };

    // Orders from the terminal and from the control port.
    let (tx, orders) = channel::<String>();
    let stdin_tx = tx.clone();
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        for line in std::io::stdin().lines().map_while(Result::ok) {
            let _ = stdin_tx.send(line);
        }
    });
    if let Ok(udp) = UdpSocket::bind(("127.0.0.1", CONTROL_PORT)) {
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut buf = [0u8; 512];
            while let Ok(n) = udp.recv(&mut buf) {
                let _ = tx.send(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).trim().to_string());
            }
        });
        println!("orders: type them here, or send to udp 127.0.0.1:{CONTROL_PORT}");
    }

    let mut lobbies: Vec<LobbyClient> = (0..count)
        .map(|i| {
            let mut c = LobbyClient::new(lobby, &format!("bot{i}")).unwrap();
            c.auto_accept = true; // bots accept every match they're found
            c.maps = net::config::pool_maps_in(std::path::Path::new(&dir));
            c
        })
        .collect();
    let mut queued = vec![false; count];
    let mut bots: Vec<Option<Bot>> = (0..count).map(|_| None).collect();
    // Connecting: until the server says which map, a bot can't find its way yet.
    let mut joining: Vec<Option<net::Client>> = (0..count).map(|_| None).collect();
    // Standing orders, kept for bots between matches.
    let mut modes = vec![Mode::Normal; count];
    let mut profiles = vec![Profile::of(difficulty); count];
    let mut sites = vec![None; count];
    let tick = Duration::from_secs_f64(1.0 / 128.0);
    let mut next = Instant::now();
    let mut matches = 0;
    let mut kills = 0;
    loop {
        while let Ok(line) = orders.try_recv() {
            for part in line.split(';').map(str::trim).filter(|p| !p.is_empty()) {
                match control::parse(part) {
                    Ok((who, order)) => {
                        let mut n = 0;
                        for (i, slot) in bots.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                            let hit = match slot {
                                Some(b) => b.is(&who),
                                None => matches!(who, net::bot::Who::All) || who == net::bot::Who::Bot(i),
                            };
                            if !hit {
                                continue;
                            }
                            n += 1;
                            match &order {
                                Order::Mode(m) => modes[i] = *m,
                                Order::Difficulty(d) => profiles[i] = Profile::of(*d),
                                Order::Site(s) => sites[i] = *s,
                                _ => {}
                            }
                            if let Some(b) = slot {
                                b.order(order.clone());
                            }
                        }
                        println!("{part}: {n} bot(s)");
                    }
                    Err(e) => println!("{part}: {e}"),
                }
            }
        }
        for i in 0..count {
            lobbies[i].tick();
            if !lobbies[i].notice.is_empty() {
                println!("bot{i}: {}", std::mem::take(&mut lobbies[i].notice));
            }
            if let Some(b) = bots[i].as_ref().filter(|b| b.client.status == net::client::Status::Rejected) {
                println!("bot{i} refused by the server: {}", b.client.reject_reason.clone().unwrap_or_default());
                bots[i] = None;
                queued[i] = false;
                continue;
            }
            if bots[i].as_ref().is_some_and(|b| b.client.match_ended) {
                bots[i] = None;
                queued[i] = false;
                matches += 1;
                if i == 0 {
                    println!("match over ({matches} bot-matches played)");
                }
            }
            if bots[i].is_none() && lobbies[i].online() && !queued[i] {
                queued[i] = true;
                lobbies[i].send(if deathmatch { Command::Deathmatch } else { Command::Play });
            }
            if let Some((mut addr, ticket, key)) = lobbies[i].found.take() {
                if local {
                    addr.set_ip([127, 0, 0, 1].into());
                }
                let mut client = net::Client::connect(addr, &format!("bot{i}"), sim::collision::World::flat_floor(-100_000.0)).unwrap();
                client.ticket = ticket;
                client.key = Some(key);
                if i == 0 {
                    println!("bots booked on {addr}");
                }
                joining[i] = Some(client);
            }
            if let Some(c) = &mut joining[i] {
                c.tick(sim::pmove::Input::default());
                if let Some(name) = c.map.clone() {
                    let mut client = joining[i].take().unwrap();
                    match load(&name) {
                        Some(map) => {
                            client.world = map.world();
                            if i == 0 {
                                println!("map: {name}");
                            }
                            let mut b = Bot::new(client, map, i, profiles[i]);
                            b.mode = modes[i];
                            b.site = sites[i];
                            bots[i] = Some(b);
                        }
                        None => println!("bot{i}: no {name}.bsp here (BOOTLEG16_DIR)"),
                    }
                }
            }
            if let Some(b) = &mut bots[i] {
                b.tick();
                for e in b.take_events() {
                    // One bot reports the match as it goes.
                    if i == 0 {
                        report(&e, &mut kills);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        next += tick;
        let now = Instant::now();
        if next > now {
            std::thread::sleep(next - now);
        } else {
            next = now;
        }
    }
}

/// A line per round (and per plant) from what one bot saw.
fn report(e: &net::protocol::GameEvent, kills: &mut u32) {
    use net::protocol::GameEvent;
    match e {
        GameEvent::Kill { .. } => {
            *kills += 1;
            if *kills % 10 == 0 {
                println!("{kills} kills so far");
            }
        }
        GameEvent::KillLimit { player } => println!("player {player} reached the kill limit: scores start over"),
        GameEvent::BombPlanted { at, .. } => println!("bomb planted at {:.0} {:.0}", at[0], at[1]),
        GameEvent::RoundEnd { winner, reason } => {
            println!("round over: {winner:?} win ({reason:?}), {kills} kills");
            *kills = 0;
        }
        GameEvent::MatchOver { winner } => println!("match over: {winner:?}"),
        _ => {}
    }
}
```

`net/examples/shooter.rs`:

```rs
//! Headless test client: joins a team and shoots at the nearest other player, for checking
//! blood, flinches, deaths and bullet holes. Usage: shooter <server addr> [t|ct] [seconds] [pitch: just look that way, no shooting] [strafe: and walk side to side (for leg animations)]
use net::protocol::Team;
use net::Client;
use sim::pmove::Input;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

fn main() {
    let a: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let addr = a.get(1).expect("server address").parse().expect("ip:port");
    let team = if a.get(2).is_some_and(|t| t == "t") { Team::T } else { Team::Ct };
    let secs: u64 = a.get(3).and_then(|x| x.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(30);
    let fixed_pitch: Option<f32> = a.get(4).and_then(|x| x.parse().ok());
    let strafe = a.get(5).is_some_and(|x| x == "strafe");
    let home = std::env::var("HOME").unwrap();
    let bsp = goldsrc::bsp::Bsp::load(format!("{}/../gamedata/maps/de_dust2.bsp", env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))).unwrap();
    let mut c = Client::connect(addr, "shooter", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
    let tick = Duration::from_secs_f64(1.0 / 128.0);
    let start = Instant::now();
    let (mut t, mut joined) = (0u32, false);
    while start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(secs) {
        t += 1;
        if !joined && c.id().is_some() {
            c.join_team(Some(team));
            joined = true;
        }
        let eye = c.me().eye();
        let target = c.others().into_iter().filter(|o| o.alive).min_by(|x, y| {
            let d = |o: &net::client::Remote| (0..3).map(|i| (o.origin[i] - eye[i]).powi(2)).sum::<f32>();
            d(x).total_cmp(&d(y))
        });
        let mut input = Input::default();
        if let Some(o) = target {
            // Alternate head and body.
            let z = if (t / 128) % 2 == 0 { 26.0 } else { 6.0 };
            let d = [o.origin[0] - eye[0], o.origin[1] - eye[1], o.origin[2] + z - eye[2]];
            input.yaw = d[1].atan2(d[0]).to_degrees();
            input.pitch = -(d[2].atan2((d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1]).sqrt())).to_degrees();
            input.attack = t > 300 && t % 64 < 8;
        }
        if let Some(p) = fixed_pitch {
            // Strafing: side to side every second, facing one fixed way.
            let side = if strafe { if (t / 128) % 2 == 0 { 400.0 } else { -400.0 } } else { 0.0 };
            input = Input { yaw: if strafe { 0.0 } else { input.yaw }, pitch: p, side, ..Default::default() };
        }
        c.tick(input);
        std::thread::sleep(tick);
    }
}
```

`net/examples/smoke.rs`:

```rs
//! Smoke test for a deployment: two fake players party up on the lobby, start a custom game,
//! and join the server it books. `cargo run -p net --example smoke -- <lobby-host:port> [--local]`
//! (`--local`: join through 127.0.0.1, for testing on the hosting machine behind a home router).
use net::lobby::{Command, LobbyClient, Mode};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

fn main() {
    let lobby = std::env::args().nth(1).unwrap_or_else(|| "127.0.0.1:27010".into());
    let lobby = std::net::ToSocketAddrs::to_socket_addrs(&lobby).expect("lobby address").next().unwrap();
    let mut a = LobbyClient::new(lobby, "smoke-a").unwrap();
    let mut b = LobbyClient::new(lobby, "smoke-b").unwrap();
    let wait = |a: &mut LobbyClient, b: &mut LobbyClient, what: &str, done: &dyn Fn(&LobbyClient, &LobbyClient) -> bool| {
        let start = Instant::now();
        while !done(a, b) {
            assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(10), "FAILED: {what} (notice: {:?} {:?})", a.notice, b.notice);
            a.tick();
            b.tick();
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
        }
        println!("ok: {what}");
    };
    wait(&mut a, &mut b, "lobby answers", &|a, b| a.online() && b.online());
    b.send(Command::JoinParty { code: a.state.as_ref().unwrap().code.clone() });
    wait(&mut a, &mut b, "party by code", &|a, _| a.state.as_ref().unwrap().members.len() == 2);
    a.send(Command::SetMode(Mode::Custom));
    let bid = b.state.as_ref().unwrap().you;
    a.send(Command::Move { member: bid, group: net::server::Group::B });
    a.send(Command::Play);
    wait(&mut a, &mut b, "match booked", &|a, b| a.found.is_some() && b.found.is_some());
    let mut players: Vec<net::Client> = [a.found.unwrap(), b.found.unwrap()]
        .iter()
        .map(|(addr, ticket, key)| {
            let local = std::env::args().any(|a| a == "--local");
            let addr = if local { std::net::SocketAddr::from(([127, 0, 0, 1], addr.port())) } else { *addr };
            let mut c = net::Client::connect(addr, "smoke", sim::collision::World::flat_floor(-100_000.0)).unwrap();
            c.ticket = *ticket;
            c.key = Some(*key);
            c
        })
        .collect();
    let start = Instant::now();
    while players.iter().any(|c| c.id().is_none() || c.team() == net::protocol::Team::Spectator) {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(10), "FAILED: joining {} ({:?})", a.found.unwrap().0, players.iter().map(|c| &c.status).collect::<Vec<_>>());
        players.iter_mut().for_each(|c| _ = c.tick(sim::pmove::Input::default()));
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(8));
    }
    println!("ok: both joined {} as {:?} / {:?}", a.found.unwrap().0, players[0].team(), players[1].team());
    players.iter_mut().for_each(|c| c.disconnect());
}
```

```rs
//! Headless test client: connects, throws one grenade (slot 4, pressed `presses` times to
//! pick the type), then stands still. Usage: thrower <server addr> [presses] [pitch]
use net::Client;
use sim::pmove::Input;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

fn main() {
    let a: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let addr = a.get(1).expect("server address").parse().expect("ip:port");
    let presses: usize = a.get(2).and_then(|x| x.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(1);
    let pitch: f32 = a.get(3).and_then(|x| x.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(-20.0);
    let home = std::env::var("HOME").unwrap();
    let bsp = goldsrc::bsp::Bsp::load(format!("{}/../gamedata/maps/de_dust2.bsp", env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))).unwrap();
    let mut c = Client::connect(addr, "thrower", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();

    let start = Instant::now();
    let mut t = 0u32;
    let mut joined = false;

        t += 1;
        if !joined && c.id().is_some() {
            c.join_team(Some(net::protocol::Team::T));

            n if n > 50 && n <= 50 + presses as u32 * 120 && (n - 50) % 120 == 1 => Input { slot: 4, ..base },

            _ => base,
        };
        c.tick(input);
        if t % 256 == 0 {
            eprintln!("t={t} active={:?} grenades={:?} flying={} smokes={}", c.state.loadout.active_id(), c.state.loadout.grenades, c.grenades.len(), c.smokes.len());
        }
        std::thread::sleep(tick);
    }
}
```

`net/src/bot/brain.rs`:

```rs
//! What a bot does each tick, after the CS 1.6 / CZ bot's states: buy, then the objective
//! (terrorists take the bomb to a site and plant it, pick it up when dropped, guard it once
//! planted; counter-terrorists guard a site, defuse a planted bomb, or run when there's no
//! time), investigating gunfire they hear, and attacking enemies once they've noticed them
//! (reaction time), with aim that improves while they track. Test orders (`Mode`) replace
//! parts of this.
use super::control::{Mode, Place};
use super::nav::dist;
use super::Bot;
use crate::protocol::{BombNet, BuyItem, GameEvent, Team};
use crate::rounds::Phase;
use sim::pmove::Input;
use sim::weapons::data::Slot;
use sim::weapons::Id;
use std::collections::HashSet;

pub(super) struct State {
    t: u32,
    rng: u64,
    path: Vec<u32>,
    path_to: Option<u32>,
    path_at: usize,
    replan: u32,
    blocked: HashSet<(u32, u32)>,
    stuck_on: u32,
    /// Who we're looking at and since when (the reaction delay runs from then).
    seen: Option<(u8, u32)>,
    round: Option<u32>,
    bought: bool,
    /// This round's site (where the bomb goes / which one to guard).
    site: usize,
    /// Pushing towards the enemy spawn this round instead of holding (aggressive bots).
    push: bool,
    /// Gunfire heard: where, and until when it's worth checking.
    noise: Option<([f32; 3], u32)>,
    /// Strafing side while fighting, and when to switch.
    strafe: (f32, u32),
    /// Where we looked last tick (an idle bot keeps looking that way).
    yaw: f32,
    /// Deathmatch: the spot we're heading for while hunting.
    hunt: Option<[f32; 3]>,
}

impl State {
    pub(super) fn new(seed: u64) -> State {
        State {
            t: 0,
            rng: seed.wrapping_mul(0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15) | 1,
            path: Vec::new(),
            path_to: None,
            path_at: 0,
            replan: 0,
            blocked: HashSet::new(),
            stuck_on: 0,
            seen: None,
            round: None,
            bought: false,
            site: 0,
            push: false,
            noise: None,
            strafe: (1.0, 0),
            yaw: 0.0,
            hunt: None,
        }
    }

    fn rand(&mut self) -> f32 {
        self.rng ^= self.rng << 13;
        self.rng ^= self.rng >> 7;
        self.rng ^= self.rng << 17;
        (self.rng >> 40) as f32 / (1u64 << 24) as f32
    }
}

/// Angles (yaw, pitch) to look from `eye` at `p`.
fn look(eye: [f32; 3], p: [f32; 3]) -> (f32, f32) {
    let d = [p[0] - eye[0], p[1] - eye[1], p[2] - eye[2]];
    (d[1].atan2(d[0]).to_degrees(), -(d[2].atan2((d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1]).sqrt())).to_degrees())
}

fn flat(a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3]) -> f32 {
    ((a[0] - b[0]).powi(2) + (a[1] - b[1]).powi(2)).sqrt()
}

impl Bot {
    /// Seconds as ticks at the server's rate (never 0: it is a divisor).
    fn secs(&self, s: f32) -> u32 {
        self.client.rate().secs(s).max(1)
    }

    /// Remember gunfire from enemies (the server only sends what we could hear).
    pub(super) fn hear(&mut self, events: &[GameEvent]) {
        let team = self.client.team();
        for e in events {
            if let GameEvent::Shot { shooter, from, .. } = e {
                let enemy = self.client.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == *shooter && o.team != team);
                if enemy {
                    self.brain.noise = Some((*from, self.brain.t + self.secs(5.0)));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn think(&mut self) -> Input {
        let input = self.decide();
        self.brain.yaw = input.yaw;
        input
    }

    fn decide(&mut self) -> Input {
        self.brain.t += 1;
        let t = self.brain.t;
        let team = self.client.team();
        if self.client.id().is_none() || team == Team::Spectator || !self.client.vitals.alive() || self.mode == Mode::Afk {
            self.brain.seen = None;
            self.brain.path.clear();
            return Input::default();
        }
        let round = self.client.round.round;
        if self.brain.round != Some(round) {
            // A new round: pick this round's site and plan.
            self.brain.round = Some(round);
            self.brain.bought = false;
            self.brain.noise = None;
            self.brain.site = self.site.unwrap_or((round as usize + team as usize) % self.map.sites.len().max(1));
            let aggression = self.profile.aggression;
            self.brain.push = self.brain.rand() < aggression * 0.6;
            self.brain.path.clear();
        }
        if self.client.me_info.can_buy && !self.brain.bought {
            self.brain.bought = true;
            self.buy(team);
        }
        let me = *self.client.me();
        let eye = me.eye();
        let mut input = Input { yaw: self.brain.yaw, ..Input::default() };
        if self.mode == Mode::Knife && self.client.state.loadout.active != Slot::Knife {
            input.slot = Slot::Knife as u8;
        }
        if self.client.round.phase == Phase::Freeze {
            return input;
        }

        // Who we'd shoot: enemies (teammates for a griefer) we can actually see.
        let target = self
            .client
            .others()
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|o| o.alive && o.team != Team::Spectator && ((o.team != team) != (self.mode == Mode::Grief)))
            // Aim at the head: about eye height (17 standing, 12 crouched), a little above.
            .map(|o| (o.id, [o.origin[0], o.origin[1], o.origin[2] + if o.crouched { 14.0 } else { 20.0 }]))
            .filter(|(_, head)| self.client.world.trace_line(eye, *head).fraction > 0.98)
            .min_by(|a, b| dist(eye, a.1).total_cmp(&dist(eye, b.1)));
        let busy = self.planting() || self.defusing();
        match target {
            Some((id, head)) if self.mode != Mode::Peaceful && !busy => return self.attack(input, id, head),
            _ => self.brain.seen = None,
        }

        // Where to be, and what to do there.
        let (yaw_hold, _) = look(eye, if team == Team::T { self.map.spawns.1 } else { self.map.spawns.0 });
        match self.mode {
            Mode::Hold => return Input { yaw: yaw_hold + ((t / self.secs(2.0)) as f32 * 40.0) % 90.0 - 45.0, ..input },
            Mode::Goto(p) | Mode::Rush(p) => {
                let at = self.place(p);
                return if flat(me.origin, at) < 48.0 { input } else { self.walk(input, at) };
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        // No objective (deathmatch, practice): hunt. Gunfire first, else roam the map from one
        // random spot to the next.
        if self.client.practice {
            if let Some(at) = self.noise() {
                return self.walk(input, at);
            }
            let me = self.client.me().origin;
            let arrived = self.brain.hunt.is_none_or(|h| flat(me, h) < 100.0) || self.brain.t % self.secs(20.0) == 0;
            if arrived {
                let n = self.map.nav.points.len().max(1);
                self.brain.hunt = Some(self.map.nav.points[(self.brain.rand() * n as f32) as usize % n]);
            }
            return self.walk(input, self.brain.hunt.unwrap());
        }
        let site = self.map.sites.get(self.site.unwrap_or(self.brain.site)).copied().unwrap_or(self.map.spawns.1);
        let bomb = self.client.bomb;
        if team == Team::T {
            if self.client.state.loadout.c4 {
                // Carrying it: to the site, then plant (hold attack with the C4 out, still).
                if self.map.zones.in_bomb_site(me.origin) && flat(me.origin, site) < 400.0 {
                    if self.client.state.loadout.active != Slot::Bomb {
                        input.slot = Slot::Bomb as u8;
                    }
                    input.attack = true;
                    return input;
                }
                return self.walk(input, site);
            }
            match bomb {
                BombNet::Dropped(at) => return self.walk(input, at),
                BombNet::Planted { at, .. } => return self.guard(input, at, yaw_hold),
                _ => {}
            }
            if let Some(at) = self.noise() {
                return self.walk(input, at);
            }
            // Escort the bomb to this round's site (aggressive ones push the enemy spawn).
            return self.walk(input, if self.brain.push { self.map.spawns.1 } else { site });
        }
        if let BombNet::Planted { at, left, defuse } = bomb {
            let mine = defuse.is_some_and(|(by, _)| Some(by) == self.client.id());
            if defuse.is_some() && !mine {
                return self.guard(input, at, yaw_hold);
            }
            // Can we make it? Running there plus the defuse, with a little spare.
            let need = flat(me.origin, at) / 250.0 + if self.client.me_info.defuse_kit { 5.0 } else { 10.0 } + 0.5;
            if need > left && !mine {
                return self.walk(input, self.map.spawns.1); // escape from the bomb
            }
            if flat(me.origin, at) < 40.0 {
                let (yaw, pitch) = look(eye, at);
                return Input { yaw, pitch, use_key: true, crouch: true, ..input };
            }
            return self.walk(input, at);
        }
        if let Some(at) = self.noise() {
            return self.walk(input, at);
        }
        if self.brain.push {
            return self.walk(input, self.map.spawns.0);
        }
        self.guard(input, site, yaw_hold)
    }

    fn planting(&self) -> bool {
        self.client.state.loadout.c4 && self.client.state.loadout.active == Slot::Bomb && self.map.zones.in_bomb_site(self.client.me().origin)
    }

    fn defusing(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.client.bomb, BombNet::Planted { defuse: Some((by, _)), .. } if Some(by) == self.client.id())
    }

    /// Gunfire worth checking (aggressive bots go more often).
    fn noise(&mut self) -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
        let (at, until) = self.brain.noise?;
        let me = self.client.me().origin;
        if self.brain.t > until || flat(me, at) < 100.0 || flat(me, at) > 1500.0 {
            self.brain.noise = None;
            return None;
        }
        (self.profile.aggression > 0.4).then_some(at)
    }

    fn place(&self, p: Place) -> [f32; 3] {
        match p {
            Place::Site(i) => self.map.sites.get(i).copied().unwrap_or(self.map.spawns.1),
            Place::TSpawn => self.map.spawns.0,
            Place::CtSpawn => self.map.spawns.1,
            Place::At(at) => at,
        }
    }

    /// Stand near a spot looking out for trouble (to it first).
    fn guard(&mut self, input: Input, at: [f32; 3], out: f32) -> Input {
        let me = self.client.me().origin;
        if flat(me, at) > 250.0 {
            return self.walk(input, at);
        }
        let sweep = ((self.brain.t / self.secs(1.5)) % 3) as f32 * 35.0 - 35.0;
        Input { yaw: out + sweep, ..input }
    }

    /// Fight: notice after the reaction time, aim (better the longer we track), shoot in
    /// bursts (taps far away), strafe close up if skilled, crouch far away.
    fn attack(&mut self, mut input: Input, id: u8, head: [f32; 3]) -> Input {
        let t = self.brain.t;
        let since = match self.brain.seen {
            Some((who, at)) if who == id => at,
            _ => {
                self.brain.seen = Some((id, t));
                t
            }
        };
        let me = *self.client.me();
        let eye = me.eye();
        let range = dist(eye, head);
        let aimbot = self.mode == Mode::Aimbot;
        let tracked = (t - since) as f32 / self.client.rate().hz() as f32;
        let err = if aimbot { 0.0 } else { self.profile.aim_error / (1.0 + tracked * 4.0) };
        let (yaw, pitch) = look(eye, head);
        input.yaw = yaw + (self.brain.rand() - 0.5) * err;
        input.pitch = pitch + (self.brain.rand() - 0.5) * err;
        let reacted = aimbot || tracked > self.profile.reaction;
        if self.mode == Mode::Knife {
            input.forward = 400.0;
            input.attack = range < 64.0;
            return input;
        }
        let tap = if range > 800.0 { 1 } else { 4 };
        // (An aimbot fires the moment it's on target and taps, keeping its shots on the head.)
        input.attack = self.mode == Mode::Spray || (reacted && if aimbot { t % self.secs(0.09375) == 0 } else { t % self.secs(0.1875) < tap });
        input.reload = self.client.state.loadout.active_gun().is_some_and(|g| g.clip == 0);
        input.crouch = range > 800.0;
        if let Mode::Rush(p) = self.mode {
            // Run and gun towards the goal.
            let at = self.place(p);
            let walk = self.walk(Input::default(), at);
            let rel = (walk.yaw - input.yaw).to_radians();
            input.forward = 400.0 * rel.cos();
            input.side = -400.0 * rel.sin();
            input.crouch = false;
        } else if self.profile.skill >= 0.75 && range < 900.0 {
            // Skilled: side-step between bursts.
            if t >= self.brain.strafe.1 {
                self.brain.strafe = (-self.brain.strafe.0, t + 40 + (self.brain.rand() * 60.0) as u32);
            }
            if !input.attack {
                input.side = 250.0 * self.brain.strafe.0;
            }
        }
        input
    }

    /// Walk the nav path to `goal` (re-planned when it changes, every few seconds, or when
    /// stuck: then press use for doors, and give up on the link after a few tries).
    fn walk(&mut self, mut input: Input, goal: [f32; 3]) -> Input {
        let me = *self.client.me();
        let nav = &self.map.nav;
        let t = self.brain.t;
        let to = nav.nearest(goal);
        let stuck = t % self.secs(0.5) == 0 && (me.velocity[0].powi(2) + me.velocity[1].powi(2)).sqrt() < 30.0;
        let mut give_up = false;
        if stuck {
            self.brain.stuck_on += 1;
            if self.brain.stuck_on >= 3 {
                if let (Some(&a), Some(&b)) = (self.brain.path.get(self.brain.path_at.saturating_sub(1)), self.brain.path.get(self.brain.path_at)) {
                    self.brain.blocked.insert((a, b));
                }
                self.brain.stuck_on = 0;
                give_up = true;
            }
        } else if t % self.secs(0.5) == 0 {
            self.brain.stuck_on = 0;
        }
        if to != self.brain.path_to || self.brain.path_at >= self.brain.path.len() || t >= self.brain.replan || give_up {
            self.brain.path_to = to;
            self.brain.path = match (nav.nearest(me.origin), to) {
                (Some(from), Some(to)) => nav.path(from, to, &self.brain.blocked),
                _ => Vec::new(),
            };
            self.brain.path_at = 1;
            self.brain.replan = t + self.secs(4.0);
        }
        let Some(&next) = self.brain.path.get(self.brain.path_at) else {
            // Nowhere to go from here: towards the goal, and turn now and then.
            let (yaw, _) = look(me.origin, goal);
            return Input { yaw: yaw + ((t / self.secs(1.0)) % 4) as f32 * 90.0, forward: 400.0, ..input };
        };
        let p = nav.points[next as usize];
        if flat(me.origin, p) < 24.0 {
            self.brain.path_at += 1;
        }
        let (yaw, _) = look(me.origin, p);
        input.yaw = yaw;
        input.pitch = 0.0;
        input.forward = 400.0;
        // Tap jump (holding it only jumps once, as in CS) onto something higher; crouch in
        // the air for the extra height. Bunny hoppers jump all the time.
        let climb = p[2] - me.origin[2] > 18.0 && flat(me.origin, p) < 64.0;
        let bhop = self.mode == Mode::Bhop && me.on_ground;
        input.jump = ((climb || self.brain.stuck_on > 0) && t % self.secs(0.125) == 0) || (bhop && t % 2 == 0);
        input.use_key = self.brain.stuck_on > 0 && t % self.secs(0.25) < 2;
        input.crouch = climb && !me.on_ground;
        input
    }

    /// A rifle and armor when there's money (a pistol round: armor), a kit for CTs who can
    /// afford it; knifers buy nothing.
    fn buy(&mut self, team: Team) {
        if self.mode == Mode::Knife {
            return;
        }
        let money = self.client.me_info.money;
        let (rifle, price) = if team == Team::T { (Id::Ak47, 2500) } else { (Id::M4a1, 3100) };
        if money >= price + 1000 {
            self.client.buy(BuyItem::Weapon(rifle));
            self.client.buy(BuyItem::KevlarHelmet);
            if team == Team::Ct && money >= price + 1000 + 400 {
                self.client.buy(BuyItem::DefuseKit);
            }
        } else if money >= 650 {
            self.client.buy(BuyItem::Kevlar);
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/bot/control.rs`:

```rs
//! Orders for test bots, as text: `<who> <order> [args]`. Who: `all`, `t`, `ct`, or a bot
//! number (`3` or `bot3`). Several orders: separate them with `;`.
//!
//! Orders: `normal` (back to playing), `afk`, `hold` (stand here, shoot what comes),
//! `goto a|b|tspawn|ctspawn|x y z`, `rush a|b`, `plant a|b` (the site to take the bomb to /
//! guard, kept alongside the mode; `plant any` undoes it),
//! `peaceful` (never shoots), `spray` (fires nonstop), `aimbot` (instant perfect aim, for
//! anti-cheat tests), `grief` (shoots teammates), `bhop`, `knife`, `leave`, `rejoin`,
//! `difficulty easy|normal|hard|expert`, `buy <weapon>`.
use super::profile::{Difficulty, Profile};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Who {
    All,
    Team(crate::protocol::Team),
    Bot(usize),
}

/// Where to go.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Place {
    Site(usize),
    TSpawn,
    CtSpawn,
    At([f32; 3]),
}

/// A standing test behaviour (replaces normal play until `normal`).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Mode {
    Normal,
    Afk,
    Hold,
    Goto(Place),
    /// Straight there, no retreating, shooting on the way.
    Rush(Place),
    Peaceful,
    Spray,
    Aimbot,
    Grief,
    Bhop,
    Knife,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Order {
    Mode(Mode),
    /// The site this bot plays (None: its own pick each round).
    Site(Option<usize>),
    Difficulty(Difficulty),
    Buy(sim::weapons::Id),
    Leave,
    Rejoin,
}

fn place(words: &[&str]) -> Option<Place> {
    Some(match words {
        ["a"] => Place::Site(0),
        ["b"] => Place::Site(1),
        ["tspawn"] => Place::TSpawn,
        ["ctspawn"] => Place::CtSpawn,
        [x, y, z] => Place::At([x.parse().ok()?, y.parse().ok()?, z.parse().ok()?]),
        _ => return None,
    })
}

/// One `<who> <order> [args]`; Err explains what was wrong.
pub fn parse(line: &str) -> Result<(Who, Order), String> {
    let words: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
    let [who, order, args @ ..] = words.as_slice() else { return Err("usage: <all|t|ct|N> <order> [args]".into()) };
    let who = match *who {
        "all" => Who::All,
        "t" => Who::Team(crate::protocol::Team::T),
        "ct" => Who::Team(crate::protocol::Team::Ct),
        n => Who::Bot(n.trim_start_matches("bot").parse().map_err(|_| format!("who? {n}"))?),
    };
    let site = |args: &[&str]| match args {
        ["a"] => Ok(0),
        ["b"] => Ok(1),
        _ => Err("site a or b".to_string()),
    };
    let order = match (*order, args) {
        ("normal", []) => Order::Mode(Mode::Normal),
        ("afk", []) => Order::Mode(Mode::Afk),
        ("hold", []) => Order::Mode(Mode::Hold),
        ("peaceful", []) => Order::Mode(Mode::Peaceful),
        ("spray", []) => Order::Mode(Mode::Spray),
        ("aimbot", []) => Order::Mode(Mode::Aimbot),
        ("grief", []) => Order::Mode(Mode::Grief),
        ("bhop", []) => Order::Mode(Mode::Bhop),
        ("knife", []) => Order::Mode(Mode::Knife),
        ("goto", a) => Order::Mode(Mode::Goto(place(a).ok_or("goto a|b|tspawn|ctspawn|x y z")?)),
        ("rush", a) => Order::Mode(Mode::Rush(place(a).ok_or("rush a|b|tspawn|ctspawn|x y z")?)),
        ("plant", ["any"]) => Order::Site(None),
        ("plant", a) => Order::Site(Some(site(a)?)),
        ("difficulty", [d]) => Order::Difficulty(Profile::parse(d).ok_or("easy|normal|hard|expert")?),
        ("buy", [w]) => Order::Buy(sim::weapons::data::by_name(w).ok_or(format!("no weapon {w}"))?),
        ("leave", []) => Order::Leave,
        ("rejoin", []) => Order::Rejoin,
        (o, _) => return Err(format!("unknown order {o} (see net/src/bot/control.rs)")),
    };
    Ok((who, order))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::protocol::Team;

    #[test]
    fn orders_parse() {
        assert_eq!(parse("t plant b"), Ok((Who::Team(Team::T), Order::Site(Some(1)))));
        assert_eq!(parse("bot3 goto 1 2 3"), Ok((Who::Bot(3), Order::Mode(Mode::Goto(Place::At([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]))))));
        assert_eq!(parse("all difficulty expert"), Ok((Who::All, Order::Difficulty(Difficulty::Expert))));
        assert_eq!(parse("2 buy ak47"), Ok((Who::Bot(2), Order::Buy(sim::weapons::Id::Ak47))));
        assert!(parse("all dance").is_err());
        assert!(parse("x afk").is_err());
    }
}
```

`net/src/bot/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Test bots: real network players for filling test matches and load tests. A bot is a normal
//! `Client` (it signs in, gets a ticket, connects, predicts) with a brain on top, after the CS
//! 1.6 / Condition Zero bot (states Buy, Hunt, Attack, FetchBomb, PlantBomb, DefuseBomb,
//! Guard, EscapeFromBomb, InvestigateNoise; a reaction delay and aim error from its profile).
//! It only knows what the server shows it (the same anti-wallhack view as a person). Tests can
//! give it orders (`control`): go afk, hold, rush a site, grief, leave and rejoin... Never in
//! real matches: the official lobby requires Steam.
use crate::client::Client;
use crate::protocol::GameEvent;
use std::sync::Arc;

mod brain;
pub mod control;
pub mod nav;
pub mod profile;
pub use control::{Mode, Order, Place, Who};
pub use nav::Nav;
pub use profile::{Difficulty, Profile};

/// What bots know about a map: the way around, the spawns, the bomb sites.
pub struct BotMap {
    pub bsp: goldsrc::bsp::Bsp,
    pub nav: Nav,
    /// (terrorist, counter-terrorist) spawn.
    pub spawns: ([f32; 3], [f32; 3]),
    /// Bomb site centres, A first.
    pub sites: Vec<[f32; 3]>,
    pub zones: sim::zones::Zones,
}

impl BotMap {
    /// Takes a moment (the navigation is worked out from the map): load once, share.
    /// `name`: the map's name (which bomb site is A depends on the map).
    pub fn new(bsp: goldsrc::bsp::Bsp, name: &str) -> Arc<BotMap> {
        let world = sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp);
        let m = &bsp.models[0];
        let nav = Nav::build(&world, m.mins, m.maxs);
        let zones = sim::zones::Zones::from_bsp(&bsp);
        let sites = zones.sites_a_first(name);
        Arc::new(BotMap { spawns: spawns_of(&zones), nav, sites, zones, bsp })
    }

    pub fn world(&self) -> sim::collision::World {
        sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&self.bsp)
    }
}

pub struct Bot {
    pub client: Client,
    pub map: Arc<BotMap>,
    /// Its number for orders (`bot3`).
    pub index: usize,
    pub name: String,
    pub profile: Profile,
    pub mode: Mode,
    /// The site it plays (`plant a`); None = its own pick each round.
    pub site: Option<usize>,
    /// Left with `leave` (rejoin with `rejoin`).
    pub gone: bool,
    events: Vec<GameEvent>,
    brain: brain::State,
}

impl Bot {
    pub fn new(client: Client, map: Arc<BotMap>, index: usize, profile: Profile) -> Bot {
        let seed = index as u64 + 1;
        Bot { client, map, index, name: format!("bot{index}"), profile, mode: Mode::Normal, site: None, gone: false, events: Vec::new(), brain: brain::State::new(seed) }
    }

    /// Decide and send this tick's input.
    pub fn tick(&mut self) {
        if self.gone {
            return;
        }
        let input = self.think();
        self.client.tick(input);
        let new = self.client.take_events();
        self.hear(&new);
        self.events.extend(new);
    }

    /// What happened since last asked (the bot reads them too).
    pub fn take_events(&mut self) -> Vec<GameEvent> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.events)
    }

    pub fn is(&self, who: &Who) -> bool {
        match who {
            Who::All => true,
            Who::Team(t) => self.client.team() == *t,
            Who::Bot(i) => self.index == *i,
        }
    }

    pub fn order(&mut self, order: Order) {
        match order {
            Order::Mode(m) => self.mode = m,
            Order::Site(s) => self.site = s,
            Order::Difficulty(d) => self.profile = Profile::of(d),
            Order::Buy(w) => self.client.buy(crate::protocol::BuyItem::Weapon(w)),
            Order::Leave => {
                self.client.disconnect();
                self.gone = true;
            }
            Order::Rejoin if self.gone => {
                let (server, ticket, key) = (self.client.server(), self.client.ticket, self.client.key);
                if let Ok(mut c) = Client::connect(server, &self.name, self.map.world()) {
                    c.ticket = ticket;
                    c.key = key;
                    self.client = c;
                    self.gone = false;
                }
            }
            Order::Rejoin => {}
        }
    }
}

/// Give orders (`control`, `;` between several) to the bots they're for; the number of bots
/// that took each order, or what was wrong.
pub fn command(bots: &mut [Bot], line: &str) -> Result<Vec<usize>, String> {
    let mut taken = Vec::new();
    for part in line.split(';').map(str::trim).filter(|p| !p.is_empty()) {
        let (who, order) = control::parse(part)?;
        let mut n = 0;
        for b in bots.iter_mut().filter(|b| b.is(&who)) {
            b.order(order.clone());
            n += 1;
        }
        taken.push(n);
    }
    Ok(taken)
}

/// The first terrorist and counter-terrorist spawn of a map.
pub fn spawns_of(zones: &sim::zones::Zones) -> ([f32; 3], [f32; 3]) {
    let first = |side| zones.spawns(side).first().copied().unwrap_or_default();
    (first(sim::zones::Side::T), first(sim::zones::Side::Ct))
}
```
