`net/src/lobby/matchmaker.rs`:

```rs
//! Casual matchmaking: fair, fast, and kind to parties. No ranks are shown, but every player
//! has a hidden skill (`rating`), and each match is built to be as close to 50/50 as the queue
//! allows:
//!
//! 1. The party waiting longest goes first. Parties near its skill (a window that widens the
//!    longer it waits) and with a good ping to the region are the candidates.
//! 2. Of those, the 10 players and the 5 v 5 split (parties never split) with the predicted
//!    win chance closest to 50% win, a little extra for keeping the skill spread small and for
//!    big premades meeting big premades. What counts as "fair enough" also widens with time.
//! 3. Everyone gets the match to accept (`ACCEPT_SECONDS`). All accept: a server is booked.
//!    Anyone doesn't: they get a short queue cooldown (longer each time that day), and the
//!    others go back to the queue keeping their place.
//! 4. At the end, the game server reports who won; ratings update. Abandoning counts as a loss
//!    and brings a cooldown too.
use super::rating::{self, Rating};
use super::*;

/// Seconds to accept a found match.
pub const ACCEPT_SECONDS: f32 = 20.0;
/// The skill window around the oldest party (in rating mu), and how it widens per second.
const SKILL_WINDOW: f64 = 4.0;
const SKILL_WIDEN_PER_SECOND: f64 = 0.05;
/// How far from 50/50 a match may be at first, how that widens per second, and the most.
const FAIR: f64 = 0.04;
const FAIR_WIDEN_PER_SECOND: f64 = 0.0015;
const FAIR_MAX: f64 = 0.20;
/// Candidates looked at per match (the search is over their combinations).
const CANDIDATES: usize = 14;
/// Cooldowns: not accepting a match (doubling each time in a day, at most an hour), and
/// abandoning one (30 minutes, doubling).
const DECLINE_COOLDOWN: u64 = 60;
const ABANDON_COOLDOWN: u64 = 30 * 60;

pub struct ReadyCheck {
    players: Vec<(u32, Group)>,
    accepted: Vec<u32>,
    until: Instant,
    region: String,
}

/// A queued party, as the matchmaker sees it.
#[derive(Clone)]
struct Entry {
    members: Vec<u32>,
    ratings: Vec<Rating>,
    mu: f64,
    waited: f64,
}

impl LobbyServer {
    fn rating_of(&self, player: u32) -> Rating {
        let steam = self.players.values().find(|p| p.id == player).map(|p| p.steam).unwrap_or(0);
        if steam == 0 {
            return Rating::default();
        }
        self.ratings.get(&steam).copied().unwrap_or_default()
    }

    /// Who a cooldown (or a running match) sticks to: the Steam account, or (no Steam) this
    /// session.
    pub(super) fn penalty_key(&self, player: u32) -> u64 {
        match self.players.values().find(|p| p.id == player).map(|p| p.steam) {
            Some(steam) if steam != 0 => steam,
            _ => 1 << 63 | player as u64,
        }
    }

    /// Seconds before this player may queue again.
    pub(super) fn cooldown_of(&self, player: u32) -> Option<f32> {
        let (_, until) = self.penalties.get(&self.penalty_key(player))?;
        let now = crate::crypto::now();
        (*until > now).then(|| (*until - now) as f32)
    }

    fn penalize(&mut self, key: u64, base: u64) {
        let now = crate::crypto::now();
        let (count, until) = self.penalties.entry(key).or_insert((0, 0));
        if now > *until + 24 * 3600 {
            *count = 0; // a clean day forgives
        }
        let secs = (base << (*count).min(5)).min(if base == DECLINE_COOLDOWN { 3600 } else { 24 * 3600 });
        *count += 1;
        *until = now + secs;
    }

    pub(super) fn ready_of(&self, player: u32) -> Option<ReadyNet> {
        let c = self.checks.iter().find(|c| c.players.iter().any(|(p, _)| *p == player))?;
        Some(ReadyNet { accepted: c.accepted.len() as u8, total: c.players.len() as u8, left: c.until.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now()).as_secs_f32(), you: c.accepted.contains(&player) })
    }

    pub(super) fn accept(&mut self, player: u32) {
        if let Some(c) = self.checks.iter_mut().find(|c| c.players.iter().any(|(p, _)| *p == player)) {
            if !c.accepted.contains(&player) {
                c.accepted.push(player);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Said no (or cancelled during a check): the check fails for them right away.
    pub(super) fn decline(&mut self, player: u32) {
        if let Some(c) = self.checks.iter_mut().find(|c| c.players.iter().any(|(p, _)| *p == player) && !c.accepted.contains(&player)) {
            c.until = Instant::now();
        }
    }

    /// Ready checks: everyone accepted, book the server; time's up, sort out who didn't.
    fn checks_step(&mut self) {
        let mut i = 0;
        while i < self.checks.len() {
            let c = &self.checks[i];
            if c.accepted.len() == c.players.len() {
                let c = self.checks.remove(i);
                if !self.start_match(c.players.clone(), false, Some(&c.region), None) {
                    // The server went away meanwhile: everyone back in line, first.
                    self.requeue(&c.players.iter().map(|(p, _)| *p).collect::<Vec<_>>());
                }
                continue;
            }
            if Instant::now() >= c.until {
                let c = self.checks.remove(i);
                let (yes, no): (Vec<u32>, Vec<u32>) = c.players.iter().map(|(p, _)| *p).partition(|p| c.accepted.contains(p));
                for p in &no {
                    let key = self.penalty_key(*p);
                    self.penalize(key, DECLINE_COOLDOWN);
                    if let Some(party) = self.parties.values_mut().find(|q| q.members.iter().any(|(m, _)| m == p)) {
                        party.queued = None;
                    }
                    if let Some(pl) = self.players.values_mut().find(|q| q.id == *p) {
                        pl.notice = "You didn't accept the match: you can queue again in a little while.".into();
                    }
                }
                // Parties whose members all accepted go back to the queue with their wait.
                self.requeue(&yes);
                for p in &yes {
                    if let Some(pl) = self.players.values_mut().find(|q| q.id == *p) {
                        pl.notice = "Someone didn't accept: back in the queue, keeping your place.".into();
                    }
                }
                continue;
            }
            i += 1;
        }
    }

    /// Parties of these players go back in the queue (they kept `queued` all along, so their
    /// place too), except parties with someone who didn't accept.
    fn requeue(&mut self, players: &[u32]) {
        for party in self.parties.values_mut() {
            if party.members.iter().any(|(m, _)| players.contains(m)) && party.queued.is_none() {
                party.queued = Some(Instant::now());
            }
        }
    }

    /// Find matches (as many as the queue makes, a few a step) and run the ready checks.
    pub(super) fn matchmake(&mut self) {
        self.checks_step();
        let side = self.match_size / 2;
        let checking: Vec<u32> = self.checks.iter().flat_map(|c| c.players.iter().map(|(p, _)| *p)).collect();
        let mut queue: Vec<Entry> = self
            .parties
            .values()
            .filter(|p| p.queued.is_some() && p.mode == Mode::Casual && p.members.len() <= side)
            .filter(|p| !p.members.iter().any(|(m, _)| checking.contains(m)))
            .map(|p| {
                let members: Vec<u32> = p.members.iter().map(|(m, _)| *m).collect();
                let ratings: Vec<Rating> = members.iter().map(|m| self.rating_of(*m)).collect();
                let mu = ratings.iter().map(|r| r.mu).sum::<f64>() / ratings.len() as f64;
                Entry { members, ratings, mu, waited: p.queued.unwrap().elapsed().as_secs_f64() }
            })
            .collect();
        queue.sort_by(|a, b| b.waited.total_cmp(&a.waited));
        let mut regions: Vec<String> = self.servers.values().filter(|s| s.official && !s.busy && !s.deathmatch).map(|s| s.region.clone()).collect();
        regions.sort();
        regions.dedup();
        let mut free: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
        for s in self.servers.values().filter(|s| s.official && !s.busy && !s.deathmatch) {
            *free.entry(s.region.clone()).or_default() += 1;
        }
        for _ in 0..8 {
            let Some((players, region)) = self.find_match(&queue, &regions, &free, side) else { break };
            *free.get_mut(&region).unwrap() -= 1;
            queue.retain(|e| !e.members.iter().any(|m| players.iter().any(|(p, _)| p == m)));
            for (p, _) in &players {
                if let Some(pl) = self.players.values_mut().find(|q| q.id == *p) {
                    pl.notice = "Match found: accept it!".into();
                }
            }
            println!("match found in {region}: {} players, waiting for them to accept", players.len());
            self.checks.push(ReadyCheck { players, accepted: Vec::new(), until: Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs_f32(ACCEPT_SECONDS), region });
        }
    }

    /// The best match around the oldest party that can have one, if fair enough.
    fn find_match(&self, queue: &[Entry], regions: &[String], free: &HashMap<String, usize>, side: usize) -> Option<(Vec<(u32, Group)>, String)> {
        for seed in queue {
            for region in regions.iter().filter(|r| free.get(*r).copied().unwrap_or(0) > 0) {
                let ok = |e: &Entry| self.worst_ping(&e.members, region).is_some_and(|p| p as f64 <= Self::ping_limit(Duration::from_secs_f64(e.waited)) as f64);
                if !ok(seed) {
                    continue;
                }
                let window = SKILL_WINDOW + seed.waited * SKILL_WIDEN_PER_SECOND;
                let mut near: Vec<&Entry> = queue.iter().filter(|e| !std::ptr::eq(*e, seed) && (e.mu - seed.mu).abs() <= window && ok(e)).collect();
                near.sort_by(|a, b| (a.mu - seed.mu).abs().total_cmp(&(b.mu - seed.mu).abs()));
                near.truncate(CANDIDATES);
                let fair = (FAIR + seed.waited * FAIR_WIDEN_PER_SECOND).min(FAIR_MAX);
                if let Some((_, off, a, b)) = best_split(seed, &near, side) {
                    if off <= fair {
                        let players = a.iter().flat_map(|e| e.members.iter().map(|m| (*m, Group::A))).chain(b.iter().flat_map(|e| e.members.iter().map(|m| (*m, Group::B)))).collect();
                        return Some((players, region.clone()));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        None
    }

    /// The game server's result: ratings move, abandoners get a cooldown.
    pub(super) fn match_result(&mut self, winners: &[u64], losers: &[u64], abandoned: &[u64]) {
        // The match is over: nobody can rejoin it.
        let seats: Vec<u64> = winners.iter().chain(losers).chain(abandoned).copied().collect();
        self.active.retain(|_, (_, t, _)| !seats.contains(t));
        let steam_of = |m: &LobbyServer, t: &u64| m.seats.get(t).map(|s| s.0).filter(|s| *s != 0);
        for t in abandoned {
            let key = steam_of(self, t).unwrap_or(1 << 62 | *t);
            self.penalize(key, ABANDON_COOLDOWN);
        }
        if winners.is_empty() || losers.is_empty() {
            return; // a draw (or a one-sided report): nobody's rating moves
        }
        let ids = |m: &LobbyServer, ts: &[u64]| ts.iter().filter_map(|t| steam_of(m, t)).collect::<Vec<u64>>();
        let (w, l) = (ids(self, winners), ids(self, losers));
        let mut wr: Vec<Rating> = w.iter().map(|s| self.ratings.get(s).copied().unwrap_or_default()).collect();
        let mut lr: Vec<Rating> = l.iter().map(|s| self.ratings.get(s).copied().unwrap_or_default()).collect();
        if wr.is_empty() || lr.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        rating::update(&mut wr, &mut lr);
        for (s, r) in w.iter().zip(wr).chain(l.iter().zip(lr)) {
            self.ratings.insert(*s, r);
        }
        if let Some(path) = &self.ratings_file {
            if let Err(e) = save_ratings(&self.ratings, path) {
                println!("can't save ratings to {}: {e}", path.display());
            }
        }
    }
}

/// The best 5 v 5 out of the seed and its candidates (parties stay whole): (its score, how
/// far its win chance is from 50/50, team A, team B). The score is that distance plus small
/// extras for a narrow skill spread and premades meeting premades.
fn best_split<'a>(seed: &'a Entry, near: &[&'a Entry], side: usize) -> Option<(f64, f64, Vec<&'a Entry>, Vec<&'a Entry>)> {
    let mut best: Option<(f64, f64, Vec<&Entry>, Vec<&Entry>)> = None;
    // Every set of candidates that makes 2 x side players with the seed...
    let n = near.len();
    for mask in 0u32..(1 << n) {
        let set: Vec<&Entry> = std::iter::once(seed).chain((0..n).filter(|i| mask & (1 << i) != 0).map(|i| near[i])).collect();
        if set.iter().map(|e| e.members.len()).sum::<usize>() != 2 * side {
            continue;
        }
        // ...and every way to split it into two teams of `side` (the seed on team A).
        let k = set.len();
        for split in 0u32..(1 << (k - 1)) {
            let in_a = |i: usize| i == 0 || split & (1 << (i - 1)) != 0;
            let size_a: usize = (0..k).filter(|i| in_a(*i)).map(|i| set[i].members.len()).sum();
            if size_a != side {
                continue;
            }
            let a: Vec<&Entry> = (0..k).filter(|i| in_a(*i)).map(|i| set[i]).collect();
            let b: Vec<&Entry> = (0..k).filter(|i| !in_a(*i)).map(|i| set[i]).collect();
            let ratings = |t: &[&Entry]| t.iter().flat_map(|e| e.ratings.iter().copied()).collect::<Vec<Rating>>();
            let fair = (rating::win_chance(&ratings(&a), &ratings(&b)) - 0.5).abs();
            // Small extras: a narrow skill spread, and premades meeting premades.
            let mus: Vec<f64> = set.iter().flat_map(|e| e.ratings.iter().map(|r| r.mu)).collect();
            let spread = mus.iter().cloned().fold(f64::MIN, f64::max) - mus.iter().cloned().fold(f64::MAX, f64::min);
            let biggest = |t: &[&Entry]| t.iter().map(|e| e.members.len()).max().unwrap_or(0) as f64;
            let premade = (biggest(&a) - biggest(&b)).abs();
            let score = fair + spread * 0.002 + premade * 0.01;
            if best.as_ref().is_none_or(|(s, _, _, _)| score < *s) {
                best = Some((score, fair, a, b));
            }
        }
    }
    best
}

pub fn save_ratings(ratings: &HashMap<u64, Rating>, path: &std::path::Path) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let list: Vec<(u64, Rating)> = ratings.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, *v)).collect();
    crate::secure::write_private(path, &encode(&list))
}

impl LobbyServer {
    /// Load the ratings kept at `path` (nothing there: everyone starts fresh).
    pub fn load_ratings(&mut self, path: &std::path::Path) {
        if let Some(list) = std::fs::read(path).ok().and_then(|b| decode::<Vec<(u64, Rating)>>(&b)) {
            self.ratings = list.into_iter().collect();
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn entry(mus: &[f64], waited: f64) -> Entry {
        let ratings: Vec<Rating> = mus.iter().map(|m| Rating { mu: *m, sigma: 3.0, matches: 20 }).collect();
        Entry { members: (0..mus.len() as u32).collect(), mu: mus.iter().sum::<f64>() / mus.len() as f64, ratings, waited }
    }

    #[test]
    fn results_move_ratings_and_abandoning_brings_a_cooldown() {
        let mut m = LobbyServer::bind("127.0.0.1:0".parse().unwrap(), vec![]).unwrap();
        for (ticket, steam) in [(1, 11), (2, 22), (3, 33)] {
            m.seats.insert(ticket, (steam, String::new(), Instant::now()));
        }
        m.active.insert(11, ("127.0.0.1:1".parse().unwrap(), 1, [0; 32]));
        m.match_result(&[1], &[2, 3], &[3]);
        let r = |s: u64| m.ratings[&s];
        assert!(r(11).mu > rating::MU && r(22).mu < rating::MU, "winner up, loser down");
        assert!(m.penalties.get(&33).is_some_and(|(_, until)| *until > crate::crypto::now() + 60), "abandoned: a cooldown");
        assert!(!m.penalties.contains_key(&22));
        assert!(m.active.is_empty(), "the match is over: no more rejoining");
    }

    #[test]
    fn splits_are_fair_and_keep_parties_whole() {
        // A strong pair, a weak pair and six middling solos: the 5 v 5 comes out even.
        let seed = entry(&[35.0, 35.0], 30.0);
        let others: Vec<Entry> = [vec![15.0, 15.0], vec![25.0], vec![25.0], vec![25.0], vec![25.0], vec![25.0], vec![25.0]].iter().map(|m| entry(m, 10.0)).collect();
        let near: Vec<&Entry> = others.iter().collect();
        let (_, off, a, b) = best_split(&seed, &near, 5).unwrap();
        assert!(off < 0.02, "{off}: should be close to 50/50");
        assert_eq!(a.iter().chain(&b).map(|e| e.members.len()).sum::<usize>(), 10);
        // (Several splits are exactly even here: what matters is the total skill per team.)
        let total = |t: &[&Entry]| t.iter().flat_map(|e| e.ratings.iter().map(|r| r.mu)).sum::<f64>();
        assert!((total(&a) - total(&b)).abs() < 1e-9, "{} v {}", total(&a), total(&b));
        // A 5-stack prefers another 5-stack over five strangers (equal skill).
        let stack = entry(&[25.0; 5], 30.0);
        let other_stack = entry(&[25.0; 5], 5.0);
        let solos: Vec<Entry> = (0..5).map(|_| entry(&[25.0], 5.0)).collect();
        let mut near: Vec<&Entry> = solos.iter().collect();
        near.push(&other_stack);
        let (_, _, _, b) = best_split(&stack, &near, 5).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(b.len(), 1, "five strangers were picked over the other 5-stack");
    }
}
```

```rs
//! What players, the lobby and game servers say to each other (the lobby's wire format).
use super::*;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum LobbyMsg {
    /// Game server -> lobby: "I'm here", and whether it's running a match.
    /// `address`: where players connect (empty = where this came from).
    /// Sealed with the official token's key (see `crypto::ServerKey`).
    /// `maps`: the pool maps it can run.
    Heartbeat { name: String, map: String, players: u8, max: u8, region: String, busy: bool, address: String, deathmatch: bool, maps: Vec<String> },
    /// Player -> lobby: sign in. `public`: a fresh key for this session; `sealed`: a `SignIn`
    /// only the lobby can read (see `crypto::client_hello`). `cookie`: 0 at first, then the
    /// one from `Cookie` (proves the address is real before the lobby does any crypto).
    Hello { cookie: u64, public: [u8; 32], sealed: Vec<u8> },
    /// Lobby -> player: say hello again with this.
    Cookie { cookie: u64 },
    /// Lobby -> player: signed in. `public`: the lobby's fresh key (finishes the handshake);
    /// `sealed`: the session number, over the new channel.
    Welcome { public: [u8; 32], sealed: Vec<u8> },
    /// Player -> lobby, in the session channel: do something (or just `Poll`).
    Command { cmd: Command, pad: Vec<u8> },
    /// Player -> lobby: what's your public key? Only for builds without one built in (tests,
    /// development): trusting the answer is only as good as the network it came over.
    KeyPlease { pad: Vec<u8> },
    Key { public: [u8; 32] },
    /// Lobby -> player: everything about you now.
    State(LobbyState),
    /// Lobby -> player: unknown session (the lobby restarted, or you timed out): sign in again.
    Expired,
    /// Lobby -> player: not let in (this lobby needs a Steam login).
    Refused { reason: String },
    /// Game server -> lobby, at the end of a match (sealed): who won and lost, by ticket, and
    /// who abandoned (gone for good before the end). Empty `winners`: a draw.
    Result { winners: Vec<u64>, losers: Vec<u64>, abandoned: Vec<u64> },
    /// Game server -> lobby: a player reported another (by their match tickets). Sealed.
    /// Game server -> lobby: the aim checks flagged a player (see `server::aimcheck`). Sealed.
    Flag { ticket: u64, reason: String, map: String, demo: String, tick: u32 },
    /// `demo`, `tick`: the match recording and the moment of the report (empty: not recorded).
    Report { reporter: u64, target: u64, reason: crate::protocol::ReportReason, map: String, round: u32, demo: String, tick: u32 },
}

/// What a player signs in with (inside the sealed hello).
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct SignIn {
    pub name: String,
    /// A Steam login (the lobby checks it with Steam); None = anonymous (tests, no Steam).
    pub steam: Option<SteamLogin>,
    pub pad: Vec<u8>,
}

/// Steam sign-in: who you say you are and Steam's ticket proving it.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct SteamLogin {
    pub steam_id: u64,
    pub ticket: Vec<u8>,
}

/// How the lobby treats Steam logins.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SteamMode {
    /// Take the claimed Steam id as is (tests and lobbies built without Steam; never official).
    Trust,
    /// Ask Steam: logins wait in `take_steam_checks` until `steam_checked` answers.
    Verify,
}

/// A party member as everyone in the party sees them.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct Member {
    pub id: u32,
    pub name: String,
    /// Team in a custom game.
    pub group: Group,
    /// Their Steam id (for the avatar), 0 = not signed in with Steam.
    pub steam: u64,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum Command {
    Poll,
    /// Join the party with this invite code (leaving yours).
    JoinParty { code: String },
    /// Leave your party (you get a new one of your own).
    LeaveParty,
    /// Leader: casual queue or custom game.
    SetMode(Mode),
    /// Leader, custom games: put a member on team A or B.
    Move { member: u32, group: Group },
    /// Leader: queue for casual / start the custom game.
    Play,
    /// Leader: leave the queue.
    Cancel,
    /// Invite a friend who is in the game (by Steam id) to your party.
    Invite { steam: u64 },
    /// Your ping (ms) to each region (from `LobbyState::regions`); the queue uses it.
    Pings(Vec<(String, u16)>),
    /// A match was found (`LobbyState::ready`): in, or out (out: a short queue cooldown).
    Accept,
    Decline,
    /// A seat on a deathmatch server (comes back as `found`).
    Deathmatch,
    /// The pool maps this player's game has (others can't be played with them).
    Maps(Vec<String>),
    /// Leader, custom games: play this map (None: a random one).
    SetMap(Option<String>),
}

/// Lobby -> game server, sealed with its token's key.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum LobbyOrder {
    /// Run this match.
    Book(crate::server::MatchSetup),
    /// Deathmatch: let this ticket in, encrypted with this key.
    Seat { ticket: u64, key: [u8; 32] },
}

/// A match found, waiting for everyone to accept.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub struct ReadyNet {
    pub accepted: u8,
    pub total: u8,
    /// Seconds left to accept.
    pub left: f32,
    /// You've accepted.
    pub you: bool,
}

/// How long an invite stays up.
pub const INVITE_SECONDS: f32 = 30.0;

/// An invite to someone's party.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct Invite {
    pub from: String,
    /// The inviter's Steam id (for the avatar).
    pub steam: u64,
    /// Their party's code: accepting is joining it.
    pub code: String,
    /// Seconds before it goes away.
    pub left: f32,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Mode {
    /// Matchmaking with strangers: up to 5 friends, always on one team.
    Casual,
    /// Private game: up to 10, you pick the teams; knife round for sides.
    Custom,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct LobbyState {
    /// Your public id (party members see it).
    pub you: u32,
    pub code: String,
    pub leader: u32,
    pub mode: Mode,
    pub members: Vec<Member>,
    /// Seconds in the casual queue, if queued.
    pub searching: Option<f32>,
    /// A match found: accept it (`Command::Accept`) before the time runs out.
    pub ready: Option<ReadyNet>,
    /// Can't queue for this many more seconds (didn't accept matches, abandoned one).
    pub cooldown: Option<f32>,
    /// Match ready: the server, your ticket and your key for it.
    pub found: Option<(SocketAddr, u64, [u8; 32])>,
    /// Your match is still running (you left it, or your game restarted): go back with this.
    pub rejoin: Option<(SocketAddr, u64, [u8; 32])>,
    /// Something to tell the player ("no server free", "party full"...).
    pub notice: String,
    /// Invites to other parties, newest last.
    pub invites: Vec<Invite>,
    /// Custom games: the map picked (None: random).
    pub map: Option<String>,
    /// One server per region to measure your ping to (answer with `Command::Pings`).
    pub regions: Vec<(String, SocketAddr)>,
}
```

```rs
//! The lobby service (the "master"): everyone online is in a party (a party of one to start,
//! like CS2) with an invite code. A party queues for a casual match, or plays a custom game:
//! up to 10 people split into team A and team B. When a match is ready it reserves a free
//! official server and gives each player a ticket for it. Game servers announce themselves
//! here; it never carries game traffic.
//!
//! Over UDP, kept simple: players send commands and poll their state every second; every
//! answer is the full state, so a lost packet never leaves anyone out of date. Requests are
//! padded so answers are never bigger than requests (nobody can use this to flood others).
use crate::protocol::{decode, encode};
use crate::server::Group;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::net::{SocketAddr, UdpSocket};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

mod client;
mod messages;
mod party;
mod servers;
mod signin;
pub use messages::*;
mod persist;
mod matchmaker;
mod queue;
pub mod rating;
mod standby;
pub use standby::Role;
pub use client::LobbyClient;

pub const LOBBY_PORT: u16 = 27010;
/// Game servers announce this often and are forgotten after missing a few.
pub const HEARTBEAT_SECONDS: u64 = 5;
const SERVER_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(HEARTBEAT_SECONDS * 3);
/// Players poll every second; ten seconds of silence and they're gone.
const PLAYER_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);
/// Every player request is padded to this: the biggest state answer fits in it.
pub const PAD: usize = 1280;
/// Packets per second one IP may send the lobby (a player polls once a second; a household
/// of players and their clicks fit easily).
const IP_RATE: f32 = 40.0;
/// Signed-in players from one IP (loopback exempt: tests run many from it), and in all.
const SESSIONS_PER_IP: usize = 10;
const MAX_PLAYERS: usize = 50_000;
/// Game servers in the pool (official ones only).
const MAX_SERVERS: usize = 2_000;
/// What a state answer may hold, so it never outgrows the padded request (see the test).
pub const MAX_REGIONS: usize = 8;
pub const MAX_INVITES: usize = 5;
pub const MAX_PARTY: usize = 5;
pub const MAX_CUSTOM: usize = 10;

struct Player {
    /// The encrypted session (commands in, states out).
    channel: crate::crypto::Channel,
    id: u32,
    name: String,
    /// Steam id once signed in with Steam (0 = anonymous).
    steam: u64,
    addr: SocketAddr,
    party: u32,
    seen: Instant,
    found: Option<(SocketAddr, u64, [u8; 32])>,
    notice: String,
    /// Who invited us (player id) and when.
    invites: Vec<(u32, Instant)>,
    /// Ping per region, as the player measured it.
    pings: HashMap<String, u16>,
    /// The pool maps their game has (None: not told: the stock ones).
    maps: Option<Vec<String>>,
}

struct Party {
    code: String,
    leader: u32,
    mode: Mode,
    /// Members in order joined, with their custom-game team.
    members: Vec<(u32, Group)>,
    queued: Option<Instant>,
    /// Custom games: the map the leader picked (None: a random one).
    map: Option<String>,
}

struct GameServer {
    /// Where players connect (the heartbeat's source unless the server says otherwise).
    public: SocketAddr,
    region: String,
    /// Which official token (its key seals our messages to it).
    key: usize,
    official: bool,
    busy: bool,
    seen: Instant,
    /// When its newest heartbeat was sealed (older ones are replays).
    sent: u64,
    /// A deathmatch server (drop-in seats, never booked for matches), its players and slots,
    /// and the seats we gave out lately (not in its player count yet).
    deathmatch: bool,
    players: u8,
    max: u8,
    seated: Vec<Instant>,
    /// The pool maps it can run.
    maps: Vec<String>,
}

pub struct LobbyServer {
    udp: UdpSocket,
    servers: HashMap<SocketAddr, GameServer>,
    /// session secret -> player.
    players: HashMap<u64, Player>,
    parties: HashMap<u32, Party>,
    next_id: u32,
    /// Our long-term key (its public half is built into the game) and the secret behind the
    /// sign-in cookies.
    key: crate::crypto::LobbyKey,
    cookies: crate::secure::Cookies,
    /// The official tokens' keys (game servers seal everything with theirs).
    pub(super) keys: Vec<crate::crypto::ServerKey>,
    /// Packet budgets per IP (players and servers alike).
    limits: crate::secure::Buckets<std::net::IpAddr>,
    started: Instant,
    /// Players per casual match (10; tests use 2).
    pub match_size: usize,
    /// When the last status line was printed.
    reported: Instant,
    pub steam_mode: SteamMode,
    /// Only players signed in with Steam (official lobbies: keeps test bots and anonymous
    /// clients out of real matches).
    pub require_steam: bool,
    /// Steam logins waiting for Steam's answer: (session, Steam id, ticket).
    steam_checks: Vec<(u64, u64, Vec<u8>)>,
    /// Who holds each match ticket (Steam id, name), for reports; kept a few hours.
    pub(super) seats: HashMap<u64, (u64, String, Instant)>,
    /// Where reports are written (one JSON object per line); None = only printed.
    pub reports: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
    /// Bookings the server hasn't confirmed yet (a busy heartbeat): the message, when it was
    /// first and last sent. Resent until confirmed, so a lost packet can't lose a match.
    pub(super) booking: HashMap<SocketAddr, (Vec<u8>, Instant, Instant)>,
    /// Active (serving players) or standby (a paired lobby is; see `standby`).
    pub role: Role,
    pub(super) peer: Option<standby::Peer>,
    /// Saved here every couple of seconds, and loaded at start (see `persist`).
    pub state_file: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
    /// Hidden skill per Steam id (see `rating`), kept in `ratings_file` for good.
    pub(super) ratings: HashMap<u64, rating::Rating>,
    pub ratings_file: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
    /// Queue cooldowns: (who: Steam id, or a session's player id for players without Steam)
    /// -> (how many in the last day, until when: unix seconds).
    pub(super) penalties: HashMap<u64, (u32, u64)>,
    /// Matches found, waiting for everyone to accept.
    pub(super) checks: Vec<matchmaker::ReadyCheck>,
    /// Running matches, per player (Steam id, or a session's player key): where, and their
    /// seat. Offered as `rejoin` until the match ends.
    pub(super) active: HashMap<u64, (SocketAddr, u64, [u8; 32])>,
    saved: Instant,
}

impl LobbyServer {
    pub fn bind(addr: SocketAddr, tokens: Vec<String>) -> std::io::Result<LobbyServer> {
        let udp = UdpSocket::bind(addr)?;
        udp.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_millis(100)))?;
        let keys = tokens.iter().map(|t| crate::crypto::ServerKey::from_token(t)).collect();
        Ok(LobbyServer { udp, key: crate::crypto::LobbyKey::generate(), cookies: crate::secure::Cookies::new(), keys, servers: HashMap::new(), players: HashMap::new(), parties: HashMap::new(), next_id: 1, limits: crate::secure::Buckets::new(100_000), started: Instant::now(), match_size: 10, reported: Instant::now(), steam_mode: SteamMode::Trust, require_steam: false, steam_checks: Vec::new(), seats: HashMap::new(), reports: None, booking: HashMap::new(), role: Role::Active, peer: None, state_file: None, saved: Instant::now(), ratings: HashMap::new(), ratings_file: None, penalties: HashMap::new(), checks: Vec::new(), active: HashMap::new() })
    }

    pub fn local_addr(&self) -> SocketAddr {
        self.udp.local_addr().expect("bound")
    }

    /// Tickets, sessions and codes come from the OS random source: seeing your own must not
    /// tell you anyone else's.
    fn rand(&mut self) -> u64 {
        crate::secure::random()
    }

    /// Handle what has arrived (waits up to 100 ms), then run matchmaking.
    pub fn step(&mut self) {
        let mut buf = [0u8; 2048];
        let _ = self.udp.set_nonblocking(false);
        // At most this many packets a step: under a flood the lobby still gets round to
        // matchmaking, saving and its standby (the rest wait in, and overflow, the OS queue).
        let mut room = 20_000;
        while let Ok((n, from)) = self.udp.recv_from(&mut buf) {
            room -= 1;
            if room == 0 {
                break;
            }
            let _ = self.udp.set_nonblocking(true);
            // Every IP has a budget: floods cost nothing past here.
            let now = self.started.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
            // (Loopback can't be faked from outside, and tests run everyone from it.)
            if !from.ip().is_loopback() && !self.limits.allow(from.ip(), IP_RATE, now) {
                continue;
            }
            if buf[0] == crate::crypto::SERVER {
                self.from_server(from, &buf[..n]);
                continue;
            }
            // Standing by: the active lobby answers players.
            if self.role == Role::Standby {
                continue;
            }
            if buf[0] == crate::crypto::CHANNEL {
                self.from_player(from, &buf[..n]);
                continue;
            }
            match decode::<LobbyMsg>(&buf[..n]) {
                Some(LobbyMsg::KeyPlease { pad }) if pad.len() >= 64 => {
                    let _ = self.udp.send_to(&encode(&LobbyMsg::Key { public: self.key.public() }), from);
                }
                Some(LobbyMsg::Hello { cookie, public, sealed }) if sealed.len() >= PAD => self.hello(from, cookie, public, &sealed),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        let now = Instant::now();
        self.seats.retain(|_, (_, _, at)| at.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(6 * 3600));
        let secs = self.started.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
        self.limits.tidy(secs, 10.0);
        for (addr, (msg, first, last)) in &mut self.booking {
            if last.elapsed() > Duration::from_millis(500) {
                let _ = self.udp.send_to(msg, addr);
                *last = Instant::now();
            }
            if first.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(5) {
                println!("server {addr} didn't take its match");
            }
        }
        self.booking.retain(|_, (_, first, _)| first.elapsed() <= Duration::from_secs(5));
        self.servers.retain(|_, s| {
            let alive = now - s.seen < SERVER_TIMEOUT;
            if !alive {
                println!("server {} stopped answering, out of the pool", s.public);
            }
            alive
        });
        self.peer_step();
        if self.role == Role::Standby {
            return;
        }
        let gone: Vec<(u32, u32)> = self.players.values().filter(|p| now - p.seen > PLAYER_TIMEOUT).map(|p| (p.id, p.party)).collect();
        for (id, party) in gone {
            self.leave(id, party);
            self.players.retain(|_, p| p.id != id);
        }
        self.matchmake();
        if let Some(path) = &self.state_file {
            if self.saved.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(2) {
                self.saved = now;
                if let Err(e) = self.save(path) {
                    println!("can't save the lobby state to {}: {e}", path.display());
                }
            }
        }
        if now - self.reported > Duration::from_secs(60) {
            self.reported = now;
            let queued: usize = self.parties.values().filter(|p| p.queued.is_some()).map(|p| p.members.len()).sum();
            let free = self.servers.values().filter(|s| s.official && !s.busy && !s.deathmatch).count();
            let busy = self.servers.values().filter(|s| s.busy).count();
            println!("{} online, {queued} in queue, servers: {free} free, {busy} in a match", self.players.len());
        }
    }

    pub fn run(&mut self) {
        loop {
            self.step();
        }
    }

}
```

```rs
//! Parties (codes, leaders, members, invites), what players ask for, and the state they get back.
use super::*;

impl LobbyServer {
    /// A party code nobody else has.
    pub(super) fn new_code(&mut self) -> String {
        loop {
            let code = self.random_code();
            if !self.parties.values().any(|p| p.code == code) {
                return code;
            }
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn random_code(&mut self) -> String {
        // No 0/O/1/I: easy to read out to a friend.
        const ABC: &[u8] = b"ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
        let r = self.rand();
        let c: String = (0..6).map(|i| ABC[((r >> (i * 5)) & 31) as usize] as char).collect();
        format!("{}-{}", &c[..3], &c[3..])
    }

    pub(super) fn new_party(&mut self, player: u32) -> u32 {
        let code = self.new_code();
        let id = self.next_id;
        self.next_id += 1;
        self.parties.insert(id, Party { code, leader: player, mode: Mode::Casual, members: vec![(player, Group::A)], queued: None, map: None });
        id
    }

    /// Take a player out of their party (it closes if they were the last).
    pub(super) fn leave(&mut self, player: u32, party: u32) {
        if let Some(p) = self.parties.get_mut(&party) {
            p.members.retain(|(m, _)| *m != player);
            p.queued = None;
            if p.members.is_empty() {
                self.parties.remove(&party);
            } else if p.leader == player {
                p.leader = p.members[0].0;
            }
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn player_party(&self, session: u64) -> Option<(u32, u32)> {
        self.players.get(&session).map(|p| (p.id, p.party))
    }

    pub(super) fn command(&mut self, session: u64, cmd: Command) {
        let Some((me, party)) = self.player_party(session) else { return };
        if let Some(p) = self.players.get_mut(&session) {
            p.seen = Instant::now();
        }
        let leader = self.parties.get(&party).is_some_and(|p| p.leader == me);
        let mut notice = String::new();
        // Official lobbies: nothing but waiting until Steam has confirmed who you are.
        if self.require_steam && self.players.get(&session).is_some_and(|p| p.steam == 0) && cmd != Command::Poll {
            if let Some(p) = self.players.get_mut(&session) {
                p.notice = "Waiting for Steam to confirm your sign-in...".into();
            }
            return;
        }
        match cmd {
            Command::Poll => {}
            Command::JoinParty { code } => {
                let code = code.trim().to_ascii_uppercase();
                match self.parties.iter().find(|(_, p)| p.code == code).map(|(id, p)| (*id, p.members.len(), p.mode)) {
                    Some((target, _, _)) if target == party => {}
                    Some((target, n, mode)) => {
                        let max = if mode == Mode::Custom { MAX_CUSTOM } else { MAX_PARTY };
                        if n >= max {
                            notice = "That party is full.".into();
                        } else {
                            self.leave(me, party);
                            let t = self.parties.get_mut(&target).unwrap();
                            // New members go to the smaller custom team.
                            let a = t.members.iter().filter(|(_, g)| *g == Group::A).count();
                            t.members.push((me, if a * 2 <= n { Group::A } else { Group::B }));
                            t.queued = None;
                            self.players.get_mut(&session).unwrap().party = target;
                        }
                    }
                    None => notice = "No party with that code.".into(),
                }
            }
            Command::LeaveParty => {
                self.leave(me, party);
                let p = self.new_party(me);
                self.players.get_mut(&session).unwrap().party = p;
            }
            Command::SetMode(mode) if leader => {
                let p = self.parties.get_mut(&party).unwrap();
                if mode == Mode::Casual && p.members.len() > MAX_PARTY {
                    notice = "Casual parties are up to 5. Use a custom game for more.".into();
                } else {
                    p.mode = mode;
                    p.queued = None;
                }
            }
            Command::Move { member, group } if leader => {
                if let Some(m) = self.parties.get_mut(&party).unwrap().members.iter_mut().find(|(m, _)| *m == member) {
                    m.1 = group;
                }
            }
            Command::Deathmatch => {
                if !self.deathmatch_seat(me) {
                    notice = "Every deathmatch server is full right now. Try again in a moment.".into();
                }
            }
            Command::Accept => self.accept(me),
            Command::Decline => self.decline(me),
            Command::Play if leader => {
                let mode = self.parties[&party].mode;
                // Anyone in the party on a cooldown keeps the party out of the queue.
                let cooling = self.parties[&party].members.iter().any(|(m, _)| self.cooldown_of(*m).is_some());
                match mode {
                    Mode::Casual if cooling => notice = "Someone in your party can't queue yet (they didn't accept a match, or left one).".into(),
                    Mode::Casual => self.parties.get_mut(&party).unwrap().queued = Some(Instant::now()),
                    Mode::Custom => {
                        let members = self.parties[&party].members.clone();
                        let map = self.parties[&party].map.clone();
                        if members.len() < 2 {
                            notice = "Invite at least one friend first.".into();
                        } else if !self.start_custom(members, map.as_deref()) {
                            notice = "No server free right now. Try again in a moment.".into();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Command::SetMap(map) if leader => {
                let have = self.common_maps(&self.parties[&party].members.iter().map(|(m, _)| *m).collect::<Vec<_>>());
                let p = self.parties.get_mut(&party).unwrap();
                match map {
                    Some(m) if !have.contains(&m) => notice = "Not everyone in the party has that map.".into(),
                    m => p.map = m,
                }
            }
            Command::Cancel if leader => {
                self.parties.get_mut(&party).unwrap().queued = None;
                self.decline(me);
            }
            Command::Maps(maps) => {
                if let Some(p) = self.players.get_mut(&session) {
                    p.maps = Some(maps.into_iter().filter(|m| crate::config::MAP_POOL.contains(&m.as_str())).collect());
                }
            }
            Command::Pings(pings) => {
                if let Some(p) = self.players.get_mut(&session) {
                    p.pings = pings.into_iter().take(32).map(|(r, ms)| (r.chars().take(16).collect(), ms)).collect();
                }
            }
            Command::Invite { steam } => match self.players.values_mut().find(|p| p.steam == steam && steam != 0) {
                Some(friend) => {
                    friend.invites.retain(|(from, _)| *from != me);
                    friend.invites.push((me, Instant::now()));
                    // The newest few (spamming invites can't push the answer past its size).
                    let extra = friend.invites.len().saturating_sub(MAX_INVITES);
                    friend.invites.drain(..extra);
                }
                None => notice = "They're not in the game right now.".into(),
            },
            _ => notice = "Only the party leader can do that.".into(),
        }
        if !notice.is_empty() {
            if let Some(p) = self.players.get_mut(&session) {
                p.notice = notice;
            }
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn state_of(&mut self, session: u64) -> Option<LobbyState> {
        let p = self.players.get_mut(&session)?;
        let notice = std::mem::take(&mut p.notice);
        p.invites.retain(|(_, at)| at.elapsed().as_secs_f32() < INVITE_SECONDS);
        let invited = p.invites.clone();
        let (you, party_id, found) = (p.id, p.party, p.found.take());
        let party = self.parties.get(&party_id)?;
        let who = |id: u32| self.players.values().find(|q| q.id == id).map(|q| (q.name.clone(), q.steam)).unwrap_or_default();
        Some(LobbyState {
            you,
            code: party.code.clone(),
            leader: party.leader,
            mode: party.mode,
            members: party.members.iter().map(|(m, g)| (*m, who(*m), *g)).map(|(id, (name, steam), group)| Member { id, name, group, steam }).collect(),
            searching: party.queued.map(|t| t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
            map: party.map.clone(),
            ready: self.ready_of(you),
            rejoin: self.active.get(&self.penalty_key(you)).copied(),
            cooldown: self.cooldown_of(you),
            found,
            notice,
            regions: self.ping_targets().into_iter().take(MAX_REGIONS).collect(),
            invites: invited
                .iter()
                .filter_map(|(from, at)| {
                    let q = self.players.values().find(|q| q.id == *from)?;
                    let code = self.parties.get(&q.party)?.code.clone();
                    Some(Invite { from: q.name.clone(), steam: q.steam, code, left: INVITE_SECONDS - at.elapsed().as_secs_f32() })
                })
                .collect(),
        })
    }
}
```

`net/src/lobby/persist.rs`:

```rs
//! The lobby's state as a snapshot: everyone's session (with its encryption state), parties,
//! the queue and the seats of running matches. Written to disk every couple of seconds (a
//! restarted lobby carries on where it was: nobody even notices) and streamed to a standby
//! lobby (see `standby`). The snapshot holds session keys: keep it as private as they are.
use super::*;
use crate::crypto::{Channel, ChannelState};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct PlayerSnap {
    session: u64,
    channel: ChannelState,
    id: u32,
    name: String,
    steam: u64,
    addr: SocketAddr,
    party: u32,
    found: Option<(SocketAddr, u64, [u8; 32])>,
    /// (inviter, seconds since)
    invites: Vec<(u32, f32)>,
    pings: Vec<(String, u16)>,
    maps: Option<Vec<String>>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct PartySnap {
    id: u32,
    code: String,
    leader: u32,
    mode: Mode,
    members: Vec<(u32, Group)>,
    /// Seconds in the queue.
    queued: Option<f32>,
    map: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub(super) struct Snapshot {
    next_id: u32,
    players: Vec<PlayerSnap>,
    parties: Vec<PartySnap>,
    /// (ticket, Steam id, name, seconds since booked)
    seats: Vec<(u64, u64, String, f32)>,
    ratings: Vec<(u64, super::rating::Rating)>,
    penalties: Vec<(u64, (u32, u64))>,
    active: Vec<(u64, (SocketAddr, u64, [u8; 32]))>,
}

/// `Instant` `secs` ago (saturating at now).
fn ago(secs: f32) -> Instant {
    Instant::now().checked_sub(Duration::from_secs_f32(secs.max(0.0))).unwrap_or_else(Instant::now)
}

impl LobbyServer {
    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let snap = Snapshot {
            next_id: self.next_id,
            players: self
                .players
                .iter()
                .map(|(session, p)| PlayerSnap {
                    session: *session,
                    channel: p.channel.export(),
                    id: p.id,
                    name: p.name.clone(),
                    steam: p.steam,
                    addr: p.addr,
                    party: p.party,
                    found: p.found,
                    invites: p.invites.iter().map(|(from, at)| (*from, at.elapsed().as_secs_f32())).collect(),
                    pings: p.pings.iter().map(|(r, ms)| (r.clone(), *ms)).collect(),
                    maps: p.maps.clone(),
                })
                .collect(),
            parties: self.parties.iter().map(|(id, p)| PartySnap { id: *id, code: p.code.clone(), leader: p.leader, mode: p.mode, members: p.members.clone(), queued: p.queued.map(|t| t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()), map: p.map.clone() }).collect(),
            seats: self.seats.iter().map(|(t, (steam, name, at))| (*t, *steam, name.clone(), at.elapsed().as_secs_f32())).collect(),
            ratings: self.ratings.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, *v)).collect(),
            penalties: self.penalties.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, *v)).collect(),
            active: self.active.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, *v)).collect(),
        };
        encode(&snap)
    }

    /// Take over a snapshot (everything we had is replaced). False if it isn't one.
    pub fn restore(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
        let Some(snap) = decode::<Snapshot>(bytes) else { return false };
        self.next_id = snap.next_id;
        self.players = snap
            .players
            .into_iter()
            .map(|p| {
                let player = Player {
                    channel: Channel::import(&p.channel),
                    id: p.id,
                    name: p.name,
                    steam: p.steam,
                    addr: p.addr,
                    party: p.party,
                    seen: Instant::now(),
                    found: p.found,
                    notice: String::new(),
                    invites: p.invites.into_iter().map(|(from, secs)| (from, ago(secs))).collect(),
                    pings: p.pings.into_iter().collect(),
                    maps: p.maps,
                };
                (p.session, player)
            })
            .collect();
        self.parties = snap.parties.into_iter().map(|p| (p.id, Party { code: p.code, leader: p.leader, mode: p.mode, members: p.members, queued: p.queued.map(ago), map: p.map })).collect();
        self.seats = snap.seats.into_iter().map(|(t, steam, name, secs)| (t, (steam, name, ago(secs)))).collect();
        self.ratings = snap.ratings.into_iter().collect();
        self.penalties = snap.penalties.into_iter().collect();
        self.active = snap.active.into_iter().collect();
        true
    }

    /// Save to `path` now (atomically: a crash mid-write never leaves half a file).
    pub fn save(&self, path: &std::path::Path) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        crate::secure::write_private(path, &self.snapshot())
    }

    /// Load what was saved at `path` (nothing there: a fresh start).
    pub fn load(&mut self, path: &std::path::Path) -> bool {
        std::fs::read(path).is_ok_and(|b| self.restore(&b))
    }
}
```

`net/src/lobby/queue.rs`:

```rs
//! Booking servers close to the players (the matching itself is in `matchmaker`). Each player measures their ping to every region; a party may play
//! in a region where all of them have a good ping, and "good" widens the longer they wait.
use super::*;
use crate::server::MatchSetup;

/// The worst ping a party accepts at first, how much it widens per second of waiting, and
/// the most it ever widens to.
const PING_START: f32 = 60.0;
const PING_WIDEN_PER_SECOND: f32 = 2.0;
const PING_MAX: f32 = 200.0;

impl LobbyServer {
    /// The ping a party accepts after waiting this long.
    pub(super) fn ping_limit(waited: Duration) -> f32 {
        (PING_START + waited.as_secs_f32() * PING_WIDEN_PER_SECOND).min(PING_MAX)
    }

    /// The worst ping of these players to a region (None: someone hasn't measured it, or
    /// can't reach it; anyone who measured nothing at all goes anywhere).
    pub(super) fn worst_ping(&self, members: &[u32], region: &str) -> Option<f32> {
        let mut worst = 0.0f32;
        for m in members {
            let p = self.players.values().find(|p| p.id == *m)?;
            if p.pings.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            worst = worst.max(*p.pings.get(region)? as f32);
        }
        Some(worst)
    }

    /// Regions with a free official server, best ping for these players first.
    fn regions_for(&self, members: &[u32]) -> Vec<(String, f32)> {
        let mut regions: Vec<(String, f32)> = Vec::new();
        for s in self.servers.values().filter(|s| s.official && !s.busy && !s.deathmatch) {
            if regions.iter().any(|(r, _)| *r == s.region) {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(ping) = self.worst_ping(members, &s.region) {
                regions.push((s.region.clone(), ping));
            }
        }
        regions.sort_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1));
        regions
    }

    /// Reserve a free official server in `region` (any region: None) for these players and
    /// hand out tickets. False if none.
    /// The pool maps one player can play (what their game reported; not told: the stock ones).
    fn maps_of(&self, player: u32) -> Vec<String> {
        match self.players.values().find(|p| p.id == player).and_then(|p| p.maps.clone()) {
            Some(m) => m,
            None => crate::config::STOCK_MAPS.iter().map(|m| m.to_string()).collect(),
        }
    }

    /// The pool maps all these players have.
    pub(super) fn common_maps(&self, players: &[u32]) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut maps: Vec<String> = crate::config::MAP_POOL.iter().map(|m| m.to_string()).collect();
        for p in players {
            let theirs = self.maps_of(*p);
            maps.retain(|m| theirs.contains(m));
        }
        maps
    }

    /// `map`: this one (a custom game's pick or veto), or None: a random one from the pool,
    /// always one every player and the server have.
    pub(super) fn start_match(&mut self, players: Vec<(u32, Group)>, knife_round: bool, region: Option<&str>, map: Option<&str>) -> bool {
        let ids: Vec<u32> = players.iter().map(|(p, _)| *p).collect();
        let common = self.common_maps(&ids);
        let fits = |s: &GameServer| match map {
            Some(m) => s.maps.iter().any(|x| x == m) || s.maps.is_empty(),
            None => s.maps.is_empty() || s.maps.iter().any(|x| common.contains(x)),
        };
        let free = self.servers.iter().find(|(_, s)| s.official && !s.busy && !s.deathmatch && region.is_none_or(|r| s.region == r) && fits(s));
        let Some((addr, public, key, region, maps)) = free.map(|(a, s)| (*a, s.public, s.key, s.region.clone(), s.maps.clone())) else { return false };
        let playable: Vec<String> = maps.into_iter().filter(|m| common.contains(m)).collect();
        let map = match map {
            Some(m) => m.to_string(),
            None if playable.is_empty() => String::new(),
            None => playable[(self.rand() % playable.len() as u64) as usize].clone(),
        };
        // A seat number and a fresh key per player: the server learns the keys from this
        // (sealed) booking, the player from the lobby (encrypted); they never travel in clear.
        let tickets: Vec<(u32, u64, Group, [u8; 32])> = players.iter().map(|(id, g)| (*id, self.rand() | 1, *g, crate::crypto::new_key())).collect();
        let setup = MatchSetup { players: tickets.iter().map(|(_, t, g, _)| (*t, *g)).collect(), knife_round, keys: tickets.iter().map(|(_, t, _, k)| (*t, *k)).collect(), map: map.clone() };
        // Sealed with the server's token key: only it can read it, nobody can forge one.
        let msg = self.keys[key].seal(&encode(&LobbyOrder::Book(setup)));
        let _ = self.udp.send_to(&msg, addr);
        self.booking.insert(addr, (msg, Instant::now(), Instant::now()));
        self.servers.get_mut(&addr).unwrap().busy = true;
        println!("match booked on {public} ({region}, {map}): {} players{}", players.len(), if knife_round { ", custom" } else { "" });
        for (id, ticket, _, k) in tickets {
            if let Some(p) = self.players.values_mut().find(|p| p.id == id) {
                p.found = Some((public, ticket, k));
                let who = if p.steam != 0 { p.steam } else { 1 << 63 | p.id as u64 };
                self.active.insert(who, (public, ticket, k));
                self.seats.insert(ticket, (p.steam, p.name.clone(), Instant::now()));
            }
            if let Some(party) = self.parties.values_mut().find(|q| q.members.iter().any(|(m, _)| *m == id)) {
                party.queued = None;
            }
        }
        true
    }

    /// A seat on the deathmatch server with room where this player pings best: sealed to the
    /// server, the ticket and key to the player (as `found`). False if they're all full.
    pub(super) fn deathmatch_seat(&mut self, player: u32) -> bool {
        for s in self.servers.values_mut() {
            s.seated.retain(|t| t.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(20));
        }
        // Room on it (players, plus seats given out but not taken yet), best ping first.
        let pick = self
            .servers
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, s)| s.official && s.deathmatch && (s.players as usize + s.seated.len()) < s.max as usize)
            .map(|(a, s)| (*a, self.worst_ping(&[player], &s.region).unwrap_or(f32::MAX)))
            .min_by(|a, b| a.1.total_cmp(&b.1))
            .map(|(a, _)| a);
        let Some(addr) = pick else { return false };
        let (ticket, key) = (self.rand() | 1, crate::crypto::new_key());
        let s = self.servers.get_mut(&addr).unwrap();
        s.seated.push(Instant::now());
        let (public, k) = (s.public, s.key);
        let order = self.keys[k].seal(&encode(&LobbyOrder::Seat { ticket, key }));
        let _ = self.udp.send_to(&order, addr);
        if let Some(p) = self.players.values_mut().find(|p| p.id == player) {
            p.found = Some((public, ticket, key));
            self.seats.insert(ticket, (p.steam, p.name.clone(), Instant::now()));
        }
        true
    }

    /// A custom game: the best region for the whole party, else any free server.
    pub(super) fn start_custom(&mut self, members: Vec<(u32, Group)>, map: Option<&str>) -> bool {
        let ids: Vec<u32> = members.iter().map(|(m, _)| *m).collect();
        let best = self.regions_for(&ids).into_iter().next().map(|(r, _)| r);
        self.start_match(members.clone(), true, best.as_deref(), map) || self.start_match(members, true, None, map)
    }

    /// One official server per region for players to ping.
    pub(super) fn ping_targets(&self) -> Vec<(String, SocketAddr)> {
        let mut out: Vec<(String, SocketAddr)> = Vec::new();
        for s in self.servers.values().filter(|s| s.official) {
            if !out.iter().any(|(r, _)| *r == s.region) {
                out.push((s.region.clone(), s.public));
            }
        }
        out.sort();
        out
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn ping_limit_widens_with_waiting() {
        assert_eq!(LobbyServer::ping_limit(Duration::ZERO), 60.0);
        assert_eq!(LobbyServer::ping_limit(Duration::from_secs(30)), 120.0);
        assert_eq!(LobbyServer::ping_limit(Duration::from_secs(600)), 200.0);
    }
}
```

`net/src/lobby/rating.rs`:

```rs
//! Hidden skill, for fair matches (never shown: casual has no ranks). Each player is a
//! Gaussian belief about their skill (mu, sigma), updated from wins and losses with the
//! Weng-Lin Bayesian approximation (Thurstone-Mosteller, the model OpenSkill implements):
//! open and patent-free, built for teams. Upsets move ratings more than expected results;
//! new players (big sigma) move fast, established ones slowly; sigma creeps back up between
//! matches so ratings keep following people who improve.
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

pub const MU: f64 = 25.0;
pub const SIGMA: f64 = MU / 3.0;
/// The skill difference that gives the better side ~76% to win.
const BETA: f64 = MU / 6.0;
/// How much uncertainty comes back each match (ratings never freeze).
const TAU: f64 = MU / 300.0;
/// Sigma never shrinks past this share per match (keeps the update stable).
const KAPPA: f64 = 0.0001;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub struct Rating {
    pub mu: f64,
    pub sigma: f64,
    pub matches: u32,
}

impl Default for Rating {
    fn default() -> Rating {
        Rating { mu: MU, sigma: SIGMA, matches: 0 }
    }
}

impl Rating {
    /// A cautious single number (we're ~99% sure they're at least this good).
    pub fn ordinal(&self) -> f64 {
        self.mu - 3.0 * self.sigma
    }
}

fn pdf(x: f64) -> f64 {
    (-x * x / 2.0).exp() / (2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI).sqrt()
}

/// The standard normal CDF (Abramowitz-Stegun 7.1.26 erf: error < 1.5e-7).
pub fn cdf(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let z = x.abs() / std::f64::consts::SQRT_2;
    let t = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.327_591_1 * z);
    let erf = 1.0 - t * (0.254_829_592 + t * (-0.284_496_736 + t * (1.421_413_741 + t * (-1.453_152_027 + t * 1.061_405_429)))) * (-z * z).exp();
    if x >= 0.0 {
        0.5 * (1.0 + erf)
    } else {
        0.5 * (1.0 - erf)
    }
}

fn team(ratings: &[Rating]) -> (f64, f64) {
    (ratings.iter().map(|r| r.mu).sum(), ratings.iter().map(|r| r.sigma * r.sigma).sum())
}

/// The chance team `a` beats team `b`.
pub fn win_chance(a: &[Rating], b: &[Rating]) -> f64 {
    let ((ma, sa), (mb, sb)) = (team(a), team(b));
    let n = (a.len() + b.len()) as f64;
    cdf((ma - mb) / (sa + sb + n * BETA * BETA).sqrt())
}

/// After a match: `winners` beat `losers` (everyone's rating, updated in place).
pub fn update(winners: &mut [Rating], losers: &mut [Rating]) {
    for r in winners.iter_mut().chain(losers.iter_mut()) {
        r.sigma = (r.sigma * r.sigma + TAU * TAU).sqrt();
    }
    let ((mw, sw), (ml, sl)) = (team(winners), team(losers));
    let c = (sw + sl + 2.0 * BETA * BETA).sqrt();
    let t = (mw - ml) / c;
    // v: how surprising the result was (big for an upset); w: how much it tells us.
    let v = pdf(t) / cdf(t).max(1e-12);
    let w = v * (v + t);
    for (side, s2, sign) in [(winners, sw, 1.0), (losers, sl, -1.0)] {
        let omega = sign * s2 / c * v;
        let gamma = s2.sqrt() / c;
        let delta = gamma * s2 / (c * c) * w;
        for r in side.iter_mut() {
            let share = r.sigma * r.sigma / s2;
            r.mu += share * omega;
            r.sigma *= (1.0 - share * delta).max(KAPPA).sqrt();
            r.matches += 1;
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn ratings_move_the_right_way_and_upsets_move_more() {
        assert!((cdf(0.0) - 0.5).abs() < 1e-7 && (cdf(1.96) - 0.975).abs() < 1e-4 && (cdf(-1.0) - 0.1587).abs() < 1e-4);
        let even = || vec![Rating::default(); 5];
        assert!((win_chance(&even(), &even()) - 0.5).abs() < 1e-9);
        let (mut w, mut l) = (even(), even());
        update(&mut w, &mut l);
        assert!(w[0].mu > MU && l[0].mu < MU, "winners up, losers down");
        assert!((w[0].mu - MU + l[0].mu - MU).abs() < 1e-9, "equal teams: symmetric");
        assert!(w[0].sigma < SIGMA, "we know more after a match");
        // Strong beat weak: expected, small change. Weak beat strong: an upset, big change.
        let strong = vec![Rating { mu: 32.0, sigma: 3.0, matches: 50 }; 5];
        let weak = vec![Rating { mu: 20.0, sigma: 3.0, matches: 50 }; 5];
        assert!(win_chance(&strong, &weak) > 0.8);
        let (mut s1, mut w1) = (strong.clone(), weak.clone());
        update(&mut s1, &mut w1);
        let (mut w2, mut s2) = (weak.clone(), strong.clone());
        update(&mut w2, &mut s2);
        assert!(w2[0].mu - 20.0 > (s1[0].mu - 32.0) * 3.0, "an upset moves ratings much more");
        // A new player moves faster than an established one in the same result.
        let mut mixed = vec![Rating::default(), strong[0], strong[0], strong[0], strong[0]];
        let mut other = weak.clone();
        update(&mut mixed, &mut other);
        assert!(mixed[0].mu - MU > mixed[1].mu - 32.0);
    }
}
```

`net/src/lobby/servers.rs`:

```rs
//! What game servers tell the lobby (sealed with their token's key): heartbeats, results,
//! reports.
use super::*;

impl LobbyServer {
    /// Write a report down for review: who, whom (Steam ids and names), why, where.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub(super) fn file_report(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, reporter: u64, target: u64, reason: crate::protocol::ReportReason, map: &str, round: u32, demo: &str, tick: u32) {
        let (Some(by), Some(of)) = (self.seats.get(&reporter), self.seats.get(&target)) else { return };
        let time = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_secs()).unwrap_or(0);
        // Names have no control characters (see Hello), so Debug quoting is valid JSON here.
        let line = format!(
            "{{\"time\":{time},\"reason\":\"{reason:?}\",\"reporter\":{{\"steam\":{},\"name\":{:?}}},\"reported\":{{\"steam\":{},\"name\":{:?}}},\"map\":{map:?},\"round\":{round},\"demo\":{demo:?},\"tick\":{tick}}}",
            by.0, by.1, of.0, of.1
        );
        self.write_report(from, &line);
    }
}

impl LobbyServer {
    /// A sealed message from a game server: only official ones (holding a token) can make
    /// one, and an old one replayed is ignored.
    pub(super) fn from_server(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, packet: &[u8]) {
        let Some(id) = crate::crypto::server_key_id(packet) else { return };
        let Some(key) = self.keys.iter().position(|k| k.id == id) else { return };
        let Some((sent, body)) = self.keys[key].open(packet) else { return };
        match decode::<LobbyMsg>(&body) {
            Some(LobbyMsg::Heartbeat { busy, address, region, deathmatch, players, max, maps, .. }) => {
                let maps: Vec<String> = maps.into_iter().filter(|m| crate::config::MAP_POOL.contains(&m.as_str())).collect();
                if self.servers.get(&from).is_some_and(|s| sent < s.sent) || (!self.servers.contains_key(&from) && self.servers.len() >= MAX_SERVERS) {
                    return;
                }
                let region: String = region.chars().filter(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || *c == '-').take(16).collect();
                let public = address.parse().unwrap_or(from);
                if !self.servers.contains_key(&from) {
                    println!("server {public} ({region}) joined the pool");
                }
                if busy {
                    self.booking.remove(&from); // took the match
                }
                // Booked, not confirmed yet: still busy as far as we're concerned.
                let busy = busy || self.booking.contains_key(&from);
                let seated = self.servers.get(&from).map(|s| s.seated.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
                self.servers.insert(from, GameServer { public, region, key, official: true, busy, seen: Instant::now(), sent, deathmatch, players, max, seated, maps });
            }
            Some(LobbyMsg::Result { winners, losers, abandoned }) if self.role == Role::Active => self.match_result(&winners, &losers, &abandoned),
            Some(LobbyMsg::Flag { ticket, reason, map, demo, tick }) if self.role == Role::Active => self.file_flag(from, ticket, &reason, &map, &demo, tick),
            Some(LobbyMsg::Report { reporter, target, reason, map, round, demo, tick }) if self.role == Role::Active => self.file_report(from, reporter, target, reason, &map, round, &demo, tick),
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    /// The aim checks flagged someone: filed with the reports, from "anti-cheat".
    pub(super) fn file_flag(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, ticket: u64, reason: &str, map: &str, demo: &str, tick: u32) {
        let Some(of) = self.seats.get(&ticket) else { return };
        let time = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_secs()).unwrap_or(0);
        let reason: String = reason.chars().filter(|c| !c.is_control()).take(200).collect();
        let line = format!(
            "{{\"time\":{time},\"reason\":\"AimCheck\",\"detail\":{reason:?},\"reporter\":\"anti-cheat\",\"reported\":{{\"steam\":{},\"name\":{:?}}},\"map\":{map:?},\"demo\":{demo:?},\"tick\":{tick}}}",
            of.0, of.1
        );
        self.write_report(from, &line);
    }

    /// Append a report line to the reports file (and the log).
    /// Appends which game server it came from (the recording is on that machine).
    fn write_report(&self, from: SocketAddr, line: &str) {
        let server = self.servers.get(&from).map(|s| s.public).unwrap_or(from);
        let line = format!("{},\"server\":\"{server}\"}}", line.strip_suffix('}').unwrap_or(line));
        println!("report: {line}");
        if let Some(path) = &self.reports {
            use std::io::Write;
            match std::fs::OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path) {
                Ok(mut f) => _ = writeln!(f, "{line}"),
                Err(e) => println!("can't write reports to {}: {e}", path.display()),
            }
        }
    }
}
```
