`net/src/lobby/signin.rs`:

```rs
//! Signing players in: the sign-in cookie, the encrypted handshake (see `crypto`), Steam
//! checks, and the session packets that follow.
use super::*;

impl LobbyServer {
    /// Our public key (build it into the game: `BOOTLEG16_LOBBY_KEY`).
    pub fn public_key(&self) -> [u8; 32] {
        self.key.public()
    }

    /// Use this long-term key (kept in a file, so the built-in public key stays valid).
    pub fn set_key(&mut self, key: crate::crypto::LobbyKey) {
        self.key = key;
    }

    /// A sign-in: check the cookie (cheap) before the key exchange (not cheap), then read
    /// who it is and start their session.
    pub(super) fn hello(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, cookie: u64, public: [u8; 32], sealed: &[u8]) {
        let now = self.started.elapsed().as_secs();
        if !self.cookies.check(from, now, cookie) {
            let _ = self.udp.send_to(&encode(&LobbyMsg::Cookie { cookie: self.cookies.make(from, now) }), from);
            return;
        }
        let Some((payload, fresh, channel)) = crate::crypto::lobby_hello(&self.key, &public, sealed) else { return };
        let Some(SignIn { name, steam, pad }) = decode::<SignIn>(&payload) else { return };
        if pad.len() < PAD {
            return;
        }
        let refuse = |m: &LobbyServer, reason: &str| _ = m.udp.send_to(&encode(&LobbyMsg::Refused { reason: reason.into() }), from);
        if steam.is_none() && self.require_steam {
            return refuse(self, "Start Steam to play online.");
        }
        if self.players.len() >= MAX_PLAYERS || (!from.ip().is_loopback() && self.players.values().filter(|p| p.addr.ip() == from.ip()).count() >= SESSIONS_PER_IP) {
            return refuse(self, "Too many players from your address, or the lobby is full. Try again later.");
        }
        let session = self.rand();
        let id = self.next_id;
        self.next_id += 1;
        let name: String = name.chars().filter(|c| !c.is_control()).take(24).collect();
        let party = self.new_party(id);
        self.players.insert(session, Player { channel, id, name, steam: 0, addr: from, party, seen: Instant::now(), found: None, notice: String::new(), invites: Vec::new(), pings: HashMap::new(), maps: None });
        if let Some(login) = steam {
            match self.steam_mode {
                // Unchecked: never let a claim push anyone else out.
                SteamMode::Trust if self.players.values().any(|p| p.steam == login.steam_id) => {}
                SteamMode::Trust => self.steam_checked(login.steam_id, Some(session)),
                SteamMode::Verify => self.steam_checks.push((session, login.steam_id, login.ticket)),
            }
        }
        let p = self.players.get_mut(&session).unwrap();
        let sealed = p.channel.seal(session, &session.to_le_bytes());
        let _ = self.udp.send_to(&encode(&LobbyMsg::Welcome { public: fresh, sealed }), from);
    }

    /// A packet in a player's session: their command, answered with their state. The key
    /// proves who it is, so a player whose address changed (a phone between networks) carries on.
    pub(super) fn from_player(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, packet: &[u8]) {
        let Some(session) = crate::crypto::channel_id(packet) else { return };
        let Some(p) = self.players.get_mut(&session) else {
            let _ = self.udp.send_to(&encode(&LobbyMsg::Expired), from);
            return;
        };
        let Some(plain) = p.channel.open(packet) else { return };
        let Some(LobbyMsg::Command { cmd, pad }) = decode::<LobbyMsg>(&plain) else { return };
        if pad.len() < PAD {
            return;
        }
        p.addr = from;
        self.command(session, cmd);
        if let Some(state) = self.state_of(session) {
            let p = self.players.get_mut(&session).unwrap();
            let sealed = p.channel.seal(session, &encode(&LobbyMsg::State(state)));
            let _ = self.udp.send_to(&sealed, from);
        }
    }

    /// Steam logins to check (`SteamMode::Verify`): (session, Steam id, ticket).
    pub fn take_steam_checks(&mut self) -> Vec<(u64, u64, Vec<u8>)> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.steam_checks)
    }

    /// Steam's answer for a login: `session` is who passed (None = the ticket was bad).
    /// Signing in somewhere else ends your older session.
    pub fn steam_checked(&mut self, steam_id: u64, session: Option<u64>) {
        let Some(session) = session.filter(|s| self.players.contains_key(s)) else { return };
        let older: Vec<(u32, u32)> = self.players.iter().filter(|(s, p)| p.steam == steam_id && **s != session).map(|(_, p)| (p.id, p.party)).collect();
        for (id, party) in older {
            self.leave(id, party);
            self.players.retain(|_, p| p.id != id);
        }
        self.players.get_mut(&session).unwrap().steam = steam_id;
    }

    /// A Steam login was refused: the player stays signed in without Steam, and is told.
    pub fn steam_refused(&mut self, session: u64) {
        if self.require_steam {
            let Some(p) = self.players.remove(&session) else { return };
            self.leave(p.id, p.party);
            let _ = self.udp.send_to(&encode(&LobbyMsg::Refused { reason: "Steam couldn't confirm your sign-in. Restart Steam and try again.".into() }), p.addr);
        } else if let Some(p) = self.players.get_mut(&session) {
            p.notice = "Steam sign-in failed: playing without Steam.".into();
        }
    }
}

```

`net/src/lobby/standby.rs`:

```rs
//! Two lobbies on two machines, one active and one standby: the active one streams its state
//! (`persist::snapshot`) every couple of seconds over TCP, sealed with the official token's
//! key (only our lobbies can read or forge it). The standby keeps that state warm, tracks the
//! game servers (they announce to both), and answers no players. If the active one goes
//! quiet, the standby takes over within seconds, with everyone's sessions: players' games
//! switch over by themselves (`LobbyClient` knows both addresses) and carry on encrypted.
//!
//! If both end up active (both started at once, or the link broke while both stayed up), the
//! one active longer wins and the other steps down, taking the winner's state.
use super::*;
use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};
use std::sync::mpsc::{channel, Receiver, Sender};

/// The active lobby sends its state this often; the standby takes over after this much silence.
const SEND_EVERY: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);
const TAKE_OVER_AFTER: Duration = Duration::from_secs(6);
/// The biggest state frame accepted (a lot of players; bigger is junk).
const MAX_FRAME: usize = 64 << 20;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct Frame {
    /// When the sender became active (unix seconds), and a tie-break.
    active_since: u64,
    tie: [u8; 32],
    snapshot: Vec<u8>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Role {
    Active,
    Standby,
}

pub struct Peer {
    out: Sender<Vec<u8>>,
    frames: Receiver<Vec<u8>>,
    heard: Instant,
    sent: Instant,
    since: u64,
}

impl Peer {
    /// Listen for the other lobby on `port`, and keep connecting to it at `peer`.
    pub fn start(port: u16, peer: SocketAddr) -> std::io::Result<Peer> {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind(("0.0.0.0", port))?;
        let (frames_tx, frames) = channel();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            for stream in listener.incoming().flatten() {
                let tx = frames_tx.clone();
                std::thread::spawn(move || read_frames(stream, tx));
            }
        });
        let (out, out_rx) = channel::<Vec<u8>>();
        std::thread::spawn(move || write_frames(peer, out_rx));
        Ok(Peer { out, frames, heard: Instant::now(), sent: Instant::now() - SEND_EVERY, since: 0 })
    }
}

fn read_frames(mut stream: TcpStream, tx: Sender<Vec<u8>>) {
    let mut len = [0u8; 4];
    while stream.read_exact(&mut len).is_ok() {
        let n = u32::from_le_bytes(len) as usize;
        if n > MAX_FRAME {
            return;
        }
        let mut frame = vec![0u8; n];
        if stream.read_exact(&mut frame).is_err() || tx.send(frame).is_err() {
            return;
        }
    }
}

/// Keep a connection to the peer and send what comes (the newest frame only: old state is
/// useless); reconnect when it drops.
fn write_frames(peer: SocketAddr, rx: Receiver<Vec<u8>>) {
    let mut stream: Option<TcpStream> = None;
    while let Ok(mut frame) = rx.recv() {
        while let Ok(newer) = rx.try_recv() {
            frame = newer;
        }
        if stream.is_none() {
            stream = TcpStream::connect_timeout(&peer, Duration::from_secs(1)).ok();
        }
        if let Some(s) = &mut stream {
            let ok = s.write_all(&(frame.len() as u32).to_le_bytes()).and_then(|_| s.write_all(&frame));
            if ok.is_err() {
                stream = None;
            }
        }
    }
}

impl LobbyServer {
    /// Pair with another lobby (both run this, pointing at each other). Starts as standby:
    /// if nobody is active it takes over after a few seconds.
    pub fn pair(&mut self, port: u16, peer: SocketAddr) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        if self.keys.is_empty() {
            return Err(std::io::Error::other("pairing needs the official token (it seals the link)"));
        }
        self.peer = Some(Peer::start(port, peer)?);
        self.role = Role::Standby;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Once a step: send our state (active) or take the other's (standby), and decide roles.
    pub(super) fn peer_step(&mut self) {
        let Some(peer) = &mut self.peer else { return };
        let mut newest = None;
        while let Ok(f) = peer.frames.try_recv() {
            newest = Some(f);
        }
        if let Some(sealed) = newest {
            let frame = self.keys[0].open(&sealed).and_then(|(_, body)| decode::<Frame>(&body));
            if let Some(f) = frame {
                let peer = self.peer.as_mut().unwrap();
                peer.heard = Instant::now();
                // Both active: the one active longer stays (a tie: the bigger tie-break).
                let mine = (peer.since, self.key.public());
                let yield_to_them = self.role == Role::Standby || (f.active_since, std::cmp::Reverse(f.tie)) < (mine.0, std::cmp::Reverse(mine.1));
                if yield_to_them {
                    if self.role == Role::Active {
                        println!("the other lobby is active: standing by");
                    }
                    self.role = Role::Standby;
                    self.restore(&f.snapshot);
                }
            }
        }
        let peer = self.peer.as_mut().unwrap();
        match self.role {
            Role::Standby if peer.heard.elapsed() > TAKE_OVER_AFTER => {
                println!("the other lobby went quiet: taking over");
                self.role = Role::Active;
                peer.since = crate::crypto::now();
                // Everyone restored is fresh: give them time to find us.
                for p in self.players.values_mut() {
                    p.seen = Instant::now();
                }
            }
            Role::Active if peer.sent.elapsed() > SEND_EVERY => {
                peer.sent = Instant::now();
                let frame = Frame { active_since: peer.since, tie: self.key.public(), snapshot: self.snapshot() };
                let sealed = self.keys[0].seal(&encode(&frame));
                let _ = self.peer.as_ref().unwrap().out.send(sealed);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Messages between client and server (postcard-encoded, one per UDP datagram).
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sim::doors::DoorNet;
use sim::combat::Vitals;
use sim::hitbox::HitGroup;
use crate::rounds::{EndReason, Phase};
use sim::player::Limits;
use sim::pmove::{Input, Player};

/// Bump when messages change; mismatched clients are turned away.
pub const PROTOCOL_VERSION: u32 = 33;
pub const DEFAULT_PORT: u16 = 27015;
/// Inputs repeated in every packet, so a few lost packets lose no keypresses.
pub const INPUT_REDUNDANCY: usize = 8;
/// Dropped after this long without a packet.
pub const TIMEOUT_SECS: f32 = 5.0;
pub const MAX_PLAYERS: usize = 32;
/// Minimum padding of an info request (see `ClientMsg::Info`).
pub const INFO_PAD: usize = 96;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum ClientMsg {
    /// `cookie`: 0 at first; then the one from `ServerMsg::Challenge` (proves our address is real).
    /// `ticket`: your seat in a reserved match (0 = none).
    Hello { version: u32, name: String, cookie: u64, ticket: u64 },
    /// Tell me about yourself (no connection made). `pad` must be at least
    /// `INFO_PAD` bytes so the answer is never bigger than the question (no amplification).
    Info { pad: Vec<u8> },
    /// Inputs numbered `first_seq`, `first_seq + 1`, ...
    /// `events`: the last reliable event number received (the server resends newer ones).
    /// `snap`: the newest snapshot received (the server sends the next ones as changes to it).
    Inputs { first_seq: u32, inputs: Vec<TimedInput>, events: u32, snap: u32 },
    /// Buy something (checked against money, buy time, buy zone and team).
    Buy { item: BuyItem },
    /// Sell back everything bought this round (while you may still buy), as CS2 does.
    UndoBuys,
    /// Pick a side; None = auto (the smaller team).
    JoinTeam { team: Option<Team> },
    /// After winning the knife round: switch sides (true) or stay.
    SideVote { switch: bool },
    /// Ask your team to surrender (only once a teammate has abandoned the match).
    CallSurrender,
    /// Ask your team to vote this teammate out of the match.
    CallKick { player: u8 },
    /// Your answer to your team's vote (surrender or kick).
    Vote { yes: bool },
    /// Report a player in your match for review.
    Report { player: u8, reason: ReportReason },
    /// One 20 ms Opus voice frame while a push-to-talk key is held.
    Voice { channel: VoiceChannel, data: Vec<u8> },
    Bye,
    /// Which character to wear on each side (terrorists, counter-terrorists; 0..`CLASSES`).
    Looks { t: u8, ct: u8 },
}

pub const CLASSES: u8 = 4;

}

    Team,
    /// Everyone alive near you, enemies too; quieter with distance.

pub const VOICE_FRAME: usize = 960;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]

    Spectator,
    T,
    Ct,

/// What the buy menu can buy.

/// One scoreboard row.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct Score {
    pub id: u8,
    pub name: String,
    pub kills: i32,
    pub deaths: u32,

/// An input plus the server time the client was showing other players at, so
/// the server can rewind them for hit detection (lag compensation).
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]

    pub input: Input,
    pub view_tick: f32,
}

/// Lag compensation never rewinds further than this (CS default `sv_maxunlag` 0.5 s).
pub const MAX_UNLAG_SECS: f32 = 0.5;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct PlayerNet {
    pub id: u8,
    /// Position in 1/8 units (small varints on the wire).
    origin: [i32; 3],
    /// View angles in 1/65536 of a turn (yaw) and of half a turn (pitch).
    yaw: u16,
    pitch: i16,
    /// Bit 0 crouched, bit 1 alive, bit 2 in the air (jumping, falling), bit 3 reloading.
    flags: u8,
    /// Weapon in hand.
    pub weapon: Id,
    pub team: Team,
    /// Health and kit: only in snapshots for their teammates (Team IDs).
    pub mate: Option<Mate>,
}

/// A teammate's health and equipment, as their Team ID shows it.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub struct Mate {
    pub health: u8,
    pub armor: u8,
    pub helmet: bool,
    pub defuse_kit: bool,
    /// The gun in hand: rounds in the magazine and in reserve (None: knife, grenade, bomb).
    pub ammo: Option<(u16, u16)>,
}

impl PlayerNet {
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn new(id: u8, origin: [f32; 3], yaw: f32, pitch: f32, crouched: bool, alive: bool, airborne: bool, reloading: bool, weapon: Id, team: Team, mate: Option<Mate>) -> PlayerNet {
        PlayerNet {
            id,
            origin: origin.map(|v| (v * 8.0).round() as i32),
            yaw: (yaw.rem_euclid(360.0) / 360.0 * 65536.0).round() as u32 as u16,
            pitch: (pitch.clamp(-90.0, 90.0) / 180.0 * 65535.0).round() as i16,
            flags: crouched as u8 | (alive as u8) << 1 | (airborne as u8) << 2 | (reloading as u8) << 3,
            weapon,
            team,
            mate,
        }
    }
    pub fn airborne(&self) -> bool {
        self.flags & 4 != 0
    }
    pub fn reloading(&self) -> bool {
        self.flags & 8 != 0
    }
    pub fn origin(&self) -> [f32; 3] {
        self.origin.map(|v| v as f32 / 8.0)
    }
    pub fn yaw(&self) -> f32 {
        self.yaw as f32 / 65536.0 * 360.0
    }
    pub fn pitch(&self) -> f32 {
        self.pitch as f32 / 65535.0 * 180.0
    }
    pub fn crouched(&self) -> bool {
        self.flags & 1 != 0
    }
    pub fn alive(&self) -> bool {
        self.flags & 2 != 0
    }
}

/// Things that happened since the last snapshot (effects, kill feed).
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum GameEvent {
    /// A bullet (or a shotgun's pellets) from `from` that ended at `to` (wall impact or far
    /// away). `holes`: every wall hit, as (point, surface normal), for bullet holes and dust.
    Shot { shooter: u8, weapon: Id, silenced: bool, from: [f32; 3], to: [f32; 3], holes: Vec<([f32; 3], [f32; 3])> },
    /// `at`: where a bullet or knife hit them (None for explosions and falls).
    Damage { attacker: u8, victim: u8, amount: f32, group: HitGroup, sound: HitSound, at: Option<[f32; 3]> },
    /// Someone's footstep (everyone else hears it; you hear your own predicted ones).
    Footstep { player: u8, at: [f32; 3], step: sim::pmove::Step },
    /// The map fired a target by name (a trigger zone or a button): `ambient_generic` sounds
    /// with that name play (train's jet fly-by, birds, dogs).
    Fired { name: String },
    GrenadeBounce { kind: sim::grenades::Kind, at: [f32; 3] },
    /// `weapon` None = fell to death.
    Kill { killer: u8, victim: u8, weapon: Option<Id>, headshot: bool },
    /// An HE went off here.
    Explosion { at: [f32; 3] },
    /// A flashbang went off here; `blinded` lists who it caught and how badly.
    Flash { at: [f32; 3], blinded: Vec<(u8, sim::grenades::Blind)> },
    /// Freeze time of round `round` began (everyone is back at their spawn).
    RoundStart { round: u32 },
    RoundEnd { winner: Team, reason: EndReason },
    /// Teams swapped sides (halftime, overtime halves).
    SidesSwapped,
    /// The match is decided (None = draw); it starts over after the final scoreboard.
    MatchOver { winner: Option<Team> },
    BombPlanted { by: u8, at: [f32; 3] },
    /// Someone started defusing (for the sound); `kit`: the fast way.
    Defusing { by: u8, kit: bool },
    BombDefused { by: u8 },
    BombExploded { at: [f32; 3] },
    /// The knife round's winners (they now vote to stay or switch).
    KnifeWon { winners: Team },
    /// Sides are settled; the match starts.
    SidesChosen { switched: bool },
    /// This team surrendered (the other wins the match).
    Surrendered { team: Team },
    /// This player's team voted them out of the match.
    VotedOut { player: u8 },
    /// Deathmatch: this player reached the kill limit (everyone's score starts over).
    KillLimit { player: u8 },
    /// A breakable broke (for its sound and debris; the state itself is `Snapshot::broken`).
    Broke { model: u16, material: sim::breakables::Material, at: [f32; 3] },
}

impl GameEvent {
    /// Events that must arrive (kill feed, round and bomb news). The rest are sounds and effects
    /// that are useless if late, so a lost one is simply lost.
    pub fn reliable(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self,
            GameEvent::Kill { .. }
                | GameEvent::Fired { .. }
                | GameEvent::RoundStart { .. }
                | GameEvent::RoundEnd { .. }
                | GameEvent::SidesSwapped
                | GameEvent::MatchOver { .. }
                | GameEvent::BombPlanted { .. }
                | GameEvent::BombDefused { .. }
                | GameEvent::BombExploded { .. }
                | GameEvent::KnifeWon { .. }
                | GameEvent::SidesChosen { .. }
                | GameEvent::Surrendered { .. }
                | GameEvent::VotedOut { .. }
                | GameEvent::KillLimit { .. }
        )
    }
}

    Welcome { id: u8, map: String, map_hash: u64, tick_rate: u32, practice: bool },

    /// Every round so far this match: who won (the side they were on then) and how. Sent with
    /// the scoreboard, so late joiners and reconnects get it all.
    History(Vec<(Team, crate::rounds::EndReason)>),
    /// Someone talking. `gain`: how loud (proximity voice fades with distance; 255 = full).
    /// `muffled`: proximity voice from behind a wall (play it dull and quieter).
    Voice { from: u8, channel: VoiceChannel, gain: u8, muffled: bool, data: Vec<u8> },
    Snapshot {
        tick: u32,
        /// Last of your inputs the server has run; replay the ones after it.
        ack: u32,
        /// Other players you can see (compact: what drawing them needs).
        players: Vec<PlayerNet>,
        /// Your own full movement state and health, for prediction (None while connecting).
        you: Option<(Player, Vitals)>,
        doors: Vec<DoorNet>,
        /// Your own weapons, for prediction and the HUD.
        loadout: Loadout,
        events: Vec<GameEvent>,
        /// Kill feed, round and bomb news, numbered: resent in every snapshot until acknowledged.
        reliable: Vec<(u32, GameEvent)>,
        /// Breakables currently broken (their brush model numbers).
        broken: Vec<u16>,
        /// Grenades in flight or lying around, and smoke clouds.
        grenades: Vec<(sim::grenades::Kind, [f32; 3])>,
        smokes: Vec<SmokeNet>,
        /// Guns lying on the ground.
        ground: Vec<(Id, [f32; 3])>,
        round: RoundNet,
        bomb: BombNet,
        me: Me,
    },
    /// A snapshot as what changed since snapshot `base` (one you confirmed): see `delta`.
    Delta { base: u32, patch: Vec<u8> },
}

pub fn encode<T: Serialize>(m: &T) -> Vec<u8> {
    postcard::to_allocvec(m).expect("messages always serialize")
}

pub fn decode<'a, T: Deserialize<'a>>(b: &'a [u8]) -> Option<T> {
    postcard::from_bytes(b).ok()
}
```

`net/src/replay.rs`:

```rs
//! Watching a recording (see `demo`) with the normal game: this plays the part of a server
//! (on this machine), and the game connects to it as a spectator and sees the match as it was:
//! everyone, everywhere, every event. `server --play <file>` runs it.
use crate::demo::{Frame, Reader};
use crate::protocol::{decode, encode, ClientMsg, GameEvent, ServerMsg};
use crate::socket::Socket;
use std::collections::{HashMap, VecDeque};
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

/// Reliable events (kill feed, round news) kept and resent, like the real server's outbox.
const OUTBOX: usize = 64;
/// The id viewers get (no player has it).
const VIEWER_ID: u8 = 255;

pub struct Replay {
    socket: Socket,
    reader: Reader,
    viewers: HashMap<SocketAddr, Instant>,
    /// Reliable events so far, numbered.
    outbox: VecDeque<(u32, GameEvent)>,
    numbered: u32,
    /// Frames per real snapshot (2: double speed).
    pub speed: u32,
    pub done: bool,
}

impl Replay {
    pub fn open(bind: SocketAddr, path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Replay, String> {
        let reader = Reader::open(path)?;
        let socket = Socket::bind(bind).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(Replay { socket, reader, viewers: HashMap::new(), outbox: VecDeque::new(), numbered: 0, speed: 1, done: false })
    }

    pub fn local_addr(&self) -> SocketAddr {
        self.socket.local_addr()
    }

    pub fn header(&self) -> &crate::demo::Header {
        &self.reader.header
    }

    /// Jump ahead to `tick` (the moment a report points at, say).
    pub fn skip_to(&mut self, tick: u32) {
        while let Some(f) = self.reader.next_frame() {
            self.keep_reliable(&f);
            if f.tick >= tick {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    fn keep_reliable(&mut self, f: &Frame) {
        for e in f.events.iter().filter(|e| e.reliable()) {
            self.numbered += 1;
            self.outbox.push_back((self.numbered, e.clone()));
            while self.outbox.len() > OUTBOX {
                self.outbox.pop_front();
            }
        }
    }

    /// The rate the recording was made at (it replays at that speed).
    fn rate(&self) -> crate::tick::TickRate {
        crate::tick::TickRate::new(self.reader.header.tick_rate).unwrap_or_default()
    }

    /// One server tick: welcome viewers; every snapshot interval, the next frame(s) to all.
    pub fn step(&mut self, tick: u32) {
        self.socket.tick();
        for (from, bytes) in self.socket.recv_all() {
            match decode::<ClientMsg>(&bytes) {
                Some(ClientMsg::Hello { .. }) => {
                    self.viewers.insert(from, Instant::now());
                    let h = &self.reader.header;
                    let welcome = ServerMsg::Welcome { id: VIEWER_ID, map: h.map.clone(), map_hash: h.map_hash, tick_rate: h.tick_rate, practice: false };
                    self.socket.send(from, encode(&welcome));
                }
                Some(ClientMsg::Bye) => _ = self.viewers.remove(&from),
                Some(_) => _ = self.viewers.get_mut(&from).map(|t| *t = Instant::now()),
                None => {}
            }
        }
        self.viewers.retain(|_, t| t.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(10));
        if tick % self.rate().snapshot_every() != 0 || self.done {
            return;
        }
        let mut frame = None;
        for _ in 0..self.speed.max(1) {
            match self.reader.next_frame() {
                Some(f) => {
                    self.keep_reliable(&f);
                    frame = Some(f);
                }
                None => {
                    self.done = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        let Some(f) = frame else { return };
        if let Some(scores) = &f.scores {
            let msg = encode(&ServerMsg::Scores(scores.clone()));
            for a in self.viewers.keys().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>() {
                self.socket.send(a, msg.clone());
            }
        }
        let msg = encode(&ServerMsg::Snapshot {
            tick: f.tick,
            ack: 0,
            players: f.players,
            you: None,
            doors: f.doors,
            loadout: sim::weapons::Loadout::knife_only(),
            events: f.events.into_iter().filter(|e| !e.reliable()).collect(),
            reliable: self.outbox.iter().cloned().collect(),
            broken: f.broken,
            grenades: f.grenades,
            smokes: f.smokes,
            ground: f.ground,
            round: f.round,
            bomb: f.bomb,
            me: crate::protocol::Me { money: 0, limits: Default::default(), can_buy: false, defuse_kit: false },
        });
        for a in self.viewers.keys().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>() {
            self.socket.send(a, msg.clone());
        }
    }

    /// Play to the end at the tick rate.
    pub fn run(&mut self) {
        let tick_len = Duration::from_secs_f64(self.rate().tick() as f64);
        let mut next = Instant::now();
        let mut tick = 0u32;
        while !self.done {
            tick += 1;
            self.step(tick);
            next += tick_len;
            if let Some(wait) = next.checked_duration_since(Instant::now()) {
                std::thread::sleep(wait);
            }
        }
        // Let viewers see the last moment for a bit.
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(3));
    }
}
```

`net/src/rounds.rs`:

```rs
//! The match: round phases, score, halftime and overtime, and the money each round pays.
//! Pure rules (no players or networking), so they can be tested on their own; the server
//! applies what this decides (`server/round.rs`).
use crate::config::{LossBonus, MatchConfig};
use crate::protocol::Team;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Phase {
    /// Waiting for both teams to have someone: respawns, free buying.
    Warmup,
    /// Round start: nobody can move or shoot; buying is open.
    Freeze,
    Live,
    /// The round is decided; the next starts after a short delay.
    Over,
    GameOver,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum EndReason {
    Eliminated,
    BombExploded,
    BombDefused,
    /// Time ran out with no bomb planted.
    TimeUp,
}

/// What happens when the gap after a round runs out.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Next {
    /// Start the next round; `swap`: teams change sides first; `money`: everyone's money is
    /// set to this (halftime, overtime) and weapons are taken away.
    Round { swap: bool, money: Option<i32> },
    /// Someone won (None = a draw, when overtime is off).
    GameOver(Option<Team>),
}

/// Seconds the final scoreboard shows before the match starts over.
const GAME_OVER_SECONDS: f32 = 15.0;

pub struct Match {
    pub cfg: MatchConfig,
    pub tick_rate: u32,
    pub phase: Phase,
    /// Tick the current phase ends: freeze → live, live → time up, over → next round.
    pub phase_end: u32,
    /// Tick buying closes.
    pub buy_end: u32,
    /// Current round number (1-based).
    pub round: u32,
    /// Rounds won: terrorists, counter-terrorists (as the sides are now; swapped at halftime).
    pub score: [u32; 2],
    /// Losses in a row per side, and the shared CS 1.6 bonus.
    losses: [u32; 2],
    shared_bonus: i32,
    pub last: Option<(Team, EndReason)>,
    /// Every round so far (winner, how).
    pub history: Vec<(Team, EndReason)>,
}

pub fn side(team: Team) -> usize {
    if team == Team::Ct {
        1
    } else {
        0
    }
}

pub fn other(team: Team) -> Team {
    if team == Team::Ct {
        Team::T
    } else {
        Team::Ct
    }
}

impl Match {
    pub fn new(cfg: MatchConfig, tick_rate: u32) -> Match {
        Match { cfg, tick_rate, phase: Phase::Warmup, phase_end: 0, buy_end: 0, round: 0, score: [0; 2], losses: [0; 2], shared_bonus: 1400, last: None, history: Vec::new() }
    }

    fn ticks(&self, seconds: f32) -> u32 {
        (seconds * self.tick_rate as f32).round() as u32
    }

    /// Begin the match from round 1 (scores and loss streaks cleared).
    pub fn start(&mut self, tick: u32) {
        *self = Match::new(self.cfg.clone(), self.tick_rate);
        self.begin_round(tick);
    }

    /// Freeze time of the next round.
    pub fn begin_round(&mut self, tick: u32) {
        self.round += 1;
        self.phase = Phase::Freeze;
        self.phase_end = tick + self.ticks(self.cfg.freeze_time);
        self.buy_end = self.phase_end + self.ticks(self.cfg.buy_time);
        self.last = None;
    }

    /// Freeze time over: the round clock runs.
    pub fn go_live(&mut self, tick: u32) {
        self.phase = Phase::Live;
        self.phase_end = tick + self.ticks(self.cfg.round_time);
    }

    pub fn can_buy(&self, tick: u32) -> bool {
        match self.phase {
            Phase::Warmup => true,
            Phase::Freeze | Phase::Live => tick < self.buy_end,
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    /// The round is decided. Returns each side's payout [T, CT]; kill rewards are separate.
    pub fn end_round(&mut self, tick: u32, winner: Team, reason: EndReason) -> [i32; 2] {
        let (w, l) = (side(winner), side(other(winner)));
        self.score[w] += 1;
        self.last = Some((winner, reason));
        self.history.push((winner, reason));
        self.phase = Phase::Over;
        self.phase_end = tick + self.ticks(self.cfg.round_end_delay);
        // docs/RULES.md 3.2 (bomb maps).
        let win = match reason {
            EndReason::BombExploded => 3500,
            _ => 3250,
        };
        let bonus = match self.cfg.loss_bonus {
            LossBonus::PerTeam => {
                self.losses[w] = 0;
                self.losses[l] += 1;
                (1400 + 500 * (self.losses[l] as i32 - 1)).min(3400)
            }
            LossBonus::Cs16 => {
                if self.losses[w] > 1 {
                    self.shared_bonus = 1500; // a streak was broken
                }
                self.losses[w] = 0;
                self.losses[l] += 1;
                if self.losses[l] > 1 && self.shared_bonus <= 2999 {
                    self.shared_bonus += 500;
                }
                self.shared_bonus
            }
        };
        // Terrorists who planted get $800 more when the bomb is defused.
        let planted = if reason == EndReason::BombDefused { 800 } else { 0 };
        let mut pay = [0; 2];
        pay[w] = win;
        pay[l] = bonus + planted;
        pay
    }

    /// The gap after a round is over: what comes next.
    pub fn next(&mut self, tick: u32) -> Next {
        let total = self.score[0] + self.score[1];
        let reg = self.cfg.max_rounds;
        let half = reg / 2;
        let ot = self.cfg.overtime_rounds;
        let best = self.score[0].max(self.score[1]);
        let leader = if self.score[0] > self.score[1] { Team::T } else { Team::Ct };
        // Rounds needed to win: 13 of 24, then 4 of each 6-round overtime on top of the tie.
        let target = if total <= reg {
            half + 1
        } else {
            let n = (total - reg).div_ceil(ot.max(1));
            half + n * ot / 2 + 1
        };
        if best >= target {
            return self.game_over(tick, Some(leader));
        }
        if total == reg && ot == 0 {
            return self.game_over(tick, None);
        }
        let mut swap = false;
        let mut money = None;
        if total == half {
            swap = true;
            money = Some(self.cfg.start_money);
        } else if total >= reg && ot > 0 {
            let into = (total - reg) % ot;
            if into == 0 {
                money = Some(self.cfg.overtime_money); // an overtime begins
            } else if into == ot / 2 {
                swap = true;
                money = Some(self.cfg.overtime_money);
            }
        }
        if swap {
            self.score.swap(0, 1);
        }
        if money.is_some() {
            self.losses = [0; 2];
            self.shared_bonus = 1400;
        }
        self.begin_round(tick);
        Next::Round { swap, money }
    }

    /// The match ends now (a surrender or a forfeit).
    pub fn forfeit(&mut self, tick: u32, winner: Team) {
        self.game_over(tick, Some(winner));
    }

    fn game_over(&mut self, tick: u32, winner: Option<Team>) -> Next {
        self.phase = Phase::GameOver;
        self.phase_end = tick + self.ticks(GAME_OVER_SECONDS);
        Next::GameOver(winner)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn m() -> Match {
        let mut m = Match::new(MatchConfig::default(), 1);
        m.start(0);
        m
    }

    #[test]
    fn halftime_swaps_and_resets_money_then_13_wins() {
        let mut m = m();
        for _ in 0..11 {
            m.end_round(0, Team::T, EndReason::Eliminated);
            assert_eq!(m.next(0), Next::Round { swap: false, money: None });
        }
        m.end_round(0, Team::T, EndReason::Eliminated);
        assert_eq!(m.next(0), Next::Round { swap: true, money: Some(800) });
        assert_eq!(m.score, [0, 12], "the old T team is CT now");
        m.end_round(0, Team::Ct, EndReason::TimeUp);
        assert_eq!(m.next(0), Next::GameOver(Some(Team::Ct)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn overtime_at_12_all_with_10k_and_side_swaps() {
        let mut m = m();
        for i in 0..24 {
            let w = if (i < 12) == (i % 2 == 0) { Team::T } else { Team::Ct };
            m.end_round(0, w, EndReason::Eliminated);
            let n = m.next(0);
            if i == 23 {
                assert_eq!(m.score[0] + m.score[1], 24);
                assert_eq!(n, Next::Round { swap: false, money: Some(10_000) }, "{:?}", m.score);
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(m.score, [12, 12]);
        // OT: 3 rounds, swap, then first to 16.
        for _ in 0..2 {
            m.end_round(0, Team::T, EndReason::Eliminated);
            m.next(0);
        }
        m.end_round(0, Team::Ct, EndReason::Eliminated);
        assert_eq!(m.next(0), Next::Round { swap: true, money: Some(10_000) });
        assert_eq!(m.score, [13, 14]);
        m.end_round(0, Team::Ct, EndReason::Eliminated);
        m.next(0);
        m.end_round(0, Team::Ct, EndReason::Eliminated);
        assert_eq!(m.next(0), Next::GameOver(Some(Team::Ct)), "16-13");
    }

    #[test]
    fn loss_bonus_ladders() {
        let mut m = m();
        let pays: Vec<i32> = (0..6).map(|_| m.end_round(0, Team::Ct, EndReason::Eliminated)[0]).collect();
        assert_eq!(pays, [1400, 1900, 2400, 2900, 3400, 3400]);
        assert_eq!(m.end_round(0, Team::T, EndReason::BombExploded), [3500, 1400]);
        assert_eq!(m.end_round(0, Team::Ct, EndReason::BombDefused), [1400 + 800, 3250], "the ladder restarted after the win");

        let mut m = Match::new(MatchConfig { loss_bonus: LossBonus::Cs16, ..Default::default() }, 1);
        m.start(0);
        let pays: Vec<i32> = (0..5).map(|_| m.end_round(0, Team::Ct, EndReason::Eliminated)[0]).collect();
        assert_eq!(pays, [1400, 1900, 2400, 2900, 3400]);
        // Ts break their streak: the bonus drops to the 1.6 reset value, then climbs again.
        assert_eq!(m.end_round(0, Team::T, EndReason::Eliminated)[1], 1500);
        assert_eq!(m.end_round(0, Team::T, EndReason::Eliminated)[1], 2000);
    }
}
```

`net/src/secure.rs`:

```rs
//! Security helpers shared by the lobby and the game server: secrets from the OS's random
//! source (tickets, sessions, codes, cookies must not be guessable from the ones you see),
//! and per-key packet budgets (token buckets). Encryption is in `crypto`.
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::hash::Hash;

/// A random u64 from the OS (unpredictable, unlike any seeded generator).
pub fn random() -> u64 {
    getrandom::u64().expect("the OS random source")
}

/// Sign-in cookies: proof that an address is real (it got our answer) before we do any work
/// for it. Stateless: a keyed hash (BLAKE3) of the address and the current 10-second window;
/// the previous window still counts. Unforgeable without the secret, which the cookies don't
/// give away.
pub struct Cookies {
    secret: [u8; 32],
}

impl Cookies {
    pub fn new() -> Cookies {
        Cookies { secret: crate::crypto::new_key() }
    }

    fn at(&self, addr: std::net::SocketAddr, window: u64) -> u64 {
        let mut h = blake3::Hasher::new_keyed(&self.secret);
        h.update(addr.to_string().as_bytes());
        h.update(&window.to_le_bytes());
        u64::from_le_bytes(h.finalize().as_bytes()[..8].try_into().unwrap()) | 1
    }

    /// The cookie for `addr` now (`now`: seconds on any steady clock).
    pub fn make(&self, addr: std::net::SocketAddr, now: u64) -> u64 {
        self.at(addr, now / 10)
    }

    pub fn check(&self, addr: std::net::SocketAddr, now: u64, cookie: u64) -> bool {
        let window = now / 10;
        cookie == self.at(addr, window) || (window > 0 && cookie == self.at(addr, window - 1))
    }
}

impl Default for Cookies {
    fn default() -> Cookies {
        Cookies::new()
    }
}

/// Write a file only we can read (secrets: keys, sessions), atomically: a crash mid-write
/// never leaves half a file, and readers see the old one or the new one.
pub fn write_private(path: &std::path::Path, bytes: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    use std::io::Write;
    use std::os::unix::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
    let tmp = path.with_extension("tmp");
    let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().write(true).create(true).truncate(true).mode(0o600).open(&tmp)?;
    f.write_all(bytes)?;
    f.sync_all()?;
    std::fs::rename(tmp, path)
}

/// Packet budgets per key: each key gets `rate` per second, banking up to one second's worth.
/// Past `max_keys` new keys are refused until old ones go quiet (no memory blow-up).
pub struct Buckets<K> {
    buckets: HashMap<K, (f32, f64)>,
    max_keys: usize,
}

impl<K: Hash + Eq + Copy> Buckets<K> {
    pub fn new(max_keys: usize) -> Buckets<K> {
        Buckets { buckets: HashMap::new(), max_keys }
    }

    /// Spend one from `key`'s budget at time `now` (seconds); false = over budget.
    pub fn allow(&mut self, key: K, rate: f32, now: f64) -> bool {
        if self.buckets.len() >= self.max_keys && !self.buckets.contains_key(&key) {
            return false;
        }
        let (budget, last) = self.buckets.entry(key).or_insert((rate, now));
        *budget = (*budget + (now - *last) as f32 * rate).min(rate);
        *last = now;
        if *budget < 1.0 {
            return false;
        }
        *budget -= 1.0;
        true
    }

    /// Forget keys quiet for `secs`.
    pub fn tidy(&mut self, now: f64, secs: f64) {
        self.buckets.retain(|_, (_, last)| now - *last < secs);
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn secrets_and_budgets() {
        assert_ne!(random(), random());
        let mut b = Buckets::new(2);
        let hits = (0..30).filter(|i| b.allow(1, 10.0, *i as f64 * 0.01)).count();
        assert!((10..=13).contains(&hits), "{hits}: one second's budget, a little refill");
        assert!(b.allow(2, 10.0, 0.0));
        assert!(!b.allow(3, 10.0, 0.0), "table full");
        // Cookies: good for this window and the one before, not for another address, and
        // another server's (another secret) don't pass.
        let (c, other) = (Cookies::new(), Cookies::new());
        let (addr, them) = ("1.2.3.4:5".parse().unwrap(), "1.2.3.4:6".parse().unwrap());
        let k = c.make(addr, 100);
        assert!(c.check(addr, 100, k) && c.check(addr, 109, k) && c.check(addr, 115, k));
        assert!(!c.check(addr, 125, k), "two windows later: stale");
        assert!(!c.check(them, 100, k) && !other.check(addr, 100, k));
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Looking into and steering a running server: for tests and admin tools.
use super::*;

impl Server {
    pub fn player_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.clients.len()
    }

    /// Server-side health of a player.
    pub fn vitals(&self, id: u8) -> Option<&Vitals> {
        self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == id).map(|c| &c.vitals)
    }

    /// Server-side state of a player (for tests and admin tools).
    pub fn player(&self, id: u8) -> Option<&Player> {
        self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == id).map(|c| &c.state.movement)
    }

    /// Set a player's health (tests and admin tools; 0 = dead).
    pub fn set_health(&mut self, id: u8, health: f32) {
        if let Some(c) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == id) {
            c.vitals.health = health;
        }
    }

    /// Move a player (tests and admin tools); their client corrects to it.
    pub fn teleport(&mut self, id: u8, origin: [f32; 3]) {
        if let Some(c) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == id) {
            c.state.movement.origin = origin;
            c.state.movement.velocity = [0.0; 3];
        }
    }

    /// Bytes in the last snapshot sent to a client.
    pub fn snapshot_bytes(&self) -> usize {
        self.snapshot_bytes
    }

    pub fn round_phase(&self) -> crate::rounds::Phase {
        self.round.phase
    }

    /// Pop a smoke cloud here (tests, admin).
    pub fn add_smoke(&mut self, at: [f32; 3]) {
        let now = self.tick as f64 * self.rate.tick() as f64;
        self.smokes.push((at, now + sim::grenades::SMOKE_SECONDS));
    }

    /// Money of a player (tests, admin).
    pub fn money(&self, id: u8) -> Option<i32> {
        self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == id).map(|c| c.money)
    }

    pub fn player_state(&self, id: u8) -> Option<&PlayerState> {
        self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == id).map(|c| &c.state)
    }

    pub fn tick(&self) -> u32 {
        self.tick
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/aimcheck.rs`:

```rs
//! Server-side aim checks: inhuman aim is flagged for a person to review (with the match
//! recording and the moment), never punished automatically: a false positive must never ban
//! an honest player. Two signals, both only over many engagements:
//!
//! - Reaction: from an enemy coming into plain sight to the first shot aimed at them (within
//!   `AIMED_DEGREES`; misses count: spread mustn't blur the measure). People take
//!   ~200 ms and more (seeing, deciding, moving the mouse); a fight opened with a hit under
//!   `FAST_MS` is near impossible. Honest players manage it now and then (prefiring a corner
//!   someone walks into), so only a large share of fights (`FAST_SHARE`) is flagged. In tests
//!   an aimbot opens about a third of its fights that fast; honest bots never do.
//!   (Headshot rates don't tell: CS 1.6's first-shot spread spoils even perfect aim.)
//! - Snaps: a big flick (over `FLICK_DEGREES` in a few ticks) that lands a hit, again and
//!   again. People flick too, so only a large share of all hits counts.
use super::*;

/// A shot this close to an enemy (degrees off their head) is aimed at them.
const AIMED_DEGREES: f32 = 3.0;
/// A fight opened faster than this (ms) isn't a human reaction.
const FAST_MS: u32 = 80;
/// Flagged: this share of fights that fast, over at least `MIN_ENGAGEMENTS`.
const FAST_SHARE: f32 = 0.25;
const MIN_ENGAGEMENTS: usize = 20;
/// A flick: the view turning this much within `FLICK_TICKS` before a hit.
const FLICK_DEGREES: f32 = 25.0;
const FLICK_TICKS: usize = 8;
/// Out of plain sight this long before coming back counts as a new engagement (peeking back
/// and forth is one fight, not many instant "reactions").
const SAME_FIGHT_SECS: f32 = 0.5;
/// Share of hits that were flicks, over at least `MIN_HITS`, that is flagged.
const FLICK_SHARE: f32 = 0.35;
const MIN_HITS: u32 = 20;

/// One player's aim, this match.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct Aim {
    /// Recent view angles (yaw, pitch), newest last.
    history: VecDeque<(f32, f32)>,
    /// Reaction times (ticks) of engagements so far.
    reactions: Vec<u32>,
    hits: u32,
    headshots: u32,
    flick_hits: u32,
    /// Already flagged for these (once a match each).
    flagged_reaction: bool,
    flagged_flicks: bool,
}

impl Aim {
    pub(super) fn look(&mut self, yaw: f32, pitch: f32) {
        self.history.push_back((yaw, pitch));
        if self.history.len() > 16 {
            self.history.pop_front();
        }
    }

    /// How far the view turned over the last few ticks (degrees).
    fn turned(&self) -> f32 {
        let (Some(now), Some(then)) = (self.history.back(), self.history.iter().rev().nth(FLICK_TICKS)) else { return 0.0 };
        let dyaw = ((now.0 - then.0 + 540.0) % 360.0) - 180.0;
        (dyaw * dyaw + (now.1 - then.1).powi(2)).sqrt()
    }
}

/// Engagements in progress: (viewer, enemy) -> when the enemy came into sight, whether the
/// viewer has hit them yet, and when they were last in plain sight.
#[derive(Default)]
pub(super) struct Sightings {
    since: HashMap<(u8, u8), (u32, bool, u32)>,
}

/// One player's aim numbers (for reviewers and tests).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub struct AimSummary {
    pub hits: u32,
    pub headshots: u32,
    pub flick_hits: u32,
    pub fights: usize,
    /// Fights opened with a hit faster than a human reaction.
    pub fast: usize,
}

impl Server {
    pub fn aim_summary(&self, id: u8) -> Option<AimSummary> {
        let a = &self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == id)?.aim;
        let fast = a.reactions.iter().filter(|r| **r * 1000 / self.rate.hz() < FAST_MS).count();
        Some(AimSummary { hits: a.hits, headshots: a.headshots, flick_hits: a.flick_hits, fights: a.reactions.len(), fast })
    }

    /// After visibility is worked out (every snapshot): note enemies newly in plain sight. Not
    /// the anti-wallhack's generous "visible" (it sends players a little before they show, so
    /// they don't pop in): a clear line from eyes to eyes, no smoke in between.
    pub(super) fn note_sightings(&mut self, sights: &HashMap<u8, std::collections::HashSet<u8>>) {
        let tick = self.tick;
        let eye = |id: u8| self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == id && c.vitals.alive()).map(|c| (c.team, c.state.movement.eye()));
        let mut plain = Vec::new();
        for (viewer, seen) in sights {
            let Some((vteam, veye)) = eye(*viewer) else { continue };
            for t in seen {
                let Some((tteam, teye)) = eye(*t) else { continue };
                if tteam != vteam && !self.world.sight_blocked(veye, teye) && !self.smoked(veye, teye) {
                    plain.push((*viewer, *t));
                }
            }
        }
        let same_fight = self.rate.secs(SAME_FIGHT_SECS);
        let s = &mut self.sightings.since;
        s.retain(|_, (_, _, last)| tick - *last < same_fight);
        for k in plain {
            s.entry(k).or_insert((tick, false, tick)).2 = tick;
        }
    }

    /// `shooter` fired along (yaw, pitch) from `eye`: the first shot aimed at an enemy in a
    /// fight is that fight's reaction.
    pub(super) fn check_shot(&mut self, shooter: u8, eye: [f32; 3], angles: [f32; 2]) {
        let tick = self.tick;
        let (f, _, _) = sim::weapons::bullets::view_vectors(angles[0], angles[1]);
        let mut reactions = Vec::new();
        for ((viewer, target), (seen, answered, _)) in self.sightings.since.iter_mut() {
            if *viewer != shooter || *answered {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(t) = self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == *target) else { continue };
            let head = t.state.movement.eye();
            let d = [head[0] - eye[0], head[1] - eye[1], head[2] - eye[2]];
            let len = (d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1] + d[2] * d[2]).sqrt().max(1.0);
            let off = ((d[0] * f[0] + d[1] * f[1] + d[2] * f[2]) / len).clamp(-1.0, 1.0).acos().to_degrees();
            if off <= AIMED_DEGREES {
                *answered = true;
                reactions.push(tick - *seen);
            }
        }
        if let Some(c) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == shooter) {
            c.aim.reactions.extend(reactions);
        }
        self.judge(shooter);
    }

    /// A bullet from `shooter` hit `victim`.
    pub(super) fn check_hit(&mut self, shooter: u8, head: bool) {
        let Some(c) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == shooter) else { return };
        let aim = &mut c.aim;
        aim.hits += 1;
        aim.headshots += head as u32;
        if aim.turned() > FLICK_DEGREES {
            aim.flick_hits += 1;
        }
        self.judge(shooter);
    }

    /// Flag what adds up to inhuman (once a match each).
    fn judge(&mut self, shooter: u8) {
        let hz = self.rate.hz();
        let Some(c) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == shooter) else { return };
        let aim = &mut c.aim;
        let mut flags: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        if !aim.flagged_reaction && aim.reactions.len() >= MIN_ENGAGEMENTS {
            let fast = aim.reactions.iter().filter(|r| **r * 1000 / hz < FAST_MS).count();
            let fast_share = fast as f32 / aim.reactions.len() as f32;
            let head_share = aim.headshots as f32 / aim.hits as f32;
            if fast_share >= FAST_SHARE {
                aim.flagged_reaction = true;
                flags.push(format!("reactions: {fast} of {} fights opened with an aimed shot under {FAST_MS} ms (people: 200+), {:.0}% of hits on the head", aim.reactions.len(), head_share * 100.0));
            }
        }
        if !aim.flagged_flicks && aim.hits >= MIN_HITS && aim.flick_hits as f32 / aim.hits as f32 >= FLICK_SHARE {
            aim.flagged_flicks = true;
            flags.push(format!("snaps: {} of {} hits came right after a flick over {FLICK_DEGREES} degrees", aim.flick_hits, aim.hits));
        }
        let (ticket, name) = (c.ticket, c.name.clone());
        for reason in flags {
            self.flag(ticket, &name, reason);
        }
    }

    /// Tell the lobbies (they file it with the reports, for a person to look at).
    fn flag(&mut self, ticket: u64, name: &str, reason: String) {
        println!("aim check flagged {name}: {reason}");
        let (demo, tick) = self.recording_now();
        let Some(key) = &self.server_key else { return };
        let sealed = key.seal(&encode(&crate::lobby::LobbyMsg::Flag { ticket, reason, map: self.map.clone(), demo, tick }));
        for lobby in self.lobbies.clone() {
            self.socket.send(lobby, sealed.clone());
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/bomb.rs`:

```rs
//! The bomb: carried by a terrorist, dropped when they die (or press G), planted in a bomb
//! site (the plant itself is weapon code in `sim`), defused by a counter-terrorist holding
//! use on it, or it explodes.
use super::*;
use crate::rounds::{EndReason, Phase};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum Bomb {
    None,
    Carried(u8),
    Dropped([f32; 3]),
    Planted {
        at: [f32; 3],
        explode: u32,
        /// Who is defusing and the tick they finish.
        defuse: Option<(u8, u32)>,
    },
    /// Exploded or defused this round.
    Gone,
}

/// CS 1.6 `PlayerUse`: things within `MAX_PLAYER_USE_RADIUS` (player centre to the bomb's
/// box centre, 4 units over where it lies) and in front (`VIEW_FIELD_NARROW`, the cosine from
/// the eyes; no wall check) can be used.
const DEFUSE_REACH: f32 = 64.0;
const DEFUSE_LOOK: f32 = 0.7;
const BOMB_CENTRE: f32 = 4.0;

impl Server {
    pub(super) fn defuser(&self) -> Option<u8> {
        match self.bomb {
            Bomb::Planted { defuse: Some((id, _)), .. } => Some(id),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    /// Round start: the bomb goes to one terrorist (taking turns by round number).
    pub(super) fn give_bomb(&mut self) {
        let mut ts: Vec<&mut Remote> = self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| c.team == Team::T && c.vitals.alive()).collect();
        ts.sort_by_key(|c| c.id);
        let n = ts.len();
        self.bomb = Bomb::None;
        if n == 0 || self.world.zones.bomb_sites.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let c = &mut ts[self.round.round as usize % n];
        c.state.loadout.give(Id::C4, 0.0);
        self.bomb = Bomb::Carried(c.id);
    }

    /// Where the bomb lands from someone's hands (on the floor under them).
    fn floor_under(&self, p: [f32; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
        self.world.trace_line(p, [p[0], p[1], p[2] - 4096.0]).end
    }

    /// Carrier dropped it (G) or died: it falls where they stand.
    pub(super) fn drop_bomb(&mut self, id: u8) {
        if self.bomb != Bomb::Carried(id) {
            return;
        }
        let Some(c) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == id) else { return };
        let l = &mut c.state.loadout;
        l.c4 = false;
        l.planting = None;
        if l.active == data::Slot::Bomb {
            let best = [data::Slot::Primary, data::Slot::Secondary, data::Slot::Knife].into_iter().find(|s| match s {
                data::Slot::Primary => l.primary.is_some(),
                data::Slot::Secondary => l.secondary.is_some(),
                _ => true,
            });
            l.switch_to(best.unwrap_or(data::Slot::Knife), c.last_run as f64 * self.rate.tick() as f64);
        }
        let at = c.state.movement.origin;
        self.bomb = Bomb::Dropped(self.floor_under(at));
    }

    pub(super) fn bomb_planted(&mut self, by: u8, at: [f32; 3]) {
        let at = self.floor_under(at);
        let explode = self.tick + (self.round.cfg.c4_timer * self.rate.hz() as f32) as u32;
        self.bomb = Bomb::Planted { at, explode, defuse: None };
        self.planter = Some(by);
        self.events.push(GameEvent::BombPlanted { by, at });
    }

    /// Pick-ups, defusing and the explosion; once a tick.
    pub(super) fn bomb_step(&mut self) {
        let tick = self.tick;
        match self.bomb {
            Bomb::Carried(id) => {
                if !self.clients.values().any(|c| c.id == id && c.vitals.alive() && c.state.loadout.c4) {
                    // Carrier gone or dead (death drops it in `settle_deaths`): don't lose it.
                    if let Some(c) = self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == id) {
                        let at = c.state.movement.origin;
                        self.bomb = Bomb::Dropped(self.floor_under(at));
                    } else {
                        self.bomb = Bomb::None;
                    }
                }
            }
            Bomb::Dropped(at) => {
                let taker = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| {
                    let o = c.state.movement.origin;
                    let h = c.state.movement.hull();
                    c.team == Team::T && c.vitals.alive() && (0..3).all(|k| at[k] >= o[k] + h.mins()[k] - 16.0 && at[k] <= o[k] + h.maxs()[k] + 16.0)
                });
                if let Some(c) = taker {
                    c.state.loadout.give(Id::C4, 0.0);
                    self.bomb = Bomb::Carried(c.id);
                }
            }
            Bomb::Planted { at, explode, defuse } => {
                if tick >= explode {
                    self.explode(at);
                    return;
                }
                // The defuser must keep holding use, alive, close and looking at it.
                let still = |c: &Remote| {
                    let (o, eye) = (c.state.movement.origin, c.state.movement.eye());
                    let centre = [at[0], at[1], at[2] + BOMB_CENTRE];
                    let near = (0..3).map(|i| (centre[i] - o[i]).powi(2)).sum::<f32>().sqrt() <= DEFUSE_REACH;
                    let d = [centre[0] - eye[0], centre[1] - eye[1], centre[2] - eye[2]];
                    let len = (d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1] + d[2] * d[2]).sqrt();
                    let (f, _, _) = bullets::view_vectors(c.view.1, c.view.0);
                    let look = if len > 1.0 { (d[0] * f[0] + d[1] * f[1] + d[2] * f[2]) / len } else { 1.0 };
                    c.team == Team::Ct && c.vitals.alive() && c.use_held && near && look > DEFUSE_LOOK
                };
                match defuse {
                    Some((id, done)) => {
                        if !self.clients.values().any(|c| c.id == id && still(c)) {
                            self.bomb = Bomb::Planted { at, explode, defuse: None };
                        } else if tick >= done {
                            self.bomb = Bomb::Gone;
                            self.events.push(GameEvent::BombDefused { by: id });
                            if self.round.phase == Phase::Live {
                                self.end_round(Team::Ct, EndReason::BombDefused);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    None => {
                        if let Some(c) = self.clients.values().filter(|c| still(c)).min_by_key(|c| c.id) {
                            let secs = if c.defuse_kit { self.round.cfg.defuse_kit_time } else { self.round.cfg.defuse_time };
                            let done = tick + (secs * self.rate.hz() as f32) as u32;
                            self.events.push(GameEvent::Defusing { by: c.id, kit: c.defuse_kit });
                            self.bomb = Bomb::Planted { at, explode, defuse: Some((c.id, done)) };
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Bomb::None | Bomb::Gone => {}
        }
    }

    /// Boom: hurts everyone out to 3.5 × the map's bomb radius, through walls (CS 1.6 C4).
    fn explode(&mut self, at: [f32; 3]) {
        self.bomb = Bomb::Gone;
        self.events.push(GameEvent::BombExploded { at });
        let radius = self.world.zones.bomb_radius;
        self.bomb_triggers(at);
        self.blast_pieces(at, radius * 3.5, radius);
        for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| c.vitals.alive()) {
            let o = c.state.movement.origin;
            let d = ((o[0] - at[0]).powi(2) + (o[1] - at[1]).powi(2) + (o[2] - at[2]).powi(2)).sqrt();
            let dmg = radius * (1.0 - d / (radius * 3.5));
            if dmg <= 0.0 {
                continue;
            }
            let (health, armor) = combat::explosion_damage(&c.vitals, dmg);
            let killed = c.vitals.hurt(health, armor);
            self.events.push(GameEvent::Damage { attacker: WORLD, victim: c.id, amount: health, group: HitGroup::Generic, sound: HitSound::Explosion, at: None });
            if killed {
                self.events.push(GameEvent::Kill { killer: WORLD, victim: c.id, weapon: Some(Id::C4), headshot: false });
            }
        }
        if self.round.phase == Phase::Live {
            self.end_round(Team::T, EndReason::BombExploded);
        }
    }

    /// The bomb as one client may see it (only terrorists are told who carries it).
    pub(super) fn bomb_net(&self, viewer: Team) -> BombNet {
        let now = self.tick;
        match self.bomb {
            Bomb::Carried(id) if viewer == Team::T => BombNet::Carried(id),
            Bomb::Dropped(at) => BombNet::Dropped(at),
            Bomb::Planted { at, explode, defuse } => BombNet::Planted {
                at,
                left: explode.saturating_sub(now) as f32 * self.rate.tick(),
                defuse: defuse.map(|(id, done)| (id, done.saturating_sub(now) as f32 * self.rate.tick())),
            },
            _ => BombNet::None,
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/breakables.rs`:

```rs
//! Breakable glass, vents and crates on the server: they take bullet and explosion damage,
//! the ones marked "only trigger" (dust2's crates) break when the bomb goes off at their
//! site, and all come back at round start. Clients get the broken list in every snapshot.
use super::*;
use sim::breakables::Breakable;

pub(super) struct Pieces {
    list: Vec<Breakable>,
    health: Vec<f32>,
    broken: Vec<bool>,
    /// Bomb sites and the target each fires when the bomb explodes there.
    site_targets: Vec<([f32; 3], [f32; 3], String)>,
}

impl Pieces {
    pub(super) fn from_bsp(bsp: &Bsp) -> Pieces {
        let list = sim::breakables::from_bsp(bsp);
        Pieces { health: list.iter().map(|b| b.health).collect(), broken: vec![false; list.len()], list, site_targets: sim::breakables::bomb_site_targets(bsp) }
    }
}

impl Server {
    fn break_piece(&mut self, i: usize) {
        let p = &mut self.pieces;
        if p.broken[i] {
            return;
        }
        p.broken[i] = true;
        let b = &p.list[i];
        self.world.set_broken(b.model, true);
        self.events.push(GameEvent::Broke { model: b.model as u16, material: b.material, at: b.center });
    }

    /// A bullet hit brush model `model` for `damage`.
    pub(super) fn shoot_piece(&mut self, model: usize, damage: f32) {
        let Some(i) = self.pieces.list.iter().position(|b| b.model == model && !b.trigger_only) else { return };
        self.pieces.health[i] -= damage;
        if self.pieces.health[i] <= 0.0 {
            self.break_piece(i);
        }
    }

    /// An explosion at `at`: damage falls off to nothing at `radius` (GoldSrc RadiusDamage).
    pub(super) fn blast_pieces(&mut self, at: [f32; 3], radius: f32, damage: f32) {
        for i in 0..self.pieces.list.len() {
            let b = &self.pieces.list[i];
            if b.trigger_only || self.pieces.broken[i] {
                continue;
            }
            let d = ((b.center[0] - at[0]).powi(2) + (b.center[1] - at[1]).powi(2) + (b.center[2] - at[2]).powi(2)).sqrt();
            let dmg = damage * (1.0 - d / radius);
            if dmg > 0.0 {
                self.pieces.health[i] -= dmg;
                if self.pieces.health[i] <= 0.0 {
                    self.break_piece(i);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// The bomb went off: the site it was in fires its target (dust2's crates at that site break).
    pub(super) fn bomb_triggers(&mut self, at: [f32; 3]) {
        let names: Vec<String> = self
            .pieces
            .site_targets
            .iter()
            .filter(|(lo, hi, _)| (0..3).all(|k| at[k] >= lo[k] - 64.0 && at[k] <= hi[k] + 64.0))
            .map(|(_, _, t)| t.clone())
            .collect();
        for i in 0..self.pieces.list.len() {
            if !self.pieces.list[i].targetname.is_empty() && names.contains(&self.pieces.list[i].targetname) {
                self.break_piece(i);
            }
        }
    }

    /// New round: everything is whole again.
    pub(super) fn restore_pieces(&mut self) {
        for i in 0..self.pieces.list.len() {
            if self.pieces.broken[i] {
                self.world.set_broken(self.pieces.list[i].model, false);
            }
            self.pieces.broken[i] = false;
            self.pieces.health[i] = self.pieces.list[i].health;
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn broken_models(&self) -> Vec<u16> {
        self.pieces.list.iter().zip(&self.pieces.broken).filter(|(_, b)| **b).map(|(p, _)| p.model as u16).collect()
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/buy.rs`:

```rs
//! Buying: prices, who may buy what, and where and when (docs/RULES.md 3 and 4).
//! Ammo isn't sold: guns come with full ammo, and everyone's is topped up each round.
use super::*;
use crate::rounds::Phase;

/// Price of one item; None = can't be bought.
pub fn price(item: BuyItem) -> Option<i32> {
    match item {
        BuyItem::Weapon(id) => Some(data::def(id).price as i32),
        BuyItem::Kevlar => Some(650),
        BuyItem::KevlarHelmet => Some(1000),
        BuyItem::DefuseKit => Some(200),
    }
}

/// The guns on sale (a trimmed CS 1.6 list), and which side may buy each.
pub fn allowed(team: Team, item: BuyItem) -> bool {
    use Id::*;
    match item {
        BuyItem::Weapon(Glock | Usp | P228 | Deagle | Mp5 | Ump45 | P90 | Scout | Awp | HeGrenade | Flashbang | Smoke) => true,
        BuyItem::Weapon(Mac10 | Galil | Ak47) => team == Team::T,
        BuyItem::Weapon(Tmp | Famas | M4a1) | BuyItem::DefuseKit => team == Team::Ct,
        BuyItem::Weapon(_) => false,
        BuyItem::Kevlar | BuyItem::KevlarHelmet => true,
    }
}

/// One purchase this round: what it cost and what it changed (to put back on undo).
pub(super) struct Purchase {
    cost: i32,
    undo: Undo,
}

enum Undo {
    /// A gun into its slot, replacing `old` (dropped on the ground) or nothing.
    Gun { slot: data::Slot, id: Id, old: Option<sim::weapons::GunState> },
    /// A grenade (index into `Loadout::grenades`) and how many there were after it.
    Grenade { i: usize, after: u8 },
    /// Armor (and helmet), and what was worn before.
    Armor { armor: f32, helmet: bool },
    Kit,
}

impl Server {
    /// Sell back everything bought this round at what was paid, newest first, while you may
    /// still buy (time, place), as CS2 does. Something already used (a gun fired, a grenade
    /// thrown, armor damaged, a gun dropped) stays and isn't refunded. A gun swapped out comes
    /// back off the floor if it's still lying there.
    pub(super) fn undo_buys(&mut self, from: SocketAddr) {
        let Some(c) = self.clients.get(&from) else { return };
        if !self.can_buy(c) {
            return;
        }
        let c = self.clients.get_mut(&from).unwrap();
        let now = c.last_run as f64 * self.rate.tick() as f64;
        let id = c.id;
        for p in std::mem::take(&mut c.purchases).into_iter().rev() {
            let l = &mut c.state.loadout;
            let undone = match p.undo {
                Undo::Gun { slot, id: gun, old } => {
                    let held = match slot {
                        data::Slot::Primary => &mut l.primary,
                        _ => &mut l.secondary,
                    };
                    let fresh = sim::weapons::GunState::new(gun);
                    if held.as_ref().is_some_and(|g| g.id == gun && g.clip == fresh.clip && g.reserve == fresh.reserve) {
                        // The swapped-out gun, if it's still on the floor where it was dropped.
                        let back = old.and_then(|o| self.ground.iter().position(|g| g.dropper == id && g.gun.id == o.id).map(|i| self.ground.remove(i).gun));
                        *held = back;
                        true
                    } else {
                        false
                    }
                }
                Undo::Grenade { i, after } if l.grenades[i] >= after => {
                    l.grenades[i] -= 1;
                    true
                }
                Undo::Grenade { .. } => false,
                Undo::Armor { armor, helmet } if c.vitals.armor >= combat::MAX_ARMOR => {
                    (c.vitals.armor, c.vitals.helmet) = (armor, helmet);
                    true
                }
                Undo::Armor { .. } => false,
                Undo::Kit if c.defuse_kit => {
                    c.defuse_kit = false;
                    true
                }
                Undo::Kit => false,
            };
            if undone {
                c.money += p.cost;
            }
        }
        // Holding something that's gone: take out the best that's left.
        let l = &mut c.state.loadout;
        let gone = match l.active {
            data::Slot::Primary => l.primary.is_none(),
            data::Slot::Secondary => l.secondary.is_none(),
            data::Slot::Grenade => l.grenades.iter().all(|n| *n == 0),
            _ => false,
        };
        if gone {
            let best = if l.primary.is_some() { data::Slot::Primary } else if l.secondary.is_some() { data::Slot::Secondary } else { data::Slot::Knife };
            l.switch_to(best, now);
        }
    }

    /// Whether this player may buy now (time, place) — prices aside.
    pub(super) fn can_buy(&self, c: &Remote) -> bool {
        if !c.vitals.alive() || c.team == Team::Spectator {
            return false;
        }
        if self.rules.free_play() || self.round.phase == Phase::Warmup {
            return true; // anywhere, any time
        }
        let side = if c.team == Team::Ct { sim::zones::Side::Ct } else { sim::zones::Side::T };
        self.round.can_buy(self.tick) && self.world.zones.in_buy_zone(side, c.state.movement.origin)
    }

    /// Buy for the player at `from`, if they may and can afford it.
    pub(super) fn buy(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, item: BuyItem) {
        let Some(c) = self.clients.get(&from) else { return };
        if !self.can_buy(c) || !allowed(c.team, item) {
            return;
        }
        let free = self.rules.free_play() || self.round.phase == Phase::Warmup;
        let tick = self.tick;
        let c = self.clients.get_mut(&from).unwrap();
        let now = c.last_run as f64 * self.rate.tick() as f64;
        // What it costs; None = nothing to buy (already have it).
        let cost = match item {
            BuyItem::Kevlar if c.vitals.armor >= combat::MAX_ARMOR => None,
            // Already wearing full armor: only the helmet is paid for.
            BuyItem::KevlarHelmet if c.vitals.helmet && c.vitals.armor >= combat::MAX_ARMOR => None,
            BuyItem::KevlarHelmet if c.vitals.armor >= combat::MAX_ARMOR => Some(350),
            BuyItem::DefuseKit if c.defuse_kit => None,
            other => price(other),
        };
        let Some(cost) = cost else { return };
        let cost = if free { 0 } else { cost };
        if c.money < cost {
            return;
        }
        let l = &mut c.state.loadout;
        let mut old = None;
        let before = (c.vitals.armor, c.vitals.helmet);
        let bought = match item {
            BuyItem::Weapon(id) => {
                // Buying a gun for a taken slot drops the old one, like CS.
                let taken = match data::def(id).slot {
                    data::Slot::Primary => l.primary.is_some(),
                    data::Slot::Secondary => l.secondary.is_some(),
                    _ => false,
                };
                if taken && sim::weapons::is_gun(id) {
                    l.switch_to(data::def(id).slot, now);
                    if let Some(dropped) = l.drop_active(now) {
                        let o = c.state.movement.origin;
                        old = Some(dropped);
                        self.ground.push(GroundGun { gun: dropped, origin: o, velocity: [0.0, 0.0, -1.0], dropper: c.id, dropper_wait_until: tick + self.rate.secs(REPICK_SECS) });
                    }
                }
                c.state.loadout.give(id, now)
            }
            BuyItem::Kevlar => {
                c.vitals.armor = combat::MAX_ARMOR;
                true
            }
            BuyItem::KevlarHelmet => {
                c.vitals.armor = combat::MAX_ARMOR;
                c.vitals.helmet = true;
                true
            }
            BuyItem::DefuseKit => {
                c.defuse_kit = true;
                true
            }
        };
        if bought {
            c.money -= cost;
            let l = &c.state.loadout;
            let undo = match item {
                BuyItem::Weapon(id @ (Id::HeGrenade | Id::Flashbang | Id::Smoke)) => {
                    let i = match id {
                        Id::HeGrenade => 0,
                        Id::Flashbang => 1,
                        _ => 2,
                    };
                    Undo::Grenade { i, after: l.grenades[i] }
                }
                BuyItem::Weapon(id) => Undo::Gun { slot: data::def(id).slot, id, old },
                BuyItem::Kevlar | BuyItem::KevlarHelmet => Undo::Armor { armor: before.0, helmet: before.1 },
                BuyItem::DefuseKit => Undo::Kit,
            };
            c.purchases.push(Purchase { cost, undo });
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn both_sides_can_buy_the_p228_for_600() {
        assert!(allowed(Team::T, BuyItem::Weapon(Id::P228)) && allowed(Team::Ct, BuyItem::Weapon(Id::P228)));
        assert_eq!(price(BuyItem::Weapon(Id::P228)), Some(600));
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/ground.rs`:

```rs
//! Guns on the ground: dropped ones fall and slide; walking over one picks it up.
use super::*;

impl Server {
    /// Dropped guns fall and slide to a stop; walking over one picks it up if that slot is free.
    pub(super) fn ground_step(&mut self) {
        let dt = self.rate.tick();
        for g in &mut self.ground {
            if g.velocity == [0.0; 3] {
                continue;
            }
            g.velocity[2] -= self.vars.gravity * dt;
            let end = std::array::from_fn(|i| g.origin[i] + g.velocity[i] * dt);
            let t = self.world.trace_line(g.origin, end);
            g.origin = t.end;
            if t.fraction < 1.0 {
                if t.normal[2] > 0.7 {
                    g.velocity = [0.0; 3];
                } else {
                    let d = g.velocity[0] * t.normal[0] + g.velocity[1] * t.normal[1] + g.velocity[2] * t.normal[2];
                    g.velocity = std::array::from_fn(|i| g.velocity[i] - t.normal[i] * d);
                }
            }
        }
        let tick = self.tick;
        let mut i = 0;
        while i < self.ground.len() {
            let g = &self.ground[i];
            let taker = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| {
                let o = c.state.movement.origin;
                let h = c.state.movement.hull();
                let near = (0..3).all(|k| g.origin[k] >= o[k] + h.mins()[k] - 8.0 && g.origin[k] <= o[k] + h.maxs()[k] + 8.0);
                near && c.vitals.alive() && !(c.id == g.dropper && tick < g.dropper_wait_until)
            });
            let gun = g.gun;
            if taker.is_some_and(|c| c.state.loadout.pick_up(gun)) {
                self.ground.swap_remove(i);
            } else {
                i += 1;
            }
        }
    }

    /// A player died: their primary (or pistol) falls where they were.
    pub(super) fn drop_on_death(&mut self, victim: u8) {
        let Some(c) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == victim) else { return };
        let l = &mut c.state.loadout;
        let gun = l.primary.take().or_else(|| l.secondary.take());
        if let Some(gun) = gun {
            self.ground.push(GroundGun { gun, origin: c.state.movement.origin, velocity: [0.0, 0.0, -1.0], dropper: victim, dropper_wait_until: 0 });
        }
    }
}
```
