`net/src/server/guard.rs`:

```rs
//! Protection against floods and spoofing, before any real work is done on a packet:
//! oversized packets are dropped, every IP gets a packet budget (small until it's a player),
//! and joining needs a cookie only a real address can echo back, so spoofed addresses can't
//! take player slots or memory. (Big volumetric floods must be filtered by the host.)
use super::*;
use std::net::IpAddr;

/// Bigger datagrams are never ours (a snapshot-sized input packet is a few hundred bytes).
pub(super) const MAX_PACKET: usize = 1400;
/// Packets per second: per player (inputs at the tick rate, voice, a little spare; an IP with
/// several players gets that much per player) / per IP for everyone else.
const PLAYER_RATE: f32 = 600.0;
const STRANGER_RATE: f32 = 20.0;
/// Players from one IP (a LAN party behind one router is fine, a flood of slots isn't).
/// Loopback is exempt: it can't be spoofed from outside, and tests run many players from it.
pub(super) const MAX_PER_IP: usize = 6;
/// IPs remembered at once; past this, strangers are ignored until the table drains.
const MAX_TRACKED: usize = 8192;

pub(super) struct Guard {
    cookies: crate::secure::Cookies,
    /// Budgets per IP, separate for players and strangers: players can't starve joins, and a
    /// flood of made-up addresses (filling the strangers' table) can't touch players.
    players: crate::secure::Buckets<IpAddr>,
    strangers: crate::secure::Buckets<IpAddr>,
    hz: f64,
}

impl Guard {
    pub(super) fn new(rate: crate::tick::TickRate) -> Guard {
        // From the OS random source: nobody can work out the cookies (and fake addresses).
        Guard { cookies: crate::secure::Cookies::new(), players: crate::secure::Buckets::new(usize::MAX), strangers: crate::secure::Buckets::new(MAX_TRACKED), hz: rate.hz() as f64 }
    }

    /// May this packet be looked at? `players`: how many players are in the game from this
    /// IP (0 = a stranger's packet: the address isn't in the game).
    pub(super) fn allow(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, len: usize, players: usize, tick: u32) -> bool {
        if len > MAX_PACKET {
            return false;
        }
        let now = tick as f64 / self.hz;
        if players > 0 {
            self.players.allow(from.ip(), PLAYER_RATE * players as f32, now)
        } else {
            self.strangers.allow(from.ip(), STRANGER_RATE, now)
        }
    }

    /// Forget IPs that have been quiet for a few seconds.
    pub(super) fn tidy(&mut self, tick: u32) {
        let now = tick as f64 / self.hz;
        self.players.tidy(now, 5.0);
        self.strangers.tidy(now, 5.0);
    }

    /// The join cookie for an address now (stateless: nothing is stored).
    pub(super) fn cookie(&self, addr: SocketAddr, tick: u32) -> u64 {
        self.cookies.make(addr, (tick as f64 / self.hz) as u64)
    }

    pub(super) fn cookie_ok(&self, addr: SocketAddr, tick: u32, cookie: u64) -> bool {
        self.cookies.check(addr, (tick as f64 / self.hz) as u64, cookie)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn players_behind_one_ip_each_get_a_budget_and_joins_still_get_through() {
        let rate = crate::tick::TickRate::default();
        let mut g = Guard::new(rate);
        let ip = |port| SocketAddr::from(([10, 0, 0, 1], port));
        // Five players behind one router, 128 inputs a second each, for a second.
        let mut dropped = 0;
        for tick in 0..rate.hz() {
            for p in 0..5 {
                if !g.allow(ip(1000 + p), 100, 5, tick) {
                    dropped += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        assert_eq!(dropped, 0);
        // A friend joining from the same router isn't starved by them.
        assert!(g.allow(ip(2000), 100, 0, rate.hz()));
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/handle.rs`:

```rs
//! What each message from a player does.
use super::*;

impl Server {
    pub(super) fn handle(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, msg: ClientMsg) {
        match msg {
            ClientMsg::Hello { version, name, cookie, ticket } => {
                if version != PROTOCOL_VERSION {
                    let reason = format!("server runs protocol {PROTOCOL_VERSION}, you have {version}");
                    self.socket.send(from, encode(&ServerMsg::Reject { reason }));
                    return;
                }
                if !self.clients.contains_key(&from) {
                    // A new address must first prove it's real: echo our cookie (stateless).
                    if !self.guard.cookie_ok(from, self.tick, cookie) {
                        let cookie = self.guard.cookie(from, self.tick);
                        self.socket.send(from, encode(&ServerMsg::Challenge { cookie }));
                        return;
                    }
                    if !from.ip().is_loopback() && self.clients.keys().filter(|a| a.ip() == from.ip()).count() >= guard::MAX_PER_IP {
                        self.socket.send(from, encode(&ServerMsg::Reject { reason: "too many players from your address".into() }));
                        return;
                    }
                    // A reserved match only lets in its own players (and puts them on their team).
                    let seat = match self.admit(ticket) {
                        Ok(seat) => seat,
                        Err(reason) => {
                            self.socket.send(from, encode(&ServerMsg::Reject { reason }));
                            return;
                        }
                    };
                    let humans = self.clients.values().filter(|c| !c.bot).count();
                    if self.clients.len() >= MAX_PLAYERS || humans >= self.round.cfg.max_players as usize {
                        self.socket.send(from, encode(&ServerMsg::Reject { reason: "server full".into() }));
                        return;
                    }
                    let id = (0..=u8::MAX).find(|i| self.clients.values().all(|c| c.id != *i)).unwrap_or(0);
                    // Everyone starts as a spectator and picks a side (JoinTeam), like CS.
                    let name: String = name.chars().filter(|c| !c.is_control()).take(24).collect();
                    let mut r = Remote::new(id, name, self.tick);
                    r.money = self.round.cfg.start_money;
                    // A deathmatch seat: keep its number (reports and aim flags name it).
                    if self.seats.contains_key(&ticket) {
                        r.ticket = ticket;
                    }
                    if let Some((group, team, saved)) = seat {
                        r.ticket = ticket;
                        r.group = Some(group);
                        r.team = team; // dead until the next round starts
                        if let Some((money, kills, deaths)) = saved {
                            (r.money, r.kills, r.deaths) = (money, kills, deaths);
                        }
                    }
                    self.clients.insert(from, r);
                    // An encrypted join: this address talks over the player's channel now.
                    if let Some((addr, ticket, ch)) = self.joining.take().filter(|j| j.0 == from) {
                        self.socket.secure(addr, ticket, ch);
                    }
                    // Deathmatch: straight in, on the smaller team (no team pick, like CSDM).
                    if self.rules.deathmatch {
                        self.handle(from, ClientMsg::JoinTeam { team: None });
                    }
                }
                let id = self.clients[&from].id;
                self.socket.send(from, encode(&ServerMsg::Welcome { id, map: self.map.clone(), map_hash: self.map_hash, tick_rate: self.rate.hz(), practice: self.rules.free_play() }));
            }
            ClientMsg::Inputs { first_seq, inputs, events, snap } => {
                let Some(c) = self.clients.get_mut(&from) else { return };
                c.last_heard = self.tick;
                // Ping, as the server sees it: from sending a snapshot to hearing it arrived.
                if snap > c.snap_ack && snap <= self.tick {
                    let ms = (self.tick - snap) as f32 * 1000.0 / self.rate.hz() as f32;
                    c.stats.ping = if c.stats.ping == 0.0 { ms } else { c.stats.ping * 0.9 + ms * 0.1 };
                }
                c.snap_ack = c.snap_ack.max(snap);
                while c.outbox.front().is_some_and(|(n, _)| *n <= events) {
                    c.outbox.pop_front();
                }
                for (i, input) in inputs.into_iter().enumerate() {
                    let seq = first_seq + i as u32;
                    if seq > c.last_queued {
                        c.queue.push_back((seq, input));
                        c.last_queued = seq;
                    }
                }
                // Never let a client queue up more than a second of movement.
                while c.queue.len() > self.rate.hz() as usize {
                    c.queue.pop_front();
                }
            }
            ClientMsg::Buy { item } => self.buy(from, item),
            ClientMsg::UndoBuys => self.undo_buys(from),
            ClientMsg::SideVote { switch } => self.side_vote(from, switch),
            ClientMsg::CallSurrender => self.call_surrender(from),
            ClientMsg::CallKick { player } => self.call_kick(from, player),
            ClientMsg::Report { player, reason } => self.report(from, player, reason),
            ClientMsg::Vote { yes } => self.surrender_vote(from, yes),
            ClientMsg::JoinTeam { .. } if self.reserved.is_some() => {} // teams are fixed in a reserved match
            ClientMsg::JoinTeam { team } => {
                let (t, ct) = self.clients.values().filter(|c| !c.bot).fold((0, 0), |(t, ct), c| match c.team {
                    Team::T => (t + 1, ct),
                    Team::Ct => (t, ct + 1),
                    Team::Spectator => (t, ct),
                });
                let tick = self.tick;
                // Mid-round you wait for the next one (freeze time still lets you in).
                let can_spawn = self.respawns() || self.round.phase == crate::rounds::Phase::Freeze;
                let Some(c) = self.clients.get_mut(&from) else { return };
                let team = team.unwrap_or(if t <= ct { Team::T } else { Team::Ct });
                if c.team == team {
                    return;
                }
                c.team = team;
                c.vitals.health = 0.0; // switching sides respawns you (or makes you watch)
                c.respawn_at = if team == Team::Spectator || !can_spawn { None } else { Some(tick) };
                let id = c.id;
                self.drop_bomb(id);
                self.place_dummies();
            }
            ClientMsg::Voice { channel, data } => self.relay_voice(from, channel, data),
            ClientMsg::Info { pad } => {
                // Padded requests only: the answer must not be bigger than the question.
                if pad.len() >= INFO_PAD {
                    let players = self.clients.values().filter(|c| !c.bot).count() as u8;
                    let cfg = &self.round.cfg;
                    // Short names: the answer must stay smaller than the padded request.
                    let short = |s: &str| s.chars().take(24).collect::<String>();
                    let info = ServerMsg::Info { version: PROTOCOL_VERSION, name: short(&cfg.name), map: short(&self.map), players, max: cfg.max_players };
                    self.socket.send(from, encode(&info));
                }
            }
            ClientMsg::Looks { t, ct } => {
                if let Some(c) = self.clients.get_mut(&from) {
                    c.looks = [t.min(CLASSES - 1), ct.min(CLASSES - 1)];
                }
            }
            ClientMsg::Bye => {
                if let Some(c) = self.clients.remove(&from) {
                    self.remember(&c);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/hits.rs`:

```rs
//! Grenades flying and going off, shots and knife hits resolved (with lag compensation), and deaths settled.
use super::*;

impl Server {
    /// Fly grenades and set off the ones that are due.
    pub(super) fn grenades_step(&mut self) {
        use sim::grenades::{self, Kind};
        let now = self.tick as f64 * self.rate.tick() as f64;
        for g in &mut self.grenades {
            if g.physics(self.rate.tick(), &self.world, self.vars.gravity) {
                self.events.push(GameEvent::GrenadeBounce { kind: g.kind, at: g.origin });
            }
        }
        let (due, flying): (Vec<_>, Vec<_>) = self.grenades.drain(..).partition(|g| g.due(now));
        self.grenades = flying;
        self.smokes.retain(|s| s.1 > now);
        let tick = self.tick;
        for g in due {
            match g.kind {
                Kind::He => {
                    let blast = g.blast_point(&self.world);
                    self.events.push(GameEvent::Explosion { at: blast });
                    self.blast_pieces(blast, 350.0, 100.0);
                    // Without friendly fire your own HE still hurts you, not your team.
                    let owner_team = self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == g.owner).map(|c| c.team);
                    let ff = self.round.cfg.friendly_fire;
                    let wet = self.world.point_contents(blast) == sim::collision::Contents::Water;
                    let mut dealt = Vec::new();
                    for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| c.vitals.alive() && (ff || c.id == g.owner || Some(c.team) != owner_team)) {
                        if !grenades::blast_reaches(wet, c.state.movement.water_level) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        let dmg = grenades::he_damage(blast, c.state.movement.origin);
                        if dmg <= 0.0 {
                            continue;
                        }
                        let (health, armor) = combat::explosion_damage(&c.vitals, dmg);
                        if Some(c.team) != owner_team {
                            dealt.push((g.owner, health.min(c.vitals.health)));
                            c.stats.hurt_by.push((g.owner, health.min(c.vitals.health)));
                        }
                        let killed = c.vitals.hurt(health, armor);
                        self.events.push(GameEvent::Damage { attacker: g.owner, victim: c.id, amount: health, group: HitGroup::Generic, sound: HitSound::Explosion, at: None });
                        if killed {
                            c.respawn_at = Some(tick + if c.bot { self.rate.secs(DUMMY_RESPAWN_SECS) } else { self.rate.secs(self.rules.respawn_secs) });
                            self.events.push(GameEvent::Kill { killer: g.owner, victim: c.id, weapon: Some(Id::HeGrenade), headshot: false });
                        }
                    }
                    self.note_damage(&dealt);
                }
                Kind::Flash => {
                    let wet = self.world.point_contents(g.origin) == sim::collision::Contents::Water;
                    let mut blinded = Vec::new();
                    for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| c.vitals.alive() && grenades::blast_reaches(wet, c.state.movement.water_level)) {
                        let (yaw, pitch) = c.view;
                        let (f, _, _) = bullets::view_vectors(pitch, yaw);
                        if let Some(b) = grenades::flash(&self.world, g.origin, c.state.movement.eye(), f) {
                            let b = grenades::combine(b, c.blind, now);
                            c.blind = Some((now, b));
                            blinded.push((c.id, b));
                        }
                    }
                    self.events.push(GameEvent::Flash { at: g.origin, blinded });
                }
                Kind::Smoke => self.smokes.push((g.origin, now + grenades::SMOKE_SECONDS)),
            }
        }
    }

    /// Trace a player's shots/swing against everyone else as the shooter saw them.
    pub(super) fn resolve(&mut self, p: Pending) {
        if let Some((kind, angles)) = p.fired.throw {
            let now = self.tick as f64 * self.rate.tick() as f64;
            self.grenades.push(sim::grenades::throw(kind, p.shooter, p.eye, angles[0], angles[1], p.velocity, now));
        }
        let targets: Vec<Target> = self.rewind(p.view_tick).into_iter().filter(|t| t.id != p.shooter).collect();
        let mut hits: Vec<(u8, f32, HitGroup, Id, Option<[f32; 3]>)> = Vec::new();
        for shot in &p.fired.shots {
            let r = if shot.pellets.is_some() {
                bullets::fire_pellets(&self.world, &self.assets.hitboxes, p.eye, shot, p.shooter, &targets)
            } else {
                bullets::fire_bullet(&self.world, &self.assets.materials, &self.assets.hitboxes, p.eye, shot, p.shooter, &targets)
            };
            let end = r.impacts.last().map(|i| i.point).unwrap_or_else(|| {
                let (f, _, _) = bullets::view_vectors(shot.angles[0], shot.angles[1]);
                std::array::from_fn(|i| p.eye[i] + f[i] * 2048.0)
            });
            let holes = r.impacts.iter().filter(|i| !i.sky).map(|i| (i.point, i.normal)).collect();
            for i in r.impacts.iter().filter(|i| i.model != 0) {
                self.shoot_piece(i.model, shot.damage as f32);
            }
            self.events.push(GameEvent::Shot { shooter: p.shooter, weapon: shot.weapon, silenced: shot.silenced, from: p.eye, to: end, holes });
            self.check_shot(p.shooter, p.eye, shot.angles);
            hits.extend(r.hits.into_iter().map(|h| (h.victim, h.damage, h.group, shot.weapon, Some(h.point))));
        }
        if let Some(swing) = p.fired.swing {
            let range = if swing.stab { STAB_RANGE } else { SLASH_RANGE };
            let (f, _, _) = bullets::view_vectors(swing.angles[0], swing.angles[1]);
            let end = std::array::from_fn(|i| p.eye[i] + f[i] * range);
            let hit = bullets::trace_melee(&self.world, &self.assets.hitboxes, p.eye, end, p.shooter, &targets);
            if let Some((victim, group)) = hit {
                let mut dmg = if swing.stab { STAB_DAMAGE } else { SLASH_DAMAGE };
                // Backstab: both facing the same way (within ~37 degrees).
                if swing.stab {
                    if let Some(t) = targets.iter().find(|t| t.id == victim) {
                        if (p.yaw - t.yaw).to_radians().cos() > 0.8 {
                            dmg *= 3.0;
                        }
                    }
                }
                hits.push((victim, dmg * combat::hitgroup_multiplier(group), group, Id::Knife, None));
            }
            if let Some(c) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == p.shooter) {
                c.state.loadout.knife_result(swing.stab, hit.is_some(), c.last_run as f64 * self.rate.tick() as f64);
            }
        }
        let tick = self.tick;
        let shooter_team = self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == p.shooter).map(|c| c.team);
        let ff = self.round.cfg.friendly_fire;
        let mut aimed = Vec::new();
        let mut dealt = Vec::new();
        for (victim, damage, group, weapon, at) in hits {
            let Some(c) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == victim) else { continue };
            if !c.vitals.alive() || (!ff && Some(c.team) == shooter_team) {
                continue;
            }
            if weapon != Id::Knife && Some(c.team) != shooter_team {
                aimed.push((victim, group == HitGroup::Head));
            }
            let (health, armor) = combat::bullet_damage(&c.vitals, damage, group, data::armor_factor(weapon), false);
            let stab = p.fired.swing.is_some_and(|s| s.stab);
            let sound = match group {
                _ if weapon == Id::Knife => if stab { HitSound::KnifeStab } else { HitSound::KnifeSlash },
                HitGroup::Head if c.vitals.helmet && c.vitals.armor > 0.0 => HitSound::Helmet,
                HitGroup::Head => HitSound::Headshot,
                HitGroup::LeftLeg | HitGroup::RightLeg => HitSound::Flesh,
                _ if c.vitals.armor > 0.0 => HitSound::Kevlar,
                _ => HitSound::Flesh,
            };
            // Slowdown and view kick (CS 1.6); the kick only where that part had no armor.
            let unarmored = match group {
                HitGroup::Head => !(c.vitals.helmet && c.vitals.armor > 0.0),
                _ => c.vitals.armor <= 0.0,
            };
            let roll = ((tick.wrapping_mul(2_654_435_761) ^ victim as u32) % 2001) as f32 / 1000.0 - 1.0;
            player::hit_by(&mut c.state, weapon, group, damage, unarmored, roll);
            c.anim.hurt(group, tick as f32 * self.rate.tick());
            if Some(c.team) != shooter_team {
                dealt.push((p.shooter, health.min(c.vitals.health)));
                c.stats.hurt_by.push((p.shooter, health.min(c.vitals.health)));
            }
            let killed = c.vitals.hurt(health, armor);
            self.events.push(GameEvent::Damage { attacker: p.shooter, victim, amount: health, group, sound, at });
            if killed {
                c.respawn_at = Some(tick + if c.bot { self.rate.secs(DUMMY_RESPAWN_SECS) } else { self.rate.secs(self.rules.respawn_secs) });
                self.events.push(GameEvent::Kill { killer: p.shooter, victim, weapon: Some(weapon), headshot: group == HitGroup::Head });
            }
        }
        self.note_damage(&dealt);
        // (A shotgun's pellets hitting one player count once.)
        aimed.dedup();
        for (_, head) in aimed {
            self.check_hit(p.shooter, head);
        }
        self.settle_deaths();
    }

    /// Health taken off enemies, for the scoreboard (ADR) and the round's MVP.
    fn note_damage(&mut self, dealt: &[(u8, f32)]) {
        for (by, amount) in dealt {
            if let Some(c) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == *by) {
                c.stats.damage += amount.round() as u32;
                c.stats.round_damage += amount.round() as u32;
            }
        }
    }

    /// Bookkeeping for kill events raised this tick: scores and dropped guns.
    pub(super) fn settle_deaths(&mut self) {
        let kills: Vec<(u8, u8, bool)> = self.events.iter().filter_map(|e| match e {
            GameEvent::Kill { killer, victim, headshot, .. } => Some((*killer, *victim, *headshot)),
            _ => None,
        }).collect();
        let respawns = self.respawns();
        for (killer, victim, headshot) in kills.into_iter().skip(self.kills_settled) {
            let team = |id: u8| self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == id).map(|c| c.team);
            let (killer_team, victim_team) = (team(killer), team(victim));
            let mut helpers = Vec::new();
            if let Some(v) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == victim) {
                v.deaths += 1;
                v.purchases.clear();
                if !respawns {
                    v.respawn_at = None; // wait for the next round
                }
                // CS2 assists: over 40 damage to them this life, by a teammate of the killer.
                let hurt = std::mem::take(&mut v.stats.hurt_by);
                for (by, _) in &hurt {
                    let total: f32 = hurt.iter().filter(|(b, _)| b == by).map(|(_, d)| d).sum();
                    if *by != killer && total > 40.0 && !helpers.contains(by) {
                        helpers.push(*by);
                    }
                }
            }
            for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| helpers.contains(&c.id) && Some(c.team) == killer_team) {
                c.stats.assists += 1;
            }
            if killer != victim && killer_team != victim_team {
                if let Some(k) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == killer) {
                    k.stats.round_kills += 1;
                    k.stats.headshots += headshot as u32;
                }
            }
            self.kill_money(killer, victim);
            self.drop_bomb(victim);
            if let Some(k) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == killer) {
                k.kills += if killer == victim { -1 } else { 1 };
            }
            self.kill_limit(killer);
            self.drop_on_death(victim);
            self.kills_settled += 1;
        }
    }

    /// Deathmatch: the first to the kill limit is announced, and everyone starts over.
    fn kill_limit(&mut self, killer: u8) {
        let limit = self.rules.kill_limit;
        if !self.rules.deathmatch || !self.clients.values().any(|c| c.id == killer && c.kills >= limit) {
            return;
        }
        self.events.push(GameEvent::KillLimit { player: killer });
        for c in self.clients.values_mut() {
            c.kills = 0;
            c.deaths = 0;
            c.stats = Stats { ping: c.stats.ping, ..Stats::default() };
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Telling the lobbies we're here (and whether we're busy), and finding them by name.
use super::*;

impl Server {
    /// Start looking up the lobbies' names (no-op when they're all addresses: parsed directly).
    pub(super) fn look_up_lobby(&mut self) {
        let list = self.round.cfg.lobby.clone();
        if list.split(',').all(|a| a.trim().is_empty() || a.trim().parse::<SocketAddr>().is_ok()) {
            return;
        }
        let (tx, rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
        std::thread::spawn(move || _ = tx.send(crate::config::addresses(&list, true)));
        self.lookup = Some(rx);
    }

    /// Announce this server to the lobby (if one is set), so it can be given matches.
    pub(super) fn heartbeat(&mut self) {
        let cfg = &self.round.cfg;
        if cfg.lobby.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        // A name (not an address): look it up again now and then, in the background.
        if let Some(found) = self.lookup.as_ref().and_then(|rx| rx.try_recv().ok()) {
            if !found.is_empty() {
                self.lobbies = found;
            }
            self.lookup = None;
        }
        if self.lookup.is_none() && self.tick % (60 * self.rate.hz()) < self.rate.secs(HEARTBEAT_SECS) {
            self.look_up_lobby();
        }
        let cfg = &self.round.cfg;
        let players = self.clients.values().filter(|c| !c.bot).count() as u8;
        let busy = self.reserved.is_some() || self.draining.is_some();
        let msg = crate::lobby::LobbyMsg::Heartbeat {
            name: cfg.name.clone(),
            map: self.map.clone(),
            players,
            max: cfg.max_players,
            region: cfg.region.clone(),
            busy,
            address: cfg.public_address.clone(),
            deathmatch: self.rules.deathmatch,
            maps: self.maps(),
        };
        // Sealed with the token's key (the token itself never goes out): only the lobby can
        // read it, and nobody can pretend to be us.
        if let Some(key) = &self.server_key {
            let sealed = key.seal(&encode(&msg));
            for lobby in self.lobbies.clone() {
                self.socket.send(lobby, sealed.clone());
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Changing maps: a booking names the map (the lobby picks it from the pool, or a custom
//! game's veto does), and the server loads it from its game files before the players come.
use super::*;

impl Server {
    /// Where the server finds maps (`maps/<name>.bsp` under this folder). Without it,
    /// it stays on the map it started with.
    pub fn set_game_dir(&mut self, dir: std::path::PathBuf) {
        self.maps = crate::config::pool_maps_in(&dir);
        if !self.maps.contains(&self.map) {
            self.maps.push(self.map.clone());
        }
        self.game_dir = Some(dir);
    }

    /// The pool maps this server can run (told to the lobby).
    pub(super) fn maps(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        if self.maps.is_empty() { vec![self.map.clone()] } else { self.maps.clone() }
    }

    /// Load another map: the world, its spawns, doors and breakables; everything lying around
    /// goes. Only between matches (nobody is in).
    pub(super) fn change_map(&mut self, name: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
        if name == self.map {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let dir = self.game_dir.clone().ok_or("no game files to load maps from")?;
        if !self.maps.iter().any(|m| m == name) {
            return Err(format!("{name} isn't on this server"));
        }
        let bsp = Bsp::load(dir.join(format!("maps/{name}.bsp"))).map_err(|e| format!("{name}: {e}"))?;
        let zones = sim::zones::Zones::from_bsp(&bsp);
        self.spawns_t = zones.spawns(sim::zones::Side::T);
        self.spawns_ct = zones.spawns(sim::zones::Side::Ct);
        self.world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
        self.pieces = breakables::Pieces::from_bsp(&bsp);
        self.map = name.to_string();
        self.map_hash = bsp.hash;
        self.history.clear();
        self.grenades.clear();
        self.smokes.clear();
        self.ground.clear();
        self.bomb = Bomb::None;
        self.last_seen.clear();
        self.sightings = Default::default();
        println!("map: {name}");
        Ok(())
    }
}
```

```rs
/// Inputs a client may bank while its packets are delayed. Anything sent faster
/// than real time beyond this is thrown away, which stops speed hacks.
const MAX_INPUT_BUDGET_SECS: f32 = 0.125;
/// Inputs left waiting after a tick that count as a backlog, and how many ticks in a row a
/// backlog may last before the oldest are dropped (else a burst after a client hitch, e.g.
/// loading the map, turns into permanent input lag: the budget only allows real time).
const BACKLOG_INPUTS: usize = 4;
const BACKLOG_SECS: f32 = 0.25;
/// Reliable events kept per client while unacknowledged.
const MAX_OUTBOX: usize = 64;


/// Dummies stay down a little longer so you see them fall.

/// Knife reach (slash / stab) and damage.
const SLASH_RANGE: f32 = 48.0;
const STAB_RANGE: f32 = 32.0;

/// A gun on the ground (dropped, or left by a dead player).
struct GroundGun {
    gun: sim::weapons::GunState,
    origin: [f32; 3],
    velocity: [f32; 3],
    /// Who dropped it, and until when they can't pick it straight back up.

/// Seconds before the dropper can pick their own gun back up.

/// A player's scoreboard numbers beyond kills and deaths.
#[derive(Default)]
struct Stats {
    assists: u32,
    mvps: u32,
    headshots: u32,
    damage: u32,
    rounds: u32,
    /// Milliseconds, smoothed.

    /// This life: health each enemy took off them (for assists).

struct Remote {
    /// Their aim this match, for the aim checks.
    aim: aimcheck::Aim,
    id: u8,
    name: String,
    team: Team,
    /// A practice dummy (no network connection; the server makes its inputs).
    bot: bool,

    deaths: u32,
    /// Scoreboard stats (see `Score`).
    stats: Stats,
    /// What they bought this round, oldest first (`buy::undo_buys` sells it back).
    purchases: Vec<buy::Purchase>,
    /// Their character on each side (`ClientMsg::Looks`); until they say, one picked by id.

    outbox: VecDeque<(u32, GameEvent)>,
    next_reliable: u32,

    /// go out as changes to that one.

}

/// Where everyone was at one tick (for lag compensation).
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct PastPositions {
    pub tick: u32,
    pub players: Vec<Target>,
}

/// A shot or swing waiting to be traced at the end of the input loop.
struct Pending {
    shooter: u8,
    eye: [f32; 3],
    yaw: f32,

pub struct Server {
    socket: Socket,
    map: String,
    map_hash: u64,
    world: World,
    assets: Assets,
    vars: MoveVars,
    clients: HashMap<SocketAddr, Remote>,
    /// Spawn points: T (`info_player_deathmatch`), CT (`info_player_start`).
    spawns_t: Vec<[f32; 3]>,
    spawns_ct: Vec<[f32; 3]>,
    rules: Rules,
    rate: crate::tick::TickRate,
    tick: u32,
    /// The last second of positions, newest last.
    history: VecDeque<PastPositions>,
    /// Happened since the last snapshot.
    events: Vec<GameEvent>,
    /// Extra weapons everyone spawns with (server option, for testing).
    give: Vec<Id>,
    grenades: Vec<sim::grenades::Grenade>,
    /// Smoke clouds: where and until when (server seconds).
    smokes: Vec<([f32; 3], f64)>,
    ground: Vec<GroundGun>,
    /// Kill events in `events` already counted (events are cleared at each snapshot).
    kills_settled: usize,
    round: Match,
    bomb: Bomb,
    /// Who planted this round's bomb (for the MVP).
    planter: Option<u8>,
    pieces: breakables::Pieces,
    guard: guard::Guard,
    /// Set while running a match for a fixed list of players.
    reserved: Option<reserve::Reserved>,
    /// Shutting down: no new matches (the lobby sees us busy), stop once the match is over.
    draining: Option<u32>,
    /// The lobbies' addresses (`master` in the config: one, or the active and standby ones,
    /// comma separated; names are looked up again every minute).
    lobbies: Vec<SocketAddr>,
    /// Name lookups running in the background (a slow DNS server must never stall the game).
    lookup: Option<std::sync::mpsc::Receiver<Vec<SocketAddr>>>,
    /// The key for talking to the lobby (from the official token, which is never sent).
    server_key: Option<crate::crypto::ServerKey>,
    /// When the last booking we took was sealed (older ones are replays).
    last_booking: u64,
    /// Enemies in sight of whom, since when (for the aim checks).
    sightings: aimcheck::Sightings,
    /// Where maps are loaded from, and the pool maps found there (see `maps`).
    game_dir: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
    maps: Vec<String>,
    /// The match being recorded (see `recording`).
    recorder: Option<crate::demo::Recorder>,
    /// Deathmatch seats the lobby handed out: ticket -> (key, when). Unused ones expire.
    seats: HashMap<u64, ([u8; 32], u32)>,
    /// A new player's channel, opened from their ticket's key while their join is checked.
    joining: Option<(SocketAddr, u64, crate::crypto::Channel)>,
    /// Size of the last snapshot sent (bandwidth checks).
    snapshot_bytes: usize,
    /// Anti-wallhack: when each (viewer, target) pair last had line of sight.
    last_seen: HashMap<(u8, u8), u32>,
}

impl Server {
    pub fn new(bind: SocketAddr, map: &str, bsp: &Bsp, assets: Assets) -> std::io::Result<Server> {
        let rate = crate::tick::TickRate::default();
        let zones = sim::zones::Zones::from_bsp(bsp);
        let (spawns_t, spawns_ct) = (zones.spawns(sim::zones::Side::T), zones.spawns(sim::zones::Side::Ct));
        Ok(Server {
            socket: Socket::bind(bind)?,
            map: map.to_string(),
            map_hash: bsp.hash,
            world: World::from_bsp(bsp),
            assets,
            vars: MoveVars::default(),
            clients: HashMap::new(),
            spawns_t,
            spawns_ct,
            rules: Rules::default(),
            tick: 0,
            history: VecDeque::new(),
            events: Vec::new(),
            give: Vec::new(),
            grenades: Vec::new(),
            smokes: Vec::new(),
            ground: Vec::new(),
            kills_settled: 0,
            round: Match::new(MatchConfig::default(), rate.hz()),
            rate,
            bomb: Bomb::None,
            planter: None,
            last_seen: HashMap::new(),
            pieces: breakables::Pieces::from_bsp(bsp),
            snapshot_bytes: 0,
            guard: guard::Guard::new(rate),
            reserved: None,
            draining: None,
            lobbies: Vec::new(),
            lookup: None,
            server_key: None,
            last_booking: 0,
            joining: None,
            seats: HashMap::new(),
            recorder: None,
            game_dir: None,
            maps: Vec::new(),
            sightings: Default::default(),
        })
    }

    /// How many steps a second this server runs (before it starts; clients follow it).
    pub fn set_rate(&mut self, rate: crate::tick::TickRate) {
        self.rate = rate;
        self.guard = guard::Guard::new(rate);
        self.round = Match::new(self.round.cfg.clone(), rate.hz());
    }

    /// Match settings (server config file). Restarts the match.
    pub fn set_config(&mut self, cfg: MatchConfig) {
        self.lobbies = crate::config::addresses(&cfg.lobby, false);
        self.server_key = (!cfg.official_token.is_empty()).then(|| crate::crypto::ServerKey::from_token(&cfg.official_token));
        if cfg.deathmatch {
            self.rules = Rules::deathmatch();
        }
        self.set_rate(cfg.tick_rate);
        self.round = Match::new(cfg, self.rate.hz());
        self.look_up_lobby();
    }

    /// An official server (it has the lobby's token): only booked players may join.
    fn official(&self) -> bool {
        !self.round.cfg.official_token.is_empty()
    }

    /// Weapons every player gets on (re)spawn, on top of the starting pistol.
    pub fn set_give(&mut self, weapons: Vec<Id>) {
        self.give = weapons;
    }

    pub fn tick_rate(&self) -> crate::tick::TickRate {
        self.rate
    }

    pub fn local_addr(&self) -> SocketAddr {
        self.socket.local_addr()
    }

    /// Practice room, dummies, respawn time and so on.
    pub fn set_rules(&mut self, rules: Rules) {
        self.rules = rules;
        self.clients.retain(|_, c| !c.bot);
        let dummies = if self.rules.practice { self.rules.dummies } else { 0 };
        for i in 0..dummies {
            let id = (0..=u8::MAX).find(|i| self.clients.values().all(|c| c.id != *i)).unwrap_or(0);
            let addr = SocketAddr::from(([0, 0, 0, 0], 60000 + i as u16)); // never sent to
            let mut r = Remote::new(id, format!("Dummy {}", i + 1), self.tick);
            r.bot = true;
            self.clients.insert(addr, r);
        }
        self.place_dummies();
    }

    /// Dummies go on the other side from the earliest-joined real player (T if nobody has picked).
    fn place_dummies(&mut self) {
        let human = self.clients.values().filter(|c| !c.bot && c.team != Team::Spectator).min_by_key(|c| c.id).map(|c| c.team);
        let side = if human == Some(Team::T) { Team::Ct } else { Team::T };
        let tick = self.tick;
        for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| c.bot && c.team != side) {
            c.team = side;
            c.vitals.health = 0.0;
            c.respawn_at = Some(tick);
        }
    }

    /// A free spawn point for the team (not on top of someone else).
    fn spawn_point(&self, team: Team) -> [f32; 3] {
        if self.rules.deathmatch {
            return self.deathmatch_spawn(team);
        }
        let list = if team == Team::Ct { &self.spawns_ct } else { &self.spawns_t };
        let taken = |p: &[f32; 3]| {
            self.clients.values().filter(|c| c.vitals.alive()).any(|c| {
                let o = c.state.movement.origin;
                (o[0] - p[0]).abs() < 40.0 && (o[1] - p[1]).abs() < 40.0 && (o[2] - p[2]).abs() < 80.0
            })
        };
        list.iter().find(|p| !taken(p)).or(list.first()).copied().unwrap_or([0.0; 3])
    }

    /// Deathmatch: any spawn point on the map, picked at random among the ones furthest from
    /// living enemies (nobody spawns in someone's sights, nobody can camp a spawn).
    fn deathmatch_spawn(&self, team: Team) -> [f32; 3] {
        let enemies: Vec<[f32; 3]> = self.clients.values().filter(|c| c.vitals.alive() && c.team != team && c.team != Team::Spectator).map(|c| c.state.movement.origin).collect();
        let mut all: Vec<([f32; 3], f32)> = self
            .spawns_t
            .iter()
            .chain(&self.spawns_ct)
            .filter(|p| !self.clients.values().any(|c| c.vitals.alive() && (0..3).map(|k| (c.state.movement.origin[k] - p[k]).powi(2)).sum::<f32>() < 64.0 * 64.0))
            .map(|p| (*p, enemies.iter().map(|e| (0..3).map(|k| (e[k] - p[k]).powi(2)).sum::<f32>()).fold(f32::MAX, f32::min)))
            .collect();
        all.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.total_cmp(&a.1));
        let pick = (crate::secure::random() % all.len().clamp(1, 4) as u64) as usize;
        all.get(pick).map(|(p, _)| *p).unwrap_or([0.0; 3])
    }

    /// CS starting weapons: T Glock + 40 rounds, CT USP + 24; dummies hold a rifle.
    fn spawn_state(&self, team: Team, bot: bool) -> PlayerState {
        let origin = self.spawn_point(team);
        let mut loadout = if team == Team::Ct { Loadout::spawn(Id::Usp, 24) } else { Loadout::spawn(Id::Glock, 40) };
        if bot {
            loadout.give(if team == Team::Ct { Id::M4a1 } else { Id::Ak47 }, 0.0);
        }
        for &w in &self.give {
            loadout.give(w, 0.0);
        }
        PlayerState { movement: Player::new(origin), loadout }
    }

    /// Everyone alive as a client saw them at `view_tick` (interpolated, like the
    /// client draws them), capped at `MAX_UNLAG_SECS` into the past.
    pub fn rewind(&self, view_tick: f32) -> Vec<Target> {
        let oldest = self.tick.saturating_sub(self.rate.secs(MAX_UNLAG_SECS)) as f32;
        let t = view_tick.clamp(oldest, self.tick as f32);
        // Only the ticks that went out as snapshots: that's exactly what clients blend between.
        let every = self.rate.snapshot_every();
        let sent: Vec<&PastPositions> = self.history.iter().filter(|h| h.tick % every == 0).collect();
        let pair = sent.iter().zip(sent.iter().skip(1)).find(|(a, b)| a.tick as f32 <= t && t <= b.tick as f32);
        let Some((a, b)) = pair else {
            return self.history.back().map(|h| h.players.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
        };
        let f = (t - a.tick as f32) / (b.tick - a.tick) as f32;
        b.players
            .iter()
            .map(|pb| match a.players.iter().find(|p| p.id == pb.id) {
                Some(pa) => Target { origin: std::array::from_fn(|i| pa.origin[i] + (pb.origin[i] - pa.origin[i]) * f), ..pb.clone() },
                None => pb.clone(),
            })
            .collect()
    }

    /// One server tick: read packets, run inputs, resolve shots, move doors, send snapshots.
    pub fn step(&mut self) {
        self.tick += 1;
        self.socket.tick();
        let tick = self.tick;
        self.read_packets();
        if tick % self.rate.hz() == 0 {
            self.guard.tidy(tick);
        }

        // Respawn the dead whose wait is over (spectators never do).
        let tick = self.tick;
        let due: Vec<(SocketAddr, Team, bool)> =
            self.clients.iter().filter(|(_, c)| c.team != Team::Spectator && c.respawn_at.is_some_and(|t| t <= tick)).map(|(a, c)| (*a, c.team, c.bot)).collect();
        for (addr, team, bot) in due {
            let state = self.spawn_state(team, bot);
            let c = self.clients.get_mut(&addr).unwrap();
            c.state = state;
            c.vitals = Vitals::default();
            c.respawn_at = None;
        }
        // Dummies "send" an input every tick: stand still.
        for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| c.bot) {
            let seq = c.last_queued + 1;
            c.queue.push_back((seq, TimedInput { input: sim::pmove::Input::default(), view_tick: tick as f32 }));
            c.last_queued = seq;
            c.last_heard = tick;
        }

        self.run_players();
        self.grenades_step();
        self.settle_deaths();
        self.ground_step();
        self.bomb_step();
        self.settle_deaths();
        self.round_step();

        // Positions as clients get them (1/8 unit, `PlayerNet`), so lag compensation rewinds to
        // exactly what they were shown.
        self.history.push_back(PastPositions {
            tick: self.tick,
            players: self
                .clients
                .values()
                .filter(|c| c.vitals.alive())
                .map(|c| {
                    let origin = c.state.movement.origin.map(|v| (v * 8.0).round() / 8.0);
                    let anim = Some((c.anim.clone(), c.drive(), self.tick as f32 * self.rate.tick()));
                    Target { id: c.id, origin, yaw: c.view.0, pitch: c.view.1, crouched: c.state.movement.crouched, weapon: c.state.loadout.active_id(), anim }
                })
                .collect(),
        });
        while self.history.len() > self.rate.hz() as usize {
            self.history.pop_front();
        }

        let tick = self.tick;
        let timeout = self.rate.secs(TIMEOUT_SECS);
        let gone: Vec<SocketAddr> = self.clients.iter().filter(|(_, c)| !c.bot && tick - c.last_heard >= timeout).map(|(a, _)| *a).collect();
        for a in gone {
            if let Some(c) = self.clients.remove(&a) {
                self.remember(&c);
            }
        }
        let ids: std::collections::HashSet<u8> = self.clients.values().map(|c| c.id).collect();
        self.last_seen.retain(|(v, t), _| ids.contains(v) && ids.contains(t));

        self.send_updates();
    }

}

impl Remote {
    /// What drives their animation now.
    fn drive(&self) -> sim::anim::Drive {
        let m = &self.state.movement;
        sim::anim::Drive {
            origin: m.origin,
            yaw: self.view.0,
            pitch: self.view.1,
            crouched: m.crouched,
            airborne: !m.on_ground && !m.on_ladder,
            reloading: self.state.loadout.active_gun().is_some_and(|g| g.reloading),
            weapon: self.state.loadout.active_id(),
        }
    }

    /// Their scoreboard line (money included: `send_updates` hides it from the other team).
    fn score(&self) -> Score {
        let s = &self.stats;
        Score {
            id: self.id,
            name: self.name.clone(),
            kills: self.kills,
            deaths: self.deaths,
            alive: self.vitals.alive(),
            team: self.team,
            bot: self.bot,
            assists: s.assists,
            mvps: s.mvps,
            headshots: s.headshots,
            damage: s.damage,
            rounds: s.rounds,
            ping: s.ping.round() as u16,
            money: Some(self.money),
            looks: self.looks,
        }
    }

    /// A newly connected player: spectating until they pick a side.
    fn new(id: u8, name: String, tick: u32) -> Remote {
        Remote {
            aim: Default::default(),
            id,
            name,
            team: Team::Spectator,
            bot: false,
            kills: 0,
            deaths: 0,
            stats: Stats::default(),
            anim: sim::anim::Anim::new(0.0),
            looks: [id % CLASSES; 2],
            purchases: Vec::new(),
            money: 0,
            defuse_kit: false,
            ticket: 0,
            group: None,
            outbox: VecDeque::new(),
            next_reliable: 0,
            sent: VecDeque::new(),
            snap_ack: 0,
            blind: None,
            state: PlayerState { movement: Player::new([0.0; 3]), loadout: Loadout::knife_only() },
            vitals: Vitals { health: 0.0, ..Vitals::default() },
            respawn_at: None,
            queue: VecDeque::new(),
            last_queued: 0,
            last_run: 0,
            budget: 0.0,
            backlog: 0,
            last_heard: tick,
            use_held: false,
            used: false,
            view: (0.0, 0.0),
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn actor(p: &Player, (yaw, pitch): (f32, f32), using: bool) -> Actor {
    let h = p.hull();
    let (sy, cy) = yaw.to_radians().sin_cos();
    let (sp, cp) = pitch.to_radians().sin_cos();
    Actor {
        mins: [p.origin[0] + h.mins()[0], p.origin[1] + h.mins()[1], p.origin[2] + h.mins()[2]],
        maxs: [p.origin[0] + h.maxs()[0], p.origin[1] + h.maxs()[1], p.origin[2] + h.maxs()[2]],
        eye: p.eye(),
        forward: [cp * cy, cp * sy, -sp],
        using,
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/packets.rs`:

```rs
//! Reading what arrived: the lobby's sealed bookings, then (within each address's budget)
//! players' packets, encrypted on official servers, handed to `handle`.
use super::*;

impl Server {
    pub(super) fn read_packets(&mut self) {
        let tick = self.tick;
        for (from, bytes) in self.socket.recv_all() {
            // The lobby's bookings have their own way in, so strangers can't crowd them out
            // (its address can be faked; the key it seals them with can't).
            if bytes.first() == Some(&crate::crypto::SERVER) {
                if self.lobbies.contains(&from) && bytes.len() <= guard::MAX_PACKET {
                    self.booking(&bytes);
                }
                continue;
            }
            // Budget first: floods and junk cost nothing past this line.
            let players = if self.clients.contains_key(&from) { self.clients.keys().filter(|a| a.ip() == from.ip()).count() } else { 0 };
            if !self.guard.allow(from, bytes.len(), players, tick) {
                continue;
            }
            let plain = if bytes.first() == Some(&crate::crypto::CHANNEL) {
                match self.unseal(from, &bytes) {
                    Some(p) => p,
                    None => continue,
                }
            } else if self.official() {
                // Official servers talk encrypted only; in the clear: just region pings.
                if let Some(msg @ ClientMsg::Info { .. }) = decode::<ClientMsg>(&bytes) {
                    self.handle(from, msg);
                }
                continue;
            } else {
                bytes
            };
            if let Some(msg) = decode::<ClientMsg>(&plain) {
                self.handle(from, msg);
            }
            self.joining = None;
        }
        if tick % self.rate.hz() == 0 {
            let clients: std::collections::HashSet<SocketAddr> = self.clients.keys().copied().collect();
            self.socket.keep_channels(|a| clients.contains(a));
            // Deathmatch seats: kept while their player is here, else for a minute.
            let here: std::collections::HashSet<u64> = self.clients.values().map(|c| c.ticket).collect();
            self.seats.retain(|t, (_, at)| here.contains(t) || tick - *at < 60 * self.rate.hz());
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/players.rs`:

```rs
//! Each tick, every player's queued inputs: movement, weapons (shots and knife swings to
//! resolve, bombs planted or dropped), within the speed-hack budget; then the world (doors)
//! moves with them.
use super::*;

impl Server {
    pub(super) fn run_players(&mut self) {
        let tick = self.tick;
        let mut actors = Vec::new();
        let mut pending = Vec::new();
        let mut planted = Vec::new();
        let mut bomb_drops = Vec::new();
        let limits: HashMap<u8, sim::player::Limits> = self.clients.values().map(|c| (c.id, self.limits(c.id))).collect();
        for c in self.clients.values_mut() {
            c.budget = (c.budget + 1.0).min(self.rate.secs(MAX_INPUT_BUDGET_SECS) as f32);
            c.used = false;
            while c.budget >= 1.0 {
                let Some((seq, TimedInput { input, view_tick })) = c.queue.pop_front() else { break };
                c.budget -= 1.0;
                c.used |= input.use_key && !c.use_held;
                c.use_held = input.use_key;
                c.view = (input.yaw, input.pitch);
                c.aim.look(input.yaw, input.pitch);
                c.last_run = seq;
                if !c.vitals.alive() {
                    continue; // the dead don't move (their inputs are still acknowledged)
                }
                let cmd_time = seq as f64 * self.rate.tick() as f64;
                let (ev, fired) = player::step(&mut c.state, &input, self.rate.tick(), cmd_time, player::seed(c.id, seq), limits[&c.id], &self.world, &self.vars);
                if fired.planted {
                    planted.push((c.id, c.state.movement.origin));
                }
                if input.drop && c.state.loadout.active == data::Slot::Bomb && c.state.loadout.c4 {
                    bomb_drops.push(c.id);
                }
                if let Some(step) = ev.footstep {
                    self.events.push(GameEvent::Footstep { player: c.id, at: c.state.movement.origin, step });
                }
                if ev.fall_damage > 0.0 && c.vitals.hurt(ev.fall_damage, 0.0) {
                    c.respawn_at = Some(tick + if c.bot { self.rate.secs(DUMMY_RESPAWN_SECS) } else { self.rate.secs(self.rules.respawn_secs) });
                    self.events.push(GameEvent::Kill { killer: c.id, victim: c.id, weapon: None, headshot: false });
                }
                if let Some(gun) = fired.dropped {
                    let (f, _, _) = bullets::view_vectors(input.pitch, input.yaw);
                    let eye = c.state.movement.eye();
                    let v = c.state.movement.velocity;
                    self.ground.push(GroundGun {
                        gun,
                        origin: eye,
                        velocity: std::array::from_fn(|i| f[i] * 400.0 + v[i]),
                        dropper: c.id,
                        dropper_wait_until: tick + self.rate.secs(REPICK_SECS),
                    });
                }
                if !fired.shots.is_empty() || fired.swing.is_some() {
                    c.anim.shot(tick as f32 * self.rate.tick());
                }
                if !fired.shots.is_empty() || fired.swing.is_some() || fired.throw.is_some() {
                    pending.push(Pending { shooter: c.id, eye: c.state.movement.eye(), yaw: input.yaw, velocity: c.state.movement.velocity, fired, view_tick });
                }
            }
            c.backlog = if c.queue.len() > BACKLOG_INPUTS { c.backlog + 1 } else { 0 };
            if c.backlog > self.rate.secs(BACKLOG_SECS) {
                // Stale movement: skip it (the client's prediction corrects once).
                while c.queue.len() > 1 {
                    c.queue.pop_front();
                }
                c.backlog = 0;
            }
            if c.vitals.alive() {
                actors.push(actor(&c.state.movement, c.view, c.used));
            }
        }
        // Players are solid to each other; bots hold their ground and the humans are pushed out.
        let hull = |m: &sim::pmove::Player| if m.crouched { sim::collision::Hull::Crouched } else { sim::collision::Hull::Standing };
        let boxes: Vec<(u8, [f32; 3], sim::collision::Hull)> = self.clients.values().filter(|c| c.vitals.alive() && c.team != Team::Spectator).map(|c| (c.id, c.state.movement.origin, hull(&c.state.movement))).collect();
        for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| c.vitals.alive() && c.team != Team::Spectator && !c.bot) {
            let others: Vec<_> = boxes.iter().filter(|b| b.0 != c.id).map(|b| (b.1, b.2)).collect();
            c.state.movement.origin = sim::crowd::push_out(&self.world, hull(&c.state.movement), c.state.movement.origin, &others);
        }
        for p in pending {
            self.resolve(p);
        }
        for (id, at) in planted {
            self.bomb_planted(id, at);
        }
        for id in bomb_drops {
            self.drop_bomb(id);
        }
        if self.rules.infinite_ammo {
            for c in self.clients.values_mut() {
                c.state.loadout.refill_ammo(true);
                c.state.loadout.refill_ammo(false);
            }
        }
        self.world.update(self.rate.tick(), &actors);
        // Animate everyone as clients draw them (their hitboxes follow it).
        let now = tick as f32 * self.rate.tick();
        let model = self.assets.hitboxes.model().clone();
        for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| c.vitals.alive()) {
            let d = c.drive();
            c.anim.step(&model, &d, now, self.rate.tick());
        }
        for name in self.world.doors.take_fired() {
            self.events.push(GameEvent::Fired { name });
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/recording.rs`:

```rs
//! Recording booked matches (see `demo`): started with the match, a frame per snapshot with
//! the whole truth, closed at the end. Reports point at the recording and the moment.
use super::*;

/// The scoreboard goes into the recording this often (in snapshots: once a second).
const SCORES_EVERY: u32 = crate::tick::SNAPSHOT_RATE;

impl Server {
    /// Start recording this match (if recordings are on: `demos` in the config).
    pub(super) fn start_recording(&mut self) {
        let cfg = &self.round.cfg;
        if cfg.demos.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(&cfg.demos);
        crate::demo::prune(&dir, cfg.demo_days as u64);
        match crate::demo::Recorder::start(&dir, &self.map, self.map_hash, &cfg.name, self.rate) {
            Ok(r) => self.recorder = Some(r),
            Err(e) => println!("can't record to {}: {e}", dir.display()),
        }
    }

    pub(super) fn stop_recording(&mut self) {
        if let Some(r) = self.recorder.take() {
            match r.finish() {
                Ok(path) => println!("match recorded: {}", path.display()),
                Err(e) => println!("recording failed at the end: {e}"),
            }
        }
    }

    /// The recording's name and the tick now (for reports), if recording.
    pub(super) fn recording_now(&self) -> (String, u32) {
        (self.recorder.as_ref().map(|r| r.name()).unwrap_or_default(), self.tick)
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub(super) fn record(&mut self, players: &[PlayerNet], events: &[GameEvent], doors: &[sim::doors::DoorNet], broken: &[u16], grenades: &[(sim::grenades::Kind, [f32; 3])], smokes: &[SmokeNet], ground: &[(Id, [f32; 3])], round: &RoundNet) {
        if self.recorder.is_none() {
            return;
        }
        let scores = (self.tick / self.rate.snapshot_every() % SCORES_EVERY == 0).then(|| {
            self.clients.values().filter(|c| !c.bot).map(|c| c.score()).collect()
        });
        let frame = crate::demo::Frame {
            tick: self.tick,
            players: players.to_vec(),
            health: self.clients.values().map(|c| (c.id, c.vitals.health.clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8)).collect(),
            events: events.to_vec(),
            doors: doors.to_vec(),
            broken: broken.to_vec(),
            grenades: grenades.to_vec(),
            smokes: smokes.to_vec(),
            ground: ground.to_vec(),
            round: *round,
            bomb: self.bomb_net(Team::T),
            scores,
        };
        if let Err(e) = self.recorder.as_mut().unwrap().frame(&frame) {
            println!("recording stopped: {e}");
            self.recorder = None;
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/report.rs`:

```rs
//! Player reports in a reserved match: checked here (both in this match, not yourself, once
//! per player, a few per match) and passed to the lobby, which knows who everyone is (their
//! Steam ids) and files them for review.
use super::*;
use crate::protocol::ReportReason;

/// Reports one player may make in a match.
const MAX_REPORTS: usize = 5;

impl Server {
    pub(super) fn report(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, player: u8, reason: ReportReason) {
        let Some(reporter) = self.clients.get(&from).map(|c| c.ticket) else { return };
        let Some(target) = self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == player).map(|c| c.ticket) else { return };
        let Some(r) = &mut self.reserved else { return };
        let mine = r.reports.iter().filter(|(by, _)| *by == reporter).count();
        if reporter == 0 || target == 0 || reporter == target || mine >= MAX_REPORTS || r.reports.contains(&(reporter, target)) {
            return;
        }
        r.reports.push((reporter, target));
        let Some(key) = &self.server_key else { return };
        let (demo, tick) = self.recording_now();
        let msg = crate::lobby::LobbyMsg::Report { reporter, target, reason, map: self.map.clone(), round: self.round.round, demo, tick };
        let sealed = key.seal(&encode(&msg));
        // To every lobby: only the active one files it.
        for lobby in self.lobbies.clone() {
            self.socket.send(lobby, sealed.clone());
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/reserve.rs`:

```rs
//! Reserved matches: the server runs one match for a known list of players (from the
//! matchmaker or a custom game), each with a ticket and a group (team A or B). Nobody else can
//! join; a player who drops can come back to their own match. Custom games start with a knife
//! round whose winners vote to stay or switch sides.
use super::*;
use crate::rounds::Phase;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

/// The two teams of a match before sides are known.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Group {
    A,
    B,
}

/// What the matchmaker (or a custom game's host) sets up.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Default)]
pub struct MatchSetup {
    /// Each player's ticket (their seat's number) and group.
    pub players: Vec<(u64, Group)>,
    /// Knife round first, winners pick sides (custom games). Otherwise A starts as T.
    pub knife_round: bool,
    /// The map to play (empty: the one the server is on).
    pub map: String,
    /// Each ticket's encryption key (official servers: a player proves their seat by
    /// encrypting with it; the key itself never crosses the network in the clear).
    pub keys: Vec<(u64, [u8; 32])>,
}

/// How long to wait for everyone before starting with whoever came, and for the side vote.
const WAIT_SECONDS: u32 = 90;
const VOTE_SECONDS: u32 = 15;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum Knife {
    /// Not started yet (waiting for players).
    Pending,
    /// The knife round is being played.
    Fighting,
    /// Winners vote until this tick.
    Vote { winners: Team, until: u32 },
    /// Over (or there is none): the real match.
    Done,
}

pub(super) struct Reserved {
    pub(super) setup: MatchSetup,
    pub(super) knife: Knife,
    since: u32,
    /// Last tick a player of the match was connected.
    last_seen: u32,
    /// Winners' votes: player id -> switch sides?
    votes: HashMap<u8, bool>,
    /// What a player had when they left, for when they come back: money, kills, deaths.
    saved: HashMap<u64, (i32, i32, u32)>,
    /// The side group A is on now (B is the other); flips at every side swap.
    pub(super) a_side: Team,
    /// Tickets of players who left, and when (they're back when they reconnect).
    pub(super) left_at: HashMap<u64, u32>,
    /// A surrender vote running, and the round each team (T, CT) last called one.
    pub(super) vote: Option<super::surrender::Vote>,
    pub(super) voted_in_round: [Option<u32>; 2],
    /// Since when a side has had nobody connected (the match is paused).
    pub(super) empty_since: Option<u32>,
    /// Reports made in this match: (reporter's ticket, reported player's ticket).
    pub(super) reports: Vec<(u64, u64)>,
    /// Who won the match (None until it's over, or a draw).
    pub(super) winner: Option<Team>,
    /// Seats voted out (they can't come back), and the round each player last called a kick.
    pub(super) kicked: Vec<u64>,
    pub(super) kick_called: HashMap<u8, u32>,
}

impl Server {
    /// Run a match for exactly these players (clears the server).
    pub fn reserve(&mut self, setup: MatchSetup) {
        self.clients.retain(|_, c| c.bot);
        let knife = if setup.knife_round { Knife::Pending } else { Knife::Done };
        self.reserved = Some(Reserved { setup, knife, since: self.tick, last_seen: self.tick, votes: HashMap::new(), saved: HashMap::new(), a_side: Team::T, left_at: HashMap::new(), vote: None, voted_in_round: [None; 2], empty_since: None, reports: Vec::new(), winner: None, kicked: Vec::new(), kick_called: HashMap::new() });
        self.round = crate::rounds::Match::new(self.round.cfg.clone(), self.rate.hz());
        self.start_recording();
    }

    /// The team a group plays on now: A starts T, B CT, and they swap with every side swap.
    pub(super) fn team_for(&self, group: Group) -> Team {
        let a = self.reserved.as_ref().map(|r| r.a_side).unwrap_or(Team::T);
        if group == Group::A {
            a
        } else {
            crate::rounds::other(a)
        }
    }

    /// Who may join a reserved server: Err(reason) for anyone without a ticket.
    pub(super) fn admit(&mut self, ticket: u64) -> Result<Option<(Group, Team, Option<(i32, i32, u32)>)>, String> {
        let Some(r) = &self.reserved else {
            // Deathmatch: anyone the lobby gave a seat.
            if self.official() && !(self.rules.deathmatch && self.seats.contains_key(&ticket)) {
                return Err("Matches here come from the lobby: use Play in the game.".into());
            }
            return Ok(None);
        };
        let Some(&(_, group)) = r.setup.players.iter().find(|(t, _)| *t == ticket && ticket != 0) else {
            return Err("This server is playing a match.".into());
        };
        if r.kicked.contains(&ticket) {
            return Err("Your team voted you out of this match.".into());
        }
        if self.clients.values().any(|c| c.ticket == ticket) {
            return Err("You're already in this match.".into());
        }
        let saved = self.reserved.as_mut().and_then(|r| r.saved.remove(&ticket));
        if let Some(r) = &mut self.reserved {
            r.left_at.remove(&ticket);
        }
        Ok(Some((group, self.team_for(group), saved)))
    }

    /// Running a match (busy for the lobby).
    pub fn is_reserved(&self) -> bool {
        self.reserved.is_some()
    }

    /// A ticket holder left: keep their money and score for when they reconnect.
    pub(super) fn remember(&mut self, c: &Remote) {
        if let Some(r) = &mut self.reserved {
            if c.ticket != 0 {
                r.saved.insert(c.ticket, (c.money, c.kills, c.deaths));
                r.left_at.insert(c.ticket, self.tick);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Before the first round: wait for everyone (or a while), then knife round or round 1.
    /// True while this handles the round flow (the normal flow must not run).
    pub(super) fn reserved_step(&mut self) -> bool {
        let tick = self.tick;
        let here = self.clients.values().filter(|c| c.ticket != 0).count();
        let Some(r) = &mut self.reserved else { return false };
        // Nobody from the match here for a while (never came, or all left): free the server.
        if here > 0 {
            r.last_seen = tick;
        } else if tick - r.last_seen > WAIT_SECONDS * self.rate.hz() {
            self.finish_reserved();
            return false;
        }
        let r = self.reserved.as_ref().unwrap();
        let expected = r.setup.players.len();
        let waited = tick - r.since > WAIT_SECONDS * self.rate.hz();
        match r.knife {
            Knife::Pending if self.round.phase == Phase::Warmup => {
                if here >= expected || (waited && here > 0) {
                    self.start_knife_round();
                }
                true
            }
            Knife::Done if self.round.phase == Phase::Warmup => {
                // Matchmade: start when everyone is in (the normal flow does the rest).
                !(here >= expected || (waited && here > 0))
            }
            Knife::Fighting => {
                let (t, ct) = (self.alive(Team::T), self.alive(Team::Ct));
                let over = tick >= self.round.phase_end && self.round.phase == Phase::Live;
                if self.round.phase == Phase::Freeze && tick >= self.round.phase_end {
                    self.round.go_live(tick);
                } else if self.round.phase == Phase::Live && (t == 0 || ct == 0 || over) {
                    // Time up: whoever has more standing (a tie goes to the terrorists).
                    let winners = if t == 0 { Team::Ct } else if ct == 0 || t >= ct { Team::T } else { Team::Ct };
                    self.events.push(GameEvent::KnifeWon { winners });
                    let until = tick + VOTE_SECONDS * self.rate.hz();
                    self.round.phase = Phase::Over;
                    self.round.phase_end = until;
                    let r = self.reserved.as_mut().unwrap();
                    r.knife = Knife::Vote { winners, until };
                    r.votes.clear();
                }
                true
            }
            Knife::Vote { winners, until } => {
                let voters = self.clients.values().filter(|c| c.team == winners && !c.bot).count();
                let r = self.reserved.as_ref().unwrap();
                let switch = r.votes.values().filter(|s| **s).count();
                if tick >= until || r.votes.len() >= voters {
                    // Majority to switch, else stay.
                    let swap = switch * 2 > r.votes.len().max(1);
                    self.reserved.as_mut().unwrap().knife = Knife::Done;
                    self.events.push(GameEvent::SidesChosen { switched: swap });
                    self.round.start(tick);
                    self.new_round(swap, Some(self.round.cfg.start_money));
                }
                true
            }
            _ => false,
        }
    }

    /// Everyone out with only a knife, no buying, no bomb.
    fn start_knife_round(&mut self) {
        let tick = self.tick;
        self.round.phase = Phase::Freeze;
        self.round.round = 0;
        self.round.phase_end = tick + 3 * self.rate.hz();
        self.round.buy_end = 0;
        self.reserved.as_mut().unwrap().knife = Knife::Fighting;
        self.new_round(false, Some(0));
        for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| c.team != Team::Spectator) {
            c.state.loadout = sim::weapons::Loadout::knife_only();
            c.defuse_kit = false;
            c.vitals.armor = 0.0;
        }
        self.bomb = Bomb::None;
    }

    /// A vote from the knife round's winners.
    pub(super) fn side_vote(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, switch: bool) {
        let Some(c) = self.clients.get(&from) else { return };
        let (id, team) = (c.id, c.team);
        if let Some(r) = &mut self.reserved {
            if let Knife::Vote { winners, .. } = r.knife {
                if team == winners {
                    r.votes.insert(id, switch);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// The match is over: tell everyone, and free the server for the next one.
    pub(super) fn finish_reserved(&mut self) {
        let Some(r) = self.reserved.take() else { return };
        self.stop_recording();
        // Tell the lobby how it went (for the hidden skill ratings and abandon cooldowns).
        let a = r.a_side;
        let team_of = |g: Group| if g == Group::A { a } else { crate::rounds::other(a) };
        let (mut winners, mut losers) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
        if let Some(w) = r.winner {
            for (ticket, g) in &r.setup.players {
                if team_of(*g) == w { winners.push(*ticket) } else { losers.push(*ticket) }
            }
        }
        // Still gone at the end (they never came back): abandoned.
        // (Voted out isn't abandoning: no cooldown for them.)
        let abandoned: Vec<u64> = r.left_at.keys().filter(|t| !r.kicked.contains(t)).copied().collect();
        if let Some(key) = &self.server_key {
            let sealed = key.seal(&encode(&crate::lobby::LobbyMsg::Result { winners, losers, abandoned }));
            for lobby in self.lobbies.clone() {
                self.socket.send(lobby, sealed.clone());
            }
        }
        let addrs: Vec<SocketAddr> = self.clients.iter().filter(|(_, c)| !c.bot).map(|(a, _)| *a).collect();
        for a in addrs {
            self.socket.send(a, encode(&ServerMsg::MatchEnded));
        }
        self.clients.retain(|_, c| c.bot);
        self.round = crate::rounds::Match::new(self.round.cfg.clone(), self.rate.hz());
    }

    /// The knife round / side vote, for the HUD.
    pub(super) fn stage(&self) -> Stage {
        match self.reserved.as_ref().map(|r| r.knife) {
            Some(Knife::Pending) => Stage::Waiting,
            Some(Knife::Fighting) => Stage::Knife,
            Some(Knife::Vote { winners, until }) => Stage::SideVote { winners, left: until.saturating_sub(self.tick) as f32 * self.rate.tick() },
            _ => Stage::Match,
        }
    }
}
```
