`net/src/server/round.rs`:

```rs
//! Running the match on the server: what `rounds::Match` decides, applied to the players
//! (spawning, money, side swaps, who wins a round).
use super::*;
use crate::rounds::{side, EndReason, Next, Phase};

/// Kill rewards (docs/RULES.md 3.4).
const KILL_REWARD: i32 = 300;
const TEAMKILL_PENALTY: i32 = 3300;

impl Server {
    /// No rounds in the practice room.
    pub(super) fn rounds_on(&self) -> bool {
        !self.rules.free_play()
    }

    /// What the round phase allows everyone (plus the defuser can't move).
    pub(super) fn limits(&self, id: u8) -> sim::player::Limits {
        let freeze = self.rounds_on() && self.round.phase == Phase::Freeze;
        let over = self.rounds_on() && self.round.phase == Phase::GameOver;
        sim::player::Limits { frozen: freeze || over || self.defuser() == Some(id), no_attack: freeze || over }
    }

    /// Whether dead players come back by themselves (practice and warmup) or wait for the next round.
    pub(super) fn respawns(&self) -> bool {
        !self.rounds_on() || self.round.phase == Phase::Warmup
    }

    fn team_size(&self, team: Team) -> usize {
        self.clients.values().filter(|c| c.team == team).count()
    }

    pub(super) fn alive(&self, team: Team) -> usize {
        self.clients.values().filter(|c| c.team == team && c.vitals.alive()).count()
    }

    /// Once a tick: phase changes and round wins.
    pub(super) fn round_step(&mut self) {
        if !self.rounds_on() || self.surrender_step() || self.reserved_step() {
            return;
        }
        let tick = self.tick;
        let both = self.team_size(Team::T) > 0 && self.team_size(Team::Ct) > 0;
        match self.round.phase {
            Phase::Warmup => {
                if both {
                    self.round.start(tick);
                    self.new_round(false, Some(self.round.cfg.start_money));
                }
            }
            _ if !both => {
                // A side emptied: wait for players again.
                self.round = crate::rounds::Match::new(self.round.cfg.clone(), self.rate.hz());
                self.bomb = Bomb::None;
                for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| c.team != Team::Spectator && !c.vitals.alive()) {
                    c.respawn_at = Some(tick);
                }
            }
            Phase::Freeze => {
                if tick >= self.round.phase_end {
                    self.round.go_live(tick);
                }
            }
            Phase::Live => {
                let planted = matches!(self.bomb, Bomb::Planted { .. });
                if self.alive(Team::Ct) == 0 {
                    self.end_round(Team::T, EndReason::Eliminated);
                } else if self.alive(Team::T) == 0 && !planted {
                    self.end_round(Team::Ct, EndReason::Eliminated);
                } else if tick >= self.round.phase_end && !planted {
                    self.end_round(Team::Ct, EndReason::TimeUp);
                }
            }
            Phase::Over => {
                if tick >= self.round.phase_end {
                    match self.round.next(tick) {
                        Next::Round { swap, money } => self.new_round(swap, money),
                        Next::GameOver(winner) => {
                            if let Some(r) = &mut self.reserved {
                                r.winner = winner;
                            }
                            self.events.push(GameEvent::MatchOver { winner })
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Phase::GameOver => {
                if tick >= self.round.phase_end && self.reserved.is_some() {
                    self.finish_reserved();
                } else if tick >= self.round.phase_end {
                    self.round.start(tick);
                    for c in self.clients.values_mut() {
                        c.kills = 0;
                        c.deaths = 0;
                    }
                    self.new_round(false, Some(self.round.cfg.start_money));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Decide the round and pay both teams.
    pub(super) fn end_round(&mut self, winner: Team, reason: EndReason) {
        let pay = self.round.end_round(self.tick, winner, reason);
        let max = self.round.cfg.max_money;
        for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| c.team != Team::Spectator) {
            // Time ran out: Ts still alive (who didn't plant) get nothing (CS 1.6
            // `MarkLivingPlayersOnTeamAsNotReceivingMoneyNextRound` after `#Target_Saved`).
            if reason == EndReason::TimeUp && c.team == Team::T && c.vitals.alive() {
                continue;
            }
            c.money = (c.money + pay[side(c.team)]).min(max);
        }
        self.events.push(GameEvent::RoundEnd { winner, reason });
        // The round's MVP (CS2): the defuser, the planter whose bomb went off, else the
        // winner with the most kills (then damage) this round.
        let defuser = self.events.iter().rev().find_map(|e| match e {
            GameEvent::BombDefused { by } => Some(*by),
            _ => None,
        });
        let mvp = match reason {
            EndReason::BombDefused => defuser,
            EndReason::BombExploded => self.planter,
            _ => None,
        }
        .or_else(|| {
            self.clients.values().filter(|c| c.team == winner && c.stats.round_kills > 0).max_by_key(|c| (c.stats.round_kills, c.stats.round_damage, std::cmp::Reverse(c.id))).map(|c| c.id)
        });
        for c in self.clients.values_mut().filter(|c| matches!(c.team, Team::T | Team::Ct)) {
            c.stats.rounds += 1;
            c.stats.mvps += (Some(c.id) == mvp) as u32;
        }
    }

    /// Freeze time: everyone back to their spawn. Survivors keep their weapons and armor;
    /// the dead start over with a pistol. `money`: halftime/overtime reset (weapons go too).
    pub(super) fn new_round(&mut self, swap: bool, money: Option<i32>) {
        if swap {
            if let Some(r) = &mut self.reserved {
                r.a_side = crate::rounds::other(r.a_side);
            }
            for c in self.clients.values_mut() {
                c.team = match c.team {
                    Team::T => Team::Ct,
                    Team::Ct => Team::T,
                    s => s,
                };
            }
            self.events.push(GameEvent::SidesSwapped);
        }
        self.planter = None;
        for c in self.clients.values_mut() {
            c.stats.round_kills = 0;
            c.stats.round_damage = 0;
            c.purchases.clear(); // a new round: last round's buys are yours for good
        }
        self.ground.clear();
        self.grenades.clear();
        self.smokes.clear();
        self.restore_pieces();
        let mut ids: Vec<(SocketAddr, u8)> = self.clients.iter().filter(|(_, c)| c.team != Team::Spectator).map(|(a, c)| (*a, c.id)).collect();
        ids.sort_by_key(|(_, id)| *id); // spawn points handed out in a fixed order
        for (addr, _) in ids {
            let (team, bot, keep) = {
                let c = &self.clients[&addr];
                (c.team, c.bot, c.vitals.alive() && money.is_none() && !swap)
            };
            // Everyone is "dead" while spawn points are picked, so nobody blocks their own.
            self.clients.get_mut(&addr).unwrap().vitals.health = 0.0;
            let fresh = self.spawn_state(team, bot);
            let c = self.clients.get_mut(&addr).unwrap();
            let armor = (c.vitals.armor, c.vitals.helmet);
            if keep {
                c.state.movement = fresh.movement;
                c.state.loadout.c4 = false;
                c.state.loadout.planting = None;
            } else {
                c.state = fresh;
                c.defuse_kit = false;
            }
            c.vitals = Vitals::default();
            if keep {
                (c.vitals.armor, c.vitals.helmet) = armor;
            }
            if let Some(m) = money {
                c.money = m;
            }
            // Ammo isn't bought: every round starts with full reserves.
            c.state.loadout.refill_ammo(true);
            c.state.loadout.refill_ammo(false);
            c.respawn_at = None;
        }
        self.give_bomb();
        self.events.push(GameEvent::RoundStart { round: self.round.round });
    }

    /// Money for kills (not in practice).
    pub(super) fn kill_money(&mut self, killer: u8, victim: u8) {
        if !self.rounds_on() || killer == victim || self.round.phase == Phase::Warmup {
            return;
        }
        let team = |id: u8| self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == id).map(|c| c.team);
        let (kt, vt) = (team(killer), team(victim));
        let max = self.round.cfg.max_money;
        if let Some(k) = self.clients.values_mut().find(|c| c.id == killer) {
            k.money = if kt == vt { (k.money - TEAMKILL_PENALTY).max(0) } else { (k.money + KILL_REWARD).min(max) };
        }
    }

    /// The round state for the HUD.
    pub(super) fn round_net(&self) -> RoundNet {
        let left = match self.round.phase {
            Phase::Warmup => 0.0,
            _ => self.round.phase_end.saturating_sub(self.tick) as f32 * self.rate.tick(),
        };
        RoundNet {
            phase: if self.rounds_on() { self.round.phase } else { Phase::Warmup },
            round: self.round.round,
            score: self.round.score,
            left,
            stage: self.stage(),
            abandoned: [self.abandoned(Team::T), self.abandoned(Team::Ct)],
            vote: self.vote_net(),
            paused: self.reserved.as_ref().is_some_and(|r| r.empty_since.is_some()),
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/running.rs`:

```rs
//! Running at the tick rate, and stopping without cutting a match short (draining).
use super::*;

impl Server {
    /// Run forever at the tick rate.
    pub fn run(&mut self) {
        self.run_until(&std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool::new(false));
    }

    /// Run at the tick rate until `stop` is set (the game's built-in server stops when you leave).
    pub fn run_until(&mut self, stop: &std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool) {
        self.run_while(|_| !stop.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed));
    }

    /// Run at the tick rate; once `stop` is set, take no new matches and return when the
    /// current one is over (updates don't cut matches short).
    pub fn run_draining(&mut self, stop: &std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool) {
        self.run_while(|s| {
            if stop.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) && s.draining.is_none() {
                println!("{}", if s.is_reserved() { "stopping after this match" } else { "stopping" });
                s.draining = Some(s.tick);
                s.heartbeat(); // tell the lobby now: no new matches here
            }
            !s.drained()
        });
    }

    /// Draining and done: no match, and no booking can still be on its way (a few seconds
    /// since the lobby heard we're busy).
    pub fn drained(&self) -> bool {
        self.draining.is_some_and(|since| !self.is_reserved() && self.tick - since > 2 * self.rate.hz())
    }

    /// Start draining (see `run_draining`).
    pub fn drain(&mut self) {
        self.draining.get_or_insert(self.tick);
    }

    pub(super) fn run_while(&mut self, mut go_on: impl FnMut(&mut Self) -> bool) {
        let tick = Duration::from_secs_f64(1.0 / self.rate.hz() as f64);
        let mut next = Instant::now();
        while go_on(self) {
            self.step();
            next += tick;
            let now = Instant::now();
            if next > now {
                std::thread::sleep(next - now);
            } else if now - next > Duration::from_millis(250) {
                next = now; // fell far behind (machine was suspended): don't fast-forward
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/sealed.rs`:

```rs
//! The encrypted side of an official server: bookings sealed by the lobby (with the key both
//! derive from the official token), and players' channels, opened with the key the lobby gave
//! their ticket. Nothing reaches the game unless it proved it came from the right key.
use super::*;
use crate::crypto::Channel;

impl Server {
    /// A sealed order from the lobby: a booking (taken if genuine, fresh and we're free), or a
    /// deathmatch seat.
    pub(super) fn booking(&mut self, packet: &[u8]) {
        let Some(key) = &self.server_key else { return };
        let Some((sent, body)) = key.open(packet) else { return };
        let setup = match decode::<crate::lobby::LobbyOrder>(&body) {
            Some(crate::lobby::LobbyOrder::Book(setup)) => setup,
            Some(crate::lobby::LobbyOrder::Seat { ticket, key }) if self.rules.deathmatch => {
                // ponytail: a few dozen seats at most (20 players, seats expire); a map is plenty.
                self.seats.insert(ticket, (key, self.tick));
                return;
            }
            _ => return,
        };
        if self.rules.deathmatch {
            return; // deathmatch servers run no booked matches
        }
        // An older booking replayed (or a resend of one we took) changes nothing.
        if sent <= self.last_booking || self.reserved.is_some() || self.draining.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        self.last_booking = sent;
        // The booked map first (the lobby only books maps we said we have).
        if !setup.map.is_empty() {
            if let Err(e) = self.change_map(&setup.map) {
                println!("can't take the booking: {e}");
                return;
            }
        }
        self.reserve(setup);
        self.heartbeat(); // tell the lobby right away that we took it
    }

    /// Decrypt a player's packet: over their channel, or (a new player) with the key of the
    /// ticket it names. A new channel is kept only once their join is accepted (see Hello).
    pub(super) fn unseal(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, packet: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        if self.socket.is_secure(from) {
            return self.socket.open(from, packet);
        }
        let ticket = crate::crypto::channel_id(packet)?;
        let booked = self.reserved.as_ref().and_then(|r| r.setup.keys.iter().find(|(t, _)| *t == ticket).map(|k| k.1));
        let key = booked.or_else(|| self.seats.get(&ticket).map(|s| s.0))?;
        let mut ch = Channel::new(&key, false);
        let plain = ch.open(packet)?;
        self.joining = Some((from, ticket, ch));
        Some(plain)
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/setup.rs`:

```rs
//! What a server is set up with: its rules (practice or a match) and what it needs from the
//! game install.
use super::*;

/// Practice room, deathmatch, or a real match (the match settings are in `MatchConfig`).
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Rules {
    /// Practice room: everything below is set for practising.
    pub practice: bool,
    /// Seconds before a dead player comes back.
    pub respawn_secs: f32,
    /// Reserve ammo is topped up all the time (you still reload).
    pub infinite_ammo: bool,
    /// Practice only: standing dummies on the other team to shoot at.
    pub dummies: u8,
    /// Deathmatch: no rounds, timers or bomb; back straight away at a random spawn away from
    /// enemies; buy anything anywhere for free; up to 20 players dropping in any time. When
    /// someone reaches `kill_limit`, they're announced and everyone's score starts over.
    pub deathmatch: bool,
    pub kill_limit: i32,
}

impl Default for Rules {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Rules { practice: false, respawn_secs: 3.0, infinite_ammo: false, dummies: 0, deathmatch: false, kill_limit: 100 }
    }
}

impl Rules {
    pub fn practice(dummies: u8) -> Rules {
        Rules { practice: true, respawn_secs: 0.5, infinite_ammo: true, dummies, ..Rules::default() }
    }

    pub fn deathmatch() -> Rules {
        Rules { deathmatch: true, respawn_secs: 1.0, ..Rules::default() }
    }

    /// No rounds: practice and deathmatch (buy anywhere, come back after dying).
    pub fn free_play(&self) -> bool {
        self.practice || self.deathmatch
    }
}

/// What the server needs from the game install besides the map.
pub struct Assets {
    pub hitboxes: Hitboxes,
    pub materials: Materials,
}

impl Assets {
    /// From the game data folder.
    pub fn load(game_dir: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Assets, String> {
        let mdl = crate::gamefiles::paths(game_dir, "models/player/arctic/arctic.mdl").into_iter().find(|p| p.exists()).ok_or("the game data folder is missing the player model (models/player/arctic/arctic.mdl)")?;
        let model = goldsrc::mdl::Model::load(&mdl).map_err(|e| format!("{}: {e}", mdl.display()))?;
        let hitboxes = Hitboxes::from_model(&model, "carbine").ok_or("player model has no aim animations")?;
        // materials.txt is optional: without it every surface counts as concrete.
        let materials = crate::gamefiles::paths(game_dir, "sound/materials.txt").iter().find_map(|p| std::fs::read_to_string(p).ok()).ok_or(()).map(|t| Materials::parse(&t)).unwrap_or_default();
        Ok(Assets { hitboxes, materials })
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/snapshot.rs`:

```rs
//! What goes out each tick: the scoreboard now and then, heartbeats to the lobbies, and every
//! player's snapshot (only what they may see: see `visibility`), with reliable events.
use super::*;

/// Snapshots kept per client as baselines (half a second: confirmations older than that, from
/// a bad connection, get full snapshots).
const SENT_KEPT: usize = (crate::tick::SNAPSHOT_RATE / 2) as usize;

impl Server {
    pub(super) fn send_updates(&mut self) {
        let tick = self.tick;
        if self.tick % (self.rate.hz() / 4) == 0 {
            let mut scores: Vec<Score> = self.clients.values().map(|c| c.score()).collect();
            scores.sort_by_key(|s| (-s.kills, s.deaths));
            // Money only for your own team (spectators: nobody's).
            let for_team = |team: Team| {
                let list: Vec<Score> = scores.iter().map(|s| Score { money: s.money.filter(|_| team != Team::Spectator && s.team == team), ..s.clone() }).collect();
                encode(&ServerMsg::Scores(list))
            };
            let msgs = [for_team(Team::T), for_team(Team::Ct), for_team(Team::Spectator)];
            let history = encode(&ServerMsg::History(self.round.history.clone()));
            let addrs: Vec<_> = self.clients.iter().filter(|(_, c)| !c.bot).map(|(a, c)| (*a, c.team)).collect();
            for (a, team) in addrs {
                let msg = match team {
                    Team::T => &msgs[0],
                    Team::Ct => &msgs[1],
                    _ => &msgs[2],
                };
                self.socket.send(a, msg.clone());
                self.socket.send(a, history.clone());
            }
        }
        if self.tick % self.rate.secs(HEARTBEAT_SECS) == 1 {
            self.heartbeat();
        }
        if self.tick % self.rate.snapshot_every() == 0 {
            let players: Vec<PlayerNet> = self
                .clients
                .values()
                .map(|c| {
                    let (m, v) = (&c.state.movement, &c.vitals);
                    let mate = Mate { health: v.health.clamp(0.0, 255.0).ceil() as u8, armor: v.armor.clamp(0.0, 255.0).ceil() as u8, helmet: v.helmet, defuse_kit: c.defuse_kit, ammo: c.state.loadout.active_gun().map(|g| (g.clip.min(u16::MAX as u32) as u16, g.reserve.min(u16::MAX as u32) as u16)) };
                    PlayerNet::new(c.id, m.origin, c.view.0, c.view.1, m.crouched, v.alive(), !m.on_ground && !m.on_ladder, c.state.loadout.active_gun().is_some_and(|g| g.reloading), c.state.loadout.active_id(), c.team, Some(mate))
                })
                .collect();
            let doors = self.world.doors.net_state();
            let events = std::mem::take(&mut self.events);
            self.kills_settled = 0;
            let now = self.tick as f64 * self.rate.tick() as f64;
            let grenades: Vec<_> = self.grenades.iter().map(|g| (g.kind, g.origin)).collect();
            let smokes: Vec<SmokeNet> = self.smokes.iter().map(|s| SmokeNet { at: s.0, left: (s.1 - now) as f32 }).collect();
            let ground: Vec<(Id, [f32; 3])> = self.ground.iter().map(|g| (g.gun.id, g.origin)).collect();
            let round = self.round_net();
            let broken = self.broken_models();
            // The recording gets everything, before anything is culled per player.
            self.record(&players, &events, &doors, &broken, &grenades, &smokes, &ground, &round);
            let viewers: Vec<u8> = self.clients.values().filter(|c| !c.bot).map(|c| c.id).collect();
            let sights: HashMap<u8, std::collections::HashSet<u8>> = viewers.iter().map(|id| (*id, self.visible_to(*id))).collect();
            self.note_sightings(&sights);
            let sends: Vec<_> = self
                .clients
                .iter()
                .filter(|(_, c)| !c.bot)
                .map(|(a, c)| {
                    let me = Me { money: c.money, limits: self.limits(c.id), can_buy: self.can_buy(c), defuse_kit: c.defuse_kit };
                    let seen = &sights[&c.id];
                    // Health and kit only for teammates (spectators see everything anyway).
                    let players: Vec<PlayerNet> = players
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|p| seen.contains(&p.id) && p.id != c.id)
                        .map(|p| {
                            let mut p = p.clone();
                            p.mate = p.mate.filter(|_| c.team == Team::Spectator || p.team == c.team);
                            p
                        })
                        .collect();
                    let you = Some((c.state.movement, c.vitals));
                    let events = self.events_for(c.id, seen, &events);
                    (*a, c.last_run, c.state.loadout.clone(), self.bomb_net(c.team), me, players, you, events)
                })
                .collect();
            for (addr, ack, loadout, bomb, me, players, you, events) in sends {
                // Reliable events go in the client's numbered outbox until it confirms them.
                let (reliable_new, events): (Vec<GameEvent>, Vec<GameEvent>) = events.into_iter().partition(|e| e.reliable());
                let c = self.clients.get_mut(&addr).unwrap();
                for e in reliable_new {
                    c.next_reliable += 1;
                    c.outbox.push_back((c.next_reliable, e));
                }
                while c.outbox.len() > MAX_OUTBOX {
                    c.outbox.pop_front(); // a client that stopped acknowledging: don't grow forever
                }
                let reliable: Vec<(u32, GameEvent)> = c.outbox.iter().cloned().collect();
                let msg = ServerMsg::Snapshot {
                    tick,
                    ack,
                    players,
                    you,
                    doors: doors.clone(),
                    loadout,
                    events,
                    reliable,
                    broken: broken.clone(),
                    grenades: grenades.clone(),
                    smokes: smokes.clone(),
                    ground: ground.clone(),
                    round,
                    bomb,
                    me,
                };
                let bytes = encode(&msg);
                let c = self.clients.get_mut(&addr).unwrap();
                let wire = match c.sent.iter().find(|(t, _)| *t == c.snap_ack) {
                    Some((base, old)) => Some(encode(&ServerMsg::Delta { base: *base, patch: crate::delta::diff(old, &bytes) })).filter(|d| d.len() < bytes.len()),
                    None => None,
                };
                c.sent.push_back((tick, bytes.clone()));
                if c.sent.len() > SENT_KEPT {
                    c.sent.pop_front();
                }
                let wire = wire.unwrap_or(bytes);
                self.snapshot_bytes = wire.len();
                self.socket.send(addr, wire);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/surrender.rs`:

```rs
//! Team votes and leavers in a reserved match. One leaver changes nothing: their seat waits
//! and they can come back. Once a teammate has been gone for 5 minutes (abandoned), the team
//! may call a surrender vote; it passes with a majority of the team still connected and the
//! other team wins. A team may also vote a teammate out (a kick vote: a majority of the
//! others): they can't come back to this match, and the team may then surrender. A side with
//! nobody left pauses the match; if it stays empty that long, it forfeits.
use super::*;
use crate::protocol::VoteNet;
use crate::rounds::Phase;

/// Gone this long counts as abandoned.
pub(super) const ABANDON_SECONDS: u32 = 300;
const VOTE_SECONDS: u32 = 30;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub(super) enum VoteKind {
    Surrender,
    /// Vote this player (id, seat ticket) out.
    Kick(u8, u64),
}

pub(super) struct Vote {
    kind: VoteKind,
    team: Team,
    yes: Vec<u8>,
    no: Vec<u8>,
    until: u32,
}

impl Server {
    /// Players of this team (by their match seat) gone for good: away 5 minutes, or voted out.
    pub(super) fn abandoned(&self, team: Team) -> bool {
        let Some(r) = &self.reserved else { return false };
        r.left_at.iter().any(|(ticket, since)| {
            let group = r.setup.players.iter().find(|(t, _)| t == ticket).map(|(_, g)| *g);
            let gone = r.kicked.contains(ticket) || self.tick - since > ABANDON_SECONDS * self.rate.hz();
            group.is_some_and(|g| self.team_for(g) == team) && gone
        })
    }

    fn connected(&self, team: Team) -> Vec<u8> {
        self.clients.values().filter(|c| c.team == team && !c.bot).map(|c| c.id).collect()
    }

    /// A player asks their team to surrender (only once someone of theirs abandoned, and one
    /// vote per team per round).
    pub(super) fn call_surrender(&mut self, from: SocketAddr) {
        let Some(c) = self.clients.get(&from) else { return };
        let (id, team) = (c.id, c.team);
        let round = self.round.round;
        if team == Team::Spectator || !self.abandoned(team) {
            return;
        }
        let tick = self.tick;
        let Some(r) = &mut self.reserved else { return };
        if r.vote.is_some() || r.voted_in_round[(team == Team::Ct) as usize] == Some(round) {
            return;
        }
        r.voted_in_round[(team == Team::Ct) as usize] = Some(round);
        r.vote = Some(Vote { kind: VoteKind::Surrender, team, yes: vec![id], no: Vec::new(), until: tick + VOTE_SECONDS * self.rate.hz() });
    }

    /// A player asks their team to vote a teammate out (one vote at a time, one call per
    /// player per round).
    pub(super) fn call_kick(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, target: u8) {
        let Some(c) = self.clients.get(&from) else { return };
        let (id, team, round, tick) = (c.id, c.team, self.round.round, self.tick);
        let Some(t) = self.clients.values().find(|t| t.id == target && t.team == team && t.ticket != 0 && t.id != id) else { return };
        let ticket = t.ticket;
        let Some(r) = &mut self.reserved else { return };
        if team == Team::Spectator || r.vote.is_some() || r.kick_called.get(&id) == Some(&round) {
            return;
        }
        r.kick_called.insert(id, round);
        r.vote = Some(Vote { kind: VoteKind::Kick(target, ticket), team, yes: vec![id], no: Vec::new(), until: tick + VOTE_SECONDS * self.rate.hz() });
    }

    pub(super) fn surrender_vote(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, yes: bool) {
        let Some(c) = self.clients.get(&from) else { return };
        let (id, team) = (c.id, c.team);
        if let Some(v) = self.reserved.as_mut().and_then(|r| r.vote.as_mut()) {
            let target = matches!(v.kind, VoteKind::Kick(t, _) if t == id);
            if v.team == team && !target && !v.yes.contains(&id) && !v.no.contains(&id) {
                if yes { v.yes.push(id) } else { v.no.push(id) }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Who may vote: the team still connected (not the one a kick vote is about).
    fn voters(&self, team: Team, kind: VoteKind) -> usize {
        self.connected(team).iter().filter(|id| !matches!(kind, VoteKind::Kick(t, _) if t == **id)).count()
    }

    fn needed(&self, team: Team, kind: VoteKind) -> usize {
        self.voters(team, kind) / 2 + 1
    }

    /// The vote for the HUD (everyone sees it; the client shows it to that team).
    pub(super) fn vote_net(&self) -> Option<VoteNet> {
        let v = self.reserved.as_ref()?.vote.as_ref()?;
        let kick = if let VoteKind::Kick(t, _) = v.kind { Some(t) } else { None };
        Some(VoteNet { team: v.team, kick, yes: v.yes.len() as u8, no: v.no.len() as u8, needed: self.needed(v.team, v.kind) as u8, left: v.until.saturating_sub(self.tick) as f32 * self.rate.tick() })
    }

    /// Once a tick in a reserved match: count the vote, and pause while a side is empty.
    /// True while the match is paused or over (the round flow must not run).
    pub(super) fn surrender_step(&mut self) -> bool {
        let tick = self.tick;
        if let Some(v) = self.reserved.as_ref().and_then(|r| r.vote.as_ref()) {
            let (kind, team, yes, no, until) = (v.kind, v.team, v.yes.len(), v.no.len(), v.until);
            let (needed, voters) = (self.needed(team, kind), self.voters(team, kind));
            if yes >= needed {
                self.reserved.as_mut().unwrap().vote = None;
                match kind {
                    VoteKind::Surrender => {
                        self.events.push(GameEvent::Surrendered { team });
                        self.end_match(crate::rounds::other(team));
                        return true;
                    }
                    VoteKind::Kick(id, ticket) => self.vote_out(id, ticket),
                }
            }
            if tick >= until || voters - no.min(voters) < needed {
                self.reserved.as_mut().unwrap().vote = None;
            }
        }
        let Some(r) = &self.reserved else { return false };
        let started = matches!(r.knife, reserve::Knife::Done) && !matches!(self.round.phase, Phase::Warmup | Phase::GameOver);
        // One side empty pauses; everyone gone is the server's to free (see `reserved_step`).
        let anyone = self.clients.values().any(|c| c.ticket != 0);
        let empty = [Team::T, Team::Ct].into_iter().find(|t| self.connected(*t).is_empty()).filter(|_| anyone);
        match (started, empty) {
            (true, Some(team)) => {
                let since = *self.reserved.as_mut().unwrap().empty_since.get_or_insert(tick);
                if tick - since > ABANDON_SECONDS * self.rate.hz() {
                    self.reserved.as_mut().unwrap().empty_since = None;
                    self.end_match(crate::rounds::other(team));
                } else {
                    // Paused: the clock doesn't run.
                    self.round.phase_end += 1;
                    self.round.buy_end += 1;
                }
                true
            }
            _ => {
                self.reserved.as_mut().unwrap().empty_since = None;
                false
            }
        }
    }

    /// Voted out: gone for this match (they can't come back), and their team may surrender.
    fn vote_out(&mut self, id: u8, ticket: u64) {
        let tick = self.tick;
        if let Some(r) = &mut self.reserved {
            r.kicked.push(ticket);
            r.left_at.insert(ticket, tick);
        }
        self.events.push(GameEvent::VotedOut { player: id });
        if let Some(addr) = self.clients.iter().find(|(_, c)| c.id == id).map(|(a, _)| *a) {
            self.socket.send(addr, encode(&ServerMsg::Reject { reason: "Your team voted you out of this match.".into() }));
            self.drop_bomb(id);
            self.clients.remove(&addr);
        }
    }

    /// The match is decided before the last round (surrender, forfeit).
    fn end_match(&mut self, winner: Team) {
        self.round.forfeit(self.tick, winner);
        if let Some(r) = &mut self.reserved {
            r.winner = Some(winner);
        }
        self.events.push(GameEvent::MatchOver { winner: Some(winner) });
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/visibility.rs`:

```rs
//! Anti-wallhack: enemies you can't possibly see aren't sent to you at all, so a cheating
//! client has nothing to draw. Sounds are separate: footsteps and gunshots still reach you
//! within hearing range (where they're audible anyway), so you can hear people behind walls.
use super::*;
use std::collections::HashSet;

/// Keep sending someone this long after they went out of sight (no flicker at corners).
const GRACE_SECS: f32 = 0.25;
/// The target's box is grown by this much sideways and their (and your) position is pushed
/// ahead along the velocity by `LOOKAHEAD` seconds, so someone stepping round a corner is
/// already there when they come into view, even with some ping.
const MARGIN: f32 = 24.0;
const LOOKAHEAD: f32 = 0.15;
/// GoldSrc sound falloff: silent at 1000 / attenuation units (footsteps: ATTN_NORM 0.8; shots:
/// `fire_attenuation`).
const HEAR_NORMAL: f32 = 1000.0 / 0.8;
/// A smoke cloud hides what's behind it once it has bloomed (1 s) until it thins out (last 2 s):
/// a sphere this big around a point this high over where it popped.
const SMOKE_RADIUS: f32 = 140.0;
const SMOKE_LIFT: f32 = 40.0;
/// Close enough to see through the haze anyway (both in the same cloud).
const SMOKE_SEE_NEAR: f32 = 64.0;

fn ahead(p: [f32; 3], v: [f32; 3]) -> [f32; 3] {
    std::array::from_fn(|i| p[i] + v[i] * LOOKAHEAD)
}

fn dist(a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3]) -> f32 {
    ((a[0] - b[0]).powi(2) + (a[1] - b[1]).powi(2) + (a[2] - b[2]).powi(2)).sqrt()
}

/// Does the segment a-b pass through the sphere (c, r)?
fn through_sphere(a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3], c: [f32; 3], r: f32) -> bool {
    let d: [f32; 3] = std::array::from_fn(|i| b[i] - a[i]);
    let f: [f32; 3] = std::array::from_fn(|i| a[i] - c[i]);
    let dd = d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1] + d[2] * d[2];
    let t = (-(f[0] * d[0] + f[1] * d[1] + f[2] * d[2]) / dd.max(1e-6)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let p: [f32; 3] = std::array::from_fn(|i| f[i] + d[i] * t);
    p[0] * p[0] + p[1] * p[1] + p[2] * p[2] < r * r
}

impl Server {
    /// Is the line a-b hidden by a smoke cloud?
    pub(super) fn smoked(&self, a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3]) -> bool {
        if dist(a, b) < SMOKE_SEE_NEAR {
            return false;
        }
        let now = self.tick as f64 * self.rate.tick() as f64;
        self.smokes.iter().any(|(at, until)| {
            let age = sim::grenades::SMOKE_SECONDS - (until - now);
            age > 1.0 && until - now > 2.0 && through_sphere(a, b, [at[0], at[1], at[2] + SMOKE_LIFT], SMOKE_RADIUS)
        })
    }

    /// Could `viewer` see any part of `target` (now or a moment from now)?
    fn in_sight(&self, viewer: &Remote, target: &Remote) -> bool {
        let (vm, tm) = (&viewer.state.movement, &target.state.movement);
        let eyes = [vm.eye(), ahead(vm.eye(), vm.velocity)];
        let h = tm.hull();
        let (lo, hi) = (h.mins(), h.maxs());
        for o in [tm.origin, ahead(tm.origin, tm.velocity)] {
            let mut points = vec![o, [o[0], o[1], o[2] + hi[2] - 4.0]];
            for x in [lo[0] - MARGIN, hi[0] + MARGIN] {
                for y in [lo[1] - MARGIN, hi[1] + MARGIN] {
                    for z in [lo[2] + 4.0, hi[2]] {
                        points.push([o[0] + x, o[1] + y, o[2] + z]);
                    }
                }
            }
            if eyes.iter().any(|e| points.iter().any(|p| !self.world.sight_blocked(*e, *p) && !self.smoked(*e, *p))) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        false
    }

    /// The living players whose eyes and ears `viewer` gets: themselves when alive; when dead,
    /// their living teammates (CS competitive: the dead only watch their own team, so they
    /// can't call out what the enemy is doing); a whole team dead: nobody's (their screen goes
    /// black). None: sees everyone (spectators, outside official matches).
    fn eyes_of(&self, viewer: u8) -> Option<Vec<&Remote>> {
        let v = self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == viewer)?;
        if v.team == Team::Spectator {
            return None;
        }
        if v.vitals.alive() {
            return Some(vec![v]);
        }
        Some(self.clients.values().filter(|c| c.team == v.team && c.vitals.alive()).collect())
    }

    /// Who `viewer` gets told about: themselves, teammates, and enemies in (or just out of)
    /// sight of their eyes (see `eyes_of`).
    pub(super) fn visible_to(&mut self, viewer: u8) -> HashSet<u8> {
        let Some(v) = self.clients.values().find(|c| c.id == viewer) else { return HashSet::new() };
        let eyes = self.eyes_of(viewer);
        let tick = self.tick;
        let mut out = HashSet::new();
        let mut seen = Vec::new();
        for t in self.clients.values() {
            let in_sight = match &eyes {
                None => true,
                Some(eyes) => eyes.iter().any(|e| self.in_sight(e, t)),
            };
            let visible = t.id == viewer || t.team == v.team || !t.vitals.alive() || in_sight;
            if visible {
                seen.push(t.id);
                out.insert(t.id);
            } else if self.last_seen.get(&(viewer, t.id)).is_some_and(|s| tick - s < self.rate.secs(GRACE_SECS)) {
                out.insert(t.id);
            }
        }
        for id in seen {
            self.last_seen.insert((viewer, id), tick);
        }
        out
    }

    /// The events `viewer` may get: sounds only within hearing range of someone hidden.
    pub(super) fn events_for(&self, viewer: u8, visible: &HashSet<u8>, events: &[GameEvent]) -> Vec<GameEvent> {
        if !self.clients.values().any(|c| c.id == viewer) {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        // Heard with the same ears as `eyes_of` (the dead: their living teammates').
        let ears: Option<Vec<[f32; 3]>> = self.eyes_of(viewer).map(|e| e.iter().map(|c| c.state.movement.eye()).collect());
        let hears = |at: [f32; 3], range: f32| ears.as_ref().is_none_or(|ears| ears.iter().any(|e| dist(at, *e) <= range));
        events
            .iter()
            .filter(|e| match e {
                GameEvent::Footstep { player, at, .. } => visible.contains(player) || hears(*at, HEAR_NORMAL),
                GameEvent::Shot { shooter, weapon, silenced, from, .. } => visible.contains(shooter) || hears(*from, 1000.0 / sim::weapons::data::fire_attenuation(*weapon, *silenced)),
                _ => true,
            })
            .cloned()
            .collect()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn segment_through_sphere() {
        let c = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0];
        assert!(super::through_sphere([-200.0, 0.0, 0.0], [200.0, 0.0, 0.0], c, 50.0));
        assert!(!super::through_sphere([-200.0, 100.0, 0.0], [200.0, 100.0, 0.0], c, 50.0));
        assert!(!super::through_sphere([100.0, 0.0, 0.0], [200.0, 0.0, 0.0], c, 50.0), "sphere behind the start");
    }
}
```

`net/src/server/voice.rs`:

```rs
//! Voice relay: the server passes Opus frames on, never decoding them. Team voice goes to the
//! speaker's whole team; proximity voice to everyone alive in range, quieter further away.
//! (Only a loudness is sent with proximity voice, not where the speaker is, and whether a wall
//! is in between: the listener hears it muffled.)
use super::*;

/// Biggest voice frame passed on (a 20 ms Opus voice frame is ~60-120 bytes).
const MAX_VOICE_BYTES: usize = 400;

impl Server {
    pub(super) fn relay_voice(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, channel: VoiceChannel, data: Vec<u8>) {
        let Some(s) = self.clients.get(&from) else { return };
        if data.len() > MAX_VOICE_BYTES || s.team == Team::Spectator {
            return;
        }
        // The dead talk to their team only.
        if channel == VoiceChannel::Proximity && !s.vitals.alive() {
            return;
        }
        let (id, team, mouth) = (s.id, s.team, s.state.movement.eye());
        let range = self.round.cfg.voice_range.max(1.0);
        let to: Vec<(SocketAddr, u8, bool)> = self
            .clients
            .iter()
            .filter(|(a, c)| **a != from && !c.bot)
            .filter_map(|(a, c)| match channel {
                VoiceChannel::Team => (c.team == team).then_some((*a, 255, false)),
                VoiceChannel::Proximity => {
                    let e = c.state.movement.eye();
                    let d = ((e[0] - mouth[0]).powi(2) + (e[1] - mouth[1]).powi(2) + (e[2] - mouth[2]).powi(2)).sqrt();
                    let gain = 1.0 - d / range;
                    let muffled = self.world.sight_blocked(mouth, e);
                    (c.vitals.alive() && gain > 0.0).then_some((*a, (gain * 255.0).round().max(1.0) as u8, muffled))
                }
            })
            .collect();
        for (addr, gain, muffled) in to {
            let msg = ServerMsg::Voice { from: id, channel, gain, muffled, data: data.clone() };
            self.socket.send(addr, encode(&msg));
        }
    }
}
```

`net/src/socket.rs`:

```rs
//! Non-blocking UDP with optional fake lag and packet loss, for testing real-world
//! conditions on one machine. Lag is counted in ticks of whoever owns the socket. Peers with
//! an encrypted channel get everything sent to them sealed (see `crypto`).
use crate::crypto::Channel;
use std::collections::{HashMap, VecDeque};
use std::net::{SocketAddr, UdpSocket};

pub struct Socket {
    udp: UdpSocket,
    /// One-way delay applied to both sends and receives.
    /// Fake one-way delay, kept in ms: ticks differ with the rate.
    delay_ms: u32,
    hz: u32,
    /// Chance (0..1) to drop each packet in each direction.
    loss: f32,
    now: u64,
    outgoing: VecDeque<(u64, SocketAddr, Vec<u8>)>,
    incoming: VecDeque<(u64, SocketAddr, Vec<u8>)>,
    rng: u64,
    /// Encrypted peers: their channel and its id (ticket).
    channels: HashMap<SocketAddr, (u64, Channel)>,
}

impl Socket {
    pub fn bind(addr: SocketAddr) -> std::io::Result<Socket> {
        let udp = UdpSocket::bind(addr)?;
        udp.set_nonblocking(true)?;
        Ok(Socket { udp, delay_ms: 0, hz: crate::tick::DEFAULT_TICK_RATE, loss: 0.0, now: 0, outgoing: VecDeque::new(), incoming: VecDeque::new(), rng: 0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15, channels: HashMap::new() })
    }

    pub fn local_addr(&self) -> SocketAddr {
        self.udp.local_addr().expect("bound socket has an address")
    }

    /// Simulate a connection with `ping_ms` round trip and `loss` packet loss.
    pub fn set_conditions(&mut self, ping_ms: u32, loss: f32) {
        self.delay_ms = ping_ms / 2;
        self.loss = loss;
    }

    /// The tick rate the delay is counted in.
    pub fn set_rate(&mut self, rate: crate::tick::TickRate) {
        self.hz = rate.hz();
    }

    fn delay_ticks(&self) -> u32 {
        self.delay_ms * self.hz / 1000
    }

    fn dropped(&mut self) -> bool {
        if self.loss <= 0.0 {
            return false;
        }
        // xorshift: deterministic and dependency-free.
        self.rng ^= self.rng << 13;
        self.rng ^= self.rng >> 7;
        self.rng ^= self.rng << 17;
        (self.rng % 10_000) as f32 / 10_000.0 < self.loss
    }

    /// From now on, everything to and from `peer` is encrypted with this channel.
    pub fn secure(&mut self, peer: SocketAddr, id: u64, channel: Channel) {
        self.channels.insert(peer, (id, channel));
    }

    pub fn is_secure(&self, peer: SocketAddr) -> bool {
        self.channels.contains_key(&peer)
    }

    /// Decrypt a packet from an encrypted peer (None: not genuine, or a replay).
    pub fn open(&mut self, from: SocketAddr, packet: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        self.channels.get_mut(&from)?.1.open(packet)
    }

    /// Forget the channels of peers that are gone.
    pub fn keep_channels(&mut self, keep: impl Fn(&SocketAddr) -> bool) {
        self.channels.retain(|a, _| keep(a));
    }

    pub fn send(&mut self, to: SocketAddr, bytes: Vec<u8>) {
        let bytes = match self.channels.get_mut(&to) {
            Some((id, ch)) => ch.seal(*id, &bytes),
            None => bytes,
        };
        if self.dropped() {
            return;
        }
        if self.delay_ticks() == 0 {
            let _ = self.udp.send_to(&bytes, to);
        } else {
            self.outgoing.push_back((self.now + self.delay_ticks() as u64, to, bytes));
        }
    }

    /// Call once per tick: releases delayed packets.
    pub fn tick(&mut self) {
        self.now += 1;
        while self.outgoing.front().is_some_and(|p| p.0 <= self.now) {
            let (_, to, b) = self.outgoing.pop_front().unwrap();
            let _ = self.udp.send_to(&b, to);
        }
    }

    /// Everything that has arrived (and finished its fake delay).
    pub fn recv_all(&mut self) -> Vec<(SocketAddr, Vec<u8>)> {
        let mut buf = vec![0u8; 65536];
        // At most this many a call: a flood waits in (and overflows) the OS queue instead of
        // our memory. 32 players send a few each per tick; this is far more.
        let mut room = 4096;
        while room > 0 {
            let Ok((n, from)) = self.udp.recv_from(&mut buf) else { break };
            room -= 1;
            if self.dropped() {
                continue;
            }
            self.incoming.push_back((self.now + self.delay_ticks() as u64, from, buf[..n].to_vec()));
        }
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        while self.incoming.front().is_some_and(|p| p.0 <= self.now) {
            let (_, from, b) = self.incoming.pop_front().unwrap();
            out.push((from, b));
        }
        out
    }
}
```

`net/src/tick.rs`:

```rs
//! The server's tick rate: how many simulation steps it runs per second.
//!
//! 128 is the default. A server runs at 64 or 128 and tells clients in the
//! Welcome message. Time-based values are written in seconds and converted
//! with `TickRate::secs`, so they mean the same thing at either rate.

/// Rates a server may run at.
pub const TICK_RATES: [u32; 2] = [64, 128];
pub const DEFAULT_TICK_RATE: u32 = 128;
/// Snapshots per second, whatever the tick rate (bandwidth and interpolation stay the same).
pub const SNAPSHOT_RATE: u32 = 64;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct TickRate(u32);

impl TickRate {
    /// `None` unless `hz` is one of `TICK_RATES`.
    pub fn new(hz: u32) -> Option<Self> {
        TICK_RATES.contains(&hz).then_some(Self(hz))
    }

    /// Steps per second.
    pub fn hz(self) -> u32 {
        self.0
    }

    /// Length of one step, in seconds.
    pub fn tick(self) -> f32 {
        1.0 / self.0 as f32
    }

    /// Ticks between snapshots.
    pub fn snapshot_every(self) -> u32 {
        self.0 / SNAPSHOT_RATE
    }

    /// Whole ticks in `seconds`, rounded to the nearest tick.
    pub fn secs(self, seconds: f32) -> u32 {
        (seconds * self.0 as f32).round() as u32
    }
}

impl Default for TickRate {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self(DEFAULT_TICK_RATE)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn default_is_128() {
        assert_eq!(TickRate::default().hz(), 128);
    }

    #[test]
    fn only_64_and_128_are_allowed() {
        assert!(TickRate::new(64).is_some());
        assert!(TickRate::new(128).is_some());
        assert!(TickRate::new(100).is_none());
        assert!(TickRate::new(0).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn seconds_match_the_old_constants_at_128() {
        let r = TickRate::default();
        assert_eq!(r.secs(5.0), 5 * 128); // TIMEOUT_TICKS
        assert_eq!(r.secs(0.5), 128 / 2); // MAX_UNLAG_TICKS
        assert_eq!(r.secs(0.25), 128 / 4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn seconds_scale_with_the_rate() {
        let r = TickRate::new(64).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(r.secs(5.0), 320);
        assert_eq!(r.secs(0.5), 32);
    }

    #[test]
    fn tick_is_one_over_hz() {
        assert!((TickRate::new(64).unwrap().tick() - 1.0 / 64.0).abs() < 1e-7);
        assert!((TickRate::default().tick() - 1.0 / 128.0).abs() < 1e-7);
    }
}
```

`net/tests/bandwidth.rs`:

```rs
//! How big snapshots are with a full server (10 players), sent 64 times a second (as changes
//! to the last one the client confirmed: see `net::delta`).
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::protocol::Team;
use sim::pmove::Input;

#[test]
fn snapshot_size_with_ten_players() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.server.set_rules(net::server::Rules::practice(8));
    // Spectators get everyone (the worst case: all 10 players in every snapshot).
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::Spectator), Some(Team::Spectator));
    assert!(g.a.others().len() >= 8, "sees {}", g.a.others().len());
    // The dummies run around (moving players are the expensive ones).
    let dummies: Vec<(u8, [f32; 3])> = g.a.others().iter().map(|o| (o.id, o.origin)).collect();
    let mut sizes = Vec::new();
    for t in 0..256 {
        for (i, (id, o)) in dummies.iter().enumerate() {
            let a = (t + i * 30) as f32 * 0.02;
            g.server.teleport(*id, [o[0] + a.cos() * 100.0, o[1] + a.sin() * 100.0, o[2]]);
        }
        g.tick(Input { forward: 400.0, yaw: t as f32, ..Default::default() }, Input::default());
        sizes.push(g.server.snapshot_bytes());
    }
    let avg = sizes.iter().sum::<usize>() as f32 / sizes.len() as f32;
    let per_second = avg * 64.0 / 1024.0;
    eprintln!("snapshot ~{avg:.0} bytes -> {per_second:.1} KB/s per player");
    // In full they're about 265 bytes (16.5 KB/s).
    assert!(per_second < 6.0, "{per_second:.1} KB/s per player");
}
```

`net/tests/bots.rs`:

```rs
//! Matches with test bots, the way players get one: 10 bots queue for casual on the lobby
//! and get booked onto the official server. Then: a whole short match to the end; a round
//! where the bomb is taken to A, planted and defused (on orders); bots leaving pause the
//! match and coming back resumes it.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::bot::{Bot, BotMap, Difficulty, Profile};
use net::lobby::{Command, LobbyClient, LobbyServer};
use net::protocol::{GameEvent, Team};
use net::server::Server;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

/// Test players accept found matches straight away.
fn accepting(mut c: LobbyClient) -> LobbyClient {
    c.auto_accept = true;
    c
}

const LOCAL: ([u8; 4], u16) = ([127, 0, 0, 1], 0);

/// A short match: 4 rounds (sides swap after 2), quick timers.
fn short(lobby: SocketAddr) -> net::config::MatchConfig {
    net::config::MatchConfig { lobby: lobby.to_string(), official_token: "tok".into(), max_rounds: 4, overtime_rounds: 0, freeze_time: 1.0, buy_time: 10.0, round_time: 40.0, round_end_delay: 1.0, ..Default::default() }
}

/// A lobby, an official server and 10 bots booked onto it.
fn booked(map: &Arc<BotMap>, cfg: impl Fn(SocketAddr) -> net::config::MatchConfig) -> (Server, Vec<Bot>) {
    let mut m = LobbyServer::bind(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), vec!["tok".into()]).unwrap();
    let lobby = m.local_addr();
    std::thread::spawn(move || m.run());
    let mut server = Server::new(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), "test", &map.bsp, assets()).unwrap();
    server.set_config(cfg(lobby));
    let mut queue: Vec<LobbyClient> = (0..10).map(|i| accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, &format!("bot{i}")).unwrap())).collect();
    let mut bots: Vec<Bot> = Vec::new();
    let mut asked = [false; 10];
    let start = Instant::now();
    while bots.len() < 10 {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(20), "not all bots got a match: {} online, {} booked, notices {:?}", queue.iter().filter(|c| c.online()).count(), bots.len(), queue.iter().map(|c| c.notice.clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>());
        server.step();
        for (i, c) in queue.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            c.tick();
            if c.online() && !asked[i] {
                asked[i] = true;
                c.send(Command::Play);
            }
            if let Some((addr, ticket, key)) = c.found.take() {
                let mut client = net::Client::connect(addr, &format!("bot{i}"), map.world()).unwrap();
                client.ticket = ticket;
                client.key = Some(key);
                bots.push(Bot::new(client, map.clone(), i, Profile::of(Difficulty::Normal)));
            }
        }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
    }
    (server, bots)
}

/// Run (simulated time, as fast as the machine goes) until `done` or `secs` of game time.
fn play(what: &str, server: &mut Server, bots: &mut [Bot], secs: u32, events: &mut Vec<GameEvent>, done: impl Fn(&[Bot], &[GameEvent]) -> bool) -> f32 {
    let mut ticks = 0u32;
    while !done(bots, events) {
        ticks += 1;
        assert!(ticks < secs * 128, "{what}: not done in {secs} game seconds (round {}, {} events, statuses {:?})", bots[0].client.round.round, events.len(), bots.iter().map(|b| format!("{:?}", b.client.status)).collect::<Vec<_>>());
        server.step();
        for b in bots.iter_mut() {
            b.tick();
        }
        events.extend(bots[0].take_events());
        bots[1..].iter_mut().for_each(|b| _ = b.take_events());
        if ticks % 8 == 0 {
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(200));
        }
    }
    ticks as f32 / 128.0
}

#[test]
fn ten_bots_play_a_whole_match() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let map = BotMap::new(bsp, "de_dust2");
    // Recorded too, to keep an eye on recording sizes.
    let demos = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("bootleg16-bot-demos-{}", std::process::id()));
    let (mut server, mut bots) = booked(&map, |l| net::config::MatchConfig { demos: demos.to_string_lossy().into(), ..short(l) });
    let mut events = Vec::new();
    let secs = play("whole match", &mut server, &mut bots, 6 * 60, &mut events, |b, _| b.iter().all(|b| b.client.match_ended));
    let count = |f: fn(&GameEvent) -> bool| events.iter().filter(|e| f(e)).count();
    let (kills, rounds, plants) = (count(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::Kill { .. })), count(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::RoundEnd { .. })), count(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::BombPlanted { .. })));
    println!("{rounds} rounds, {kills} kills, {plants} plants, {secs:.0} game seconds");
    let size: u64 = std::fs::read_dir(&demos).map(|d| d.flatten().filter_map(|e| e.metadata().ok()).map(|m| m.len()).sum()).unwrap_or(0);
    println!("recording: {} KB, {:.1} MB per hour of 10 players", size / 1024, size as f64 / secs as f64 * 3600.0 / 1e6);
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&demos);
    assert!(events.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::MatchOver { .. })));
    assert!(rounds >= 3 && kills > 0, "{rounds} rounds, {kills} kills");
    assert!(!server.is_reserved(), "server free for the next match");
}

#[test]
fn bomb_goes_to_a_and_gets_defused() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let map = BotMap::new(bsp, "de_dust2");
    let (mut server, mut bots) = booked(&map, short);
    // Nobody shoots: the terrorists take the bomb to A, the counter-terrorists come to defuse.
    net::bot::command(&mut bots, "all peaceful; all plant a").unwrap();
    let mut events = Vec::new();
    play("until planted", &mut server, &mut bots, 90, &mut events, |_, e| e.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::BombPlanted { .. })));
    let at = events.iter().find_map(|e| if let GameEvent::BombPlanted { at, .. } = e { Some(*at) } else { None }).unwrap();
    let a = map.sites[0];
    assert!(((at[0] - a[0]).powi(2) + (at[1] - a[1]).powi(2)).sqrt() < 600.0, "planted at {at:?}, A is {a:?}");
    play("until defused or exploded", &mut server, &mut bots, 60, &mut events, |_, e| e.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::BombDefused { .. } | GameEvent::BombExploded { .. })));
    assert!(events.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::BombDefused { .. })), "a counter-terrorist should make it in time from CT spawn to A");
}

#[test]
fn bots_leaving_pause_the_match_and_coming_back_resumes_it() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let map = BotMap::new(bsp, "de_dust2");
    let (mut server, mut bots) = booked(&map, short);
    let mut events = Vec::new();
    play("round 1 live", &mut server, &mut bots, 30, &mut events, |b, _| b[0].client.round.round >= 1 && b[0].client.round.phase == net::rounds::Phase::Live);
    let t = bots.iter().find(|b| b.client.team() == Team::T).unwrap().index;
    // (Generous limits: with every test suite running at once the machine is busy.)
    net::bot::command(&mut bots, "ct leave").unwrap();
    play("paused after leaving", &mut server, &mut bots, 30, &mut events, |b, _| b[t].client.round.paused);
    net::bot::command(&mut bots, "ct rejoin").unwrap();
    play("resumed after rejoining", &mut server, &mut bots, 30, &mut events, |b, _| !b[t].client.round.paused);
}
```

`net/tests/breakables.rs`:

```rs
//! Breakables over localhost UDP: nuke's glass breaks when shot (and stops blocking),
//! dust2's crates break when the bomb goes off at their site, all come back next round.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::protocol::{GameEvent, Team};
use sim::pmove::Input;

#[test]
fn shooting_nukes_glass_breaks_it_for_everyone() {
    let Some(bsp) = map("de_nuke") else { return };
    let glass = sim::breakables::from_bsp(&bsp).into_iter().find(|b| b.material == sim::breakables::Material::Glass).expect("nuke has glass");
    let m = bsp.models[glass.model];
    // The thin axis is the glass's facing: stand 120 units off it, eyes level with its middle.
    let size: Vec<f32> = (0..3).map(|i| m.maxs[i] - m.mins[i]).collect();
    let axis = if size[0] < size[1] { 0 } else { 1 };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::T));
    let a = g.a.id().unwrap();
    let world = sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let c = glass.center;
    let spot = [-1.0f32, 1.0]
        .iter()
        .map(|s| {
            let mut o = [c[0], c[1], c[2] - 17.0];
            o[axis] += 120.0 * s;
            o
        })
        .find(|o| !world.is_solid(sim::collision::Hull::Standing, *o))
        .expect("room on one side of the glass");
    g.server.teleport(a, spot);
    let yaw = if axis == 0 { if spot[0] > c[0] { 180.0 } else { 0.0 } } else if spot[1] > c[1] { 270.0 } else { 90.0 };
    let mut broke = false;
    for t in 0..400 {
        // Teleporting resets velocity each tick so A stays put while shooting.
        if t % 8 == 0 {
            g.server.teleport(a, spot);
        }
        g.tick(Input { yaw, pitch: 0.0, attack: t % 16 < 2, ..Default::default() }, Input::default());
        broke |= g.b.take_events().iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::Broke { model, .. } if *model as usize == glass.model));
        let _ = g.a.take_events();
        if broke && g.b.broken.contains(&(glass.model as u16)) {
            break;
        }
    }
    assert!(broke, "glass never broke");
    assert!(g.b.broken.contains(&(glass.model as u16)), "B's world doesn't know");
    // It no longer blocks a line through it, on the client too.
    let from = [spot[0], spot[1], c[2]];
    assert!(g.b.world.trace_line(from, c).fraction >= 1.0);
}
```

`net/tests/common/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Shared by the network tests: a server and two clients over real localhost UDP.
//! Tests are skipped when de_dust2 isn't installed.
#![allow(dead_code)]
use goldsrc::bsp::Bsp;
use net::{Client, Server};
use sim::collision::World;
use sim::pmove::Input;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::time::Duration;

pub fn game_dir() -> Option<String> {
    Some(net::gamefiles::data_dir().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
}

pub fn map(name: &str) -> Option<Bsp> {
    Bsp::load(format!("{}/maps/{name}.bsp", game_dir()?)).ok()
}

pub fn dust2() -> Option<Bsp> {
    Bsp::load(format!("{}/maps/de_dust2.bsp", game_dir()?)).ok()
}

pub fn assets() -> net::server::Assets {
    let dir = game_dir().unwrap();
    let model = goldsrc::mdl::Model::load(format!("{dir}/models/player/arctic/arctic.mdl")).expect("player model");
    net::server::Assets {
        hitboxes: sim::hitbox::Hitboxes::from_model(&model, "carbine").unwrap(),
        materials: goldsrc::materials::Materials::parse(&std::fs::read_to_string(format!("{dir}/sound/materials.txt")).unwrap_or_default()),
    }
}

pub struct Game {
    pub server: Server,
    pub a: Client,
    pub b: Client,
}

/// A server and two clients; engine tests use rules that stay out of the way:
/// no freeze time, money to spare, teammates hittable.
pub fn setup(bsp: &Bsp, ping_ms: u32, loss: f32) -> Game {
    setup_with(bsp, ping_ms, loss, net::config::MatchConfig { freeze_time: 0.0, buy_time: 1e6, round_time: 1e6, start_money: 16_000, friendly_fire: true, ..Default::default() })
}

pub fn setup_with(bsp: &Bsp, ping_ms: u32, loss: f32, cfg: net::config::MatchConfig) -> Game {
    let mut server = Server::new(SocketAddr::from(([127, 0, 0, 1], 0)), "test", bsp, assets()).unwrap();
    server.set_config(cfg);
    let addr = server.local_addr();
    let mut a = Client::connect(addr, "a", World::from_bsp(bsp)).unwrap();
    let mut b = Client::connect(addr, "b", World::from_bsp(bsp)).unwrap();
    a.simulate_network(ping_ms, loss);
    b.simulate_network(ping_ms, loss);
    Game { server, a, b }
}

impl Game {
    /// One tick of everything; a short sleep lets localhost packets arrive.
    pub fn tick(&mut self, ia: Input, ib: Input) {
        self.server.step();
        self.a.tick(ia);
        self.b.tick(ib);
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(150));
    }

    /// Connect and pick sides (auto puts them on opposite teams).
    pub fn connect(&mut self) {
        self.connect_as(None, None);
    }

    /// Connect and join the given teams (same team = neighbouring spawns, handy for shooting tests).
    pub fn connect_as(&mut self, a: Option<net::protocol::Team>, b: Option<net::protocol::Team>) {
        for _ in 0..128 {
            self.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
        }
        self.a.join_team(a);
        for _ in 0..8 {
            self.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
        }
        self.b.join_team(b);
        for _ in 0..128 {
            self.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
        }
        assert!(self.a.id().is_some() && self.b.id().is_some(), "{:?} {:?}", self.a.status, self.b.status);
        assert!(self.server.player_count() >= 2);
        if a != Some(net::protocol::Team::Spectator) {
            assert!(self.server.vitals(self.a.id().unwrap()).unwrap().alive(), "A spawned");
        }
    }
}

pub fn dist(a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3]) -> f32 {
    ((a[0] - b[0]).powi(2) + (a[1] - b[1]).powi(2) + (a[2] - b[2]).powi(2)).sqrt()
}
```

`net/tests/crowd.rs`:

```rs
//! Players are solid to each other: running at someone stops at their edge.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::protocol::Team;
use sim::pmove::Input;

fn flat_distance(a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3]) -> f32 {
    ((a[0] - b[0]).powi(2) + (a[1] - b[1]).powi(2)).sqrt()
}

#[test]
fn a_player_running_at_another_stops_at_their_edge() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::T));
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    let (pa, pb) = (g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin, g.server.player(b).unwrap().origin);
    let yaw = (pb[1] - pa[1]).atan2(pb[0] - pa[0]).to_degrees();
    let mut closest = f32::MAX;
    for _ in 0..400 {
        g.tick(Input { forward: 400.0, yaw, ..Default::default() }, Input::default());
        let (pa, pb) = (g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin, g.server.player(b).unwrap().origin);
        closest = closest.min(flat_distance(pa, pb));
    }
    // The boxes are 32 wide: centres never get much closer than that.
    assert!(closest > 28.0, "walked into the other player: closest {closest}");
    assert!(closest < 60.0, "never reached them ({closest}): the test proves nothing");
}
```

`net/tests/deathmatch.rs`:

```rs
//! Deathmatch, the way players get it: ask the lobby for a seat, drop into the deathmatch
//! server (encrypted, no booking), fight, come back at once at a random spawn, and when
//! someone reaches the kill limit everyone's score starts over. No seat: no way in.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::bot::{Bot, BotMap, Difficulty, Profile};
use net::lobby::{Command, LobbyClient, LobbyServer};
use net::protocol::GameEvent;
use net::server::{Rules, Server};
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

const LOCAL: ([u8; 4], u16) = ([127, 0, 0, 1], 0);

#[test]
fn drop_in_fight_respawn_and_the_kill_limit_resets_scores() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let map = BotMap::new(bsp, "de_dust2");
    let mut m = LobbyServer::bind(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), vec!["tok".into()]).unwrap();
    let lobby = m.local_addr();
    std::thread::spawn(move || m.run());
    let mut server = Server::new(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), "dm", &map.bsp, assets()).unwrap();
    server.set_config(net::config::MatchConfig { lobby: lobby.to_string(), official_token: "tok".into(), deathmatch: true, max_players: 20, ..Default::default() });
    server.set_rules(Rules { kill_limit: 1, ..Rules::deathmatch() });
    // Two players ask for deathmatch and get seats on it.
    let mut cs: Vec<LobbyClient> = (0..2).map(|i| LobbyClient::new(lobby, &format!("p{i}")).unwrap()).collect();
    let mut asked = [false; 2];
    let mut bots: Vec<Bot> = Vec::new();
    let start = Instant::now();
    while bots.len() < 2 {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(10), "no deathmatch seats");
        server.step();
        for (i, c) in cs.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            c.tick();
            if c.online() && !asked[i] {
                asked[i] = true;
                c.send(Command::Deathmatch);
            }
            if let Some((addr, ticket, key)) = c.found.take() {
                assert_eq!(addr, server.local_addr());
                let mut client = net::Client::connect(addr, &format!("p{i}"), map.world()).unwrap();
                client.ticket = ticket;
                client.key = Some(key);
                bots.push(Bot::new(client, map.clone(), i, Profile::of(Difficulty::Expert)));
            }
        }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
    }
    // A walk-in without a seat gets nowhere.
    let mut walk_in = net::Client::connect(server.local_addr(), "x", map.world()).unwrap();
    // Straight onto a team (no team pick), they fight, die, come back.
    let (mut events, mut ticks) = (Vec::new(), 0);
    while !events.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::KillLimit { .. })) {
        ticks += 1;
        assert!(ticks < 128 * 240, "nobody reached the kill limit ({} events)", events.len());
        server.step();
        walk_in.tick(sim::pmove::Input::default());
        for b in bots.iter_mut() {
            b.tick();
        }
        events.extend(bots[0].take_events());
        bots[1].take_events();
        if ticks % 8 == 0 {
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(200));
        }
    }
    assert!(walk_in.id().is_none(), "no seat, no way in");
    // Back in the fight straight away, and the scores started over.
    for _ in 0..3 * 128 {
        server.step();
        bots.iter_mut().for_each(|b| b.tick());
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(150));
    }
    assert!(bots.iter().all(|b| b.client.vitals.alive()), "everyone respawned");
    assert!(bots[0].client.scores.iter().all(|s| s.kills <= 1), "scores started over: {:?}", bots[0].client.scores);
}

#[test]
fn the_aim_check_flags_an_aimbot_and_nobody_else() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let map = BotMap::new(bsp, "de_dust2");
    let reports = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("bootleg16-aim-{}.jsonl", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&reports);
    let mut m = LobbyServer::bind(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), vec!["tok".into()]).unwrap();
    m.reports = Some(reports.clone());
    let lobby = m.local_addr();
    std::thread::spawn(move || m.run());
    let mut server = Server::new(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), "dm", &map.bsp, assets()).unwrap();
    server.set_config(net::config::MatchConfig { lobby: lobby.to_string(), official_token: "tok".into(), deathmatch: true, max_players: 20, ..Default::default() });
    // Six players: one cheats with an aimbot; the honest ones are hard and normal bots.
    let mut cs: Vec<LobbyClient> = (0..6).map(|i| LobbyClient::new(lobby, &format!("p{i}")).unwrap()).collect();
    let mut asked = [false; 6];
    let mut bots: Vec<Bot> = Vec::new();
    let start = Instant::now();
    while bots.len() < 6 {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(10), "no deathmatch seats");
        server.step();
        for (i, c) in cs.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            c.tick();
            if c.online() && !asked[i] {
                asked[i] = true;
                c.send(Command::Deathmatch);
            }
            if let Some((addr, ticket, key)) = c.found.take() {
                let mut client = net::Client::connect(addr, &format!("p{i}"), map.world()).unwrap();
                client.ticket = ticket;
                client.key = Some(key);
                // (Expert bots lock onto heads: not a fair stand-in for honest people.)
                let level = if i % 2 == 0 { Difficulty::Hard } else { Difficulty::Normal };
                let mut b = Bot::new(client, map.clone(), i, Profile::of(level));
                if i == 0 {
                    b.mode = net::bot::Mode::Aimbot;
                }
                bots.push(b);
            }
        }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
    }
    // (Named after their sign-in: p0 is the aimbot.)
    let cheater = "p0".to_string();
    let flagged = |path: &std::path::Path| std::fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap_or_default();
    let mut ticks = 0;
    while !flagged(&reports).contains(&format!("\"name\":\"{cheater}\"")) {
        ticks += 1;
        assert!(ticks < 128 * 600, "the aimbot wasn't flagged in 10 game minutes");
        server.step();
        bots.iter_mut().for_each(|b| {
            b.tick();
            b.take_events();
        });
        if ticks % 8 == 0 {
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(200));
        }
    }
    // Give the honest ones the same time again: none of them may be flagged.
    for t in 0..ticks {
        server.step();
        bots.iter_mut().for_each(|b| {
            b.tick();
            b.take_events();
        });
        if t % 8 == 0 {
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(200));
        }
    }
    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300));
    let text = flagged(&reports);
    println!("{text}");
    let honest_flagged: Vec<&str> = text.lines().filter(|l| !l.contains(&format!("\"name\":\"{cheater}\""))).collect();
    assert!(honest_flagged.is_empty(), "honest players flagged: {honest_flagged:?}");
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&reports);
}
```

`net/tests/guard.rs`:

```rs
//! Server protection over localhost UDP: joining needs the server's cookie, a flood from one
//! address is cut off, and junk / oversized packets are ignored.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::protocol::{decode, encode, ClientMsg, ServerMsg, PROTOCOL_VERSION};
use std::net::{SocketAddr, UdpSocket};
use std::time::Duration;

fn recv(udp: &UdpSocket) -> Vec<ServerMsg> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut buf = [0u8; 4096];
    while let Ok((n, _)) = udp.recv_from(&mut buf) {
        out.extend(decode::<ServerMsg>(&buf[..n]));
    }
    out
}

#[test]
fn join_needs_the_cookie_and_floods_are_cut_off() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut server = net::Server::new(SocketAddr::from(([127, 0, 0, 1], 0)), "de_dust2", &bsp, assets()).unwrap();
    let addr = server.local_addr();
    let udp = UdpSocket::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    udp.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_millis(20))).unwrap();
    let hello = |cookie| encode(&ClientMsg::Hello { version: PROTOCOL_VERSION, name: "x".into(), cookie, ticket: 0 });
    // A Hello without the cookie gets a challenge, no slot.
    udp.send_to(&hello(0), addr).unwrap();
    server.step();
    let msgs = recv(&udp);
    let Some(ServerMsg::Challenge { cookie }) = msgs.first().cloned() else { panic!("{msgs:?}") };
    assert_eq!(server.player_count(), 0);
    // A wrong cookie (a spoofer can't see ours) gets nothing but another challenge.
    udp.send_to(&hello(cookie ^ 1), addr).unwrap();
    server.step();
    assert!(recv(&udp).iter().all(|m| matches!(m, ServerMsg::Challenge { .. })));
    assert_eq!(server.player_count(), 0);
    // Echoing it joins.
    udp.send_to(&hello(cookie), addr).unwrap();
    server.step();
    assert!(recv(&udp).iter().any(|m| matches!(m, ServerMsg::Welcome { .. })));
    assert_eq!(server.player_count(), 1);

    // A stranger flooding info requests: only the first ~20 a second get an answer.
    let flood = UdpSocket::bind("127.0.0.2:0").unwrap();
    flood.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_millis(20))).unwrap();
    let info = encode(&ClientMsg::Info { pad: vec![0; net::protocol::INFO_PAD] });
    for _ in 0..500 {
        flood.send_to(&info, addr).unwrap();
    }
    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(20));
    server.step();
    let answers = recv(&flood).len();
    assert!((1..=25).contains(&answers), "{answers} answers to 500 requests");
    // Oversized and garbage packets: ignored, no crash.
    flood.send_to(&[0xffu8; 1500], addr).ok();
    flood.send_to(&[1, 2, 3], addr).unwrap();
    server.step();
}
```

`net/tests/leavers.rs`:

```rs
//! Leaving a reserved match: one leaver changes nothing until they've been gone 5 minutes;
//! then their team may vote to surrender. A side with nobody left pauses the match, and
//! forfeits if it stays empty.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::protocol::{GameEvent, Team};
use net::server::{Group, MatchSetup};
use sim::pmove::Input;

/// Fast-forward: the server and the given clients, no sleeping (localhost is quick enough
/// with a short pause every few ticks).
fn run(g: &mut Game, extra: &mut [&mut net::Client], ticks: u32, events: &mut Vec<GameEvent>) {
    for t in 0..ticks {
        g.server.step();
        g.a.tick(Input::default());
        events.extend(g.a.take_events());
        g.b.tick(Input::default());
        for c in extra.iter_mut() {
            c.tick(Input::default());
        }
        if t % 8 == 0 {
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_micros(150));
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn surrender_after_a_teammate_abandons() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, net::config::MatchConfig { round_time: 1e6, ..Default::default() });
    g.server.reserve(MatchSetup { players: vec![(1, Group::A), (2, Group::A), (3, Group::B)], knife_round: false, keys: Vec::new(), map: String::new() });
    g.a.ticket = 1;
    g.b.ticket = 3;
    let mut mate = net::Client::connect(g.server.local_addr(), "mate", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
    mate.ticket = 2;
    let mut ev = Vec::new();
    run(&mut g, &mut [&mut mate], 256, &mut ev);
    assert_eq!((g.a.team(), mate.team(), g.b.team()), (Team::T, Team::T, Team::Ct));
    // A's teammate leaves: nothing happens, and a surrender can't be called yet.
    mate.disconnect();
    run(&mut g, &mut [], 128, &mut ev);
    g.a.call_surrender();
    run(&mut g, &mut [], 64, &mut ev);
    assert!(g.a.round.vote.is_none(), "too early: they may come back");
    // Five minutes later they count as abandoned: A calls the vote, which passes (A is the
    // whole connected team), and B's team wins the match.
    run(&mut g, &mut [], 300 * 128, &mut ev);
    assert_eq!(g.a.round.abandoned, [true, false]);
    g.a.call_surrender();
    run(&mut g, &mut [], 128, &mut ev);
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| *e == GameEvent::Surrendered { team: Team::T }), "{ev:?}");
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| *e == GameEvent::MatchOver { winner: Some(Team::Ct) }));
}

#[test]
fn an_empty_side_pauses_then_forfeits() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, net::config::MatchConfig { freeze_time: 1.0, round_time: 30.0, ..Default::default() });
    g.server.reserve(MatchSetup { players: vec![(1, Group::A), (2, Group::B)], knife_round: false, keys: Vec::new(), map: String::new() });
    g.a.ticket = 1;
    g.b.ticket = 2;
    let mut ev = Vec::new();
    run(&mut g, &mut [], 3 * 128, &mut ev);
    let round = g.a.round.round;
    assert!(round >= 1);
    g.b.disconnect();
    // A minute later: still the same round, and the clock hasn't run out (paused).
    run(&mut g, &mut [], 60 * 128, &mut ev);
    assert_eq!(g.a.round.round, round, "paused, no rounds handed out");
    assert!(!ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::MatchOver { .. })));
    // Nobody came back for five minutes: the side forfeits.
    run(&mut g, &mut [], 241 * 128, &mut ev);
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| *e == GameEvent::MatchOver { winner: Some(Team::T) }), "{ev:?}");
}

#[test]
fn a_team_votes_a_teammate_out() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, net::config::MatchConfig { round_time: 1e6, ..Default::default() });
    g.server.reserve(MatchSetup { players: vec![(1, Group::A), (2, Group::A), (3, Group::B)], knife_round: false, keys: Vec::new(), map: String::new() });
    g.a.ticket = 1;
    g.b.ticket = 3;
    let mut mate = net::Client::connect(g.server.local_addr(), "mate", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
    mate.ticket = 2;
    let mut ev = Vec::new();
    run(&mut g, &mut [&mut mate], 256, &mut ev);
    let target = mate.id().unwrap();
    // A calls the vote; with the target not voting, A alone is the majority: out.
    g.a.call_kick(target);
    run(&mut g, &mut [&mut mate], 128, &mut ev);
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| *e == GameEvent::VotedOut { player: target }), "{ev:?}");
    assert_eq!(mate.status, net::client::Status::Rejected);
    // They can't come back, and A's team may now surrender (a teammate is gone for good).
    let mut back = net::Client::connect(g.server.local_addr(), "mate", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
    back.ticket = 2;
    run(&mut g, &mut [&mut back], 256, &mut ev);
    assert!(back.id().is_none());
    assert_eq!(g.a.round.abandoned, [true, false]);
    // B can't vote someone off A's team.
    g.b.call_kick(g.a.id().unwrap());
    run(&mut g, &mut [], 64, &mut ev);
    assert!(g.a.round.vote.is_none() && g.a.id().is_some());
}

#[test]
fn a_dropped_player_rejoins_their_seat() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, net::config::MatchConfig { round_time: 1e6, ..Default::default() });
    g.server.reserve(MatchSetup { players: vec![(1, Group::A), (2, Group::B)], knife_round: false, keys: Vec::new(), map: String::new() });
    g.a.ticket = 1;
    g.b.ticket = 2;
    let mut ev = Vec::new();
    run(&mut g, &mut [], 256, &mut ev);
    let before = g.server.player_count();
    // A's network goes dark for 6 s: the server drops them (5 s timeout), A hears nothing.
    g.a.simulate_network(0, 1.0);
    run(&mut g, &mut [], 6 * 128, &mut ev);
    assert_eq!(g.server.player_count(), before - 1, "dropped");
    assert!(g.a.silence() > 5.0);
    g.a.simulate_network(0, 0.0);
    // A rejoins: back in, on their own side.
    g.a.rejoin();
    run(&mut g, &mut [], 256, &mut ev);
    assert!(matches!(g.a.status, net::client::Status::Connected { .. }), "{:?}", g.a.status);
    assert!(g.a.silence() < 0.1);
    assert_eq!(g.server.player_count(), before);
    assert_eq!(g.a.team(), Team::T);
}
```
