`net/tests/lobby.rs`:

```rs
//! The lobby over localhost UDP: friends party up by code (custom game, teams A/B) or queue
//! for casual; the lobby reserves the official game server and both get in with tickets.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::lobby::{Command, LobbyClient, LobbyServer, Mode};
use net::protocol::Team;
use net::server::{Group, Server};
use sim::pmove::Input;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

/// Test players accept found matches straight away.
fn accepting(mut c: LobbyClient) -> LobbyClient {
    c.auto_accept = true;
    c
}

const LOCAL: ([u8; 4], u16) = ([127, 0, 0, 1], 0);

/// A lobby (in its own thread) and an official game server announcing to it.
fn world(bsp: &goldsrc::bsp::Bsp, match_size: usize) -> (Server, SocketAddr) {
    world_with(bsp, match_size, None)
}

fn world_with(bsp: &goldsrc::bsp::Bsp, match_size: usize, reports: Option<std::path::PathBuf>) -> (Server, SocketAddr) {
    let mut m = LobbyServer::bind(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), vec!["tok".into()]).unwrap();
    m.match_size = match_size;
    m.reports = reports;
    let lobby = m.local_addr();
    std::thread::spawn(move || m.run());
    let mut server = Server::new(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), "test", bsp, assets()).unwrap();
    server.set_config(net::config::MatchConfig { lobby: lobby.to_string(), official_token: "tok".into(), ..Default::default() });
    (server, lobby)
}

/// Step the server and lobby clients until `done` (or panic after a while).
fn until(server: &mut Server, cs: &mut [&mut LobbyClient], what: &str, done: impl Fn(&[&mut LobbyClient]) -> bool) {
    let start = Instant::now();
    while !done(cs) {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5), "timed out: {what}");
        server.step();
        for c in cs.iter_mut() {
            c.tick();
        }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
    }
}

/// Both join the server they were sent to with their tickets; returns their teams.
fn play(server: &mut Server, bsp: &goldsrc::bsp::Bsp, found: [(SocketAddr, u64, [u8; 32]); 2]) -> [Team; 2] {
    let mut cs: Vec<net::Client> = found
        .iter()
        .map(|(addr, ticket, key)| {
            assert_eq!(*addr, server.local_addr());
            let mut c = net::Client::connect(*addr, "p", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(bsp)).unwrap();
            c.ticket = *ticket;
            c.key = Some(*key);
            c
        })
        .collect();
    for _ in 0..256 {
        server.step();
        cs.iter_mut().for_each(|c| _ = c.tick(Input::default()));
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(150));
    }
    [cs[0].team(), cs[1].team()]
}

#[test]
fn custom_game_with_a_friend() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let (mut server, lobby) = world(&bsp, 2);
    let (mut a, mut b) = (accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "a").unwrap()), accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "b").unwrap()));
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "sign in", |c| c.iter().all(|c| c.online()));
    // B joins A's party by code; A makes it a custom game and puts B on team B.
    let code = a.state.as_ref().unwrap().code.clone();
    b.send(Command::JoinParty { code: code.to_lowercase() });
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "party", |c| c[0].state.as_ref().unwrap().members.len() == 2);
    let st = a.state.clone().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(st.leader, st.you);
    b.send(Command::Play);
    a.send(Command::SetMode(Mode::Custom));
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "notice", |c| !c[1].notice.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(b.notice, "Only the party leader can do that.");
    let bid = b.state.as_ref().unwrap().you;
    a.send(Command::Move { member: bid, group: Group::B });
    a.send(Command::Play);
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "match found", |c| c.iter().all(|c| c.found.is_some()));
    let teams = play(&mut server, &bsp, [a.found.unwrap(), b.found.unwrap()]);
    assert_eq!(teams, [Team::T, Team::Ct], "A starts T (knife round decides later)");
}

#[test]
fn casual_queue_matches_two_strangers() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let (mut server, lobby) = world(&bsp, 2);
    let (mut a, mut b) = (accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "a").unwrap()), accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "b").unwrap()));
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "sign in", |c| c.iter().all(|c| c.online()));
    a.send(Command::Play);
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "queued", |c| c[0].state.as_ref().unwrap().searching.is_some());
    b.send(Command::Play);
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "match found", |c| c.iter().all(|c| c.found.is_some()));
    let teams = play(&mut server, &bsp, [a.found.unwrap(), b.found.unwrap()]);
    assert!(teams.contains(&Team::T) && teams.contains(&Team::Ct), "{teams:?}");
}

#[test]
fn steam_sign_in_and_lobby_restart() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let (mut server, lobby) = world(&bsp, 2);
    let login = |id: u64| -> Option<Box<dyn FnMut() -> Option<net::lobby::SteamLogin> + Send + Sync>> { Some(Box::new(move || Some(net::lobby::SteamLogin { steam_id: id, ticket: vec![1, 2, 3] }))) };
    let mut a = accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "a").unwrap());
    a.steam = login(76561197960287930);
    let mut b = accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "b").unwrap());
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "sign in", |c| c.iter().all(|c| c.online()));
    // B invites A (in the game, signed in with Steam); A accepts by joining that party.
    b.send(Command::Invite { steam: 76561197960287930 });
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "invite", |c| !c[0].state.as_ref().unwrap().invites.is_empty());
    let inv = a.state.as_ref().unwrap().invites[0].clone();
    assert_eq!((inv.from.as_str(), inv.code.as_str()), ("b", b.state.as_ref().unwrap().code.as_str()));
    a.send(Command::JoinParty { code: inv.code });
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "party", |c| c[1].state.as_ref().unwrap().members.len() == 2);
    let m = &b.state.as_ref().unwrap().members;
    assert_eq!((m[0].steam, m[1].steam), (0, 76561197960287930), "B sees A's Steam id (for the avatar)");
    // Someone else claims A's Steam id on this unchecked (trust) lobby: they get in, but
    // without it, and A stays (a claim must never push anyone out).
    let mut a2 = accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "a").unwrap());
    a2.steam = login(76561197960287930);
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a2, &mut b], "claimer in", |c| c[0].online());
    assert_eq!(a2.state.as_ref().unwrap().members[0].steam, 0);
    assert_eq!(b.state.as_ref().unwrap().members.len(), 2);
}

#[test]
fn a_checked_steam_sign_in_replaces_the_older_one() {
    // With Steam checks, a second sign-in Steam confirmed ends the first session.
    let mut m = LobbyServer::bind(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), vec![]).unwrap();
    m.steam_mode = net::lobby::SteamMode::Verify;
    let login = || -> Option<Box<dyn FnMut() -> Option<net::lobby::SteamLogin> + Send + Sync>> { Some(Box::new(|| Some(net::lobby::SteamLogin { steam_id: 5, ticket: vec![9] }))) };
    let (mut first, mut second) = (accepting(LobbyClient::new(m.local_addr(), "x").unwrap()), accepting(LobbyClient::new(m.local_addr(), "x").unwrap()));
    first.steam = login();
    second.steam = login();
    let start = Instant::now();
    let mut checked = 0;
    while checked < 2 || !second.online() {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5));
        m.step();
        first.tick();
        if checked >= 1 {
            second.tick();
        }
        for (session, id, _) in m.take_steam_checks() {
            m.steam_checked(id, Some(session)); // what Steam would say for a good ticket
            checked += 1;
        }
    }
    // The first one is gone: its next poll gets Expired and it signs in afresh.
    let code = first.state.as_ref().unwrap().code.clone();
    while first.state.as_ref().unwrap().code == code {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(10));
        m.step();
        first.tick();
        second.tick();
        let _ = m.take_steam_checks();
    }
}

#[test]
fn answers_never_outgrow_requests() {
    // The biggest state the lobby sends, against the smallest request it answers.
    let long = "W".repeat(24);
    let addr: SocketAddr = "[2001:db8::1]:27015".parse().unwrap();
    let state = net::lobby::LobbyState {
        you: u32::MAX,
        code: "ABC-DEF".into(),
        leader: u32::MAX,
        mode: net::lobby::Mode::Custom,
        members: (0..net::lobby::MAX_CUSTOM).map(|i| net::lobby::Member { id: u32::MAX - i as u32, name: long.clone(), group: net::server::Group::B, steam: u64::MAX }).collect(),
        searching: Some(1e9),
        found: Some((addr, u64::MAX, [255; 32])),
        rejoin: Some((addr, u64::MAX, [255; 32])),
        ready: Some(net::lobby::ReadyNet { accepted: 10, total: 10, left: 20.0, you: true }),
        cooldown: Some(1e9),
        // (The lobby only ever lists pool maps.)
        map: Some("de_inferno".into()),
        notice: "Too many players from your address, or the lobby is full. Try again later.".into(),
        invites: (0..net::lobby::MAX_INVITES).map(|_| net::lobby::Invite { from: long.clone(), steam: u64::MAX, code: "ABC-DEF".into(), left: 30.0 }).collect(),
        regions: (0..net::lobby::MAX_REGIONS).map(|_| ("x".repeat(16), addr)).collect(),
    };
    let answer = net::protocol::encode(&net::lobby::LobbyMsg::State(state)).len();
    // Both travel sealed in the session channel, which adds the same to each.
    let request = net::protocol::encode(&net::lobby::LobbyMsg::Command { cmd: Command::Poll, pad: vec![0; net::lobby::PAD] }).len();
    assert!(answer <= request, "answer {answer} bytes, request {request}");
}

#[test]
fn signs_in_again_after_the_lobby_restarts() {
    // A lobby that has never heard of our session answers Expired; the client signs in again.
    let first = LobbyServer::bind(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), vec![]).unwrap();
    let addr = first.local_addr();
    let mut c = accepting(LobbyClient::new(addr, "a").unwrap());
    let mut m = first;
    let start = Instant::now();
    while !c.online() {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5));
        m.step();
        c.tick();
    }
    let code = c.state.as_ref().unwrap().code.clone();
    drop(m);
    let mut m = LobbyServer::bind(addr, vec![]).unwrap();
    while c.state.as_ref().unwrap().code == code {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(10), "never signed in again");
        m.step();
        c.tick();
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
    }
}

#[test]
fn queue_books_the_region_players_ping_best() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let (mut eu, lobby) = world(&bsp, 2);
    let mut na = Server::new(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), "test", &bsp, assets()).unwrap();
    na.set_config(net::config::MatchConfig { lobby: lobby.to_string(), official_token: "tok".into(), region: "na".into(), ..Default::default() });
    let (mut a, mut b) = (accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "a").unwrap()), accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "b").unwrap()));
    let both = |eu: &mut Server, na: &mut Server, cs: &mut [&mut LobbyClient], what: &str, done: &dyn Fn(&[&mut LobbyClient]) -> bool| {
        let start = Instant::now();
        while !done(cs) {
            assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5), "timed out: {what}");
            eu.step();
            na.step();
            cs.iter_mut().for_each(|c| c.tick());
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
        }
    };
    both(&mut eu, &mut na, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "both regions listed", &|c| c.iter().all(|c| c.state.as_ref().is_some_and(|s| s.regions.len() == 2)));
    // Let the automatic pings (both ~0 ms on localhost) go out, then say we're far from eu.
    let t = Instant::now();
    both(&mut eu, &mut na, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "pings", &|_| t.elapsed() > Duration::from_millis(300));
    for c in [&mut a, &mut b] {
        c.send(Command::Pings(vec![("eu".into(), 150), ("na".into(), 25)]));
        c.send(Command::Play);
    }
    both(&mut eu, &mut na, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "match found", &|c| c.iter().all(|c| c.found.is_some()));
    assert_eq!(a.found.unwrap().0, na.local_addr(), "booked in na, where both ping 25 ms");
}

#[test]
fn reports_are_filed_with_steam_ids() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("bootleg16-reports-{}.jsonl", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
    let (mut server, lobby) = world_with(&bsp, 2, Some(path.clone()));
    let mut a = accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "a").unwrap());
    a.steam = Some(Box::new(|| Some(net::lobby::SteamLogin { steam_id: 111, ticket: vec![] })));
    let mut b = accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "b \"quoted\"").unwrap());
    b.steam = Some(Box::new(|| Some(net::lobby::SteamLogin { steam_id: 222, ticket: vec![] })));
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "sign in", |c| c.iter().all(|c| c.online()));
    a.send(Command::Play);
    b.send(Command::Play);
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "match found", |c| c.iter().all(|c| c.found.is_some()));
    let mut cs: Vec<net::Client> = [a.found.unwrap(), b.found.unwrap()]
        .iter()
        .map(|(addr, ticket, key)| {
            let mut c = net::Client::connect(*addr, "p", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
            c.ticket = *ticket;
            c.key = Some(*key);
            c
        })
        .collect();
    for _ in 0..256 {
        server.step();
        cs.iter_mut().for_each(|c| _ = c.tick(Input::default()));
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(150));
    }
    let target = cs[1].id().unwrap();
    cs[0].report(target, net::protocol::ReportReason::Cheating);
    cs[0].report(target, net::protocol::ReportReason::Cheating); // once per player
    let start = Instant::now();
    while std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap_or_default().is_empty() {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(5), "no report filed");
        server.step();
        cs.iter_mut().for_each(|c| _ = c.tick(Input::default()));
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(2));
    }
    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300));
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(text.lines().count(), 1, "{text}");
    for want in ["\"reason\":\"Cheating\"", "\"steam\":111", "\"steam\":222,\"name\":\"b \\\"quoted\\\"\"", "\"map\":\"test\"", "\"server\":\""] {
        assert!(text.contains(want), "{want} in {text}");
    }
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
}

#[test]
fn official_servers_only_take_booked_players() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };

#[test]
fn a_seen_ticket_without_its_key_gets_nobody_in() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let (mut server, lobby) = world(&bsp, 2);
    let (mut a, mut b) = (accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "a").unwrap()), accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "b").unwrap()));
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "sign in", |c| c.iter().all(|c| c.online()));
    a.send(Command::Play);
    b.send(Command::Play);
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "match found", |c| c.iter().all(|c| c.found.is_some()));
    let (addr, ticket, key) = a.found.unwrap();
    // Someone who saw A's ticket (but not the key, which never travels in the clear) tries
    // first; then A joins for real.
    let mut thief = net::Client::connect(addr, "thief", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
    thief.ticket = ticket;
    thief.key = Some([7; 32]);
    let mut real = net::Client::connect(addr, "a", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
    real.ticket = ticket;
    real.key = Some(key);
    for t in 0..512 {
        server.step();
        thief.tick(Input::default());
        if t > 256 {
            real.tick(Input::default());
        }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(150));
    }
    assert!(thief.id().is_none(), "the wrong key gets nowhere");
    assert!(real.id().is_some(), "the seat is still A's");
}

/// A lobby stepped by the test itself (to stand in for Steam's answers), with an official
/// server in its pool.
fn manual_world(bsp: &goldsrc::bsp::Bsp) -> (LobbyServer, Server) {
    let mut m = LobbyServer::bind(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), vec!["tok".into()]).unwrap();
    m.match_size = 2;
    m.steam_mode = net::lobby::SteamMode::Verify;
    let mut server = Server::new(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), "test", bsp, assets()).unwrap();
    server.set_config(net::config::MatchConfig { lobby: m.local_addr().to_string(), official_token: "tok".into(), ..Default::default() });
    (m, server)
}

fn steam(id: u64) -> Option<Box<dyn FnMut() -> Option<net::lobby::SteamLogin> + Send + Sync>> {
    Some(Box::new(move || Some(net::lobby::SteamLogin { steam_id: id, ticket: vec![1] })))
}

fn step_all(m: &mut LobbyServer, server: &mut Server, cs: &mut [&mut LobbyClient], secs: u64, what: &str, done: &dyn Fn(&[&mut LobbyClient]) -> bool) {
    let start = Instant::now();
    while !done(cs) {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(secs), "timed out: {what}");
        m.step();
        server.step();
        cs.iter_mut().for_each(|c| c.tick());
        for (session, id, _) in m.take_steam_checks() {
            m.steam_checked(id, Some(session)); // Steam says yes
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn not_accepting_a_match_costs_a_cooldown_and_the_other_keeps_their_place() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let (mut m, mut server) = manual_world(&bsp);
    let (mut a, mut b) = (LobbyClient::new(m.local_addr(), "a").unwrap(), accepting(LobbyClient::new(m.local_addr(), "b").unwrap()));
    a.steam = steam(1);
    b.steam = steam(2);
    step_all(&mut m, &mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 5, "sign in", &|c| c.iter().all(|c| c.online()));
    a.send(Command::Play);
    b.send(Command::Play);
    step_all(&mut m, &mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 5, "match found", &|c| c[0].state.as_ref().unwrap().ready.is_some());
    a.send(Command::Decline);
    step_all(&mut m, &mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 5, "check over", &|c| c[0].state.as_ref().unwrap().ready.is_none() && c[1].state.as_ref().unwrap().ready.is_none());
    let (sa, sb) = (a.state.clone().unwrap(), b.state.clone().unwrap());
    assert!(sa.cooldown.is_some() && sa.searching.is_none(), "A: out of the queue, cooling down");
    assert!(sb.cooldown.is_none() && sb.searching.is_some(), "B: still queued");
    a.send(Command::Play);
    step_all(&mut m, &mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 5, "refused", &|c| !c[0].notice.is_empty());
    assert!(a.state.as_ref().unwrap().searching.is_none(), "can't queue while cooling down");
}

#[test]
fn a_restarted_game_is_offered_its_running_match() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let (mut m, mut server) = manual_world(&bsp);
    let (mut a, mut b) = (accepting(LobbyClient::new(m.local_addr(), "a").unwrap()), accepting(LobbyClient::new(m.local_addr(), "b").unwrap()));
    a.steam = steam(1);
    b.steam = steam(2);
    step_all(&mut m, &mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 5, "sign in", &|c| c.iter().all(|c| c.online()));
    a.send(Command::Play);
    b.send(Command::Play);
    step_all(&mut m, &mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 5, "booked", &|c| c.iter().all(|c| c.found.is_some()));
    let seat = a.found.unwrap();
    // A's game crashes and starts again: a new sign-in, same Steam account.
    drop(a);
    let mut again = LobbyClient::new(m.local_addr(), "a").unwrap();
    again.steam = steam(1);
    step_all(&mut m, &mut server, &mut [&mut again, &mut b], 5, "offered", &|c| c[0].state.as_ref().is_some_and(|s| s.rejoin.is_some()));
    assert_eq!(again.state.unwrap().rejoin, Some(seat), "the same seat, key and server");
}

#[test]
fn a_custom_game_plays_the_map_the_leader_picked() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let Some(dir) = game_dir() else { return };
    let (mut server, lobby) = world(&bsp, 2);
    server.set_game_dir(dir.into());
    let (mut a, mut b) = (accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "a").unwrap()), accepting(LobbyClient::new(lobby, "b").unwrap()));
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "sign in", |c| c.iter().all(|c| c.online()));
    b.send(Command::JoinParty { code: a.state.as_ref().unwrap().code.clone() });
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "party", |c| c[0].state.as_ref().unwrap().members.len() == 2);
    a.send(Command::SetMode(Mode::Custom));
    let bid = b.state.as_ref().unwrap().you;
    a.send(Command::Move { member: bid, group: Group::B });
    // Only the leader picks.
    b.send(Command::SetMap(Some("de_nuke".into())));
    a.send(Command::SetMap(Some("de_train".into())));
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "picked", |c| c[1].state.as_ref().unwrap().map.as_deref() == Some("de_train"));
    a.send(Command::Play);
    until(&mut server, &mut [&mut a, &mut b], "match found", |c| c.iter().all(|c| c.found.is_some()));
    // The server switched to the picked map; the players are told so when they join.
    let (addr, ticket, key) = a.found.unwrap();
    let mut p = net::Client::connect(addr, "a", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
    p.ticket = ticket;
    p.key = Some(key);
    for _ in 0..256 {
        server.step();
        p.tick(Input::default());
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(150));
    }
    assert_eq!(p.map.as_deref(), Some("de_train"));
}

#[test]
fn only_maps_everyone_has_are_offered() {

```

`net/tests/lobby_ha.rs`:

```rs
//! The lobby never being a single point of failure: a restarted lobby picks up exactly where
//! it was (sessions, parties), and a standby lobby on another machine takes over when the
//! active one dies; players' games switch over by themselves and carry on, still encrypted.
use net::crypto::LobbyKey;
use net::lobby::{Command, LobbyClient, LobbyServer, Role};
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

const LOCAL: ([u8; 4], u16) = ([127, 0, 0, 1], 0);

fn run(ms: &mut [&mut LobbyServer], cs: &mut [&mut LobbyClient], secs: u64, what: &str, done: impl Fn(&[&mut LobbyServer], &[&mut LobbyClient]) -> bool) {
    let start = Instant::now();
    while !done(ms, cs) {
        assert!(start.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(secs), "timed out: {what}");
        for m in ms.iter_mut() {
            m.step();
        }
        for c in cs.iter_mut() {
            c.tick();
        }
    }
}

fn code(c: &LobbyClient) -> String {
    c.state.as_ref().map(|s| s.code.clone()).unwrap_or_default()
}

#[test]
fn a_restarted_lobby_carries_on() {
    let file = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("bootleg16-lobby-{}.state", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&file);
    let key = LobbyKey::generate().to_hex();
    let mut m = LobbyServer::bind(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), vec![]).unwrap();
    let addr = m.local_addr();
    m.set_key(LobbyKey::from_hex(&key).unwrap());
    m.state_file = Some(file.clone());
    let (mut a, mut b) = (LobbyClient::new(addr, "a").unwrap(), LobbyClient::new(addr, "b").unwrap());
    run(&mut [&mut m], &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 5, "sign in", |_, c| c.iter().all(|c| c.online()));
    b.send(Command::JoinParty { code: code(&a) });
    run(&mut [&mut m], &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 5, "party", |_, c| c[0].state.as_ref().unwrap().members.len() == 2);
    let party = code(&a);
    let wait = Instant::now();
    run(&mut [&mut m], &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 5, "saved", |_, _| wait.elapsed() > Duration::from_millis(2500));
    // The lobby dies and comes back (same key and saved state, same address).
    drop(m);
    let mut m = LobbyServer::bind(addr, vec![]).unwrap();
    m.set_key(LobbyKey::from_hex(&key).unwrap());
    assert!(m.load(&file));
    // Same party, nobody signed in again (a new sign-in would mean a new party code).
    let wait = Instant::now();
    run(&mut [&mut m], &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 5, "carry on", |_, _| wait.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(2));
    assert_eq!(code(&a), party);
    assert_eq!(a.state.as_ref().unwrap().members.len(), 2);
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&file);
}

#[test]
fn a_standby_lobby_takes_over_when_the_active_one_dies() {
    let key = LobbyKey::generate().to_hex();
    let token = vec!["tok".to_string()];
    let (mut one, mut two) = (LobbyServer::bind(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), token.clone()).unwrap(), LobbyServer::bind(SocketAddr::from(LOCAL), token).unwrap());
    // Both lobbies have the same key (the one built into the game).
    one.set_key(LobbyKey::from_hex(&key).unwrap());
    two.set_key(LobbyKey::from_hex(&key).unwrap());
    let ports = (free_port(), free_port());
    one.pair(ports.0, SocketAddr::from(([127, 0, 0, 1], ports.1))).unwrap();
    two.pair(ports.1, SocketAddr::from(([127, 0, 0, 1], ports.0))).unwrap();
    let lobbies = vec![one.local_addr(), two.local_addr()];
    // One becomes active, the other stands by.
    run(&mut [&mut one, &mut two], &mut [], 15, "roles", |m, _| (m[0].role == Role::Active) != (m[1].role == Role::Active));
    let one_active = one.role == Role::Active;
    let (mut a, mut b) = (LobbyClient::with_lobbies(lobbies.clone(), "a").unwrap(), LobbyClient::with_lobbies(lobbies, "b").unwrap());
    run(&mut [&mut one, &mut two], &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 15, "sign in", |_, c| c.iter().all(|c| c.online()));
    b.send(Command::JoinParty { code: code(&a) });
    run(&mut [&mut one, &mut two], &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 10, "party", |_, c| c[0].state.as_ref().unwrap().members.len() == 2);
    let party = code(&a);
    let wait = Instant::now();
    run(&mut [&mut one, &mut two], &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 10, "standby in sync", |_, _| wait.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(3));
    // The active lobby dies.
    let mut survivor = if one_active { drop(one); two } else { drop(two); one };
    run(&mut [&mut survivor], &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 20, "take over", |m, _| m[0].role == Role::Active);
    // The players' games find it and carry on: same party, same session.
    b.send(Command::LeaveParty);
    let leave_at = Instant::now();
    run(&mut [&mut survivor], &mut [&mut a, &mut b], 20, "players carry on", |_, c| leave_at.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(1) && c[0].state.as_ref().is_some_and(|s| s.members.len() == 1) && code(&c[0]) == party);
}

fn free_port() -> u16 {
    std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap().local_addr().unwrap().port()
}
```

`net/tests/multiplayer.rs`:

```rs
//! Server + two clients over real localhost UDP. Skipped when de_dust2 isn't installed.
mod common;
use common::*;
use sim::pmove::Input;
use std::time::Duration;

/// Run A along a path, then stand still; check the server, B's view and A's prediction agree.
/// `unlag_tolerance`: with packet loss the client blends across missing snapshots,
/// so its view of a turning player differs slightly from the server's full history.
/// `max_correction`: the biggest snap of A's prediction allowed (bumping into a teammate, who is
/// solid, is corrected by a few units: the client only knows where they were a moment ago).
fn run_and_check(g: &mut Game, label: &str, unlag_tolerance: f32, max_correction: f32) {
    let id = g.a.id().unwrap();
    let mut last = g.server.player(id).unwrap().origin;
    let mut travelled = 0.0;
    let mut worst_correction = 0.0f32;
    let mut worst_unlag = 0.0f32;
    for t in 0..256 {
        // Run in wide circles with jumps, bouncing off whatever walls are near the spawn.
        let input = Input { forward: 400.0, yaw: t as f32 * 2.0, jump: t % 70 == 0, ..Default::default() };
        g.tick(input, Input::default());
        worst_correction = worst_correction.max(g.a.last_correction);
        // Lag compensation: rewinding to B's view time puts A exactly where B is drawing A.
        if t > 64 {
            if let Some(seen) = g.b.others().into_iter().find(|r| r.id == id) {
                let rewound = g.server.rewind(g.b.view_tick()).into_iter().find(|p| p.id == id).unwrap().origin;
                worst_unlag = worst_unlag.max(dist(seen.origin, rewound));
            }
        }
        let now = g.server.player(id).unwrap().origin;
        travelled += dist(now, last);
        last = now;
    }
    for _ in 0..128 {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
    }
    let server_a = *g.server.player(g.a.id().unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert!(travelled > 200.0, "{label}: A only travelled {travelled} units on the server");
    // A's prediction ends exactly where the server says (same code, same inputs).
    assert!(dist(g.a.me().origin, server_a.origin) < 0.01, "{label}: prediction {:?} vs server {:?}", g.a.me().origin, server_a.origin);
    assert!(worst_unlag < unlag_tolerance, "{label}: rewound position off by {worst_unlag} from what B saw");
    // Mid-run corrections stay tiny: prediction was right the whole way.
    assert!(worst_correction < max_correction, "{label}: worst correction {worst_correction}");
    // B sees A where the server has them.
    let seen = g.b.others().into_iter().find(|r| Some(r.id) == g.a.id()).expect("B sees A");
    assert!(dist(seen.origin, server_a.origin) < 1.0, "{label}: B sees A at {:?}, server {:?}", seen.origin, server_a.origin);
}

#[test]
fn speed_hack_gains_nothing() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.connect();
    let id = g.a.id().unwrap();
    let mut last = g.server.player(id).unwrap().origin;
    let mut travelled = 0.0;
    // A hacked client sends inputs 3x faster than real time for 2 seconds,
    // running in circles so walls don't cut the run short.
    for t in 0..256 {
        let run = Input { forward: 400.0, yaw: t as f32 * 2.0, ..Default::default() };
        g.server.step();
        for _ in 0..3 {
            g.a.tick(run);
        }
        g.b.tick(Input::default());
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(150));
        let now = g.server.player(id).unwrap().origin;
        travelled += dist(now, last);
        last = now;
    }
    let moved = travelled;
    // Honest max: 2 s at 250 u/s = 500 units (+ the 16-input burst allowance). Walls may cut it short.
    assert!(moved < 540.0, "speed hack moved {moved} units in 2 s");
    assert!(moved > 300.0, "player should still move at normal speed, moved {moved}");
}

#[test]
fn ak_kills_another_player_and_everyone_hears_about_it() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 60, 0.0);
    g.server.set_give(vec![sim::weapons::Id::Ak47]);
    g.connect_as(Some(net::protocol::Team::T), Some(net::protocol::Team::T));
    // The give applies on spawn; respawn both by waiting? They spawned before set_give took
    // effect only if connect happened first, so check what A holds.
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    assert_eq!(g.server.player_state(a).unwrap().loadout.active_id(), sim::weapons::Id::Ak47);
    let target = g.server.player(b).unwrap().origin;
    let eye = g.server.player(a).unwrap().eye();
    let d = [target[0] - eye[0], target[1] - eye[1], target[2] + 8.0 - eye[2]];
    let yaw = d[1].atan2(d[0]).to_degrees();
    let pitch = -(d[2] / (d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1]).sqrt()).atan().to_degrees();
    let mut kills = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..384 {
        g.tick(Input { yaw, pitch, attack: true, ..Default::default() }, Input::default());
        kills.extend(g.b.take_events().into_iter().filter(|e| matches!(e, net::protocol::GameEvent::Kill { .. })));
        let _ = g.a.take_events();
    }
    assert!(!kills.is_empty(), "B never died; health {:?}", g.server.vitals(b));
    assert!(matches!(kills[0], net::protocol::GameEvent::Kill { killer, victim, weapon: Some(sim::weapons::Id::Ak47), .. } if killer == a && victim == b));
    // A's own predicted ammo matches the server's.
    let server_clip = g.server.player_state(a).unwrap().loadout.active_gun().unwrap().clip;
    for _ in 0..64 {
        g.tick(Input { yaw, pitch, ..Default::default() }, Input::default());
    }
    let server_clip_now = g.server.player_state(a).unwrap().loadout.active_gun().unwrap().clip;
    assert_eq!(g.a.state.loadout.active_gun().unwrap().clip, server_clip_now, "predicted clip matches (was {server_clip})");
}

#[test]
fn he_hurts_and_flash_blinds_across_the_network() {
    use net::protocol::GameEvent;
    use sim::weapons::Id;
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 40, 0.0);
    g.server.set_give(vec![Id::HeGrenade, Id::Flashbang]);
    g.connect_as(Some(net::protocol::Team::T), Some(net::protocol::Team::T));
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    let target = g.server.player(b).unwrap().origin;
    let eye = g.server.player(a).unwrap().eye();
    let d = [target[0] - eye[0], target[1] - eye[1]];
    let yaw = d[1].atan2(d[0]).to_degrees();
    // Aim a little down so the grenade lands near B; B looks at A for the flash.
    let look = |pitch| Input { yaw, pitch, ..Default::default() };
    let b_looks = Input { yaw: yaw + 180.0, ..Default::default() };
    let mut events = Vec::new();
    let run = |g: &mut Game, events: &mut Vec<GameEvent>, input: Input, ticks: usize| {
        for _ in 0..ticks {
            g.tick(input, b_looks);
            events.extend(g.b.take_events());
        }
    };
    run(&mut g, &mut events, Input { slot: 4, ..look(30.0) }, 1);
    run(&mut g, &mut events, look(30.0), 128);
    assert_eq!(g.a.state.loadout.active_id(), Id::HeGrenade);
    run(&mut g, &mut events, Input { attack: true, ..look(30.0) }, 80); // pull the pin
    run(&mut g, &mut events, look(30.0), 300); // release, 1.5 s fuse
    let health = g.server.vitals(b).unwrap().health;
    assert!(events.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::Explosion { .. })), "no explosion");
    assert!(health < 100.0, "B unhurt by the HE: {health}");
    // A now holds the flashbang (the HE is gone).
    assert_eq!(g.a.state.loadout.active_id(), Id::Flashbang);
    run(&mut g, &mut events, Input { attack: true, ..look(10.0) }, 80);
    run(&mut g, &mut events, look(10.0), 300);
    let flashed = events.iter().find_map(|e| match e {
        GameEvent::Flash { at, blinded } => blinded.iter().find(|(id, _)| *id == b).map(|x| (*at, x.1)),
        _ => None,
    });
    let (at, blind) = flashed.expect("B should be blinded");
    // Full white only if the flash went off in front of B (it may fly past them).
    let eye_b = g.server.player(b).unwrap().eye();
    let (f, _, _) = sim::weapons::bullets::view_vectors(0.0, yaw + 180.0);
    let in_front = (at[0] - eye_b[0]) * f[0] + (at[1] - eye_b[1]) * f[1] + (at[2] + 1.0 - eye_b[2]) * f[2] >= 0.0;
    assert_eq!(blind.alpha, if in_front { 255 } else { 200 }, "flash at {at:?}");
    assert!(blind.hold > 0.0 && blind.fade > blind.hold);
}

#[test]
fn practice_room_dummies_and_infinite_ammo() {
    use sim::weapons::Id;
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.server.set_rules(net::server::Rules::practice(3));
    g.server.set_give(vec![Id::Ak47]);
    g.connect();
    assert_eq!(g.server.player_count(), 5, "2 players + 3 dummies");
    assert!(g.a.practice);
    let me = g.a.team();
    let dummies: Vec<_> = g.a.scores.iter().filter(|s| s.bot).collect();
    assert_eq!(dummies.len(), 3);
    assert!(dummies.iter().all(|d| d.team != me && d.team != net::protocol::Team::Spectator), "dummies are on the other side");
    // Dummies stand still.
    let d = dummies[0].id;
    let before = g.server.player(d).unwrap().origin;
    for _ in 0..200 {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
    }
    let after = g.server.player(d).unwrap().origin;
    assert!((before[0] - after[0]).abs() + (before[1] - after[1]).abs() < 1.0, "dummy moved");
    // Infinite reserve: spray a whole clip and the reserve stays full.
    for _ in 0..512 {
        g.tick(Input { attack: true, ..Default::default() }, Input::default());
    }
    let gun = *g.server.player_state(g.a.id().unwrap()).unwrap().loadout.active_gun().unwrap();
    assert_eq!((gun.id, gun.reserve), (Id::Ak47, 90));
}

#[test]
fn kill_feed_survives_packet_loss() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    // 40% of packets lost: plain events would often vanish.
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 50, 0.4);
    g.server.set_give(vec![sim::weapons::Id::Ak47]);
    g.connect_as(Some(net::protocol::Team::T), Some(net::protocol::Team::T));
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    let target = g.server.player(b).unwrap().origin;
    let eye = g.server.player(a).unwrap().eye();
    let d = [target[0] - eye[0], target[1] - eye[1], target[2] + 8.0 - eye[2]];
    let yaw = d[1].atan2(d[0]).to_degrees();
    let pitch = -(d[2] / (d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1]).sqrt()).atan().to_degrees();
    let (mut kills_a, mut kills_b) = (0, 0);
    for t in 0..1200 {
        let fire = t < 400;
        g.tick(Input { yaw, pitch, attack: fire, ..Default::default() }, Input::default());
        kills_a += g.a.take_events().iter().filter(|e| matches!(e, net::protocol::GameEvent::Kill { .. })).count();
        kills_b += g.b.take_events().iter().filter(|e| matches!(e, net::protocol::GameEvent::Kill { .. })).count();
    }
    let deaths = g.a.scores.iter().find(|s| s.id == b).map(|s| s.deaths).unwrap_or(0);
    assert!(deaths >= 1, "B never died (health {:?})", g.server.vitals(b));
    assert!(kills_a >= 1 && kills_a == kills_b, "kills seen: A {kills_a}, B {kills_b}");
}
```

`net/tests/recording.rs`:

```rs
//! Match recordings: a booked match is recorded (everyone, everything), the file closes at the
//! end, a report points at it, and replaying it shows a watching game the same players at the
//! same places.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::server::{Group, MatchSetup};
use sim::pmove::Input;
use std::time::Duration;

#[test]
fn a_match_is_recorded_and_plays_back() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("bootleg16-demos-{}", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, net::config::MatchConfig { demos: dir.to_string_lossy().into(), name: "rec test".into(), ..Default::default() });
    g.server.reserve(MatchSetup { players: vec![(1, Group::A), (2, Group::B)], knife_round: false, keys: Vec::new(), map: String::new() });
    g.a.ticket = 1;
    g.b.ticket = 2;
    // Two seconds of play, A walking.
    for _ in 0..256 {
        g.tick(Input { forward: 400.0, ..Default::default() }, Input::default());
    }
    let a = g.a.id().unwrap();
    let walked_to = g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin;
    // Everyone leaves: the match frees the server, and the recording closes.
    g.a.disconnect();
    g.b.disconnect();
    for _ in 0..95 * 128 {
        g.server.step();
    }
    let files: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(&dir).unwrap().flatten().map(|e| e.path()).collect();
    assert_eq!(files.len(), 1, "one recording: {files:?}");
    let name = files[0].file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
    assert!(name.contains("rec_test") && name.ends_with("-test.bdem"), "{name}");
    // Read back: A is in it, walking, and was where the server had them.
    let mut r = net::demo::Reader::open(&files[0]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.header.map, "test");
    let mut frames = 0;
    let mut a_moved = false;
    while let Some(f) = r.next_frame() {
        frames += 1;
        if let Some(p) = f.players.iter().find(|p| p.id == a) {
            a_moved |= dist(p.origin(), walked_to) < 8.0;
        }
    }
    assert!(frames > 100, "{frames} frames");
    assert!(a_moved, "A's walk is in the recording");
    // Played back to a watching game: it sees A.
    let mut replay = net::replay::Replay::open("127.0.0.1:0".parse().unwrap(), &files[0]).unwrap();
    let mut viewer = net::Client::connect(replay.local_addr(), "viewer", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
    let mut seen = false;
    for t in 1..400 {
        replay.step(t);
        viewer.tick(Input::default());
        seen |= viewer.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == a);
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_micros(300));
    }
    assert!(seen, "the replay showed A to the viewer");
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
}
```

`net/tests/reserved.rs`:

```rs
//! Reserved matches over localhost UDP: only ticket holders get in, on their teams; a knife
//! round decides sides (winners vote), then round 1; a dropped player gets their seat back.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::protocol::{GameEvent, Stage, Team};
use net::server::{Group, MatchSetup};
use sim::pmove::Input;

#[test]
fn knife_round_then_winners_pick_sides() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, net::config::MatchConfig::default());
    g.server.reserve(MatchSetup { players: vec![(111, Group::A), (222, Group::B)], knife_round: true, keys: Vec::new(), map: String::new() });
    g.a.ticket = 111;
    g.b.ticket = 222;
    let mut ev = Vec::new();
    let run = |g: &mut Game, n: usize, ia: Input, ib: Input, ev: &mut Vec<GameEvent>| {
        for _ in 0..n {
            g.tick(ia, ib);
            ev.extend(g.a.take_events());
            g.b.take_events();
        }
    };
    run(&mut g, 128, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    assert_eq!(g.a.team(), Team::T, "group A starts as T");
    assert_eq!(g.b.team(), Team::Ct);
    assert_eq!(g.a.round.stage, Stage::Knife, "everyone's in: knife round");
    assert_eq!(g.server.player_state(a).unwrap().loadout.active_id(), sim::weapons::Id::Knife);
    // Someone without a ticket is turned away.
    let mut stranger = net::Client::connect(g.server.local_addr(), "x", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
    for _ in 0..64 {
        g.server.step();
        stranger.tick(Input::default());
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_micros(150));
    }
    assert_eq!(stranger.status, net::client::Status::Rejected);
    // After freeze time, A knifes B (put right in front of them).
    run(&mut g, 3 * 128, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    let o = g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin;
    for t in 0..800 {
        if t % 32 == 0 {
            g.server.teleport(b, [o[0] + 30.0, o[1], o[2]]);
        }
        run(&mut g, 1, Input { yaw: 0.0, pitch: 5.0, attack: t % 64 < 2, ..Default::default() }, Input::default(), &mut ev);
        if ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::KnifeWon { .. })) {
            break;
        }
    }
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| *e == GameEvent::KnifeWon { winners: Team::T }), "{ev:?}");
    assert!(matches!(g.a.round.stage, Stage::SideVote { winners: Team::T, .. }));
    // The winner votes to switch: sides swap and round 1 starts with pistols.
    g.a.side_vote(true);
    run(&mut g, 64, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| *e == GameEvent::SidesChosen { switched: true }), "{ev:?}");
    assert_eq!(g.a.team(), Team::Ct);
    assert_eq!(g.a.round.stage, Stage::Match);
    assert_eq!(g.a.round.round, 1);
    assert_eq!(g.server.player_state(a).unwrap().loadout.active_id(), sim::weapons::Id::Usp, "CT pistol");

    // B drops and comes back with the same ticket: same seat (now T), same money.
    let money = g.server.money(b).unwrap();
    g.b.disconnect();
    run(&mut g, 16, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    let mut back = net::Client::connect(g.server.local_addr(), "b", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
    back.ticket = 222;
    for _ in 0..128 {
        g.server.step();
        g.a.tick(Input::default());
        back.tick(Input::default());
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_micros(150));
    }
    let id = back.id().expect("rejoined");
    assert_eq!(back.team(), Team::T);
    assert_eq!(g.server.money(id), Some(money));
}

#[test]
fn abandoned_match_frees_the_server() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, net::config::MatchConfig::default());
    g.server.reserve(MatchSetup { players: vec![(111, Group::A), (222, Group::B)], knife_round: false, keys: Vec::new(), map: String::new() });
    // Nobody with a ticket shows up (a and b have none): after the wait, the server is free again.
    for _ in 0..92 * 128 {
        g.server.step();
    }
    assert!(!g.server.is_reserved());
}

#[test]
fn draining_waits_for_the_match_to_end() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, net::config::MatchConfig::default());
    g.server.reserve(MatchSetup { players: vec![(111, Group::A), (222, Group::B)], knife_round: false, keys: Vec::new(), map: String::new() });
    g.a.ticket = 111;
    g.b.ticket = 222;
    for _ in 0..128 {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
    }
    g.server.drain();
    for _ in 0..4 * 128 {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
    }
    assert!(!g.server.drained(), "a match is running: keep going");
    // Everyone leaves; the match frees the server after its wait, and draining is done.
    g.a.disconnect();
    g.b.disconnect();
    for _ in 0..95 * 128 {
        g.server.step();
    }
    assert!(g.server.drained());
}
```

`net/tests/rounds.rs`:

```rs
//! The round system end to end over localhost UDP: freeze time, round wins and money,
//! planting, defusing and the explosion. Skipped when de_dust2 isn't installed.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::config::MatchConfig;
use net::protocol::{GameEvent, Team};
use net::rounds::{EndReason, Phase};
use sim::pmove::Input;

/// Short timers so the tests run fast.
fn quick() -> MatchConfig {
    MatchConfig { freeze_time: 1.0, buy_time: 5.0, round_end_delay: 1.0, c4_timer: 5.0, defuse_time: 2.0, ..Default::default() }
}

fn wait(g: &mut Game, secs: f32, ia: Input, ib: Input, events: &mut Vec<GameEvent>) {
    for _ in 0..(secs * 128.0) as u32 {
        g.tick(ia, ib);
        events.extend(g.a.take_events());
        g.b.take_events();
    }
}

/// A standing spot in the middle of a bomb site (players drop to the floor).
fn site_spot(bsp: &goldsrc::bsp::Bsp) -> [f32; 3] {
    let z = sim::zones::Zones::from_bsp(bsp);
    let (lo, hi) = z.bomb_sites[0];
    let p = [(lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2.0, (lo[1] + hi[1]) / 2.0, lo[2] + 40.0];
    assert!(z.in_bomb_site(p));
    p
}

#[test]
fn freeze_time_then_a_win_pays_both_teams_and_starts_the_next_round() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, quick());
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct));
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    let mut ev = Vec::new();
    // connect_as ran ~1 s: we're in the first round. Wait for the next freeze to test it cleanly.
    assert_ne!(g.a.round.phase, Phase::Warmup, "both teams have a player: the match started");
    // Live: the terrorist shoots the CT (put right in front of him): terrorists win by elimination.
    while g.a.round.phase != Phase::Live {
        wait(&mut g, 0.05, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    }
    let o = g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin;
    g.server.teleport(b, [o[0] + 64.0, o[1], o[2]]);
    ev.clear();
    for i in 0..60 {
        // Semi-auto pistol: press and release; aim at the body.
        let fire = Input { yaw: 0.0, pitch: 8.0, attack: i % 2 == 0, ..Default::default() };
        wait(&mut g, 0.05, fire, Input::default(), &mut ev);
        if ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::RoundEnd { .. })) {
            break;
        }

    }
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| *e == GameEvent::RoundEnd { winner: Team::T, reason: EndReason::Eliminated }), "{ev:?}");
    // T: 800 + 300 kill + 3250 win; CT: 800 + 1400 first loss.
    wait(&mut g, 1.2, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    assert_eq!(g.server.money(a), Some(4350));
    assert_eq!(g.server.money(b), Some(2200));
    // The next round started and brought the CT back.
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::RoundStart { round: 2 })), "{ev:?}");
    assert!(g.server.vitals(b).unwrap().alive());
    assert_eq!(g.a.round.score, [1, 0]);
    // The scoreboard: the T is the round's MVP, both played a round, the history has it, and
    // money shows for your own team only.
    let me = g.a.scores.iter().find(|s| s.id == a).unwrap();
    let them = g.a.scores.iter().find(|s| s.id == b).unwrap();
    assert_eq!((me.mvps, me.rounds, them.rounds), (1, 1, 1));
    assert_eq!(me.kills, 1);
    assert!(me.damage >= 100, "{}", me.damage);
    assert_eq!(me.money, Some(4350));
    assert_eq!(them.money, None, "the other team's money is hidden");
    assert_eq!(g.a.round_history, vec![(Team::T, EndReason::Eliminated)]);
    assert!(me.ping < 100, "{}", me.ping);
    // Ammo isn't bought: the new round tops everyone's reserve up.
    let full = sim::weapons::gun(sim::weapons::Id::Glock).unwrap().reserve;
    assert_eq!(g.server.player_state(a).unwrap().loadout.secondary.unwrap().reserve, full);
    // Freeze time of round 2 (1 s): holding forward goes nowhere (falling onto the floor is fine).
    assert_eq!(g.server.round_phase(), Phase::Freeze);
    let start = g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin;
    wait(&mut g, 0.3, Input { forward: 400.0, ..Default::default() }, Input::default(), &mut ev);
    let now = g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin;
    let moved = dist([now[0], now[1], 0.0], [start[0], start[1], 0.0]);
    assert!(moved < 1.0, "moved {moved} during freeze time");
}

/// Plant in a site (3 s holding attack with the C4 out), then either defuse or let it blow.
fn plant(g: &mut Game, bsp: &goldsrc::bsp::Bsp, ev: &mut Vec<GameEvent>) -> [f32; 3] {
    let a = g.a.id().unwrap();
    while g.a.round.phase != Phase::Live {
        wait(g, 0.05, Input::default(), Input::default(), ev);
    }
    assert!(g.server.player_state(a).unwrap().loadout.c4, "the only terrorist carries the bomb");
    let spot = site_spot(bsp);
    g.server.teleport(a, spot);
    wait(g, 0.5, Input::default(), Input::default(), ev);
    // Outside a site nothing happens; inside, 3 s of holding attack plants it.
    wait(g, 0.1, Input { slot: 5, ..Default::default() }, Input::default(), ev);
    wait(g, 0.5, Input::default(), Input::default(), ev);
    ev.clear();
    wait(g, 3.3, Input { attack: true, ..Default::default() }, Input::default(), ev);
    let at = ev.iter().find_map(|e| match e {
        GameEvent::BombPlanted { at, .. } => Some(*at),
        _ => None,
    });
    at.expect("planted")
}

#[test]
fn bomb_defused_pays_the_planters_bonus() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, quick());
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct));
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    let mut ev = Vec::new();
    let at = plant(&mut g, &bsp, &mut ev);
    let money_t = g.server.money(a).unwrap();
    // The CT stands next to it, looks down at it and holds use for the defuse time (2 s here).
    g.server.teleport(b, [at[0] + 30.0, at[1], at[2] + 40.0]);
    wait(&mut g, 0.3, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    let eye = g.server.player(b).unwrap().eye();
    let d = [at[0] - eye[0], at[1] - eye[1], at[2] - eye[2]];
    let look = Input { yaw: d[1].atan2(d[0]).to_degrees(), pitch: -(d[2].atan2((d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1]).sqrt())).to_degrees(), use_key: true, ..Default::default() };
    ev.clear();
    wait(&mut g, 2.5, Input::default(), look, &mut ev);
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::BombDefused { .. })), "{ev:?}");
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| *e == GameEvent::RoundEnd { winner: Team::Ct, reason: EndReason::BombDefused }));
    assert_eq!(g.server.money(a).unwrap(), money_t + 1400 + 800, "loss bonus plus the planted bonus");
}

#[test]
fn bomb_explodes_wins_the_round_and_kills_nearby() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, quick());
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct));
    let b = g.b.id().unwrap();
    let mut ev = Vec::new();
    let at = plant(&mut g, &bsp, &mut ev);
    g.server.teleport(b, [at[0] + 100.0, at[1], at[2] + 40.0]);
    ev.clear();
    wait(&mut g, 5.5, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::BombExploded { .. })), "{ev:?}");
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| *e == GameEvent::RoundEnd { winner: Team::T, reason: EndReason::BombExploded }));
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::Kill { victim, weapon: Some(sim::weapons::Id::C4), .. } if *victim == b)), "{ev:?}");
    // dust2's crates at that site go with it, and are back next round.
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::Broke { .. })), "no crates broke: {ev:?}");
    assert!(!g.a.broken.is_empty());
    wait(&mut g, 2.0, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    assert!(g.a.broken.is_empty(), "crates not restored: {:?}", g.a.broken);
}

#[test]
fn time_running_out_pays_living_terrorists_nothing() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, MatchConfig { round_time: 2.0, ..quick() });
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct));
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    let mut ev = Vec::new();
    while g.a.round.phase != Phase::Live {
        wait(&mut g, 0.05, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    }
    let (t, ct) = (g.server.money(a).unwrap(), g.server.money(b).unwrap());
    ev.clear();
    wait(&mut g, 2.5, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    assert!(ev.iter().any(|e| *e == GameEvent::RoundEnd { winner: Team::Ct, reason: EndReason::TimeUp }), "{ev:?}");
    assert_eq!(g.server.money(a), Some(t), "the living T gets no loss bonus");
    assert_eq!(g.server.money(b), Some(ct + 3250));
}

#[test]
fn everything_bought_this_round_sells_back() {
    use net::protocol::BuyItem;
    use sim::weapons::Id;
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup_with(&bsp, 0, 0.0, MatchConfig { freeze_time: 3.0, buy_time: 20.0, start_money: 16000, ..quick() });
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct));
    let a = g.a.id().unwrap();
    let mut ev = Vec::new();
    wait(&mut g, 0.5, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    let money = g.server.money(a).unwrap();
    for item in [BuyItem::Weapon(Id::Ak47), BuyItem::KevlarHelmet, BuyItem::Weapon(Id::HeGrenade), BuyItem::Weapon(Id::Deagle)] {
        g.a.buy(item);
        wait(&mut g, 0.1, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    }
    let l = g.server.player_state(a).unwrap().loadout.clone();
    assert_eq!((l.primary.map(|p| p.id), l.secondary.map(|p| p.id), l.grenades[0]), (Some(Id::Ak47), Some(Id::Deagle), 1), "bought");
    assert!(g.server.money(a).unwrap() < money);
    g.a.undo_buys();
    wait(&mut g, 0.2, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    let l = g.server.player_state(a).unwrap().loadout.clone();
    assert_eq!(g.server.money(a), Some(money), "every dollar back");
    assert_eq!((l.primary.map(|p| p.id), l.secondary.map(|p| p.id), l.grenades[0]), (None, Some(Id::Glock), 0), "the Glock is back off the floor");
    assert_eq!(g.server.vitals(a).unwrap().armor, 0.0);
    // A gun that's been fired is yours: no refund.
    g.a.buy(BuyItem::Weapon(Id::Ak47));
    wait(&mut g, 1.0, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    wait(&mut g, 0.3, Input { attack: true, ..Default::default() }, Input::default(), &mut ev);
    let after = g.server.money(a).unwrap();
    g.a.undo_buys();
    wait(&mut g, 0.2, Input::default(), Input::default(), &mut ev);
    assert_eq!(g.server.money(a), Some(after));
    assert_eq!(g.server.player_state(a).unwrap().loadout.primary.map(|p| p.id), Some(Id::Ak47));
}
```

`net/tests/visibility.rs`:

```rs
//! Anti-wallhack over localhost UDP: enemies out of sight aren't sent; sounds are sent only
//! within hearing range. Skipped when de_dust2 isn't installed.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::protocol::{GameEvent, Team};
use sim::pmove::Input;

#[test]
fn enemies_behind_walls_are_not_sent_but_in_the_open_they_are() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct));
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    // T and CT spawns on dust2 are far apart with the whole map in between.
    for _ in 0..64 {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
    }
    assert!(!g.a.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == b), "the CT at his spawn was sent to the T");
    // Far away and walking: the T doesn't hear (or get) those footsteps either.
    let mut steps = 0;
    for _ in 0..256 {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input { forward: 400.0, ..Default::default() });
        steps += g.a.take_events().iter().filter(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::Footstep { player, .. } if *player == b)).count();
    }
    assert_eq!(steps, 0, "footsteps from across the map");
    // Right in front of him in the open spawn area: sent, and his steps are heard.
    let o = g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin;
    g.server.teleport(b, [o[0] + 150.0, o[1], o[2]]);
    let mut steps = 0;
    for _ in 0..256 {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input { side: 400.0, ..Default::default() });
        steps += g.a.take_events().iter().filter(|e| matches!(e, GameEvent::Footstep { player, .. } if *player == b)).count();
    }
    assert!(g.a.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == b), "the CT in plain view wasn't sent");
    assert!(steps > 0, "no footsteps from someone next to you");
    // It works both ways.
    assert!(g.b.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == a));
}

#[test]
fn smoke_hides_enemies_from_the_server_too() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct));
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    let o = g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin;
    g.server.teleport(b, [o[0] + 400.0, o[1], o[2]]);
    for _ in 0..64 {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
    }
    assert!(g.a.others().iter().any(|p| p.id == b), "in plain view first");
    // A smoke between them: thrown straight ahead (smokes pop when they stop rolling).
    g.server.add_smoke([o[0] + 200.0, o[1], o[2] - 30.0]);
    for _ in 0..(128 * 3) {
        g.server.teleport(b, [o[0] + 400.0, o[1], o[2]]);
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
    }
    assert!(!g.a.others().iter().any(|p| p.id == b), "seen through the smoke");
}

#[test]
fn the_dead_only_see_what_their_living_teammates_see() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct));
    let mut mate = net::Client::connect(g.server.local_addr(), "mate", sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp)).unwrap();
    let tick = |g: &mut Game, mate: &mut net::Client| {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
        mate.tick(Input::default());
    };
    for _ in 0..128 {
        tick(&mut g, &mut mate);
    }
    mate.join_team(Some(Team::Ct));
    for _ in 0..128 {
        tick(&mut g, &mut mate);
    }
    let (t, ct, m) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap(), mate.id().unwrap());
    // B (a CT) dies; their living teammate is at CT spawn (joining mid-round you'd sit out
    // the round, as in CS: bring them in), the T across the map at his.
    g.server.set_health(m, 100.0);
    g.server.teleport(m, g.server.player(ct).unwrap().origin);
    g.server.set_health(ct, 0.0);
    for _ in 0..64 {
        tick(&mut g, &mut mate);
    }
    assert_eq!((mate.team(), g.b.vitals.alive()), (Team::Ct, false), "setup");
    assert!(!mate.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == t), "setup: the living teammate can't see the T either");
    assert!(!g.b.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == t), "dead, but shown an enemy no teammate can see (ghosting)");
    // The teammate walks up to the T: now B sees him too (watching that teammate).
    let o = g.server.player(t).unwrap().origin;
    g.server.teleport(m, [o[0] + 150.0, o[1], o[2]]);
    for _ in 0..64 {
        tick(&mut g, &mut mate);
    }
    assert!(mate.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == t), "setup: the teammate next to him sees him");
    assert!(g.b.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == t), "a teammate sees him, so the dead do too");
    // Team IDs: a teammate's health comes along, an enemy's never does.
    assert_eq!(g.b.others().iter().find(|o| o.id == m).and_then(|o| o.mate).map(|x| x.health), Some(100));
    assert!(mate.others().iter().find(|o| o.id == t).is_some_and(|o| o.mate.is_none()), "an enemy's health was sent");
}

#[test]
fn a_whole_team_dead_sees_nothing_of_the_enemy() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct));
    let (t, ct) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    // The CT right in front of the T, then dies: their team is all dead, the screen goes black.
    let o = g.server.player(t).unwrap().origin;
    g.server.teleport(ct, [o[0] + 150.0, o[1], o[2]]);
    for _ in 0..64 {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
    }
    assert!(g.b.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == t));
    g.server.set_health(ct, 0.0);
    for _ in 0..128 {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
    }
    assert!(!g.b.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == t && o.alive), "nobody alive on their team: nothing of the enemy");
}
```

`net/tests/voice.rs`:

```rs
//! Voice relay over localhost UDP: team voice reaches teammates anywhere, proximity voice
//! reaches everyone alive nearby (enemies too) and fades with distance.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::protocol::{Team, VoiceChannel};
use sim::pmove::Input;

fn heard(g: &mut Game) -> Vec<net::client::Heard> {
    for _ in 0..16 {
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
    }
    g.b.take_voice()
}

#[test]
fn team_voice_everywhere_proximity_only_nearby_and_fading() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct)); // enemies, at opposite ends of the map
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    // Team voice never reaches the other team.
    g.a.send_voice(VoiceChannel::Team, vec![1, 2, 3]);
    assert!(heard(&mut g).is_empty());
    // Proximity voice from across the map: out of range.
    g.a.send_voice(VoiceChannel::Proximity, vec![1, 2, 3]);
    assert!(heard(&mut g).is_empty());
    // Close by, the enemy hears it, loud; further away, quieter.
    let o = g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin;
    g.server.teleport(b, [o[0] + 100.0, o[1], o[2]]);
    g.a.send_voice(VoiceChannel::Proximity, vec![9, 9]);
    let near = heard(&mut g);
    assert_eq!(near.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!((near[0].from, near[0].channel, near[0].data.clone(), near[0].muffled), (a, VoiceChannel::Proximity, vec![9, 9], false));
    g.server.teleport(b, [o[0] + 600.0, o[1], o[2]]);
    g.a.send_voice(VoiceChannel::Proximity, vec![9, 9]);
    let far = heard(&mut g);
    assert!(far.len() == 1 && far[0].gain < near[0].gain, "{} vs {}", far.first().map(|f| f.gain).unwrap_or(0), near[0].gain);

    // Teammates hear team voice from anywhere at full volume.
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::T));
    let b = g.b.id().unwrap();
    g.server.teleport(b, [o[0] + 4000.0, o[1], o[2]]);
    g.a.send_voice(VoiceChannel::Team, vec![5]);
    let t = heard(&mut g);
    assert_eq!(t.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(t[0].gain, 255);
}

#[test]
fn proximity_voice_through_a_wall_is_muffled() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct));
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    let o = g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin;
    // A standing spot within earshot with a wall between the two.
    let world = sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let eye = |p: [f32; 3]| [p[0], p[1], p[2] + 17.0];
    let spot = (1..12)
        .flat_map(|r| (0..16).map(move |k| (r as f32 * 40.0, k as f32 * 22.5)))
        .map(|(r, deg)| [o[0] + r * deg.to_radians().cos(), o[1] + r * deg.to_radians().sin(), o[2]])
        .find(|p| !world.is_solid(sim::collision::Hull::Standing, *p) && world.sight_blocked(eye(o), eye(*p)))
        .expect("a spot behind a wall near the T spawn");
    for _ in 0..8 {
        g.server.teleport(b, spot);
        g.tick(Input::default(), Input::default());
    }
    g.server.teleport(b, spot);
    g.a.send_voice(VoiceChannel::Proximity, vec![7]);
    let h = heard(&mut g);
    assert!(h.len() == 1 && h[0].muffled, "{h:?}");
}
```

`net/tests/wallbang.rs`:

```rs
//! A bullet that gets through a wall hurts someone the server never sent to the shooter.
//! Skipped when de_dust2 isn't installed.
mod common;
use common::*;
use net::protocol::Team;
use sim::collision::Contents;
use sim::pmove::Input;
use sim::weapons::bullets::{fire_bullet, view_vectors, Target};

#[test]
fn a_shot_through_a_wall_hurts_someone_who_was_never_sent() {
    let Some(bsp) = dust2() else { return };
    let mut g = setup(&bsp, 0, 0.0);
    g.server.set_give(vec![sim::weapons::Id::Ak47]);
    g.connect_as(Some(Team::T), Some(Team::Ct));
    let (a, b) = (g.a.id().unwrap(), g.b.id().unwrap());
    let world = sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let assets = assets();
    let (origin, eye) = (g.server.player(a).unwrap().origin, g.server.player(a).unwrap().eye());
    let ak = g.server.player_state(a).unwrap().loadout.active_gun().map(|_| sim::weapons::Id::Ak47).unwrap();
    // Where A stands relative to the floor, then search the map for a place with a wall in
    // front that this very bullet gets through to a spot where someone could stand.
    let floor = |p: [f32; 3]| world.trace_line(p, [p[0], p[1], p[2] - 200.0]).end[2];
    let (stand, eye_up) = (origin[2] - floor(origin), eye[2] - origin[2]);
    let (mut tried, mut walls, mut stands, mut gridok) = (0, 0, 0, 0);
    let mut found = None;
    'search: for gx in (-2400..2400).step_by(96) {
        for gy in (-2400..2400).step_by(96) {
            for gz in (-700..500).step_by(48) {
            let top = [gx as f32, gy as f32, gz as f32];
            if world.point_contents(top) != Contents::Empty {
                continue;
            }
            let down = world.trace_line(top, [top[0], top[1], top[2] - 60.0]);
            if down.fraction >= 1.0 || down.start_solid {
                continue;
            }
            gridok += 1;
            let me = [top[0], top[1], down.end[2] + stand];
            let eye = [me[0], me[1], me[2] + eye_up];
            if [0.0, 20.0, -30.0].iter().any(|dz| world.point_contents([me[0], me[1], me[2] + dz]) != Contents::Empty) {
                continue;
            }
            stands += 1;
            for yaw in (0..360).step_by(10) {
                let (f, _, _) = view_vectors(0.0, yaw as f32);
                let wall = world.trace_line(eye, std::array::from_fn(|i| eye[i] + f[i] * 600.0));
                if wall.fraction >= 1.0 || wall.start_solid {
                    continue;
                }
                for k in (24..100).step_by(8) {
                    let at: [f32; 3] = std::array::from_fn(|i| wall.end[i] + f[i] * k as f32);
                    let spot = [at[0], at[1], floor([at[0], at[1], eye[2]]) + stand];
                    if (spot[2] - me[2]).abs() > 8.0 || [-30.0, 0.0, 30.0, 50.0].iter().any(|dz| world.point_contents([spot[0], spot[1], spot[2] + dz]) != Contents::Empty) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let d = [spot[0] - eye[0], spot[1] - eye[1]];
                    let aim = d[1].atan2(d[0]).to_degrees();
                    let target = Target { id: b, origin: spot, yaw: 0.0, pitch: 0.0, crouched: false, weapon: ak, anim: None };
                    tried += 1;
                    let r = fire_bullet(&world, &assets.materials, &assets.hitboxes, eye, &ak_shot(ak, aim), a, &[target]);
                    walls += !r.impacts.is_empty() as u32;
                    // hidden the way the server judges it: no part of his box, grown by its margin, in sight
                    let mut pts = vec![spot, [spot[0], spot[1], spot[2] + 32.0]];
                    for x in [-40.0, 40.0] {
                        for y in [-40.0, 40.0] {
                            for z in [-32.0, 36.0] {
                                pts.push([spot[0] + x, spot[1] + y, spot[2] + z]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    let clear = pts.iter().any(|p| !world.sight_blocked(eye, *p));
                    if !clear && r.hits.iter().any(|h| h.victim == b) {
                        found = Some((me, spot, aim));
                        break 'search;
                    }
                }
            }
            }
        }
    }
    let Some((me, spot, yaw)) = found else { panic!("no wall on the map that a bullet gets through to a standing spot ({gridok} floors, {stands} stand spots, {tried} tried, {walls} with impacts; stand {stand} eye_up {eye_up})") };
    g.server.teleport(a, me);
    let eye = [me[0], me[1], me[2] + eye_up];
    let health = g.server.vitals(b).unwrap().health;
    for _ in 0..128 {
        g.server.teleport(b, spot);
        g.tick(Input { yaw, pitch: 0.0, ..Default::default() }, Input::default());
    }
    assert!(world.trace_line(eye, [spot[0], spot[1], eye[2]]).fraction < 1.0, "a wall is between them");
    assert!(!g.a.others().iter().any(|o| o.id == b), "setup: he was sent to A");
    for _ in 0..64 {
        g.server.teleport(b, spot);
        g.tick(Input { yaw, pitch: 0.0, attack: true, ..Default::default() }, Input::default());
    }
    let now = g.server.vitals(b).unwrap();
    assert!(now.health < health, "no damage through the wall: {health} -> {}", now.health);
}

/// A perfectly accurate AK bullet (its numbers from the weapon table).
fn ak_shot(weapon: sim::weapons::Id, yaw: f32) -> sim::weapons::Shot {
    sim::weapons::Shot { weapon, damage: 36, range_mod: 0.98, penetration: 2, distance: 8192.0, bullet: sim::weapons::data::B762, spread: 0.0, angles: [0.0, yaw], seed: 0, pellets: None, silenced: false }
}
```

```txt
bootleg16: how to install (Linux)

1. Unpack this archive anywhere:
     tar xzf bootleg16-*-linux.tar.gz
2. Go into the folder and install (for your user only, no root needed):
     cd bootleg16-*-linux
     ./install.sh
3. Start it from your applications menu ("bootleg16"), or run:
     bootleg16
   (If the command is not found, add ~/.local/bin to your PATH.)

Where things go
  The game and its data:  ~/.local/share/bootleg16
  The command:            ~/.local/bin/bootleg16
  The menu entry:         ~/.local/share/applications/bootleg16.desktop
  Your settings:          ~/.config/bootleg16

Practice (Practice > Solo) works on its own, with no server.

Settings > Display: Windowed or Borderless, and the window size. Alt+Enter switches
between them.

Remove it:
  ./uninstall.sh            removes the game
  ./uninstall.sh --purge    also removes your settings

Needs a Vulkan-capable graphics driver. Wayland and X11 both work.
```

`packaging/linux/build.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Linux installer: dist/bootleg16-<version>-linux.tar.gz holding the game, its data and
# install.sh / uninstall.sh (per user, no root). The game data is private: this is a private
# build until the data is our own (docs/TODO.md).
#
#   cargo build --release -p client --no-default-features --features steam
#   packaging/linux/build.sh
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
game="${BOOTLEG16_DIR:-gamedata}"
version="${VERSION:-$(sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' client/Cargo.toml | head -n1)}"
[ -x target/release/client ] || { echo "Build the release first (see the top of this file)."; exit 1; }
[ -d "$game/maps" ] || { echo "No game data at $game (set BOOTLEG16_DIR)."; exit 1; }
name="bootleg16-$version-linux"
out="dist/$name"
rm -rf "$out"
mkdir -p "$out/bootleg16/data"
cp target/release/client "$out/bootleg16/bootleg16"
command -v strip >/dev/null && strip "$out/bootleg16/bootleg16"
[ -f target/release/libsteam_api.so ] && cp target/release/libsteam_api.so "$out/bootleg16/"
# Opus (voice) isn't on every Linux: bring ours (the game looks next to itself first).
opus=$(ldd target/release/client | awk '/libopus/ {print $3}')
[ -n "$opus" ] && cp "$opus" "$out/bootleg16/"
cp -r "$game"/. "$out/bootleg16/data/"
cp packaging/bootleg16.png "$out/bootleg16/"
cp packaging/linux/install.sh packaging/linux/uninstall.sh packaging/linux/INSTALL.txt "$out/"
chmod +x "$out/install.sh" "$out/uninstall.sh" "$out/bootleg16/bootleg16"
tar czf "dist/$name.tar.gz" -C dist "$name"
echo "dist/$name.tar.gz ($(du -h "dist/$name.tar.gz" | cut -f1)): unpack and run ./install.sh"

```

`packaging/linux/install.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install bootleg16 for this user: the game in ~/.local/share/bootleg16, a `bootleg16` command
# in ~/.local/bin and a menu entry. No root. PREFIX=/some/dir to put the game elsewhere.
set -euo pipefail
here="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
prefix="${PREFIX:-$HOME/.local/share/bootleg16}"
bin="${BINDIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}"
apps="${APPDIR:-$HOME/.local/share/applications}"
icons="${ICONDIR:-$HOME/.local/share/icons/hicolor/512x512/apps}"

[ -x "$here/bootleg16/bootleg16" ] || { echo "Run this from the unpacked folder (bootleg16/ next to install.sh)."; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$prefix" "$bin" "$apps" "$icons"
rm -rf "$prefix"
mkdir -p "$prefix"
cp -r "$here/bootleg16/." "$prefix/"
cp "$here/bootleg16/bootleg16.png" "$icons/bootleg16.png"

cat > "$bin/bootleg16" <<RUN
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Start bootleg16 with its data next to it.
export BOOTLEG16_DIR="$prefix/data"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$prefix\${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:\$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
exec "$prefix/bootleg16" "\$@"
RUN
chmod +x "$bin/bootleg16"

cat > "$apps/bootleg16.desktop" <<DESK
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=bootleg16
Comment=Team shooter
Exec=$bin/bootleg16
Icon=bootleg16
Terminal=false
Categories=Game;ActionGame;
DESK

command -v update-desktop-database >/dev/null && update-desktop-database "$apps" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Installed to $prefix. Start it from your menu or run: bootleg16"
case ":$PATH:" in *":$bin:"*) ;; *) echo "(add $bin to your PATH to use the command)";; esac

```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Remove bootleg16 (the game and its menu entry). Your settings in ~/.config/bootleg16 stay
# unless you pass --purge.
set -euo pipefail
prefix="${PREFIX:-$HOME/.local/share/bootleg16}"
```
