`server/src/main.rs`:

```rs
//! Dedicated server. Usage: `server [map] [port] [--config server.cfg] [--give ak47,awp] [--tick 64]`
//! (defaults: de_dust2, 27015). Match rules come from the config file (see `config/server.cfg`);
//! without `--config`, `server.cfg` in the current directory is used if it exists.
//! Reads the map from the CS 1.6 install in `BOOTLEG16_DIR` (default: Steam's).
//! `--give` hands every player extra weapons on spawn.
//! `--practice <dummies>` runs the practice room (infinite ammo, quick respawn, standing dummies).
//! There are no bots: matches are people only.
//! `--play <recording.bdem> [port] [--speed N] [--from TICK]`: replay a match recording; join
//! it with the game (`client --connect 127.0.0.1:<port>`) to watch it as a spectator.
//! `--reports <reports.jsonl>` / `--review <reports.jsonl> <n> [port] [--demos dir]`: see `review`.
mod review;

use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn main() {
    let mut positional = Vec::new();
    let mut give = Vec::new();
    let mut practice: Option<u8> = None;
    let mut config: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    let mut tick: Option<u32> = None;
    let all: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    if let Some(i) = all.iter().position(|a| a == "--play") {
        return play(&all, i);
    }
    if let Some(i) = all.iter().position(|a| a == "--reports") {
        return review::list(all.get(i + 1).expect("--reports <reports.jsonl>"));
    }
    if let Some(i) = all.iter().position(|a| a == "--review") {
        let file = all.get(i + 1).expect("--review <reports.jsonl> <n>");
        let n = all.get(i + 2).and_then(|n| n.parse().ok()).expect("--review <reports.jsonl> <n>");
        let demos = all.iter().position(|a| a == "--demos").and_then(|i| all.get(i + 1)).map_or("demos", |d| d.as_str());
        let (demo, from) = review::find(file, n, std::path::Path::new(demos));
        let port = all.iter().skip(i + 3).filter(|a| !a.starts_with("--")).find_map(|a| a.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(net::protocol::DEFAULT_PORT);
        return watch(&demo, port, 1, Some(from));
    }
    let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
    while let Some(a) = args.next() {
        if a == "--practice" {
            practice = Some(args.next().and_then(|n| n.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(5));
        } else if a == "--tick" {
            tick = args.next().and_then(|n| n.parse().ok());
            assert!(tick.is_some(), "--tick 64 or --tick 128");
        } else if a == "--config" {
            config = args.next().map(PathBuf::from);
        } else if a == "--give" {
            for w in args.next().unwrap_or_default().split(',') {
                give.push(sim::weapons::data::by_name(w).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("unknown weapon {w}")));
            }
        } else {
            positional.push(a);
        }
    }
    let map = positional.first().cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| "de_dust2".into());
    let port: u16 = positional.get(1).and_then(|p| p.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(net::protocol::DEFAULT_PORT);
    let dir = net::gamefiles::data_dir();
    let path = dir.join("maps").join(format!("{map}.bsp"));
    let bsp = goldsrc::bsp::Bsp::load(&path).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("loading {}: {e}", path.display()));
    let addr = SocketAddr::from(([0, 0, 0, 0], port));
    let assets = net::server::Assets::load(&dir).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("loading game files: {e}"));
    let mut server = net::Server::new(addr, &map, &bsp, assets).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("binding {addr}: {e}"));
    server.set_game_dir(dir.clone());
    server.set_give(give);
    let config = config.or_else(|| Some(PathBuf::from("server.cfg")).filter(|p| p.exists()));
    if let Some(path) = config {
        let cfg = net::config::MatchConfig::load(&path).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}"));
        println!("match rules from {}", path.display());
        server.set_config(cfg);
    }
    if let Some(hz) = tick {
        server.set_rate(net::tick::TickRate::new(hz).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("--tick must be 64 or 128")));
    }
    if let Some(n) = practice {
        server.set_rules(net::server::Rules::practice(n));
    }
    println!("bootleg16 server: {map} on {} at {} tick", server.local_addr(), server.tick_rate().hz());
    // SIGTERM / Ctrl-C (docker stop, updates): finish the current match, then exit.
    on_stop_signal();
    server.run_draining(&STOP);
}

static STOP: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

/// Set STOP on SIGINT / SIGTERM (std has no signal API; libc's `signal` is always linked).
fn on_stop_signal() {
    extern "C" fn handler(_: i32) {
        STOP.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    extern "C" {
        fn signal(sig: i32, handler: extern "C" fn(i32)) -> usize;
    }
    const SIGINT: i32 = 2;
    const SIGTERM: i32 = 15;
    unsafe {
        signal(SIGINT, handler);
        signal(SIGTERM, handler);
    }
}

/// Replay a recording for the game to watch.
fn play(args: &[String], i: usize) {
    let file = args.get(i + 1).expect("--play <recording.bdem>");
    let flag = |name: &str| args.iter().position(|a| a == name).and_then(|i| args.get(i + 1)).and_then(|v| v.parse::<u32>().ok());
    let port = args.iter().skip(1).filter(|a| !a.starts_with("--")).filter_map(|a| a.parse::<u16>().ok()).next().unwrap_or(net::protocol::DEFAULT_PORT);
    watch(std::path::Path::new(file), port, flag("--speed").unwrap_or(1), flag("--from"));
}

fn watch(file: &std::path::Path, port: u16, speed: u32, from: Option<u32>) {
    let mut replay = net::replay::Replay::open(SocketAddr::from(([127, 0, 0, 1], port)), file).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}"));
    replay.speed = speed;
    if let Some(tick) = from {
        replay.skip_to(tick);
    }
    let h = replay.header();
    println!("replaying {} ({}, recorded on {}): watch with  client --connect {}", file.display(), h.map, h.server, replay.local_addr());
    replay.run();
}

```

`server/src/review.rs`:

```rs
//! Reviewing reports: `server --reports <reports.jsonl>` lists them (newest last, numbered);
//! `server --review <reports.jsonl> <n> [port] [--demos dir]` replays the recording it points at
//! from a little before the moment (the recording is on the game server named in the report:
//! copy it from that machine's demos folder first).
use serde_json::Value;
use std::path::Path;

/// Start this long before the reported moment (the lead-up matters).
const LEAD_SECONDS: u32 = 10;

fn load(path: &str) -> Vec<Value> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("reading {path}: {e}"));
    text.lines().filter_map(|l| serde_json::from_str(l).ok()).collect()
}

fn who(v: &Value) -> String {
    match v {
        Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
        v => format!("{} ({})", v["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"), v["steam"]),
    }
}

/// One line per report: number, age, why, who reported whom, where.
pub fn list(path: &str) {
    let now = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).map(|d| d.as_secs()).unwrap_or(0);
    for (i, r) in load(path).iter().enumerate() {
        let hours = now.saturating_sub(r["time"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0)) / 3600;
        let detail = r["detail"].as_str().map(|d| format!(": {d}")).unwrap_or_default();
        let demo = r["demo"].as_str().filter(|d| !d.is_empty()).map(|d| format!("{d} at tick {}", r["tick"])).unwrap_or("no recording".into());
        println!(
            "#{}  {hours}h ago  {}{detail}  by {} against {}  {} round {}  on {}  {demo}",
            i + 1,
            r["reason"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
            who(&r["reporter"]),
            who(&r["reported"]),
            r["map"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
            r["round"].as_u64().map(|n| n.to_string()).unwrap_or("-".into()),
            r["server"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
        );
    }
}

/// Report number `n`'s recording (in `demos`) and where to start watching.
pub fn find(path: &str, n: usize, demos: &Path) -> (std::path::PathBuf, u32) {
    let all = load(path);
    let r = all.get(n.wrapping_sub(1)).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no report #{n} (there are {})", all.len()));
    let demo = r["demo"].as_str().filter(|d| !d.is_empty()).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("report #{n} has no recording"));
    // Only a file name: never let a report point outside the demos folder.
    let name = Path::new(demo).file_name().unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("bad recording name {demo}"));
    let file = demos.join(name);
    if !file.exists() {
        panic!("{} isn't here: copy it from {}'s demos folder", file.display(), r["server"].as_str().unwrap_or("the game server"));
    }
    let tick = r["tick"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32;
    // The report's tick is in the recording's own ticks (its header says how many a second).
    let hz = net::demo::Reader::open(&file).map_or(net::tick::DEFAULT_TICK_RATE, |r| r.header.tick_rate);
    (file, tick.saturating_sub(LEAD_SECONDS * hz))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn finds_the_recording_and_starts_before_the_moment() {
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("bootleg16-review-{}", std::process::id()));
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(dir.join("m.bdem"), b"").unwrap();
        let reports = dir.join("reports.jsonl");
        let line = r#"{"time":1,"reason":"Cheating","reporter":{"steam":1,"name":"a"},"reported":{"steam":2,"name":"b"},"map":"de_dust2","round":3,"demo":"../../m.bdem","tick":5000,"server":"1.2.3.4:27015"}"#;
        std::fs::write(&reports, format!("{line}\nnot json\n")).unwrap();
        let (file, from) = super::find(reports.to_str().unwrap(), 1, &dir);
        assert_eq!(file, dir.join("m.bdem"), "stays inside the demos folder");
        assert_eq!(from, 5000 - 10 * net::tick::DEFAULT_TICK_RATE);
        super::list(reports.to_str().unwrap());
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
    }
}
```

`sim/examples/floorplan.rs`:

```rs
//! A map's floor plan as a grid of bytes (1 where there is floor under open air at head height),
//! for matching against the overview images. Usage: floorplan <map.bsp> <out.bin>
//! Writes: i32 columns, i32 rows, f32 min_x, f32 min_y, f32 step, then rows*columns bytes
//! (row 0 = min y, column 0 = min x).
use goldsrc::bsp::Bsp;
use sim::collision::World;

fn main() {
    let a: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let bsp = Bsp::load(&a[1]).unwrap();
    let world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let (lo, hi) = (bsp.models[0].mins, bsp.models[0].maxs);
    let step = 16.0f32;
    let (cols, rows) = (((hi[0] - lo[0]) / step) as usize + 1, ((hi[1] - lo[1]) / step) as usize + 1);
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    out.extend((cols as i32).to_le_bytes());
    out.extend((rows as i32).to_le_bytes());
    for v in [lo[0], lo[1], step] {
        out.extend(v.to_le_bytes());
    }
    let mut grid = vec![0u8; cols * rows];
    for r in 0..rows {
        for c in 0..cols {
            let (x, y) = (lo[0] + c as f32 * step, lo[1] + r as f32 * step);
            // any floor: a downward line from above that lands on a surface facing up
            let t = world.trace_line([x, y, hi[2] - 1.0], [x, y, lo[2] + 1.0]);
            if t.fraction < 1.0 && t.normal[2] > 0.7 && !t.hit_sky {
                grid[r * cols + c] = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    out.extend(grid);
    std::fs::write(&a[2], out).unwrap();
}
```

```rs
//! Print which hit group a horizontal shot hits at each height. Usage: hitscan <model.mdl> [crouch]
fn main() {
```

```rs
//! Trace lines in 8 directions from a point. Usage: tline <map.bsp> x y z
fn main() {
    let a: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let bsp = goldsrc::bsp::Bsp::load(&a[1]).unwrap();
    let w = sim::collision::World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let p: Vec<f32> = a[2..5].iter().map(|x| x.parse().unwrap()).collect();
    let p = [p[0], p[1], p[2]];
    println!("contents at point: {:?}, standing hull solid: {}", w.point_contents(p), w.is_solid(sim::collision::Hull::Standing, p));
    for yaw in (0..360).step_by(45) {
        let (s, c) = (yaw as f32).to_radians().sin_cos();
        let t = w.trace_line(p, [p[0] + c * 100.0, p[1] + s * 100.0, p[2]]);
        let h = w.trace(sim::collision::Hull::Standing, [p[0], p[1], p[2] - 20.0], [p[0] + c * 100.0, p[1] + s * 100.0, p[2] - 20.0]);
        println!("yaw {yaw:3}: line fraction {:.2} start_solid {}  | hull fraction {:.2}", t.fraction, t.start_solid, h.fraction);
    }
}
```

`sim/src/anim.rs`:

```rs
//! How a player's model is animated, the way CS 1.6 does it, shared by the client (drawing)
//! and the server (posing hitboxes, so shots hit where players are drawn):
//! - Legs: idle / walk / run (crouched: crouch_idle / crouchrun) played by speed, facing where
//!   they move (`StudioEstimateGait`); more than 120 degrees from the view they face the other
//!   way and play backwards; standing still they catch up with the view. In the air: `jump`.
//! - Upper body: the weapon's aim pose at the look pitch, or a one-off action (shoot, reload,
//!   flinch), twisted back towards the view over the spine (`CalculateYawBlend`).
use crate::hitbox::HitGroup;
use crate::weapons::{data::anim_ext, Id};
use goldsrc::mdl::{BoneTransform, Model};

/// What drives a player's animation this instant.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Drive {
    pub origin: [f32; 3],
    /// Where they look (GoldSrc degrees; pitch down-positive).
    pub yaw: f32,
    pub pitch: f32,
    pub crouched: bool,
    pub airborne: bool,
    pub reloading: bool,
    pub weapon: Id,
}

/// A one-off upper-body animation.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Action {
    Shoot,
    Reload,
    Flinch(HitGroup),
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Anim {
    /// Which way the legs face (degrees) and whether the gait plays backwards.
    pub gait_yaw: f32,
    backwards: bool,
    gait_frame: f32,
    /// Ground speed, smoothed.
    speed: f32,
    last_origin: Option<[f32; 3]>,
    /// When they left the ground.
    jumped: Option<f32>,
    action: Option<(Action, f32)>,
    reloading: bool,
}

/// What `pose` computed: bone transforms (model space) and the yaw the model faces.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Posed {
    pub bones: Vec<BoneTransform>,
    pub yaw: f32,
}

fn wrap(a: f32) -> f32 {
    (a + 540.0).rem_euclid(360.0) - 180.0
}

impl Anim {
    pub fn new(yaw: f32) -> Anim {
        Anim { gait_yaw: yaw, backwards: false, gait_frame: 0.0, speed: 0.0, last_origin: None, jumped: None, action: None, reloading: false }
    }

    /// They fired (the shoot animation starts again).
    pub fn shot(&mut self, now: f32) {
        self.action = Some((Action::Shoot, now));
    }

    /// They were hit.
    pub fn hurt(&mut self, group: HitGroup, now: f32) {
        self.action = Some((Action::Flinch(group), now));
    }

    /// Advance by `dt` seconds (at time `now`).
    pub fn step(&mut self, model: &Model, d: &Drive, now: f32, dt: f32) {
        let dt = dt.max(1e-4);
        let last = self.last_origin.unwrap_or(d.origin);
        let (vx, vy) = ((d.origin[0] - last[0]) / dt, (d.origin[1] - last[1]) / dt);
        self.last_origin = Some(d.origin);
        let moved = (vx * vx + vy * vy).sqrt();
        if moved < 5.0 {
            let diff = wrap(d.yaw - self.gait_yaw);
            self.gait_yaw = wrap(self.gait_yaw + diff * if dt < 0.25 { dt * 4.0 } else { dt });
        } else {
            self.gait_yaw = vy.atan2(vx).to_degrees();
        }
        self.backwards = false;
        let twist = wrap(d.yaw - self.gait_yaw);
        if twist > 120.0 {
            self.gait_yaw = wrap(self.gait_yaw - 180.0);
            self.backwards = true;
        } else if twist < -120.0 {
            self.gait_yaw = wrap(self.gait_yaw + 180.0);
            self.backwards = true;
        }
        self.speed = self.speed * 0.8 + moved.min(400.0) * 0.2;
        let (gait, nominal) = self.gait(model, d);
        let gs = &model.sequences[gait];
        let rate = if nominal > 0.0 { (self.speed / nominal).clamp(0.5, 1.5) } else { 1.0 };
        let step = gs.fps * rate * dt * if self.backwards { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
        self.gait_frame = (self.gait_frame + step).rem_euclid(gs.frames.max(1) as f32);
        match (d.airborne, self.jumped) {
            (true, None) => self.jumped = Some(now),
            (false, Some(_)) => self.jumped = None,
            _ => {}
        }
        if d.reloading && !self.reloading {
            self.action = Some((Action::Reload, now));
        }
        self.reloading = d.reloading;
    }

    /// The gait sequence for their speed and stance, and the speed it's drawn for.
    fn gait(&self, model: &Model, d: &Drive) -> (usize, f32) {
        let (name, nominal) = match (d.crouched, self.speed) {
            (true, s) if s > 10.0 => ("crouchrun", 85.0),
            (true, _) => ("crouch_idle", 0.0),
            (false, s) if s > 150.0 => ("run", 250.0),
            (false, s) if s > 10.0 => ("walk", 130.0),
            _ => ("idle1", 0.0),
        };
        (model.sequence(name).unwrap_or(0), nominal)
    }

    /// The pose now.
    pub fn pose(&mut self, model: &Model, d: &Drive, now: f32) -> Posed {
        let stance = if d.crouched { "crouch" } else { "ref" };
        let ext = anim_ext(d.weapon);
        let (mut gait, _) = self.gait(model, d);
        let mut gait_frame = self.gait_frame;
        if let (Some(t0), Some(j)) = (self.jumped, model.sequence("jump")) {
            gait = j;
            gait_frame = ((now - t0) * model.sequences[j].fps).min(model.sequences[j].frames as f32 - 1.0);
        }
        let aim = model.sequence(&format!("{stance}_aim_{ext}")).or_else(|| model.sequence(&format!("{stance}_aim_carbine"))).unwrap_or(0);
        let mut upper = (aim, 0.0);
        if let Some((a, t0)) = self.action {
            let name = match a {
                Action::Shoot => format!("{stance}_shoot_{ext}"),
                Action::Reload => format!("{stance}_reload_{ext}"),
                Action::Flinch(HitGroup::Head) => "head_flinch".into(),
                Action::Flinch(_) => "gut_flinch".into(),
            };
            match model.sequence(&name) {
                Some(s) if (now - t0) * model.sequences[s].fps < model.sequences[s].frames as f32 - 1.0 => upper = (s, (now - t0) * model.sequences[s].fps),
                _ => self.action = None,
            }
        }
        // Aim pitch picks the blend (9 sets from looking up to looking down).
        let blend = 0.5 + d.pitch.clamp(-90.0, 90.0) / 180.0;
        let twist = wrap(d.yaw - self.gait_yaw).clamp(-90.0, 90.0);
        Posed { bones: model.player_pose((gait, gait_frame), upper, blend, twist), yaw: self.gait_yaw }
    }
}
```

`sim/src/breakables.rs`:

```rs
//! `func_breakable` brushes: glass, vents and crates that break when shot or blown up.
//! Read from the map so the server and clients agree on which pieces exist.
use crate::Vec3;
use goldsrc::bsp::Bsp;

/// What a breakable is made of (the BSP `material` key), for its break sound and debris.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub enum Material {
    Glass,
    Wood,
    Metal,
    Flesh,
    Concrete,
    CeilingTile,
    Computer,
    UnbreakableGlass,
    Rocks,
}

impl Material {
    fn from_key(v: i32) -> Material {
        use Material::*;
        [Glass, Wood, Metal, Flesh, Concrete, CeilingTile, Computer, UnbreakableGlass, Rocks].get(v.max(0) as usize).copied().unwrap_or(Glass)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Breakable {
    /// The brush model (`*N`).
    pub model: usize,
    pub health: f32,
    pub material: Material,
    /// Spawnflag 1: only breaks when triggered (dust2's crates, by the bomb going off at its site).
    pub trigger_only: bool,
    pub targetname: String,
    /// Middle of the brush (world space), for the break sound and debris.
    pub center: Vec3,
}

pub fn from_bsp(bsp: &Bsp) -> Vec<Breakable> {
    bsp.entity_list()
        .iter()
        .filter(|e| e.get("classname").map(String::as_str) == Some("func_breakable"))
        .filter_map(|e| {
            let model: usize = e.get("model")?.strip_prefix('*')?.parse().ok()?;
            let m = bsp.models.get(model)?;
            let num = |k: &str| e.get(k).and_then(|v| v.parse::<f32>().ok());
            let flags = num("spawnflags").unwrap_or(0.0) as i32;
            Some(Breakable {
                model,
                health: num("health").unwrap_or(1.0).max(1.0),
                material: Material::from_key(num("material").unwrap_or(0.0) as i32),
                trigger_only: flags & 1 != 0,
                targetname: e.get("targetname").cloned().unwrap_or_default(),
                center: std::array::from_fn(|i| (m.mins[i] + m.maxs[i]) / 2.0),
            })
        })
        .filter(|b| b.material != Material::UnbreakableGlass)
        .collect()
}

/// Targets fired when the bomb goes off in a site: the site's `target` key (dust2: `tgt_a`).
pub fn bomb_site_targets(bsp: &Bsp) -> Vec<(Vec3, Vec3, String)> {
    bsp.entity_list()
        .iter()
        .filter(|e| e.get("classname").map(String::as_str) == Some("func_bomb_target"))
        .filter_map(|e| {
            let model: usize = e.get("model")?.strip_prefix('*')?.parse().ok()?;
            let m = bsp.models.get(model)?;
            Some((m.mins, m.maxs, e.get("target")?.clone()))
        })
        .collect()
}
```

`sim/src/collision.rs`:

```rs
//! Swept player-hull traces against the map's precomputed collision hulls.
//!
//! GoldSrc compiles each map with "expanded" hulls: the world grown by the player
//! box. Tracing the player's centre point through that hull equals sweeping the
//! box through the real world.
use crate::doors::{angle_vectors, local_to_world, world_to_local, Actor, Doors};
use crate::{add, dot, lerp, sub, Vec3};
use goldsrc::bsp::Bsp;

const CONTENTS_EMPTY: i32 = -1;
const CONTENTS_SOLID: i32 = -2;
/// Traces stop this far short of a surface so the next one doesn't start inside it.
const DIST_EPSILON: f32 = 0.03125;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum Hull {
    Standing = 1,
    Crouched = 3,
}

impl Hull {
    /// Box size relative to the player's origin (the box centre).
    pub fn mins(self) -> Vec3 {
        match self {
            Hull::Standing => [-16.0, -16.0, -36.0],
            Hull::Crouched => [-16.0, -16.0, -18.0],
        }
    }
    pub fn maxs(self) -> Vec3 {
        match self {
            Hull::Standing => [16.0, 16.0, 36.0],
            Hull::Crouched => [16.0, 16.0, 18.0],
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Trace {
    /// Started inside solid.
    pub start_solid: bool,
    /// The whole move was inside solid.
    pub all_solid: bool,
    /// 0..1: how far along the move it got.
    pub fraction: f32,
    pub end: Vec3,
    /// Normal of the surface hit (valid when fraction < 1).
    pub normal: Vec3,
    hit_contents: i32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Node {
    normal: Vec3,
    dist: f32,
    children: [i32; 2],
}

/// A solid brush model: the world (offset zero) or a brush entity at an offset.
struct Model {
    heads: [i32; 4],
    offset: Vec3,
    /// Index into `World::doors` when this model moves.
    door: Option<usize>,
    bsp_model: usize,
    /// False once broken (a `func_breakable` that was shot or blown up): no longer solid.
    enabled: bool,
    /// Drawn normally (`rendermode` 0): you can't see through it. Glass, fences and other
    /// see-through brushes aren't.
    opaque: bool,
    /// World-space bounds (where it sits closed, for doors), for skipping far-off models.
    bounds: (Vec3, Vec3),
}

/// Which BSP tree a trace walks: the player-sized clip hulls, or the exact
/// geometry (hull 0, the render tree) that bullets use.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum Tree<'a> {
    Clip(&'a [Node]),
    Point(&'a [Node], &'a [i32]),
}

const CONTENTS_SKY: i32 = -6;

impl Tree<'_> {
    fn nodes(&self) -> &[Node] {
        match self {
            Tree::Clip(n) | Tree::Point(n, _) => n,
        }
    }
    /// Contents of a leaf reached as child `num` (< 0).
    fn leaf(&self, num: i32) -> i32 {
        match self {
            Tree::Clip(_) => num,
            Tree::Point(_, leaves) => leaves.get((-(num + 1)) as usize).copied().unwrap_or(CONTENTS_EMPTY),
        }
    }
    fn blocks(&self, contents: i32) -> bool {
        contents == CONTENTS_SOLID || (matches!(self, Tree::Point(..)) && contents == CONTENTS_SKY)
    }
    fn contents(&self, mut num: i32, p: Vec3) -> i32 {
        let nodes = self.nodes();
        while num >= 0 {
            let n = &nodes[num as usize];
            num = n.children[(dot(n.normal, p) - n.dist < 0.0) as usize];
        }
        self.leaf(num)
    }
}

/// A bullet trace through the exact map geometry.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct LineTrace {
    pub fraction: f32,
    pub end: Vec3,
    pub normal: Vec3,
    /// Started inside solid (e.g. the muzzle is in a wall).
    pub start_solid: bool,
    /// Stopped by the sky (no decal, no penetration).
    pub hit_sky: bool,
    /// The BSP model hit (0 = the world, else a brush entity such as a breakable).
    pub model: usize,
}

/// Point `p` in a model's own space, given where its door (if any) currently is.
fn to_local(m: &Model, door: Option<&crate::doors::Door>, p: Vec3) -> Vec3 {
    let Some(d) = door else { return sub(p, m.offset) };
    let (off, ang) = d.transform();
    let rel = sub(p, add(m.offset, off));
    if ang == [0.0; 3] {
        return rel;
    }
    let (f, r, u) = angle_vectors(ang);
    world_to_local(rel, f, r, u)
}

fn contents(nodes: &[Node], mut num: i32, p: Vec3) -> i32 {
    while num >= 0 {
        let n = &nodes[num as usize];
        num = n.children[(dot(n.normal, p) - n.dist < 0.0) as usize];
    }
    num
}

/// Point contents a player can be in.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum Contents {
    Empty,
    Solid,
    Water,
}

/// Axis-aligned box of a ladder brush, in world space.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Ladder {
    pub mins: Vec3,
    pub maxs: Vec3,
}

/// Everything the movement code collides with.
pub struct World {
    nodes: Vec<Node>,
    models: Vec<Model>,
    /// Hull-0 BSP (render nodes): the only tree that knows about water.
    point_nodes: Vec<Node>,
    leaf_contents: Vec<i32>,
    /// Hull-0 roots to test for water: the world plus `func_water` brushes.
    water_roots: Vec<(i32, Vec3)>,
    pub ladders: Vec<Ladder>,
    pub doors: Doors,
    /// Buy zones, bomb sites.
    pub zones: crate::zones::Zones,
    /// Faces on each point node, for finding the texture a bullet hit.
    node_faces: Vec<(u32, u32)>,
    surfaces: Vec<Surface>,
    textures: Vec<String>,
}

/// Enough of a face to tell whether a point on its plane is inside it.
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct Surface {
    s: [f32; 4],
    t: [f32; 4],
    /// Texture-space extents of the face.
    min: [f32; 2],
    max: [f32; 2],
    texture: u32,
}

/// Brush entities players walk through.
fn non_solid(class: &str) -> bool {
    class.starts_with("trigger_")
        || class.starts_with("func_buyzone")
        || matches!(
            class,
            "func_bomb_target" | "func_hostage_rescue" | "func_vip_safetyzone" | "func_escapezone" | "func_illusionary" | "func_ladder"
        )
}

impl World {
    pub fn from_bsp(bsp: &Bsp) -> World {
        let nodes = bsp
            .clipnodes
            .iter()
            .map(|c| {
                let p = bsp.planes[c.plane as usize];
                Node { normal: p.normal, dist: p.dist, children: [c.children[0] as i32, c.children[1] as i32] }
            })
            .collect();
        // Point nodes: map leaf children to the clip-node convention (negative = contents).
        let point_nodes = bsp
            .nodes
            .iter()
            .map(|n| {
                let p = bsp.planes[n.plane as usize];
                Node { normal: p.normal, dist: p.dist, children: [n.children[0] as i32, n.children[1] as i32] }
            })
            .collect();
        let doors = Doors::from_bsp(bsp);
        let mut models = vec![Model { heads: bsp.models[0].head_nodes, offset: [0.0; 3], door: None, bsp_model: 0, enabled: true, opaque: true, bounds: ([f32::MIN; 3], [f32::MAX; 3]) }];
        let mut water_roots = vec![(bsp.models[0].head_nodes[0], [0.0; 3])];
        let mut ladders = Vec::new();
        for e in bsp.entity_list() {
            let class = e.get("classname").map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
            let Some(i) = e.get("model").and_then(|m| m.strip_prefix('*')?.parse::<usize>().ok()) else { continue };
            if i == 0 || i >= bsp.models.len() {
                continue;
            }
            let o: Vec<f32> = e.get("origin").map(|o| o.split_whitespace().filter_map(|x| x.parse().ok()).collect()).unwrap_or_default();
            let offset = [o.first().copied().unwrap_or(0.0), o.get(1).copied().unwrap_or(0.0), o.get(2).copied().unwrap_or(0.0)];
            let m = bsp.models[i];
            match class {
                "func_ladder" => ladders.push(Ladder { mins: crate::add(m.mins, offset), maxs: crate::add(m.maxs, offset) }),
                "func_water" => water_roots.push((m.head_nodes[0], offset)),
                c if non_solid(c) => {}
                _ => {
                    let opaque = e.get("rendermode").and_then(|v| v.parse::<i32>().ok()).unwrap_or(0) == 0;
                    models.push(Model { heads: m.head_nodes, offset, door: doors.door_for_model(i), bsp_model: i, enabled: true, opaque, bounds: (crate::add(m.mins, offset), crate::add(m.maxs, offset)) })
                }
            }
        }
        let surfaces = bsp
            .faces
            .iter()
            .map(|f| {
                let ti = bsp.texinfo[f.texinfo as usize];
                let (mut min, mut max) = ([f32::MAX; 2], [f32::MIN; 2]);
                for v in bsp.face_vertices(f) {
                    for (k, axis) in [ti.s, ti.t].iter().enumerate() {
                        let x = dot(v, [axis[0], axis[1], axis[2]]) + axis[3];
                        min[k] = min[k].min(x);
                        max[k] = max[k].max(x);
                    }
                }
                Surface { s: ti.s, t: ti.t, min, max, texture: ti.miptex }
            })
            .collect();
        World {
            nodes,
            models,
            point_nodes,
            leaf_contents: bsp.leaf_contents.clone(),
            water_roots,
            ladders,
            doors,
            zones: crate::zones::Zones::from_bsp(bsp),
            node_faces: bsp.nodes.iter().map(|n| (n.first_face as u32, n.num_faces as u32)).collect(),
            surfaces,
            textures: bsp.textures.iter().map(|t| t.name.clone()).collect(),
        }
    }

    /// Name of the world texture hit by the line `start`..`end` (first surface crossed).
    /// The world face (BSP face index) a line meets first, if any.
    pub fn face_at(&self, start: Vec3, end: Vec3) -> Option<usize> {
        self.surface_at(self.water_roots.first()?.0, start, end)
    }

    pub fn texture_at(&self, start: Vec3, end: Vec3) -> Option<&str> {
        let root = self.water_roots.first()?.0;
        let face = self.surface_at(root, start, end)?;
        self.textures.get(self.surfaces[face].texture as usize).map(String::as_str)
    }

    /// The texture a line meets on brush model `bsp_model` (0: the world), where it is now
    /// (GoldSrc `TRACE_TEXTURE` on the entity a bullet hit: glass, crates, doors).
    pub fn texture_of(&self, bsp_model: usize, start: Vec3, end: Vec3) -> Option<&str> {
        if bsp_model == 0 {
            return self.texture_at(start, end);
        }
        let m = self.models.iter().find(|m| m.bsp_model == bsp_model)?;
        let door = self.door_of(m);
        let face = self.surface_at(m.heads[0], to_local(m, door, start), to_local(m, door, end))?;
        self.textures.get(self.surfaces[face].texture as usize).map(String::as_str)
    }

    fn surface_at(&self, num: i32, start: Vec3, end: Vec3) -> Option<usize> {
        if num < 0 {
            return None;
        }
        let n = self.point_nodes[num as usize];
        let (d1, d2) = (dot(n.normal, start) - n.dist, dot(n.normal, end) - n.dist);
        let side = (d1 < 0.0) as usize;
        if (d2 < 0.0) as usize == side {
            return self.surface_at(n.children[side], start, end);
        }
        let mid = lerp(start, end, d1 / (d1 - d2));
        if let Some(f) = self.surface_at(n.children[side], start, mid) {
            return Some(f);
        }
        let (first, count) = self.node_faces[num as usize];
        for i in first..first + count {
            let sf = &self.surfaces[i as usize];
            let s = dot(mid, [sf.s[0], sf.s[1], sf.s[2]]) + sf.s[3];
            let t = dot(mid, [sf.t[0], sf.t[1], sf.t[2]]) + sf.t[3];
            if s >= sf.min[0] - 0.5 && s <= sf.max[0] + 0.5 && t >= sf.min[1] - 0.5 && t <= sf.max[1] + 0.5 {
                return Some(i as usize);
            }
        }
        self.surface_at(n.children[side ^ 1], mid, end)
    }

    /// Advance doors and triggers one tick.
    pub fn update(&mut self, dt: f32, actors: &[Actor]) {
        let (nodes, models) = (&self.nodes, &self.models);
        self.doors.update(dt, actors, |door, a| {
            let origin = crate::scale(add(a.mins, a.maxs), 0.5);
            let hull = if a.maxs[2] - a.mins[2] > 40.0 { Hull::Standing } else { Hull::Crouched };
            models
                .iter()
                .filter(|m| m.bsp_model == door.model)
                .any(|m| contents(nodes, m.heads[hull as usize], to_local(m, Some(door), origin)) == CONTENTS_SOLID)
        });
    }

    fn contents(&self, num: i32, p: Vec3) -> i32 {
        contents(&self.nodes, num, p)
    }

    fn door_of(&self, m: &Model) -> Option<&crate::doors::Door> {
        m.door.map(|i| &self.doors.doors[i])
    }

    /// What a single point is in (water comes from the hull-0 tree and `func_water`).
    pub fn point_contents(&self, p: Vec3) -> Contents {
        if self.is_solid_point(p) {
            return Contents::Solid;
        }
        for &(root, offset) in &self.water_roots {
            let mut num = root;
            let q = sub(p, offset);
            while num >= 0 {
                let n = &self.point_nodes[num as usize];
                num = n.children[(dot(n.normal, q) - n.dist < 0.0) as usize];
            }
            // Leaf index is -(num + 1); its contents say what it is.
            let c = self.leaf_contents.get((-(num + 1)) as usize).copied().unwrap_or(CONTENTS_EMPTY);
            // func_water brushes are marked solid/water in their own tree.
            if matches!(c, -5..=-3) || (root != self.water_roots[0].0 && c == CONTENTS_SOLID) {
                return Contents::Water;
            }
        }
        Contents::Empty
    }

    fn is_solid_point(&self, p: Vec3) -> bool {
        let mut num = self.water_roots[0].0;
        while num >= 0 {
            let n = &self.point_nodes[num as usize];
            num = n.children[(dot(n.normal, p) - n.dist < 0.0) as usize];
        }
        self.leaf_contents.get((-(num + 1)) as usize) == Some(&CONTENTS_SOLID)
    }

    /// The ladder the player box at `origin` is touching, if any.
    pub fn ladder_at(&self, hull: Hull, origin: Vec3) -> Option<&Ladder> {
        let (mins, maxs) = (crate::add(origin, hull.mins()), crate::add(origin, hull.maxs()));
        self.ladders.iter().find(|l| (0..3).all(|i| mins[i] <= l.maxs[i] + 1.0 && maxs[i] >= l.mins[i] - 1.0))
    }

    /// Is the player box at `origin` stuck in something?
    pub fn is_solid(&self, hull: Hull, origin: Vec3) -> bool {
        self.models.iter().filter(|m| m.enabled).any(|m| self.contents(m.heads[hull as usize], to_local(m, self.door_of(m), origin)) == CONTENTS_SOLID)
    }

    /// Sweep the player box from `start` to `end`; returns where it stops.
    pub fn trace(&self, hull: Hull, start: Vec3, end: Vec3) -> Trace {
        let mut best = Trace { start_solid: false, all_solid: false, fraction: 1.0, end, normal: [0.0; 3], hit_contents: CONTENTS_EMPTY };
        for m in self.models.iter().filter(|m| m.enabled) {
            let head = m.heads[hull as usize];
            let door = self.door_of(m);
            let (s, e) = (to_local(m, door, start), to_local(m, door, end));
            let mut t = Trace { start_solid: false, all_solid: true, fraction: 1.0, end: e, normal: [0.0; 3], hit_contents: CONTENTS_EMPTY };
            self.recursive(Tree::Clip(&self.nodes), head, head, 0.0, 1.0, s, e, &mut t);
            // Rotated door: bring the hit normal back to world space.
            if let Some(ang) = door.map(|d| d.transform().1).filter(|a| *a != [0.0; 3]) {
                let (f, r, u) = angle_vectors(ang);
                t.normal = local_to_world(t.normal, f, r, u);
            }
            if t.all_solid {
                t.start_solid = true;
            }
            if t.start_solid {
                best.start_solid = true;
                best.all_solid |= t.all_solid;
            }
            if t.fraction < best.fraction {
                best.fraction = t.fraction;
                best.normal = t.normal;
                best.end = lerp(start, end, t.fraction);
            }
        }
        if best.start_solid {
            // GoldSrc's player trace: starting inside solid counts as blocked at once.
            best.fraction = 0.0;
            best.end = start;
        } else if best.fraction == 1.0 {
            best.end = end;
        }
        best
    }

    /// A bullet-style line trace through the exact geometry (world + doors).
    /// A breakable broke (false) or was put back at round start (true).
    pub fn set_broken(&mut self, bsp_model: usize, broken: bool) {
        for m in self.models.iter_mut().filter(|m| m.bsp_model == bsp_model) {
            m.enabled = !broken;
        }
    }

    /// Whether anything you can't see through blocks a line of sight: the world, closed doors,
    /// crates (as they are now: open doors and broken pieces don't). For hiding players you
    /// can't see: anything see-through (glass, fences) must not count.
    pub fn sight_blocked(&self, start: Vec3, end: Vec3) -> bool {
        let tree = Tree::Point(&self.point_nodes, &self.leaf_contents);
        let near = |m: &Model| (0..3).all(|i| start[i].min(end[i]) <= m.bounds.1[i] && start[i].max(end[i]) >= m.bounds.0[i]);
        self.models.iter().filter(|m| m.enabled && m.opaque && m.heads[0] >= 0).any(|m| {
            let door = self.door_of(m);
            if door.is_none() && !near(m) {
                return false;
            }
            let (s, e) = (to_local(m, door, start), to_local(m, door, end));
            let head = m.heads[0];
            let mut t = Trace { start_solid: false, all_solid: true, fraction: 1.0, end: e, normal: [0.0; 3], hit_contents: CONTENTS_EMPTY };
            self.recursive(tree, head, head, 0.0, 1.0, s, e, &mut t);
            t.fraction < 1.0
        })
    }

    pub fn trace_line(&self, start: Vec3, end: Vec3) -> LineTrace {
        let tree = Tree::Point(&self.point_nodes, &self.leaf_contents);
        let mut best = LineTrace { fraction: 1.0, end, normal: [0.0; 3], start_solid: false, hit_sky: false, model: 0 };
        for m in self.models.iter().filter(|m| m.enabled) {
            let head = m.heads[0];
            if head < 0 {
                continue;
            }
            let door = self.door_of(m);
            let (s, e) = (to_local(m, door, start), to_local(m, door, end));
            let mut t = Trace { start_solid: false, all_solid: true, fraction: 1.0, end: e, normal: [0.0; 3], hit_contents: CONTENTS_EMPTY };
            self.recursive(tree, head, head, 0.0, 1.0, s, e, &mut t);
            if let Some(ang) = door.map(|d| d.transform().1).filter(|a| *a != [0.0; 3]) {
                let (f, r, u) = angle_vectors(ang);
                t.normal = local_to_world(t.normal, f, r, u);
            }
            best.start_solid |= t.start_solid || t.all_solid;
            if t.fraction < best.fraction {
                best.fraction = t.fraction;
                best.normal = t.normal;
                best.end = lerp(start, end, t.fraction);
                best.hit_sky = t.hit_contents == CONTENTS_SKY;
                best.model = m.bsp_model;
            }
        }
        best
    }

    /// Returns false once the move is blocked (the hit is recorded in `t`).
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn recursive(&self, tree: Tree, head: i32, num: i32, f1: f32, f2: f32, p1: Vec3, p2: Vec3, t: &mut Trace) -> bool {
        if num < 0 {
            if !tree.blocks(tree.leaf(num)) {
                t.all_solid = false;
            } else {
                t.start_solid = true;
            }
            return true;
        }
        let n = tree.nodes()[num as usize];
        let (d1, d2) = (dot(n.normal, p1) - n.dist, dot(n.normal, p2) - n.dist);
        if d1 >= 0.0 && d2 >= 0.0 {
            return self.recursive(tree, head, n.children[0], f1, f2, p1, p2, t);
        }
        if d1 < 0.0 && d2 < 0.0 {
            return self.recursive(tree, head, n.children[1], f1, f2, p1, p2, t);
        }
        // The move crosses this plane: split it, stopping just short of the plane.
        let mut frac = if d1 < 0.0 { (d1 + DIST_EPSILON) / (d1 - d2) } else { (d1 - DIST_EPSILON) / (d1 - d2) }.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let mut midf = f1 + (f2 - f1) * frac;
        let mut mid = lerp(p1, p2, frac);
        let side = (d1 < 0.0) as usize;

        if !self.recursive(tree, head, n.children[side], f1, midf, p1, mid, t) {
            return false;
        }
        let beyond = tree.contents(n.children[side ^ 1], mid);
        if !tree.blocks(beyond) {
            return self.recursive(tree, head, n.children[side ^ 1], midf, f2, mid, p2, t);
        }
        t.hit_contents = beyond;
        if t.all_solid {
            return false; // never left solid
        }
        // Hit the plane from `side`.
        t.normal = if side == 0 { n.normal } else { [-n.normal[0], -n.normal[1], -n.normal[2]] };
        // Back off until outside solid (float error can land the midpoint inside).
        while tree.blocks(tree.contents(head, mid)) {
            frac -= 0.1;
            if frac < 0.0 {
                t.fraction = midf;
                t.end = mid;
                return false;
            }
            midf = f1 + (f2 - f1) * frac;
            mid = lerp(p1, p2, frac);
        }
        t.fraction = midf;
        t.end = mid;
        false
    }

    /// Test helper: an infinite floor at height `z` (solid below).
    pub fn flat_floor(z: f32) -> World {
        // One node per hull: plane z = floor + half the hull height; below is solid.
        let nodes = vec![
            Node { normal: [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], dist: z + 36.0, children: [CONTENTS_EMPTY, CONTENTS_SOLID] },
            Node { normal: [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], dist: z + 18.0, children: [CONTENTS_EMPTY, CONTENTS_SOLID] },
        ];
        World {
            nodes,
            // Hull 0 (exact geometry) root is point node 0; hulls 1 and 3 are clip nodes 0 and 1.
            models: vec![Model { heads: [0, 0, -1, 1], offset: [0.0; 3], door: None, bsp_model: 0, enabled: true, opaque: true, bounds: ([f32::MIN; 3], [f32::MAX; 3]) }],
            point_nodes: vec![Node { normal: [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], dist: z, children: [-1, -2] }],
            leaf_contents: vec![CONTENTS_EMPTY, CONTENTS_SOLID],
            water_roots: vec![(0, [0.0; 3])],
            ladders: Vec::new(),
            doors: Doors::default(),
            zones: Default::default(),
            node_faces: vec![(0, 0)],
            surfaces: Vec::new(),
            textures: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn falling_onto_floor_stops_just_above_it() {
        let w = World::flat_floor(0.0);
        let t = w.trace(Hull::Standing, [0.0, 0.0, 100.0], [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
        assert!(t.fraction < 1.0 && !t.start_solid);
        assert!((t.end[2] - 36.0).abs() < 0.1, "stopped at {:?}", t.end);
        assert_eq!(t.normal, [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn open_move_is_unblocked_and_solid_start_detected() {
        let w = World::flat_floor(0.0);
        let t = w.trace(Hull::Standing, [0.0, 0.0, 100.0], [50.0, 0.0, 100.0]);
        assert_eq!(t.fraction, 1.0);
        assert!(w.trace(Hull::Standing, [0.0, 0.0, 10.0], [0.0, 0.0, 20.0]).all_solid);
        assert!(!w.is_solid(Hull::Crouched, [0.0, 0.0, 20.0]));
        assert!(w.is_solid(Hull::Standing, [0.0, 0.0, 20.0]));
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Health, armor and death. Damage formulas live with the weapons.
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

pub const MAX_HEALTH: f32 = 100.0;
pub const MAX_ARMOR: f32 = 100.0;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Vitals {
    pub health: f32,
    pub armor: f32,
    pub helmet: bool,
}

impl Default for Vitals {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Vitals { health: MAX_HEALTH, armor: 0.0, helmet: false }
    }
}

impl Vitals {
    pub fn alive(&self) -> bool {
        self.health > 0.0
    }

    /// Take `health_damage` and `armor_damage` (already split by the armor rules).
    /// Returns true if this killed the player.
    pub fn hurt(&mut self, health_damage: f32, armor_damage: f32) -> bool {
        if !self.alive() {
            return false;
        }
        self.armor = (self.armor - armor_damage).max(0.0);
        if self.armor == 0.0 {
            self.helmet = false;
        }
        self.health -= health_damage;
        !self.alive()
    }
}

use crate::hitbox::HitGroup;

/// Hit group damage multiplier (`TraceAttack`).
pub fn hitgroup_multiplier(g: HitGroup) -> f32 {
    match g {
        HitGroup::Head => 4.0,
        HitGroup::Stomach => 1.25,
        HitGroup::LeftLeg | HitGroup::RightLeg => 0.75,
        HitGroup::Shield => 0.0,
        _ => 1.0,
    }
}

/// Whether kevlar protects this body part (head also needs the helmet; legs never).
fn armored(v: &Vitals, g: HitGroup) -> bool {
    v.armor > 0.0
        && match g {
            HitGroup::Head => v.helmet,
            HitGroup::LeftLeg | HitGroup::RightLeg | HitGroup::Shield => false,
            _ => true,
        }
}

/// Health lost from one bullet or knife hit (`TakeDamage`), applying the armor rules.
/// `damage` already includes the hit group multiplier. Returns (health damage, armor damage).
/// `armor_factor` is the attacker's weapon (AWP 1.95, AK 1.55, ...). `teammate`: x0.35.
pub fn bullet_damage(v: &Vitals, mut damage: f32, group: HitGroup, armor_factor: f32, teammate: bool) -> (f32, f32) {
    if teammate {
        damage *= 0.35;
    }
    if !armored(v, group) {
        return (damage.trunc(), 0.0);
    }
    let ratio = 0.5 * armor_factor;
    let mut health = ratio * damage;
    let mut armor_loss = (damage - health) * 0.5;
    if armor_loss > v.armor {
        // Not enough armor left: it absorbs twice its value, the rest goes through.
        health = damage - v.armor * 2.0;
        armor_loss = v.armor;
    } else if armor_loss < 0.0 {
        armor_loss = 1.0;
    }
    (health.trunc(), armor_loss)
}

/// Health lost from an explosion (HE, C4): generic hit group, armor absorbs 1x.
pub fn explosion_damage(v: &Vitals, damage: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
    if v.armor <= 0.0 {
        return (damage.trunc(), 0.0);
    }
    let mut health = 0.5 * damage;
    let mut armor_loss = (damage - health) * 0.5;
    if armor_loss > v.armor {
        health = damage - v.armor;
        armor_loss = v.armor;
    }
    (health.trunc(), armor_loss)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn armored_vitals(helmet: bool) -> Vitals {
        Vitals { health: 100.0, armor: 100.0, helmet }
    }

    #[test]
    fn known_cs_damage_numbers() {
        // AK-47 (36 damage, armor factor 1.55) at point blank.
        let body = bullet_damage(&armored_vitals(true), 36.0, HitGroup::Chest, 1.55, false);
        assert_eq!(body.0, 27.0, "AK chest on kevlar");
        let head = bullet_damage(&armored_vitals(true), 36.0 * 4.0, HitGroup::Head, 1.55, false);
        assert_eq!(head.0, 111.0, "AK headshot through a helmet kills");
        let bare = bullet_damage(&Vitals::default(), 36.0 * 4.0, HitGroup::Head, 1.55, false);
        assert_eq!(bare.0, 144.0);
        // Legs are never armored.
        assert_eq!(bullet_damage(&armored_vitals(true), 27.0, HitGroup::LeftLeg, 1.55, false).0, 27.0);
        // Helmetless head hit ignores the vest.
        assert_eq!(bullet_damage(&armored_vitals(false), 144.0, HitGroup::Head, 1.55, false).0, 144.0);
        // AWP body shot on kevlar: 115 * 0.975 = 112 -> kills.
        assert_eq!(bullet_damage(&armored_vitals(false), 115.0, HitGroup::Chest, 1.95, false).0, 112.0);
        // Teammate damage is 35%.
        assert_eq!(bullet_damage(&Vitals::default(), 100.0, HitGroup::Chest, 1.0, true).0, 35.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn thin_armor_lets_damage_through() {
        let v = Vitals { health: 100.0, armor: 2.0, helmet: false };
        // AK 36: wants armor loss (36-27.9)*0.5 = 4.05 > 2 -> health = 36 - 4 = 32.
        assert_eq!(bullet_damage(&v, 36.0, HitGroup::Chest, 1.55, false), (32.0, 2.0));
    }
}
```

`sim/src/crowd.rs`:

```rs
//! Players are solid to each other: nobody stands inside someone else. One rule for the
//! server and the client's prediction, so they agree.
use crate::collision::{Hull, World};
use crate::Vec3;

/// Landing on (or touching the top of) someone's head is not a collision: you can stand there.
const STAND_ON: f32 = 6.0;

/// `me` pushed out of every box in `others` it overlaps (sideways, by the smaller overlap).
/// A push into a wall is skipped.
pub fn push_out(world: &World, hull: Hull, mut me: Vec3, others: &[(Vec3, Hull)]) -> Vec3 {
    for (o, oh) in others {
        let overlap = |axis: usize| (me[axis] + hull.maxs()[axis]).min(o[axis] + oh.maxs()[axis]) - (me[axis] + hull.mins()[axis]).max(o[axis] + oh.mins()[axis]);
        let (dx, dy, dz) = (overlap(0), overlap(1), overlap(2));
        if dx <= 0.0 || dy <= 0.0 || dz <= STAND_ON {
            continue;
        }
        // Out along the axis with the smaller overlap, away from the other player.
        let axis = if dx <= dy { 0 } else { 1 };
        let depth = if axis == 0 { dx } else { dy } + 0.05;
        let mut moved = me;
        moved[axis] += if me[axis] >= o[axis] { depth } else { -depth };
        if !world.is_solid(hull, moved) {
            me = moved;
        }
    }
    me
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn overlapping_players_are_pushed_apart_but_can_stand_on_a_head() {
        let world = World::flat_floor(-100.0);
        let other = ([0.0, 0.0, 0.0], Hull::Standing);
        // Side by side, overlapping by 8 units on x: pushed out to touching.
        let out = push_out(&world, Hull::Standing, [24.0, 3.0, 0.0], &[other]);
        assert!((out[0] - 32.0).abs() < 0.2 && out[1] == 3.0, "{out:?}");
        // Already apart: untouched.
        assert_eq!(push_out(&world, Hull::Standing, [40.0, 0.0, 0.0], &[other]), [40.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
        // On top of a head (72 up): untouched.
        assert_eq!(push_out(&world, Hull::Standing, [5.0, 0.0, 72.0], &[other]), [5.0, 0.0, 72.0]);
    }
}

```

`sim/src/doors.rs`:

```rs
//! Doors (`func_door`, `func_door_rotating`), buttons (`func_button`, `func_rot_button`) and
//! the touch zones that open them (`trigger_multiple`). Behaviour follows GoldSrc's door
//! rules: named doors only open when triggered, unnamed ones open on touch, use-only doors
//! open with +use, rotating doors swing away from whoever opened them, and a closing door
//! that hits a player goes back up. A button moves in when used (or touched, if it's
//! touch-only), fires its target once it's in, and comes back out after `wait`.
//! +use picks as CS 1.6's `PlayerUse` does: the usable thing most in front of you, within
//! 64 units of your centre and 45 degrees of your view.
use crate::{add, dot, length, scale, sub, Vec3};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;

// Spawnflags shared by both door types.
const SF_START_OPEN: u32 = 1;
const SF_TOGGLE: u32 = 32; // stays open until activated again
const SF_USE_ONLY: u32 = 256;
// Rotating-door spawnflags.
const SF_REVERSE: u32 = 2;
const SF_ONE_WAY: u32 = 16;
const SF_ROTATE_X: u32 = 64;
const SF_ROTATE_Y: u32 = 128;

// Button spawnflags (toggle is the same bit as the doors' `SF_TOGGLE`).
const SF_BUTTON_DONTMOVE: u32 = 1;
const SF_BUTTON_TOUCH_ONLY: u32 = 256;

/// `PlayerUse`: `MAX_PLAYER_USE_RADIUS` (your centre to the thing's) and `VIEW_FIELD_NARROW`.
const USE_RANGE: f32 = 64.0;
const USE_CONE: f32 = 0.7;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum DoorState {
    Closed,
    Opening,
    /// Open; closes when the timer (seconds) runs out, unless it never auto-closes.
    Open(f32),
    Closing,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Door {
    /// Index into the map's brush models (for rendering and collision).
    pub model: usize,
    pub name: Option<String>,
    /// Rotation pivot (rotating doors) or zero.
    pub pivot: Vec3,
    /// Model bounds in model space.
    pub mins: Vec3,
    pub maxs: Vec3,
    rotating: bool,
    /// Linear: offset when fully open. Rotating: angles (pitch, yaw, roll) when fully open.
    open_delta: Vec3,
    speed: f32,
    /// Seconds to stay open; negative = never close on its own.
    wait: f32,
    flags: u32,
    /// 0 = closed .. 1 = open.
    progress: f32,
    /// A button: what it fires when pressed in.
    button: Option<Button>,
    /// Sounds: doors' `movesnd`/`stopsnd` (doors/doormoveN.wav, doors/doorstopN.wav), a
    /// button's `sounds` (buttons/buttonN.wav) in `move_sound`. 0 = none.
    pub move_sound: u8,
    pub stop_sound: u8,
    /// Rotating doors: +1 or -1, picked so the door swings away from the opener.
    sign: f32,
    pub state: DoorState,
}

impl Door {
    /// Current offset from the closed position, and current rotation angles (degrees).
    pub fn transform(&self) -> (Vec3, Vec3) {
        let d = scale(self.open_delta, self.progress * self.sign);
        if self.rotating {
            ([0.0; 3], d)
        } else {
            (d, [0.0; 3])
        }
    }

    /// World-space bounding box at the current position (conservative while rotating).
    pub fn bounds(&self) -> (Vec3, Vec3) {
        let (off, ang) = self.transform();
        let origin = add(self.pivot, off);
        let (f, r, u) = angle_vectors(ang);
        let mut lo = [f32::MAX; 3];
        let mut hi = [f32::MIN; 3];
        for i in 0..8 {
            let c = [
                if i & 1 == 0 { self.mins[0] } else { self.maxs[0] },
                if i & 2 == 0 { self.mins[1] } else { self.maxs[1] },
                if i & 4 == 0 { self.mins[2] } else { self.maxs[2] },
            ];
            let w = add(origin, local_to_world(c, f, r, u));
            for k in 0..3 {
                lo[k] = lo[k].min(w[k]);
                hi[k] = hi[k].max(w[k]);
            }
        }
        (lo, hi)
    }

    fn travel(&self) -> f32 {
        length(self.open_delta).max(1.0)
    }

    fn activate(&mut self, opener: Option<Vec3>) {
        if self.button.is_some() {
            // `ButtonUse`: not while moving; pressed in, only a toggle button comes back out.
            match self.state {
                DoorState::Closed => self.state = DoorState::Opening,
                DoorState::Open(t) if self.flags & SF_TOGGLE != 0 && t.is_infinite() && self.wait >= 0.0 => self.state = DoorState::Closing,
                _ => {}
            }
            return;
        }
        match self.state {
            DoorState::Open(_) if self.flags & SF_TOGGLE != 0 || self.wait < 0.0 => self.state = DoorState::Closing,
            DoorState::Open(_) | DoorState::Opening => {}
            DoorState::Closed | DoorState::Closing => {
                if self.rotating && self.state == DoorState::Closed && self.flags & SF_ONE_WAY == 0 {
                    if let Some(p) = opener {
                        self.sign = self.swing_away_from(p);
                    }
                }
                self.state = DoorState::Opening;
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn is_button(&self) -> bool {
        self.button.is_some()
    }

    /// Opened with +use: use-only doors, and buttons that aren't touch-only.
    fn usable(&self) -> bool {
        match self.button {
            Some(_) => self.flags & SF_BUTTON_TOUCH_ONLY == 0,
            None => self.flags & SF_USE_ONLY != 0,
        }
    }

    /// Opened by walking into it: unnamed doors that aren't use-only, touch-only buttons.
    fn touch_opens(&self) -> bool {
        match self.button {
            Some(_) => self.flags & SF_BUTTON_TOUCH_ONLY != 0,
            None => self.name.is_none() && self.flags & SF_USE_ONLY == 0,
        }
    }

    /// Pick the rotation direction that moves the door's far edge away from `p`.
    fn swing_away_from(&self, p: Vec3) -> f32 {
        let centre = scale(add(self.mins, self.maxs), 0.5); // model space = relative to pivot
        let to_player = sub(p, self.pivot);
        let base = if self.flags & SF_REVERSE != 0 { -1.0 } else { 1.0 };
        // Positive yaw turns the panel counter-clockwise, towards the panel's left side.
        let cross = centre[0] * to_player[1] - centre[1] * to_player[0];
        if cross > 0.0 {
            -base
        } else {
            base
        }
    }
}

/// The part of a door that changes during play (sent from server to clients).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct DoorNet {
    pub progress: f32,
    pub sign: f32,
    pub state: DoorState,
}

/// What a button fires (by name: doors open), after `delay`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Button {
    target: String,
    delay: f32,
}

/// A `trigger_multiple`: touching it fires its target (after `delay`), then rests `wait` seconds.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Trigger {
    mins: Vec3,
    maxs: Vec3,
    target: String,
    wait: f32,
    delay: f32,
    ready_at: f32,
}

/// What a player is doing this tick, for doors and triggers.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Actor {
    pub mins: Vec3,
    pub maxs: Vec3,
    pub eye: Vec3,
    /// View direction (unit vector).
    pub forward: Vec3,
    /// +use pressed this tick.
    pub using: bool,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Doors {
    pub doors: Vec<Door>,
    triggers: Vec<Trigger>,
    /// (time, target name) waiting to fire.
    pending: Vec<(f32, String)>,
    /// Names fired since the last `take_fired` (sounds and other things the clients play).
    fired: Vec<String>,
    time: f32,
}

fn vec3(s: Option<&String>) -> Vec3 {
    let v: Vec<f32> = s.map(|s| s.split_whitespace().filter_map(|x| x.parse().ok()).collect()).unwrap_or_default();
    [v.first().copied().unwrap_or(0.0), v.get(1).copied().unwrap_or(0.0), v.get(2).copied().unwrap_or(0.0)]
}

fn num(e: &HashMap<String, String>, k: &str, default: f32) -> f32 {
    e.get(k).and_then(|v| v.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(default)
}

/// GoldSrc "angle" key: -1 = up, -2 = down, else a yaw in degrees.
fn move_dir(e: &HashMap<String, String>) -> Vec3 {
    let yaw = e.get("angle").and_then(|v| v.parse::<f32>().ok()).unwrap_or_else(|| vec3(e.get("angles"))[1]);
    if yaw == -1.0 {
        [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
    } else if yaw == -2.0 {
        [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]
    } else {
        let (s, c) = yaw.to_radians().sin_cos();
        [c, s, 0.0]
    }
}

/// GoldSrc AngleVectors: forward, right, up for (pitch, yaw, roll) in degrees.
pub fn angle_vectors(a: Vec3) -> (Vec3, Vec3, Vec3) {
    let (sp, cp) = a[0].to_radians().sin_cos();
    let (sy, cy) = a[1].to_radians().sin_cos();
    let (sr, cr) = a[2].to_radians().sin_cos();
    (
        [cp * cy, cp * sy, -sp],
        [-sr * sp * cy + cr * sy, -sr * sp * sy - cr * cy, -sr * cp],
        [cr * sp * cy + sr * sy, cr * sp * sy - sr * cy, cr * cp],
    )
}

pub fn world_to_local(v: Vec3, f: Vec3, r: Vec3, u: Vec3) -> Vec3 {
    [dot(v, f), -dot(v, r), dot(v, u)]
}

pub fn local_to_world(l: Vec3, f: Vec3, r: Vec3, u: Vec3) -> Vec3 {
    add(add(scale(f, l[0]), scale(r, -l[1])), scale(u, l[2]))
}

fn overlaps(amin: Vec3, amax: Vec3, bmin: Vec3, bmax: Vec3) -> bool {
    (0..3).all(|i| amin[i] <= bmax[i] && amax[i] >= bmin[i])
}

impl Doors {
    pub fn from_bsp(bsp: &goldsrc::bsp::Bsp) -> Doors {
        let mut out = Doors::default();
        for e in bsp.entity_list() {
            let class = e.get("classname").map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
            let Some(model) = e.get("model").and_then(|m| m.strip_prefix('*')?.parse::<usize>().ok()) else { continue };
            let Some(m) = bsp.models.get(model) else { continue };
            let flags = num(&e, "spawnflags", 0.0) as u32;
            match class {
                "trigger_multiple" => out.triggers.push(Trigger {
                    mins: m.mins,
                    maxs: m.maxs,
                    target: e.get("target").cloned().unwrap_or_default(),
                    wait: num(&e, "wait", 0.2),
                    delay: num(&e, "delay", 0.0),
                    ready_at: 0.0,
                }),
                "func_door" | "func_door_rotating" | "func_button" | "func_rot_button" => {
                    let rotating = matches!(class, "func_door_rotating" | "func_rot_button");
                    let button = matches!(class, "func_button" | "func_rot_button");
                    // Buttons: `lip` 4, speed 40 and wait 1 when not set (0); `wait` -1 stays in.
                    let or = |v: f32, d: f32| if v == 0.0 { d } else { v };
                    let lip = if button { or(num(&e, "lip", 0.0), 4.0) } else { num(&e, "lip", 0.0) };
                    let open_delta = if rotating {
                        let dist = num(&e, "distance", 90.0);
                        if flags & SF_ROTATE_X != 0 {
                            [0.0, 0.0, dist]
                        } else if flags & SF_ROTATE_Y != 0 {
                            [dist, 0.0, 0.0]
                        } else {
                            [0.0, dist, 0.0]
                        }
                    } else {
                        // Move by the model's size along the direction, minus `lip`.
                        let dir = move_dir(&e);
                        let size = sub(m.maxs, m.mins);
                        let span = (dir[0] * (size[0] - 2.0)).abs() + (dir[1] * (size[1] - 2.0)).abs() + (dir[2] * (size[2] - 2.0)).abs();
                        if button && (span - lip < 1.0 || flags & SF_BUTTON_DONTMOVE != 0) {
                            [0.0; 3]
                        } else {
                            scale(dir, span - lip)
                        }
                    };
                    let mut door = Door {
                        model,
                        name: e.get("targetname").cloned(),
                        pivot: vec3(e.get("origin")),
                        mins: m.mins,
                        maxs: m.maxs,
                        rotating,
                        open_delta,
                        speed: if button { or(num(&e, "speed", 0.0), 40.0) } else { num(&e, "speed", 100.0) }.max(1.0),
                        wait: if button { or(num(&e, "wait", 0.0), 1.0) } else { num(&e, "wait", 3.0) },
                        // A button's flags only share the toggle and rotation bits with doors'.
                        flags: if button { flags & (SF_TOGGLE | SF_REVERSE | SF_ROTATE_X | SF_ROTATE_Y | SF_BUTTON_TOUCH_ONLY) } else { flags },
                        progress: 0.0,
                        button: button.then(|| Button { target: e.get("target").cloned().unwrap_or_default(), delay: num(&e, "delay", 0.0) }),
                        move_sound: num(&e, if button { "sounds" } else { "movesnd" }, 0.0) as u8,
                        stop_sound: if button { 0 } else { num(&e, "stopsnd", 0.0) as u8 },
                        sign: if rotating && flags & SF_REVERSE != 0 { -1.0 } else { 1.0 },
                        state: DoorState::Closed,
                    };
                    if !button && flags & SF_START_OPEN != 0 {
                        door.progress = 1.0;
                        door.state = DoorState::Open(f32::INFINITY);
                    }
                    out.doors.push(door);
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        out
    }

    pub fn net_state(&self) -> Vec<DoorNet> {
        self.doors.iter().map(|d| DoorNet { progress: d.progress, sign: d.sign, state: d.state }).collect()
    }

    /// Adopt the server's door positions (same map, so same door order).
    pub fn apply_net_state(&mut self, s: &[DoorNet]) {
        for (d, n) in self.doors.iter_mut().zip(s) {
            d.progress = n.progress;
            d.sign = n.sign;
            d.state = n.state;
        }
    }

    /// Target names fired since the last call (`ambient_generic` sounds listen for them).
    pub fn take_fired(&mut self) -> Vec<String> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.fired)
    }

    /// Index of the door using this brush model, if it is one.
    pub fn door_for_model(&self, model: usize) -> Option<usize> {
        self.doors.iter().position(|d| d.model == model)
    }

    /// Advance doors and triggers by `dt`. `blocked(door, actor)` reports whether a
    /// door at its current position overlaps that player (supplied by the world).
    pub fn update(&mut self, dt: f32, actors: &[Actor], blocked: impl Fn(&Door, &Actor) -> bool) {
        self.time += dt;
        let now = self.time;

        // Touch zones.
        for t in &mut self.triggers {
            if now >= t.ready_at && actors.iter().any(|a| overlaps(a.mins, a.maxs, t.mins, t.maxs)) {
                self.pending.push((now + t.delay, t.target.clone()));
                t.ready_at = now + t.wait;
            }
        }
        // Fire due targets.
        let (due, later): (Vec<_>, Vec<_>) = self.pending.drain(..).partition(|(t, _)| *t <= now);
        self.pending = later;
        for (_, name) in due {
            self.fired.push(name.clone());
            for d in self.doors.iter_mut().filter(|d| d.name.as_deref() == Some(name.as_str())) {
                d.activate(None);
            }
        }

        // Players touching or using doors and buttons.
        for a in actors {
            let centre = scale(add(a.mins, a.maxs), 0.5);
            if a.using {
                // `PlayerUse`: the usable thing whose centre is most in front of you, in reach.
                let hit = self
                    .doors
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .filter(|(_, d)| d.usable())
                    .filter_map(|(i, d)| {
                        let (lo, hi) = d.bounds();
                        let mid = scale(add(lo, hi), 0.5);
                        let to = sub(mid, a.eye);
                        let facing = dot(to, a.forward) / length(to).max(1e-3);
                        (length(sub(mid, centre)) <= USE_RANGE && facing > USE_CONE).then_some((i, facing))
                    })
                    .max_by(|x, y| x.1.total_cmp(&y.1));
                if let Some((i, _)) = hit {
                    self.doors[i].activate(Some(centre));
                }
            }
            for d in self.doors.iter_mut().filter(|d| d.touch_opens()) {
                let (lo, hi) = d.bounds();
                let grow = |v: Vec3, s: f32| add(v, [s; 3]);
                if matches!(d.state, DoorState::Closed | DoorState::Closing) && overlaps(a.mins, a.maxs, grow(lo, -1.0), grow(hi, 1.0)) {
                    d.activate(Some(centre));
                }
            }
        }

        // Motion.
        for d in &mut self.doors {
            let step = d.speed * dt / d.travel();
            match d.state {
                DoorState::Opening => {
                    d.progress = (d.progress + step).min(1.0);
                    if d.progress >= 1.0 {
                        d.state = DoorState::Open(if d.wait < 0.0 || d.flags & SF_TOGGLE != 0 { f32::INFINITY } else { d.wait });
                        // `TriggerAndWait`: a button pressed all the way in fires its target.
                        if let Some(b) = &d.button {
                            self.pending.push((now + b.delay, b.target.clone()));
                        }
                    }
                }
                DoorState::Open(t) => {
                    if t.is_finite() {
                        let left = t - dt;
                        d.state = if left <= 0.0 { DoorState::Closing } else { DoorState::Open(left) };
                    }
                }
                DoorState::Closing => {
                    let before = d.progress;
                    d.progress = (d.progress - step).max(0.0);
                    if d.button.is_none() && actors.iter().any(|a| blocked(d, a)) {
                        // Hit a player: go back up instead of crushing them.
                        d.progress = before;
                        d.state = DoorState::Opening;
                    } else if d.progress <= 0.0 {
                        d.state = DoorState::Closed;
                        // `ButtonBackHome`: a toggle button fires again when it comes back out.
                        if let Some(b) = d.button.as_ref().filter(|_| d.flags & SF_TOGGLE != 0) {
                            self.pending.push((now + b.delay, b.target.clone()));
                        }
                    }
                }
                DoorState::Closed => {}
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn panel(model: usize, name: Option<&str>, button: Option<&str>, at: Vec3, open_delta: Vec3) -> Door {
        Door {
            model,
            name: name.map(String::from),
            pivot: at,
            mins: [-2.0, -8.0, -8.0],
            maxs: [2.0, 8.0, 8.0],
            rotating: false,
            open_delta,
            speed: 40.0,
            wait: 1.0,
            flags: 0,
            progress: 0.0,
            sign: 1.0,
            state: DoorState::Closed,
            button: button.map(|t| Button { target: t.into(), delay: 0.0 }),
            move_sound: 0,
            stop_sound: 0,
        }
    }

    /// Someone standing `back` units in front of the button (at x = 0), looking along `forward`.
    fn actor(back: f32, forward: Vec3, using: bool) -> Actor {
        let o = [-back, 0.0, 36.0];
        Actor { mins: add(o, [-16.0, -16.0, -36.0]), maxs: add(o, [16.0, 16.0, 36.0]), eye: add(o, [0.0, 0.0, 17.0]), forward, using }
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_button_pressed_with_use_opens_its_door_then_pops_back_out() {
        let mut d = Doors { doors: vec![panel(1, None, Some("gate"), [0.0, 0.0, 50.0], [4.0, 0.0, 0.0]), panel(2, Some("gate"), None, [300.0, 0.0, 50.0], [0.0, 0.0, 100.0])], ..Default::default() };
        let tick = |d: &mut Doors, a: Actor| d.update(0.01, &[a], |_, _| false);
        // Looking away, or too far: nothing.
        tick(&mut d, actor(40.0, [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0], true));
        tick(&mut d, actor(90.0, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], true));
        assert_eq!(d.doors[0].state, DoorState::Closed);
        // Facing it, close enough: it goes in (4 units at 40/s), fires, and the gate opens.
        tick(&mut d, actor(40.0, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], true));
        assert_eq!(d.doors[0].state, DoorState::Opening);
        for _ in 0..12 {
            tick(&mut d, actor(40.0, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], false));
        }
        assert!(matches!(d.doors[0].state, DoorState::Open(_)), "{:?}", d.doors[0].state);
        assert_eq!(d.doors[1].state, DoorState::Opening, "the button fired its target");
        // Pressing again while it's in does nothing; after `wait` (1 s) it comes back out.
        tick(&mut d, actor(40.0, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], true));
        for _ in 0..120 {
            tick(&mut d, actor(40.0, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], false));
        }
        assert_eq!(d.doors[0].state, DoorState::Closed);
        // Touching a use-button does nothing.
        let mut touch = actor(0.0, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], false);
        touch.mins[0] = -2.0;
        tick(&mut d, touch);
        assert_eq!(d.doors[0].state, DoorState::Closed);
    }
}
```
