`sim/src/grenades.rs`:

```rs
//! Thrown grenades: GoldSrc toss/bounce physics, fuses, and what each one does
//! when it goes off (HE damage, flash blindness, smoke). docs/WEAPONS.md 2.8.
use crate::collision::World;
use crate::{add, dot, length, scale, sub, Vec3};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Kind {
    He,
    Flash,
    Smoke,
}

impl Kind {
    /// Gravity scale and friction (`ShootTimed`, `ShootSmokeGrenade`).
    fn physics(self) -> (f32, f32) {
        match self {
            Kind::He => (0.55, 0.7),
            Kind::Flash | Kind::Smoke => (0.5, 0.8),
        }
    }
}

pub const FUSE: f64 = 1.5;
const MAX_THROW_SPEED: f32 = 750.0;
pub const HE_DAMAGE: f32 = 100.0;
pub const HE_RADIUS: f32 = HE_DAMAGE * 3.5;
pub const FLASH_RADIUS: f32 = 1500.0;
/// How long a smoke cloud lasts (21 puffs, one per second).
pub const SMOKE_SECONDS: f64 = 21.0;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Grenade {
    pub kind: Kind,
    pub owner: u8,
    pub origin: Vec3,
    pub velocity: Vec3,
    pub on_ground: bool,
    bounces: u32,
    pub detonate_at: f64,
}

/// Start a throw: GoldSrc's pitch remap and speed `(90 - pitch) * 6`, capped at 750,
/// launched from 16 units in front of the eye, plus the thrower's own velocity.
pub fn throw(kind: Kind, owner: u8, eye: Vec3, pitch: f32, yaw: f32, player_velocity: Vec3, now: f64) -> Grenade {
    let p = if pitch < 0.0 { -10.0 + pitch * (80.0 / 90.0) } else { -10.0 + pitch * (100.0 / 90.0) };
    let speed = ((90.0 - p) * 6.0).min(MAX_THROW_SPEED);
    let (sp, cp) = p.to_radians().sin_cos();
    let (sy, cy) = yaw.to_radians().sin_cos();
    let forward = [cp * cy, cp * sy, -sp];
    Grenade {
        kind,
        owner,
        origin: add(eye, scale(forward, 16.0)),
        velocity: add(scale(forward, speed), player_velocity),
        on_ground: false,
        bounces: 0,
        detonate_at: now + FUSE,
    }
}

fn clip(v: Vec3, n: Vec3, backoff: f32) -> Vec3 {
    let mut out = sub(v, scale(n, dot(v, n) * backoff));
    for c in &mut out {
        if c.abs() < 0.1 {
            *c = 0.0;
        }
    }
    out
}

impl Grenade {
    /// One tick of `MOVETYPE_BOUNCE` physics plus the grenade's own touch rule.
    /// Returns true when it hit something hard enough to make a bounce sound.
    pub fn physics(&mut self, dt: f32, world: &World, gravity: f32) -> bool {
        if self.velocity[2] > 0.0 {
            self.on_ground = false;
        }
        if self.on_ground && self.velocity == [0.0; 3] {
            return false;
        }
        let (grav, friction) = self.kind.physics();
        self.velocity[2] -= grav * gravity * dt;
        let t = world.trace_line(self.origin, add(self.origin, scale(self.velocity, dt)));
        self.origin = t.end;
        if t.fraction >= 1.0 || t.start_solid {
            return false;
        }
        // Touch (`BounceTouch`): rolling slows it; after 10 bounces it settles.
        // The bounce sound plays for the first five bounces in the air.
        let sound = !self.on_ground && self.bounces < 5;
        if self.on_ground {
            self.velocity = scale(self.velocity, 0.8);
        } else {
            self.bounces += 1;
            if self.bounces >= 10 {
                self.on_ground = true;
                self.velocity = [0.0; 3];
                return sound;
            }
        }
        // Bounce off the surface: friction 0.7 keeps 30% of the speed into it, 0.8 keeps 20%.
        self.velocity = clip(self.velocity, t.normal, 2.0 - friction);
        if t.normal[2] > 0.7 {
            if dot(self.velocity, self.velocity) < 900.0 {
                self.on_ground = true;
                self.velocity = [0.0; 3];
            } else {
                // Use up the rest of the move along the new direction.
                let rest = scale(self.velocity, (1.0 - t.fraction) * dt * 0.9);
                self.origin = world.trace_line(self.origin, add(self.origin, rest)).end;
            }
        }
        sound
    }

    /// Ready to go off: HE and flash on the fuse; smoke on the fuse once on the ground.
    pub fn due(&self, now: f64) -> bool {
        now >= self.detonate_at && (self.kind != Kind::Smoke || self.on_ground)
    }

    /// HE blast point: pulled 45.6 units off the surface below, if it's close (`Explode3`).
    pub fn blast_point(&self, world: &World) -> Vec3 {
        let t = world.trace_line(add(self.origin, [0.0, 0.0, 8.0]), sub(self.origin, [0.0, 0.0, 40.0]));
        if t.fraction < 1.0 {
            add(t.end, scale(t.normal, (HE_DAMAGE - 24.0) * 0.6))
        } else {
            self.origin
        }
    }
}

/// HE damage to someone standing at `victim_origin` (no wall check, like cstrike).
pub fn he_damage(blast: Vec3, victim_origin: Vec3) -> f32 {
    let d = length(sub(add(blast, [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]), victim_origin));
    (HE_DAMAGE - d * (HE_DAMAGE / HE_RADIUS)).max(0.0)
}

/// How hard a flash blinds someone (`RadiusFlash`).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Blind {
    /// Seconds fully white, then seconds fading out.
    pub hold: f32,
    pub fade: f32,
    /// 255 when looking at it, 200 when facing away.
    pub alpha: u8,
}

/// `None` if the flash can't see the victim's eyes (wall in between) or is too far.
pub fn flash(world: &World, blast: Vec3, eye: Vec3, forward: Vec3) -> Option<Blind> {
    let from = add(blast, [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]);
    let blocked = |a: Vec3, b: Vec3| {
        let t = world.trace_line(a, b);
        t.fraction < 1.0 || t.start_solid
    };
    if blocked(from, eye) || blocked(eye, from) {
        return None;
    }
    let dist = length(sub(eye, from));
    if dist > FLASH_RADIUS {
        return None;
    }
    let adj = (4.0 - dist * (4.0 / FLASH_RADIUS)).max(0.0);
    if adj <= 0.0 {
        return None;
    }
    Some(if dot(sub(from, eye), forward) >= 0.0 {
        Blind { hold: adj / 1.5, fade: 3.0 * adj, alpha: 255 }
    } else {
        Blind { hold: adj / 3.5, fade: 1.75 * adj, alpha: 200 }
    })
}

/// A flash on someone still blinded by an earlier one (`RadiusFlash`): looking at it adds
/// the white hold that's left; while the old one lasts, the longer fade and the stronger white
/// win. `old`: when the last one started and how it was.
pub fn combine(new: Blind, old: Option<(f64, Blind)>, now: f64) -> Blind {
    let Some((start, old)) = old else { return new };
    let mut b = new;
    let hold_left = (start + old.hold as f64 - now) as f32;
    if hold_left > 0.0 && b.alpha == 255 {
        b.hold += hold_left;
    }
    if start + (old.fade + old.hold) as f64 > now {
        b.fade = b.fade.max(old.fade);
        b.alpha = b.alpha.max(old.alpha);
    }
    b
}

/// Flashes and HE blasts don't cross the water's surface (`RadiusFlash`, `RadiusDamage`): one
/// in water only reaches people in it (feet at least), one out of it nobody whose head is under.
pub fn blast_reaches(blast_in_water: bool, water_level: u8) -> bool {
    if blast_in_water {
        water_level > 0
    } else {
        water_level < 3
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const DT: f32 = 1.0 / 128.0;

    #[test]
    fn level_throw_speed_and_landing() {
        // Looking level: pitch remaps to -10, speed (90 + 10) * 6 = 600.
        let g = throw(Kind::He, 0, [0.0, 0.0, 100.0], 0.0, 0.0, [0.0; 3], 0.0);
        assert!((length(g.velocity) - 600.0).abs() < 0.01);
        assert!(g.velocity[2] > 0.0, "a level throw goes slightly upwards");
        // Looking down at 45 degrees throws slower and lower; straight up caps at 750.
        let down = throw(Kind::He, 0, [0.0; 3], 45.0, 0.0, [0.0; 3], 0.0);
        assert!(length(down.velocity) < 600.0);
        assert_eq!(length(throw(Kind::He, 0, [0.0; 3], -89.0, 0.0, [0.0; 3], 0.0).velocity), 750.0);

        let w = World::flat_floor(0.0);
        let mut g = throw(Kind::Flash, 0, [0.0, 0.0, 64.0], 0.0, 0.0, [0.0; 3], 0.0);
        let mut t = 0.0;
        while !g.on_ground && t < 10.0 {
            g.physics(DT, &w, 800.0);
            t += DT;
            if g.origin[2] < -0.01 {
                panic!("fell through the floor at t={t}: {:?} v={:?}", g.origin, g.velocity);
            }
        }
        assert!(g.on_ground && g.velocity == [0.0; 3], "came to rest");
        assert!(g.origin[0] > 200.0, "travelled {:?}", g.origin);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_second_flash_adds_to_the_first() {
        let full = Blind { hold: 2.0, fade: 6.0, alpha: 255 };
        let away = Blind { hold: 0.5, fade: 2.0, alpha: 200 };
        assert_eq!(combine(full, None, 10.0), full);
        // 1 s into a 2 s hold: 1 s left is added; fade and white stay the stronger.
        assert_eq!(combine(full, Some((9.0, full)), 10.0), Blind { hold: 3.0, fade: 6.0, alpha: 255 });
        // Facing away from the second: no hold added, but the first's white and fade carry on.
        assert_eq!(combine(away, Some((9.0, full)), 10.0), Blind { hold: 0.5, fade: 6.0, alpha: 255 });
        // Long over: the new one alone.
        assert_eq!(combine(away, Some((0.0, full)), 10.0), away);
        assert!(blast_reaches(false, 2) && !blast_reaches(false, 3));
        assert!(blast_reaches(true, 1) && !blast_reaches(true, 0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn he_falloff_and_flash_rules() {
        assert_eq!(he_damage([0.0; 3], [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]), 100.0);
        assert!((he_damage([0.0; 3], [175.0, 0.0, 1.0]) - 50.0).abs() < 0.01);
        assert_eq!(he_damage([0.0; 3], [400.0, 0.0, 1.0]), 0.0);
        let w = World::flat_floor(-100.0);
        let eye = [100.0, 0.0, 50.0];
        let facing = flash(&w, [0.0, 0.0, 49.0], eye, [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0]).unwrap();
        let away = flash(&w, [0.0, 0.0, 49.0], eye, [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(facing.alpha, 255);
        assert!(facing.hold > away.hold && facing.fade > away.fade);
        assert!(flash(&w, [0.0, 0.0, 49.0], [2000.0, 0.0, 50.0], [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0]).is_none(), "too far");
        // Behind the floor (no line of sight).
        assert!(flash(&w, [0.0, 0.0, -150.0], eye, [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0]).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn smoke_waits_for_the_ground() {
        let mut g = throw(Kind::Smoke, 0, [0.0, 0.0, 2000.0], 0.0, 0.0, [0.0; 3], 0.0);
        assert!(!g.due(2.0), "still in the air after the fuse");
        g.on_ground = true;
        assert!(g.due(2.0));
    }
}
```

`sim/src/hitbox.rs`:

```rs
//! Player hit zones from the real player model's hitboxes, posed with its own
//! animations (standing / crouched aim poses at 9 pitch steps).
use crate::Vec3;
use goldsrc::mdl::{BoneTransform, Model};

/// Body part a bullet hit (GoldSrc hit groups).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub enum HitGroup {
    Generic,
    Head,
    Chest,
    Stomach,
    LeftArm,
    RightArm,
    LeftLeg,
    RightLeg,
    Shield,
}

impl HitGroup {
    fn from_mdl(g: i32) -> HitGroup {
        match g {
            1 => HitGroup::Head,
            2 => HitGroup::Chest,
            3 => HitGroup::Stomach,
            4 => HitGroup::LeftArm,
            5 => HitGroup::RightArm,
            6 => HitGroup::LeftLeg,
            7 => HitGroup::RightLeg,
            8 => HitGroup::Shield,
            _ => HitGroup::Generic,
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct PosedBox {
    group: HitGroup,
    bone: BoneTransform,
    mins: Vec3,
    maxs: Vec3,
}

/// Number of aim-pitch poses (the CS player models' blend sets).
const PITCH_STEPS: usize = 9;

/// One aim pose set: [stance][pitch step] -> boxes in model space (x forward, z up).
type Poses = [Vec<Vec<PosedBox>>; 2];

pub struct Hitboxes {
    /// Per weapon pose (`ref_aim_<ext>`): the head sits up to ~7 units differently between
    /// them, so a player is hit where they're drawn for the gun they hold.
    poses: std::collections::HashMap<&'static str, Poses>,
    /// For weapons whose pose the model doesn't have.
    fallback: &'static str,
    /// The model's boxes (bone, group, bounds in the bone's space), for any pose (`trace_posed`).
    boxes: Vec<(usize, HitGroup, Vec3, Vec3)>,
    /// The model itself, to pose animated players (`trace_animated`).
    model: std::sync::Arc<Model>,
}

/// Every weapon pose name (`sim::weapons::data::anim_ext`).
const EXTS: [&str; 11] = ["carbine", "onehanded", "knife", "rifle", "ak47", "mp5", "shotgun", "grenade", "c4", "dualpistols", "m249"];

/// Where a ray entered a hitbox.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Hit {
    pub group: HitGroup,
    /// Distance along the (unit) ray.
    pub distance: f32,
}

impl Hitboxes {
    /// All weapon aim poses the model has; `fallback`: the one to use for the rest (e.g. "carbine").
    pub fn from_model(model: &Model, fallback: &str) -> Option<Hitboxes> {
        let set = |aim: &str| -> Option<Poses> {
            let stance = |prefix: &str| -> Option<Vec<Vec<PosedBox>>> {
                let seq = model.sequence(&format!("{prefix}_aim_{aim}"))?;
                Some(
                    (0..PITCH_STEPS)
                        .map(|i| {
                            let pose = model.pose(seq, 0, i as f32 / (PITCH_STEPS - 1) as f32);
                            model
                                .hitboxes
                                .iter()
                                .filter(|h| h.group != 8) // the shield box only matters with a shield
                                .map(|h| PosedBox { group: HitGroup::from_mdl(h.group), bone: pose[h.bone], mins: h.mins, maxs: h.maxs })
                                .collect()
                        })
                        .collect(),
                )
            };
            Some([stance("ref")?, stance("crouch")?])
        };
        let poses: std::collections::HashMap<_, _> = EXTS.iter().filter_map(|e| Some((*e, set(e)?))).collect();
        let fallback = *EXTS.iter().find(|e| **e == fallback && poses.contains_key(*e))?;
        let boxes = model.hitboxes.iter().filter(|h| h.group != 8).map(|h| (h.bone, HitGroup::from_mdl(h.group), h.mins, h.maxs)).collect();
        Some(Hitboxes { poses, fallback, boxes, model: std::sync::Arc::new(model.clone()) })
    }

    /// First hitbox the ray `start + dir * t` (dir normalised, t <= `max`) enters, for a
    /// player at `origin` facing `yaw` and aiming at `pitch` (GoldSrc degrees), holding `weapon`.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub fn trace(&self, origin: Vec3, yaw: f32, pitch: f32, crouched: bool, weapon: crate::weapons::Id, start: Vec3, dir: Vec3, max: f32) -> Option<Hit> {
        // Blend 0.5 + pitch/180 (GoldSrc pitch is down-positive): checked against the drawn model.
        let step = (((pitch + 90.0) / 180.0) * (PITCH_STEPS - 1) as f32).round().clamp(0.0, (PITCH_STEPS - 1) as f32) as usize;
        let set = self.poses.get(crate::weapons::data::anim_ext(weapon)).unwrap_or(&self.poses[self.fallback]);
        let boxes = &set[crouched as usize][step];
        // Into model space: undo the player's position and yaw.
        let (s, c) = (-yaw).to_radians().sin_cos();
        let rot = |v: Vec3| [v[0] * c - v[1] * s, v[0] * s + v[1] * c, v[2]];
        let ms = rot(crate::sub(start, origin));
        let md = rot(dir);
        let mut best: Option<Hit> = None;
        for b in boxes {
            let (o, d) = (b.bone.inverse_apply(ms), b.bone.inverse_rotate(md));
            if let Some(t) = slab(o, d, b.mins, b.maxs, max) {
                if best.is_none_or(|h| t < h.distance) {
                    best = Some(Hit { group: b.group, distance: t });
                }
            }
        }
        best
    }
}

impl Hitboxes {
    /// The player model the boxes come from.
    pub fn model(&self) -> &std::sync::Arc<Model> {
        &self.model
    }

    /// Like `trace`, posing the player as they're drawn first, but only when the ray comes near
    /// them (their box, grown for arms and gun): posing costs more than a box test.
    pub fn trace_animated(&self, anim: &(crate::anim::Anim, crate::anim::Drive, f32), origin: Vec3, crouched: bool, start: Vec3, dir: Vec3, max: f32) -> Option<Hit> {
        let (lo, hi) = if crouched { ([-40.0, -40.0, -24.0], [40.0, 40.0, 40.0]) } else { ([-40.0, -40.0, -40.0], [40.0, 40.0, 48.0]) };
        slab(crate::sub(start, origin), dir, lo, hi, max)?;
        let (mut a, d, now) = anim.clone();
        let posed = a.pose(&self.model, &d, now);
        self.trace_posed(&posed, origin, start, dir, max)
    }

    /// Like `trace`, for a player posed as they're drawn (`anim::Anim::pose`: whatever they're
    /// doing, legs and all), at `origin`, the model facing `posed.yaw`.
    pub fn trace_posed(&self, posed: &crate::anim::Posed, origin: Vec3, start: Vec3, dir: Vec3, max: f32) -> Option<Hit> {
        let (s, c) = (-posed.yaw).to_radians().sin_cos();
        let rot = |v: Vec3| [v[0] * c - v[1] * s, v[0] * s + v[1] * c, v[2]];
        let (ms, md) = (rot(crate::sub(start, origin)), rot(dir));
        let mut best: Option<Hit> = None;
        for &(bone, group, mins, maxs) in &self.boxes {
            let Some(b) = posed.bones.get(bone) else { continue };
            if let Some(t) = slab(b.inverse_apply(ms), b.inverse_rotate(md), mins, maxs, max) {
                if best.is_none_or(|h| t < h.distance) {
                    best = Some(Hit { group, distance: t });
                }
            }
        }
        best
    }
}

/// Ray vs axis-aligned box in the box's own space: entry distance, if within `max`.
pub(crate) fn slab(o: Vec3, d: Vec3, mins: Vec3, maxs: Vec3, max: f32) -> Option<f32> {
    let (mut t0, mut t1) = (0.0f32, max);
    for i in 0..3 {
        if d[i].abs() < 1e-8 {
            if o[i] < mins[i] || o[i] > maxs[i] {
                return None;
            }
            continue;
        }
        let (a, b) = ((mins[i] - o[i]) / d[i], (maxs[i] - o[i]) / d[i]);
        t0 = t0.max(a.min(b));
        t1 = t1.min(a.max(b));
        if t0 > t1 {
            return None;
        }
    }
    Some(t0)
}
```

```rs
//! Deterministic game simulation (GoldSrc units, Z up). No engine or rendering code.
pub mod anim;
pub mod breakables;
pub mod collision;
pub mod combat;
pub mod crowd;
pub mod doors;
pub mod grenades;
pub mod hitbox;
pub mod player;
pub mod pmove;
pub mod weapons;
pub mod zones;

pub type Vec3 = [f32; 3];

pub(crate) fn dot(a: Vec3, b: Vec3) -> f32 {
    a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2]
}
pub(crate) fn add(a: Vec3, b: Vec3) -> Vec3 {
    [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2]]
}
pub(crate) fn sub(a: Vec3, b: Vec3) -> Vec3 {
    [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]]
}
pub(crate) fn scale(a: Vec3, s: f32) -> Vec3 {
    [a[0] * s, a[1] * s, a[2] * s]
}
pub(crate) fn lerp(a: Vec3, b: Vec3, t: f32) -> Vec3 {
    add(a, scale(sub(b, a), t))
}
pub(crate) fn length(a: Vec3) -> f32 {
    dot(a, a).sqrt()
}
```

`sim/src/player.rs`:

```rs
//! One player's complete per-command step (movement, then weapons), shared by the
//! server and the client's prediction so both compute exactly the same thing.
use crate::collision::World;
use crate::pmove::{self, Events, Input, MoveVars, Player};
use crate::weapons::{Context, Fired, Loadout};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct PlayerState {
    pub movement: Player,
    pub loadout: Loadout,
}

/// What the round allows a player right now (sent to the client for its prediction).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Limits {
    /// Can't move (freeze time, defusing); looking around is fine.
    pub frozen: bool,
    /// Can't shoot, swing, throw or plant (freeze time, round over).
    pub no_attack: bool,
}

/// Run one input. `cmd_time` is this player's own command clock (input number x tick
/// length), which all weapon timers use, so a client replaying its inputs gets the
/// same timings as the server. `seed` drives spread and recoil randomness.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn step(s: &mut PlayerState, input: &Input, dt: f32, cmd_time: f64, seed: u64, limits: Limits, world: &World, vars: &MoveVars) -> (Events, Fired) {
    s.movement.max_speed = s.loadout.max_speed();
    let frozen_input;
    let input = if limits.frozen {
        frozen_input = Input { forward: 0.0, side: 0.0, jump: false, ..*input };
        &frozen_input
    } else {
        input
    };
    tagging(&mut s.movement, dt);
    let events = pmove::step(&mut s.movement, input, dt, world, vars);
    let ctx = Context {
        now: cmd_time,
        dt,
        on_ground: s.movement.on_ground,
        crouched: s.movement.crouched,
        speed_2d: s.movement.speed_2d(),
        yaw: input.yaw,
        pitch: input.pitch,
        attack: input.attack,
        attack2: input.attack2,
        reload: input.reload,
        slot: input.slot,
        drop: input.drop,
        can_shoot: !limits.no_attack,
        in_bomb_site: world.zones.in_bomb_site(s.movement.origin),
        seed,
    };
    let fired = s.loadout.update(&ctx);
    (events, fired)
}

/// Seed for one player's command: unique per player and input number.
pub fn seed(player: u8, seq: u32) -> u64 {
    ((player as u64) << 32) | seq as u64
}

/// The slowdown from being shot wearing off (CS 1.6 `CBasePlayer::PreThink`): on the ground,
/// each server frame the modifier gains 0.01 and scales the velocity. CS's servers ran ~100
/// frames a second; at our tick rate the same happens per 1/100 s.
pub fn tagging(p: &mut Player, dt: f32) {
    if p.on_ground && p.velocity_modifier < 1.0 {
        let frames = dt * 100.0;
        p.velocity_modifier = (p.velocity_modifier + 0.01 * frames).min(1.0);
        let k = p.velocity_modifier.powf(frames);
        p.velocity = p.velocity.map(|v| v * k);
    }
}

/// What a bullet hit does to the victim, as CS 1.6 (`TakeDamage`, `TraceAttack`, `ShouldDoLargeFlinch`):
/// slowdown 0.65 for a "large flinch" (standing, not a leg hit, from a rifle, sniper or
/// Deagle), else 0.5; and the view kicked up when the hit part had no armor.
/// `roll` is a random number in -1..1 for the head-shot tilt.
pub fn hit_by(s: &mut PlayerState, weapon: crate::weapons::Id, group: crate::hitbox::HitGroup, damage: f32, unarmored: bool, roll: f32) {
    use crate::hitbox::HitGroup::*;
    use crate::weapons::Id::*;
    let large_gun = matches!(weapon, Scout | Galil | Famas | Awp | M4a1 | Deagle | Ak47);
    let large = !s.movement.crouched && !matches!(group, LeftLeg | RightLeg) && large_gun;
    s.movement.velocity_modifier = if large { 0.65 } else { 0.5 };
    if !unarmored {
        return;
    }
    let punch = &mut s.loadout.punch;
    match group {
        Head => {
            punch[0] = (damage * -0.5).max(-12.0);
            punch[2] = (damage * roll).clamp(-9.0, 9.0);
        }
        Chest | Stomach => punch[0] = (damage * -0.1).max(-4.0),
        _ => {}
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::hitbox::HitGroup;
    use crate::weapons::{Id, Loadout};

    fn state() -> PlayerState {
        let mut m = Player::new([0.0; 3]);
        m.on_ground = true;
        PlayerState { movement: m, loadout: Loadout::knife_only() }
    }

    #[test]
    fn being_shot_slows_you_and_it_wears_off_in_half_a_second() {
        let mut s = state();
        hit_by(&mut s, Id::Ak47, HitGroup::Chest, 36.0, true, 0.0);
        assert_eq!(s.movement.velocity_modifier, 0.65, "AK to the chest standing: large flinch");
        assert!((s.loadout.punch[0] + 3.6).abs() < 1e-5, "chest, no armor: kick 36 x -0.1");
        s.movement.velocity = [250.0, 0.0, 0.0];
        tagging(&mut s.movement, 1.0 / 128.0);
        assert!(s.movement.velocity[0] < 250.0 * 0.75, "slowed: {:?}", s.movement.velocity);
        for _ in 0..64 {
            tagging(&mut s.movement, 1.0 / 128.0);
        }
        assert_eq!(s.movement.velocity_modifier, 1.0, "recovered after ~0.5 s");
        // Pistols and leg hits are the small flinch; a helmet stops the head kick.
        let mut s = state();
        hit_by(&mut s, Id::Glock, HitGroup::LeftLeg, 25.0, true, 0.0);
        assert_eq!((s.movement.velocity_modifier, s.loadout.punch[0]), (0.5, 0.0));
        hit_by(&mut s, Id::Usp, HitGroup::Head, 120.0, false, 0.5);
        assert_eq!(s.loadout.punch[0], 0.0);
        hit_by(&mut s, Id::Usp, HitGroup::Head, 120.0, true, 0.5);
        assert_eq!(s.loadout.punch, [-12.0, 0.0, 9.0]);
    }
}

```

`sim/src/pmove.rs`:

```rs
//! CS 1.6 player movement: friction, ground/air acceleration, stepping, jumping
//! with stamina, the bunny-hop speed cap, and crouching. Clean-room; constants
//! are read from the game's own `cs.so` (see docs/MOVEMENT.md).
use crate::collision::{Contents, Hull, Ladder, World};
use crate::{add, dot, length, scale, sub, Vec3};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

/// Server movement settings. Defaults are what CS 1.6 forces every round.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct MoveVars {
    pub gravity: f32,
    pub stop_speed: f32,
    pub accelerate: f32,
    pub air_accelerate: f32,
    pub friction: f32,
    pub edge_friction: f32,
    pub step_size: f32,
    pub max_velocity: f32,
    pub water_accelerate: f32,
    pub water_friction: f32,
}

impl Default for MoveVars {
    fn default() -> Self {
        MoveVars {
            gravity: 800.0,
            stop_speed: 75.0,
            accelerate: 5.0,
            air_accelerate: 10.0,
            friction: 4.0,
            edge_friction: 2.0,
            step_size: 18.0,
            max_velocity: 2000.0,
            water_accelerate: 10.0,
            water_friction: 1.0,
        }
    }
}

/// Jump speed for a 45-unit jump at 800 gravity: sqrt(2 * 800 * 45).
const JUMP_SPEED: f32 = 268.328_16;
/// Stamina set by a jump; it drains by 1000 per second and slows the next jump/landing.
const JUMP_STAMINA: f32 = 1315.789;
/// Bunny-hop cap: jumping above 1.2x max speed scales you down to 0.8 of that cap.
const BHOP_CAP: f32 = 1.2;
const BHOP_PENALTY: f32 = 0.8;
const CROUCH_SPEED: f32 = 0.333;
/// Air control: wish speed is capped at 30 for air acceleration.
const AIR_WISH_CAP: f32 = 30.0;
/// Surfaces steeper than this (normal z below it) are walls, not floors.
const FLOOR_NORMAL_Z: f32 = 0.7;
/// Moving up faster than this means you are not on the ground.
const LIFT_OFF_SPEED: f32 = 180.0;
/// Origin difference between the standing and crouched hulls (box centres).
const CROUCH_OFFSET: f32 = 18.0;
/// Shift-walk multiplier: client cvar `cl_movespeedkey` (client.so).
const WALK_SPEED: f32 = 0.52;
/// `PM_UpdateStepSound`: at this speed or slower no footsteps (and the next waits
/// `FOOTSTEP_QUIET_MS`); faster, one every `FOOTSTEP_MS` (ladders, wading knee-deep slower),
/// `FOOTSTEP_SLOW_MS` more crouched or on a ladder.
const FOOTSTEP_MIN_SPEED: f32 = 150.0;
const FOOTSTEP_QUIET_MS: f32 = 400.0;
const FOOTSTEP_MS: f32 = 300.0;
const FOOTSTEP_LADDER_MS: f32 = 350.0;
const FOOTSTEP_WADE_MS: f32 = 600.0;
const FOOTSTEP_SLOW_MS: f32 = 100.0;
/// Seconds to crouch on the ground (`PM_Duck`).
const TIME_TO_DUCK: f32 = 0.4;
/// Ladders (`PM_LadderMove`).
const LADDER_CLIMB_SPEED: f32 = 200.0;
const LADDER_JUMP_SPEED: f32 = 270.0;
/// Water (`PM_WaterMove`, `PM_Jump`). Swimming is at 0.8x max speed.
const WATER_SPEED: f32 = 0.8;
const WATER_SINK_SPEED: f32 = 60.0;
const WATER_SWIM_UP_SPEED: f32 = 100.0;
/// Falling (`PM_CheckFalling`, `CBasePlayer::PostThink`, `FlPlayerFallDamage`).
const LAND_SPEED: f32 = 250.0;
const SAFE_FALL_SPEED: f32 = 500.0;
const FALL_DAMAGE_PER_SPEED: f32 = 100.0 / 600.0 * 1.25;

pub const VIEW_HEIGHT_STANDING: f32 = 17.0;
pub const VIEW_HEIGHT_CROUCHED: f32 = 12.0;

pub const SLOT_LAST: u8 = 6;
pub const SLOT_NEXT: u8 = 7;
pub const SLOT_PREV: u8 = 8;

/// One tick of player input.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Input {
    /// Forward and sideways move (units/s; CS clients send ±400).
    pub forward: f32,
    pub side: f32,
    /// View yaw in degrees (GoldSrc: 0 = +X, counter-clockwise).
    pub yaw: f32,
    /// View pitch in degrees (GoldSrc: positive looks down). Used on ladders and in water.
    pub pitch: f32,
    pub jump: bool,
    pub crouch: bool,
    /// Shift: walk slowly (0.52x), quiet enough to make no footsteps.
    pub walk: bool,
    /// E (+use) held: opens use-only doors on the press.
    pub use_key: bool,
    /// Mouse 1 / mouse 2 / R held.
    pub attack: bool,
    pub attack2: bool,
    pub reload: bool,
    /// Weapon selection this tick: 1 primary .. 5 bomb, `SLOT_LAST` (Q),
    /// `SLOT_NEXT` / `SLOT_PREV` (mouse wheel); 0 = none.
    pub slot: u8,
    /// G: drop the weapon in hand.
    pub drop: bool,
}

/// Full movement state; the server sends it so clients can correct their prediction.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Player {
    pub origin: Vec3,
    pub velocity: Vec3,
    /// Fully crouched (small hull).
    pub crouched: bool,
    pub on_ground: bool,
    pub on_ladder: bool,
    /// 0 = dry, 1 = feet, 2 = waist (swimming), 3 = head under.
    pub water_level: u8,
    /// Weapon-dependent max speed (250 knife/pistols, 221 AK...).
    pub max_speed: f32,
    /// Eye height above the origin; animates while crouching.
    pub view_height: f32,
    stamina: f32,
    jump_held: bool,
    /// Crouch is held but the 0.4 s crouch hasn't finished yet.
    ducking: bool,
    /// Counts down from 1000 ms while crouching.
    duck_time: f32,
    /// Downward speed while airborne, for landing and fall damage.
    fall_velocity: f32,
    /// Milliseconds until the next footstep may play.
    step_timer: f32,
    /// Getting shot slows you (CS 1.6 `m_flVelocityModifier`): 0.5 or 0.65 after a hit,
    /// back to 1 over about half a second while on the ground (`player::tagging`).
    pub velocity_modifier: f32,
}

/// Things that happened during a step, for the game rules to act on.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct Events {
    /// Landed hard enough for a landing sound/view punch.
    pub landed: bool,
    /// Health to subtract (0 when the fall was safe).
    pub fall_damage: f32,
    /// A footstep sound plays now (other players hear it).
    pub footstep: Option<Step>,
}

/// Where a footstep is (`PM_UpdateStepSound`): on the floor (its texture picks the sound),
/// on a ladder, wading knee-deep or sloshing ankle-deep.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum StepKind {
    Surface,
    Ladder,
    Wade,
    Slosh,
}

/// A footstep (`PM_PlayStepSound`, always `ATTN_NORM`).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Step {
    pub kind: StepKind,
    /// None: the surface's own volume (concrete 0.5, dirt 0.55, vent 0.7, ...).
    pub volume: Option<f32>,
    /// Crouched: 0.35 times as loud.
    pub crouched: bool,
}

impl Step {
    /// The volume to play it at, given the surface's own (`materials.txt` letter).
    pub fn loudness(&self, material: char) -> f32 {
        let own = match material {
            'D' => 0.55,
            'V' => 0.7,
            _ => 0.5,
        };
        self.volume.unwrap_or(own) * if self.crouched { 0.35 } else { 1.0 }
    }
}

/// `PM_CheckFalling`'s landing sound (`PM_PLAYER_MIN_BOUNCE_SPEED`, `PM_PLAYER_MAX_SAFE_FALL_SPEED`).
const LAND_MIN_SOUND: f32 = 350.0;
const LAND_LOUD: f32 = 580.0;

impl Player {
    pub fn new(origin: Vec3) -> Player {
        Player {
            origin,
            velocity: [0.0; 3],
            crouched: false,
            on_ground: false,
            on_ladder: false,
            water_level: 0,
            max_speed: 250.0,
            view_height: VIEW_HEIGHT_STANDING,
            stamina: 0.0,
            jump_held: false,
            ducking: false,
            duck_time: 0.0,
            fall_velocity: 0.0,
            step_timer: 0.0,
            velocity_modifier: 1.0,
        }
    }

    pub fn hull(&self) -> Hull {
        if self.crouched {
            Hull::Crouched
        } else {
            Hull::Standing
        }
    }

    pub fn eye(&self) -> Vec3 {
        add(self.origin, [0.0, 0.0, self.view_height])
    }

    /// Horizontal speed, as shown on speed meters.
    pub fn speed_2d(&self) -> f32 {
        (self.velocity[0].powi(2) + self.velocity[1].powi(2)).sqrt()
    }
}

/// GoldSrc view vectors (roll is always 0 for movement).
fn view_vectors(yaw: f32, pitch: f32) -> (Vec3, Vec3) {
    let (sy, cy) = yaw.to_radians().sin_cos();
    let (sp, cp) = pitch.to_radians().sin_cos();
    ([cp * cy, cp * sy, -sp], [sy, -cy, 0.0])
}

/// Advance one player by `dt` seconds.
pub fn step(p: &mut Player, input: &Input, dt: f32, world: &World, vars: &MoveVars) -> Events {
    let mut ev = Events::default();
    let ms = dt * 1000.0;
    p.stamina = (p.stamina - ms).max(0.0);
    p.duck_time = (p.duck_time - ms).max(0.0);
    let was_on_ground = p.on_ground;
    categorize(p, world);
    check_water(p, world);
    if !p.on_ground {
        p.fall_velocity = -p.velocity[2];
    }

    duck(p, input, world);

    // The client clamps input to the weapon's max speed before crouching scales it.
    let (mut fmove, mut smove) = (input.forward, input.side);
    let len = (fmove * fmove + smove * smove).sqrt();
    if len > p.max_speed {
        fmove *= p.max_speed / len;
        smove *= p.max_speed / len;
    }
    if input.walk {
        fmove *= WALK_SPEED;
        smove *= WALK_SPEED;
    }
    if p.crouched || p.ducking {
        fmove *= CROUCH_SPEED;
        smove *= CROUCH_SPEED;
    }

    let jump_pressed = input.jump && !p.jump_held;
    p.jump_held = input.jump;

    p.on_ladder = world.ladder_at(p.hull(), p.origin).is_some();
    if let Some(ladder) = world.ladder_at(p.hull(), p.origin).copied() {
        ladder_move(p, input, &ladder, dt, world);
    } else if p.water_level >= 2 {
        if input.jump {
            p.velocity[2] = WATER_SWIM_UP_SPEED;
        }
        water_move(p, input, fmove, smove, dt, world, vars);
    } else {
        if jump_pressed && p.on_ground {
            jump(p);
            // `PM_Jump`: jumping off at 150 or faster thuds at full volume.
            if p.speed_2d() >= FOOTSTEP_MIN_SPEED {
                ev.footstep = Some(Step { kind: StepKind::Surface, volume: Some(1.0), crouched: false });
            }
        }
        // Gravity is applied in two halves around the move (more accurate arcs).
        if !p.on_ground {
            p.velocity[2] -= vars.gravity * 0.5 * dt;
        } else {
            p.velocity[2] = 0.0;
            friction(p, dt, world, vars);
        }

        let (fwd, right) = view_vectors(input.yaw, 0.0);
        let wish = add(scale(fwd, fmove), scale(right, smove));
        let wish_speed = length(wish).min(p.max_speed);
        let wish_dir = if wish_speed > 0.0 { scale(wish, 1.0 / length(wish)) } else { [0.0; 3] };
        if p.on_ground {
            accelerate(p, wish_dir, wish_speed, vars.accelerate, dt);
            clamp_velocity(p, vars);
            walk_move(p, dt, world, vars);
        } else {
            air_accelerate(p, wish_dir, wish_speed, vars.air_accelerate, dt);
            clamp_velocity(p, vars);
            fly_move(p, dt, world);
        }
        categorize(p, world);
        if !p.on_ground {
            p.velocity[2] -= vars.gravity * 0.5 * dt;
        } else {
            p.velocity[2] = 0.0;
        }
    }
    clamp_velocity(p, vars);
    categorize(p, world);
    check_water(p, world);

    if p.on_ground && !was_on_ground && p.fall_velocity >= LAND_SPEED {
        ev.landed = true;
        // In this order, as CS has it (so 0.5 is only heard in water).
        let volume = match p.fall_velocity {
            _ if p.water_level > 0 => 0.5,
            v if v > LAND_LOUD => 1.0,
            v if v > LAND_LOUD / 2.0 => 0.85,
            v if v < LAND_MIN_SOUND => 0.0,
            _ => 0.5,
        };
        if volume > 0.0 {
            ev.footstep = Some(Step { kind: StepKind::Surface, volume: Some(volume), crouched: false });
            p.step_timer = FOOTSTEP_MS;
        }
        if p.water_level == 0 && p.fall_velocity > SAFE_FALL_SPEED {
            ev.fall_damage = (p.fall_velocity - SAFE_FALL_SPEED) * FALL_DAMAGE_PER_SPEED;
        }
    }
    if p.on_ground || p.on_ladder || p.water_level >= 2 {
        p.fall_velocity = 0.0;
    }
    p.step_timer = (p.step_timer - ms).max(0.0);
    if p.step_timer == 0.0 {
        if crate::length(p.velocity) <= FOOTSTEP_MIN_SPEED {
            p.step_timer = FOOTSTEP_QUIET_MS;
        } else if p.on_ground || p.on_ladder {
            let h = p.hull();
            let height = h.maxs()[2] - h.mins()[2];
            let wet = |z: f32| world.point_contents([p.origin[0], p.origin[1], p.origin[2] - z * height]) == Contents::Water;
            let (kind, volume, ms) = if p.on_ladder {
                (StepKind::Ladder, Some(0.35), FOOTSTEP_LADDER_MS)
            } else if wet(0.3) {
                (StepKind::Wade, Some(0.65), FOOTSTEP_WADE_MS)
            } else if wet(0.5) {
                (StepKind::Slosh, Some(0.5), FOOTSTEP_MS)
            } else {
                (StepKind::Surface, None, FOOTSTEP_MS)
            };
            p.step_timer = ms + if p.crouched || p.on_ladder { FOOTSTEP_SLOW_MS } else { 0.0 };
            ev.footstep = Some(Step { kind, volume, crouched: p.crouched && !p.on_ladder });
        }
    }
    ev
}

/// Water depth from three probe points: feet, box centre, eyes.
fn check_water(p: &mut Player, world: &World) {
    let wet = |z: f32| world.point_contents([p.origin[0], p.origin[1], z]) == Contents::Water;
    let feet = p.origin[2] + p.hull().mins()[2] + 1.0;
    let mid = p.origin[2] + (p.hull().mins()[2] + p.hull().maxs()[2]) * 0.5;
    p.water_level = if !wet(feet) {
        0
    } else if !wet(mid) {
        1
    } else if !wet(p.origin[2] + p.view_height) {
        2
    } else {
        3
    };
}

fn clamp_velocity(p: &mut Player, vars: &MoveVars) {
    for v in &mut p.velocity {
        *v = v.clamp(-vars.max_velocity, vars.max_velocity);
    }
}

/// On the ground = a walkable floor within 2 units below, and not flying upward.
fn categorize(p: &mut Player, world: &World) {
    if p.velocity[2] > LIFT_OFF_SPEED {
        p.on_ground = false;
        return;
    }
    let t = world.trace(p.hull(), p.origin, sub(p.origin, [0.0, 0.0, 2.0]));
    p.on_ground = t.fraction < 1.0 && t.normal[2] >= FLOOR_NORMAL_Z && !t.all_solid;
    if p.on_ground && !t.start_solid {
        p.origin = t.end; // snap down onto the floor
    }
}

fn jump(p: &mut Player) {
    // Bunny-hop cap: arriving too fast costs speed.
    let max = BHOP_CAP * p.max_speed;
    let spd = length(p.velocity);
    if spd > max {
        p.velocity = scale(p.velocity, max / spd * BHOP_PENALTY);
    }
    p.velocity[2] = JUMP_SPEED;
    if p.stamina > 0.0 {
        p.velocity[2] *= stamina_factor(p.stamina);
    }
    p.stamina = JUMP_STAMINA;
    p.on_ground = false;
}

/// 1.0 when rested, lower right after a jump (CS 1.6 formula).
fn stamina_factor(stamina: f32) -> f32 {
    (100.0 - stamina * 0.001 * 19.0) * 0.01
}

/// Smooth 0..1 ease used for the crouch view animation.
fn spline_fraction(t: f32, scale: f32) -> f32 {
    let v = (t * scale).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    3.0 * v * v - 2.0 * v * v * v
}

/// Crouching takes 0.4 s on the ground (instant in the air): the eye lowers
/// smoothly, then the hull shrinks. Grounded players keep their feet in place;
/// airborne players pull their legs up (the classic crouch-jump).
fn duck(p: &mut Player, input: &Input, world: &World) {
    if input.crouch {
        if !p.crouched && !p.ducking {
            p.ducking = true;
            p.duck_time = 1000.0;
        }
        if p.ducking {
            let elapsed = (1000.0 - p.duck_time) / 1000.0;
            if elapsed >= TIME_TO_DUCK || !p.on_ground {
                if p.on_ground {
                    p.origin[2] -= CROUCH_OFFSET;
                }
                p.crouched = true;
                p.ducking = false;
                p.view_height = VIEW_HEIGHT_CROUCHED;
            } else {
                // Eye height relative to the still-standing origin: 17 down to 12 - 18.
                let f = spline_fraction(elapsed, 1.0 / TIME_TO_DUCK);
                p.view_height = (VIEW_HEIGHT_CROUCHED - CROUCH_OFFSET) * f + VIEW_HEIGHT_STANDING * (1.0 - f);
            }
        }
    } else if p.ducking {
        p.ducking = false;
        p.view_height = VIEW_HEIGHT_STANDING;
    } else if p.crouched {
        // Stand up only if there is room.
        let up = add(p.origin, [0.0, 0.0, if p.on_ground { CROUCH_OFFSET } else { 0.0 }]);
        if !world.is_solid(Hull::Standing, up) {
            p.origin = up;
            p.crouched = false;
            p.view_height = VIEW_HEIGHT_STANDING;
        }
    }
}

/// Climbing: no gravity; look direction and keys move you along the ladder face.
fn ladder_move(p: &mut Player, input: &Input, ladder: &Ladder, dt: f32, world: &World) {
    // The ladder's face normal: its thin horizontal axis, pointing at the player.
    let size = sub(ladder.maxs, ladder.mins);
    let centre = scale(add(ladder.mins, ladder.maxs), 0.5);
    let axis = if size[0] < size[1] { 0 } else { 1 };
    let mut normal = [0.0; 3];
    normal[axis] = if p.origin[axis] >= centre[axis] { 1.0 } else { -1.0 };

    if input.jump {
        p.velocity = scale(normal, LADDER_JUMP_SPEED);
        p.on_ladder = false;
        fly_move(p, dt, world);
        return;
    }
    let mut climb = LADDER_CLIMB_SPEED;
    if p.crouched || p.ducking {
        climb *= CROUCH_SPEED;
    }
    let forward = climb * input.forward.signum() * (input.forward != 0.0) as i32 as f32;
    let right = climb * input.side.signum() * (input.side != 0.0) as i32 as f32;
    if forward == 0.0 && right == 0.0 {
        p.velocity = [0.0; 3];
        return;
    }
    let (vpn, vright) = view_vectors(input.yaw, input.pitch);
    let vel = add(scale(vpn, forward), scale(vright, right));
    // Split into "into the ladder" and "along it"; pushing into it climbs up.
    let up = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0];
    let perp = {
        let c = [up[1] * normal[2] - up[2] * normal[1], up[2] * normal[0] - up[0] * normal[2], up[0] * normal[1] - up[1] * normal[0]];
        scale(c, 1.0 / length(c).max(1e-6))
    };
    let normal_comp = dot(vel, normal);
    let lateral = sub(vel, scale(normal, normal_comp));
    let tmp = [normal[1] * perp[2] - normal[2] * perp[1], normal[2] * perp[0] - normal[0] * perp[2], normal[0] * perp[1] - normal[1] * perp[0]];
    p.velocity = add(lateral, scale(tmp, -normal_comp));
    // Walking backwards off a ladder that reaches the floor.
    let feet = add(p.origin, [0.0, 0.0, p.hull().mins()[2] - 1.0]);
    if world.point_contents(feet) == Contents::Solid && normal_comp > 0.0 {
        p.velocity = add(p.velocity, scale(normal, LADDER_CLIMB_SPEED));
    }
    fly_move(p, dt, world);
}

/// Swimming: 3D movement along the view direction, slow sinking, heavy drag.
fn water_move(p: &mut Player, input: &Input, fmove: f32, smove: f32, dt: f32, world: &World, vars: &MoveVars) {
    let (vpn, vright) = view_vectors(input.yaw, input.pitch);
    let mut wish = add(scale(vpn, fmove), scale(vright, smove));
    if fmove == 0.0 && smove == 0.0 && !input.jump {
        wish[2] -= WATER_SINK_SPEED;
    }
    let mut wish_speed = length(wish);
    let wish_dir = if wish_speed > 0.0 { scale(wish, 1.0 / wish_speed) } else { [0.0; 3] };
    wish_speed = wish_speed.min(p.max_speed) * WATER_SPEED;

    let speed = length(p.velocity);
    let new_speed = if speed > 0.0 { (speed - dt * speed * vars.friction * vars.water_friction).max(0.0) } else { 0.0 };
    if speed > 0.0 {
        p.velocity = scale(p.velocity, new_speed / speed);
    }
    if wish_speed >= 0.1 {
        let add_speed = wish_speed - new_speed;
        if add_speed > 0.0 {
            let a = (vars.water_accelerate * wish_speed * dt).min(add_speed);
            p.velocity = add(p.velocity, scale(wish_dir, a));
        }
    }
    fly_move(p, dt, world);
}

fn friction(p: &mut Player, dt: f32, world: &World, vars: &MoveVars) {
    let speed = length(p.velocity);
    if speed < 0.1 {
        return;
    }
    // Edge friction: stronger when the ground ends just ahead (stops you sliding off ledges).
    let ahead = add(p.origin, scale(p.velocity, 16.0 / speed));
    let start = [ahead[0], ahead[1], p.origin[2] + p.hull().mins()[2]];
    let mut fric = vars.friction;
    if world.trace(p.hull(), start, sub(start, [0.0, 0.0, 34.0])).fraction == 1.0 {
        fric *= vars.edge_friction;
    }
    let control = speed.max(vars.stop_speed);
    let new_speed = (speed - control * fric * dt).max(0.0);
    p.velocity = scale(p.velocity, new_speed / speed);
}

fn accelerate(p: &mut Player, dir: Vec3, wish_speed: f32, accel: f32, dt: f32) {
    let add_speed = wish_speed - dot(p.velocity, dir);
    if add_speed <= 0.0 {
        return;
    }
    let a = (accel * dt * wish_speed).min(add_speed);
    p.velocity = add(p.velocity, scale(dir, a));
}

/// Air strafing: the projected speed cap is tiny (30), but acceleration uses the full
/// wish speed, so turning while strafing gains speed.
fn air_accelerate(p: &mut Player, dir: Vec3, wish_speed: f32, accel: f32, dt: f32) {
    let add_speed = wish_speed.min(AIR_WISH_CAP) - dot(p.velocity, dir);
    if add_speed <= 0.0 {
        return;
    }
    let a = (accel * wish_speed * dt).min(add_speed);
    p.velocity = add(p.velocity, scale(dir, a));
}

/// Ground move with stair stepping: try the move flat, and also stepped up by
/// `step_size` then back down; keep whichever went further.
fn walk_move(p: &mut Player, dt: f32, world: &World, vars: &MoveVars) {
    if p.stamina > 0.0 {
        let f = stamina_factor(p.stamina);
        p.velocity[0] *= f;
        p.velocity[1] *= f;
    }
    p.velocity[2] = 0.0;
    if length(p.velocity) < 1.0 {
        p.velocity = [0.0; 3];
        return;
    }
    let dest = add(p.origin, scale(p.velocity, dt));
    let t = world.trace(p.hull(), p.origin, dest);
    if t.fraction == 1.0 {
        p.origin = t.end;
        return;
    }

    let (orig, ovel) = (p.origin, p.velocity);
    fly_move(p, dt, world);
    let (down_origin, down_vel) = (p.origin, p.velocity);

    p.origin = orig;
    p.velocity = ovel;
    let up = world.trace(p.hull(), p.origin, add(p.origin, [0.0, 0.0, vars.step_size]));
    if !up.start_solid && !up.all_solid {
        p.origin = up.end;
    }
    fly_move(p, dt, world);
    let down = world.trace(p.hull(), p.origin, sub(p.origin, [0.0, 0.0, vars.step_size]));
    if !down.start_solid && !down.all_solid {
        p.origin = down.end;
    }
    let flat_dist = (down_origin[0] - orig[0]).powi(2) + (down_origin[1] - orig[1]).powi(2);
    let step_dist = (p.origin[0] - orig[0]).powi(2) + (p.origin[1] - orig[1]).powi(2);
    if down.normal[2] < FLOOR_NORMAL_Z || flat_dist > step_dist {
        p.origin = down_origin;
        p.velocity = down_vel;
    } else {
        p.velocity[2] = down_vel[2];
    }
}

fn clip_velocity(v: Vec3, normal: Vec3) -> Vec3 {
    let back = dot(v, normal);
    let mut out = sub(v, scale(normal, back));
    for c in &mut out {
        if c.abs() < 0.1 {
            *c = 0.0;
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Slide along whatever is hit, up to 4 times per move.
fn fly_move(p: &mut Player, dt: f32, world: &World) {
    let primal = p.velocity;
    let mut original = p.velocity;
    let mut planes: Vec<Vec3> = Vec::with_capacity(5);
    let mut time_left = dt;

    for _ in 0..4 {
        if p.velocity == [0.0; 3] {
            break;
        }
        let end = add(p.origin, scale(p.velocity, time_left));
        let t = world.trace(p.hull(), p.origin, end);
        if t.all_solid {
            p.velocity = [0.0; 3];
            return;
        }
        if t.fraction > 0.0 {
            p.origin = t.end;
            original = p.velocity;
            planes.clear();
        }
        if t.fraction == 1.0 {
            break;
        }
        time_left -= time_left * t.fraction;
        if planes.len() >= 5 {
            p.velocity = [0.0; 3];
            break;
        }
        planes.push(t.normal);

        if !p.on_ground {
            // In the air: clip against each plane in turn (this is what makes surfing work).
            for &n in &planes {
                p.velocity = clip_velocity(original, n);
                original = p.velocity;
            }
        } else {
            // On the ground: find a direction that slides along every plane hit.
            let mut found = false;
            for i in 0..planes.len() {
                let v = clip_velocity(original, planes[i]);
                if planes.iter().enumerate().all(|(j, &n)| j == i || dot(v, n) >= 0.0) {
                    p.velocity = v;
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if !found {
                if planes.len() != 2 {
                    p.velocity = [0.0; 3];
                    break;
                }
                // Slide along the crease of two planes.
                let (a, b) = (planes[0], planes[1]);
                let crease = [a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1], a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2], a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]];
                p.velocity = scale(crease, dot(crease, p.velocity));
            }
        }
        if dot(p.velocity, primal) <= 0.0 {
            p.velocity = [0.0; 3];
            break;
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const DT: f32 = 1.0 / 128.0;

    fn run(p: &mut Player, input: Input, secs: f32, w: &World) {
        for _ in 0..(secs / DT) as usize {
            step(p, &input, DT, w, &MoveVars::default());
        }
    }

    fn standing_on_floor() -> (Player, World) {
        let w = World::flat_floor(0.0);
        let mut p = Player::new([0.0, 0.0, 100.0]);
        run(&mut p, Input::default(), 1.0, &w);
        (p, w)
    }

    #[test]
    fn falls_and_lands_on_floor() {
        let (p, _) = standing_on_floor();
        assert!(p.on_ground);
        assert!((p.origin[2] - 36.0).abs() < 0.1, "{:?}", p.origin);
    }

    #[test]
    fn running_reaches_and_keeps_max_speed() {
        let (mut p, w) = standing_on_floor();
        run(&mut p, Input { forward: 400.0, ..Default::default() }, 2.0, &w);
        let s = p.speed_2d();
        assert!((s - 250.0).abs() < 2.0, "speed {s}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn friction_stops_a_runner() {
        let (mut p, w) = standing_on_floor();
        run(&mut p, Input { forward: 400.0, ..Default::default() }, 2.0, &w);
        run(&mut p, Input::default(), 1.0, &w);
        assert_eq!(p.speed_2d(), 0.0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn jump_reaches_45_units() {
        let (mut p, w) = standing_on_floor();
        let base = p.origin[2];
        let mut top = base;
        step(&mut p, &Input { jump: true, ..Default::default() }, DT, &w, &MoveVars::default());
        for _ in 0..128 {
            step(&mut p, &Input::default(), DT, &w, &MoveVars::default());
            top = top.max(p.origin[2]);
        }
        assert!((top - base - 45.0).abs() < 1.0, "jump height {}", top - base);
        assert!(p.on_ground);
    }

    #[test]
    fn crouching_slows_and_lowers_view() {
        let (mut p, w) = standing_on_floor();
        run(&mut p, Input { forward: 400.0, crouch: true, ..Default::default() }, 2.0, &w);
        assert!(p.crouched);
        assert!((p.speed_2d() - 250.0 * CROUCH_SPEED).abs() < 2.0, "{}", p.speed_2d());
        assert!((p.eye()[2] - (18.0 + VIEW_HEIGHT_CROUCHED)).abs() < 0.1);
        run(&mut p, Input::default(), 0.1, &w);
        assert!(!p.crouched && (p.origin[2] - 36.0).abs() < 0.1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn bhop_speed_is_capped() {
        let (mut p, w) = standing_on_floor();
        p.velocity = [400.0, 0.0, 0.0];
        step(&mut p, &Input { jump: true, ..Default::default() }, DT, &w, &MoveVars::default());
        assert!(p.speed_2d() <= 250.0 * BHOP_CAP * BHOP_PENALTY + 1.0, "{}", p.speed_2d());
    }

    #[test]
    fn same_inputs_same_result() {
        let w = World::flat_floor(0.0);
        let sim = || {
            let mut p = Player::new([0.0, 0.0, 100.0]);
            for i in 0..512 {
                let input = Input { forward: 400.0, side: if i % 64 < 32 { 400.0 } else { -400.0 }, yaw: i as f32, jump: i % 50 == 0, ..Default::default() };
                step(&mut p, &input, DT, &w, &MoveVars::default());
            }
            (p.origin, p.velocity)
        };
        assert_eq!(sim(), sim());
    }

    #[test]
    fn crouch_takes_point_four_seconds_on_ground() {
        let (mut p, w) = standing_on_floor();
        let crouch = Input { crouch: true, ..Default::default() };
        run(&mut p, crouch, 0.2, &w);
        assert!(!p.crouched && p.view_height < VIEW_HEIGHT_STANDING, "mid-crouch eye {}", p.view_height);
        run(&mut p, crouch, 0.25, &w);
        assert!(p.crouched && p.view_height == VIEW_HEIGHT_CROUCHED);
    }

    #[test]
    fn fall_damage_matches_cs() {
        let w = World::flat_floor(0.0);
        let mut events = Vec::new();
        for height in [100.0, 300.0, 1000.0] {
            let mut p = Player::new([0.0, 0.0, 36.0 + height]);
            let mut dmg = 0.0;
            for _ in 0..1024 {
                dmg += step(&mut p, &Input::default(), DT, &w, &MoveVars::default()).fall_damage;
            }
            events.push(dmg);
        }
        // 100 units: safe. 300 units: ~693 u/s at landing -> ~40 HP. 1000 units: lethal.
        assert_eq!(events[0], 0.0);
        assert!((events[1] - 40.0).abs() < 3.0, "{events:?}");
        assert!(events[2] > 100.0, "{events:?}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn shift_walk_is_slow_and_silent() {
        let (mut p, w) = standing_on_floor();
        let walk = Input { forward: 400.0, walk: true, ..Default::default() };
        let mut steps = 0;
        for _ in 0..256 {
            steps += step(&mut p, &walk, DT, &w, &MoveVars::default()).footstep.is_some() as i32;
        }
        assert!((p.speed_2d() - 130.0).abs() < 1.0, "{}", p.speed_2d());
        assert_eq!(steps, 0);
        let run_input = Input { forward: 400.0, ..Default::default() };
        for _ in 0..256 {
            steps += step(&mut p, &run_input, DT, &w, &MoveVars::default()).footstep.is_some() as i32;
        }
        // One every 300 ms once over 150 (after up to 400 ms from walking): 6 in 2 s.
        assert!((5..=7).contains(&steps), "running made {steps} footsteps in 2 s");
        // Crouch-running is under 150: silent.
        let mut quiet = 0;
        for _ in 0..256 {
            quiet += step(&mut p, &Input { crouch: true, ..run_input }, DT, &w, &MoveVars::default()).footstep.is_some() as i32;
        }
        assert!(p.crouched);
        assert!(quiet <= 1, "{quiet} footsteps crouched");
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Tracing shots through the map and players: CS 1.6 `FireBullets3` (penetration,
//! per-segment range falloff, surface materials) and the shotgun pellet volley.
use super::{rand01, Shot};
use crate::collision::{Hull, World};
use crate::combat::hitgroup_multiplier;
use crate::hitbox::{HitGroup, Hitboxes};
use crate::{add, length, scale, sub, Vec3};
use goldsrc::materials::Materials;

/// Another player a bullet can hit (positions already rewound for lag compensation).
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Target {
    pub id: u8,
    pub origin: Vec3,
    pub yaw: f32,
    pub pitch: f32,
    pub crouched: bool,
    /// What they hold (their hitboxes follow that weapon's pose).
    pub weapon: crate::weapons::Id,
    /// Their animation as drawn (`anim`: state, what drives it, the time), when known:
    /// hitboxes follow it (else the plain aim pose).
    pub anim: Option<(crate::anim::Anim, crate::anim::Drive, f32)>,
}

/// Damage reaching a player, after the hit group multiplier (armor comes later).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct BulletHit {
    pub victim: u8,
    pub damage: f32,
    pub group: HitGroup,
    /// Where it hit them (for blood).
    pub point: Vec3,
}

/// Where a bullet hit the world (for decals and sparks).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Impact {
    pub point: Vec3,
    pub normal: Vec3,
    /// Hit the sky brush (no hole to draw).
    pub sky: bool,
    /// The BSP model hit (0 = world): lets the server damage breakables.
    pub model: usize,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct ShotResult {
    pub hits: Vec<BulletHit>,
    pub impacts: Vec<Impact>,
}

/// GoldSrc view vectors (forward, right, up) for pitch/yaw in degrees.
pub fn view_vectors(pitch: f32, yaw: f32) -> (Vec3, Vec3, Vec3) {
    let (sp, cp) = pitch.to_radians().sin_cos();
    let (sy, cy) = yaw.to_radians().sin_cos();
    ([cp * cy, cp * sy, -sp], [sy, -cy, 0.0], [sp * cy, sp * sy, cp])
}

/// The nearest thing along `src -> end`: a player (id, group, fraction) or the world.
fn nearest(world: &World, hitboxes: &Hitboxes, src: Vec3, end: Vec3, targets: &[Target], skip: &[u8]) -> (f32, Option<(u8, HitGroup)>, crate::collision::LineTrace) {
    let wt = world.trace_line(src, end);
    if wt.start_solid {
        // Restarted inside a wall that's thicker than the penetration step: GoldSrc
        // reports an immediate hit, which costs another penetration.
        return (0.0, None, wt);
    }
    let seg = sub(end, src);
    let len = length(seg);
    let dir = scale(seg, 1.0 / len.max(1e-6));
    let mut best = (wt.fraction, None);
    for t in targets.iter().filter(|t| !skip.contains(&t.id)) {
        let hit = match &t.anim {
            Some(a) => hitboxes.trace_animated(a, t.origin, t.crouched, src, dir, len * best.0),
            None => hitboxes.trace(t.origin, t.yaw, t.pitch, t.crouched, t.weapon, src, dir, len * best.0),
        };
        if let Some(h) = hit {
            best = (h.distance / len, Some((t.id, h.group)));
        }
    }
    (best.0, best.1, wt)
}

/// One `FireBullets3` bullet. `eye` is the shooter's eye; `shooter` is never hit.
pub fn fire_bullet(world: &World, materials: &Materials, hitboxes: &Hitboxes, eye: Vec3, shot: &Shot, shooter: u8, targets: &[Target]) -> ShotResult {
    let (fwd, right, up) = view_vectors(shot.angles[0], shot.angles[1]);
    let mut src = eye;
    // Triangular spread on each axis (sum of two uniforms), not normalised.
    let x = rand01(shot.seed, 0) - 0.5 + rand01(shot.seed, 1) - 0.5;
    let y = rand01(shot.seed, 2) - 0.5 + rand01(shot.seed, 3) - 0.5;
    let dir = add(fwd, add(scale(right, x * shot.spread), scale(up, y * shot.spread)));

    let mut out = ShotResult::default();
    let mut dmg = shot.damage;
    let mut power = shot.bullet.power;
    let mut pen_left = shot.penetration;
    let mut dist = shot.distance;
    let mut dmg_mod = 0.5f32;
    let mut end = add(src, scale(dir, dist));
    let mut hit_players: Vec<u8> = vec![shooter];

    while pen_left != 0 {
        let mut skip = hit_players.clone();
        skip.dedup();
        let (fraction, player, wt) = nearest(world, hitboxes, src, end, targets, &skip);
        if fraction >= 1.0 {
            break;
        }
        // Surface material changes how well the bullet carries on (players count as flesh).
        if player.is_none() {
            let tex = world.texture_of(wt.model, src, end).map(|t| materials.kind(t)).unwrap_or('C');
            match tex {
                'M' => {
                    power = (power as f32 * 0.15) as i32;
                    dmg_mod = 0.2;
                }
                'C' => power = (power as f32 * 0.25) as i32,
                'G' => {
                    power = (power as f32 * 0.5) as i32;
                    dmg_mod = 0.4;
                }
                'V' => {
                    power = (power as f32 * 0.5) as i32;
                    dmg_mod = 0.45;
                }
                'T' => {
                    power = (power as f32 * 0.65) as i32;
                    dmg_mod = 0.3;
                }
                'P' => {
                    power = (power as f32 * 0.4) as i32;
                    dmg_mod = 0.45;
                }
                'W' => dmg_mod = 0.6,
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        pen_left -= 1;
        let seg = fraction * dist;
        dmg = (dmg as f32 * shot.range_mod.powf(seg / 500.0)) as i32;
        if seg > shot.bullet.max_pen_distance {
            pen_left = 0;
        }
        let hit_point = add(src, scale(sub(end, src), fraction));
        if player.is_none() {
            out.impacts.push(Impact { point: hit_point, normal: wt.normal, sky: wt.hit_sky, model: wt.model });
            if wt.hit_sky {
                break; // nothing behind the sky
            }
        }
        if let Some((_, HitGroup::Shield)) = player {
            break; // shields stop bullets
        }
        let dist_mod = if player.is_some() || pen_left == 0 {
            power = 42;
            dmg_mod = 0.75;
            0.75
        } else {
            0.5
        };
        if let Some((id, group)) = player {
            out.hits.push(BulletHit { victim: id, damage: dmg as f32 * hitgroup_multiplier(group), group, point: hit_point });
            hit_players.push(id);
        }
        src = add(hit_point, scale(dir, power as f32));
        dist = (dist - seg) * dist_mod;
        end = add(src, scale(dir, dist));
        dmg = (dmg as f32 * dmg_mod) as i32;
    }
    out
}

/// Shotgun volley (old `FireBullets`): no penetration, linear falloff, damage
/// summed per victim (armor is then applied once to the sum).
pub fn fire_pellets(world: &World, hitboxes: &Hitboxes, eye: Vec3, shot: &Shot, shooter: u8, targets: &[Target]) -> ShotResult {
    let p = shot.pellets.expect("pellet shot");
    let (fwd, right, up) = view_vectors(shot.angles[0], shot.angles[1]);
    let mut out = ShotResult::default();
    for i in 0..p.count as u64 {
        // Circular cone: redraw until inside the unit circle.
        let (mut x, mut y);
        let mut k = 100 + i * 64;
        loop {
            x = rand01(shot.seed, k) - 0.5 + rand01(shot.seed, k + 1) - 0.5;
            y = rand01(shot.seed, k + 2) - 0.5 + rand01(shot.seed, k + 3) - 0.5;
            k += 4;
            if x * x + y * y <= 1.0 {
                break;
            }
        }
        let dir = add(fwd, add(scale(right, x * p.cone), scale(up, y * p.cone)));
        let end = add(eye, scale(dir, p.range));
        let (fraction, player, wt) = nearest(world, hitboxes, eye, end, targets, &[shooter]);
        if fraction >= 1.0 {
            continue;
        }
        let dmg = ((1.0 - fraction) * p.damage) as i32 as f32;
        let point = add(eye, scale(sub(end, eye), fraction));
        match player {
            Some((id, group)) => {
                let d = dmg * hitgroup_multiplier(group);
                match out.hits.iter_mut().find(|h| h.victim == id) {
                    Some(h) => {
                        h.damage += d;
                        h.group = group;
                        h.point = point;
                    }
                    None => out.hits.push(BulletHit { victim: id, damage: d, group, point }),
                }
            }
            None => out.impacts.push(Impact { point, normal: wt.normal, sky: wt.hit_sky, model: wt.model }),
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Knife reach, as GoldSrc's `CKnife::Swing`: a line along the view (against hitboxes); if it
/// meets nothing at all, the same move swept with a crouching-size box (`head_hull`), which
/// meets the world or a player's bounding box (generic hit group: no part hit). Returns the
/// player hit, if any. (`FindHullIntersection` only moves the impact point: not needed.)
pub fn trace_melee(world: &World, hitboxes: &Hitboxes, src: Vec3, end: Vec3, shooter: u8, targets: &[Target]) -> Option<(u8, HitGroup)> {
    let (f, player, _) = nearest(world, hitboxes, src, end, targets, &[shooter]);
    if f < 1.0 {
        return player;
    }
    let seg = sub(end, src);
    let len = length(seg);
    let dir = scale(seg, 1.0 / len.max(1e-6));
    let (lo, hi) = (Hull::Crouched.mins(), Hull::Crouched.maxs());
    let mut best = (world.trace(Hull::Crouched, src, end).fraction * len, None);
    for t in targets.iter().filter(|t| t.id != shooter) {
        let h = if t.crouched { Hull::Crouched } else { Hull::Standing };
        // The swept box meets their box: a line meets their box grown by ours.
        let (mins, maxs) = (sub(add(t.origin, h.mins()), hi), sub(add(t.origin, h.maxs()), lo));
        if let Some(d) = crate::hitbox::slab(src, dir, mins, maxs, best.0).filter(|d| *d < best.0) {
            best = (d, Some((t.id, HitGroup::Generic)));
        }
    }
    best.1
}
```

```rs
use super::*;

impl Loadout {
    pub(super) fn knife(&mut self, c: &Context, out: &mut Fired) {
        // Timings are refined by the hit result in `knife_result`.
        if c.attack2 && c.now >= self.knife_next_secondary {
            out.swing = Some(Swing { stab: true, angles: [c.pitch, c.yaw] });
            self.knife_next_primary = c.now + 1.0;
            self.knife_next_secondary = c.now + 1.0;
        } else if c.attack && c.now >= self.knife_next_primary {
            out.swing = Some(Swing { stab: false, angles: [c.pitch, c.yaw] });
            self.knife_next_primary = c.now + 0.35;
            self.knife_next_secondary = c.now + 0.5;
        }
    }

    /// Hold attack in a bomb site, standing on the ground, for `C4_PLANT_TIME`; letting go
    /// or leaving the site starts over. Once planted, the best other weapon comes out.
    pub(super) fn plant(&mut self, c: &Context, out: &mut Fired) {
        if !(c.attack && c.can_shoot && c.in_bomb_site && c.on_ground) {
            self.planting = None;
            return;
        }
        let start = *self.planting.get_or_insert(c.now);
        if c.now - start >= C4_PLANT_TIME {
            self.planting = None;
            self.c4 = false;
            out.planted = true;
            let next = [Slot::Primary, Slot::Secondary, Slot::Knife].into_iter().find(|s| self.has(*s)).unwrap_or(Slot::Knife);
            self.switch_to(next, c.now);
        }
    }

    /// Hold fire to pull the pin; the throw happens when you let go (at least 0.5 s
    /// after pulling it). After the last of a type, the next type or the last weapon.
    pub(super) fn grenade_update(&mut self, c: &Context, out: &mut Fired) {
        let Some(id) = self.grenade_id() else {
            self.switch_to(self.last_slot, c.now);
            return;
        };
        self.grenade = match id {
            Id::HeGrenade => 0,
            Id::Flashbang => 1,
            _ => 2,
        };
        match self.pin_until {
            None if c.attack && c.now >= self.grenade_next && c.can_shoot => self.pin_until = Some(c.now + 0.5),
            Some(t) if !c.attack && c.now >= t => {
                let kind = [crate::grenades::Kind::He, crate::grenades::Kind::Flash, crate::grenades::Kind::Smoke][self.grenade as usize];
                out.throw = Some((kind, [c.pitch + self.punch[0], c.yaw + self.punch[1]]));
                self.grenades[self.grenade as usize] -= 1;
                self.pin_until = None;
                self.grenade_next = c.now + 0.5;
                self.next_attack = c.now + 0.5;
                if self.grenade_id().is_none() {
                    let back = if self.last_slot == Slot::Grenade { Slot::Knife } else { self.last_slot };
                    self.switch_to(back, c.now + 0.5);
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    /// After tracing a swing: hits recover a bit slower than misses.
    pub fn knife_result(&mut self, stab: bool, hit: bool, now: f64) {
        if hit {
            if stab {
                self.knife_next_primary = now + 1.1;
                self.knife_next_secondary = now + 1.1;
            } else {
                self.knife_next_primary = now + 0.4;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Every gun's numbers. Source: docs/WEAPONS.md (checked against CS 1.6's cs.so)
//! and docs/RULES.md (prices).
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Id {
    Knife,
    Glock,
    Usp,
    P228,
    Deagle,
    Mac10,
    Tmp,
    Mp5,
    Ump45,
    P90,
    Galil,
    Famas,
    Ak47,
    M4a1,
    Scout,
    Awp,
    HeGrenade,
    Flashbang,
    Smoke,
    C4,
}

/// Inventory slot (the number key that selects it).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Slot {
    Primary = 1,
    Secondary = 2,
    Knife = 3,
    Grenade = 4,
    Bomb = 5,
}

/// Penetration power and the longest segment that still penetrates, per bullet type.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Bullet {
    pub power: i32,
    pub max_pen_distance: f32,
}

pub const B9MM: Bullet = Bullet { power: 21, max_pen_distance: 800.0 };
pub const B45ACP: Bullet = Bullet { power: 15, max_pen_distance: 500.0 };
pub const B338: Bullet = Bullet { power: 45, max_pen_distance: 8000.0 };
pub const B762: Bullet = Bullet { power: 39, max_pen_distance: 5000.0 };
pub const B556: Bullet = Bullet { power: 35, max_pen_distance: 4000.0 };
pub const B50AE: Bullet = Bullet { power: 30, max_pen_distance: 1000.0 };
pub const B57: Bullet = Bullet { power: 30, max_pen_distance: 2000.0 };
pub const B357: Bullet = Bullet { power: 25, max_pen_distance: 800.0 };

/// How the spread number is chosen for a shot ("acc" = the gun's accuracy value).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub enum Spread {
    /// Rifles/M249: `a + b*acc` for in the air, horizontal speed > `fast_speed`, otherwise.
    Rifle { air: (f32, f32), fast_speed: f32, fast: (f32, f32), still: (f32, f32) },
    /// SMGs: `k*acc`; P90 also has a fast-moving value.
    Smg { air: f32, fast: Option<(f32, f32)>, still: f32 },
    /// Pistols: `k*(1-acc)` for air, moving (any speed), crouched, standing.
    Pistol { air: f32, moving: f32, duck: f32, stand: f32 },
    /// Snipers: flat values (speed thresholds tested in order), plus `unscoped` when not zoomed.
    Sniper { air: f32, moving: &'static [(f32, f32)], duck: f32, stand: f32, unscoped: f32 },
}

/// How accuracy changes as you shoot.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub enum Accuracy {
    /// `shots^power div div + add`, capped. `div` 0 means float divide by `fdiv` (MP5).
    Auto { power: u32, div: i32, fdiv: f32, add: f32, cap: f32, initial: f32, on_reload: f32 },
    /// Pistols: `acc -= (k - since_last_shot) * s`, clamped to `lo..hi`.
    PistolTime { k: f32, s: f32, lo: f32, hi: f32, initial: f32 },
    /// Auto-snipers: `min(cap, since_last_shot * k + base)`.
    SniperTime { base: f32, k: f32, cap: f32, initial: f32, on_reload: Option<f32>, first_shot: Option<f32> },
    None,
}

/// How the view kicks per shot.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub enum Recoil {
    /// `KickBack` parameter sets for moving, air, crouched, standing.
    /// Rifles pick moving first; SMGs/M249 pick air first (`smg_order`).
    Kick { smg_order: bool, sets: [[f32; 7]; 4] },
    /// Flat pitch kick per shot (pistols, AWP, Scout).
    Flat(f32),
    /// G3SG1/SG550: random pitch kick in `lo..hi` plus a quarter of the current punch, random yaw.
    AutoSniper { lo: f32, hi: f32 },
    /// Shotguns: random integer pitch kick, bigger in the air.
    Shotgun { ground: (i32, i32), air: (i32, i32) },
    None,
}

/// One firing mode (silenced or not).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Mode {
    pub damage: i32,
    pub range_mod: f32,
    pub cycle: f32,
    pub spread: Spread,
}

/// What the secondary button does.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Secondary {
    None,
    /// Switch between `modes[0]` and `modes[1]`; seconds the switch takes.
    Toggle(f32),
    /// Field-of-view steps to cycle through (back to 90 after the last).
    Zoom(&'static [u8]),
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Pellets {
    pub count: u32,
    pub cone: f32,
    pub range: f32,
    pub damage: f32,
    /// Seconds per shell when reloading.
    pub shell_time: f32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Gun {
    pub clip: u32,
    pub reserve: u32,
    pub penetration: u32,
    pub distance: f32,
    pub bullet: Bullet,
    pub reload: f32,
    pub deploy: f32,
    pub speed: f32,
    pub scoped_speed: f32,
    /// Attacker weapon factor in the armor formula.
    pub armor_factor: f32,
    pub modes: &'static [Mode],
    pub secondary: Secondary,
    /// Fire with zoom on drops the zoom until the gun is ready again (AWP, Scout).
    pub unscope_on_fire: bool,
    /// Zoomed fire interval (AUG, SG552).
    pub zoomed_cycle: Option<f32>,
    pub accuracy: Accuracy,
    pub recoil: Recoil,
    /// One shot per click (pistols in semi mode).
    pub semi_auto: bool,
    pub pellets: Option<Pellets>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub enum Kind {
    Gun(Gun),
    Knife,
    Grenade,
    C4,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Def {
    pub id: Id,
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub slot: Slot,
    pub price: u32,
    pub kind: Kind,
}

const RIFLE_SPEED: f32 = 140.0;

const M4_KICK: [[f32; 7]; 4] = [
    [1.0, 0.45, 0.28, 0.045, 3.75, 3.0, 7.0],
    [1.2, 0.5, 0.23, 0.15, 5.5, 3.5, 6.0],
    [0.6, 0.3, 0.2, 0.0125, 3.25, 2.0, 7.0],
    [0.65, 0.35, 0.25, 0.015, 3.5, 2.25, 7.0],
];
const FAMAS_KICK: [[f32; 7]; 4] = [
    [1.0, 0.45, 0.275, 0.05, 4.0, 2.5, 7.0],
    [1.25, 0.45, 0.22, 0.18, 5.5, 4.0, 5.0],
    [0.575, 0.325, 0.2, 0.011, 3.25, 2.0, 8.0],
    [0.625, 0.375, 0.25, 0.0125, 3.5, 2.25, 8.0],
];

const fn auto(power: u32, div: i32, add: f32, cap: f32, initial: f32, on_reload: f32) -> Accuracy {
    Accuracy::Auto { power, div, fdiv: 0.0, add, cap, initial, on_reload }
}
const fn pistol_acc(k: f32, s: f32, lo: f32, hi: f32) -> Accuracy {
    Accuracy::PistolTime { k, s, lo, hi, initial: hi }
}
const fn pistol_spread(air: f32, moving: f32, duck: f32, stand: f32) -> Spread {
    Spread::Pistol { air, moving, duck, stand }
}
const fn rifle(air: (f32, f32), fast: (f32, f32), still: (f32, f32)) -> Spread {
    Spread::Rifle { air, fast_speed: RIFLE_SPEED, fast, still }
}
const fn one(damage: i32, range_mod: f32, cycle: f32, spread: Spread) -> Mode {
    Mode { damage, range_mod, cycle, spread }
}

            recoil: Recoil::Flat(2.0),
            ..BASE
        }),
    },
    Def { id: Id::HeGrenade, name: "hegrenade", slot: Slot::Grenade, price: 300, kind: Kind::Grenade },
    Def { id: Id::Flashbang, name: "flashbang", slot: Slot::Grenade, price: 200, kind: Kind::Grenade },
    Def { id: Id::Smoke, name: "smokegrenade", slot: Slot::Grenade, price: 300, kind: Kind::Grenade },
    Def { id: Id::C4, name: "c4", slot: Slot::Bomb, price: 0, kind: Kind::C4 },
];

pub fn def(id: Id) -> &'static Def {
    WEAPONS.iter().find(|d| d.id == id).expect("every Id has a table entry")
}

pub fn gun(id: Id) -> Option<&'static Gun> {
    match &def(id).kind {
        Kind::Gun(g) => Some(g),
        _ => None,
    }
}

/// Max speed with this weapon out (scoped speed when zoomed).
pub fn max_speed(id: Id, zoomed: bool) -> f32 {
    match gun(id) {
        Some(g) if zoomed => g.scoped_speed,
        Some(g) => g.speed,
        None => 250.0,
    }
}

/// Armor formula factor of the attacker's weapon (knife 1.7).
pub fn armor_factor(id: Id) -> f32 {
    match &def(id).kind {
        Kind::Gun(g) => g.armor_factor,
        Kind::Knife => 1.7,
        _ => 1.0,
    }
}

/// Look a weapon up by its CS name ("ak47", "awp", "deagle", ...).
pub fn by_name(name: &str) -> Option<Id> {
    let n = name.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
    let n = n.strip_prefix("weapon_").unwrap_or(&n);
    WEAPONS.iter().find(|d| d.name == n || (n == "mp5" && d.name == "mp5navy") || (n == "glock" && d.name == "glock18")).map(|d| d.id)
}

/// How fast a gunshot fades with distance (GoldSrc attenuation: silent at 1000 / attn units),
/// as CS 1.6 plays it (`EV_Fire*` in `cl_dlls/client.so`, volume 1 for all).
pub fn fire_attenuation(id: Id, silenced: bool) -> f32 {
    use Id::*;
    match id {
        Awp => 0.28,
        Ak47 | Galil => 0.4,
        Famas => 0.48,
        M4a1 if silenced => 1.4,
        M4a1 => 0.52,
        Deagle => 0.6,
        Mp5 | P90 | Ump45 => 0.64,
        Mac10 => 0.72,
        Scout | Tmp => 1.6,
        Usp if silenced => 2.0,
        _ => 0.8, // Glock, USP, P228
    }
}

/// The player body animation set CS uses for each weapon (`ref_aim_<ext>`, `crouch_aim_<ext>`).
pub fn anim_ext(id: Id) -> &'static str {
    use Id::*;
    match id {
        Knife => "knife",
        Glock | Usp | P228 | Deagle => "onehanded",
        Mac10 | Tmp | Mp5 | Ump45 | P90 => "mp5",
        Galil | Ak47 => "ak47",
        Famas | M4a1 => "carbine",
        Scout | Awp => "rifle",
        HeGrenade | Flashbang | Smoke => "grenade",
        C4 => "c4",
    }
}
```
