```rs
use super::*;

pub(super) fn fire(g: &mut GunState, gd: &data::Gun, c: &Context, out: &mut Fired, punch: &mut [f32; 3]) {
    {
        let mode = gd.modes[g.mode as usize];
        if g.clip == 0 {
            out.dry_fire = true;
            g.next_primary = c.now + 0.2;
            return;
        }
        // Semi-auto: one shot per click (shots_fired resets when the button is released).
        if gd.semi_auto {
            g.shots_fired += 1;
            if g.shots_fired > 1 {
                return;
            }
        }
        let since_last = if g.last_fire > 0.0 { Some((c.now - g.last_fire) as f32) } else { None };

        // Spread from the accuracy left by the previous shot.
        let acc_before = g.accuracy;
        let spread = spread(&mode.spread, acc_before, c, g.zoom > 0);

        // Accuracy for the next shot.
        if !gd.semi_auto {
            g.delay_fire = true;
            g.shots_fired += 1;
        }
        match gd.accuracy {
            Accuracy::Auto { power, div, fdiv, add, cap, .. } => {
                let n = g.shots_fired;
                let p = if power == 3 { n * n * n } else { n * n };
                let step = if div > 0 { (p / div) as f32 } else { p as f32 / fdiv };
                g.accuracy = (step + add).min(cap);
            }
            Accuracy::PistolTime { k, s, lo, hi, .. } => {
                if let Some(dt) = since_last {
                    g.accuracy = (g.accuracy - (k - dt) * s).clamp(lo, hi);
                }
            }
            Accuracy::SniperTime { base, k, cap, .. } => {
                if let Some(dt) = since_last {
                    g.accuracy = (dt * k + base).min(cap);
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        g.last_fire = c.now;

        g.clip -= 1;
        out.shots.push(Shot {
            weapon: g.id,
            damage: mode.damage,
            range_mod: mode.range_mod,
            penetration: gd.penetration,
            distance: gd.distance,
            bullet: gd.bullet,
            spread,
            angles: [c.pitch + punch[0], c.yaw + punch[1]],
            seed: c.seed,
            pellets: gd.pellets,
            silenced: matches!(g.id, Id::M4a1 | Id::Usp) && g.mode == 1,
        });
        let cycle = if g.zoom > 0 { gd.zoomed_cycle.unwrap_or(mode.cycle) } else { mode.cycle };
        g.next_primary = c.now + cycle as f64;
        if gd.unscope_on_fire && g.zoom > 0 {
            g.resume_zoom = g.zoom;
            g.zoom = 0;
        }
        kick(punch, g, gd, c);
    }
}

pub(super) fn start_reload(g: &mut GunState, gd: &data::Gun, now: f64) -> Option<f64> {
    if g.reserve == 0 || g.clip >= gd.clip || now <= g.next_primary {
        return None;
    }
    g.zoom = 0;
    g.resume_zoom = 0;
    if gd.pellets.is_some() {
        if g.shell_state == 0 {
            g.shell_state = 1;
            g.shell_at = now + 0.55;
            g.next_primary = now + 0.55;
        }
        return None;
    }
    g.reloading = true;
    g.shots_fired = 0;
    g.delay_fire = false;
    if let Accuracy::Auto { on_reload, .. } = gd.accuracy {
        g.accuracy = on_reload;
    } else if let Accuracy::PistolTime { initial, .. } = gd.accuracy {
        g.accuracy = initial;
    } else if let Accuracy::SniperTime { on_reload: Some(a), .. } = gd.accuracy {
        g.accuracy = a;
    }
    Some(now + gd.reload as f64)
}

pub(super) fn shotgun_reload_step(g: &mut GunState, gd: &data::Gun, p: &data::Pellets, now: f64) {
    if g.shell_state == 0 || now < g.shell_at {
        return;
    }
    match g.shell_state {
        1 => {
            g.shell_state = 2;
            g.shell_at = now + p.shell_time as f64;
        }
        _ => {
            if g.reserve > 0 && g.clip < gd.clip {
                g.clip += 1;
                g.reserve -= 1;
            }
            g.shell_state = if g.clip < gd.clip && g.reserve > 0 { 1 } else { 0 };
            g.shell_at = now;
        }
    }
}

/// The spread number for a shot in the current movement state.
pub(super) fn spread(s: &Spread, acc: f32, c: &Context, zoomed: bool) -> f32 {
    let air = !c.on_ground;
    match *s {
        Spread::Rifle { air: a, fast_speed, fast, still } => {
            let (b, k) = if air {
                a
            } else if c.speed_2d > fast_speed {
                fast
            } else {
                still
            };
            b + k * acc
        }
        Spread::Smg { air: a, fast, still } => {
            if air {
                a * acc
            } else if let Some((speed, k)) = fast.filter(|(s, _)| c.speed_2d > *s) {
                let _ = speed;
                k * acc
            } else {
                still * acc
            }
        }
        Spread::Pistol { air: a, moving, duck, stand } => {
            let k = if air {
                a
            } else if c.speed_2d > 0.0 {
                moving
            } else if c.crouched {
                duck
            } else {
                stand
            };
            k * (1.0 - acc)
        }
        Spread::Sniper { air: a, moving, duck, stand, unscoped } => {
            let moving_value = moving.iter().find(|(speed, _)| c.speed_2d > *speed).map(|(_, v)| *v);
            let base = if air {
                a
            } else if let Some(v) = moving_value {
                v
            } else if c.crouched {
                duck
            } else {
                stand
            };
            base + if zoomed { 0.0 } else { unscoped }
        }
    }
}

/// Recoil of one shot.
pub(super) fn kick(punch: &mut [f32; 3], g: &mut GunState, gd: &data::Gun, c: &Context) {
    match gd.recoil {
        Recoil::Kick { smg_order, sets } => {
            let moving = c.speed_2d > 0.0;
            let air = !c.on_ground;
            let set = if smg_order {
                if air {
                    sets[1]
                } else if moving {
                    sets[0]
                } else if c.crouched {
                    sets[2]
                } else {
                    sets[3]
                }
            } else if moving {
                sets[0]
            } else if air {
                sets[1]
            } else if c.crouched {
                sets[2]
            } else {
                sets[3]
            };
            let [up_base, lat_base, up_mod, lat_mod, up_max, lat_max, dir_change] = set;
            let n = g.shots_fired as f32;
            let (up, lat) = if g.shots_fired <= 1 { (up_base, lat_base) } else { (n * up_mod + up_base, n * lat_mod + lat_base) };
            punch[0] = (punch[0] - up).max(-up_max);
            if g.direction == 1 {
                punch[1] = (punch[1] + lat).min(lat_max);
            } else {
                punch[1] = (punch[1] - lat).max(-lat_max);
            }
            if rand_int(c.seed, 10, 0, dir_change as i32) == 0 {
                g.direction = 1 - g.direction;
            }
        }
        Recoil::Flat(p) => punch[0] -= p,
        Recoil::AutoSniper { lo, hi } => {
            punch[0] -= rand_range(c.seed, 4, lo, hi) + punch[0] * 0.25;
            punch[1] += rand_range(c.seed, 5, -0.75, 0.75);
        }
        Recoil::Shotgun { ground, air } => {
            let (lo, hi) = if c.on_ground { ground } else { air };
            punch[0] -= rand_int(c.seed, 1, lo, hi) as f32;
        }
        Recoil::None => {}
    }
}
```

`sim/src/weapons/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! Weapon behaviour: firing timing, ammo and reloads, accuracy, spread, recoil,
//! fire modes, scopes, switching. Follows docs/WEAPONS.md. Bullets are traced in
//! `bullets`; this module decides when and how each shot happens.
pub mod bullets;
pub mod data;
mod carried;
mod firing;
mod update;

pub use data::{def, gun, Id, Slot};
use data::{Accuracy, Kind, Recoil, Secondary, Spread};
use firing::{fire, shotgun_reload_step, spread, start_reload};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

/// Deterministic random numbers: the same (seed, k) always gives the same value,
/// so a shot replays identically (tests, replays, client effects).
pub fn rand01(seed: u64, k: u64) -> f32 {
    let mut z = seed.wrapping_add(k.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15)).wrapping_add(0x6A09_E667_F3BC_C909);
    z = (z ^ (z >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
    z = (z ^ (z >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
    z ^= z >> 31;
    (z >> 40) as f32 / (1u64 << 24) as f32
}

fn rand_range(seed: u64, k: u64, lo: f32, hi: f32) -> f32 {
    lo + (hi - lo) * rand01(seed, k)
}

fn rand_int(seed: u64, k: u64, lo: i32, hi: i32) -> i32 {
    lo + ((rand01(seed, k) * (hi - lo + 1) as f32) as i32).min(hi - lo)
}

/// One owned gun and everything about its state.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GunState {
    pub id: Id,
    pub clip: u32,
    pub reserve: u32,
    /// Index into the gun's modes (silencer on).
    pub mode: u8,
    /// Zoom step: 0 = none, n = `Secondary::Zoom` entry n-1.
    pub zoom: u8,
    /// AWP/Scout: zoom to restore once the bolt is back.
    resume_zoom: u8,
    pub accuracy: f32,
    pub shots_fired: i32,
    delay_fire: bool,
    decrease_at: f64,
    /// Time of the last shot; 0 = never fired.
    last_fire: f64,
    /// KickBack lateral direction (0/1); never reset.
    direction: u8,
    next_primary: f64,
    next_secondary: f64,
    pub reloading: bool,
    /// Shotguns: 0 idle, 1 between shells, 2 inserting.
    shell_state: u8,
    shell_at: f64,
}

impl GunState {
    pub fn new(id: Id) -> GunState {
        let g = gun(id).expect("not a gun");
        GunState {
            id,
            clip: g.clip,
            reserve: g.reserve,
            mode: 0,
            zoom: 0,
            resume_zoom: 0,
            accuracy: initial_accuracy(&g.accuracy),
            shots_fired: 0,
            delay_fire: false,
            decrease_at: 0.0,
            last_fire: 0.0,
            direction: 0,
            next_primary: 0.0,
            next_secondary: 0.0,
            reloading: false,
            shell_state: 0,
            shell_at: 0.0,
        }
    }

    /// A shotgun is loading shells one by one.
    pub fn loading_shells(&self) -> bool {
        self.shell_state != 0
    }

    pub fn fov(&self) -> u8 {
        match gun(self.id).map(|g| g.secondary) {
            Some(Secondary::Zoom(steps)) if self.zoom > 0 => steps[self.zoom as usize - 1],
            _ => 90,
        }
    }
}

fn initial_accuracy(a: &Accuracy) -> f32 {
    match *a {
        Accuracy::Auto { initial, .. } | Accuracy::PistolTime { initial, .. } | Accuracy::SniperTime { initial, .. } => initial,
        Accuracy::None => 0.0,
    }
}

/// What the player is carrying.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Loadout {
    pub primary: Option<GunState>,
    pub secondary: Option<GunState>,
    pub knife: bool,
    /// HE, flash, smoke counts.
    pub grenades: [u8; 3],
    pub c4: bool,
    pub active: Slot,
    last_slot: Slot,
    /// Blocks all weapon actions until this time (deploy, reload).
    next_attack: f64,
    /// Recoil view punch (pitch, yaw, roll) in degrees.
    pub punch: [f32; 3],
    knife_next_primary: f64,
    knife_next_secondary: f64,
    /// Grenade in hand: index into `grenades` (0 HE, 1 flash, 2 smoke).
    pub grenade: u8,
    /// Pin pulled; the throw happens on release once this time has passed.
    pin_until: Option<f64>,
    grenade_next: f64,
    /// Planting the bomb since this time (attack held with the C4 out, in a bomb site).
    pub planting: Option<f64>,
}

/// Seconds of holding attack to plant the bomb (CS 1.6 C4 arming time).
pub const C4_PLANT_TIME: f64 = 3.0;

/// A bullet (or pellet volley) to trace, decided by the weapon update.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Shot {
    pub weapon: Id,
    pub damage: i32,
    pub range_mod: f32,
    pub penetration: u32,
    pub distance: f32,
    pub bullet: data::Bullet,
    /// Spread number (0 = perfectly accurate); x/y offsets come from `seed`.
    pub spread: f32,
    /// View angles + punch at the moment of the shot (pitch, yaw), degrees.
    pub angles: [f32; 2],
    pub seed: u64,
    pub pellets: Option<data::Pellets>,
    /// M4A1/USP with the silencer on (quieter, different sound).
    pub silenced: bool,
}

/// A knife swing to trace.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Swing {
    pub stab: bool,
    pub angles: [f32; 2],
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct Fired {
    pub shots: Vec<Shot>,
    pub swing: Option<Swing>,
    /// The empty-clip click.
    pub dry_fire: bool,
    /// The bomb went down (planting finished this tick).
    pub planted: bool,
    /// A grenade left the hand: which, and the view angles (pitch, yaw) incl. punch.
    pub throw: Option<(crate::grenades::Kind, [f32; 2])>,
    /// A gun was dropped (G), with its ammo.
    pub dropped: Option<GunState>,
}

/// What the weapon code needs to know about the player this tick.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Context {
    pub now: f64,
    pub dt: f32,
    pub on_ground: bool,
    pub crouched: bool,
    pub speed_2d: f32,
    pub yaw: f32,
    pub pitch: f32,
    pub attack: bool,
    pub attack2: bool,
    pub reload: bool,
    /// Slot key pressed this tick (0 = none; see `pmove::SLOT_*`).
    pub slot: u8,
    /// G pressed this tick.
    pub drop: bool,
    /// Freeze time etc.: no shooting.
    pub can_shoot: bool,
    /// Standing in a bomb site (the C4 can be planted).
    pub in_bomb_site: bool,
    /// Per-tick random seed (player and input number).
    pub seed: u64,
}

impl Loadout {
    /// Knife only.
    pub fn knife_only() -> Loadout {
        Loadout {
            primary: None,
            secondary: None,
            knife: true,
            grenades: [0; 3],
            c4: false,
            active: Slot::Knife,
            last_slot: Slot::Knife,
            next_attack: 0.0,
            punch: [0.0; 3],
            knife_next_primary: 0.0,
            knife_next_secondary: 0.0,
            grenade: 0,
            pin_until: None,
            grenade_next: 0.0,
            planting: None,
        }
    }

    /// Knife + a pistol with spawn ammo (T: Glock 20+40, CT: USP 12+24), pistol out.
    pub fn spawn(pistol: Id, reserve: u32) -> Loadout {
        let mut l = Loadout::knife_only();
        let mut p = GunState::new(pistol);
        p.reserve = reserve;
        l.secondary = Some(p);
        l.active = Slot::Secondary;
        l
    }

    /// Add a weapon: a gun replaces what's in its slot and is drawn; grenades stack
    /// up to their carry limit (1 HE, 2 flash, 1 smoke). Returns false if it didn't fit.
    pub fn give(&mut self, id: Id, now: f64) -> bool {
        match id {
            Id::HeGrenade | Id::Flashbang | Id::Smoke => {
                let (i, max) = match id {
                    Id::HeGrenade => (0, 1),
                    Id::Flashbang => (1, 2),
                    _ => (2, 1),
                };
                if self.grenades[i] >= max {
                    return false;
                }
                self.grenades[i] += 1;
                return true;
            }
            Id::C4 => {
                self.c4 = true;
                return true;
            }
            Id::Knife => {
                self.knife = true;
                return true;
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        let g = GunState::new(id);
        match def(id).slot {
            Slot::Primary => self.primary = Some(g),
            Slot::Secondary => self.secondary = Some(g),
            _ => return false,
        }
        self.switch_to(def(id).slot, now);
        true
    }

    /// Take the gun in hand out of the inventory (G, or on death) and draw the best
    /// remaining weapon. Knife and grenades can't be dropped.
    pub fn drop_active(&mut self, now: f64) -> Option<GunState> {
        let gun = match self.active {
            Slot::Primary => self.primary.take(),
            Slot::Secondary => self.secondary.take(),
            _ => None,
        }?;
        let mut g = gun;
        g.reloading = false;
        g.zoom = 0;
        g.resume_zoom = 0;
        g.shell_state = 0;
        let best = [Slot::Primary, Slot::Secondary, Slot::Knife, Slot::Grenade].into_iter().find(|s| self.has(*s)).unwrap_or(Slot::Knife);
        self.active = Slot::Knife; // nothing in hand to holster
        self.switch_to(best, now);
        Some(g)
    }

    /// Pick up a dropped gun if its slot is free (keeps its ammo). Returns false if not.
    pub fn pick_up(&mut self, g: GunState) -> bool {
        let slot = match def(g.id).slot {
            Slot::Primary => &mut self.primary,
            Slot::Secondary => &mut self.secondary,
            _ => return false,
        };
        if slot.is_some() {
            return false;
        }
        *slot = Some(g);
        true
    }

    /// Fill the reserve ammo of the primary (or pistol) to the most it can carry.
    pub fn refill_ammo(&mut self, primary: bool) {
        let g = if primary { self.primary.as_mut() } else { self.secondary.as_mut() };
        if let Some(g) = g {
            g.reserve = gun(g.id).map(|d| d.reserve).unwrap_or(g.reserve);
        }
    }

    /// The pin is pulled on the grenade in hand.
    pub fn pin_pulled(&self) -> bool {
        self.pin_until.is_some()
    }

    /// The grenade type in hand (or that slot 4 would draw).
    pub fn grenade_id(&self) -> Option<Id> {
        let kinds = [Id::HeGrenade, Id::Flashbang, Id::Smoke];
        (0..3).map(|k| (self.grenade as usize + k) % 3).find(|&i| self.grenades[i] > 0).map(|i| kinds[i])
    }

    /// Spread the next shot would have in this movement state (for the crosshair).
    pub fn spread_now(&self, on_ground: bool, crouched: bool, speed_2d: f32) -> Option<f32> {
        let g = self.active_gun()?;
        let gd = gun(g.id)?;
        let c = Context { now: 0.0, dt: 0.0, on_ground, crouched, speed_2d, yaw: 0.0, pitch: 0.0, attack: false, attack2: false, reload: false, slot: 0, drop: false, can_shoot: true, in_bomb_site: false, seed: 0 };
        Some(spread(&gd.modes[g.mode as usize].spread, g.accuracy, &c, g.zoom > 0))
    }

    pub fn active_gun(&self) -> Option<&GunState> {
        match self.active {
            Slot::Primary => self.primary.as_ref(),
            Slot::Secondary => self.secondary.as_ref(),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    fn active_gun_mut(&mut self) -> Option<&mut GunState> {
        match self.active {
            Slot::Primary => self.primary.as_mut(),
            Slot::Secondary => self.secondary.as_mut(),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    pub fn active_id(&self) -> Id {
        match self.active {
            Slot::Grenade => self.grenade_id().unwrap_or(Id::Knife),
            Slot::Bomb => Id::C4,
            _ => self.active_gun().map(|g| g.id).unwrap_or(Id::Knife),
        }
    }

    /// Movement speed with the current weapon.
    pub fn max_speed(&self) -> f32 {
        // You can't move while planting.
        if self.planting.is_some() {
            return 1.0;
        }
        self.active_gun().map(|g| data::max_speed(g.id, g.zoom > 0)).unwrap_or(250.0)
    }

    fn has(&self, slot: Slot) -> bool {
        match slot {
            Slot::Primary => self.primary.is_some(),
            Slot::Secondary => self.secondary.is_some(),
            Slot::Knife => self.knife,
            Slot::Grenade => self.grenades.iter().any(|&n| n > 0),
            Slot::Bomb => self.c4,
        }
    }

    /// Holster the current weapon (cancels a reload) and deploy another.
    pub fn switch_to(&mut self, slot: Slot, now: f64) {
        if !self.has(slot) {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(g) = self.active_gun_mut() {
            g.reloading = false;
            g.shell_state = 0;
            g.zoom = 0;
            g.resume_zoom = 0;
        }
        self.pin_until = None;
        self.last_slot = self.active;
        self.active = slot;
        let deploy = match self.active_gun_mut() {
            Some(g) => {
                let gd = gun(g.id).unwrap();
                g.accuracy = initial_accuracy(&gd.accuracy);
                g.shots_fired = 0;
                g.delay_fire = false;
                g.decrease_at = now;
                g.zoom = 0;
                g.next_primary = now + gd.deploy as f64;
                gd.deploy
            }
            None => 0.75,
        };
        self.next_attack = now + deploy as f64;
    }
}

/// Weapon state machine tests (no map needed).
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests;

/// Kind check helper used by the server.
pub fn is_gun(id: Id) -> bool {
    matches!(def(id).kind, Kind::Gun(_))
}
```

```rs
use super::*;

const DT: f32 = 1.0 / 128.0;

struct Sim {
    l: Loadout,
    now: f64,
    tick: u64,
}

impl Sim {
    fn with(id: Id) -> Sim {
        let mut l = Loadout::knife_only();
        l.give(id, 0.0);
        let mut s = Sim { l, now: 0.0, tick: 0 };
        s.idle(2.0); // finish deploying
        s
    }

    fn ctx(&self) -> Context {
        Context {
            now: self.now,
            dt: DT,
            on_ground: true,
            crouched: false,
            speed_2d: 0.0,
            yaw: 0.0,
            pitch: 0.0,
            attack: false,
            attack2: false,
            reload: false,
            slot: 0,
            drop: false,
            can_shoot: true,
            in_bomb_site: false,
            seed: self.tick,
        }
    }

    fn step(&mut self, f: impl Fn(&mut Context)) -> Fired {
        self.tick += 1;
        self.now += DT as f64;
        let mut c = self.ctx();
        f(&mut c);
        self.l.update(&c)
    }

    /// Hold an input for `secs`, collecting every shot.
    fn hold(&mut self, secs: f32, f: impl Fn(&mut Context) + Copy) -> Vec<Shot> {
        (0..(secs / DT).round() as usize).flat_map(|_| self.step(f).shots).collect()
    }

    fn idle(&mut self, secs: f32) {
        self.hold(secs, |_| {});
    }

    fn gun(&self) -> GunState {
        *self.l.active_gun().unwrap()
    }
}

fn attack(c: &mut Context) {
    c.attack = true;
}

#[test]
fn ak_fires_about_ten_rounds_a_second_then_reloads() {
    let mut s = Sim::with(Id::Ak47);
    let shots = s.hold(1.0, attack);
    // 0.0955 s cycle, rounded up to whole ticks: 10 or 11 shots in a second.
    assert!((10..=11).contains(&shots.len()), "{} shots", shots.len());
    assert!(shots.iter().all(|sh| sh.damage == 36));
    // Empty the clip, release: it reloads by itself and the ammo arrives at the end.
    s.hold(3.0, attack);
    assert_eq!(s.gun().clip, 0);
    s.idle(0.1);
    assert!(s.gun().reloading);
    assert_eq!(s.gun().clip, 0, "ammo only moves when the reload finishes");
    s.idle(2.5);
    assert_eq!((s.gun().clip, s.gun().reserve), (30, 60));
}

#[test]
fn switching_cancels_a_reload_without_losing_ammo() {
    let mut s = Sim::with(Id::Ak47);
    s.hold(0.5, attack);
    let before = s.gun();
    s.step(|c| c.reload = true);
    s.idle(1.0);
    s.step(|c| c.slot = 3); // knife
    s.idle(3.0);
    s.step(|c| c.slot = 1);
    s.idle(1.0);
    assert_eq!((s.gun().clip, s.gun().reserve), (before.clip, before.reserve));
}

#[test]
fn ak_accuracy_steps_and_first_shot_is_pinpoint() {
    let mut s = Sim::with(Id::Ak47);
    let shots = s.hold(1.0, attack);
    // First shot after deploy: 0.0275 * 0.2.
    assert!((shots[0].spread - 0.0055).abs() < 1e-6, "{}", shots[0].spread);
    // Shots 2-6 use accuracy 0.35 (n = 1..5), from the 7th it is 1.25.
    assert!((shots[1].spread - 0.0275 * 0.35).abs() < 1e-6);
    assert!((shots[5].spread - 0.0275 * 0.35).abs() < 1e-6);
    assert!((shots[6].spread - 0.0275 * 1.25).abs() < 1e-6);
}

#[test]
fn spraying_climbs_to_the_recoil_cap_and_settles_after() {
    let mut s = Sim::with(Id::Ak47);
    // The cap is hit right after each shot; the punch then fades until the next one.
    let mut peak = 0.0f32;
    for _ in 0..256 {
        s.step(attack);
        peak = peak.min(s.l.punch[0]);
    }
    assert!((peak + 5.75).abs() < 0.01, "standing AK caps at -5.75, got {peak}");
    s.idle(1.5);
    assert_eq!(s.l.punch, [0.0; 3]);
}

#[test]
fn moving_and_jumping_ruin_rifle_accuracy() {
    let mut s = Sim::with(Id::Ak47);
    let still = s.step(attack).shots[0].spread;
    s.idle(2.0);
    let running = s.step(|c| {
        c.attack = true;
        c.speed_2d = 200.0;
    });
    s.idle(2.0);
    let jumping = s.step(|c| {
        c.attack = true;
        c.on_ground = false;
    });
    assert!(running.shots[0].spread > still * 5.0);
    assert!(jumping.shots[0].spread > running.shots[0].spread);
}

#[test]
fn spread_offsets_are_triangular_and_bounded() {
    let (mut sum, mut sumsq) = (0.0f64, 0.0f64);
    for seed in 0..20000u64 {
        let x = rand01(seed, 0) - 0.5 + rand01(seed, 1) - 0.5;
        assert!((-1.0..=1.0).contains(&x));
        sum += x as f64;
        sumsq += (x * x) as f64;
    }
    let mean = sum / 20000.0;
    let var = sumsq / 20000.0 - mean * mean;
    assert!(mean.abs() < 0.01);
    assert!((var - 1.0 / 6.0).abs() < 0.01, "triangular(-1,1) variance is 1/6, got {var}");
}

#[test]
fn grenades_throw_on_release_and_cycle() {
    let mut l = Loadout::knife_only();
    assert!(l.give(Id::Flashbang, 0.0) && l.give(Id::Flashbang, 0.0));
    assert!(!l.give(Id::Flashbang, 0.0), "only two flashes");
    assert!(l.give(Id::HeGrenade, 0.0));
    let mut s = Sim { l, now: 0.0, tick: 0 };
    s.step(|c| c.slot = 4);
    s.idle(1.0);
    assert_eq!(s.l.active_id(), Id::HeGrenade);
    s.step(|c| c.slot = 4); // next type
    s.idle(1.0);
    assert_eq!(s.l.active_id(), Id::Flashbang);
    // Holding the pin never throws; letting go does.
    let held: Vec<_> = (0..128).filter_map(|_| s.step(attack).throw).collect();
    assert!(held.is_empty());
    let thrown = s.step(|_| {}).throw;
    assert_eq!(thrown.map(|t| t.0), Some(crate::grenades::Kind::Flash));
    assert_eq!(s.l.grenades, [1, 1, 0]);
    // A quick tap still throws, once the pin time (0.5 s) is up.
    s.idle(1.0);
    s.step(attack);
    let early: Vec<_> = (0..32).filter_map(|_| s.step(|_| {}).throw).collect();
    assert!(early.is_empty(), "not before 0.5 s");
    let later: Vec<_> = (0..64).filter_map(|_| s.step(|_| {}).throw).collect();
    assert_eq!(later.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(s.l.grenades, [1, 0, 0]);
}

#[test]
fn q_wheel_and_drop() {
    let mut s = Sim::with(Id::Ak47);
    s.step(|c| c.slot = 3);
    s.idle(1.0);
    assert_eq!(s.l.active, Slot::Knife);
    s.step(|c| c.slot = crate::pmove::SLOT_LAST);
    s.idle(1.0);
    assert_eq!(s.l.active, Slot::Primary, "Q goes back to the AK");
    s.step(|c| c.slot = crate::pmove::SLOT_NEXT);
    s.idle(1.0);
    assert_eq!(s.l.active, Slot::Knife, "no pistol in this test: next is the knife");
    s.step(|c| c.slot = crate::pmove::SLOT_PREV);
    s.idle(1.0);
    assert_eq!(s.l.active, Slot::Primary);
    s.hold(0.3, attack);
    let clip = s.gun().clip;
    let dropped = s.step(|c| c.drop = true).dropped.expect("dropped the AK");
    assert_eq!((dropped.id, dropped.clip), (Id::Ak47, clip));
    assert_eq!(s.l.active, Slot::Knife);
    assert!(s.l.pick_up(dropped));
    assert!(!s.l.pick_up(GunState::new(Id::M4a1)), "slot taken");
}

#[test]
fn c4_plants_after_three_seconds_held_in_a_site_only() {
    let mut s = Sim::with(Id::Glock);
    s.l.give(Id::C4, 0.0);
    s.step(|c| c.slot = 5);
    s.idle(1.0);
    assert_eq!(s.l.active, Slot::Bomb);
    // Outside a site: nothing, and you can still move.
    let planted = (0..512).any(|_| s.step(attack).planted);
    assert!(!planted && s.l.planting.is_none() && s.l.max_speed() > 200.0);
    // In a site: frozen while planting, done after 3 s.
    let in_site = |c: &mut Context| {
        c.attack = true;
        c.in_bomb_site = true;
    };
    let ticks = (0..1000).position(|_| s.step(in_site).planted).expect("planted");
    assert!((380..=390).contains(&ticks), "{ticks} ticks");
    assert!(!s.l.c4 && s.l.active == Slot::Secondary, "bomb gone, pistol out");
    // Letting go halfway starts over.
    s.l.give(Id::C4, s.now);
    s.step(|c| c.slot = 5);
    s.idle(1.0);
    s.hold(1.5, in_site);
    assert!(s.l.planting.is_some() && s.l.max_speed() < 2.0);
    s.idle(0.1);
    assert!(s.l.planting.is_none());
}
```

`sim/src/weapons/update.rs`:

```rs
use super::*;

impl Loadout {
    /// One tick of weapon logic. Call after the movement step.
    pub fn update(&mut self, c: &Context) -> Fired {
        let mut out = Fired::default();
        // Recoil punch fades: at least 10 deg/s, faster when large (PM_DropPunchAngle).
        let len = (self.punch[0].powi(2) + self.punch[1].powi(2) + self.punch[2].powi(2)).sqrt();
        if len > 0.0 {
            let new = (len - (10.0 + 0.5 * len) * c.dt).max(0.0);
            self.punch = self.punch.map(|p| p * new / len);
        }

        if c.drop {
            out.dropped = self.drop_active(c.now);
        }
        if c.slot != 0 {
            let order = [Slot::Primary, Slot::Secondary, Slot::Knife, Slot::Grenade, Slot::Bomb];
            let pos = order.iter().position(|s| *s == self.active).unwrap_or(0);
            let cycle = |step: usize| (1..=5).map(|k| order[(pos + k * step) % 5]).find(|s| self.has(*s)).unwrap_or(self.active);
            let slot = match c.slot {
                1 => Slot::Primary,
                2 => Slot::Secondary,
                3 => Slot::Knife,
                4 => Slot::Grenade,
                5 => Slot::Bomb,
                crate::pmove::SLOT_LAST => self.last_slot,
                crate::pmove::SLOT_NEXT => cycle(1),
                _ => cycle(4), // previous = four steps forward round the five slots
            };
            if slot != self.active {
                self.switch_to(slot, c.now);
            } else if slot == Slot::Grenade && self.pin_until.is_none() {
                // Pressing 4 again picks the next grenade type you carry.
                if let Some(i) = (1..=3).map(|k| (self.grenade as usize + k) % 3).find(|&i| self.grenades[i] > 0) {
                    self.grenade = i as u8;
                    self.next_attack = c.now + 0.75;
                }
            }
        }

        if self.active != Slot::Bomb {
            self.planting = None;
        }
        if c.now < self.next_attack {
            return out;
        }
        if self.active == Slot::Knife {
            if c.can_shoot {
                self.knife(c, &mut out);
            }
            return out;
        }
        if self.active == Slot::Bomb {
            self.plant(c, &mut out);
            return out;
        }
        if self.active == Slot::Grenade {
            self.grenade_update(c, &mut out);
            return out;
        }
        let mut punch = self.punch;
        let Some(g) = self.active_gun_mut().copied() else { return out };
        let mut g = g;
        let gd = gun(g.id).unwrap();
        let mut next_attack = None;

        // 1. AWP/Scout zoom comes back once the bolt is done.
        if g.resume_zoom > 0 && c.now >= g.next_primary {
            g.zoom = g.resume_zoom;
            g.resume_zoom = 0;
        }
        // 2. Reload finishes: ammo moves only now, so cancelling loses nothing.
        if g.reloading && gd.pellets.is_none() {
            let moved = (gd.clip - g.clip).min(g.reserve);
            g.clip += moved;
            g.reserve -= moved;
            g.reloading = false;
        }

        // 3. Exactly one of: secondary, primary, reload, idle.
        if c.attack2 && gd.secondary != Secondary::None && c.now >= g.next_secondary {
            match gd.secondary {
                Secondary::Toggle(t) => {
                    g.mode = (g.mode + 1) % gd.modes.len() as u8;
                    g.next_secondary = c.now + t as f64;
                    if t > 0.5 {
                        g.next_primary = c.now + t as f64; // attaching a silencer takes a while
                    }
                }
                Secondary::Zoom(steps) => {
                    g.zoom = (g.zoom + 1) % (steps.len() as u8 + 1);
                    g.next_secondary = c.now + 0.3;
                }
                Secondary::None => {}
            }
        } else if c.attack && c.now >= g.next_primary && c.can_shoot {
            if gd.pellets.is_some() && g.shell_state != 0 {
                g.shell_state = 0; // firing interrupts a shotgun reload
            }
            fire(&mut g, gd, c, &mut out, &mut punch);
            if gd.pellets.is_some() && g.clip == 0 && out.dry_fire {
                g.next_primary = c.now + 0.15;
            }
        } else if c.reload && !c.attack && !g.reloading {
            next_attack = start_reload(&mut g, gd, c.now);
        } else if !c.attack && !c.attack2 {
            // Idle: shots-fired decay, semi-auto release, auto reload.
            if g.delay_fire {
                g.delay_fire = false;
                g.shots_fired = g.shots_fired.min(15);
                g.decrease_at = c.now + 0.4;
            }
            if gd.semi_auto {
                g.shots_fired = 0;
            } else if g.shots_fired > 0 && g.decrease_at < c.now {
                g.decrease_at = c.now + 0.0225;
                g.shots_fired -= 1;
            }
            if g.clip == 0 && g.reserve > 0 && c.now > g.next_primary && !g.reloading && g.shell_state == 0 {
                next_attack = start_reload(&mut g, gd, c.now);
            }
        }
        // Shotguns load shell by shell in the background until full or interrupted.
        if let Some(p) = gd.pellets {
            shotgun_reload_step(&mut g, gd, &p, c.now);
        }

        if let Some(t) = next_attack {
            self.next_attack = t;
        }
        self.punch = punch;
        if let Some(slot) = self.active_gun_mut() {
            *slot = g;
        }
        out
    }
}
```

`sim/src/zones.rs`:

```rs
//! Map areas with rules attached: where each team can buy, where the bomb can be planted,
//! and how big the bomb blast is. Read from the map's entities, so the server and the
//! client's prediction agree.
use crate::Vec3;
use goldsrc::bsp::Bsp;

/// Which side a zone belongs to (the BSP `team` key: 1 = terrorists, 2 = counter-terrorists).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Side {
    T,
    Ct,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Zones {
    /// Buy areas per side: boxes (mins, maxs).
    buy: Vec<(Side, Vec3, Vec3)>,
    /// Maps without `func_buyzone`: you can buy near your own team's spawn points.
    spawn_buy: Vec<(Side, Vec3)>,
    /// Bomb sites (`func_bomb_target`): boxes.
    pub bomb_sites: Vec<(Vec3, Vec3)>,
    /// Each site's own name where the map gives one ('a' / 'b' from targets like `tgt_a`).
    site_names: Vec<Option<char>>,
    /// `info_map_parameters bombradius` (default 500): the blast hurts out to 3.5 times this.
    pub bomb_radius: f32,
}

/// CS: without buy zones in the map, within this distance of your team's spawn points.
const SPAWN_BUY_RADIUS: f32 = 200.0;

impl Zones {
    pub fn from_bsp(bsp: &Bsp) -> Zones {
        let mut z = Zones { bomb_radius: 500.0, ..Default::default() };
        let bounds = |e: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>| -> Option<(Vec3, Vec3)> {
            let i: usize = e.get("model")?.strip_prefix('*')?.parse().ok()?;
            let m = bsp.models.get(i)?;
            Some((m.mins, m.maxs))
        };
        let origin = |e: &std::collections::HashMap<String, String>| -> Option<Vec3> {
            let v: Vec<f32> = e.get("origin")?.split_whitespace().filter_map(|x| x.parse().ok()).collect();
            Some([*v.first()?, *v.get(1)?, *v.get(2)?])
        };
        for e in bsp.entity_list() {
            match e.get("classname").map(String::as_str) {
                Some("func_buyzone") => {
                    let side = if e.get("team").map(String::as_str) == Some("1") { Side::T } else { Side::Ct };
                    if let Some((lo, hi)) = bounds(&e) {
                        z.buy.push((side, lo, hi));
                    }
                }
                Some("func_bomb_target") => {
                    if let Some(b) = bounds(&e) {
                        z.bomb_sites.push(b);
                        let name = e.get("target").or(e.get("targetname")).and_then(|t| match t.to_ascii_lowercase().chars().last() {
                            Some(c @ ('a' | 'b')) if t.len() > 1 && !t[..t.len() - 1].ends_with(|c: char| c.is_ascii_alphabetic()) => Some(c),
                            _ => None,
                        });
                        z.site_names.push(name);
                    }
                }
                Some("info_player_deathmatch") => z.spawn_buy.extend(origin(&e).map(|o| (Side::T, o))),
                Some("info_player_start") => z.spawn_buy.extend(origin(&e).map(|o| (Side::Ct, o))),
                Some("info_map_parameters") => {
                    if let Some(r) = e.get("bombradius").and_then(|r| r.parse().ok()) {
                        z.bomb_radius = r;
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        z
    }

    pub fn in_buy_zone(&self, side: Side, at: Vec3) -> bool {
        if self.buy.is_empty() {
            return self.spawn_buy.iter().any(|(s, o)| *s == side && (0..3).map(|i| (o[i] - at[i]).powi(2)).sum::<f32>() < SPAWN_BUY_RADIUS * SPAWN_BUY_RADIUS);
        }
        self.buy.iter().any(|(s, lo, hi)| *s == side && inside(at, *lo, *hi))
    }

    /// The bomb sites' centres, A first. Names come from the map where it has them (de_dust2's
    /// `tgt_a`); else from what's known of the map (Inferno: B is the north site, up banana;
    /// Nuke: A is the upper site; Mirage, BubkeZ's original: A is the south site; Train: A is
    /// the big middle yard, B the lower yard by the CT spawn, so A is the west one); else the
    /// east site is A.
    pub fn sites_a_first(&self, map: &str) -> Vec<Vec3> {
        let centre = |(lo, hi): &(Vec3, Vec3)| [(lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2.0, (lo[1] + hi[1]) / 2.0, lo[2] + 36.0];
        let mut sites: Vec<(Vec3, Option<char>)> = self.bomb_sites.iter().zip(&self.site_names).map(|(b, n)| (centre(b), *n)).collect();
        if sites.iter().all(|(_, n)| n.is_some()) {
            sites.sort_by_key(|(_, n)| *n);
        } else {
            match map {
                "de_inferno" => sites.sort_by(|a, b| a.0[1].total_cmp(&b.0[1])), // north (bigger y) is B
                "de_nuke" => sites.sort_by(|a, b| b.0[2].total_cmp(&a.0[2])),    // upper is A
                "de_mirage" => sites.sort_by(|a, b| a.0[1].total_cmp(&b.0[1])),  // south (smaller y) is A
                "de_train" => sites.sort_by(|a, b| a.0[0].total_cmp(&b.0[0])),   // west (smaller x) is A
                _ => sites.sort_by(|a, b| b.0[0].total_cmp(&a.0[0])),
            }
        }
        sites.into_iter().map(|(c, _)| c).collect()
    }

    /// A side's spawn points (`info_player_deathmatch`: terrorists, `info_player_start`:
    /// counter-terrorists), in map order.
    pub fn spawns(&self, side: Side) -> Vec<Vec3> {
        self.spawn_buy.iter().filter(|(s, _)| *s == side).map(|(_, o)| *o).collect()
    }

    pub fn in_bomb_site(&self, at: Vec3) -> bool {
        self.bomb_sites.iter().any(|(lo, hi)| inside(at, *lo, *hi))
    }
}

fn inside(p: Vec3, lo: Vec3, hi: Vec3) -> bool {
    (0..3).all(|i| p[i] >= lo[i] && p[i] <= hi[i])
}

```

`sim/tests/maps.rs`:

```rs
//! Movement, doors and ladders on the real maps. Skipped when CS 1.6 isn't installed.
use goldsrc::bsp::Bsp;
use sim::collision::{Hull, World};
use sim::doors::{Actor, DoorState};
use sim::pmove::{step, Input, MoveVars, Player};

const DT: f32 = 1.0 / 128.0;

fn load(map: &str) -> Option<Bsp> {
    let home = std::env::var("HOME").ok()?;
    let dir = std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_DIR").unwrap_or(format!("{}/../gamedata", env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")));
    Bsp::load(format!("{dir}/maps/{map}.bsp")).ok()
}

fn vec3(s: &str) -> [f32; 3] {
    let v: Vec<f32> = s.split_whitespace().map(|x| x.parse().unwrap()).collect();
    [v[0], v[1], v[2]]
}

fn actor(p: &Player, using: bool) -> Actor {
    let h = p.hull();
    Actor {
        mins: [p.origin[0] + h.mins()[0], p.origin[1] + h.mins()[1], p.origin[2] + h.mins()[2]],
        maxs: [p.origin[0] + h.maxs()[0], p.origin[1] + h.maxs()[1], p.origin[2] + h.maxs()[2]],
        eye: p.eye(),
        forward: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0],
        using,
    }
}

/// One tick of the whole world for a single player.
fn tick(w: &mut World, p: &mut Player, input: &Input) {
    step(p, input, DT, w, &MoveVars::default());
    w.update(DT, &[actor(p, false)]);
}

#[test]
fn spawns_land_and_players_can_run() {
    for map in ["de_dust2", "de_inferno", "de_nuke", "de_train", "de_mirage"] {
        let Some(bsp) = load(map) else {
            eprintln!("{map} not installed, skipping");
            continue;
        };
        let mut world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
        let spawns: Vec<[f32; 3]> = bsp
            .entity_list()
            .iter()
            .filter(|e| matches!(e.get("classname").map(String::as_str), Some("info_player_start" | "info_player_deathmatch")))
            .map(|e| vec3(&e["origin"]))
            .collect();
        assert!(spawns.len() >= 10, "{map}: found {} spawns", spawns.len());
        for (i, &s) in spawns.iter().enumerate() {
            assert!(!world.is_solid(Hull::Standing, s), "{map} spawn {i} at {s:?} is inside a wall");
            let mut p = Player::new(s);
            for _ in 0..128 {
                tick(&mut world, &mut p, &Input::default());
            }
            assert!(p.on_ground, "{map} spawn {i} never landed: {:?}", p.origin);
            for t in 0..512 {
                let input = Input { forward: 400.0, yaw: t as f32 * 0.7, jump: t % 90 == 0, ..Default::default() };
                tick(&mut world, &mut p, &input);
                assert!(!world.is_solid(p.hull(), p.origin), "{map} spawn {i}: stuck at tick {t}: {:?}", p.origin);
            }
            assert!(p.origin[2] > s[2] - 600.0, "{map} spawn {i}: fell out of the map to {:?}", p.origin);
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn nuke_glass_doors_open_from_their_trigger_and_close_again() {
    let Some(bsp) = load("de_nuke") else { return };
    let mut world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let ents = bsp.entity_list();
    let trig = ents.iter().find(|e| e.get("target").map(String::as_str) == Some("GlassDoor1")).expect("trigger");
    let m = bsp.models[trig["model"][1..].parse::<usize>().unwrap()];
    let centre = [(m.mins[0] + m.maxs[0]) / 2.0, (m.mins[1] + m.maxs[1]) / 2.0, (m.mins[2] + m.maxs[2]) / 2.0];
    let inside = Actor { mins: [centre[0] - 16.0, centre[1] - 16.0, centre[2] - 36.0], maxs: [centre[0] + 16.0, centre[1] + 16.0, centre[2] + 36.0], eye: centre, forward: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], using: false };
    let doors = |w: &World| w.doors.doors.iter().filter(|d| d.name.as_deref() == Some("GlassDoor1")).map(|d| d.state).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    assert!(doors(&world).iter().all(|s| *s == DoorState::Closed));
    for _ in 0..(128 * 3) {
        world.update(DT, &[inside]);
    }
    assert!(doors(&world).iter().all(|s| matches!(s, DoorState::Open(_))), "{:?}", doors(&world));
    // Walk away: after wait (10 s) plus travel they close again.
    for _ in 0..(128 * 20) {
        world.update(DT, &[]);
    }
    assert!(doors(&world).iter().all(|s| *s == DoorState::Closed), "{:?}", doors(&world));
}

#[test]
fn inferno_rotating_door_opens_on_touch_and_lets_you_through() {
    let Some(bsp) = load("de_inferno") else { return };
    let mut world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let door = world.doors.doors[0].clone();
    let (lo, hi) = door.bounds();
    // Stand right next to the closed door's thin side, on whichever side has room.
    let thin = if hi[0] - lo[0] < hi[1] - lo[1] { 0 } else { 1 };
    let mid = [(lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2.0, (lo[1] + hi[1]) / 2.0, lo[2] + 37.0];
    let mut start = mid;
    start[thin] = lo[thin] - 17.0;
    if world.is_solid(Hull::Standing, start) {
        start[thin] = hi[thin] + 17.0;
    }
    let p = Player::new(start);
    for _ in 0..(128 * 2) {
        world.update(DT, &[actor(&p, false)]);
    }
    let d = &world.doors.doors[0];
    assert!(matches!(d.state, DoorState::Open(_) | DoorState::Opening), "{:?}", d.state);
    assert!(d.transform().1[1].abs() > 45.0, "door only rotated to {:?}", d.transform().1);
}

#[test]
fn train_ladder_can_be_climbed() {
    let Some(bsp) = load("de_train") else { return };
    let mut world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    // Find a ladder with standing room in front of its base.
    let ladders = world.ladders.clone();
    let mut climbed = 0;
    for l in &ladders {
        let thin = if l.maxs[0] - l.mins[0] < l.maxs[1] - l.mins[1] { 0 } else { 1 };
        for side in [-1.0f32, 1.0] {
            let mut o = [(l.mins[0] + l.maxs[0]) / 2.0, (l.mins[1] + l.maxs[1]) / 2.0, l.mins[2] + 38.0];
            o[thin] = if side < 0.0 { l.mins[thin] - 16.5 } else { l.maxs[thin] + 16.5 };
            if world.is_solid(Hull::Standing, o) {
                continue;
            }
            // Face the ladder and look up while pressing forward.
            let yaw = if thin == 0 { if side < 0.0 { 0.0 } else { 180.0 } } else if side < 0.0 { 90.0 } else { 270.0 };
            let mut p = Player::new(o);
            let start_z = p.origin[2];
            for _ in 0..128 {
                tick(&mut world, &mut p, &Input { forward: 400.0, yaw, pitch: -60.0, ..Default::default() });
            }
            if p.origin[2] > start_z + 60.0 {
                climbed += 1;
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    assert!(climbed == ladders.len(), "climbed {climbed} of {} ladders", ladders.len());
}

#[test]
fn bullets_hit_floor_walls_and_sky_on_dust2() {
    let Some(bsp) = load("de_dust2") else { return };
    let world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let spawns: Vec<[f32; 3]> = bsp
        .entity_list()
        .iter()
        .filter(|e| e.get("classname").map(String::as_str) == Some("info_player_deathmatch"))
        .map(|e| vec3(&e["origin"]))
        .collect();
    let mut sky_hits = 0;
    for s in &spawns {
        // Where a player lands, the floor is 36 units below its origin.
        let landed = world.trace(Hull::Standing, *s, [s[0], s[1], s[2] - 200.0]).end;
        let down = world.trace_line(landed, [s[0], s[1], s[2] - 200.0]);
        assert!(!down.start_solid && (down.end[2] - (landed[2] - 36.0)).abs() < 1.0, "floor under {landed:?} at {:?}", down.end);
        assert!(down.normal[2] > 0.7);
        // Every direction on the ground plane ends at a wall within the map.
        for yaw in (0..360).step_by(45) {
            let (y, x) = (yaw as f32).to_radians().sin_cos();
            let t = world.trace_line(*s, [s[0] + x * 8192.0, s[1] + y * 8192.0, s[2]]);
            assert!(t.fraction < 1.0, "shot from {s:?} at yaw {yaw} left the map");
        }
        sky_hits += world.trace_line(*s, [s[0], s[1], s[2] + 8192.0]).hit_sky as i32;
    }
    // T spawn on dust2 is outdoors.
    assert!(sky_hits > 0, "no spawn has open sky above it");
}

#[test]
fn hitboxes_from_the_real_player_model() {
    let Some(home) = std::env::var("HOME").ok() else { return };
    let dir = std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_DIR").unwrap_or(format!("{}/../gamedata", env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")));
    let Ok(model) = goldsrc::mdl::Model::load(format!("{dir}/models/player/arctic/arctic.mdl")) else { return };
    use sim::hitbox::{HitGroup, Hitboxes};
    let hb = Hitboxes::from_model(&model, "carbine").expect("aim sequences");
    // Twisting turns the head round the vertical axis, not off it.
    let seq0 = model.sequence("ref_aim_carbine").unwrap();
    let (straight, turned) = (model.player_pose((0, 0.0), (seq0, 0.0), 0.5, 0.0), model.player_pose((0, 0.0), (seq0, 0.0), 0.5, 20.0));
    let head_bone = model.bones.iter().position(|b| b.name == "Bip01 Head").unwrap();
    let (a, b) = (straight[head_bone].pos, turned[head_bone].pos);
    assert!(((a[0] - b[0]).powi(2) + (a[1] - b[1]).powi(2)).sqrt() > 1.0 && (a[2] - b[2]).abs() < 2.0, "{a:?} -> {b:?}");
    // Aim at the posed head's real centre (the rifle aim pose leans the head forward).
    let seq = model.sequence("ref_aim_carbine").unwrap();
    let pose = model.pose(seq, 0, 0.5);
    let head = model.hitboxes.iter().find(|h| h.group == 1).unwrap();
    let c = pose[head.bone].apply([(head.mins[0] + head.maxs[0]) / 2.0, (head.mins[1] + head.maxs[1]) / 2.0, (head.mins[2] + head.maxs[2]) / 2.0]);
    assert!(c[2] > 14.0 && c[2] < 24.0, "head centre at {c:?}");
    let shot = |from: [f32; 3], yaw: f32| {
        let d = [c[0] - from[0], c[1] - from[1], c[2] - from[2]];
        let l = (d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1] + d[2] * d[2]).sqrt();
        hb.trace([0.0; 3], yaw, 0.0, false, sim::weapons::Id::M4a1, from, [d[0] / l, d[1] / l, d[2] / l], 1000.0).map(|h| h.group)
    };
    // From the front-above and from above, the head is the first thing hit.
    assert_eq!(shot([200.0, c[1], c[2] + 60.0], 0.0), Some(HitGroup::Head));
    assert_eq!(shot([c[0], c[1], 300.0], 0.0), Some(HitGroup::Head));
    // Horizontal shots by height: legs low, body in the middle, nothing over the head.
    let level = |z: f32, crouched: bool| hb.trace([0.0; 3], 0.0, 0.0, crouched, sim::weapons::Id::M4a1, [200.0, 0.0, z], [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0], 400.0).map(|h| h.group);
    assert!(matches!(level(-15.0, false), Some(HitGroup::LeftLeg | HitGroup::RightLeg)));
    assert!(matches!(level(10.0, false), Some(HitGroup::Chest | HitGroup::LeftArm | HitGroup::RightArm)));
    assert_eq!(level(30.0, false), None);
    // Close range at eye level (+17) to the face is a headshot; 9 units higher (8° up at
    // 64 units, as an old test aimed) goes over the head.
    let front = |z: f32, w| hb.trace([0.0; 3], 180.0, 0.0, false, w, [-64.0, -c[1], z], [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], 200.0).map(|h| h.group);
    assert_eq!(front(18.0, sim::weapons::Id::M4a1), Some(HitGroup::Head));
    assert_eq!(front(26.0, sim::weapons::Id::M4a1), None);
    // Hitboxes follow the weapon's pose: each gun's real head centre is a headshot, from the side.
    for (w, ext) in [(sim::weapons::Id::Ak47, "ak47"), (sim::weapons::Id::Knife, "knife"), (sim::weapons::Id::Awp, "rifle"), (sim::weapons::Id::Glock, "onehanded")] {
        for (stance, crouched) in [("ref", false), ("crouch", true)] {
            let p = model.pose(model.sequence(&format!("{stance}_aim_{ext}")).unwrap(), 0, 0.5);
            let hc = p[head.bone].apply([(head.mins[0] + head.maxs[0]) / 2.0, (head.mins[1] + head.maxs[1]) / 2.0, (head.mins[2] + head.maxs[2]) / 2.0]);
            let side = hb.trace([0.0; 3], 0.0, 0.0, crouched, w, [hc[0], -200.0, hc[2]], [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], 400.0).map(|h| h.group);
            assert_eq!(side, Some(HitGroup::Head), "{stance} {ext} head at {hc:?}");
        }
    }
    // A rotated player is hit the same way: shooting the head of a player facing +y.
    let rotated = [-c[1], c[0], c[2]];
    let from = [rotated[0], rotated[1], 300.0];
    let d = [0.0, 0.0, -1.0];
    assert_eq!(hb.trace([0.0; 3], 90.0, 0.0, false, sim::weapons::Id::M4a1, from, d, 1000.0).map(|h| h.group), Some(HitGroup::Head));
}

#[test]
fn bullets_know_what_texture_they_hit() {
    let Some(bsp) = load("de_dust2") else { return };
    let world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let s = bsp.entity_list().iter().find(|e| e.get("classname").map(String::as_str) == Some("info_player_deathmatch")).map(|e| vec3(&e["origin"])).unwrap();
    let below = [s[0], s[1], s[2] - 500.0];

        "{}/../gamedata/sound/materials.txt",
        env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")
    )).unwrap_or_default());
    eprintln!("dust2 T spawn floor: {floor} -> material {}", mats.kind(floor));
}

mod shooting {
    use super::*;
    use sim::hitbox::{HitGroup, Hitboxes};
    use sim::weapons::bullets::{fire_bullet, Target};
    use sim::weapons::{gun, Id, Shot};

    fn setup() -> Option<(World, Hitboxes, goldsrc::materials::Materials, [f32; 3])> {
        let bsp = load("de_dust2")?;
        let home = std::env::var("HOME").ok()?;
        let dir = std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_DIR").unwrap_or(format!("{}/../gamedata", env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")));
        let model = goldsrc::mdl::Model::load(format!("{dir}/models/player/arctic/arctic.mdl")).ok()?;
        let mats = goldsrc::materials::Materials::parse(&std::fs::read_to_string(format!("{dir}/sound/materials.txt")).ok()?);
        let world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
        // Stand on the floor at the first T spawn.
        let s = bsp.entity_list().iter().find(|e| e.get("classname").map(String::as_str) == Some("info_player_deathmatch")).map(|e| vec3(&e["origin"]))?;
        let origin = world.trace(Hull::Standing, s, [s[0], s[1], s[2] - 200.0]).end;
        Some((world, Hitboxes::from_model(&model, "carbine")?, mats, origin))
    }

    /// A direction from `origin` with at least `need` units of open floor ahead.
    fn open_direction(world: &World, origin: [f32; 3], need: f32) -> f32 {
        (0..72)
            .map(|i| i as f32 * 5.0)
            .find(|yaw| {
                let (s, c) = yaw.to_radians().sin_cos();
                (0..3).all(|k| {
                    let z = origin[2] - 20.0 + k as f32 * 25.0;
                    world.trace_line([origin[0], origin[1], z], [origin[0] + c * need, origin[1] + s * need, z]).fraction == 1.0
                })
            })
            .expect("some open direction")
    }

    fn ak_shot(pitch: f32, yaw: f32) -> Shot {
        let g = gun(Id::Ak47).unwrap();
        Shot { weapon: Id::Ak47, damage: 36, range_mod: 0.98, penetration: g.penetration, distance: g.distance, bullet: g.bullet, spread: 0.0, angles: [pitch, yaw], seed: 1, pellets: None, silenced: false }
    }

    #[test]
    fn ak_hits_a_player_500_units_away_with_falloff() {
        let Some((world, hb, mats, me)) = setup() else { return };
        let yaw = open_direction(&world, me, 700.0);
        let (s, c) = yaw.to_radians().sin_cos();
        let target = Target { id: 1, origin: [me[0] + c * 500.0, me[1] + s * 500.0, me[2]], yaw: yaw + 180.0, pitch: 0.0, crouched: false, weapon: Id::M4a1, anim: None };
        let eye = [me[0], me[1], me[2] + 17.0];
        // Aim level at chest height (target origin + 9).
        let pitch = -((target.origin[2] + 9.0 - eye[2]) / 500.0).atan().to_degrees();
        let r = fire_bullet(&world, &mats, &hb, eye, &ak_shot(pitch, yaw), 0, &[target]);
        assert_eq!(r.hits.len(), 1, "{r:?}");
        // 36 * 0.98^(500/500) = 35.28 -> 35 (integer), chest x1 / arms x1 / stomach x1.25.
        assert!(matches!(r.hits[0].group, HitGroup::Chest | HitGroup::LeftArm | HitGroup::RightArm | HitGroup::Stomach), "{:?}", r.hits[0]);
        assert!((r.hits[0].damage - 35.0 * sim::combat::hitgroup_multiplier(r.hits[0].group)).abs() < 0.01, "{:?}", r.hits[0]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn bullets_pass_through_one_player_into_the_next() {
        let Some((world, hb, mats, me)) = setup() else { return };
        let yaw = open_direction(&world, me, 700.0);
        let (s, c) = yaw.to_radians().sin_cos();
        let at = |d: f32, id| Target { id, origin: [me[0] + c * d, me[1] + s * d, me[2]], yaw: yaw + 180.0, pitch: 0.0, crouched: false, weapon: Id::M4a1, anim: None };
        let eye = [me[0], me[1], me[2] + 17.0];
        let pitch = -((me[2] + 9.0 - eye[2]) / 300.0).atan().to_degrees();
        let r = fire_bullet(&world, &mats, &hb, eye, &ak_shot(pitch, yaw), 0, &[at(200.0, 1), at(300.0, 2)]);
        assert_eq!(r.hits.iter().map(|h| h.victim).collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![1, 2], "{r:?}");
        let base = |h: &sim::weapons::bullets::BulletHit| h.damage / sim::combat::hitgroup_multiplier(h.group);
        assert!(base(&r.hits[1]) < base(&r.hits[0]) * 0.8, "second victim takes less: {r:?}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_thick_wall_stops_the_bullet() {
        let Some((world, hb, mats, me)) = setup() else { return };
        // Shoot straight down: the bullet hits the floor and the target "under" it is safe.
        let below = Target { id: 1, origin: [me[0], me[1], me[2] - 300.0], yaw: 0.0, pitch: 0.0, crouched: false, weapon: Id::M4a1, anim: None };
        let eye = [me[0], me[1], me[2] + 17.0];
        let r = fire_bullet(&world, &mats, &hb, eye, &ak_shot(89.0, 0.0), 0, &[below]);
        assert!(r.hits.is_empty(), "{r:?}");
        assert!(!r.impacts.is_empty());
    }
}

#[test]
fn bomb_site_a_is_the_right_one_on_each_map() {
    // (map, A site centre, B site centre), from the maps themselves (de_dust2 names them) and
    // what's known of each layout.
    let expected = [("de_train", [264.0, -1280.0], [1296.0, -160.0]), ("de_dust2", [1152.0, 2464.0], [-1536.0, 2688.0]), ("de_inferno", [1984.0, 456.0], [288.0, 2784.0]), ("de_nuke", [680.0, -776.0], [648.0, -904.0]), ("de_mirage", [-688.0, -1168.0], [-2312.0, 1288.0])];
    for (map, a, b) in expected {
        let Some(bsp) = load(map) else { continue };
        let sites = sim::zones::Zones::from_bsp(&bsp).sites_a_first(map);
        let near = |s: [f32; 3], p: [f32; 2]| (s[0] - p[0]).abs() < 1.0 && (s[1] - p[1]).abs() < 1.0;
        assert!(near(sites[0], a) && near(sites[1], b), "{map}: {sites:?}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn closed_doors_block_sight_open_ones_and_glass_dont() {
    let Some(bsp) = load("de_inferno") else { return };
    let mut world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let (lo, hi) = world.doors.doors[0].bounds();
    // A line straight through the middle of the closed door.
    let thin = if hi[0] - lo[0] < hi[1] - lo[1] { 0 } else { 1 };
    let mid = [(lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2.0, (lo[1] + hi[1]) / 2.0, lo[2] + 40.0];
    let (mut a, mut b) = (mid, mid);
    a[thin] = lo[thin] - 40.0;
    b[thin] = hi[thin] + 40.0;
    assert!(world.sight_blocked(a, b), "seen through a closed door");
    let mut p = Player::new(a);
    p.origin[thin] = lo[thin] - 17.0;
    for _ in 0..(128 * 2) {
        world.update(DT, &[actor(&p, false)]);
    }
    assert!(matches!(world.doors.doors[0].state, DoorState::Open(_)), "{:?}", world.doors.doors[0].state);
    assert!(!world.sight_blocked(a, b), "an open door still blocks sight");

    // Nuke's glass doors: closed, but see-through.
    let Some(bsp) = load("de_nuke") else { return };
    let world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let d = world.doors.doors.iter().find(|d| d.name.as_deref() == Some("GlassDoor1")).unwrap();
    let (lo, hi) = d.bounds();
    let thin = if hi[0] - lo[0] < hi[1] - lo[1] { 0 } else { 1 };
    // Somewhere across its face a line meets the glass first (not its frame) and still sees through.
    let wide = 1 - thin;
    let through_glass = (1..10).flat_map(|i| (1..10).map(move |k| (i, k))).any(|(i, k)| {
        let mut a = [0.0; 3];
        a[wide] = lo[wide] + (hi[wide] - lo[wide]) * i as f32 / 10.0;
        a[2] = lo[2] + (hi[2] - lo[2]) * k as f32 / 10.0;
        let mut b = a;
        a[thin] = lo[thin] - 40.0;
        b[thin] = hi[thin] + 40.0;
        world.trace_line(a, b).model == d.model && !world.sight_blocked(a, b)
    });
    assert!(through_glass, "glass hides players");
}

#[test]
fn knife_line_first_then_a_crouch_box_sweep() {
    use sim::hitbox::{HitGroup, Hitboxes};
    use sim::weapons::bullets::{trace_melee, Target};
    use sim::weapons::Id;
    let Some(bsp) = load("de_dust2") else { return };
    let home = std::env::var("HOME").unwrap();
    let dir = std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_DIR").unwrap_or(format!("{}/../gamedata", env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")));
    let Ok(model) = goldsrc::mdl::Model::load(format!("{dir}/models/player/arctic/arctic.mdl")) else { return };
    let hb = Hitboxes::from_model(&model, "carbine").unwrap();
    let world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let s = bsp.entity_list().iter().find(|e| e.get("classname").map(String::as_str) == Some("info_player_deathmatch")).map(|e| vec3(&e["origin"])).unwrap();
    let me = world.trace(Hull::Standing, s, [s[0], s[1], s[2] - 200.0]).end;
    // An open direction: 100 units clear at eye height.
    let eye = [me[0], me[1], me[2] + 17.0];
    let yaw = (0..72).map(|i| i as f32 * 5.0).find(|y| {
        let (s, c) = y.to_radians().sin_cos();
        world.trace(Hull::Crouched, eye, [eye[0] + c * 100.0, eye[1] + s * 100.0, eye[2]]).fraction == 1.0
    }).unwrap();
    let (sn, cs) = yaw.to_radians().sin_cos();
    let end = [eye[0] + cs * 48.0, eye[1] + sn * 48.0, eye[2]];
    // Someone `side` units to the side of the swing, 40 ahead.
    let at = |side: f32| Target { id: 1, origin: [me[0] + cs * 40.0 - sn * side, me[1] + sn * 40.0 + cs * side, me[2]], yaw: yaw + 180.0, pitch: 0.0, crouched: false, weapon: Id::M4a1, anim: None };
    let hit = |side| trace_melee(&world, &hb, eye, end, 0, &[at(side)]);
    assert!(matches!(hit(0.0), Some((1, g)) if g != HitGroup::Generic), "straight on: the line hits a body part");
    // Off to the side: the line misses, the box (16 + their 16) still catches them.
    assert_eq!(hit(28.0), Some((1, HitGroup::Generic)));
    assert_eq!(hit(-28.0), Some((1, HitGroup::Generic)));
    assert_eq!(hit(40.0), None, "out of reach");
}

#[test]
fn bullets_read_the_texture_of_the_glass_they_hit() {
    let Some(bsp) = load("de_nuke") else { return };
    let world = World::from_bsp(&bsp);
    let home = std::env::var("HOME").unwrap();
    let dir = std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_DIR").unwrap_or(format!("{}/../gamedata", env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")));
    let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(format!("{dir}/sound/materials.txt")) else { return };
    let mats = goldsrc::materials::Materials::parse(&text);
    let d = world.doors.doors.iter().find(|d| d.name.as_deref() == Some("GlassDoor1")).unwrap();
    let (lo, hi) = d.bounds();
    let thin = if hi[0] - lo[0] < hi[1] - lo[1] { 0 } else { 1 };
    let wide = 1 - thin;
    let (a, b) = (1..10)
        .flat_map(|i| (1..10).map(move |k| (i, k)))
        .map(|(i, k)| {
            let mut a = [0.0; 3];
            a[wide] = lo[wide] + (hi[wide] - lo[wide]) * i as f32 / 10.0;
            a[2] = lo[2] + (hi[2] - lo[2]) * k as f32 / 10.0;
            let mut b = a;
            a[thin] = lo[thin] - 40.0;
            b[thin] = hi[thin] + 40.0;
            (a, b)
        })
        .find(|(a, b)| world.trace_line(*a, *b).model == d.model)
        .expect("a line that meets the glass");
    let tex = world.texture_of(d.model, a, b).expect("the glass's texture");
    assert_eq!(mats.kind(tex), 'Y', "{tex} isn't glass");
}

#[test]
fn animated_hitboxes_follow_the_model() {
    use sim::anim::{Anim, Drive};
    use sim::hitbox::{HitGroup, Hitboxes};
    use sim::weapons::Id;
    let Some(home) = std::env::var("HOME").ok() else { return };
    let dir = std::env::var("BOOTLEG16_DIR").unwrap_or(format!("{}/../gamedata", env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")));
    let Ok(model) = goldsrc::mdl::Model::load(format!("{dir}/models/player/arctic/arctic.mdl")) else { return };
    let hb = Hitboxes::from_model(&model, "carbine").unwrap();
    // Standing at the origin, looking at the shooter (who stands 200 units east, looking west).
    let drive = |origin: [f32; 3]| Drive { origin, yaw: 0.0, pitch: 0.0, crouched: false, airborne: false, reloading: false, weapon: Id::M4a1 };
    let mut a = Anim::new(0.0);
    for i in 0..128 {
        a.step(&model, &drive([0.0; 3]), i as f32 / 128.0, 1.0 / 128.0);
    }
    let posed = a.pose(&model, &drive([0.0; 3]), 1.0);
    let shot = |p: &sim::anim::Posed, z: f32| hb.trace_posed(p, [0.0; 3], [200.0, 0.0, z], [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0], 400.0).map(|h| h.group);
    // Same as the plain aim pose for someone standing still.
    // The head is up top and the body below it, as the model stands.
    let groups: Vec<_> = (0..40).filter_map(|i| shot(&posed, -36.0 + i as f32 * 1.8)).collect();
    assert!(groups.contains(&HitGroup::Head) && groups.iter().any(|g| matches!(g, HitGroup::LeftLeg | HitGroup::RightLeg)), "{groups:?}");
    // Strafing north while still looking at the shooter: legs turn, the chest still faces them.
    let mut s = Anim::new(0.0);
    for i in 0..128 {
        s.step(&model, &drive([0.0, i as f32 * 2.0, 0.0]), i as f32 / 128.0, 1.0 / 128.0);
    }
    assert!((s.gait_yaw - 90.0).abs() < 1.0, "legs face {}", s.gait_yaw);
    let at = [0.0, 254.0, 0.0];
    let p = s.pose(&model, &drive(at), 1.0);
    // The upper body turns back to the view: the chest faces the same way in the world as
    // standing still (the model itself faces the legs' way, 90 degrees round).
    let bone = |n: &str| model.bones.iter().position(|b| b.name == n).unwrap();
    let (l, r) = (bone("Bip01 L UpperArm"), bone("Bip01 R UpperArm"));
    // Where the chest faces (degrees, world): square to the shoulder line.
    let facing = |p: &sim::anim::Posed| {
        let (a, b) = (p.bones[l].pos, p.bones[r].pos);
        let (dx, dy) = (b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); // left shoulder -> right shoulder
        // Facing is the shoulder line turned 90 degrees anticlockwise (right is to its right).
        dx.atan2(-dy).to_degrees() + p.yaw
    };
    let wrap = |a: f32| (a + 540.0).rem_euclid(360.0) - 180.0;
    let (f0, f1) = (wrap(facing(&posed)), wrap(facing(&p)));
    assert!(wrap(f1 - f0).abs() < 25.0, "chest faces {f1} strafing vs {f0} standing");
}
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# A personal offline copy of the game for your own other machine: the release build plus the
# game data (gamedata). It holds Valve's files: never publish or share it.
#
#   cargo build --release -p client --no-default-features --features steam
#   tools/bundle.sh              -> dist/bootleg16-linux.tar.gz
#
# On the other machine: unpack anywhere, run ./play.sh (Practice > Solo works offline).
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
game="${BOOTLEG16_DIR:-gamedata}"
[ -x target/release/client ] || { echo "Build the release first (see the top of this file)."; exit 1; }
[ -d "$game/maps" ] || { echo "No game data at $game (set BOOTLEG16_DIR)."; exit 1; }
out=dist/bootleg16
rm -rf "$out"
mkdir -p "$out/data"
cp target/release/client "$out/bootleg16"
# Smaller without debug symbols (crash traces lose line numbers; fine for a test copy).
command -v strip >/dev/null && strip "$out/bootleg16"
[ -f target/release/libsteam_api.so ] && cp target/release/libsteam_api.so "$out/"
# Opus (voice chat) isn't on every Linux: bring ours (the game looks next to itself first).
opus=$(ldd target/release/client | awk '/libopus/ {print $3}')
[ -n "$opus" ] && cp "$opus" "$out/"
# The game data (the game finds `data/` next to itself).
cp -r "$game"/. "$out/data/"
cat > "$out/play.sh" <<'RUN'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Start bootleg16 with its data next to it.
here="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
BOOTLEG16_DIR="$here/data" exec "$here/bootleg16" "$@"
RUN
chmod +x "$out/play.sh" "$out/bootleg16"
tar czf dist/bootleg16-linux.tar.gz -C dist bootleg16
echo "dist/bootleg16-linux.tar.gz ($(du -h dist/bootleg16-linux.tar.gz | cut -f1)): copy it over, unpack, run ./play.sh"
```
